janmādyasya yato'nvayāditarataścārtheṣvabhijñaḥ svarāṭ  tene brahma hṛdā ya ādikavaye muhyanti yatsūrayaḥ  |
tejovārimṛdāṃ yathā vinimayo yatra trisargo'mṛṣā   dhāmnā svena sadā nirastakuhakaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ dhīmahi  || 01.01.001 ||*
dharmaḥ projjhitakaitavo'tra paramo nirmatsarāṇāṃ satāṃ   vedyaṃ vāstavamatra vastu śivadaṃ tāpatrayonmūlanam  |
śrīmadbhāgavate mahāmunikṛte kiṃ vā parairīśvaraḥ   sadyo hṛdyavarudhyate'tra kṛtibhiḥ śuśrūṣubhistatkṣaṇāt || 01.01.002 ||*
nigamakalpatarorgalitaṃ phalaṃ   śukamukhādamṛtadravasaṃyutam  |
pibata bhāgavataṃ rasamālayaṃ   muhuraho rasikā bhuvi bhāvukāḥ  || 01.01.003 ||*
naimiṣe'nimiṣakṣetre īśayaḥ śaunakādayaḥ  |
satraṃ svargāya lokāya sahasrasamamāsata  || 01.01.004 ||
ta ekadā tu munayaḥ prātarhutahutāgnayaḥ  |
satkṛtaṃ sūtamāsīnaṃ papracchuridamādarāt || 01.01.005 ||
01.01.006|0 ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
tvayā khalu purāṇāni setihāsāni cānagha  |
ākhyātānyapyadhītāni dharmaśāstrāṇi yānyuta  || 01.01.006 ||
yāni vedavidāṃ śreṣṭho bhagavān bādarāyaṇaḥ  |
anye ca munayaḥ sūta parāvaravido viduḥ  || 01.01.007 ||
vettha tvaṃ saumya tatsarvaṃ tattvatastadanugrahāt |
brūyuḥ snigdhasya śiṣyasya guravo guhyamapyuta  || 01.01.008 ||
tatra tatrāñjasāyuṣman bhavatā yadviniścitam  |
puṃsāmekāntataḥ śreyastannaḥ śaṃsitumarhasi  || 01.01.009 ||
prāyeṇālpāyuṣaḥ sabhya kalāvasmin yuge janāḥ  |
mandāḥ sumandamatayo mandabhāgyā hyupadrutāḥ  || 01.01.010 ||
bhūrīṇi bhūrikarmāṇi śrotavyāni vibhāgaśaḥ  |
ataḥ sādho'tra yatsāraṃ samuddhṛtya manīṣayā  |
brūhi bhadrāya bhūtānāṃ yenātmā suprasīdati  || 01.01.011 ||
sūta jānāsi bhadraṃ te bhagavān sātvatāṃ patiḥ  |
devakyāṃ vasudevasya jāto yasya cikīrṣayā  || 01.01.012 ||
tannaḥ śuṣrūṣamāṇānāmarhasyaṅgānuvarṇitum  |
yasyāvatāro bhūtānāṃ kṣemāya ca bhavāya ca  || 01.01.013 ||
āpannaḥ saṃsṛtiṃ ghorāṃ yannāma vivaśo gṛṇan  |
tataḥ sadyo vimucyeta yadbibheti svayaṃ bhayam  || 01.01.014 ||
yatpādasaṃśrayāḥ sūta munayaḥ praśamāyanāḥ  |
sadyaḥ punantyupaspṛṣṭāḥ svardhunyāpo'nusevayā  || 01.01.015 ||
ko vā bhagavatastasya puṇyaślokeḍyakarmaṇaḥ  |
śuddhikāmo na śṛṇuyādyaśaḥ kalimalāpaham  || 01.01.016 ||
tasya karmāṇyudārāṇi parigītāni sūribhiḥ  |
brūhi naḥ śraddadhānānāṃ līlayā dadhataḥ kalāḥ  || 01.01.017 ||
athākhyāhi harerdhīmannavatārakathāḥ śubhāḥ  |
īlā vidadhataḥ svairamīśvarasyātmamāyayā  || 01.01.018 ||
vayaṃ tu na vitṛpyāma uttamaślokavikrame  |
yacchṛṇvatāṃ rasajñānāṃ svādu svādu pade pade  || 01.01.019 ||
kṛtavān kila karmāṇi saha rāmeṇa keśavaḥ  |
atimartyāni bhagavān gūḍhaḥ kapaṭamānuṣaḥ  || 01.01.020 ||
kalimāgatamājñāya kṣetre'smin vaiṣṇave vayam  |
āsīnā dīrghasatreṇa kathāyāṃ sakṣaṇā hareḥ  || 01.01.021 ||
tvaṃ naḥ sandarśito dhātrā dustaraṃ nistitīrṣatām  |
kaliṃ sattvaharaṃ puṃsāṃ karṇadhāra ivārṇavam  || 01.01.022 ||
brūhi yogeśvare kṛṣṇe brahmaṇye dharmavarmaṇi  |
svāṃ kāṣṭhāmadhunopete dharmaḥ kaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ  || 01.01.023 ||
01.02.001|0 vyāsa uvāca
iti sampraśnasaṃhṛṣṭo viprāṇāṃ raumaharśaṇiḥ  |
pratipūjya vacasteśāṃ pravaktumupacakrame  || 01.02.001 ||
01.02.002|0 sūta uvāca
yaṃ pravrajantamanupetamapetakṛtyaṃ dvaipāyano virahakātara ājuhāva  |
putreti tanmayatayā taravo'bhinedustaṃ sarvabhūtahṛdayaṃ munimānato'smi  || 01.02.002 ||
yaḥ svānubhāvamakhilaśrutisāramekamadhyātmadīpamatititīrṣatāṃ tamo'ndham  |
saṃsāriṇāṃ karuṇayāha purāṇaguhyaṃ taṃ vyāsasūnumupayāmi guruṃ munīnām  || 01.02.003 ||
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam  |
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet || 01.02.004 ||
munayaḥ sādhu pṛṣṭo'haṃ bhavadbhirlokamaṅgalam  |
yatkṛtaḥ kṛṣṇasampraśno yenātmā suprasīdati  || 01.02.005 ||
sa vai puṃsāṃ paro dharmo yato bhaktiradhokṣaje  |
ahaitukyapratihatā yayātmā suprasīdati  || 01.02.006 ||
vāsudeve bhagavati bhaktiyogaḥ prayojitaḥ  |
janayatyāśu vairāgyaṃ jñānaṃ ca yadahaitukam  || 01.02.007 ||
dharmaḥ svanuṣṭhitaḥ puṃsāṃ viṣvaksenakathāsu yaḥ  |
notpādayedyadi ratiṃ śrama eva hi kevalam  || 01.02.008 ||
dharmasya hyāpavargyasya nārtho'rthāyopakalpate  |
nārthasya dharmaikāntasya kāmo lābhāya hi smṛtaḥ  || 01.02.009 ||
kāmasya nendriyaprītirlābho jīveta yāvatā  |
jīvasya tattvajijñāsā nārtho yaśceha karmabhiḥ  || 01.02.010 ||
vadanti tattattvavidastattvaṃ yajjñānamadvayam  |
brahmeti paramātmeti bhagavāniti śabdyate  || 01.02.011 ||
tacchraddadhānā munayo jñānavairāgyayuktayā  |
paśyantyātmani cātmānaṃ bhaktyā śrutagṛhītayā  || 01.02.012 ||
ataḥ pumbhirdvijaśreṣṭhā varṇāśramavibhāgaśaḥ  |
svanuṣṭhitasya dharmasya saṃsiddhirharitoṣaṇam  || || 01.02.013 || ||
tasmādekena manasā bhagavān sātvatāṃ patiḥ  |
śrotavyaḥ kīrtitavyaśca dhyeyaḥ pūjyaśca nityadā  || 01.02.014 ||
yadanudhyāsinā yuktāḥ karmagranthinibandhanam  |
chindanti kovidāstasya ko na kuryātkathāratim  || 01.02.015 ||
śuśrūṣoḥ śraddadhānasya vāsudevakathāruciḥ  |
syānmahatsevayā viprāḥ puṇyatīrthaniṣevaṇāt || 01.02.016 ||
śṛṇvatāṃ svakathāḥ kṛṣṇaḥ puṇyaśravaṇakīrtanaḥ  |
hṛdyantaḥstho hyabhadrāṇi vidhunoti suhṛtsatām  || 01.02.017 ||
naṣṭaprāyeṣvabhadreṣu nityaṃ bhāgavatasevayā  |
bhagavatyuttamaśloke bhaktirbhavati naiṣṭhikī  || 01.02.018 ||
tadā rajastamobhāvāḥ kāmalobhādayaśca ye  |
ceta etairanāviddhaṃ sthitaṃ sattve prasīdati  || 01.02.019 ||
evaṃ prasannamanaso bhagavadbhaktiyogataḥ  |
bhagavattattvavijñānaṃ muktasaṅgasya jāyate  || 01.02.020 ||
bhidyate hṛdayagranthiśchidyante sarvasaṃśayāḥ  |
kṣīyante cāsya karmāṇi dṛṣṭa evātmanīśvare  || 01.02.021 ||
ato vai kavayo nityaṃ bhaktiṃ paramayā mudā  |
vāsudeve bhagavati kurvantyātmaprasādanīm  || 01.02.022 ||
sattvaṃ rajastama iti prakṛterguṇāstairyuktaḥ paramapuruṣa eka ihāsya dhatte  |
sthityādaye hariviriñcihareti saṃjñāḥ śreyāṃsi tatra khalu sattvatanornṛṇāṃ syuḥ  || 01.02.023 ||
pārthivāddāruṇo dhūmastasmādagnistrayīmayaḥ  |
tamasastu rajastasmātsattvaṃ yadbrahmadarśanam  || 01.02.024 ||
bhejire munayo'thāgre bhagavantamadhokṣajam  |
sattvaṃ viśuddhaṃ kṣemāya kalpante ye'nu tāniha  || 01.02.025 ||
mumukṣavo ghorarūpān hitvā bhūtapatīnatha  |
nārāyaṇakalāḥ śāntā bhajanti hyanasūyavaḥ  || 01.02.026 ||
rajastamaḥprakṛtayaḥ samaśīlā bhajanti vai  |
pitṛbhūtaprajeśādīn śriyaiśvaryaprajepsavaḥ  || 01.02.027 ||
vāsudevaparā vedā vāsudevaparā makhāḥ  |
vāsudevaparā yoga vāsudevaparāḥ kriyāḥ  || 01.02.028 ||
vāsudevaparaṃ jñānaṃ vāsudevaparaṃ tapaḥ  |
vāsudevaparo dharmo vāsudevaparā gatiḥ  || 01.02.029 ||
sa evedaṃ sasarjāgre bhagavānātmamāyayā  |
sadasadrūpayā cāsau guṇamayāguṇo vibhuḥ  || 01.02.030 ||
tayā vilasiteṣveṣu guṇeṣu guṇavāniva  |
antaḥpraviṣṭa ābhāti vijñānena vijṛmbhitaḥ  || 01.02.031 ||
yathā hyavahito vahnirdāruṣvekaḥ svayoniṣu  |
nāneva bhāti viśvātmā bhūteṣu ca tathā pumān  || 01.02.032 ||
asau guṇamayairbhāvairbhūtasūkṣmendriyātmabhiḥ  |
svanirmiteṣu nirviṣṭo bhuṅkte bhūteṣu tadguṇān  || 01.02.033 ||
bhāvayatyeṣa sattvena lokān vai lokabhāvanaḥ  |
līlāvatārānurato devatiryaṅnarādiṣu  || 01.02.034 ||
01.03.001|0 sūta uvāca
jagṛhe pauruṣaṃ rūpaṃ bhagavānmahadādibhiḥ  |
sambhūtaṃ ṣoḍaśakalamādau lokasisṛkṣayā  || 01.03.001 ||
yasyāmbhasi śayānasya yoganidrāṃ vitanvataḥ  |
nābhihradāmbujādāsīdbrahmā viśvasṛjāṃ patiḥ  || 01.03.002 ||
yasyāvayavasaṃsthānaiḥ kalpito lokavistaraḥ  |
tadvai bhagavato rūpaṃ viśuddhaṃ sattvamūrjitam  || 01.03.003 ||
paśyantyado rūpamadabhracakṣuṣā sahasrapādorubhujānanādbhutam  |
sahasramūrdhaśravaṇākṣināsikaṃ sahasramaulyambarakuṇḍalollasat || 01.03.004 ||
etannānāvatārāṇāṃ nidhānaṃ bījamavyayam  |
yasyāṃśāṃśena sṛjyante devatiryaṅnarādayaḥ  || 01.03.005 ||
sa eva prathamaṃ devaḥ kaumāraṃ sargamāśritaḥ  |
cacāra duścaraṃ brahmā brahmacaryamakhaṇḍitam  || 01.03.006 ||
dvitīyaṃ tu bhavāyāsya rasātalagatāṃ mahīm  |
uddhariṣyannupādatta yajñeśaḥ saukaraṃ vapuḥ  || 01.03.007 ||
tṛtīyamṛṣisargaṃ vai devarṣitvamupetya saḥ  |
tantraṃ sātvatamācaṣṭa naiṣkarmyaṃ karmaṇāṃ yataḥ  || 01.03.008 ||
turye dharmakalāsarge naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī  |
bhūtvātmopaśamopetamakarodduścaraṃ tapaḥ  || 01.03.009 ||
pañcamaḥ kapilo nāma siddheśaḥ kālaviplutam  |
provācāsuraye sāṅkhyaṃ tattvagrāmavinirṇayam  || 01.03.010 ||
ṣaṣṭhamatrerapatyatvaṃ vṛtaḥ prāpto'nasūyayā  |
ānvīkṣikīmalarkāya prahlādādibhya ūcivān  || 01.03.011 ||
tataḥ saptama ākūtyāṃ ruceryajño'bhyajāyata  |
sa yāmādyaiḥ suragaṇairapātsvāyambhuvāntaram  || 01.03.012 ||
aṣṭame merudevyāṃ tu nābherjāta urukramaḥ  |
darśayan vartma dhīrāṇāṃ sarvāśramanamaskṛtam  || 01.03.013 ||
ṛṣibhiryācito bheje navamaṃ pārthivaṃ vapuḥ  |
dugdhemāmoṣadhīrviprāstenāyaṃ sa uśattamaḥ  || 01.03.014 ||
rūpaṃ sa jagṛhe mātsyaṃ cākṣuṣodadhisamplave  |
nāvyāropya mahīmayyāmapādvaivasvataṃ manum  || 01.03.015 ||
surāsurāṇāmudadhiṃ mathnatāṃ mandarācalam  |
dadhre kamaṭharūpeṇa pṛṣṭha ekādaśe vibhuḥ  || 01.03.016 ||
dhānvantaraṃ dvādaśamaṃ trayodaśamameva ca  |
apāyayatsurānanyānmohinyā mohayan striyā  || 01.03.017 ||
caturdaśaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ bibhraddaityendramūrjitam  |
dadāra karajairūrāverakāṃ kaṭakṛdyathā  || 01.03.018 ||
pañcadaśaṃ vāmanakaṃ kṛtvāgādadhvaraṃ baleḥ  |
padatrayaṃ yācamānaḥ pratyāditsustripiṣṭapam  || 01.03.019 ||
avatāre ṣoḍaśame paśyan brahmadruho nṛpān  |
triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ kupito niḥkṣatrāmakaronmahīm  || 01.03.020 ||
tataḥ saptadaśe jātaḥ satyavatyāṃ parāśarāt |
cakre vedataroḥ śākhā dṛṣṭvā puṃso'lpamedhasaḥ  || 01.03.021 ||
naradevatvamāpannaḥ surakāryacikīrṣayā  |
samudranigrahādīni cakre vīryāṇyataḥ param  || 01.03.022 ||
ekonaviṃśe viṃśatime vṛṣṇiṣu prāpya janmanī  |
rāmakṛṣṇāviti bhuvo bhagavānaharadbharam  || 01.03.023 ||
tataḥ kalau sampravṛtte sammohāya suradviṣām  |
buddho nāmnāñjanasutaḥ kīkaṭeṣu bhaviṣyati  || 01.03.024 ||
athāsau yugasandhyāyāṃ dasyuprāyeṣu rājasu  |
janitā viṣṇuyaśaso nāmnā kalkirjagatpatiḥ  || 01.03.025 ||
avatārā hyasaṅkhyeyā hareḥ sattvanidherdvijāḥ  |
yathāvidāsinaḥ kulyāḥ sarasaḥ syuḥ sahasraśaḥ  || 01.03.026 ||
ṛṣayo manavo devā manuputrā mahaujasaḥ  |
kalāḥ sarve harereva saprajāpatayaḥ smṛtāḥ  || 01.03.027 ||
ete cāṃśakalāḥ puṃsaḥ kṛṣṇastu bhagavān svayam  |
indrārivyākulaṃ lokaṃ mṛḍayanti yuge yuge  || 01.03.028 ||
janma guhyaṃ bhagavato ya etatprayato naraḥ  |
sāyaṃ prātargṛṇan bhaktyā duḥkhagrāmādvimucyate  || 01.03.029 ||
etadrūpaṃ bhagavato hyarūpasya cidātmanaḥ  |
māyāguṇairviracitaṃ mahadādibhirātmani  || 01.03.030 ||
yathā nabhasi meghaugho reṇurvā pārthivo'nile  |
evaṃ draṣṭari dṛśyatvamāropitamabuddhibhiḥ  || 01.03.031 ||
ataḥ paraṃ yadavyaktamavyūḍhaguṇabṛṃhitam  |
adṛṣṭāśrutavastutvātsa jīvo yatpunarbhavaḥ  || 01.03.032 ||
yatreme sadasadrūpe pratiṣiddhe svasaṃvidā  |
avidyayātmani kṛte iti tadbrahmadarśanam  || 01.03.033 ||
yadyeṣoparatā devī māyā vaiśāradī matiḥ  |
sampanna eveti vidurmahimni sve mahīyate  || 01.03.034 ||
evaṃ ca janmāni karmāṇi hyakarturajanasya ca  |
varṇayanti sma kavayo vedaguhyāni hṛtpateḥ  || 01.03.035 ||
sa vā idaṃ viśvamamoghalīlaḥ sṛjatyavatyatti na sajjate'smin  |
bhūteṣu cāntarhita ātmatantraḥ ṣāḍvargikaṃ jighrati ṣaḍguṇeśaḥ  || 01.03.036 ||
na cāsya kaścinnipuṇena dhāturavaiti jantuḥ kumanīṣa ūtīḥ  |
nāmāni rūpāṇi manovacobhiḥ santanvato naṭacaryāmivājñaḥ  || 01.03.037 ||
sa veda dhātuḥ padavīṃ parasya durantavīryasya rathāṅgapāṇeḥ  |
yo'māyayā santatayānuvṛttyā bhajeta tatpādasarojagandham  || 01.03.038 ||
atheha dhanyā bhagavanta itthaṃ yadvāsudeve'khilalokanāthe  |
kurvanti sarvātmakamātmabhāvaṃ na yatra bhūyaḥ parivarta ugraḥ  || 01.03.039 ||
idaṃ bhāgavataṃ nāma purāṇaṃ brahmasammitam  |
uttamaślokacaritaṃ cakāra bhagavānṛṣiḥ  || 01.03.040 ||
niḥśreyasāya lokasya dhanyaṃ svastyayanaṃ mahat |
tadidaṃ grāhayāmāsasutamātmavatāṃ varam  || 01.03.041 ||
sarvavedetihāsānāṃ sāraṃ sāraṃ samuddhṛtam  |
sa tu saṃśrāvayāmāsamahārājaṃ parīkṣitam  || 01.03.042 ||
prāyopaviṣṭaṃ gaṅgāyāṃ parītaṃ paramarṣibhiḥ  |
kṛṣṇe svadhāmopagate dharmajñānādibhiḥ saha  || 01.03.043 ||
kalau naṣṭadṛśāmeṣa purāṇārko'dhunoditaḥ  |
tatra kīrtayato viprā viprarṣerbhūritejasaḥ  || 01.03.044 ||
ahaṃ cādhyagamaṃ tatra niviṣṭastadanugrahāt |
so'haṃ vaḥ śrāvayiṣyāmi yathādhītaṃ yathāmati  || 01.03.045 ||
01.04.001|0 vyāsa uvāca
iti bruvāṇaṃ saṃstūya munīnāṃ dīrghasatriṇām  |
vṛddhaḥ kulapatiḥ sūtaṃ bahvṛcaḥ śaunako'bravīt || 01.04.001 ||
01.04.002|0 śaunaka uvāca
sūta sūta mahābhāga vada no vadatāṃ vara  |
kathāṃ bhāgavatīṃ puṇyāṃ yadāha bhagavāñchukaḥ  || 01.04.002 ||
kasmin yuge pravṛtteyaṃ sthāne vā kena hetunā  |
kutaḥ sañcoditaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛtavān saṃhitāṃ muniḥ  || 01.04.003 ||
tasya putro mahāyogī samadṛṅnirvikalpakaḥ  |
ekāntamatirunnidro gūḍho mūḍha iveyate  || 01.04.004 ||
dṛṣṭvānuyāntamṛṣimātmajamapyanagnaṃ devyo hriyā paridadhurna sutasya citram  |
tadvīkṣya pṛcchati munau jagadustavāsti strīpumbhidā na tu sutasya viviktadṛṣṭeḥ  || 01.04.005 ||
kathamālakṣitaḥ pauraiḥ samprāptaḥ kurujāṅgalān  |
unmattamūkajaḍavadvicaran gajasāhvaye  || 01.04.006 ||
kathaṃ vā pāṇḍaveyasya rājarṣermuninā saha  |
saṃvādaḥ samabhūttāta yatraiṣā sātvatī śrutiḥ  || 01.04.007 ||
sa godohanamātraṃ hi gṛheṣu gṛhamedhinām  |
avekṣate mahābhāgastīrthīkurvaṃstadāśramam  || 01.04.008 ||
abhimanyusutaṃ sūta prāhurbhāgavatottamam  |
tasya janma mahāścaryaṃ karmāṇi ca gṛṇīhi naḥ  || 01.04.009 ||
sa samrāṭkasya vā hetoḥ pāṇḍūnāṃ mānavardhanaḥ  |
prāyopaviṣṭo gaṅgāyāmanādṛtyādhirāṭśriyam  || 01.04.010 ||
namanti yatpādaniketamātmanaḥ śivāya hānīya dhanāni śatravaḥ  |

01.04.014|0 sūta uvāca

tasyaivaṃ khilamātmānaṃ manyamānasya khidyataḥ  |

01.05.008|0 śrīnārada uvāca
bhavatānuditaprāyaṃ yaśo bhagavato'malam  |

vicakṣaṇo'syārhati vedituṃ vibhoranantapārasya nivṛttitaḥ sukham  |

tvamātmanātmānamavehyamoghadṛkparasya puṃsaḥ paramātmanaḥ kalām  |

jñānaṃ guhyatamaṃ yattatsākṣādbhagavatoditam  |

yenaivāhaṃ bhagavato vāsudevasya vedhasaḥ  |

01.06.005|0 nārada uvāca

sakṛdyaddarśitaṃ rūpametatkāmāya te'nagha  |

na hyasya karhicidrājan pumān veda vidhitsitam  |
yadvijijñāsayā yuktā muhyanti kavayo'pi hi  || 01.09.016 ||
tasmādidaṃ daivatantraṃ vyavasya bharatarṣabha  |
tasyānuvihito'nāthā nātha pāhi prajāḥ prabho  || 01.09.017 ||
eṣa vai bhagavān sākṣādādyo nārāyaṇaḥ pumān  |
mohayanmāyayā lokaṃ gūḍhaścarati vṛṣṇiṣu  || 01.09.018 ||
asyānubhāvaṃ bhagavān veda guhyatamaṃ śivaḥ  |
devarṣirnāradaḥ sākṣādbhagavān kapilo nṛpa  || 01.09.019 ||
yaṃ manyase mātuleyaṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ suhṛttamam  |
akaroḥ sacivaṃ dūtaṃ sauhṛdādatha sārathim  || 01.09.020 ||
sarvātmanaḥ samadṛśo hyadvayasyānahaṅkṛteḥ  |
tatkṛtaṃ mativaiṣamyaṃ niravadyasya na kvacit || 01.09.021 ||
tathāpyekāntabhakteṣu paśya bhūpānukampitam  |
yanme'sūṃstyajataḥ sākṣātkṛṣṇo darśanamāgataḥ  || 01.09.022 ||
bhaktyāveśya mano yasmin vācā yannāma kīrtayan  |
tyajan kalevaraṃ yogī mucyate kāmakarmabhiḥ  || 01.09.023 ||
sa devadevo bhagavān pratīkṣatāṃ kalevaraṃ yāvadidaṃ hinomyaham  |
prasannahāsāruṇalocanollasanmukhāmbujo dhyānapathaścaturbhujaḥ  || 01.09.024 ||
01.09.025|0 sūta uvāca
yudhiṣṭhirastadākarṇya śayānaṃ śarapañjare  |
apṛcchadvividhān dharmānṛṣīṇāṃ cānuśṛṇvatām  || 01.09.025 ||
puruṣasvabhāvavihitān yathāvarṇaṃ yathāśramam  |
vairāgyarāgopādhibhyāmāmnātobhayalakṣaṇān  || 01.09.026 ||
dānadharmān rājadharmānmokṣadharmān vibhāgaśaḥ  |
strīdharmān bhagavaddharmān samāsavyāsayogataḥ  || 01.09.027 ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca sahopāyān yathā mune  |
nānākhyānetihāseṣu varṇayāmāsa tattvavit || 01.09.028 ||
dharmaṃ pravadatastasya sa kālaḥ pratyupasthitaḥ  |
yo yoginaśchandamṛtyorvāñchitastūttarāyaṇaḥ  || 01.09.029 ||
tadopasaṃhṛtya giraḥ sahasraṇīrvimuktasaṅgaṃ mana ādipūruṣe  |

01.09.032|0 śrībhīṣma uvāca
iti matirupakalpitā vitṛṣṇā bhagavati sātvatapuṅgave vibhūmni  |
svasukhamupagate kvacidvihartuṃ prakṛtimupeyuṣi yadbhavapravāhaḥ  || 01.09.032 ||
tribhuvanakamanaṃ tamālavarṇaṃ ravikaragauravarāmbaraṃ dadhāne  |
vapuralakakulāvṛtānanābjaṃ vijayasakhe ratirastu me'navadyā  || 01.09.033 ||
yudhi turagarajovidhūmraviṣvakkacalulitaśramavāryalaṅkṛtāsye  |
mama niśitaśarairvibhidyamāna tvaci vilasatkavace'stu kṛṣṇa ātmā  || 01.09.034 ||
sapadi sakhivaco niśamya madhye nijaparayorbalayo rathaṃ niveśya  |

vyavahitapṛtanāmukhaṃ nirīkṣya svajanavadhādvimukhasya doṣabuddhyā  |

śitaviśikhahato viśīrṇadaṃśaḥ kṣatajaparipluta ātatāyino me  |

vijayarathakuṭumba āttatotre dhṛtahayaraśmini tacchriyekṣaṇīye  |

lalitagativilāsavalguhāsa praṇayanirīkṣaṇakalpitorumānāḥ  |

munigaṇanṛpavaryasaṅkule'ntaḥ sadasi yudhiṣṭhirarājasūya eṣām  |

01.09.043|0 sūta uvāca
kṛṣṇa evaṃ bhagavati manovāgdṛṣṭivṛttibhiḥ  |
ātmanyātmānamāveśya so'ntaḥśvāsa upāramat || 01.09.043 ||
sampadyamānamājñāya bhīṣmaṃ brahmaṇi niṣkale  |
sarve babhūvuste tūṣṇīṃ vayāṃsīva dinātyaye  || 01.09.044 ||
tatra dundubhayo nedurdevamānavavāditāḥ  |
śaśaṃsuḥ sādhavo rājñāṃ khātpetuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭayaḥ  || 01.09.045 ||
tasya nirharaṇādīni samparetasya bhārgava  |
yudhiṣṭhiraḥ kārayitvā muhūrtaṃ duḥkhito'bhavat || 01.09.046 ||
tuṣṭuvurmunayo hṛṣṭāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tadguhyanāmabhiḥ  |
tataste kṛṣṇahṛdayāḥ svāśramān prayayuḥ punaḥ  || 01.09.047 ||
tato yudhiṣṭhiro gatvā sahakṛṣṇo gajāhvayam  |
pitaraṃ sāntvayāmāsa gāndhārīṃ ca tapasvinīm  || 01.09.048 ||
pitrā cānumato rājā vāsudevānumoditaḥ  |
cakāra rājyaṃ dharmeṇa pitṛpaitāmahaṃ vibhuḥ  || 01.09.049 ||
01.10.001|0 śaunaka uvāca
hatvā svarikthaspṛdha ātatāyino yudhiṣṭhiro dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaḥ  |
sahānujaiḥ pratyavaruddhabhojanaḥ kathaṃ pravṛttaḥ kimakāraṣīttataḥ  || 01.10.001 ||
01.10.002|0 sūta uvāca
vaṃśaṃ kurorvaṃśadavāgninirhṛtaṃ saṃrohayitvā bhavabhāvano hariḥ  |
niveśayitvā nijarājya īśvaro yudhiṣṭhiraṃ prītamanā babhūva ha  || 01.10.002 ||
niśamya bhīṣmoktamathācyutoktaṃ pravṛttavijñānavidhūtavibhramaḥ  |
śaśāsa gāmindra ivājitāśrayaḥ paridhyupāntāmanujānuvartitaḥ  || 01.10.003 ||
kāmaṃ vavarṣa parjanyaḥ sarvakāmadughā mahī  |
siṣicuḥ sma vrajān gāvaḥ payasodhasvatīrmudā  || 01.10.004 ||
nadyaḥ samudrā girayaḥ savanaspativīrudhaḥ  |
phalantyoṣadhayaḥ sarvāḥ kāmamanvṛtu tasya vai  || 01.10.005 ||
nādhayo vyādhayaḥ kleśā daivabhūtātmahetavaḥ  |
ajātaśatrāvabhavan jantūnāṃ rājñi karhicit || 01.10.006 ||
uṣitvā hāstinapure māsān katipayān hariḥ  |
suhṛdāṃ ca viśokāya svasuśca priyakāmyayā  || 01.10.007 ||
āmantrya cābhyanujñātaḥ pariṣvajyābhivādya tam  |
āruroha rathaṃ kaiścitpariṣvakto'bhivāditaḥ  || 01.10.008 ||
subhadrā draupadī kuntī virāṭatanayā tathā  |
gāndhārī dhṛtarāṣṭraśca yuyutsurgautamo yamau  || 01.10.009 ||
vṛkodaraśca dhaumyaśca striyo matsyasutādayaḥ  |
na sehire vimuhyanto virahaṃ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ  || 01.10.010 ||
satsaṅgānmuktaduḥsaṅgo hātuṃ notsahate budhaḥ  |
kīrtyamānaṃ yaśo yasya sakṛdākarṇya rocanam  || 01.10.011 ||
tasminnyastadhiyaḥ pārthāḥ saheran virahaṃ katham  |
darśanasparśasaṃlāpa śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ  || 01.10.012 ||
sarve te'nimiṣairakṣaistamanu drutacetasaḥ  |
vīkṣantaḥ snehasambaddhā vicelustatra tatra ha  || 01.10.013 ||
nyarundhannudgaladbāṣpamautkaṇṭhyāddevakīsute  |
niryātyagārānno'bhadramiti syādbāndhavastriyaḥ  || 01.10.014 ||
mṛdaṅgaśaṅkhabheryaśca vīṇāpaṇavagomukhāḥ  |
dhundhuryānakaghaṇṭādyā nedurdundubhayastathā  || 01.10.015 ||
prāsādaśikharārūḍhāḥ kurunāryo didṛkṣayā  |
vavṛṣuḥ kusumaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ premavrīḍāsmitekṣaṇāḥ  || 01.10.016 ||
sitātapatraṃ jagrāha muktādāmavibhūṣitam  |
ratnadaṇḍaṃ guḍākeśaḥ priyaḥ priyatamasya ha  || 01.10.017 ||
uddhavaḥ sātyakiścaiva vyajane paramādbhute  |
vikīryamāṇaḥ kusumai reje madhupatiḥ pathi  || 01.10.018 ||
aśrūyantāśiṣaḥ satyāstatra tatra dvijeritāḥ  |
nānurūpānurūpāśca nirguṇasya guṇātmanaḥ  || 01.10.019 ||
anyonyamāsītsañjalpa uttamaślokacetasām  |
kauravendrapurastrīṇāṃ sarvaśrutimanoharaḥ  || 01.10.020 ||
sa vai kilāyaṃ puruṣaḥ purātano ya eka āsīdaviśeṣa ātmani  |
agre guṇebhyo jagadātmanīśvare nimīlitātmanniśi suptaśaktiṣu  || 01.10.021 ||
sa eva bhūyo nijavīryacoditāṃ svajīvamāyāṃ prakṛtiṃ sisṛkṣatīm  |
anāmarūpātmani rūpanāmanī vidhitsamāno'nusasāra śāstrakṛt || 01.10.022 ||
sa vā ayaṃ yatpadamatra sūrayo jitendriyā nirjitamātariśvanaḥ  |
paśyanti bhaktyutkalitāmalātmanā nanveṣa sattvaṃ parimārṣṭumarhati  || 01.10.023 ||
sa vā ayaṃ sakhyanugītasatkatho vedeṣu guhyeṣu ca guhyavādibhiḥ  |
ya eka īśo jagadātmalīlayā sṛjatyavatyatti na tatra sajjate  || 01.10.024 ||
yadā hyadharmeṇa tamodhiyo nṛpā jīvanti tatraiṣa hi sattvataḥ kila  |
dhatte bhagaṃ satyamṛtaṃ dayāṃ yaśo bhavāya rūpāṇi dadhadyuge yuge  || 01.10.025 ||
aho alaṃ ślāghyatamaṃ yadoḥ kulamaho alaṃ puṇyatamaṃ madhorvanam  |
yadeṣa puṃsāmṛṣabhaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ svajanmanā caṅkramaṇena cāñcati  || 01.10.026 ||
aho bata svaryaśasastiraskarī kuśasthalī puṇyayaśaskarī bhuvaḥ  |
paśyanti nityaṃ yadanugraheṣitaṃ smitāvalokaṃ svapatiṃ sma yatprajāḥ  || 01.10.027 ||
nūnaṃ vratasnānahutādineśvaraḥ samarcito hyasya gṛhītapāṇibhiḥ  |
pibanti yāḥ sakhyadharāmṛtaṃ muhurvrajastriyaḥ sammumuhuryadāśayāḥ  || 01.10.028 ||
yā vīryaśulkena hṛtāḥ svayaṃvare pramathya caidyapramukhān hi śuṣmiṇaḥ  |
pradyumnasāmbāmbasutādayo'parā yāścāhṛtā bhaumavadhe sahasraśaḥ  || 01.10.029 ||
etāḥ paraṃ strītvamapāstapeśalaṃ nirastaśaucaṃ bata sādhu kurvate  |
yāsāṃ gṛhātpuṣkaralocanaḥ patirna jātvapaityāhṛtibhirhṛdi spṛśan  || 01.10.030 ||
evaṃvidhā gadantīnāṃ sa giraḥ purayoṣitām  |
nirīkṣaṇenābhinandan sasmitena yayau hariḥ  || 01.10.031 ||
ajātaśatruḥ pṛtanāṃ gopīthāya madhudviṣaḥ  |
parebhyaḥ śaṅkitaḥ snehātprāyuṅkta caturaṅgiṇīm  || 01.10.032 ||
atha dūrāgatān śauriḥ kauravān virahāturān  |
sannivartya dṛḍhaṃ snigdhān prāyātsvanagarīṃ priyaiḥ  || 01.10.033 ||
kurujāṅgalapāñcālān śūrasenān sayāmunān  |
brahmāvartaṃ kurukṣetraṃ matsyān sārasvatānatha  || 01.10.034 ||
marudhanvamatikramya sauvīrābhīrayoḥ parān  |
ānartān bhārgavopāgācchrāntavāho manāgvibhuḥ  || 01.10.035 ||
tatra tatra ha tatratyairhariḥ pratyudyatārhaṇaḥ  |
sāyaṃ bheje diśaṃ paścādgaviṣṭho gāṃ gatastadā  || 01.10.036 ||
01.11.001|0 sūta uvāca
ānartān sa upavrajya svṛddhāñjanapadān svakān  |
dadhmau daravaraṃ teṣāṃ viṣādaṃ śamayanniva  || 01.11.001 ||
sa uccakāśe dhavalodaro daro'pyurukramasyādharaśoṇaśoṇimā  |
dādhmāyamānaḥ karakañjasampuṭe yathābjakhaṇḍe kalahaṃsa utsvanaḥ  || 01.11.002 ||
tamupaśrutya ninadaṃ jagadbhayabhayāvaham  |
pratyudyayuḥ prajāḥ sarvā bhartṛdarśanalālasāḥ  || 01.11.003 ||
tatropanītabalayo raverdīpamivādṛtāḥ  |
ātmārāmaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ nijalābhena nityadā  || 01.11.004 ||
prītyutphullamukhāḥ procurharṣagadgadayā girā  |
pitaraṃ sarvasuhṛdamavitāramivārbhakāḥ  || 01.11.005 ||
natāḥ sma te nātha sadāṅghripaṅkajaṃ viriñcavairiñcyasurendravanditam  |
parāyaṇaṃ kṣemamihecchatāṃ paraṃ na yatra kālaḥ prabhavetparaḥ prabhuḥ  || 01.11.006 ||
bhavāya nastvaṃ bhava viśvabhāvana tvameva mātātha suhṛtpatiḥ pitā  |
tvaṃ sadgururnaḥ paramaṃ ca daivataṃ yasyānuvṛttyā kṛtino babhūvima  || 01.11.007 ||
aho sanāthā bhavatā sma yadvayaṃ traiviṣṭapānāmapi dūradarśanam  |
premasmitasnigdhanirīkṣaṇānanaṃ paśyema rūpaṃ tava sarvasaubhagam  || 01.11.008 ||
yarhyambujākṣāpasasāra bho bhavān kurūnmadhūn vātha suhṛddidṛkṣayā  |
tatrābdakoṭipratimaḥ kṣaṇo bhavedraviṃ vinākṣṇoriva nastavācyuta  || 01.11.009 ||
kathaṃ vayaṃ nātha ciroṣite tvayi prasannadṛṣṭyākhilatāpaśoṣaṇam  |
jīvema te sundarahāsaśobhitamapaśyamānā vadanaṃ manoharam  || 01.11.010 ||
iti codīritā vācaḥ prajānāṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ  |
śṛṇvāno'nugrahaṃ dṛṣṭyā vitanvan prāviśatpuram  || 01.11.011 ||
madhubhojadaśārhārhakukurāndhakavṛṣṇibhiḥ  |
ātmatulyabalairguptāṃ nāgairbhogavatīmiva  || 01.11.012 ||
sarvartusarvavibhavapuṇyavṛkṣalatāśramaiḥ  |
udyānopavanārāmairvṛtapadmākaraśriyam  || 01.11.013 ||
gopuradvāramārgeṣu kṛtakautukatoraṇām  |
citradhvajapatākāgrairantaḥ pratihatātapām  || 01.11.014 ||
sammārjitamahāmārga rathyāpaṇakacatvarām  |
siktāṃ gandhajalairuptāṃ phalapuṣpākṣatāṅkuraiḥ  || 01.11.015 ||
dvāri dvāri gṛhāṇāṃ ca dadhyakṣataphalekṣubhiḥ  |
alaṅkṛtāṃ pūrṇakumbhairbalibhirdhūpadīpakaiḥ  || 01.11.016 ||
niśamya preṣṭhamāyāntaṃ vasudevo mahāmanāḥ  |
akrūraścograsenaśca rāmaścādbhutavikramaḥ  || 01.11.017 ||
pradyumnaścārudeṣṇaśca sāmbo jāmbavatīsutaḥ  |
praharṣavegocchaśitaśayanāsanabhojanāḥ  || 01.11.018 ||
vāraṇendraṃ puraskṛtya brāhmaṇaiḥ sasumaṅgalaiḥ  |
śaṅkhatūryaninādena brahmaghoṣeṇa cādṛtāḥ  |
pratyujjagmū rathairhṛṣṭāḥ praṇayāgatasādhvasāḥ  || 01.11.019 ||
vāramukhyāśca śataśo yānaistaddarśanotsukāḥ  |
lasatkuṇḍalanirbhātakapolavadanaśriyaḥ  || 01.11.020 ||
naṭanartakagandharvāḥ sūtamāgadhavandinaḥ  |
gāyanti cottamaślokacaritānyadbhutāni ca  || 01.11.021 ||
bhagavāṃstatra bandhūnāṃ paurāṇāmanuvartinām  |
yathāvidhyupasaṅgamya sarveṣāṃ mānamādadhe  || 01.11.022 ||
prahvābhivādanāśleṣakarasparśasmitekṣaṇaiḥ  |
āśvāsya cāśvapākebhyo varaiścābhimatairvibhuḥ  || 01.11.023 ||
svayaṃ ca gurubhirvipraiḥ sadāraiḥ sthavirairapi  |
āśīrbhiryujyamāno'nyairvandibhiścāviśatpuram  || 01.11.024 ||
rājamārgaṃ gate kṛṣṇe dvārakāyāḥ kulastriyaḥ  |
harmyāṇyāruruhurvipra tadīkṣaṇamahotsavāḥ  || 01.11.025 ||
nityaṃ nirīkṣamāṇānāṃ yadapi dvārakaukasām  |
na vitṛpyanti hi dṛśaḥ śriyo dhāmāṅgamacyutam  || 01.11.026 ||
śriyo nivāso yasyoraḥ pānapātraṃ mukhaṃ dṛśām  |
bāhavo lokapālānāṃ sāraṅgāṇāṃ padāmbujam  || 01.11.027 ||
sitātapatravyajanairupaskṛtaḥ prasūnavarṣairabhivarṣitaḥ pathi  |
piśaṅgavāsā vanamālayā babhau ghano yathārkoḍupacāpavaidyutaiḥ  || 01.11.028 ||
praviṣṭastu gṛhaṃ pitroḥ pariṣvaktaḥ svamātṛbhiḥ  |
vavande śirasā sapta devakīpramukhā mudā  || 01.11.029 ||
tāḥ putramaṅkamāropya snehasnutapayodharāḥ  |
harṣavihvalitātmānaḥ siṣicurnetrajairjalaiḥ  || 01.11.030 ||
athāviśatsvabhavanaṃ sarvakāmamanuttamam  |
prāsādā yatra patnīnāṃ sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa  || 01.11.031 ||
patnyaḥ patiṃ proṣya gṛhānupāgataṃ vilokya sañjātamanomahotsavāḥ  |
uttasthurārātsahasāsanāśayātsākaṃ vratairvrīḍitalocanānanāḥ  || 01.11.032 ||
tamātmajairdṛṣṭibhirantarātmanā durantabhāvāḥ parirebhire patim  |
niruddhamapyāsravadambu netrayorvilajjatīnāṃ bhṛguvarya vaiklavāt || 01.11.033 ||
yadyapyasau pārśvagato rahogatastathāpi tasyāṅghriyugaṃ navaṃ navam  |

evaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ kṣitibhārajanmanāmakṣauhiṇībhiḥ parivṛttatejasām  |
vidhāya vairaṃ śvasano yathānalaṃ mitho vadhenoparato nirāyudhaḥ  || 01.11.035 ||
sa eṣa naraloke'sminnavatīrṇaḥ svamāyayā  |
reme strīratnakūṭastho bhagavān prākṛto yathā  || 01.11.036 ||

vāyurvāti kharasparśo rajasā visṛjaṃstamaḥ  |
asṛgvarṣanti jaladā bībhatsamiva sarvataḥ  || 01.14.016 ||
sūryaṃ hataprabhaṃ paśya grahamardaṃ mitho divi  |

daivatāni rudantīva svidyanti hyuccalanti ca  |

01.14.025|0 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca

suṣeṇaścārudeṣṇaśca sāmbo jāmbavatīsutaḥ  |

yadbāhudaṇḍaguptāyāṃ svapuryāṃ yadavo'rcitāḥ  |

yatpādaśuśrūṣaṇamukhyakarmaṇā satyādayo dvyaṣṭasahasrayoṣitaḥ  |

yadbāhudaṇḍābhyudayānujīvino yadupravīrā hyakutobhayā muhuḥ  |

kaccitte'nāmayaṃ tāta bhraṣṭatejā vibhāsi me  |

kaccinnābhihato'bhāvaiḥ śabdādibhiramaṅgalaiḥ  |

kaccittvaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bālaṃ gāṃ vṛddhaṃ rogiṇaṃ striyam  |

kaccittvaṃ nāgamo'gamyāṃ gamyāṃ vāsatkṛtāṃ striyam  |

kaccitpreṣṭhatamenātha hṛdayenātmabandhunā  |

01.15.001|0 sūta uvāca
evaṃ kṛṣṇasakhaḥ kṛṣṇo bhrātrā rājñā vikalpitaḥ  |

01.15.005|0 arjuna uvāca

tatraiva me viharato bhujadaṇḍayugmaṃ gāṇḍīvalakṣaṇamarātivadhāya devāḥ  |

yadbāndhavaḥ kurubalābdhimanantapārameko rathena tatare'hamatīryasattvam  |

yo bhīṣmakarṇaguruśalyacamūṣvadabhra rājanyavaryarathamaṇḍalamaṇḍitāsu  |

yaddoḥṣu mā praṇihitaṃ gurubhīṣmakarṇa naptṛtrigartaśalyasaindhavabāhlikādyaiḥ  |
astrāṇyamoghamahimāni nirūpitāni nopaspṛśurnṛharidāsamivāsurāṇi  || 01.15.016 ||
sautye vṛtaḥ kumatinātmada īśvaro me yatpādapadmamabhavāya bhajanti bhavyāḥ  |

narmāṇyudārarucirasmitaśobhitāni he pārtha he'rjuna sakhe kurunandaneti  |

śayyāsanāṭanavikatthanabhojanādiṣvaikyādvayasya ṛtavāniti vipralabdhaḥ  |

01.15.028|0 sūta uvāca
evaṃ cintayato jiṣṇoḥ kṛṣṇapādasaroruham  |

vāsudevāṅghryanudhyāna paribṛṃhitaraṃhasā  |

gītaṃ bhagavatā jñānaṃ yattatsaṅgrāmamūrdhani  |

viśoko brahmasampattyā sañchinnadvaitasaṃśayaḥ  |
līnaprakṛtinairguṇyādaliṅgatvādasambhavaḥ  || 01.15.031 ||
niśamya bhagavanmārgaṃ saṃsthāṃ yadukulasya ca  |

pṛthāpyanuśrutya dhanañjayoditaṃ nāśaṃ yadūnāṃ bhagavadgatiṃ ca tām  |

yayāharadbhuvo bhāraṃ tāṃ tanuṃ vijahāvajaḥ  |

yathā matsyādirūpāṇi dhatte jahyādyathā naṭaḥ  |

yadā mukundo bhagavānimāṃ mahīṃ jahau svatanvā śravaṇīyasatkathaḥ  |

yudhiṣṭhirastatparisarpaṇaṃ budhaḥ pure ca rāṣṭre ca gṛhe tathātmani  |

svarāṭpautraṃ vinayinamātmanaḥ susamaṃ guṇaiḥ  |

mathurāyāṃ tathā vajraṃ śūrasenapatiṃ tataḥ  |

visṛjya tatra tatsarvaṃ dukūlavalayādikam  |

vācaṃ juhāva manasi tatprāṇa itare ca tam  |

sarvamātmanyajuhavīdbrahmaṇyātmānamavyaye  || 01.15.042 ||
cīravāsā nirāhāro baddhavāṅmuktamūrdhajaḥ  |

anavekṣamāṇo niragādaśṛṇvan badhiro yathā  |
udīcīṃ praviveśāśāṃ gatapūrvāṃ mahātmabhiḥ  |

sarve tamanunirjagmurbhrātaraḥ kṛtaniścayāḥ  |

taddhyānodriktayā bhaktyā viśuddhadhiṣaṇāḥ pare  |

avāpurduravāpāṃ te asadbhirviṣayātmabhiḥ  |

viduro'pi parityajya prabhāse dehamātmanaḥ  |

01.16.001|0 sūta uvāca

01.16.010|0 sūta uvāca
yadā parīkṣitkurujāṅgale'vasatkaliṃ praviṣṭaṃ nijacakravartite  |

sārathyapāraṣadasevanasakhyadautya   vīrāsanānugamanastavanapraṇāmān  |

01.16.021|0 dharma uvāca
kaccidbhadre'nāmayamātmanaste vicchāyāsi mlāyateṣanmukhena  |

kiṃ kṣatrabandhūn kalinopasṛṣṭān rāṣṭrāṇi vā tairavaropitāni  |
