03.16.027|0 brahmovāca
atha te munayo dṛṣṭvā nayanānandabhājanam  |
vaikuṇṭhaṃ tadadhiṣṭhānaṃ vikuṇṭhaṃ ca svayaṃprabham  || 03.16.027 ||
bhagavantaṃ parikramya praṇipatyānumānya ca  |
pratijagmuḥ pramuditāḥ śaṃsanto vaiṣṇavīṃ śriyam  || 03.16.028 ||
bhagavānanugāvāha yātaṃ mā bhaiṣṭamastu śam  |
brahmatejaḥ samartho'pi hantuṃ necche mataṃ tu me  || 03.16.029 ||
etatpuraiva nirdiṣṭaṃ ramayā kruddhayā yadā  |
purāpavāritā dvāri viśantī mayyupārate  || 03.16.030 ||
mayi saṃrambhayogena nistīrya brahmahelanam  |
pratyeṣyataṃ nikāśaṃ me kālenālpīyasā punaḥ  || 03.16.031 ||
dvāḥsthāvādiśya bhagavān vimānaśreṇibhūṣaṇam  |
sarvātiśayayā lakṣmyā juṣṭaṃ svaṃ dhiṣṇyamāviśat || 03.16.032 ||
tau tu gīrvāṇaṛṣabhau dustarāddharilokataḥ  |
hataśriyau brahmaśāpādabhūtāṃ vigatasmayau  || 03.16.033 ||
tadā vikuṇṭhadhiṣaṇāttayornipatamānayoḥ  |
hāhākāro mahānāsīdvimānāgryeṣu putrakāḥ  || 03.16.034 ||
tāveva hyadhunā prāptau pārṣadapravarau hareḥ  |
diterjaṭharanirviṣṭaṃ kāśyapaṃ teja ulbaṇam  || 03.16.035 ||
tayorasurayoradya tejasā yamayorhi vaḥ  |
ākṣiptaṃ teja etarhi bhagavāṃstadvidhitsati  || 03.16.036 ||
viśvasya yaḥ sthitilayodbhavaheturādyo   yogeśvarairapi duratyayayogamāyaḥ  |
kṣemaṃ vidhāsyati sa no bhagavāṃstryadhīśas  tatrāsmadīyavimṛśena kiyānihārthaḥ  || 03.16.037 ||*
03.17.002|0 maitreya uvāca
niśamyātmabhuvā gītaṃ kāraṇaṃ śaṅkayojjhitāḥ  |
tataḥ sarve nyavartanta tridivāya divaukasaḥ  || 03.17.001 ||
ditistu bharturādeśādapatyapariśaṅkinī  |
pūrṇe varṣaśate sādhvī putrau prasuṣuve yamau  || 03.17.002 ||
utpātā bahavastatra nipeturjāyamānayoḥ  |
divi bhuvyantarikṣe ca lokasyorubhayāvahāḥ  || 03.17.003 ||
sahācalā bhuvaścelurdiśaḥ sarvāḥ prajajvaluḥ  |
solkāścāśanayaḥ petuḥ ketavaścārtihetavaḥ  || 03.17.004 ||
vavau vāyuḥ suduḥsparśaḥ phūtkārānīrayanmuhuḥ  |
unmūlayannagapatīn vātyānīko rajodhvajaḥ  || 03.17.005 ||
uddhasattaḍidambhoda ghaṭayā naṣṭabhāgaṇe  |
vyomni praviṣṭatamasā na sma vyādṛśyate padam  || 03.17.006 ||
cukrośa vimanā vārdhirudūrmiḥ kṣubhitodaraḥ  |
sodapānāśca saritaścukṣubhuḥ śuṣkapaṅkajāḥ  || 03.17.007 ||
muhuḥ paridhayo'bhūvan sarāhvoḥ śaśisūryayoḥ  |
nirghātā rathanirhrādā vivarebhyaḥ prajajñire  || 03.17.008 ||
antargrāmeṣu mukhato vamantyo vahnimulbaṇam  |
sṛgālolūkaṭaṅkāraiḥ praṇeduraśivaṃ śivāḥ  || 03.17.009 ||
saṅgītavadrodanavadunnamayya śirodharām  |
vyamuñcan vividhā vāco grāmasiṃhāstatastataḥ  || 03.17.010 ||
kharāśca karkaśaiḥ kṣattaḥ khurairghnanto dharātalam  |
khārkārarabhasā mattāḥ paryadhāvan varūthaśaḥ  || 03.17.011 ||
rudanto rāsabhatrastā nīḍādudapatan khagāḥ  |
ghoṣe'raṇye ca paśavaḥ śakṛnmūtramakurvata  || 03.17.012 ||
gāvo'trasannasṛgdohāstoyadāḥ pūyavarṣiṇaḥ  |
vyarudan devaliṅgāni drumāḥ peturvinānilam  || 03.17.013 ||
grahān puṇyatamānanye bhagaṇāṃścāpi dīpitāḥ  |
aticerurvakragatyā yuyudhuśca parasparam  || 03.17.014 ||
dṛṣṭvānyāṃśca mahotpātānatattattvavidaḥ prajāḥ  |
brahmaputrānṛte bhītā menire viśvasamplavam  || 03.17.015 ||
tāvādidaityau sahasā vyajyamānātmapauruṣau  |
vavṛdhāte'śmasāreṇa kāyenādripatī iva  || 03.17.016 ||
divispṛśau hemakirīṭakoṭibhirniruddhakāṣṭhau sphuradaṅgadābhujau  |
gāṃ kampayantau caraṇaiḥ pade pade kaṭyā sukāñcyārkamatītya tasthatuḥ  || 03.17.017 ||
prajāpatirnāma tayorakārṣīdyaḥ prāksvadehādyamayorajāyata  |
taṃ vai hiraṇyakaśipuṃ viduḥ prajā yaṃ taṃ hiraṇyākṣamasūta sāgrataḥ  || 03.17.018 ||
cakre hiraṇyakaśipurdorbhyāṃ brahmavareṇa ca  |
vaśe sapālān lokāṃstrīnakutomṛtyuruddhataḥ  || 03.17.019 ||
hiraṇyākṣo'nujastasya priyaḥ prītikṛdanvaham  |
gadāpāṇirdivaṃ yāto yuyutsurmṛgayan raṇam  || 03.17.020 ||
taṃ vīkṣya duḥsahajavaṃ raṇatkāñcananūpuram  |
vaijayantyā srajā juṣṭamaṃsanyastamahāgadam  || 03.17.021 ||
manovīryavarotsiktamasṛṇyamakutobhayam  |
bhītā nililyire devāstārkṣyatrastā ivāhayaḥ  || 03.17.022 ||
sa vai tirohitān dṛṣṭvā mahasā svena daityarāṭ |
sendrān devagaṇān kṣībānapaśyan vyanadadbhṛśam  || 03.17.023 ||
tato nivṛttaḥ krīḍiṣyan gambhīraṃ bhīmanisvanam  |
vijagāhe mahāsattvo vārdhiṃ matta iva dvipaḥ  || 03.17.024 ||
tasmin praviṣṭe varuṇasya sainikā yādogaṇāḥ sannadhiyaḥ sasādhvasāḥ  |
ahanyamānā api tasya varcasā pradharṣitā dūrataraṃ pradudruvuḥ  || 03.17.025 ||
sa varṣapūgānudadhau mahābalaścaranmahormīñchvasaneritānmuhuḥ  |
maurvyābhijaghne gadayā vibhāvarīmāsedivāṃstāta purīṃ pracetasaḥ  || 03.17.026 ||
tatropalabhyāsuralokapālakaṃ yādogaṇānāmṛṣabhaṃ pracetasam  |
smayan pralabdhuṃ praṇipatya nīcavajjagāda me dehyadhirāja saṃyugam  || 03.17.027 ||
tvaṃ lokapālo'dhipatirbṛhacchravā vīryāpaho durmadavīramāninām  |
vijitya loke'khiladaityadānavān yadrājasūyena purāyajatprabho  || 03.17.028 ||
sa evamutsiktamadena vidviṣā dṛḍhaṃ pralabdho bhagavānapāṃ patiḥ  |
roṣaṃ samutthaṃ śamayan svayā dhiyā vyavocadaṅgopaśamaṃ gatā vayam  || 03.17.029 ||
paśyāmi nānyaṃ puruṣātpurātanādyaḥ saṃyuge tvāṃ raṇamārgakovidam  |
ārādhayiṣyatyasurarṣabhehi taṃ manasvino yaṃ gṛṇate bhavādṛśāḥ  || 03.17.030 ||
taṃ vīramārādabhipadya vismayaḥ śayiṣyase vīraśaye śvabhirvṛtaḥ  |
yastvadvidhānāmasatāṃ praśāntaye rūpāṇi dhatte sadanugrahecchayā  || 03.17.031 ||
03.18.001|0 maitreya uvāca
tadevamākarṇya jaleśabhāṣitaṃ mahāmanāstadvigaṇayya durmadaḥ  |
harerviditvā gatimaṅga nāradādrasātalaṃ nirviviśe tvarānvitaḥ  || 03.18.001 ||
dadarśa tatrābhijitaṃ dharādharaṃ pronnīyamānāvanimagradaṃṣṭrayā  |
muṣṇantamakṣṇā svaruco'ruṇaśriyā jahāsa cāho vanagocaro mṛgaḥ  || 03.18.002 ||
āhainamehyajña mahīṃ vimuñca no rasaukasāṃ viśvasṛjeyamarpitā  |
na svasti yāsyasyanayā mamekṣataḥ surādhamāsāditasūkarākṛte  || 03.18.003 ||
tvaṃ naḥ sapatnairabhavāya kiṃ bhṛto yo māyayā hantyasurān parokṣajit |
tvāṃ yogamāyābalamalpapauruṣaṃ saṃsthāpya mūḍha pramṛje suhṛcchucaḥ  || 03.18.004 ||
tvayi saṃsthite gadayā śīrṇaśīrṣaṇyasmadbhujacyutayā ye ca tubhyam  |
baliṃ harantyṛṣayo ye ca devāḥ svayaṃ sarve na bhaviṣyantyamūlāḥ  || 03.18.005 ||
sa tudyamāno'riduruktatomarairdaṃṣṭrāgragāṃ gāmupalakṣya bhītām  |
todaṃ mṛṣanniragādambumadhyādgrāhāhataḥ sakareṇuryathebhaḥ  || 03.18.006 ||
taṃ niḥsarantaṃ salilādanudruto hiraṇyakeśo dviradaṃ yathā jhaṣaḥ  |
karāladaṃṣṭro'śaninisvano'bravīdgatahriyāṃ kiṃ tvasatāṃ vigarhitam  || 03.18.007 ||
sa gāmudastātsalilasya gocare vinyasya tasyāmadadhātsvasattvam  |
abhiṣṭuto viśvasṛjā prasūnairāpūryamāṇo vibudhaiḥ paśyato'reḥ  || 03.18.008 ||
parānuṣaktaṃ tapanīyopakalpaṃ mahāgadaṃ kāñcanacitradaṃśam  |
marmāṇyabhīkṣṇaṃ pratudantaṃ duruktaiḥ pracaṇḍamanyuḥ prahasaṃstaṃ babhāṣe  || 03.18.009 ||
03.18.010|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
satyaṃ vayaṃ bho vanagocarā mṛgā yuṣmadvidhānmṛgaye grāmasiṃhān  |
na mṛtyupāśaiḥ pratimuktasya vīrā vikatthanaṃ tava gṛhṇantyabhadra  || 03.18.010 ||
ete vayaṃ nyāsaharā rasaukasāṃ gatahriyo gadayā drāvitāste  |
tiṣṭhāmahe'thāpi kathañcidājau stheyaṃ kva yāmo balinotpādya vairam  || 03.18.011 ||
tvaṃ padrathānāṃ kila yūthapādhipo ghaṭasva no'svastaya āśvanūhaḥ  |
saṃsthāpya cāsmān pramṛjāśru svakānāṃ yaḥ svāṃ pratijñāṃ nātipipartyasabhyaḥ  || 03.18.012 ||
03.18.013|0 maitreya uvāca
so'dhikṣipto bhagavatā pralabdhaśca ruṣā bhṛśam  |
ājahārolbaṇaṃ krodhaṃ krīḍyamāno'hirāḍiva  || 03.18.013 ||

animittā bhāgavatī bhaktiḥ siddhergarīyasī  |
jarayatyāśu yā kośaṃ nigīrṇamanalo yathā  || 03.25.034 ||
naikātmatāṃ me spṛhayanti kecinmatpādasevābhiratā madīhāḥ  |
ye'nyonyato bhāgavatāḥ prasajya sabhājayante mama pauruṣāṇi  || 03.25.035 ||
paśyanti te me rucirāṇyamba santaḥ prasannavaktrāruṇalocanāni  |
rūpāṇi divyāni varapradāni sākaṃ vācaṃ spṛhaṇīyāṃ vadanti  || 03.25.036 ||
tairdarśanīyāvayavairudāra vilāsahāsekṣitavāmasūktaiḥ  |
hṛtātmano hṛtaprāṇāṃśca bhaktiranicchato me gatimaṇvīṃ prayuṅkte  || 03.25.037 ||
atho vibhūtiṃ mama māyāvinastāmaiśvaryamaṣṭāṅgamanupravṛttam  |
śriyaṃ bhāgavatīṃ vāspṛhayanti bhadrāṃ parasya me te'śnuvate tu loke  || 03.25.038 ||
na karhicinmatparāḥ śāntarūpe naṅkṣyanti no me'nimiṣo leḍhi hetiḥ  |
yeṣāmahaṃ priya ātmā sutaśca sakhā guruḥ suhṛdo daivamiṣṭam  || 03.25.039 ||
imaṃ lokaṃ tathaivāmumātmānamubhayāyinam  |
ātmānamanu ye ceha ye rāyaḥ paśavo gṛhāḥ  || 03.25.040 ||
visṛjya sarvānanyāṃśca māmevaṃ viśvatomukham  |
bhajantyananyayā bhaktyā tānmṛtyoratipāraye  || 03.25.041 ||
nānyatra madbhagavataḥ pradhānapuruṣeśvarāt |
ātmanaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhayaṃ tīvraṃ nivartate  || 03.25.042 ||
madbhayādvāti vāto'yaṃ sūryastapati madbhayāt |
varṣatīndro dahatyagnirmṛtyuścarati madbhayāt || 03.25.043 ||
jñānavairāgyayuktena bhaktiyogena yoginaḥ  |
kṣemāya pādamūlaṃ me praviśantyakutobhayam  || 03.25.044 ||
etāvāneva loke'smin puṃsāṃ niḥśreyasodayaḥ  |
tīvreṇa bhaktiyogena mano mayyarpitaṃ sthiram  || 03.25.045 ||
03.26.001|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
atha te sampravakṣyāmi tattvānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ pṛthak |
yadviditvā vimucyeta puruṣaḥ prākṛtairguṇaiḥ  || 03.26.001 ||
jñānaṃ niḥśreyasārthāya puruṣasyātmadarśanam  |
yadāhurvarṇaye tatte hṛdayagranthibhedanam  || 03.26.002 ||
anādirātmā puruṣo nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ  |
pratyagdhāmā svayaṃjyotirviśvaṃ yena samanvitam  || 03.26.003 ||
sa eṣa prakṛtiṃ sūkṣmāṃ daivīṃ guṇamayīṃ vibhuḥ  |
yadṛcchayaivopagatāmabhyapadyata līlayā  || 03.26.004 ||
guṇairvicitrāḥ sṛjatīṃ sarūpāḥ prakṛtiṃ prajāḥ  |
vilokya mumuhe sadyaḥ sa iha jñānagūhayā  || 03.26.005 ||
evaṃ parābhidhyānena kartṛtvaṃ prakṛteḥ pumān  |
karmasu kriyamāṇeṣu guṇairātmani manyate  || 03.26.006 ||
tadasya saṃsṛtirbandhaḥ pāratantryaṃ ca tatkṛtam  |
bhavatyakarturīśasya sākṣiṇo nirvṛtātmanaḥ  || 03.26.007 ||
kāryakāraṇakartṛtve kāraṇaṃ prakṛtiṃ viduḥ  |
bhoktṛtve sukhaduḥkhānāṃ puruṣaṃ prakṛteḥ param  || 03.26.008 ||
03.26.009|0 devahūtiruvāca
prakṛteḥ puruṣasyāpi lakṣaṇaṃ puruṣottama  |
brūhi kāraṇayorasya sadasacca yadātmakam  || 03.26.009 ||
03.26.010|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
yattattriguṇamavyaktaṃ nityaṃ sadasadātmakam  |
pradhānaṃ prakṛtiṃ prāhuraviśeṣaṃ viśeṣavat || 03.26.010 ||
pañcabhiḥ pañcabhirbrahma caturbhirdaśabhistathā  |
etaccaturviṃśatikaṃ gaṇaṃ prādhānikaṃ viduḥ  || 03.26.011 ||
mahābhūtāni pañcaiva bhūrāpo'gnirmarunnabhaḥ  |
tanmātrāṇi ca tāvanti gandhādīni matāni me  || 03.26.012 ||
indriyāṇi daśa śrotraṃ tvagdṛgrasananāsikāḥ  |
vākkarau caraṇau meḍhraṃ pāyurdaśama ucyate  || 03.26.013 ||
mano buddhirahaṅkāraścittamityantarātmakam  |
caturdhā lakṣyate bhedo vṛttyā lakṣaṇarūpayā  || 03.26.014 ||
etāvāneva saṅkhyāto brahmaṇaḥ saguṇasya ha  |
sanniveśo mayā prokto yaḥ kālaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ  || 03.26.015 ||
prabhāvaṃ pauruṣaṃ prāhuḥ kālameke yato bhayam  |
ahaṅkāravimūḍhasya kartuḥ prakṛtimīyuṣaḥ  || 03.26.016 ||
prakṛterguṇasāmyasya nirviśeṣasya mānavi  |
ceṣṭā yataḥ sa bhagavān kāla ityupalakṣitaḥ  || 03.26.017 ||
antaḥ puruṣarūpeṇa kālarūpeṇa yo bahiḥ  |
samanvetyeṣa sattvānāṃ bhagavānātmamāyayā  || 03.26.018 ||
daivātkṣubhitadharmiṇyāṃ svasyāṃ yonau paraḥ pumān  |
ādhatta vīryaṃ sāsūta mahattattvaṃ hiraṇmayam  || 03.26.019 ||
viśvamātmagataṃ vyañjan kūṭastho jagadaṅkuraḥ  |
svatejasāpibattīvramātmaprasvāpanaṃ tamaḥ  || 03.26.020 ||
yattatsattvaguṇaṃ svacchaṃ śāntaṃ bhagavataḥ padam  |
yadāhurvāsudevākhyaṃ cittaṃ tanmahadātmakam  || 03.26.021 ||
svacchatvamavikāritvaṃ śāntatvamiti cetasaḥ  |
vṛttibhirlakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ yathāpāṃ prakṛtiḥ parā  || 03.26.022 ||
mahattattvādvikurvāṇādbhagavadvīryasambhavāt |
kriyāśaktirahaṅkārastrividhaḥ samapadyata  || 03.26.023 ||
vaikārikastaijasaśca tāmasaśca yato bhavaḥ  |
manasaścendriyāṇāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ mahatāmapi  || 03.26.024 ||
sahasraśirasaṃ sākṣādyamanantaṃ pracakṣate  |
saṅkarṣaṇākhyaṃ puruṣaṃ bhūtendriyamanomayam  || 03.26.025 ||
kartṛtvaṃ karaṇatvaṃ ca kāryatvaṃ ceti lakṣaṇam  |
śāntaghoravimūḍhatvamiti vā syādahaṅkṛteḥ  || 03.26.026 ||
vaikārikādvikurvāṇānmanastattvamajāyata  |
yatsaṅkalpavikalpābhyāṃ vartate kāmasambhavaḥ  || 03.26.027 ||
yadvidurhyaniruddhākhyaṃ hṛṣīkāṇāmadhīśvaram  |
śāradendīvaraśyāmaṃ saṃrādhyaṃ yogibhiḥ śanaiḥ  || 03.26.028 ||
taijasāttu vikurvāṇādbuddhitattvamabhūtsati  |
dravyasphuraṇavijñānamindriyāṇāmanugrahaḥ  || 03.26.029 ||
saṃśayo'tha viparyāso niścayaḥ smṛtireva ca  |
svāpa ityucyate buddherlakṣaṇaṃ vṛttitaḥ pṛthak || 03.26.030 ||
taijasānīndriyāṇyeva kriyājñānavibhāgaśaḥ  |
prāṇasya hi kriyāśaktirbuddhervijñānaśaktitā  || 03.26.031 ||
tāmasācca vikurvāṇādbhagavadvīryacoditāt |
śabdamātramabhūttasmānnabhaḥ śrotraṃ tu śabdagam  || 03.26.032 ||
arthāśrayatvaṃ śabdasya draṣṭurliṅgatvameva ca  |
tanmātratvaṃ ca nabhaso lakṣaṇaṃ kavayo viduḥ  || 03.26.033 ||
bhūtānāṃ chidradātṛtvaṃ bahirantarameva ca  |
prāṇendriyātmadhiṣṇyatvaṃ nabhaso vṛttilakṣaṇam  || 03.26.034 ||
nabhasaḥ śabdatanmātrātkālagatyā vikurvataḥ  |
sparśo'bhavattato vāyustvaksparśasya ca saṅgrahaḥ  || 03.26.035 ||
mṛdutvaṃ kaṭhinatvaṃ ca śaityamuṣṇatvameva ca  |
etatsparśasya sparśatvaṃ tanmātratvaṃ nabhasvataḥ  || 03.26.036 ||
cālanaṃ vyūhanaṃ prāptirnetṛtvaṃ dravyaśabdayoḥ  |
sarvendriyāṇāmātmatvaṃ vāyoḥ karmābhilakṣaṇam  || 03.26.037 ||
vāyośca sparśatanmātrādrūpaṃ daiveritādabhūt |
samutthitaṃ tatastejaścakṣū rūpopalambhanam  || 03.26.038 ||
dravyākṛtitvaṃ guṇatā vyaktisaṃsthātvameva ca  |
tejastvaṃ tejasaḥ sādhvi rūpamātrasya vṛttayaḥ  || 03.26.039 ||
dyotanaṃ pacanaṃ pānamadanaṃ himamardanam  |
tejaso vṛttayastvetāḥ śoṣaṇaṃ kṣuttṛḍeva ca  || 03.26.040 ||
rūpamātrādvikurvāṇāttejaso daivacoditāt |
rasamātramabhūttasmādambho jihvā rasagrahaḥ  || 03.26.041 ||
kaṣāyo madhurastiktaḥ kaṭvamla iti naikadhā  |
bhautikānāṃ vikāreṇa rasa eko vibhidyate  || 03.26.042 ||
kledanaṃ piṇḍanaṃ tṛptiḥ prāṇanāpyāyanondanam  |
tāpāpanodo bhūyastvamambhaso vṛttayastvimāḥ  || 03.26.043 ||
rasamātrādvikurvāṇādambhaso daivacoditāt |
gandhamātramabhūttasmātpṛthvī ghrāṇastu gandhagaḥ  || 03.26.044 ||
karambhapūtisaurabhya śāntogrāmlādibhiḥ pṛthak |
dravyāvayavavaiṣamyādgandha eko vibhidyate  || 03.26.045 ||
bhāvanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ dhāraṇaṃ sadviśeṣaṇam  |
sarvasattvaguṇodbhedaḥ pṛthivīvṛttilakṣaṇam  || 03.26.046 ||
nabhoguṇaviśeṣo'rtho yasya tacchrotramucyate  |
vāyorguṇaviśeṣo'rtho yasya tatsparśanaṃ viduḥ  || 03.26.047 ||
tejoguṇaviśeṣo'rtho yasya taccakṣurucyate  |
ambhoguṇaviśeṣo'rtho yasya tadrasanaṃ viduḥ  |
bhūmerguṇaviśeṣo'rtho yasya sa ghrāṇa ucyate  || 03.26.048 ||
parasya dṛśyate dharmo hyaparasmin samanvayāt |
ato viśeṣo bhāvānāṃ bhūmāvevopalakṣyate  || 03.26.049 ||
etānyasaṃhatya yadā mahadādīni sapta vai  |
kālakarmaguṇopeto jagadādirupāviśat || 03.26.050 ||
tatastenānuviddhebhyo yuktebhyo'ṇḍamacetanam  |
utthitaṃ puruṣo yasmādudatiṣṭhadasau virāṭ || 03.26.051 ||
etadaṇḍaṃ viśeṣākhyaṃ kramavṛddhairdaśottaraiḥ  |
toyādibhiḥ parivṛtaṃ pradhānenāvṛtairbahiḥ  |
yatra lokavitāno'yaṃ rūpaṃ bhagavato hareḥ  || 03.26.052 ||
hiraṇmayādaṇḍakośādutthāya salile śayāt |
tamāviśya mahādevo bahudhā nirbibheda kham  || 03.26.053 ||
nirabhidyatāsya prathamaṃ mukhaṃ vāṇī tato'bhavat |
vāṇyā vahniratho nāse prāṇoto ghrāṇa etayoḥ  || 03.26.054 ||
ghrāṇādvāyurabhidyetāmakṣiṇī cakṣuretayoḥ  |
tasmātsūryo nyabhidyetāṃ karṇau śrotraṃ tato diśaḥ  || 03.26.055 ||
nirbibheda virājastvagromaśmaśrvādayastataḥ  |
tata oṣadhayaścāsan śiśnaṃ nirbibhide tataḥ  || 03.26.056 ||
retastasmādāpa āsannirabhidyata vai gudam  |
gudādapāno'pānācca mṛtyurlokabhayaṅkaraḥ  || 03.26.057 ||
hastau ca nirabhidyetāṃ balaṃ tābhyāṃ tataḥ svarāṭ |
pādau ca nirabhidyetāṃ gatistābhyāṃ tato hariḥ  || 03.26.058 ||
nāḍyo'sya nirabhidyanta tābhyo lohitamābhṛtam  |
nadyastataḥ samabhavannudaraṃ nirabhidyata  || 03.26.059 ||
kṣutpipāse tataḥ syātāṃ samudrastvetayorabhūt |
athāsya hṛdayaṃ bhinnaṃ hṛdayānmana utthitam  || 03.26.060 ||
manasaścandramā jāto buddhirbuddhergirāṃ patiḥ  |
ahaṅkārastato rudraścittaṃ caityastato'bhavat || 03.26.061 ||
ete hyabhyutthitā devā naivāsyotthāpane'śakan  |
punarāviviśuḥ khāni tamutthāpayituṃ kramāt || 03.26.062 ||
vahnirvācā mukhaṃ bheje nodatiṣṭhattadā virāṭ |
ghrāṇena nāsike vāyurnodatiṣṭhattadā virāṭ || 03.26.063 ||
akṣiṇī cakṣuṣādityo nodatiṣṭhattadā virāṭ |
śrotreṇa karṇau ca diśo nodatiṣṭhattadā virāṭ || 03.26.064 ||
tvacaṃ romabhiroṣadhyo nodatiṣṭhattadā virāṭ |
retasā śiśnamāpastu nodatiṣṭhattadā virāṭ || 03.26.065 ||
gudaṃ mṛtyurapānena nodatiṣṭhattadā virāṭ |
hastāvindro balenaiva nodatiṣṭhattadā virāṭ || 03.26.066 ||
viṣṇurgatyaiva caraṇau nodatiṣṭhattadā virāṭ |
nāḍīrnadyo lohitena nodatiṣṭhattadā virāṭ || 03.26.067 ||
kṣuttṛḍbhyāmudaraṃ sindhurnodatiṣṭhattadā virāṭ |
hṛdayaṃ manasā candro nodatiṣṭhattadā virāṭ || 03.26.068 ||
buddhyā brahmāpi hṛdayaṃ nodatiṣṭhattadā virāṭ |
rudro'bhimatyā hṛdayaṃ nodatiṣṭhattadā virāṭ || 03.26.069 ||
cittena hṛdayaṃ caityaḥ kṣetrajñaḥ prāviśadyadā  |
virāṭtadaiva puruṣaḥ salilādudatiṣṭhata  || 03.26.070 ||
yathā prasuptaṃ puruṣaṃ prāṇendriyamanodhiyaḥ  |
prabhavanti vinā yena notthāpayitumojasā  || 03.26.071 ||
tamasmin pratyagātmānaṃ dhiyā yogapravṛttayā  |
bhaktyā viraktyā jñānena vivicyātmani cintayet || 03.26.072 ||
03.27.001|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
prakṛtistho'pi puruṣo nājyate prākṛtairguṇaiḥ  |
avikārādakartṛtvānnirguṇatvājjalārkavat || 03.27.001 ||
sa eṣa yarhi prakṛterguṇeṣvabhiviṣajjate  |
ahaṅkriyāvimūḍhātmā kartāsmītyabhimanyate  || 03.27.002 ||
tena saṃsārapadavīmavaśo'bhyetyanirvṛtaḥ  |
prāsaṅgikaiḥ karmadoṣaiḥ sadasanmiśrayoniṣu  || 03.27.003 ||
arthe hyavidyamāne'pi saṃsṛtirna nivartate  |
dhyāyato viṣayānasya svapne'narthāgamo yathā  || 03.27.004 ||
ata eva śanaiścittaṃ prasaktamasatāṃ pathi  |
bhaktiyogena tīvreṇa viraktyā ca nayedvaśam  || 03.27.005 ||
yamādibhiryogapathairabhyasañśraddhayānvitaḥ  |
mayi bhāvena satyena matkathāśravaṇena ca  || 03.27.006 ||
sarvabhūtasamatvena nirvaireṇāprasaṅgataḥ  |
brahmacaryeṇa maunena svadharmeṇa balīyasā  || 03.27.007 ||
yadṛcchayopalabdhena santuṣṭo mitabhuṅmuniḥ  |
viviktaśaraṇaḥ śānto maitraḥ karuṇa ātmavān  || 03.27.008 ||
sānubandhe ca dehe'sminnakurvannasadāgraham  |
jñānena dṛṣṭatattvena prakṛteḥ puruṣasya ca  || 03.27.009 ||
nivṛttabuddhyavasthāno dūrībhūtānyadarśanaḥ  |
upalabhyātmanātmānaṃ cakṣuṣevārkamātmadṛk || 03.27.010 ||
muktaliṅgaṃ sadābhāsamasati pratipadyate  |
sato bandhumasaccakṣuḥ sarvānusyūtamadvayam  || 03.27.011 ||
yathā jalastha ābhāsaḥ sthalasthenāvadṛśyate  |
svābhāsena tathā sūryo jalasthena divi sthitaḥ  || 03.27.012 ||
evaṃ trivṛdahaṅkāro bhūtendriyamanomayaiḥ  |
svābhāsairlakṣito'nena sadābhāsena satyadṛk || 03.27.013 ||
bhūtasūkṣmendriyamano buddhyādiṣviha nidrayā  |
līneṣvasati yastatra vinidro nirahaṅkriyaḥ  || 03.27.014 ||
manyamānastadātmānamanaṣṭo naṣṭavanmṛṣā  |
naṣṭe'haṅkaraṇe draṣṭā naṣṭavitta ivāturaḥ  || 03.27.015 ||
evaṃ pratyavamṛśyāsāvātmānaṃ pratipadyate  |
sāhaṅkārasya dravyasya yo'vasthānamanugrahaḥ  || 03.27.016 ||
03.27.017|0 devahūtiruvāca
puruṣaṃ prakṛtirbrahmanna vimuñcati karhicit |
anyonyāpāśrayatvācca nityatvādanayoḥ prabho  || 03.27.017 ||
yathā gandhasya bhūmeśca na bhāvo vyatirekataḥ  |
apāṃ rasasya ca yathā tathā buddheḥ parasya ca  || 03.27.018 ||
akartuḥ karmabandho'yaṃ puruṣasya yadāśrayaḥ  |
guṇeṣu satsu prakṛteḥ kaivalyaṃ teṣvataḥ katham  || 03.27.019 ||
kvacittattvāvamarśena nivṛttaṃ bhayamulbaṇam  |
anivṛttanimittatvātpunaḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate  || 03.27.020 ||
03.27.021|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
animittanimittena svadharmeṇāmalātmanā  |
tīvrayā mayi bhaktyā ca śrutasambhṛtayā ciram  || 03.27.021 ||
jñānena dṛṣṭatattvena vairāgyeṇa balīyasā  |
tapoyuktena yogena tīvreṇātmasamādhinā  || 03.27.022 ||
prakṛtiḥ puruṣasyeha dahyamānā tvaharniśam  |
tirobhavitrī śanakairagneryonirivāraṇiḥ  || 03.27.023 ||
bhuktabhogā parityaktā dṛṣṭadoṣā ca nityaśaḥ  |
neśvarasyāśubhaṃ dhatte sve mahimni sthitasya ca  || 03.27.024 ||
yathā hyapratibuddhasya prasvāpo bahvanarthabhṛt |
sa eva pratibuddhasya na vai mohāya kalpate  || 03.27.025 ||
evaṃ viditatattvasya prakṛtirmayi mānasam  |
yuñjato nāpakuruta ātmārāmasya karhicit || 03.27.026 ||
yadaivamadhyātmarataḥ kālena bahujanmanā  |
sarvatra jātavairāgya ābrahmabhuvanānmuniḥ  || 03.27.027 ||
madbhaktaḥ pratibuddhārtho matprasādena bhūyasā  |
niḥśreyasaṃ svasaṃsthānaṃ kaivalyākhyaṃ madāśrayam  || 03.27.028 ||
prāpnotīhāñjasā dhīraḥ svadṛśā cchinnasaṃśayaḥ  |
yadgatvā na nivarteta yogī liṅgādvinirgame  || 03.27.029 ||
yadā na yogopacitāsu ceto māyāsu siddhasya viṣajjate'ṅga  |
ananyahetuṣvatha me gatiḥ syādātyantikī yatra na mṛtyuhāsaḥ  || 03.27.030 ||
03.28.001|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
yogasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye sabījasya nṛpātmaje  |
mano yenaiva vidhinā prasannaṃ yāti satpatham  || 03.28.001 ||
svadharmācaraṇaṃ śaktyā vidharmācca nivartanam  |
daivāllabdhena santoṣa ātmaviccaraṇārcanam  || 03.28.002 ||
grāmyadharmanivṛttiśca mokṣadharmaratistathā  |
mitamedhyādanaṃ śaśvadviviktakṣemasevanam  || 03.28.003 ||
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ yāvadarthaparigrahaḥ  |
brahmacaryaṃ tapaḥ śaucaṃ svādhyāyaḥ puruṣārcanam  || 03.28.004 ||
maunaṃ sadāsanajayaḥ sthairyaṃ prāṇajayaḥ śanaiḥ  |
pratyāhāraścendriyāṇāṃ viṣayānmanasā hṛdi  || 03.28.005 ||
svadhiṣṇyānāmekadeśe manasā prāṇadhāraṇam  |
vaikuṇṭhalīlābhidhyānaṃ samādhānaṃ tathātmanaḥ  || 03.28.006 ||
etairanyaiśca pathibhirmano duṣṭamasatpatham  |
buddhyā yuñjīta śanakairjitaprāṇo hyatandritaḥ  || 03.28.007 ||
śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya vijitāsana āsanam  |
tasmin svasti samāsīna ṛjukāyaḥ samabhyaset || 03.28.008 ||
prāṇasya śodhayenmārgaṃ pūrakumbhakarecakaiḥ  |
pratikūlena vā cittaṃ yathā sthiramacañcalam  || 03.28.009 ||
mano'cirātsyādvirajaṃ jitaśvāsasya yoginaḥ  |
vāyvagnibhyāṃ yathā lohaṃ dhmātaṃ tyajati vai malam  || 03.28.010 ||
prāṇāyāmairdaheddoṣān dhāraṇābhiśca kilbiṣān  |
pratyāhāreṇa saṃsargān dhyānenānīśvarān guṇān  || 03.28.011 ||
yadā manaḥ svaṃ virajaṃ yogena susamāhitam  |
kāṣṭhāṃ bhagavato dhyāyetsvanāsāgrāvalokanaḥ  || 03.28.012 ||
prasannavadanāmbhojaṃ padmagarbhāruṇekṣaṇam  |
nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam  || 03.28.013 ||
lasatpaṅkajakiñjalka pītakauśeyavāsasam  |
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ bhrājatkaustubhāmuktakandharam  || 03.28.014 ||
mattadvirephakalayā parītaṃ vanamālayā  |
parārdhyahāravalaya kirīṭāṅgadanūpuram  || 03.28.015 ||
kāñcīguṇollasacchroṇiṃ hṛdayāmbhojaviṣṭaram  |
darśanīyatamaṃ śāntaṃ manonayanavardhanam  || 03.28.016 ||
apīcyadarśanaṃ śaśvatsarvalokanamaskṛtam  |
santaṃ vayasi kaiśore bhṛtyānugrahakātaram  || 03.28.017 ||
kīrtanyatīrthayaśasaṃ puṇyaślokayaśaskaram  |
dhyāyeddevaṃ samagrāṅgaṃ yāvanna cyavate manaḥ  || 03.28.018 ||
sthitaṃ vrajantamāsīnaṃ śayānaṃ vā guhāśayam  |
prekṣaṇīyehitaṃ dhyāyecchuddhabhāvena cetasā  || 03.28.019 ||
tasmin labdhapadaṃ cittaṃ sarvāvayavasaṃsthitam  |
vilakṣyaikatra saṃyujyādaṅge bhagavato muniḥ  || 03.28.020 ||
sañcintayedbhagavataścaraṇāravindaṃ   vajrāṅkuśadhvajasaroruhalāñchanāḍhyam  |
uttuṅgaraktavilasannakhacakravāla   jyotsnābhirāhatamahaddhṛdayāndhakāram  || 03.28.021 ||*
yacchaucaniḥsṛtasaritpravarodakena   tīrthena mūrdhnyadhikṛtena śivaḥ śivo'bhūt |
dhyāturmanaḥśamalaśailanisṛṣṭavajraṃ   dhyāyecciraṃ bhagavataścaraṇāravindam  || 03.28.022 ||*
jānudvayaṃ jalajalocanayā jananyā   lakṣmyākhilasya suravanditayā vidhātuḥ  |
ūrvornidhāya karapallavarociṣā yat  saṃlālitaṃ hṛdi vibhorabhavasya kuryāt || 03.28.023 ||*
ūrū suparṇabhujayoradhi śobhamānāv  ojonidhī atasikākusumāvabhāsau  |
vyālambipītavaravāsasi vartamāna   kāñcīkalāpaparirambhi nitambabimbam  || 03.28.024 ||*
nābhihradaṃ bhuvanakośaguhodarasthaṃ   yatrātmayonidhiṣaṇākhilalokapadmam  |
vyūḍhaṃ harinmaṇivṛṣastanayoramuṣya   dhyāyeddvayaṃ viśadahāramayūkhagauram  || 03.28.025 ||*
vakṣo'dhivāsamṛṣabhasya mahāvibhūteḥ   puṃsāṃ manonayananirvṛtimādadhānam  |
kaṇṭhaṃ ca kaustubhamaṇeradhibhūṣaṇārthaṃ   kuryānmanasyakhilalokanamaskṛtasya  || 03.28.026 ||*
bāhūṃśca mandaragireḥ parivartanena   nirṇiktabāhuvalayānadhilokapālān  |
sañcintayeddaśaśatāramasahyatejaḥ   śaṅkhaṃ ca tatkarasaroruharājahaṃsam  || 03.28.027 ||*
kaumodakīṃ bhagavato dayitāṃ smareta   digdhāmarātibhaṭaśoṇitakardamena  |
mālāṃ madhuvratavarūthagiropaghuṣṭāṃ   caityasya tattvamamalaṃ maṇimasya kaṇṭhe  || 03.28.028 ||*
bhṛtyānukampitadhiyeha gṛhītamūrteḥ   sañcintayedbhagavato vadanāravindam  |
yadvisphuranmakarakuṇḍalavalgitena   vidyotitāmalakapolamudāranāsam  || 03.28.029 ||*
yacchrīniketamalibhiḥ parisevyamānaṃ   bhūtyā svayā kuṭilakuntalavṛndajuṣṭam  |
mīnadvayāśrayamadhikṣipadabjanetraṃ   dhyāyenmanomayamatandrita ullasadbhru  || 03.28.030 ||*
tasyāvalokamadhikaṃ kṛpayātighora   tāpatrayopaśamanāya nisṛṣṭamakṣṇoḥ  |
snigdhasmitānuguṇitaṃ vipulaprasādaṃ   dhyāyecciraṃ vipulabhāvanayā guhāyām  || 03.28.031 ||*
hāsaṃ hareravanatākhilalokatīvra   śokāśrusāgaraviśoṣaṇamatyudāram  |
sammohanāya racitaṃ nijamāyayāsya   bhrūmaṇḍalaṃ munikṛte makaradhvajasya  || 03.28.032 ||*
dhyānāyanaṃ prahasitaṃ bahulādharoṣṭha   bhāsāruṇāyitatanudvijakundapaṅkti  |
dhyāyetsvadehakuhare'vasitasya viṣṇor  bhaktyārdrayārpitamanā na pṛthagdidṛkṣet || 03.28.033 ||*
evaṃ harau bhagavati pratilabdhabhāvo   bhaktyā dravaddhṛdaya utpulakaḥ pramodāt |
autkaṇṭhyabāṣpakalayā muhurardyamānas  taccāpi cittabaḍiśaṃ śanakairviyuṅkte  || 03.28.034 ||*
muktāśrayaṃ yarhi nirviṣayaṃ viraktaṃ   nirvāṇamṛcchati manaḥ sahasā yathārciḥ  |
ātmānamatra puruṣo'vyavadhānamekam   anvīkṣate pratinivṛttaguṇapravāhaḥ  || 03.28.035 ||*
so'pyetayā caramayā manaso nivṛttyā   tasminmahimnyavasitaḥ sukhaduḥkhabāhye  |
hetutvamapyasati kartari duḥkhayoryat  svātman vidhatta upalabdhaparātmakāṣṭhaḥ  || 03.28.036 ||*
dehaṃ ca taṃ na caramaḥ sthitamutthitaṃ vā   siddho vipaśyati yato'dhyagamatsvarūpam  |
daivādupetamatha daivavaśādapetaṃ   vāso yathā parikṛtaṃ madirāmadāndhaḥ  || 03.28.037 ||*
deho'pi daivavaśagaḥ khalu karma yāvat  svārambhakaṃ pratisamīkṣata eva sāsuḥ  |
taṃ saprapañcamadhirūḍhasamādhiyogaḥ   svāpnaṃ punarna bhajate pratibuddhavastuḥ  || 03.28.038 ||*
yathā putrācca vittācca pṛthaṅmartyaḥ pratīyate  |
apyātmatvenābhimatāddehādeḥ puruṣastathā  || 03.28.039 ||
yatholmukādvisphuliṅgāddhūmādvāpi svasambhavāt |
apyātmatvenābhimatādyathāgniḥ pṛthagulmukāt || 03.28.040 ||
bhūtendriyāntaḥkaraṇātpradhānājjīvasaṃjñitāt |
ātmā tathā pṛthagdraṣṭā bhagavān brahmasaṃjñitaḥ  || 03.28.041 ||
sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani  |
īkṣetānanyabhāvena bhūteṣviva tadātmatām  || 03.28.042 ||
svayoniṣu yathā jyotirekaṃ nānā pratīyate  |
yonīnāṃ guṇavaiṣamyāttathātmā prakṛtau sthitaḥ  || 03.28.043 ||
tasmādimāṃ svāṃ prakṛtiṃ daivīṃ sadasadātmikām  |
durvibhāvyāṃ parābhāvya svarūpeṇāvatiṣṭhate  || 03.28.044 ||
03.29.001|0 devahūtiruvāca
lakṣaṇaṃ mahadādīnāṃ prakṛteḥ puruṣasya ca  |
svarūpaṃ lakṣyate'mīṣāṃ yena tatpāramārthikam  || 03.29.001 ||
yathā sāṅkhyeṣu kathitaṃ yanmūlaṃ tatpracakṣate  |
bhaktiyogasya me mārgaṃ brūhi vistaraśaḥ prabho  || 03.29.002 ||
virāgo yena puruṣo bhagavan sarvato bhavet |
ācakṣva jīvalokasya vividhā mama saṃsṛtīḥ  || 03.29.003 ||
kālasyeśvararūpasya pareṣāṃ ca parasya te  |
svarūpaṃ bata kurvanti yaddhetoḥ kuśalaṃ janāḥ  || 03.29.004 ||
lokasya mithyābhimateracakṣuṣaściraṃ prasuptasya tamasyanāśraye  |
śrāntasya karmasvanuviddhayā dhiyā tvamāvirāsīḥ kila yogabhāskaraḥ  || 03.29.005 ||
03.29.006|0 maitreya uvāca
iti māturvacaḥ ślakṣṇaṃ pratinandya mahāmuniḥ  |
ābabhāṣe kuruśreṣṭha prītastāṃ karuṇārditaḥ  || 03.29.006 ||
03.29.007|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
bhaktiyogo bahuvidho mārgairbhāmini bhāvyate  |
svabhāvaguṇamārgeṇa puṃsāṃ bhāvo vibhidyate  || 03.29.007 ||
abhisandhāya yo hiṃsāṃ dambhaṃ mātsaryameva vā  |
saṃrambhī bhinnadṛgbhāvaṃ mayi kuryātsa tāmasaḥ  || 03.29.008 ||
viṣayānabhisandhāya yaśa aiśvaryameva vā  |
arcādāvarcayedyo māṃ pṛthagbhāvaḥ sa rājasaḥ  || 03.29.009 ||
karmanirhāramuddiśya parasmin vā tadarpaṇam  |
yajedyaṣṭavyamiti vā pṛthagbhāvaḥ sa sāttvikaḥ  || 03.29.010 ||
madguṇaśrutimātreṇa mayi sarvaguhāśaye  |
manogatiravicchinnā yathā gaṅgāmbhaso'mbudhau  || 03.29.011 ||
lakṣaṇaṃ bhaktiyogasya nirguṇasya hyudāhṛtam  |
ahaitukyavyavahitā yā bhaktiḥ puruṣottame  || 03.29.012 ||
sālokyasārṣṭisāmīpya sārūpyaikatvamapyuta  |
dīyamānaṃ na gṛhṇanti vinā matsevanaṃ janāḥ  || 03.29.013 ||
sa eva bhaktiyogākhya ātyantika udāhṛtaḥ  |
yenātivrajya triguṇaṃ madbhāvāyopapadyate  || 03.29.014 ||
niṣevitenānimittena svadharmeṇa mahīyasā  |
kriyāyogena śastena nātihiṃsreṇa nityaśaḥ  || 03.29.015 ||
maddhiṣṇyadarśanasparśa pūjāstutyabhivandanaiḥ  |
bhūteṣu madbhāvanayā sattvenāsaṅgamena ca  || 03.29.016 ||
mahatāṃ bahumānena dīnānāmanukampayā  |
maitryā caivātmatulyeṣu yamena niyamena ca  || 03.29.017 ||
ādhyātmikānuśravaṇānnāmasaṅkīrtanācca me  |
ārjavenāryasaṅgena nirahaṅkriyayā tathā  || 03.29.018 ||
maddharmaṇo guṇairetaiḥ parisaṃśuddha āśayaḥ  |
puruṣasyāñjasābhyeti śrutamātraguṇaṃ hi mām  || 03.29.019 ||
yathā vātaratho ghrāṇamāvṛṅkte gandha āśayāt |
evaṃ yogarataṃ ceta ātmānamavikāri yat || 03.29.020 ||
ahaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu bhūtātmāvasthitaḥ sadā  |
tamavajñāya māṃ martyaḥ kurute'rcāviḍambanam  || 03.29.021 ||
yo māṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu santamātmānamīśvaram  |
hitvārcāṃ bhajate mauḍhyādbhasmanyeva juhoti saḥ  || 03.29.022 ||
dviṣataḥ parakāye māṃ mānino bhinnadarśinaḥ  |
bhūteṣu baddhavairasya na manaḥ śāntimṛcchati  || 03.29.023 ||
ahamuccāvacairdravyaiḥ kriyayotpannayānaghe  |
naiva tuṣye'rcito'rcāyāṃ bhūtagrāmāvamāninaḥ  || 03.29.024 ||
arcādāvarcayettāvadīśvaraṃ māṃ svakarmakṛt |
yāvanna veda svahṛdi sarvabhūteṣvavasthitam  || 03.29.025 ||
ātmanaśca parasyāpi yaḥ karotyantarodaram  |
tasya bhinnadṛśo mṛtyurvidadhe bhayamulbaṇam  || 03.29.026 ||
atha māṃ sarvabhūteṣu bhūtātmānaṃ kṛtālayam  |
arhayeddānamānābhyāṃ maitryābhinnena cakṣuṣā  || 03.29.027 ||
jīvāḥ śreṣṭhā hyajīvānāṃ tataḥ prāṇabhṛtaḥ śubhe  |
tataḥ sacittāḥ pravarāstataścendriyavṛttayaḥ  || 03.29.028 ||
tatrāpi sparśavedibhyaḥ pravarā rasavedinaḥ  |
tebhyo gandhavidaḥ śreṣṭhāstataḥ śabdavido varāḥ  || 03.29.029 ||
rūpabhedavidastatra tataścobhayatodataḥ  |
teṣāṃ bahupadāḥ śreṣṭhāścatuṣpādastato dvipāt || 03.29.030 ||
tato varṇāśca catvārasteṣāṃ brāhmaṇa uttamaḥ  |
brāhmaṇeṣvapi vedajño hyarthajño'bhyadhikastataḥ  || 03.29.031 ||
arthajñātsaṃśayacchettā tataḥ śreyān svakarmakṛt |
muktasaṅgastato bhūyānadogdhā dharmamātmanaḥ  || 03.29.032 ||
tasmānmayyarpitāśeṣa kriyārthātmā nirantaraḥ  |
mayyarpitātmanaḥ puṃso mayi sannyastakarmaṇaḥ  |
na paśyāmi paraṃ bhūtamakartuḥ samadarśanāt || 03.29.033 ||
manasaitāni bhūtāni praṇamedbahumānayan  |
īśvaro jīvakalayā praviṣṭo bhagavāniti  || 03.29.034 ||
bhaktiyogaśca yogaśca mayā mānavyudīritaḥ  |
yayorekatareṇaiva puruṣaḥ puruṣaṃ vrajet || 03.29.035 ||
etadbhagavato rūpaṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ  |
paraṃ pradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ daivaṃ karmaviceṣṭitam  || 03.29.036 ||
rūpabhedāspadaṃ divyaṃ kāla ityabhidhīyate  |
bhūtānāṃ mahadādīnāṃ yato bhinnadṛśāṃ bhayam  || 03.29.037 ||
yo'ntaḥ praviśya bhūtāni bhūtairattyakhilāśrayaḥ  |
sa viṣṇvākhyo'dhiyajño'sau kālaḥ kalayatāṃ prabhuḥ  || 03.29.038 ||
na cāsya kaściddayito na dveṣyo na ca bāndhavaḥ  |
āviśatyapramatto'sau pramattaṃ janamantakṛt || 03.29.039 ||
yadbhayādvāti vāto'yaṃ sūryastapati yadbhayāt |
yadbhayādvarṣate devo bhagaṇo bhāti yadbhayāt || 03.29.040 ||
yadvanaspatayo bhītā latāścauṣadhibhiḥ saha  |
sve sve kāle'bhigṛhṇanti puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca  || 03.29.041 ||
sravanti sarito bhītā notsarpatyudadhiryataḥ  |
agnirindhe sagiribhirbhūrna majjati yadbhayāt || 03.29.042 ||
nabho dadāti śvasatāṃ padaṃ yanniyamādadaḥ  |
lokaṃ svadehaṃ tanute mahān saptabhirāvṛtam  || 03.29.043 ||
guṇābhimānino devāḥ sargādiṣvasya yadbhayāt |
vartante'nuyugaṃ yeṣāṃ vaśa etaccarācaram  || 03.29.044 ||
so'nanto'ntakaraḥ kālo'nādirādikṛdavyayaḥ  |
janaṃ janena janayanmārayanmṛtyunāntakam  || 03.29.045 ||
03.30.001|0 kapila uvāca
tasyaitasya jano nūnaṃ nāyaṃ vedoruvikramam  |
kālyamāno'pi balino vāyoriva ghanāvaliḥ  || 03.30.001 ||
yaṃ yamarthamupādatte duḥkhena sukhahetave  |
taṃ taṃ dhunoti bhagavān pumān chocati yatkṛte  || 03.30.002 ||
yadadhruvasya dehasya sānubandhasya durmatiḥ  |
dhruvāṇi manyate mohādgṛhakṣetravasūni ca  || 03.30.003 ||
janturvai bhava etasmin yāṃ yāṃ yonimanuvrajet |
tasyāṃ tasyāṃ sa labhate nirvṛtiṃ na virajyate  || 03.30.004 ||
narakastho'pi dehaṃ vai na pumāṃstyaktumicchati  |
nārakyāṃ nirvṛtau satyāṃ devamāyāvimohitaḥ  || 03.30.005 ||
ātmajāyāsutāgāra paśudraviṇabandhuṣu  |
nirūḍhamūlahṛdaya ātmānaṃ bahu manyate  || 03.30.006 ||
sandahyamānasarvāṅga eṣāmudvahanādhinā  |
karotyavirataṃ mūḍho duritāni durāśayaḥ  || 03.30.007 ||
ākṣiptātmendriyaḥ strīṇāmasatīnāṃ ca māyayā  |
raho racitayālāpaiḥ śiśūnāṃ kalabhāṣiṇām  || 03.30.008 ||
gṛheṣu kūṭadharmeṣu duḥkhatantreṣvatandritaḥ  |
kurvan duḥkhapratīkāraṃ sukhavanmanyate gṛhī  || 03.30.009 ||
arthairāpāditairgurvyā hiṃsayetastataśca tān  |
puṣṇāti yeṣāṃ poṣeṇa śeṣabhugyātyadhaḥ svayam  || 03.30.010 ||
vārtāyāṃ lupyamānāyāmārabdhāyāṃ punaḥ punaḥ  |
lobhābhibhūto niḥsattvaḥ parārthe kurute spṛhām  || 03.30.011 ||
kuṭumbabharaṇākalpo mandabhāgyo vṛthodyamaḥ  |
śriyā vihīnaḥ kṛpaṇo dhyāyan chvasiti mūḍhadhīḥ  || 03.30.012 ||
evaṃ svabharaṇākalpaṃ tatkalatrādayastathā  |
nādriyante yathā pūrvaṃ kīnāśā iva gojaram  || 03.30.013 ||
tatrāpyajātanirvedo bhriyamāṇaḥ svayaṃ bhṛtaiḥ  |
jarayopāttavairūpyo maraṇābhimukho gṛhe  || 03.30.014 ||
āste'vamatyopanyastaṃ gṛhapāla ivāharan  |
āmayāvyapradīptāgniralpāhāro'lpaceṣṭitaḥ  || 03.30.015 ||
vāyunotkramatottāraḥ kaphasaṃruddhanāḍikaḥ  |
kāsaśvāsakṛtāyāsaḥ kaṇṭhe ghuraghurāyate  || 03.30.016 ||
śayānaḥ pariśocadbhiḥ parivītaḥ svabandhubhiḥ  |
vācyamāno'pi na brūte kālapāśavaśaṃ gataḥ  || 03.30.017 ||
evaṃ kuṭumbabharaṇe vyāpṛtātmājitendriyaḥ  |
mriyate rudatāṃ svānāmuruvedanayāstadhīḥ  || 03.30.018 ||
yamadūtau tadā prāptau bhīmau sarabhasekṣaṇau  |
sa dṛṣṭvā trastahṛdayaḥ śakṛnmūtraṃ vimuñcati  || 03.30.019 ||
yātanādeha āvṛtya pāśairbaddhvā gale balāt |
nayato dīrghamadhvānaṃ daṇḍyaṃ rājabhaṭā yathā  || 03.30.020 ||
tayornirbhinnahṛdayastarjanairjātavepathuḥ  |
pathi śvabhirbhakṣyamāṇa ārto'ghaṃ svamanusmaran  || 03.30.021 ||
kṣuttṛṭparīto'rkadavānalānilaiḥ santapyamānaḥ pathi taptavāluke  |
kṛcchreṇa pṛṣṭhe kaśayā ca tāḍitaścalatyaśakto'pi nirāśramodake  || 03.30.022 ||
tatra tatra patan chrānto mūrcchitaḥ punarutthitaḥ  |
pathā pāpīyasā nītastarasā yamasādanam  || 03.30.023 ||
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi navatiṃ nava cādhvanaḥ  |
tribhirmuhūrtairdvābhyāṃ vā nītaḥ prāpnoti yātanāḥ  || 03.30.024 ||
ādīpanaṃ svagātrāṇāṃ veṣṭayitvolmukādibhiḥ  |
ātmamāṃsādanaṃ kvāpi svakṛttaṃ parato'pi vā  || 03.30.025 ||
jīvataścāntrābhyuddhāraḥ śvagṛdhrairyamasādane  |
sarpavṛścikadaṃśādyairdaśadbhiścātmavaiśasam  || 03.30.026 ||
kṛntanaṃ cāvayavaśo gajādibhyo bhidāpanam  |
pātanaṃ giriśṛṅgebhyo rodhanaṃ cāmbugartayoḥ  || 03.30.027 ||
yāstāmisrāndhatāmisrā rauravādyāśca yātanāḥ  |
bhuṅkte naro vā nārī vā mithaḥ saṅgena nirmitāḥ  || 03.30.028 ||
atraiva narakaḥ svarga iti mātaḥ pracakṣate  |
yā yātanā vai nārakyastā ihāpyupalakṣitāḥ  || 03.30.029 ||
evaṃ kuṭumbaṃ bibhrāṇa udaraṃ bhara eva vā  |
visṛjyehobhayaṃ pretya bhuṅkte tatphalamīdṛśam  || 03.30.030 ||
ekaḥ prapadyate dhvāntaṃ hitvedaṃ svakalevaram  |
kuśaletarapātheyo bhūtadroheṇa yadbhṛtam  || 03.30.031 ||
daivenāsāditaṃ tasya śamalaṃ niraye pumān  |
bhuṅkte kuṭumbapoṣasya hṛtavitta ivāturaḥ  || 03.30.032 ||
kevalena hyadharmeṇa kuṭumbabharaṇotsukaḥ  |
yāti jīvo'ndhatāmisraṃ caramaṃ tamasaḥ padam  || 03.30.033 ||
adhastānnaralokasya yāvatīryātanādayaḥ  |
kramaśaḥ samanukramya punaratrāvrajecchuciḥ  || 03.30.034 ||
03.30.001|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
karmaṇā daivanetreṇa janturdehopapattaye  |
striyāḥ praviṣṭa udaraṃ puṃso retaḥkaṇāśrayaḥ  || 03.31.001 ||
kalalaṃ tvekarātreṇa pañcarātreṇa budbudam  |
daśāhena tu karkandhūḥ peśyaṇḍaṃ vā tataḥ param  || 03.31.002 ||
māsena tu śiro dvābhyāṃ bāhvaṅghryādyaṅgavigrahaḥ  |
nakhalomāsthicarmāṇi liṅgacchidrodbhavastribhiḥ  || 03.31.003 ||
caturbhirdhātavaḥ sapta pañcabhiḥ kṣuttṛḍudbhavaḥ  |
ṣaḍbhirjarāyuṇā vītaḥ kukṣau bhrāmyati dakṣiṇe  || 03.31.004 ||
māturjagdhānnapānādyairedhaddhāturasammate  |
śete viṇmūtrayorgarte sa janturjantusambhave  || 03.31.005 ||
kṛmibhiḥ kṣatasarvāṅgaḥ saukumāryātpratikṣaṇam  |
mūrcchāmāpnotyurukleśastatratyaiḥ kṣudhitairmuhuḥ  || 03.31.006 ||
kaṭutīkṣṇoṣṇalavaṇa rūkṣāmlādibhirulbaṇaiḥ  |
mātṛbhuktairupaspṛṣṭaḥ sarvāṅgotthitavedanaḥ  || 03.31.007 ||
ulbena saṃvṛtastasminnantraiśca bahirāvṛtaḥ  |
āste kṛtvā śiraḥ kukṣau bhugnapṛṣṭhaśirodharaḥ  || 03.31.008 ||
akalpaḥ svāṅgaceṣṭāyāṃ śakunta iva pañjare  |
tatra labdhasmṛtirdaivātkarma janmaśatodbhavam  |
smaran dīrghamanucchvāsaṃ śarma kiṃ nāma vindate  || 03.31.009 ||
ārabhya saptamānmāsāllabdhabodho'pi vepitaḥ  |
naikatrāste sūtivātairviṣṭhābhūriva sodaraḥ  || 03.31.010 ||
nāthamāna ṛṣirbhītaḥ saptavadhriḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ  |
stuvīta taṃ viklavayā vācā yenodare'rpitaḥ  || 03.31.011 ||
03.31.012|0 janturuvāca
tasyopasannamavituṃ jagadicchayātta   nānātanorbhuvi calaccaraṇāravindam  |
so'haṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ hyakutobhayaṃ me   yenedṛśī gatiradarśyasato'nurūpā  || 03.31.012 ||*
yastvatra baddha iva karmabhirāvṛtātmā   bhūtendriyāśayamayīmavalambya māyām  |
āste viśuddhamavikāramakhaṇḍabodham   ātapyamānahṛdaye'vasitaṃ namāmi  || 03.31.013 ||*
yaḥ pañcabhūtaracite rahitaḥ śarīre   cchanno'yathendriyaguṇārthacidātmako'ham  |
tenāvikuṇṭhamahimānamṛṣiṃ tamenaṃ   vande paraṃ prakṛtipūruṣayoḥ pumāṃsam  || 03.31.014 ||*
yanmāyayoruguṇakarmanibandhane'smin   sāṃsārike pathi caraṃstadabhiśrameṇa  |
naṣṭasmṛtiḥ punarayaṃ pravṛṇīta lokaṃ   yuktyā kayā mahadanugrahamantareṇa  || 03.31.015 ||*
jñānaṃ yadetadadadhātkatamaḥ sa devas  traikālikaṃ sthiracareṣvanuvartitāṃśaḥ  |
taṃ jīvakarmapadavīmanuvartamānās  tāpatrayopaśamanāya vayaṃ bhajema  || 03.31.016 ||*
dehyanyadehavivare jaṭharāgnināsṛg  viṇmūtrakūpapatito bhṛśataptadehaḥ  |
icchannito vivasituṃ gaṇayan svamāsān   nirvāsyate kṛpaṇadhīrbhagavan kadā nu  || 03.31.017 ||*
yenedṛśīṃ gatimasau daśamāsya īśa   saṅgrāhitaḥ purudayena bhavādṛśena  |
svenaiva tuṣyatu kṛtena sa dīnanāthaḥ   ko nāma tatprati vināñjalimasya kuryāt || 03.31.018 ||*
paśyatyayaṃ dhiṣaṇayā nanu saptavadhriḥ   śārīrake damaśarīryaparaḥ svadehe  |
yatsṛṣṭayāsaṃ tamahaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ   paśye bahirhṛdi ca caityamiva pratītam  || 03.31.019 ||*
so'haṃ vasannapi vibho bahuduḥkhavāsaṃ   garbhānna nirjigamiṣe bahirandhakūpe  |
yatropayātamupasarpati devamāyā   mithyā matiryadanu saṃsṛticakrametat || 03.31.020 ||*
tasmādahaṃ vigataviklava uddhariṣya   ātmānamāśu tamasaḥ suhṛdātmanaiva  |
bhūyo yathā vyasanametadanekarandhraṃ   mā me bhaviṣyadupasāditaviṣṇupādaḥ  || 03.31.021 ||*
03.32.022|0 kapila uvāca
evaṃ kṛtamatirgarbhe daśamāsyaḥ stuvannṛṣiḥ  |
sadyaḥ kṣipatyavācīnaṃ prasūtyai sūtimārutaḥ  || 03.32.022 ||
tenāvasṛṣṭaḥ sahasā kṛtvāvākśira āturaḥ  |
viniṣkrāmati kṛcchreṇa nirucchvāso hatasmṛtiḥ  || 03.32.023 ||
patito bhuvyasṛṅmiśraḥ viṣṭhābhūriva ceṣṭate  |
rorūyati gate jñāne viparītāṃ gatiṃ gataḥ  || 03.32.024 ||
paracchandaṃ na viduṣā puṣyamāṇo janena saḥ  |
anabhipretamāpannaḥ pratyākhyātumanīśvaraḥ  || 03.32.025 ||
śāyito'śuciparyaṅke jantuḥ svedajadūṣite  |
neśaḥ kaṇḍūyane'ṅgānāmāsanotthānaceṣṭane  || 03.32.026 ||
tudantyāmatvacaṃ daṃśā maśakā matkuṇādayaḥ  |
rudantaṃ vigatajñānaṃ kṛmayaḥ kṛmikaṃ yathā  || 03.32.027 ||
ityevaṃ śaiśavaṃ bhuktvā duḥkhaṃ paugaṇḍameva ca  |
alabdhābhīpsito'jñānādiddhamanyuḥ śucārpitaḥ  || 03.32.028 ||
saha dehena mānena vardhamānena manyunā  |
karoti vigrahaṃ kāmī kāmiṣvantāya cātmanaḥ  || 03.32.029 ||
bhūtaiḥ pañcabhirārabdhe dehe dehyabudho'sakṛt |
ahaṃ mametyasadgrāhaḥ karoti kumatirmatim  || 03.32.030 ||
tadarthaṃ kurute karma yadbaddho yāti saṃsṛtim  |
yo'nuyāti dadatkleśamavidyākarmabandhanaḥ  || 03.32.031 ||
yadyasadbhiḥ pathi punaḥ śiśnodarakṛtodyamaiḥ  |
āsthito ramate jantustamo viśati pūrvavat || 03.32.032 ||
satyaṃ śaucaṃ dayā maunaṃ buddhiḥ śrīrhrīryaśaḥ kṣamā  |
śamo damo bhagaśceti yatsaṅgādyāti saṅkṣayam  || 03.32.033 ||
teṣvaśānteṣu mūḍheṣu khaṇḍitātmasvasādhuṣu  |
saṅgaṃ na kuryācchocyeṣu yoṣitkrīḍāmṛgeṣu ca  || 03.32.034 ||
na tathāsya bhavenmoho bandhaścānyaprasaṅgataḥ  |
yoṣitsaṅgādyathā puṃso yathā tatsaṅgisaṅgataḥ  || 03.32.035 ||
prajāpatiḥ svāṃ duhitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā tadrūpadharṣitaḥ  |
rohidbhūtāṃ so'nvadhāvadṛkṣarūpī hatatrapaḥ  || 03.32.036 ||
tatsṛṣṭasṛṣṭasṛṣṭeṣu ko nvakhaṇḍitadhīḥ pumān  |
ṛṣiṃ nārāyaṇamṛte yoṣinmayyeha māyayā  || 03.32.037 ||
balaṃ me paśya māyāyāḥ strīmayyā jayino diśām  |
yā karoti padākrāntān bhrūvijṛmbheṇa kevalam  || 03.32.038 ||
saṅgaṃ na kuryātpramadāsu jātu yogasya pāraṃ paramārurukṣuḥ  |
matsevayā pratilabdhātmalābho vadanti yā nirayadvāramasya  || 03.32.039 ||
yopayāti śanairmāyā yoṣiddevavinirmitā  |
tāmīkṣetātmano mṛtyuṃ tṛṇaiḥ kūpamivāvṛtam  || 03.32.040 ||
yāṃ manyate patiṃ mohānmanmāyāmṛṣabhāyatīm  |
strītvaṃ strīsaṅgataḥ prāpto vittāpatyagṛhapradam  || 03.32.041 ||
tāmātmano vijānīyātpatyapatyagṛhātmakam  |
daivopasāditaṃ mṛtyuṃ mṛgayorgāyanaṃ yathā  || 03.32.042 ||
dehena jīvabhūtena lokāllokamanuvrajan  |
bhuñjāna eva karmāṇi karotyavirataṃ pumān  || 03.32.043 ||
jīvo hyasyānugo deho bhūtendriyamanomayaḥ  |
tannirodho'sya maraṇamāvirbhāvastu sambhavaḥ  || 03.32.044 ||
dravyopalabdhisthānasya dravyekṣāyogyatā yadā  |
tatpañcatvamahaṃmānādutpattirdravyadarśanam  || 03.32.045 ||
yathākṣṇordravyāvayava darśanāyogyatā yadā  |
tadaiva cakṣuṣo draṣṭurdraṣṭṛtvāyogyatānayoḥ  || 03.32.046 ||
tasmānna kāryaḥ santrāso na kārpaṇyaṃ na sambhramaḥ  |
buddhvā jīvagatiṃ dhīro muktasaṅgaścarediha  || 03.32.047 ||
samyagdarśanayā buddhyā yogavairāgyayuktayā  |
māyāviracite loke carennyasya kalevaram  || 03.32.048 ||
03.32.001|0 kapila uvāca
atha yo gṛhamedhīyān dharmānevāvasan gṛhe  |
kāmamarthaṃ ca dharmān svān dogdhi bhūyaḥ piparti tān  || 03.32.001 ||
sa cāpi bhagavaddharmātkāmamūḍhaḥ parāṅmukhaḥ  |
yajate kratubhirdevān pitṃśca śraddhayānvitaḥ  || 03.32.002 ||
tacchraddhayākrāntamatiḥ pitṛdevavrataḥ pumān  |
gatvā cāndramasaṃ lokaṃ somapāḥ punareṣyati  || 03.32.003 ||
yadā cāhīndraśayyāyāṃ śete'nantāsano hariḥ  |
tadā lokā layaṃ yānti ta ete gṛhamedhinām  || 03.32.004 ||
ye svadharmānna duhyanti dhīrāḥ kāmārthahetave  |
niḥsaṅgā nyastakarmāṇaḥ praśāntāḥ śuddhacetasaḥ  || 03.32.005 ||
nivṛttidharmaniratā nirmamā nirahaṅkṛtāḥ  |
svadharmāptena sattvena pariśuddhena cetasā  || 03.32.006 ||
sūryadvāreṇa te yānti puruṣaṃ viśvatomukham  |
parāvareśaṃ prakṛtimasyotpattyantabhāvanam  || 03.32.007 ||
dviparārdhāvasāne yaḥ pralayo brahmaṇastu te  |
tāvadadhyāsate lokaṃ parasya paracintakāḥ  || 03.32.008 ||
kṣmāmbho'nalānilaviyanmanaindriyārtha   bhūtādibhiḥ parivṛtaṃ pratisañjihīrṣuḥ  |
avyākṛtaṃ viśati yarhi guṇatrayātmākālaṃ   parākhyamanubhūya paraḥ svayambhūḥ  || 03.32.009 ||*
evaṃ paretya bhagavantamanupraviṣṭāye   yogino jitamarunmanaso virāgāḥ  |
tenaiva sākamamṛtaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ   brahma pradhānamupayāntyagatābhimānāḥ  || 03.32.010 ||*
atha taṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ hṛtpadmeṣu kṛtālayam  |
śrutānubhāvaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja bhāvena bhāmini  || 03.32.011 ||
ādyaḥ sthiracarāṇāṃ yo vedagarbhaḥ saharṣibhiḥ  |
yogeśvaraiḥ kumārādyaiḥ siddhairyogapravartakaiḥ  || 03.32.012 ||
bhedadṛṣṭyābhimānena niḥsaṅgenāpi karmaṇā  |
kartṛtvātsaguṇaṃ brahma puruṣaṃ puruṣarṣabham  || 03.32.013 ||
sa saṃsṛtya punaḥ kāle kāleneśvaramūrtinā  |
jāte guṇavyatikare yathāpūrvaṃ prajāyate  || 03.32.014 ||
aiśvaryaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ ca te'pi dharmavinirmitam  |
niṣevya punarāyānti guṇavyatikare sati  || 03.32.015 ||
ye tvihāsaktamanasaḥ karmasu śraddhayānvitāḥ  |
kurvantyapratiṣiddhāni nityānyapi ca kṛtsnaśaḥ  || 03.32.016 ||
rajasā kuṇṭhamanasaḥ kāmātmāno'jitendriyāḥ  |
pitn yajantyanudinaṃ gṛheṣvabhiratāśayāḥ  || 03.32.017 ||
traivargikāste puruṣā vimukhā harimedhasaḥ  |
kathāyāṃ kathanīyoru vikramasya madhudviṣaḥ  || 03.32.018 ||
nūnaṃ daivena vihatā ye cācyutakathāsudhām  |
hitvā śṛṇvantyasadgāthāḥ purīṣamiva viḍbhujaḥ  || 03.32.019 ||
dakṣiṇena pathāryamṇaḥ pitṛlokaṃ vrajanti te  |
prajāmanu prajāyante śmaśānāntakriyākṛtaḥ  || 03.32.020 ||
tataste kṣīṇasukṛtāḥ punarlokamimaṃ sati  |
patanti vivaśā devaiḥ sadyo vibhraṃśitodayāḥ  || 03.32.021 ||
tasmāttvaṃ sarvabhāvena bhajasva parameṣṭhinam  |
tadguṇāśrayayā bhaktyā bhajanīyapadāmbujam  || 03.32.022 ||
vāsudeve bhagavati bhaktiyogaḥ prayojitaḥ  |
janayatyāśu vairāgyaṃ jñānaṃ yadbrahmadarśanam  || 03.32.023 ||
yadāsya cittamartheṣu sameṣvindriyavṛttibhiḥ  |
na vigṛhṇāti vaiṣamyaṃ priyamapriyamityuta  || 03.32.024 ||
sa tadaivātmanātmānaṃ niḥsaṅgaṃ samadarśanam  |
heyopādeyarahitamārūḍhaṃ padamīkṣate  || 03.32.025 ||
jñānamātraṃ paraṃ brahma paramātmeśvaraḥ pumān  |
dṛśyādibhiḥ pṛthagbhāvairbhagavāneka īyate  || 03.32.026 ||
etāvāneva yogena samagreṇeha yoginaḥ  |
yujyate'bhimato hyartho yadasaṅgastu kṛtsnaśaḥ  || 03.32.027 ||
jñānamekaṃ parācīnairindriyairbrahma nirguṇam  |
avabhātyartharūpeṇa bhrāntyā śabdādidharmiṇā  || 03.32.028 ||
yathā mahānahaṃrūpastrivṛtpañcavidhaḥ svarāṭ |
ekādaśavidhastasya vapuraṇḍaṃ jagadyataḥ  || 03.32.029 ||
etadvai śraddhayā bhaktyā yogābhyāsena nityaśaḥ  |
samāhitātmā niḥsaṅgo viraktyā paripaśyati  || 03.32.030 ||
ityetatkathitaṃ gurvi jñānaṃ tadbrahmadarśanam  |
yenānubuddhyate tattvaṃ prakṛteḥ puruṣasya ca  || 03.32.031 ||
jñānayogaśca manniṣṭho nairguṇyo bhaktilakṣaṇaḥ  |
dvayorapyeka evārtho bhagavacchabdalakṣaṇaḥ  || 03.32.032 ||
yathendriyaiḥ pṛthagdvārairartho bahuguṇāśrayaḥ  |
eko nāneyate tadvadbhagavān śāstravartmabhiḥ  || 03.32.033 ||
kriyayā kratubhirdānaistapaḥsvādhyāyamarśanaiḥ  |
ātmendriyajayenāpi sannyāsena ca karmaṇām  || 03.32.034 ||
yogena vividhāṅgena bhaktiyogena caiva hi  |
dharmeṇobhayacihnena yaḥ pravṛttinivṛttimān  || 03.32.035 ||
ātmatattvāvabodhena vairāgyeṇa dṛḍhena ca  |
īyate bhagavānebhiḥ saguṇo nirguṇaḥ svadṛk || 03.32.036 ||
prāvocaṃ bhaktiyogasya svarūpaṃ te caturvidham  |
kālasya cāvyaktagateryo'ntardhāvati jantuṣu  || 03.32.037 ||
jīvasya saṃsṛtīrbahvīravidyākarmanirmitāḥ  |
yāsvaṅga praviśannātmā na veda gatimātmanaḥ  || 03.32.038 ||
naitatkhalāyopadiśennāvinītāya karhicit |
na stabdhāya na bhinnāya naiva dharmadhvajāya ca  || 03.32.039 ||
na lolupāyopadiśenna gṛhārūḍhacetase  |
nābhaktāya ca me jātu na madbhaktadviṣāmapi  || 03.32.040 ||
śraddadhānāya bhaktāya vinītāyānasūyave  |
bhūteṣu kṛtamaitrāya śuśrūṣābhiratāya ca  || 03.32.041 ||
bahirjātavirāgāya śāntacittāya dīyatām  |
nirmatsarāya śucaye yasyāhaṃ preyasāṃ priyaḥ  || 03.32.042 ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādamba śraddhayā puruṣaḥ sakṛt |
yo vābhidhatte maccittaḥ sa hyeti padavīṃ ca me  || 03.32.043 ||
03.33.001|0 maitreya uvāca
evaṃ niśamya kapilasya vaco janitrīsā kardamasya dayitā kila devahūtiḥ  |
visrastamohapaṭalā tamabhipraṇamyatuṣṭāva tattvaviṣayāṅkitasiddhibhūmim  || 03.33.001 ||
03.33.002|0 devahūtiruvāca
athāpyajo'ntaḥsalile śayānaṃ bhūtendriyārthātmamayaṃ vapuste  |
guṇapravāhaṃ sadaśeṣabījaṃ dadhyau svayaṃ yajjaṭharābjajātaḥ  || 03.33.002 ||
sa eva viśvasya bhavān vidhatte guṇapravāheṇa vibhaktavīryaḥ  |
sargādyanīho'vitathābhisandhirātmeśvaro'tarkyasahasraśaktiḥ  || 03.33.003 ||
sa tvaṃ bhṛto me jaṭhareṇa nātha kathaṃ nu yasyodara etadāsīt |
viśvaṃ yugānte vaṭapatra ekaḥ śete sma māyāśiśuraṅghripānaḥ  || 03.33.004 ||
tvaṃ dehatantraḥ praśamāya pāpmanāṃ nideśabhājāṃ ca vibho vibhūtaye  |
yathāvatārāstava sūkarādayastathāyamapyātmapathopalabdhaye  || 03.33.005 ||
yannāmadheyaśravaṇānukīrtanādyatprahvaṇādyatsmaraṇādapi kvacit |
śvādo'pi sadyaḥ savanāya kalpate kutaḥ punaste bhagavannu darśanāt || 03.33.006 ||
aho bata śvapaco'to garīyān yajjihvāgre vartate nāma tubhyam  |
tepustapaste juhuvuḥ sasnurāryā brahmānūcurnāma gṛṇanti ye te  || 03.33.007 ||
taṃ tvāmahaṃ brahma paraṃ pumāṃsaṃ pratyaksrotasyātmani saṃvibhāvyam  |
svatejasā dhvastaguṇapravāhaṃ vande viṣṇuṃ kapilaṃ vedagarbham  || 03.33.008 ||
03.33.009|0 maitreya uvāca
īḍito bhagavānevaṃ kapilākhyaḥ paraḥ pumān  |
vācāviklavayetyāha mātaraṃ mātṛvatsalaḥ  || 03.33.009 ||
03.33.010|0 kapila uvāca
mārgeṇānena mātaste susevyenoditena me  |

sā brahmaṇi svamahimanyapi nātha mā bhūt  kiṃ tvantakāsilulitātpatatāṃ vimānāt || 04.09.010 ||*
bhaktiṃ muhuḥ pravahatāṃ tvayi me prasaṅgo   bhūyādananta mahatāmamalāśayānām  |

te na smarantyatitarāṃ priyamīśa martyaṃ   ye cānvadaḥ sutasuhṛdgṛhavittadārāḥ  |
ye tvabjanābha bhavadīyapadāravinda   saugandhyalubdhahṛdayeṣu kṛtaprasaṅgāḥ  || 04.09.012 ||*
tiryaṅnagadvijasarīsṛpadevadaitya   martyādibhiḥ paricitaṃ sadasadviśeṣam  |

kalpānta etadakhilaṃ jaṭhareṇa gṛhṇan   śete pumān svadṛganantasakhastadaṅke  |

tvaṃ nityamuktapariśuddhavibuddha ātmā   kūṭastha ādipuruṣo bhagavāṃstryadhīśaḥ  |

yasmin viruddhagatayo hyaniśaṃ patanti   vidyādayo vividhaśaktaya ānupūrvyāt |
tadbrahma viśvabhavamekamanantamādyam   ānandamātramavikāramahaṃ prapadye  || 04.09.016 ||*
satyāśiṣo hi bhagavaṃstava pādapadmam   āśīstathānubhajataḥ puruṣārthamūrteḥ  |
apyevamarya bhagavān paripāti dīnān   vāśreva vatsakamanugrahakātaro'smān  || 04.09.017 ||*

04.09.036|0 maitreya uvāca

abhivandya pituḥ pādāvāśīrbhiścābhimantritaḥ  |

pariṣvajyāha jīveti bāṣpagadgadayā girā  || 04.09.046 ||

sunītirasya jananī prāṇebhyo'pi priyaṃ sutam  |

payaḥ stanābhyāṃ susrāva netrajaiḥ salilaiḥ śivaiḥ  |

tāṃ śaśaṃsurjanā rājñīṃ diṣṭyā te putra ārtihā  |

abhyarcitastvayā nūnaṃ bhagavān praṇatārtihā  |
yadanudhyāyino dhīrā mṛtyuṃ jigyuḥ sudurjayam  || 04.09.052 ||
lālyamānaṃ janairevaṃ dhruvaṃ sabhrātaraṃ nṛpaḥ  |
āropya kariṇīṃ hṛṣṭaḥ stūyamāno'viśatpuram  || 04.09.053 ||
tatra tatropasaṅkḷptairlasanmakaratoraṇaiḥ  |

cūtapallavavāsaḥsraṅmuktādāmavilambibhiḥ  |

prākārairgopurāgāraiḥ śātakumbhaparicchadaiḥ  |
sarvato'laṅkṛtaṃ śrīmadvimānaśikharadyubhiḥ  || 04.09.056 ||
mṛṣṭacatvararathyāṭṭa mārgaṃ candanacarcitam  |

dhruvāya pathi dṛṣṭāya tatra tatra purastriyaḥ  |

upajahruḥ prayuñjānā vātsalyādāśiṣaḥ satīḥ  |

yatra sphaṭikakuḍyeṣu mahāmārakateṣu ca  |

04.10.001|0 maitreya uvāca

abhyavarṣan prakupitāḥ sarathaṃ sahasārathim  |

auttānapādiḥ sa tadā śastravarṣeṇa bhūriṇā  |

hāhākārastadaivāsītsiddhānāṃ divi paśyatām  |

dhanurvisphūrjayan divyaṃ dviṣatāṃ khedamudvahan  |

tasya te cāpanirmuktā bhittvā varmāṇi rakṣasām  |

ūrubhirhematālābhairdorbhirvalayavalgubhiḥ  || 04.10.018 ||
hārakeyūramukuṭairuṣṇīṣaiśca mahādhanaiḥ  |

hatāvaśiṣṭā itare raṇājirādrakṣogaṇāḥ kṣatriyavaryasāyakaiḥ  |

kṣaṇenācchāditaṃ vyoma ghanānīkena sarvataḥ  |
visphurattaḍitā dikṣu trāsayatstanayitnunā  || 04.10.023 ||
vavṛṣū rudhiraughāsṛkpūyaviṇmūtramedasaḥ  |
nipeturgaganādasya kabandhānyagrato'nagha  || 04.10.024 ||
tataḥ khe'dṛśyata girirnipetuḥ sarvatodiśam  |

ahayo'śaniniḥśvāsā vamanto'gniṃ ruṣākṣibhiḥ  |

evaṃvidhānyanekāni trāsanānyamanasvinām  |
sasṛjustigmagataya āsuryā māyayāsurāḥ  || 04.10.028 ||
dhruve prayuktāmasuraistāṃ māyāmatidustarām  |

04.11.001|0 maitreya uvāca

04.11.007|0 manuruvāca
alaṃ vatsātiroṣeṇa tamodvāreṇa pāpmanā  |
yena puṇyajanānetānavadhīstvamanāgasaḥ  || 04.11.007 ||

titikṣayā karuṇayā maitryā cākhilajantuṣu  |

samprasanne bhagavati puruṣaḥ prākṛtairguṇaiḥ  |

bhūtaiḥ pañcabhirārabdhairyoṣitpuruṣa eva hi  |

evaṃ pravartate sargaḥ sthitiḥ saṃyama eva ca  |

nimittamātraṃ tatrāsīnnirguṇaḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ  |

janaṃ janena janayanmārayanmṛtyunāntakam  || 04.11.019 ||

svargāpavargadvārāya nityaṃ śuciṣade namaḥ  |
namo hiraṇyavīryāya cāturhotrāya tantave  || 04.24.037 ||
nama ūrja iṣe trayyāḥ pataye yajñaretase  |
tṛptidāya ca jīvānāṃ namaḥ sarvarasātmane  || 04.24.038 ||
sarvasattvātmadehāya viśeṣāya sthavīyase  |
namastrailokyapālāya saha ojobalāya ca  || 04.24.039 ||
arthaliṅgāya nabhase namo'ntarbahirātmane  |
namaḥ puṇyāya lokāya amuṣmai bhūrivarcase  || 04.24.040 ||
pravṛttāya nivṛttāya pitṛdevāya karmaṇe  |
namo'dharmavipākāya mṛtyave duḥkhadāya ca  || 04.24.041 ||
namasta āśiṣāmīśa manave kāraṇātmane  |
namo dharmāya bṛhate kṛṣṇāyākuṇṭhamedhase  |
puruṣāya purāṇāya sāṅkhyayogeśvarāya ca  || 04.24.042 ||
śaktitrayasametāya mīḍhuṣe'haṅkṛtātmane  |
cetaākūtirūpāya namo vāco vibhūtaye  || 04.24.043 ||
darśanaṃ no didṛkṣūṇāṃ dehi bhāgavatārcitam  |
rūpaṃ priyatamaṃ svānāṃ sarvendriyaguṇāñjanam  || 04.24.044 ||
snigdhaprāvṛḍghanaśyāmaṃ sarvasaundaryasaṅgraham  |
cārvāyatacaturbāhu sujātarucirānanam  || 04.24.045 ||
padmakośapalāśākṣaṃ sundarabhru sunāsikam  |
sudvijaṃ sukapolāsyaṃ samakarṇavibhūṣaṇam  || 04.24.046 ||
prītiprahasitāpāṅgamalakai rūpaśobhitam  |
lasatpaṅkajakiñjalka dukūlaṃ mṛṣṭakuṇḍalam  || 04.24.047 ||
sphuratkirīṭavalaya hāranūpuramekhalam  |
śaṅkhacakragadāpadma mālāmaṇyuttamarddhimat || 04.24.048 ||
siṃhaskandhatviṣo bibhratsaubhagagrīvakaustubham  |
śriyānapāyinyā kṣipta nikaṣāśmorasollasat || 04.24.049 ||
pūrarecakasaṃvigna valivalgudalodaram  |
pratisaṅkrāmayadviśvaṃ nābhyāvartagabhīrayā  || 04.24.050 ||
śyāmaśroṇyadhirociṣṇu dukūlasvarṇamekhalam  |
samacārvaṅghrijaṅghoru nimnajānusudarśanam  || 04.24.051 ||
padā śaratpadmapalāśarociṣā nakhadyubhirno'ntaraghaṃ vidhunvatā  |
pradarśaya svīyamapāstasādhvasaṃ padaṃ guro mārgagurustamojuṣām  || 04.24.052 ||
etadrūpamanudhyeyamātmaśuddhimabhīpsatām  |
yadbhaktiyogo'bhayadaḥ svadharmamanutiṣṭhatām  || 04.24.053 ||
bhavān bhaktimatā labhyo durlabhaḥ sarvadehinām  |
svārājyasyāpyabhimata ekāntenātmavidgatiḥ  || 04.24.054 ||
taṃ durārādhyamārādhya satāmapi durāpayā  |
ekāntabhaktyā ko vāñchetpādamūlaṃ vinā bahiḥ  || 04.24.055 ||
yatra nirviṣṭamaraṇaṃ kṛtānto nābhimanyate  |
viśvaṃ vidhvaṃsayan vīrya śauryavisphūrjitabhruvā  || 04.24.056 ||
kṣaṇārdhenāpi tulaye na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavam  |
bhagavatsaṅgisaṅgasya martyānāṃ kimutāśiṣaḥ  || 04.24.057 ||
athānaghāṅghrestava kīrtitīrthayorantarbahiḥsnānavidhūtapāpmanām  |
bhūteṣvanukrośasusattvaśīlināṃ syātsaṅgamo'nugraha eṣa nastava  || 04.24.058 ||
na yasya cittaṃ bahirarthavibhramaṃ tamoguhāyāṃ ca viśuddhamāviśat |
yadbhaktiyogānugṛhītamañjasā munirvicaṣṭe nanu tatra te gatim  || 04.24.059 ||
yatredaṃ vyajyate viśvaṃ viśvasminnavabhāti yat |
tattvaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirākāśamiva vistṛtam  || 04.24.060 ||
yo māyayedaṃ pururūpayāsṛjadbibharti bhūyaḥ kṣapayatyavikriyaḥ  |
yadbhedabuddhiḥ sadivātmaduḥsthayā tvamātmatantraṃ bhagavan pratīmahi  || 04.24.061 ||
kriyākalāpairidameva yoginaḥ śraddhānvitāḥ sādhu yajanti siddhaye  |
bhūtendriyāntaḥkaraṇopalakṣitaṃ vede ca tantre ca ta eva kovidāḥ  || 04.24.062 ||
tvameka ādyaḥ puruṣaḥ suptaśaktistayā rajaḥsattvatamo vibhidyate  |
mahānahaṃ khaṃ marudagnivārdharāḥ surarṣayo bhūtagaṇā idaṃ yataḥ  || 04.24.063 ||
sṛṣṭaṃ svaśaktyedamanupraviṣṭaścaturvidhaṃ puramātmāṃśakena  |
atho vidustaṃ puruṣaṃ santamantarbhuṅkte hṛṣīkairmadhu sāraghaṃ yaḥ  || 04.24.064 ||
sa eṣa lokānaticaṇḍavego vikarṣasi tvaṃ khalu kālayānaḥ  |
bhūtāni bhūtairanumeyatattvo ghanāvalīrvāyurivāviṣahyaḥ  || 04.24.065 ||
pramattamuccairiti kṛtyacintayā pravṛddhalobhaṃ viṣayeṣu lālasam  |
tvamapramattaḥ sahasābhipadyase kṣullelihāno'hirivākhumantakaḥ  || 04.24.066 ||
kastvatpadābjaṃ vijahāti paṇḍito yaste'vamānavyayamānaketanaḥ  |
viśaṅkayāsmadgururarcati sma yadvinopapattiṃ manavaścaturdaśa  || 04.24.067 ||
atha tvamasi no brahman paramātman vipaścitām  |
viśvaṃ rudrabhayadhvastamakutaścidbhayā gatiḥ  || 04.24.068 ||
idaṃ japata bhadraṃ vo viśuddhā nṛpanandanāḥ  |
svadharmamanutiṣṭhanto bhagavatyarpitāśayāḥ  || 04.24.069 ||
tamevātmānamātmasthaṃ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitam  |
pūjayadhvaṃ gṛṇantaśca dhyāyantaścāsakṛddharim  || 04.24.070 ||
yogādeśamupāsādya dhārayanto munivratāḥ  |
samāhitadhiyaḥ sarva etadabhyasatādṛtāḥ  || 04.24.071 ||
idamāha purāsmākaṃ bhagavān viśvasṛkpatiḥ  |
bhṛgvādīnāmātmajānāṃ sisṛkṣuḥ saṃsisṛkṣatām  || 04.24.072 ||
te vayaṃ noditāḥ sarve prajāsarge prajeśvarāḥ  |
anena dhvastatamasaḥ sisṛkṣmo vividhāḥ prajāḥ  || 04.24.073 ||
athedaṃ nityadā yukto japannavahitaḥ pumān  |
acirācchreya āpnoti vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ  || 04.24.074 ||
śreyasāmiha sarveṣāṃ jñānaṃ niḥśreyasaṃ param  |
sukhaṃ tarati duṣpāraṃ jñānanaurvyasanārṇavam  || 04.24.075 ||
ya imaṃ śraddhayā yukto madgītaṃ bhagavatstavam  |
adhīyāno durārādhyaṃ harimārādhayatyasau  || 04.24.076 ||
vindate puruṣo'muṣmādyadyadicchatyasatvaram  |
madgītagītātsuprītācchreyasāmekavallabhāt || 04.24.077 ||
idaṃ yaḥ kalya utthāya prāñjaliḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ  |
śṛṇuyācchrāvayenmartyo mucyate karmabandhanaiḥ  || 04.24.078 ||
gītaṃ mayedaṃ naradevanandanāḥ parasya puṃsaḥ paramātmanaḥ stavam  |
japanta ekāgradhiyastapo mahatcaradhvamante tata āpsyathepsitam  || 04.24.079 ||
04.25.001|0 maitreya uvāca
iti sandiśya bhagavān bārhiṣadairabhipūjitaḥ  |
paśyatāṃ rājaputrāṇāṃ tatraivāntardadhe haraḥ  || 04.25.001 ||
rudragītaṃ bhagavataḥ stotraṃ sarve pracetasaḥ  |
japantaste tapastepurvarṣāṇāmayutaṃ jale  || 04.25.002 ||
prācīnabarhiṣaṃ kṣattaḥ karmasvāsaktamānasam  |
nārado'dhyātmatattvajñaḥ kṛpāluḥ pratyabodhayat || 04.25.003 ||
śreyastvaṃ katamadrājan karmaṇātmana īhase  |
duḥkhahāniḥ sukhāvāptiḥ śreyastanneha ceṣyate  || 04.25.004 ||
04.25.005|0 rājovāca
na jānāmi mahābhāga paraṃ karmāpaviddhadhīḥ  |
brūhi me vimalaṃ jñānaṃ yena mucyeya karmabhiḥ  || 04.25.005 ||
gṛheṣu kūṭadharmeṣu putradāradhanārthadhīḥ  |
na paraṃ vindate mūḍho bhrāmyan saṃsāravartmasu  || 04.25.006 ||
04.25.007|0 nārada uvāca
bho bhoḥ prajāpate rājan paśūn paśya tvayādhvare  |
saṃjñāpitāñjīvasaṅghānnirghṛṇena sahasraśaḥ  || 04.25.007 ||
ete tvāṃ sampratīkṣante smaranto vaiśasaṃ tava  |
samparetamayaḥkūṭaiśchindantyutthitamanyavaḥ  || 04.25.008 ||
atra te kathayiṣye'mumitihāsaṃ purātanam  |
purañjanasya caritaṃ nibodha gadato mama  || 04.25.009 ||
āsītpurañjano nāma rājā rājan bṛhacchravāḥ  |
tasyāvijñātanāmāsītsakhāvijñātaceṣṭitaḥ  || 04.25.010 ||
so'nveṣamāṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ babhrāma pṛthivīṃ prabhuḥ  |
nānurūpaṃ yadāvindadabhūtsa vimanā iva  || 04.25.011 ||
na sādhu mene tāḥ sarvā bhūtale yāvatīḥ puraḥ  |
kāmān kāmayamāno'sau tasya tasyopapattaye  || 04.25.012 ||
sa ekadā himavato dakṣiṇeṣvatha sānuṣu  |
dadarśa navabhirdvārbhiḥ puraṃ lakṣitalakṣaṇām  || 04.25.013 ||
prākāropavanāṭṭāla parikhairakṣatoraṇaiḥ  |
svarṇaraupyāyasaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ saṅkulāṃ sarvato gṛhaiḥ  || 04.25.014 ||
nīlasphaṭikavaidūrya muktāmarakatāruṇaiḥ  |
kḷptaharmyasthalīṃ dīptāṃ śriyā bhogavatīmiva  || 04.25.015 ||
sabhācatvararathyābhirākrīḍāyatanāpaṇaiḥ  |
caityadhvajapatākābhiryuktāṃ vidrumavedibhiḥ  || 04.25.016 ||
puryāstu bāhyopavane divyadrumalatākule  |
nadadvihaṅgālikula kolāhalajalāśaye  || 04.25.017 ||
himanirjharavipruṣmatkusumākaravāyunā  |
calatpravālaviṭapa nalinītaṭasampadi  || 04.25.018 ||
nānāraṇyamṛgavrātairanābādhe munivrataiḥ  |
āhūtaṃ manyate pāntho yatra kokilakūjitaiḥ  || 04.25.019 ||
yadṛcchayāgatāṃ tatra dadarśa pramadottamām  |
bhṛtyairdaśabhirāyāntīmekaikaśatanāyakaiḥ  || 04.25.020 ||
añcaśīrṣāhinā guptāṃ pratīhāreṇa sarvataḥ  |
anveṣamāṇāmṛṣabhamaprauḍhāṃ kāmarūpiṇīm  || 04.25.021 ||
sunāsāṃ sudatīṃ bālāṃ sukapolāṃ varānanām  |
samavinyastakarṇābhyāṃ bibhratīṃ kuṇḍalaśriyam  || 04.25.022 ||
piśaṅganīvīṃ suśroṇīṃ śyāmāṃ kanakamekhalām  |
padbhyāṃ kvaṇadbhyāṃ calantīṃ nūpurairdevatāmiva  || 04.25.023 ||
stanau vyañjitakaiśorau samavṛttau nirantarau  |
vastrāntena nigūhantīṃ vrīḍayā gajagāminīm  || 04.25.024 ||
tāmāha lalitaṃ vīraḥ savrīḍasmitaśobhanām  |
snigdhenāpāṅgapuṅkhena spṛṣṭaḥ premodbhramadbhruvā  || 04.25.025 ||
kā tvaṃ kañjapalāśākṣi kasyāsīha kutaḥ sati  |
imāmupa purīṃ bhīru kiṃ cikīrṣasi śaṃsa me  || 04.25.026 ||
ka ete'nupathā ye ta ekādaśa mahābhaṭāḥ  |
etā vā lalanāḥ subhru ko'yaṃ te'hiḥ puraḥsaraḥ  || 04.25.027 ||
tvaṃ hrīrbhavānyasyatha vāgramā patiṃ vicinvatī kiṃ munivadraho vane  |
tvadaṅghrikāmāptasamastakāmaṃ kva padmakośaḥ patitaḥ karāgrāt || 04.25.028 ||
nāsāṃ varorvanyatamā bhuvispṛkpurīmimāṃ vīravareṇa sākam  |
arhasyalaṅkartumadabhrakarmaṇā lokaṃ paraṃ śrīriva yajñapuṃsā  || 04.25.029 ||
yadeṣa māpāṅgavikhaṇḍitendriyaṃ savrīḍabhāvasmitavibhramadbhruvā  |
tvayopasṛṣṭo bhagavānmanobhavaḥ prabādhate'thānugṛhāṇa śobhane  || 04.25.030 ||
tvadānanaṃ subhru sutāralocanaṃ vyālambinīlālakavṛndasaṃvṛtam  |
unnīya me darśaya valguvācakaṃ yadvrīḍayā nābhimukhaṃ śucismite  || 04.25.031 ||
04.25.032|0 nārada uvāca
itthaṃ purañjanaṃ nārī yācamānamadhīravat |
abhyanandata taṃ vīraṃ hasantī vīra mohitā  || 04.25.032 ||
na vidāma vayaṃ samyakkartāraṃ puruṣarṣabha  |
ātmanaśca parasyāpi gotraṃ nāma ca yatkṛtam  || 04.25.033 ||
ihādya santamātmānaṃ vidāma na tataḥ param  |
yeneyaṃ nirmitā vīra purī śaraṇamātmanaḥ  || 04.25.034 ||
ete sakhāyaḥ sakhyo me narā nāryaśca mānada  |
suptāyāṃ mayi jāgarti nāgo'yaṃ pālayan purīm  || 04.25.035 ||
diṣṭyāgato'si bhadraṃ te grāmyān kāmānabhīpsase  |
udvahiṣyāmi tāṃste'haṃ svabandhubhirarindama  || 04.25.036 ||
imāṃ tvamadhitiṣṭhasva purīṃ navamukhīṃ vibho  |
mayopanītān gṛhṇānaḥ kāmabhogān śataṃ samāḥ  || 04.25.037 ||
kaṃ nu tvadanyaṃ ramaye hyaratijñamakovidam  |
asamparāyābhimukhamaśvastanavidaṃ paśum  || 04.25.038 ||
dharmo hyatrārthakāmau ca prajānando'mṛtaṃ yaśaḥ  |
lokā viśokā virajā yānna kevalino viduḥ  || 04.25.039 ||
pitṛdevarṣimartyānāṃ bhūtānāmātmanaśca ha  |
kṣemyaṃ vadanti śaraṇaṃ bhave'smin yadgṛhāśramaḥ  || 04.25.040 ||
kā nāma vīra vikhyātaṃ vadānyaṃ priyadarśanam  |
na vṛṇīta priyaṃ prāptaṃ mādṛśī tvādṛśaṃ patim  || 04.25.041 ||
kasyā manaste bhuvi bhogibhogayoḥ striyā na sajjedbhujayormahābhuja  |
yo'nāthavargādhimalaṃ ghṛṇoddhata smitāvalokena caratyapohitum  || 04.25.042 ||
04.25.043|0 nārada uvāca
iti tau dampatī tatra samudya samayaṃ mithaḥ  |
tāṃ praviśya purīṃ rājanmumudāte śataṃ samāḥ  || 04.25.043 ||
upagīyamāno lalitaṃ tatra tatra ca gāyakaiḥ  |
krīḍan parivṛtaḥ strībhirhradinīmāviśacchucau  || 04.25.044 ||
saptopari kṛtā dvāraḥ purastasyāstu dve adhaḥ  |
pṛthagviṣayagatyarthaṃ tasyāṃ yaḥ kaścaneśvaraḥ  || 04.25.045 ||
pañca dvārastu paurastyā dakṣiṇaikā tathottarā  |
paścime dve amūṣāṃ te nāmāni nṛpa varṇaye  || 04.25.046 ||
khadyotāvirmukhī ca prāgdvārāvekatra nirmite  |
vibhrājitaṃ janapadaṃ yāti tābhyāṃ dyumatsakhaḥ  || 04.25.047 ||
nalinī nālinī ca prāgdvārāvekatra nirmite  |
avadhūtasakhastābhyāṃ viṣayaṃ yāti saurabham  || 04.25.048 ||
mukhyā nāma purastāddvāstayāpaṇabahūdanau  |
viṣayau yāti purarāḍrasajñavipaṇānvitaḥ  || 04.25.049 ||
pitṛhūrnṛpa puryā dvārdakṣiṇena purañjanaḥ  |
rāṣṭraṃ dakṣiṇapañcālaṃ yāti śrutadharānvitaḥ  || 04.25.050 ||
devahūrnāma puryā dvā uttareṇa purañjanaḥ  |
rāṣṭramuttarapañcālaṃ yāti śrutadharānvitaḥ  || 04.25.051 ||
āsurī nāma paścāddvāstayā yāti purañjanaḥ  |
grāmakaṃ nāma viṣayaṃ durmadena samanvitaḥ  || 04.25.052 ||
nirṛtirnāma paścāddvāstayā yāti purañjanaḥ  |
vaiśasaṃ nāma viṣayaṃ lubdhakena samanvitaḥ  || 04.25.053 ||
andhāvamīṣāṃ paurāṇāṃ nirvākpeśaskṛtāvubhau  |
akṣaṇvatāmadhipatistābhyāṃ yāti karoti ca  || 04.25.054 ||
sa yarhyantaḥpuragato viṣūcīnasamanvitaḥ  |
mohaṃ prasādaṃ harṣaṃ vā yāti jāyātmajodbhavam  || 04.25.055 ||
evaṃ karmasu saṃsaktaḥ kāmātmā vañcito'budhaḥ  |
mahiṣī yadyadīheta tattadevānvavartata  || 04.25.056 ||
kvacitpibantyāṃ pibati madirāṃ madavihvalaḥ  |
aśnantyāṃ kvacidaśnāti jakṣatyāṃ saha jakṣiti  || 04.25.057 ||
kvacidgāyati gāyantyāṃ rudatyāṃ rudati kvacit |
kvaciddhasantyāṃ hasati jalpantyāmanu jalpati  || 04.25.058 ||
kvaciddhāvati dhāvantyāṃ tiṣṭhantyāmanu tiṣṭhati  |
anu śete śayānāyāmanvāste kvacidāsatīm  || 04.25.059 ||
kvacicchṛṇoti śṛṇvantyāṃ paśyantyāmanu paśyati  |

kvacicca śocatīṃ jāyāmanu śocati dīnavat |
anu hṛṣyati hṛṣyantyāṃ muditāmanu modate  || 04.25.061 ||
vipralabdho mahiṣyaivaṃ sarvaprakṛtivañcitaḥ  |
necchannanukarotyajñaḥ klaibyātkrīḍāmṛgo yathā  || 04.25.062 ||
04.26.001|0 nārada uvāca
sa ekadā maheṣvāso rathaṃ pañcāśvamāśugam  |
dvīṣaṃ dvicakramekākṣaṃ triveṇuṃ pañcabandhuram  || 04.26.001 ||
ekaraśmyekadamanamekanīḍaṃ dvikūbaram  |
pañcapraharaṇaṃ sapta varūthaṃ pañcavikramam  || 04.26.002 ||
haimopaskaramāruhya svarṇavarmākṣayeṣudhiḥ  |
ekādaśacamūnāthaḥ pañcaprasthamagādvanam  || 04.26.003 ||
cacāra mṛgayāṃ tatra dṛpta ātteṣukārmukaḥ  |
vihāya jāyāmatadarhāṃ mṛgavyasanalālasaḥ  || 04.26.004 ||
āsurīṃ vṛttimāśritya ghorātmā niranugrahaḥ  |
nyahananniśitairbāṇairvaneṣu vanagocarān  || 04.26.005 ||
tīrtheṣu pratidṛṣṭeṣu rājā medhyān paśūn vane  |
yāvadarthamalaṃ lubdho hanyāditi niyamyate  || 04.26.006 ||
ya evaṃ karma niyataṃ vidvān kurvīta mānavaḥ  |

guṇapravāhapatito naṣṭaprajño vrajatyadhaḥ  || 04.26.008 ||
tatra nirbhinnagātrāṇāṃ citravājaiḥ śilīmukhaiḥ  |
viplavo'bhūdduḥkhitānāṃ duḥsahaḥ karuṇātmanām  || 04.26.009 ||
śaśān varāhānmahiṣān gavayān ruruśalyakān  |
medhyānanyāṃśca vividhān vinighnan śramamadhyagāt || 04.26.010 ||
tataḥ kṣuttṛṭpariśrānto nivṛtto gṛhameyivān  |
kṛtasnānocitāhāraḥ saṃviveśa gataklamaḥ  || 04.26.011 ||
ātmānamarhayāṃ cakre dhūpālepasragādibhiḥ  |

04.27.001|0 nārada uvāca

teṣu tadrikthahāreṣu gṛhakośānujīviṣu  |

kālasya duhitā kācittrilokīṃ varamicchatī  |

duhitṝḥ putrapautrāṃśca jāmijāmātṛpārṣadān  |

vikṛṣyamāṇaḥ prasabhaṃ yavanena balīyasā  |

vibhajya tanayebhyaḥ kṣmāṃ rājarṣirmalayadhvajaḥ  |

uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha rājarṣe imāmudadhimekhalām  |

04.28.052|0 brāhmaṇa uvāca
kā tvaṃ kasyāsi ko vāyaṃ śayāno yasya śocasi  |

vipaṇastu kriyāśaktirbhūtaprakṛtiravyayā  |

04.29.002|0 nārada uvāca
puruṣaṃ purañjanaṃ vidyādyadvyanaktyātmanaḥ puram  |

nalinī nālinī nāse gandhaḥ saurabha ucyate  |

manoraśmirbuddhisūto hṛnnīḍo dvandvakūbaraḥ  |

ākūtirvikramo bāhyo mṛgatṛṣṇāṃ pradhāvati  |

saṃvatsaraścaṇḍavegaḥ kālo yenopalakṣitaḥ  |

kālakanyā jarā sākṣāllokastāṃ nābhinandati  |

guṇābhimānī sa tadā karmāṇi kurute'vaśaḥ  |

kṣutparīto yathā dīnaḥ sārameyo gṛhaṃ gṛham  |

naikāntataḥ pratīkāraḥ karmaṇāṃ karma kevalam  |

so'cirādeva rājarṣe syādacyutakathāśrayaḥ  |
śṛṇvataḥ śraddadhānasya nityadā syādadhīyataḥ  || 04.29.038 ||
yatra bhāgavatā rājan sādhavo viśadāśayāḥ  |
bhagavadguṇānukathana śravaṇavyagracetasaḥ  || 04.29.039 ||
tasminmahanmukharitā madhubhiccaritrapīyūṣaśeṣasaritaḥ paritaḥ sravanti  |

etairupadruto nityaṃ jīvalokaḥ svabhāvajaiḥ  |
na karoti harernūnaṃ kathāmṛtanidhau ratim  || 04.29.041 ||
prajāpatipatiḥ sākṣādbhagavān giriśo manuḥ  |

marīciratryaṅgirasau pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ  |

adyāpi vācaspatayastapovidyāsamādhibhiḥ  |

yadā yasyānugṛhṇāti bhagavānātmabhāvitaḥ  |

tasmātkarmasu barhiṣmannajñānādarthakāśiṣu  |

svaṃ lokaṃ na viduste vai yatra devo janārdanaḥ  |
āhurdhūmradhiyo vedaṃ sakarmakamatadvidaḥ  || 04.29.048 ||
āstīrya darbhaiḥ prāgagraiḥ kārtsnyena kṣitimaṇḍalam  |
stabdho bṛhadvadhānmānī karma nāvaiṣi yatparam  |
tatkarma haritoṣaṃ yatsā vidyā tanmatiryayā  || 04.29.049 ||
harirdehabhṛtāmātmā svayaṃ prakṛtirīśvaraḥ  |

sa vai priyatamaścātmā yato na bhayamaṇvapi  |
iti veda sa vai vidvān yo vidvān sa gururhariḥ  || 04.29.051 ||

tasyāḥ sulalitagamanapadavinyāsagativilāsāyāścānupadaṃ khaṇakhaṇāyamānaruciracaraṇābharaṇasvanamupākarṇya naradevakumāraḥ samādhiyogenāmīlitanayananalinamukulayugalamīṣadvikacayya vyacaṣṭa  || 05.02.005 ||_*
tāmevāvidūre madhukarīmiva sumanasa upajighrantīṃ divijamanujamanonayanāhlādadughairgativihāravrīḍāvinayāvalokasusvarākṣarāvayavairmanasi nṛṇāṃ kusumāyudhasya vidadhatīṃ vivaraṃ nijamukhavigalitāmṛtāsavasahāsabhāṣaṇāmodamadāndhamadhukaranikaroparodhena drutapadavinyāsena valguspandanastanakalaśakabarabhāraraśanāṃ devīṃ tadavalokanena vivṛtāvasarasya bhagavato makaradhvajasya vaśamupanīto jaḍavaditi hovāca  || 05.02.006 ||_*
kā tvaṃ cikīrṣasi ca kiṃ munivarya śaile   māyāsi kāpi bhagavatparadevatāyāḥ  |
vijye bibharṣi dhanuṣī suhṛdātmano'rthe   kiṃ vā mṛgānmṛgayase vipine pramattān  || 05.02.007 ||*
bāṇāvimau bhagavataḥ śatapatrapatrau   śāntāvapuṅkharucirāvatitigmadantau  |
kasmai yuyuṅkṣasi vane vicaranna vidmaḥ   kṣemāya no jaḍadhiyāṃ tava vikramo'stu  || 05.02.008 ||*
śiṣyā ime bhagavataḥ paritaḥ paṭhanti   gāyanti sāma sarahasyamajasramīśam  |
yuṣmacchikhāvilulitāḥ sumano'bhivṛṣṭīḥ   sarve bhajantyṛṣigaṇā iva vedaśākhāḥ  || 05.02.009 ||*
vācaṃ paraṃ caraṇapañjaratittirīṇāṃ   brahmannarūpamukharāṃ śṛṇavāma tubhyam  |
labdhā kadambaruciraṅkaviṭaṅkabimbe   yasyāmalātaparidhiḥ kva ca valkalaṃ te  || 05.02.010 ||*
kiṃ sambhṛtaṃ rucirayordvija śṛṅgayoste   madhye kṛśo vahasi yatra dṛśiḥ śritā me  |
paṅko'ruṇaḥ surabhirātmaviṣāṇa īdṛg  yenāśramaṃ subhaga me surabhīkaroṣi  || 05.02.011 ||*
lokaṃ pradarśaya suhṛttama tāvakaṃ me   yatratya itthamurasāvayavāvapūrvau  |
asmadvidhasya manaunnayanau bibharti   bahvadbhutaṃ sarasarāsasudhādi vaktre  || 05.02.012 ||*
kā vātmavṛttiradanāddhaviraṅga vāti   viṣṇoḥ kalāsyanimiṣonmakarau ca karṇau  |
udvignamīnayugalaṃ dvijapaṅktiśocir  āsannabhṛṅganikaraṃ sara inmukhaṃ te  || 05.02.013 ||*
yo'sau tvayā karasarojahataḥ pataṅgo   dikṣu bhraman bhramata ejayate'kṣiṇī me  |
muktaṃ na te smarasi vakrajaṭāvarūthaṃ   kaṣṭo'nilo harati lampaṭa eṣa nīvīm  || 05.02.014 ||*
rūpaṃ tapodhana tapaścaratāṃ tapoghnaṃ   hyetattu kena tapasā bhavatopalabdham  |
cartuṃ tapo'rhasi mayā saha mitra mahyaṃ   kiṃ vā prasīdati sa vai bhavabhāvano me  || 05.02.015 ||*
na tvāṃ tyajāmi dayitaṃ dvijadevadattaṃ   yasminmano dṛgapi no na viyāti lagnam  |
māṃ cāruśṛṅgyarhasi netumanuvrataṃ te   cittaṃ yataḥ pratisarantu śivāḥ sacivyaḥ  || 05.02.016 ||*

nāyaṃ deho dehabhājāṃ nṛloke kaṣṭān kāmānarhate viḍbhujāṃ ye  |

mahatsevāṃ dvāramāhurvimuktestamodvāraṃ yoṣitāṃ saṅgisaṅgam  |
mahāntaste samacittāḥ praśāntā vimanyavaḥ suhṛdaḥ sādhavo ye  || 05.05.002 ||
ye vā mayīśe kṛtasauhṛdārthā janeṣu dehambharavārtikeṣu  |
gṛheṣu jāyātmajarātimatsu na prītiyuktā yāvadarthāśca loke  || 05.05.003 ||
nūnaṃ pramattaḥ kurute vikarma yadindriyaprītaya āpṛṇoti  |

parābhavastāvadabodhajāto yāvanna jijñāsata ātmatattvam  |

evaṃ manaḥ karmavaśaṃ prayuṅkte avidyayātmanyupadhīyamāne  |

yadā na paśyatyayathā guṇehāṃ svārthe pramattaḥ sahasā vipaścit |
gatasmṛtirvindati tatra tāpānāsādya maithunyamagāramajñaḥ  || 05.05.007 ||
puṃsaḥ striyā mithunībhāvametaṃ tayormitho hṛdayagranthimāhuḥ  |

yadā manohṛdayagranthirasya karmānubaddho dṛḍha āślatheta  |

haṃse gurau mayi bhaktyānuvṛtyā vitṛṣṇayā dvandvatitikṣayā ca  |

matkarmabhirmatkathayā ca nityaṃ maddevasaṅgādguṇakīrtanānme  |
nirvairasāmyopaśamena putrā jihāsayā dehagehātmabuddheḥ  || 05.05.011 ||
adhyātmayogena viviktasevayā prāṇendriyātmābhijayena sadhryak |
sacchraddhayā brahmacaryeṇa śaśvadasampramādena yamena vācām  || 05.05.012 ||
sarvatra madbhāvavicakṣaṇena jñānena vijñānavirājitena  |
yogena dhṛtyudyamasattvayukto liṅgaṃ vyapohetkuśalo'hamākhyam  || 05.05.013 ||
karmāśayaṃ hṛdayagranthibandhamavidyayāsāditamapramattaḥ  |
anena yogena yathopadeśaṃ samyagvyapohyoparameta yogāt || 05.05.014 ||
putrāṃśca śiṣyāṃśca nṛpo gururvā mallokakāmo madanugrahārthaḥ  |
itthaṃ vimanyuranuśiṣyādatajjñānna yojayetkarmasu karmamūḍhān  |
kaṃ yojayanmanujo'rthaṃ labheta nipātayannaṣṭadṛśaṃ hi garte  || 05.05.015 ||
lokaḥ svayaṃ śreyasi naṣṭadṛṣṭiryo'rthān samīheta nikāmakāmaḥ  |
anyonyavairaḥ sukhaleśahetoranantaduḥkhaṃ ca na veda mūḍhaḥ  || 05.05.016 ||
kastaṃ svayaṃ tadabhijño vipaścidavidyāyāmantare vartamānam  |
dṛṣṭvā punastaṃ saghṛṇaḥ kubuddhiṃ prayojayedutpathagaṃ yathāndham  || 05.05.017 ||
gururna sa syātsvajano na sa syātpitā na sa syājjananī na sā syāt |

idaṃ śarīraṃ mama durvibhāvyaṃ sattvaṃ hi me hṛdayaṃ yatra dharmaḥ  |
pṛṣṭhe kṛto me yadadharma ārādato hi māmṛṣabhaṃ prāhurāryāḥ  || 05.05.019 ||
tasmādbhavanto hṛdayena jātāḥ sarve mahīyāṃsamamuṃ sanābham  |

bhūteṣu vīrudbhya uduttamā ye sarīsṛpāsteṣu sabodhaniṣṭhāḥ  |

devāsurebhyo maghavatpradhānā dakṣādayo brahmasutāstu teṣām  |

na brāhmaṇaistulaye bhūtamanyatpaśyāmi viprāḥ kimataḥ paraṃ tu  |

dhṛtā tanūruśatī me purāṇī yeneha sattvaṃ paramaṃ pavitram  |
śamo damaḥ satyamanugrahaśca tapastitikṣānubhavaśca yatra  || 05.05.024 ||
matto'pyanantātparataḥ parasmātsvargāpavargādhipaterna kiñcit |
