atha kaśyapapatnīnāṃ yatprasūtamidaṃ jagat |
aditirditirdanuḥ kāṣṭhā ariṣṭā surasā ilā  || 06.06.025 ||
muniḥ krodhavaśā tāmrā surabhiḥ saramā timiḥ  |
timeryādogaṇā āsan śvāpadāḥ saramāsutāḥ  || 06.06.026 ||
surabhermahiṣā gāvo ye cānye dviśaphā nṛpa  |
tāmrāyāḥ śyenagṛdhrādyā munerapsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ  || 06.06.027 ||
dandaśūkādayaḥ sarpā rājan krodhavaśātmajāḥ  |
ilāyā bhūruhāḥ sarve yātudhānāśca saurasāḥ  || 06.06.028 ||
ariṣṭāyāstu gandharvāḥ kāṣṭhāyā dviśaphetarāḥ  |
sutā danorekaṣaṣṭisteṣāṃ prādhānikāñśṛṇu  || 06.06.029 ||
dvimūrdhā śambaro'riṣṭo hayagrīvo vibhāvasuḥ  |
ayomukhaḥ śaṅkuśirāḥ svarbhānuḥ kapilo'ruṇaḥ  || 06.06.030 ||
pulomā vṛṣaparvā ca ekacakro'nutāpanaḥ  |
dhūmrakeśo virūpākṣo vipracittiśca durjayaḥ  || 06.06.031 ||
svarbhānoḥ suprabhāṃ kanyāmuvāha namuciḥ kila  |
vṛṣaparvaṇastu śarmiṣṭhāṃ yayātirnāhuṣo balī  || 06.06.032 ||
vaiśvānarasutā yāśca catasraścārudarśanāḥ  |
upadānavī hayaśirā pulomā kālakā tathā  || 06.06.033 ||
upadānavīṃ hiraṇyākṣaḥ kraturhayaśirāṃ nṛpa  |
pulomāṃ kālakāṃ ca dve vaiśvānarasute tu kaḥ  || 06.06.034 ||
upayeme'tha bhagavān kaśyapo brahmacoditaḥ  |
paulomāḥ kālakeyāśca dānavā yuddhaśālinaḥ  || 06.06.035 ||
tayoḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi yajñaghnāṃste pituḥ pitā  |
jaghāna svargato rājanneka indrapriyaṅkaraḥ  || 06.06.036 ||
vipracittiḥ siṃhikāyāṃ śataṃ caikamajījanat |
rāhujyeṣṭhaṃ ketuśataṃ grahatvaṃ ya upāgatāḥ  || 06.06.037 ||
athātaḥ śrūyatāṃ vaṃśo yo'diteranupūrvaśaḥ  |
yatra nārāyaṇo devaḥ svāṃśenāvātaradvibhuḥ  || 06.06.038 ||
vivasvānaryamā pūṣā tvaṣṭātha savitā bhagaḥ  |
dhātā vidhātā varuṇo mitraḥ śatru urukramaḥ  || 06.06.039 ||
vivasvataḥ śrāddhadevaṃ saṃjñāsūyata vai manum  |
mithunaṃ ca mahābhāgā yamaṃ devaṃ yamīṃ tathā  |
saiva bhūtvātha vaḍavā nāsatyau suṣuve bhuvi  || 06.06.040 ||
chāyā śanaiścaraṃ lebhe sāvarṇiṃ ca manuṃ tataḥ  |
kanyāṃ ca tapatīṃ yā vai vavre saṃvaraṇaṃ patim  || 06.06.041 ||
aryamṇo mātṛkā patnī tayoścarṣaṇayaḥ sutāḥ  |
yatra vai mānuṣī jātirbrahmaṇā copakalpitā  || 06.06.042 ||
pūṣānapatyaḥ piṣṭādo bhagnadanto'bhavatpurā  |
yo'sau dakṣāya kupitaṃ jahāsa vivṛtadvijaḥ  || 06.06.043 ||
tvaṣṭurdaityātmajā bhāryā racanā nāma kanyakā  |
sanniveśastayorjajñe viśvarūpaśca vīryavān  || 06.06.044 ||
taṃ vavrire suragaṇā svasrīyaṃ dviṣatāmapi  |
vimatena parityaktā guruṇāṅgirasena yat || 06.06.045 ||
06.07.001|0 śrīrājovāca
kasya hetoḥ parityaktā ācāryeṇātmanaḥ surāḥ  |
etadācakṣva bhagavañchiṣyāṇāmakramaṃ gurau  || 06.07.001 ||
06.07.002|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
indrastribhuvanaiśvarya madollaṅghitasatpathaḥ  |
marudbhirvasubhī rudrairādityairṛbhubhirnṛpa  || 06.07.002 ||
viśvedevaiśca sādhyaiśca nāsatyābhyāṃ pariśritaḥ  |
siddhacāraṇagandharvairmunibhirbrahmavādibhiḥ  || 06.07.003 ||
vidyādharāpsarobhiśca kinnaraiḥ patagoragaiḥ  |
niṣevyamāṇo maghavān stūyamānaśca bhārata  || 06.07.004 ||
upagīyamāno lalitamāsthānādhyāsanāśritaḥ  |
pāṇḍureṇātapatreṇa candramaṇḍalacāruṇā  || 06.07.005 ||
yuktaścānyaiḥ pārameṣṭhyaiścāmaravyajanādibhiḥ  |
virājamānaḥ paulamyā sahārdhāsanayā bhṛśam  || 06.07.006 ||
sa yadā paramācāryaṃ devānāmātmanaśca ha  |
nābhyanandata samprāptaṃ pratyutthānāsanādibhiḥ  || 06.07.007 ||
vācaspatiṃ munivaraṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam  |
noccacālāsanādindraḥ paśyannapi sabhāgatam  || 06.07.008 ||
tato nirgatya sahasā kavirāṅgirasaḥ prabhuḥ  |
āyayau svagṛhaṃ tūṣṇīṃ vidvān śrīmadavikriyām  || 06.07.009 ||
tarhyeva pratibudhyendro guruhelanamātmanaḥ  |
garhayāmāsa sadasi svayamātmānamātmanā  || 06.07.010 ||
aho bata mayāsādhu kṛtaṃ vai dabhrabuddhinā  |
yanmayaiśvaryamattena guruḥ sadasi kātkṛtaḥ  || 06.07.011 ||
ko gṛdhyetpaṇḍito lakṣmīṃ tripiṣṭapapaterapi  |
yayāhamāsuraṃ bhāvaṃ nīto'dya vibudheśvaraḥ  || 06.07.012 ||
yaḥ pārameṣṭhyaṃ dhiṣaṇamadhitiṣṭhanna kañcana  |
pratyuttiṣṭhediti brūyurdharmaṃ te na paraṃ viduḥ  || 06.07.013 ||
teṣāṃ kupathadeṣṭṝṇāṃ patatāṃ tamasi hyadhaḥ  |
ye śraddadhyurvacaste vai majjantyaśmaplavā iva  || 06.07.014 ||
athāhamamarācāryamagādhadhiṣaṇaṃ dvijam  |
prasādayiṣye niśaṭhaḥ śīrṣṇā taccaraṇaṃ spṛśan  || 06.07.015 ||
evaṃ cintayatastasya maghono bhagavān gṛhāt |
bṛhaspatirgato'dṛṣṭāṃ gatimadhyātmamāyayā  || 06.07.016 ||
gurornādhigataḥ saṃjñāṃ parīkṣan bhagavān svarāṭ |
dhyāyan dhiyā surairyuktaḥ śarma nālabhatātmanaḥ  || 06.07.017 ||
tacchrutvaivāsurāḥ sarva āśrityauśanasaṃ matam  |
devān pratyudyamaṃ cakrurdurmadā ātatāyinaḥ  || 06.07.018 ||
tairvisṛṣṭeṣubhistīkṣṇairnirbhinnāṅgorubāhavaḥ  |
brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ sahendrā natakandharāḥ  || 06.07.019 ||
tāṃstathābhyarditān vīkṣya bhagavānātmabhūrajaḥ  |
kṛpayā parayā deva uvāca parisāntvayan  || 06.07.020 ||
06.07.021|0 śrībrahmovāca
aho bata suraśreṣṭhā hyabhadraṃ vaḥ kṛtaṃ mahat |
brahmiṣṭhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dāntamaiśvaryānnābhyanandata  || 06.07.021 ||
tasyāyamanayasyāsītparebhyo vaḥ parābhavaḥ  |
prakṣīṇebhyaḥ svavairibhyaḥ samṛddhānāṃ ca yatsurāḥ  || 06.07.022 ||
maghavan dviṣataḥ paśya prakṣīṇān gurvatikramāt |
sampratyupacitān bhūyaḥ kāvyamārādhya bhaktitaḥ  |
ādadīrannilayanaṃ mamāpi bhṛgudevatāḥ  || 06.07.023 ||
tripiṣṭapaṃ kiṃ gaṇayantyabhedya mantrā bhṛgūṇāmanuśikṣitārthāḥ  |
na vipragovindagavīśvarāṇāṃ bhavantyabhadrāṇi nareśvarāṇām  || 06.07.024 ||
tadviśvarūpaṃ bhajatāśu vipraṃ tapasvinaṃ tvāṣṭramathātmavantam  |
sabhājito'rthān sa vidhāsyate vo yadi kṣamiṣyadhvamutāsya karma  || 06.07.025 ||
06.07.026|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ta evamuditā rājan brahmaṇā vigatajvarāḥ  |

06.07.027|0 śrīdevā ūcuḥ
vayaṃ te'tithayaḥ prāptā āśramaṃ bhadramastu te  |
kāmaḥ sampādyatāṃ tāta pitṝṇāṃ samayocitaḥ  || 06.07.027 ||
putrāṇāṃ hi paro dharmaḥ pitṛśuśrūṣaṇaṃ satām  |
api putravatāṃ brahman kimuta brahmacāriṇām  || 06.07.028 ||
ācāryo brahmaṇo mūrtiḥ pitā mūrtiḥ prajāpateḥ  |
bhrātā marutpatermūrtirmātā sākṣātkṣitestanuḥ  || 06.07.029 ||
dayāyā bhaginī mūrtirdharmasyātmātithiḥ svayam  |
agnerabhyāgato mūrtiḥ sarvabhūtāni cātmanaḥ  || 06.07.030 ||
tasmātpitṝṇāmārtānāmārtiṃ paraparābhavam  |
tapasāpanayaṃstāta sandeśaṃ kartumarhasi  || 06.07.031 ||
vṛṇīmahe tvopādhyāyaṃ brahmiṣṭhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gurum  |
yathāñjasā vijeṣyāmaḥ sapatnāṃstava tejasā  || 06.07.032 ||
na garhayanti hyartheṣu yaviṣṭhāṅghryabhivādanam  |
chandobhyo'nyatra na brahman vayo jyaiṣṭhyasya kāraṇam  || 06.07.033 ||
06.07.034|0 śrīṛṣiruvāca
abhyarthitaḥ suragaṇaiḥ paurahitye mahātapāḥ  |

06.07.035|0 śrīviśvarūpa uvāca
vigarhitaṃ dharmaśīlairbrahmavarcaupavyayam  |
kathaṃ nu madvidho nāthā lokeśairabhiyācitam  |
pratyākhyāsyati tacchiṣyaḥ sa eva svārtha ucyate  || 06.07.035 ||
akiñcanānāṃ hi dhanaṃ śiloñchanaṃ teneha nirvartitasādhusatkriyaḥ  |
kathaṃ vigarhyaṃ nu karomyadhīśvarāḥ paurodhasaṃ hṛṣyati yena durmatiḥ  || 06.07.036 ||
tathāpi na pratibrūyāṃ gurubhiḥ prārthitaṃ kiyat |
bhavatāṃ prārthitaṃ sarvaṃ prāṇairarthaiśca sādhaye  || 06.07.037 ||
06.07.038|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
tebhya evaṃ pratiśrutya viśvarūpo mahātapāḥ  |
paurahityaṃ vṛtaścakre parameṇa samādhinā  || 06.07.038 ||
suradviṣāṃ śriyaṃ guptāmauśanasyāpi vidyayā  |
ācchidyādānmahendrāya vaiṣṇavyā vidyayā vibhuḥ  || 06.07.039 ||
yayā guptaḥ sahasrākṣo jigye'suracamūrvibhuḥ  |
tāṃ prāha sa mahendrāya viśvarūpa udāradhīḥ  || 06.07.040 ||
06.08.001|0 śrīrājovāca
yayā guptaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ savāhān ripusainikān  |
krīḍanniva vinirjitya trilokyā bubhuje śriyam  || 06.08.001 ||
bhagavaṃstanmamākhyāhi varma nārāyaṇātmakam  |
yathātatāyinaḥ śatrūn yena gupto'jayanmṛdhe  || 06.08.002 ||
06.08.003|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
vṛtaḥ purohitastvāṣṭro mahendrāyānupṛcchate  |

06.08.004|0 śrīviśvarūpa uvāca
dhautāṅghripāṇirācamya sapavitra udaṅmukhaḥ  |
kṛtasvāṅgakaranyāso mantrābhyāṃ vāgyataḥ śuciḥ  || 06.08.004 ||
nārāyaṇaparaṃ varma sannahyedbhaya āgate  |
pādayorjānunorūrvorudare hṛdyathorasi  || 06.08.005 ||
mukhe śirasyānupūrvyādoṃkārādīni vinyaset |
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti viparyayamathāpi vā  || 06.08.006 ||
karanyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāddvādaśākṣaravidyayā  |
praṇavādiyakārāntamaṅgulyaṅguṣṭhaparvasu  || 06.08.007 ||
nyaseddhṛdaya oṃkāraṃ vikāramanu mūrdhani  |
ṣakāraṃ tu bhruvormadhye ṇakāraṃ śikhayā nyaset || 06.08.008 ||
vekāraṃ netrayoryuñjyānnakāraṃ sarvasandhiṣu  |
makāramastramuddiśya mantramūrtirbhavedbudhaḥ  || 06.08.009 ||
savisargaṃ phaḍantaṃ tatsarvadikṣu vinirdiśet |
oṃ viṣṇave nama iti  || 06.08.010 ||
ātmānaṃ paramaṃ dhyāyeddhyeyaṃ ṣaṭśaktibhiryutam  |
vidyātejastapomūrtimimaṃ mantramudāharet || 06.08.011 ||
oṃ harirvidadhyānmama sarvarakṣāṃ nyastāṅghripadmaḥ patagendrapṛṣṭhe  |
darāricarmāsigadeṣucāpa pāśān dadhāno'ṣṭaguṇo'ṣṭabāhuḥ  || 06.08.012 ||
jaleṣu māṃ rakṣatu matsyamūrtiryādogaṇebhyo varuṇasya pāśāt |
sthaleṣu māyāvaṭuvāmano'vyāttrivikramaḥ khe'vatu viśvarūpaḥ  || 06.08.013 ||
durgeṣvaṭavyājimukhādiṣu prabhuḥ pāyānnṛsiṃho'surayūthapāriḥ  |
vimuñcato yasya mahāṭṭahāsaṃ diśo vinedurnyapataṃśca garbhāḥ  || 06.08.014 ||
rakṣatvasau mādhvani yajñakalpaḥ svadaṃṣṭrayonnītadharo varāhaḥ  |
rāmo'drikūṭeṣvatha vipravāse salakṣmaṇo'vyādbharatāgrajo'smān  || 06.08.015 ||
māmugradharmādakhilātpramādānnārāyaṇaḥ pātu naraśca hāsāt |
dattastvayogādatha yoganāthaḥ pāyādguṇeśaḥ kapilaḥ karmabandhāt || 06.08.016 ||
sanatkumāro'vatu kāmadevāddhayaśīrṣā māṃ pathi devahelanāt |
devarṣivaryaḥ puruṣārcanāntarātkūrmo harirmāṃ nirayādaśeṣāt || 06.08.017 ||
dhanvantarirbhagavān pātvapathyāddvandvādbhayādṛṣabho nirjitātmā  |
yajñaśca lokādavatājjanāntādbalo gaṇātkrodhavaśādahīndraḥ  || 06.08.018 ||
dvaipāyano bhagavānaprabodhādbuddhastu pāṣaṇḍagaṇapramādāt |
kalkiḥ kaleḥ kālamalātprapātu dharmāvanāyorukṛtāvatāraḥ  || 06.08.019 ||
māṃ keśavo gadayā prātaravyādgovinda āsaṅgavamāttaveṇuḥ  |
nārāyaṇaḥ prāhṇa udāttaśaktirmadhyandine viṣṇurarīndrapāṇiḥ  || 06.08.020 ||
devo'parāhṇe madhuhogradhanvā sāyaṃ tridhāmāvatu mādhavo mām  |
doṣe hṛṣīkeśa utārdharātre niśītha eko'vatu padmanābhaḥ  || 06.08.021 ||
śrīvatsadhāmāpararātra īśaḥ pratyūṣa īśo'sidharo janārdanaḥ  |
dāmodaro'vyādanusandhyaṃ prabhāte viśveśvaro bhagavān kālamūrtiḥ  || 06.08.022 ||
cakraṃ yugāntānalatigmanemi bhramatsamantādbhagavatprayuktam  |
dandagdhi dandagdhyarisainyamāśu kakṣaṃ yathā vātasakho hutāśaḥ  || 06.08.023 ||
gade'śanisparśanavisphuliṅge niṣpiṇḍhi niṣpiṇḍhyajitapriyāsi  |
kuṣmāṇḍavaināyakayakṣarakṣo bhūtagrahāṃścūrṇaya cūrṇayārīn  || 06.08.024 ||
tvaṃ yātudhānapramathapretamātṛ piśācavipragrahaghoradṛṣṭīn  |
darendra vidrāvaya kṛṣṇapūrito bhīmasvano'rerhṛdayāni kampayan  || 06.08.025 ||
tvaṃ tigmadhārāsivarārisainyamīśaprayukto mama chindhi chindhi  |
cakṣūṃṣi carman chatacandra chādaya dviṣāmaghonāṃ hara pāpacakṣuṣām  || 06.08.026 ||
yanno bhayaṃ grahebhyo'bhūtketubhyo nṛbhya eva ca  |
sarīsṛpebhyo daṃṣṭribhyo bhūtebhyo'ṃhobhya eva ca  || 06.08.027 ||
sarvāṇyetāni bhagavannāmarūpānukīrtanāt |
prayāntu saṅkṣayaṃ sadyo ye naḥ śreyaḥpratīpakāḥ  || 06.08.028 ||
garuḍo bhagavān stotra stobhaśchandomayaḥ prabhuḥ  |
rakṣatvaśeṣakṛcchrebhyo viṣvaksenaḥ svanāmabhiḥ  || 06.08.029 ||
sarvāpadbhyo harernāma rūpayānāyudhāni naḥ  |
buddhīndriyamanaḥprāṇān pāntu pārṣadabhūṣaṇāḥ  || 06.08.030 ||
yathā hi bhagavāneva vastutaḥ sadasacca yat |
satyenānena naḥ sarve yāntu nāśamupadravāḥ  || 06.08.031 ||
yathaikātmyānubhāvānāṃ vikalparahitaḥ svayam  |
bhūṣaṇāyudhaliṅgākhyā dhatte śaktīḥ svamāyayā  || 06.08.032 ||
tenaiva satyamānena sarvajño bhagavān hariḥ  |
pātu sarvaiḥ svarūpairnaḥ sadā sarvatra sarvagaḥ  || 06.08.033 ||
vidikṣu dikṣūrdhvamadhaḥ samantādantarbahirbhagavānnārasiṃhaḥ  |
prahāpaya lokabhayaṃ svanena svatejasā grastasamastatejāḥ  || 06.08.034 ||
maghavannidamākhyātaṃ varma nārāyaṇātmakam  |
vijeṣyase'ñjasā yena daṃśito'surayūthapān  || 06.08.035 ||
etaddhārayamāṇastu yaṃ yaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣā  |
padā vā saṃspṛśetsadyaḥ sādhvasātsa vimucyate  || 06.08.036 ||
na kutaścidbhayaṃ tasya vidyāṃ dhārayato bhavet |
rājadasyugrahādibhyo vyādhyādibhyaśca karhicit || 06.08.037 ||
imāṃ vidyāṃ purā kaścitkauśiko dhārayan dvijaḥ  |
yogadhāraṇayā svāṅgaṃ jahau sa marudhanvani  || 06.08.038 ||
tasyopari vimānena gandharvapatirekadā  |
yayau citrarathaḥ strībhirvṛto yatra dvijakṣayaḥ  || 06.08.039 ||
gaganānnyapatatsadyaḥ savimāno hyavākśirāḥ  |
sa vālikhilyavacanādasthīnyādāya vismitaḥ  |
prāsya prācīsarasvatyāṃ snātvā dhāma svamanvagāt || 06.08.040 ||
06.08.041|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyātkāle yo dhārayati cādṛtaḥ  |
taṃ namasyanti bhūtāni mucyate sarvato bhayāt || 06.08.041 ||
etāṃ vidyāmadhigato viśvarūpācchatakratuḥ  |
trailokyalakṣmīṃ bubhuje vinirjitya mṛdhe'surān  || 06.08.042 ||
06.09.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
tasyāsan viśvarūpasya śirāṃsi trīṇi bhārata  |
somapīthaṃ surāpīthamannādamiti śuśruma  || 06.09.001 ||
sa vai barhiṣi devebhyo bhāgaṃ pratyakṣamuccakaiḥ  |
adadadyasya pitaro devāḥ sapraśrayaṃ nṛpa  || 06.09.002 ||
sa eva hi dadau bhāgaṃ parokṣamasurān prati  |
yajamāno'vahadbhāgaṃ mātṛsnehavaśānugaḥ  || 06.09.003 ||
taddevahelanaṃ tasya dharmālīkaṃ sureśvaraḥ  |
ālakṣya tarasā bhītastacchīrṣāṇyacchinadruṣā  || 06.09.004 ||
somapīthaṃ tu yattasya śira āsītkapiñjalaḥ  |
kalaviṅkaḥ surāpīthamannādaṃ yatsa tittiriḥ  || 06.09.005 ||
brahmahatyāmañjalinā jagrāha yadapīśvaraḥ  |
saṃvatsarānte tadaghaṃ bhūtānāṃ sa viśuddhaye  || 06.09.006 ||
bhūmyambudrumayoṣidbhyaścaturdhā vyabhajaddhariḥ  |
bhūmisturīyaṃ jagrāha khātapūravareṇa vai  || 06.09.007 ||
īriṇaṃ brahmahatyāyā rūpaṃ bhūmau pradṛśyate  |
turyaṃ chedaviroheṇa vareṇa jagṛhurdrumāḥ  || 06.09.008 ||
teṣāṃ niryāsarūpeṇa brahmahatyā pradṛśyate  |
śaśvatkāmavareṇāṃhasturīyaṃ jagṛhuḥ striyaḥ  |2| 06.09.009 ||
rajorūpeṇa tāsvaṃho māsi māsi pradṛśyate  |
dravyabhūyovareṇāpasturīyaṃ jagṛhurmalam  || 06.09.010 ||
tāsu budbudaphenābhyāṃ dṛṣṭaṃ taddharati kṣipan  |
hataputrastatastvaṣṭā juhāvendrāya śatrave  || 06.09.011 ||
indraśatro vivardhasva mā ciraṃ jahi vidviṣam  |
athānvāhāryapacanādutthito ghoradarśanaḥ  || 06.09.012 ||
kṛtānta iva lokānāṃ yugāntasamaye yathā  |
viṣvagvivardhamānaṃ tamiṣumātraṃ dine dine  || 06.09.013 ||
dagdhaśailapratīkāśaṃ sandhyābhrānīkavarcasam  |
taptatāmraśikhāśmaśruṃ madhyāhnārkogralocanam  || 06.09.014 ||
dedīpyamāne triśikhe śūla āropya rodasī  |
nṛtyantamunnadantaṃ ca cālayantaṃ padā mahīm  || 06.09.015 ||
darīgambhīravaktreṇa pibatā ca nabhastalam  |
lihatā jihvayarkṣāṇi grasatā bhuvanatrayam  || 06.09.016 ||
mahatā raudradaṃṣṭreṇa jṛmbhamāṇaṃ muhurmuhuḥ  |
vitrastā dudruvurlokā vīkṣya sarve diśo daśa  || 06.09.017 ||
yenāvṛtā ime lokāstapasā tvāṣṭramūrtinā  |
sa vai vṛtra iti proktaḥ pāpaḥ paramadāruṇaḥ  || 06.09.018 ||
taṃ nijaghnurabhidrutya sagaṇā vibudharṣabhāḥ  |
svaiḥ svairdivyāstraśastraughaiḥ so'grasattāni kṛtsnaśaḥ  || 06.09.019 ||
tataste vismitāḥ sarve viṣaṇṇā grastatejasaḥ  |
pratyañcamādipuruṣamupatasthuḥ samāhitāḥ  || 06.09.020 ||
06.09.021|0 śrīdevā ūcuḥ
vāyvambarāgnyapkṣitayastrilokā brahmādayo ye vayamudvijantaḥ  |
harāma yasmai balimantako'sau bibheti yasmādaraṇaṃ tato naḥ  || 06.09.021 ||
avismitaṃ taṃ paripūrṇakāmaṃ svenaiva lābhena samaṃ praśāntam  |
vinopasarpatyaparaṃ hi bāliśaḥ śvalāṅgulenātititarti sindhum  || 06.09.022 ||
yasyoruśṛṅge jagatīṃ svanāvaṃ manuryathābadhya tatāra durgam  |
sa eva nastvāṣṭrabhayāddurantāttrātāśritān vāricaro'pi nūnam  || 06.09.023 ||
purā svayambhūrapi saṃyamāmbhasyudīrṇavātormiravaiḥ karāle  |
eko'ravindātpatitastatāra tasmādbhayādyena sa no'stu pāraḥ  || 06.09.024 ||
ya eka īśo nijamāyayā naḥ sasarja yenānusṛjāma viśvam  |
vayaṃ na yasyāpi puraḥ samīhataḥ paśyāma liṅgaṃ pṛthagīśamāninaḥ  || 06.09.025 ||
yo naḥ sapatnairbhṛśamardyamānān devarṣitiryaṅnṛṣu nitya eva  |
kṛtāvatārastanubhiḥ svamāyayā kṛtvātmasātpāti yuge yuge ca  || 06.09.026 ||
tameva devaṃ vayamātmadaivataṃ paraṃ pradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ viśvamanyam  |
vrajāma sarve śaraṇaṃ śaraṇyaṃ svānāṃ sa no dhāsyati śaṃ mahātmā  || 06.09.027 ||
06.09.028|0 śrīśuka uvāca
iti teṣāṃ mahārāja surāṇāmupatiṣṭhatām  |
pratīcyāṃ diśyabhūdāviḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ  || 06.09.028 ||
ātmatulyaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirvinā śrīvatsakaustubhau  |
paryupāsitamunnidra śaradamburuhekṣaṇam  || 06.09.029 ||
dṛṣṭvā tamavanau sarva īkṣaṇāhlādaviklavāḥ  |
daṇḍavatpatitā rājañchanairutthāya tuṣṭuvuḥ  || 06.09.030 ||
06.09.031|0 śrīdevā ūcuḥ
namaste yajñavīryāya vayase uta te namaḥ  |
namaste hyastacakrāya namaḥ supuruhūtaye  || 06.09.031 ||
yatte gatīnāṃ tisṛṇāmīśituḥ paramaṃ padam  |
nārvācīno visargasya dhātarveditumarhati  || 06.09.032 ||
oṃ namaste'stu bhagavannārāyaṇa vāsudevādipuruṣa mahāpuruṣa mahānubhāva paramamaṅgala paramakalyāṇa paramakāruṇika kevala jagadādhāra lokaikanātha sarveśvara lakṣmīnātha paramahaṃsaparivrājakaiḥ parameṇātmayogasamādhinā paribhāvitaparisphuṭapāramahaṃsyadharmeṇodghāṭitatamaḥkapāṭadvāre citte'pāvṛta ātmaloke svayamupalabdhanijasukhānubhavo bhavān  || 06.09.033 ||_*
duravabodha iva tavāyaṃ vihārayogo yadaśaraṇo'śarīra idamanavekṣitāsmatsamavāya ātmanaivāvikriyamāṇena saguṇamaguṇaḥ sṛjasi pāsi harasi  || 06.09.034 ||_*
atha tatra bhavān kiṃ devadattavadiha guṇavisargapatitaḥ pāratantryeṇa svakṛtakuśalākuśalaṃ phalamupādadātyāhosvidātmārāma upaśamaśīlaḥ samañjasadarśana udāsta iti ha vāva na vidāmaḥ  || 06.09.035 ||_*
na hi virodha ubhayaṃ bhagavatyaparimitaguṇagaṇa īśvare'navagāhyamāhātmye'rvācīnavikalpavitarkavicārapramāṇābhāsakutarkaśāstrakalilāntaḥkaraṇāśrayaduravagrahavādināṃ vivādānavasara uparatasamastamāyāmaye kevala evātmamāyāmantardhāya ko nvartho durghaṭa iva bhavati svarūpadvayābhāvāt || 06.09.036 ||_*
samaviṣamamatīnāṃ matamanusarasi yathā rajjukhaṇḍaḥ sarpādidhiyām  || 06.09.037 ||_*
sa eva hi punaḥ sarvavastuni vastusvarūpaḥ sarveśvaraḥ sakalajagatkāraṇakāraṇabhūtaḥ sarvapratyagātmatvātsarvaguṇābhāsopalakṣita eka eva paryavaśeṣitaḥ  || 06.09.038 ||_*
atha ha vāva tava mahimāmṛtarasasamudravipruṣā sakṛdavalīḍhayā svamanasi niṣyandamānānavaratasukhena vismāritadṛṣṭaśrutaviṣayasukhaleśābhāsāḥ paramabhāgavatā ekāntino bhagavati sarvabhūtapriyasuhṛdi sarvātmani nitarāṃ nirantaraṃ nirvṛtamanasaḥ kathamu ha vā ete madhumathana punaḥ svārthakuśalā hyātmapriyasuhṛdaḥ sādhavastvaccaraṇāmbujānusevāṃ visṛjanti na yatra punarayaṃ saṃsāraparyāvartaḥ  || 06.09.039 ||_*
tribhuvanātmabhavana trivikrama trinayana trilokamanoharānubhāva tavaiva vibhūtayo ditijadanujādayaścāpi teṣāmupakramasamayo'yamiti svātmamāyayā suranaramṛgamiśritajalacarākṛtibhiryathāparādhaṃ daṇḍaṃ daṇḍadhara dadhartha evamenamapi bhagavan jahi tvāṣṭramuta yadi manyase  || 06.09.040 ||_*
asmākaṃ tāvakānāṃ tatatata natānāṃ hare tava caraṇanalinayugaladhyānānubaddhahṛdayanigaḍānāṃ svaliṅgavivaraṇenātmasātkṛtānāmanukampānurañjitaviśadaruciraśiśirasmitāvalokena vigalitamadhuramukharasāmṛtakalayā cāntastāpamanaghārhasi śamayitum  || 06.09.041 ||_*
atha bhagavaṃstavāsmābhirakhilajagadutpattisthitilayanimittāyamānadivyamāyāvinodasya sakalajīvanikāyānāmantarhṛdayeṣu bahirapi ca brahmapratyagātmasvarūpeṇa pradhānarūpeṇa ca yathādeśakāladehāvasthānaviśeṣaṃ tadupādānopalambhakatayānubhavataḥ sarvapratyayasākṣiṇa ākāśaśarīrasya sākṣātparabrahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ kiyāniha vārthaviśeṣo vijñāpanīyaḥ syādvisphuliṅgādibhiriva hiraṇyaretasaḥ  || 06.09.042 ||_*
ata eva svayaṃ tadupakalpayāsmākaṃ bhagavataḥ paramagurostava caraṇaśatapalāśacchāyāṃ vividhavṛjinasaṃsārapariśramopaśamanīmupasṛtānāṃ vayaṃ yatkāmenopasāditāḥ  || 06.09.043 ||_*
atho īśa jahi tvāṣṭraṃ grasantaṃ bhuvanatrayam  |

haṃsāya dahranilayāya nirīkṣakāya kṛṣṇāya mṛṣṭayaśase nirupakramāya  |

06.09.046|0 śrīśuka uvāca

06.09.047|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
prīto'haṃ vaḥ suraśreṣṭhā madupasthānavidyayā  |
ātmaiśvaryasmṛtiḥ puṃsāṃ bhaktiścaiva yayā mayi  || 06.09.047 ||
kiṃ durāpaṃ mayi prīte tathāpi vibudharṣabhāḥ  |
mayyekāntamatirnānyanmatto vāñchati tattvavit || 06.09.048 ||
na veda kṛpaṇaḥ śreya ātmano guṇavastudṛk |

svayaṃ niḥśreyasaṃ vidvānna vaktyajñāya karma hi  |

maghavan yāta bhadraṃ vo dadhyañcamṛṣisattamam  |
vidyāvratatapaḥsāraṃ gātraṃ yācata mā ciram  || 06.09.051 ||

dadhyaṅṅātharvaṇastvaṣṭre varmābhedyaṃ madātmakam  |
viśvarūpāya yatprādāttvaṣṭā yattvamadhāstataḥ  || 06.09.053 ||

yena vṛtraśiro hartā mattejaupabṛṃhitaḥ  || 06.09.054 ||
tasmin vinihate yūyaṃ tejo'strāyudhasampadaḥ  |
bhūyaḥ prāpsyatha bhadraṃ vo na hiṃsanti ca matparān  || 06.09.055 ||
06.10.001|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
indramevaṃ samādiśya bhagavān viśvabhāvanaḥ  |

06.10.005|0 śrīdevā ūcuḥ

06.10.007|0 śrīṛṣiruvāca
dharmaṃ vaḥ śrotukāmena yūyaṃ me pratyudāhṛtāḥ  |

06.10.011|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
evaṃ kṛtavyavasito dadhyaṅṅātharvaṇastanum  |

yatākṣāsumanobuddhistattvadṛgdhvastabandhanaḥ  |

athendro vajramudyamya nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā  |
muneḥ śaktibhirutsikto bhagavattejasānvitaḥ  || 06.10.013 ||

stūyamāno munigaṇaistrailokyaṃ harṣayanniva  || 06.10.014 ||
vṛtramabhyadravacchatrumasurānīkayūthapaiḥ  |
paryastamojasā rājan kruddho rudra ivāntakam  || 06.10.015 ||

rudrairvasubhirādityairaśvibhyāṃ pitṛvahnibhiḥ  |

dṛṣṭvā vajradharaṃ śakraṃ rocamānaṃ svayā śriyā  |

namuciḥ śambaro'narvā dvimūrdhā ṛṣabho'suraḥ  |

pulomā vṛṣaparvā ca prahetirhetirutkalaḥ  |
daiteyā dānavā yakṣā rakṣāṃsi ca sahasraśaḥ  || 06.10.020 ||
sumālimālipramukhāḥ kārtasvaraparicchadāḥ  |
pratiṣidhyendrasenāgraṃ mṛtyorapi durāsadam  || 06.10.021 ||
abhyardayannasambhrāntāḥ siṃhanādena durmadāḥ  |
gadābhiḥ parighairbāṇaiḥ prāsamudgaratomaraiḥ  || 06.10.022 ||
śūlaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ śataghnībhirbhuśuṇḍibhiḥ  |

na te'dṛśyanta sañchannāḥ śarajālaiḥ samantataḥ  |
puṅkhānupuṅkhapatitairjyotīṃṣīva nabhoghanaiḥ  || 06.10.024 ||
na te śastrāstravarṣaughā hyāseduḥ surasainikān  |
chinnāḥ siddhapathe devairlaghuhastaiḥ sahasradhā  || 06.10.025 ||
atha kṣīṇāstraśastraughā giriśṛṅgadrumopalaiḥ  |
abhyavarṣan surabalaṃ cicchidustāṃśca pūrvavat || 06.10.026 ||
tānakṣatān svastimato niśāmya śastrāstrapūgairatha vṛtranāthāḥ  |
drumairdṛṣadbhirvividhādriśṛṅgairavikṣatāṃstatrasurindrasainikān  || 06.10.027 ||
sarve prayāsā abhavan vimoghāḥ kṛtāḥ kṛtā devagaṇeṣu daityaiḥ  |
kṛṣṇānukūleṣu yathā mahatsu kṣudraiḥ prayuktā ūṣatī rūkṣavācaḥ  || 06.10.028 ||
te svaprayāsaṃ vitathaṃ nirīkṣya harāvabhaktā hatayuddhadarpāḥ  |
palāyanāyājimukhe visṛjya patiṃ manaste dadhurāttasārāḥ  || 06.10.029 ||
vṛtro'surāṃstānanugānmanasvī pradhāvataḥ prekṣya babhāṣa etat |
palāyitaṃ prekṣya balaṃ ca bhagnaṃ bhayena tīvreṇa vihasya vīraḥ  || 06.10.030 ||
kālopapannāṃ rucirāṃ manasvināṃ jagāda vācaṃ puruṣapravīraḥ  |
he vipracitte namuce pulomanmayānarvan chambara me śṛṇudhvam  || 06.10.031 ||
jātasya mṛtyurdhruva eva sarvataḥ pratikriyā yasya na ceha kḷptā  |

dvau sammatāviha mṛtyū durāpau yadbrahmasandhāraṇayā jitāsuḥ  |

06.11.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ta evaṃ śaṃsato dharmaṃ vacaḥ patyuracetasaḥ  |
naivāgṛhṇanta sambhrāntāḥ palāyanaparā nṛpa  || 06.11.001 ||
viśīryamāṇāṃ pṛtanāmāsurīmasurarṣabhaḥ  |
kālānukūlaistridaśaiḥ kālyamānāmanāthavat || 06.11.002 ||
dṛṣṭvātapyata saṅkruddha indraśatruramarṣitaḥ  |
tānnivāryaujasā rājannirbhartsyedamuvāca ha  || 06.11.003 ||
kiṃ va uccaritairmāturdhāvadbhiḥ pṛṣṭhato hataiḥ  |

yadi vaḥ pradhane śraddhā sāraṃ vā kṣullakā hṛdi  |

vyanadatsumahāprāṇo yena lokā vicetasaḥ  || 06.11.006 ||

mamarda padbhyāṃ surasainyamāturaṃ nimīlitākṣaṃ raṇaraṅgadurmadaḥ  |

sa indraśatruḥ kupito bhṛśaṃ tayā mahendravāhaṃ gadayoruvikramaḥ  |

airāvato vṛtragadābhimṛṣṭo vighūrṇito'driḥ kuliśāhato yathā  |

na sannavāhāya viṣaṇṇacetase prāyuṅkta bhūyaḥ sa gadāṃ mahātmā  |

06.11.014|0 śrīvṛtra uvāca
diṣṭyā bhavānme samavasthito ripuryo brahmahā guruhā bhrātṛhā ca  |

yo no'grajasyātmavido dvijātergurorapāpasya ca dīkṣitasya  |
viśrabhya khaḍgena śirāṃsyavṛścatpaśorivākaruṇaḥ svargakāmaḥ  || 06.11.015 ||
śrīhrīdayākīrtibhirujjhitaṃ tvāṃ svakarmaṇā puruṣādaiśca garhyam  |

anye'nu ye tveha nṛśaṃsamajñā yadudyatāstrāḥ praharanti mahyam  |

atho hare me kuliśena vīra hartā pramathyaiva śiro yadīha  |

nanveṣa vajrastava śakra tejasā harerdadhīcestapasā ca tejitaḥ  |

traivargikāyāsavighātamasmatpatirvidhatte puruṣasya śakra  |

ajātapakṣā iva mātaraṃ khagāḥ stanyaṃ yathā vatsatarāḥ kṣudhārtāḥ  |

mamottamaślokajaneṣu sakhyaṃ saṃsāracakre bhramataḥ svakarmabhiḥ  |
tvanmāyayātmātmajadārageheṣvāsaktacittasya na nātha bhūyāt || 06.11.027 ||
06.12.001|0 śrīṛṣiruvāca
evaṃ jihāsurnṛpa dehamājau mṛtyuṃ varaṃ vijayānmanyamānaḥ  |
śūlaṃ pragṛhyābhyapatatsurendraṃ yathā mahāpuruṣaṃ kaiṭabho'psu  || 06.12.001 ||
tato yugāntāgnikaṭhorajihvamāvidhya śūlaṃ tarasāsurendraḥ  |

chinnaikabāhuḥ parigheṇa vṛtraḥ saṃrabdha āsādya gṛhītavajram  |

yuyutsatāṃ kutracidātatāyināṃ jayaḥ sadaikatra na vai parātmanām  |

lokāḥ sapālā yasyeme śvasanti vivaśā vaśe  |
dvijā iva śicā baddhāḥ sa kāla iha kāraṇam  || 06.12.008 ||

yathā dārumayī nārī yathā patramayo mṛgaḥ  |

puruṣaḥ prakṛtirvyaktamātmā bhūtendriyāśayāḥ  |

avidvānevamātmānaṃ manyate'nīśamīśvaram  |

tasmādakīrtiyaśasorjayāpajayayorapi  |

sattvaṃ rajastama iti prakṛternātmano guṇāḥ  |

paśya māṃ nirjitaṃ śatru vṛkṇāyudhabhujaṃ mṛdhe  |

prāṇaglaho'yaṃ samara iṣvakṣo vāhanāsanaḥ  |
atra na jñāyate'muṣya jayo'muṣya parājayaḥ  || 06.12.017 ||
06.12.018|0 śrīśuka uvāca
indro vṛtravacaḥ śrutvā gatālīkamapūjayat |

06.12.019|0 indra uvāca
aho dānava siddho'si yasya te matirīdṛśī  |

06.12.023|0 śrīśuka uvāca
iti bruvāṇāvanyonyaṃ dharmajijñāsayā nṛpa  |

nabhogambhīravaktreṇa leliholbaṇajihvayā  |

paro'pyapatyaṃ hitakṛdyathauṣadhaṃ svadehajo'pyāmayavatsuto'hitaḥ  |
chindyāttadaṅgaṃ yadutātmano'hitaṃ śeṣaṃ sukhaṃ jīvati yadvivarjanāt || 07.05.037 ||
sarvairupāyairhantavyaḥ sambhojaśayanāsanaiḥ  |
suhṛlliṅgadharaḥ śatrurmunerduṣṭamivendriyam  || 07.05.038 ||
nairṛtāste samādiṣṭā bhartrā vai śūlapāṇayaḥ  |
tigmadaṃṣṭrakarālāsyāstāmraśmaśruśiroruhāḥ  || 07.05.039 ||
nadanto bhairavaṃ nādaṃ chindhi bhindhīti vādinaḥ  |
āsīnaṃ cāhanan śūlaiḥ prahrādaṃ sarvamarmasu  || 07.05.040 ||
pare brahmaṇyanirdeśye bhagavatyakhilātmani  |
yuktātmanyaphalā āsannapuṇyasyeva satkriyāḥ  || 07.05.041 ||
prayāse'pahate tasmin daityendraḥ pariśaṅkitaḥ  |
cakāra tadvadhopāyānnirbandhena yudhiṣṭhira  || 07.05.042 ||
diggajairdandaśūkendrairabhicārāvapātanaiḥ  |
māyābhiḥ sannirodhaiśca garadānairabhojanaiḥ  || 07.05.043 ||
himavāyvagnisalilaiḥ parvatākramaṇairapi  |
na śaśāka yadā hantumapāpamasuraḥ sutam  |
cintāṃ dīrghatamāṃ prāptastatkartuṃ nābhyapadyata  || 07.05.044 ||
eṣa me bahvasādhūkto vadhopāyāśca nirmitāḥ  |
taistairdrohairasaddharmairmuktaḥ svenaiva tejasā  || 07.05.045 ||
vartamāno'vidūre vai bālo'pyajaḍadhīrayam  |
na vismarati me'nāryaṃ śunaḥ śepa iva prabhuḥ  || 07.05.046 ||
aprameyānubhāvo'yamakutaścidbhayo'maraḥ  |
nūnametadvirodhena mṛtyurme bhavitā na vā  || 07.05.047 ||
iti taccintayā kiñcinmlānaśriyamadhomukham  |
śaṇḍāmarkāvauśanasau vivikta iti hocatuḥ  || 07.05.048 ||
jitaṃ tvayaikena jagattrayaṃ bhruvorvijṛmbhaṇatrastasamastadhiṣṇyapam  |
na tasya cintyaṃ tava nātha cakṣvahe na vai śiśūnāṃ guṇadoṣayoḥ padam  || 07.05.049 ||
imaṃ tu pāśairvaruṇasya baddhvā nidhehi bhīto na palāyate yathā  |
buddhiśca puṃso vayasāryasevayā yāvadgururbhārgava āgamiṣyati  || 07.05.050 ||
tatheti guruputroktamanujñāyedamabravīt |
dharmo hyasyopadeṣṭavyo rājñāṃ yo gṛhamedhinām  || 07.05.051 ||
dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca nitarāṃ cānupūrvaśaḥ  |
prahrādāyocatū rājan praśritāvanatāya ca  || 07.05.052 ||
yathā trivargaṃ gurubhirātmane upaśikṣitam  |
na sādhu mene tacchikṣāṃ dvandvārāmopavarṇitām  || 07.05.053 ||
yadācāryaḥ parāvṛtto gṛhamedhīyakarmasu  |
vayasyairbālakaistatra sopahūtaḥ kṛtakṣaṇaiḥ  || 07.05.054 ||
atha tān ślakṣṇayā vācā pratyāhūya mahābudhaḥ  |
uvāca vidvāṃstanniṣṭhāṃ kṛpayā prahasanniva  || 07.05.055 ||
te tu tadgauravātsarve tyaktakrīḍāparicchadāḥ  |
bālā adūṣitadhiyo dvandvārāmeritehitaiḥ  || 07.05.056 ||
paryupāsata rājendra tannyastahṛdayekṣaṇāḥ  |
tānāha karuṇo maitro mahābhāgavato'suraḥ  || 07.05.057 ||
07.06.001|0 śrīprahrāda uvāca
kaumāra ācaretprājño dharmān bhāgavatāniha  |
durlabhaṃ mānuṣaṃ janma tadapyadhruvamarthadam  || 07.06.001 ||
yathā hi puruṣasyeha viṣṇoḥ pādopasarpaṇam  |
yadeṣa sarvabhūtānāṃ priya ātmeśvaraḥ suhṛt || 07.06.002 ||
sukhamaindriyakaṃ daityā dehayogena dehinām  |
sarvatra labhyate daivādyathā duḥkhamayatnataḥ  || 07.06.003 ||
tatprayāso na kartavyo yata āyurvyayaḥ param  |
na tathā vindate kṣemaṃ mukundacaraṇāmbujam  || 07.06.004 ||
tato yateta kuśalaḥ kṣemāya bhavamāśritaḥ  |
śarīraṃ pauruṣaṃ yāvanna vipadyeta puṣkalam  || 07.06.005 ||
puṃso varṣaśataṃ hyāyustadardhaṃ cājitātmanaḥ  |
niṣphalaṃ yadasau rātryāṃ śete'ndhaṃ prāpitastamaḥ  || 07.06.006 ||
mugdhasya bālye kaiśore krīḍato yāti viṃśatiḥ  |
jarayā grastadehasya yātyakalpasya viṃśatiḥ  || 07.06.007 ||
durāpūreṇa kāmena mohena ca balīyasā  |
śeṣaṃ gṛheṣu saktasya pramattasyāpayāti hi  || 07.06.008 ||
ko gṛheṣu pumān saktamātmānamajitendriyaḥ  |
snehapāśairdṛḍhairbaddhamutsaheta vimocitum  || 07.06.009 ||
ko nvarthatṛṣṇāṃ visṛjetprāṇebhyo'pi ya īpsitaḥ  |
yaṃ krīṇātyasubhiḥ preṣṭhaistaskaraḥ sevako vaṇik || 07.06.010 ||
kathaṃ priyāyā anukampitāyāḥ saṅgaṃ rahasyaṃ rucirāṃśca mantrān  |
suhṛtsu tatsnehasitaḥ śiśūnāṃ kalākṣarāṇāmanuraktacittaḥ  || 07.06.011 ||
putrān smaraṃstā duhitṝrhṛdayyā bhrātṝn svasṝrvā pitarau ca dīnau  |
gṛhānmanojñoruparicchadāṃśca vṛttīśca kulyāḥ paśubhṛtyavargān  || 07.06.012 ||
tyajeta kośaskṛdivehamānaḥ karmāṇi lobhādavitṛptakāmaḥ  |
aupasthyajaihvaṃ bahumanyamānaḥ kathaṃ virajyeta durantamohaḥ  || 07.06.013 ||
kuṭumbapoṣāya viyannijāyurna budhyate'rthaṃ vihataṃ pramattaḥ  |
sarvatra tāpatrayaduḥkhitātmā nirvidyate na svakuṭumbarāmaḥ  || 07.06.014 ||
vitteṣu nityābhiniviṣṭacetā vidvāṃśca doṣaṃ paravittahartuḥ  |
pretyeha vāthāpyajitendriyastadaśāntakāmo harate kuṭumbī  || 07.06.015 ||
vidvānapītthaṃ danujāḥ kuṭumbaṃ puṣṇan svalokāya na kalpate vai  |
yaḥ svīyapārakyavibhinnabhāvastamaḥ prapadyeta yathā vimūḍhaḥ  || 07.06.016 ||
yato na kaścitkva ca kutracidvā dīnaḥ svamātmānamalaṃ samarthaḥ  |
vimocituṃ kāmadṛśāṃ vihāra krīḍāmṛgo yannigaḍo visargaḥ  || 07.06.017 ||
tato vidūrātparihṛtya daityā daityeṣu saṅgaṃ viṣayātmakeṣu  |
upeta nārāyaṇamādidevaṃ sa muktasaṅgairiṣito'pavargaḥ  || 07.06.018 ||
na hyacyutaṃ prīṇayato bahvāyāso'surātmajāḥ  |
ātmatvātsarvabhūtānāṃ siddhatvādiha sarvataḥ  || 07.06.019 ||
parāvareṣu bhūteṣu brahmāntasthāvarādiṣu  |
bhautikeṣu vikāreṣu bhūteṣvatha mahatsu ca  || 07.06.020 ||
guṇeṣu guṇasāmye ca guṇavyatikare tathā  |
eka eva paro hyātmā bhagavānīśvaro'vyayaḥ  || 07.06.021 ||
pratyagātmasvarūpeṇa dṛśyarūpeṇa ca svayam  |
vyāpyavyāpakanirdeśyo hyanirdeśyo'vikalpitaḥ  || 07.06.022 ||
kevalānubhavānanda svarūpaḥ parameśvaraḥ  |
māyayāntarhitaiśvarya īyate guṇasargayā  || 07.06.023 ||
tasmātsarveṣu bhūteṣu dayāṃ kuruta sauhṛdam  |
bhāvamāsuramunmucya yayā tuṣyatyadhokṣajaḥ  || 07.06.024 ||
tuṣṭe ca tatra kimalabhyamananta ādye   kiṃ tairguṇavyatikarādiha ye svasiddhāḥ  |
dharmādayaḥ kimaguṇena ca kāṅkṣitena   sāraṃ juṣāṃ caraṇayorupagāyatāṃ naḥ  || 07.06.025 ||*
dharmārthakāma iti yo'bhihitastrivarga   īkṣā trayī nayadamau vividhā ca vārtā  |
manye tadetadakhilaṃ nigamasya satyaṃ   svātmārpaṇaṃ svasuhṛdaḥ paramasya puṃsaḥ  || 07.06.026 ||*
jñānaṃ tadetadamalaṃ duravāpamāha   nārāyaṇo narasakhaḥ kila nāradāya  |
ekāntināṃ bhagavatastadakiñcanānāṃ   pādāravindarajasāplutadehināṃ syāt || 07.06.027 ||*
śrutametanmayā pūrvaṃ jñānaṃ vijñānasaṃyutam  |
dharmaṃ bhāgavataṃ śuddhaṃ nāradāddevadarśanāt || 07.06.028 ||
07.06.029|0 śrīdaityaputrā ūcuḥ
prahrāda tvaṃ vayaṃ cāpi narte'nyaṃ vidmahe gurum  |
etābhyāṃ guruputrābhyāṃ bālānāmapi hīśvarau  || 07.06.029 ||
bālasyāntaḥpurasthasya mahatsaṅgo duranvayaḥ  |
chindhi naḥ saṃśayaṃ saumya syāccedvisrambhakāraṇam  || 07.06.030 ||
07.07.001|0 śrīnārada uvāca
evaṃ daityasutaiḥ pṛṣṭo mahābhāgavato'suraḥ  |
uvāca tān smayamānaḥ smaranmadanubhāṣitam  || 07.07.001 ||
07.07.002|0 śrīprahrāda uvāca
pitari prasthite'smākaṃ tapase mandarācalam  |
yuddhodyamaṃ paraṃ cakrurvibudhā dānavān prati  || 07.07.002 ||
pipīlikairahiriva diṣṭyā lokopatāpanaḥ  |
pāpena pāpo'bhakṣīti vadanto vāsavādayaḥ  || 07.07.003 ||
teṣāmatibalodyogaṃ niśamyāsurayūthapāḥ  |
vadhyamānāḥ surairbhītā dudruvuḥ sarvato diśam  || 07.07.004 ||
kalatraputravittāptān gṛhān paśuparicchadān  |
nāvekṣyamāṇāstvaritāḥ sarve prāṇaparīpsavaḥ  || 07.07.005 ||
vyalumpan rājaśibiramamarā jayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ  |
indrastu rājamahiṣīṃ mātaraṃ mama cāgrahīt || 07.07.006 ||
nīyamānāṃ bhayodvignāṃ rudatīṃ kurarīmiva  |
yadṛcchayāgatastatra devarṣirdadṛśe pathi  || 07.07.007 ||
prāha naināṃ surapate netumarhasyanāgasam  |
muñca muñca mahābhāga satīṃ paraparigraham  || 07.07.008 ||
07.07.009|0 śrīindra uvāca
āste'syā jaṭhare vīryamaviṣahyaṃ suradviṣaḥ  |
āsyatāṃ yāvatprasavaṃ mokṣye'rthapadavīṃ gataḥ  || 07.07.009 ||
07.07.010|0 śrīnārada uvāca
ayaṃ niṣkilbiṣaḥ sākṣānmahābhāgavato mahān  |
tvayā na prāpsyate saṃsthāmanantānucaro balī  || 07.07.010 ||
ityuktastāṃ vihāyendro devarṣermānayan vacaḥ  |
anantapriyabhaktyaināṃ parikramya divaṃ yayau  || 07.07.011 ||
tato me mātaramṛṣiḥ samānīya nijāśrame  |
āśvāsyehoṣyatāṃ vatse yāvatte bharturāgamaḥ  || 07.07.012 ||
tathetyavātsīddevarṣerantike sākutobhayā  |
yāvaddaityapatirghorāttapaso na nyavartata  || 07.07.013 ||
ṛṣiṃ paryacarattatra bhaktyā paramayā satī  |
antarvatnī svagarbhasya kṣemāyecchāprasūtaye  || 07.07.014 ||
ṛṣiḥ kāruṇikastasyāḥ prādādubhayamīśvaraḥ  |
dharmasya tattvaṃ jñānaṃ ca māmapyuddiśya nirmalam  || 07.07.015 ||
tattu kālasya dīrghatvātstrītvānmātustirodadhe  |
ṛṣiṇānugṛhītaṃ māṃ nādhunāpyajahātsmṛtiḥ  || 07.07.016 ||
bhavatāmapi bhūyānme yadi śraddadhate vacaḥ  |
vaiśāradī dhīḥ śraddhātaḥ strībālānāṃ ca me yathā  || 07.07.017 ||
janmādyāḥ ṣaḍime bhāvā dṛṣṭā dehasya nātmanaḥ  |
phalānāmiva vṛkṣasya kāleneśvaramūrtinā  || 07.07.018 ||
ātmā nityo'vyayaḥ śuddha ekaḥ kṣetrajña āśrayaḥ  |
avikriyaḥ svadṛgheturvyāpako'saṅgyanāvṛtaḥ  || 07.07.019 ||
etairdvādaśabhirvidvānātmano lakṣaṇaiḥ paraiḥ  |
ahaṃ mametyasadbhāvaṃ dehādau mohajaṃ tyajet || 07.07.020 ||
svarṇaṃ yathā grāvasu hemakāraḥ kṣetreṣu yogaistadabhijña āpnuyāt |
kṣetreṣu deheṣu tathātmayogairadhyātmavidbrahmagatiṃ labheta  || 07.07.021 ||
aṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ proktāstraya eva hi tadguṇāḥ  |
vikārāḥ ṣoḍaśācāryaiḥ pumānekaḥ samanvayāt || 07.07.022 ||
dehastu sarvasaṅghāto jagattasthuriti dvidhā  |
atraiva mṛgyaḥ puruṣo neti netītyatattyajan  || 07.07.023 ||
anvayavyatirekeṇa vivekenośatātmanā  |
svargasthānasamāmnāyairvimṛśadbhirasatvaraiḥ  || 07.07.024 ||
buddherjāgaraṇaṃ svapnaḥ suṣuptiriti vṛttayaḥ  |
tā yenaivānubhūyante so'dhyakṣaḥ puruṣaḥ paraḥ  || 07.07.025 ||
ebhistrivarṇaiḥ paryastairbuddhibhedaiḥ kriyodbhavaiḥ  |
svarūpamātmano budhyedgandhairvāyumivānvayāt || 07.07.026 ||
etaddvāro hi saṃsāro guṇakarmanibandhanaḥ  |
ajñānamūlo'pārtho'pi puṃsaḥ svapna ivārpyate  || 07.07.027 ||
tasmādbhavadbhiḥ kartavyaṃ karmaṇāṃ triguṇātmanām  |
bījanirharaṇaṃ yogaḥ pravāhoparamo dhiyaḥ  || 07.07.028 ||
tatropāyasahasrāṇāmayaṃ bhagavatoditaḥ  |
yadīśvare bhagavati yathā yairañjasā ratiḥ  || 07.07.029 ||
guruśuśrūṣayā bhaktyā sarvalabdhārpaṇena ca  |
saṅgena sādhubhaktānāmīśvarārādhanena ca  || 07.07.030 ||
śraddhayā tatkathāyāṃ ca kīrtanairguṇakarmaṇām  |
tatpādāmburuhadhyānāttalliṅgekṣārhaṇādibhiḥ  || 07.07.031 ||
hariḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu bhagavānāsta īśvaraḥ  |
iti bhūtāni manasā kāmaistaiḥ sādhu mānayet || 07.07.032 ||
evaṃ nirjitaṣaḍvargaiḥ kriyate bhaktirīśvare  |
vāsudeve bhagavati yayā saṃlabhyate ratiḥ  || 07.07.033 ||
niśamya karmāṇi guṇānatulyān vīryāṇi līlātanubhiḥ kṛtāni  |
yadātiharṣotpulakāśrugadgadaṃ protkaṇṭha udgāyati rauti nṛtyati  || 07.07.034 ||
yadā grahagrasta iva kvaciddhasatyākrandate dhyāyati vandate janam  |
muhuḥ śvasan vakti hare jagatpate nārāyaṇetyātmamatirgatatrapaḥ  || 07.07.035 ||
tadā pumānmuktasamastabandhanastadbhāvabhāvānukṛtāśayākṛtiḥ  |
nirdagdhabījānuśayo mahīyasā bhaktiprayogeṇa sametyadhokṣajam  || 07.07.036 ||
adhokṣajālambhamihāśubhātmanaḥ śarīriṇaḥ saṃsṛticakraśātanam  |
tadbrahmanirvāṇasukhaṃ vidurbudhāstato bhajadhvaṃ hṛdaye hṛdīśvaram  || 07.07.037 ||
ko'tiprayāso'surabālakā harerupāsane sve hṛdi chidravatsataḥ  |
svasyātmanaḥ sakhyuraśeṣadehināṃ sāmānyataḥ kiṃ viṣayopapādanaiḥ  || 07.07.038 ||
rāyaḥ kalatraṃ paśavaḥ sutādayo gṛhā mahī kuñjarakośabhūtayaḥ  |
sarve'rthakāmāḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgurāyuṣaḥ kurvanti martyasya kiyatpriyaṃ calāḥ  || 07.07.039 ||
evaṃ hi lokāḥ kratubhiḥ kṛtā amī kṣayiṣṇavaḥ sātiśayā na nirmalāḥ  |
tasmādadṛṣṭaśrutadūṣaṇaṃ paraṃ bhaktyoktayeśaṃ bhajatātmalabdhaye  || 07.07.040 ||
yadartha iha karmāṇi vidvanmānyasakṛnnaraḥ  |
karotyato viparyāsamamoghaṃ vindate phalam  || 07.07.041 ||
sukhāya duḥkhamokṣāya saṅkalpa iha karmiṇaḥ  |
sadāpnotīhayā duḥkhamanīhāyāḥ sukhāvṛtaḥ  || 07.07.042 ||
kāmān kāmayate kāmyairyadarthamiha pūruṣaḥ  |
sa vai dehastu pārakyo bhaṅguro yātyupaiti ca  || 07.07.043 ||
kimu vyavahitāpatya dārāgāradhanādayaḥ  |
rājyakośagajāmātya bhṛtyāptā mamatāspadāḥ  || 07.07.044 ||
kimetairātmanastucchaiḥ saha dehena naśvaraiḥ  |
anarthairarthasaṅkāśairnityānandarasodadheḥ  || 07.07.045 ||
nirūpyatāmiha svārthaḥ kiyān dehabhṛto'surāḥ  |
niṣekādiṣvavasthāsu kliśyamānasya karmabhiḥ  || 07.07.046 ||
karmāṇyārabhate dehī dehenātmānuvartinā  |
karmabhistanute dehamubhayaṃ tvavivekataḥ  || 07.07.047 ||
tasmādarthāśca kāmāśca dharmāśca yadapāśrayāḥ  |
bhajatānīhayātmānamanīhaṃ harimīśvaram  || 07.07.048 ||
sarveṣāmapi bhūtānāṃ harirātmeśvaraḥ priyaḥ  |
bhūtairmahadbhiḥ svakṛtaiḥ kṛtānāṃ jīvasaṃjñitaḥ  || 07.07.049 ||
devo'suro manuṣyo vā yakṣo gandharva eva vā  |
bhajanmukundacaraṇaṃ svastimān syādyathā vayam  || 07.07.050 ||
nālaṃ dvijatvaṃ devatvamṛṣitvaṃ vāsurātmajāḥ  |
prīṇanāya mukundasya na vṛttaṃ na bahujñatā  || 07.07.051 ||
na dānaṃ na tapo nejyā na śaucaṃ na vratāni ca  |
prīyate'malayā bhaktyā hariranyadviḍambanam  || 07.07.052 ||
tato harau bhagavati bhaktiṃ kuruta dānavāḥ  |
ātmaupamyena sarvatra sarvabhūtātmanīśvare  || 07.07.053 ||
daiteyā yakṣarakṣāṃsi striyaḥ śūdrā vrajaukasaḥ  |
khagā mṛgāḥ pāpajīvāḥ santi hyacyutatāṃ gatāḥ  || 07.07.054 ||
etāvāneva loke'smin puṃsaḥ svārthaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ  |
ekāntabhaktirgovinde yatsarvatra tadīkṣaṇam  || 07.07.055 ||
07.08.001|0 śrīnārada uvāca
atha daityasutāḥ sarve śrutvā tadanuvarṇitam  |
jagṛhurniravadyatvānnaiva gurvanuśikṣitam  || 07.08.001 ||
athācāryasutasteṣāṃ buddhimekāntasaṃsthitām  |
ālakṣya bhītastvarito rājña āvedayadyathā  || 07.08.002 ||
śrutvā tadapriyaṃ daityo duḥsahaṃ tanayānayam  |
kopāveśacaladgātraḥ putraṃ hantuṃ mano dadhe  || 07.08.003 ||
kṣiptvā paruṣayā vācā prahrādamatadarhaṇam  |
āhekṣamāṇaḥ pāpena tiraścīnena cakṣuṣā  || 07.08.004 ||
praśrayāvanataṃ dāntaṃ baddhāñjalimavasthitam  |
sarpaḥ padāhata iva śvasan prakṛtidāruṇaḥ  || 07.08.005 ||
07.08.006|0 śrīhiraṇyakaśipuruvāca
he durvinīta mandātman kulabhedakarādhama  |
stabdhaṃ macchāsanodvṛttaṃ neṣye tvādya yamakṣayam  || 07.08.006 ||
kruddhasya yasya kampante trayo lokāḥ saheśvarāḥ  |
tasya me'bhītavanmūḍha śāsanaṃ kiṃ balo'tyagāḥ  || 07.08.007 ||
07.08.008|0 śrīprahrāda uvāca
na kevalaṃ me bhavataśca rājan sa vai balaṃ balināṃ cāpareṣām  |
pare'vare'mī sthirajaṅgamā ye brahmādayo yena vaśaṃ praṇītāḥ  || 07.08.008 ||
sa īśvaraḥ kāla urukramo'sāvojaḥ sahaḥ sattvabalendriyātmā  |
sa eva viśvaṃ paramaḥ svaśaktibhiḥ sṛjatyavatyatti guṇatrayeśaḥ  || 07.08.009 ||
jahyāsuraṃ bhāvamimaṃ tvamātmanaḥ samaṃ mano dhatsva na santi vidviṣaḥ  |
ṛte'jitādātmana utpathe sthitāttaddhi hyanantasya mahatsamarhaṇam  || 07.08.010 ||
dasyūn purā ṣaṇna vijitya lumpato manyanta eke svajitā diśo daśa  |
jitātmano jñasya samasya dehināṃ sādhoḥ svamohaprabhavāḥ kutaḥ pare  || 07.08.011 ||
07.08.012|0 śrīhiraṇyakaśipuruvāca
vyaktaṃ tvaṃ martukāmo'si yo'timātraṃ vikatthase  |
mumūrṣūṇāṃ hi mandātmannanu syurviklavā giraḥ  || 07.08.012 ||
yastvayā mandabhāgyokto madanyo jagadīśvaraḥ  |
kvāsau yadi sa sarvatra kasmātstambhe na dṛśyate  || 07.08.013 ||
so'haṃ vikatthamānasya śiraḥ kāyāddharāmi te  |
gopāyeta haristvādya yaste śaraṇamīpsitam  || 07.08.014 ||
evaṃ duruktairmuhurardayan ruṣā sutaṃ mahābhāgavataṃ mahāsuraḥ  |
khaḍgaṃ pragṛhyotpatito varāsanātstambhaṃ tatāḍātibalaḥ svamuṣṭinā  || 07.08.015 ||
tadaiva tasminninado'tibhīṣaṇo babhūva yenāṇḍakaṭāhamasphuṭat |
yaṃ vai svadhiṣṇyopagataṃ tvajādayaḥ śrutvā svadhāmātyayamaṅga menire  || 07.08.016 ||
sa vikraman putravadhepsurojasā niśamya nirhrādamapūrvamadbhutam  |
antaḥsabhāyāṃ na dadarśa tatpadaṃ vitatrasuryena surāriyūthapāḥ  || 07.08.017 ||
satyaṃ vidhātuṃ nijabhṛtyabhāṣitaṃ vyāptiṃ ca bhūteṣvakhileṣu cātmanaḥ  |
adṛśyatātyadbhutarūpamudvahan stambhe sabhāyāṃ na mṛgaṃ na mānuṣam  || 07.08.018 ||
sa sattvamenaṃ parito vipaśyan stambhasya madhyādanunirjihānam  |
nāyaṃ mṛgo nāpi naro vicitramaho kimetannṛmṛgendrarūpam  || 07.08.019 ||
mīmāṃsamānasya samutthito'grato nṛsiṃharūpastadalaṃ bhayānakam  |
prataptacāmīkaracaṇḍalocanaṃ sphuratsaṭākeśarajṛmbhitānanam  || 07.08.020 ||
karāladaṃṣṭraṃ karavālacañcala kṣurāntajihvaṃ bhrukuṭīmukholbaṇam  |
stabdhordhvakarṇaṃ girikandarādbhuta vyāttāsyanāsaṃ hanubhedabhīṣaṇam  || 07.08.021 ||
divispṛśatkāyamadīrghapīvara grīvoruvakṣaḥsthalamalpamadhyamam  |
candrāṃśugauraiśchuritaṃ tanūruhairviṣvagbhujānīkaśataṃ nakhāyudham  || 07.08.022 ||
durāsadaṃ sarvanijetarāyudha pravekavidrāvitadaityadānavam  |
prāyeṇa me'yaṃ hariṇorumāyinā vadhaḥ smṛto'nena samudyatena kim  || 07.08.023 ||
evaṃ bruvaṃstvabhyapatadgadāyudho nadannṛsiṃhaṃ prati daityakuñjaraḥ  |
alakṣito'gnau patitaḥ pataṅgamo yathā nṛsiṃhaujasi so'surastadā  || 07.08.024 ||
na tadvicitraṃ khalu sattvadhāmani svatejasā yo nu purāpibattamaḥ  |
tato'bhipadyābhyahananmahāsuro ruṣā nṛsiṃhaṃ gadayoruvegayā  || 07.08.025 ||
taṃ vikramantaṃ sagadaṃ gadādharo mahoragaṃ tārkṣyasuto yathāgrahīt |
sa tasya hastotkalitastadāsuro vikrīḍato yadvadahirgarutmataḥ  || 07.08.026 ||
asādhvamanyanta hṛtaukaso'marā ghanacchadā bhārata sarvadhiṣṇyapāḥ  |
taṃ manyamāno nijavīryaśaṅkitaṃ yaddhastamukto nṛhariṃ mahāsuraḥ  |
punastamāsajjata khaḍgacarmaṇī pragṛhya vegena gataśramo mṛdhe  || 07.08.027 ||
taṃ śyenavegaṃ śatacandravartmabhiścarantamacchidramuparyadho hariḥ  |
kṛtvāṭṭahāsaṃ kharamutsvanolbaṇaṃ nimīlitākṣaṃ jagṛhe mahājavaḥ  || 07.08.028 ||
viṣvaksphurantaṃ grahaṇāturaṃ harirvyālo yathākhuṃ kuliśākṣatatvacam  |
dvāryūrumāpatya dadāra līlayā nakhairyathāhiṃ garuḍo mahāviṣam  || 07.08.029 ||
saṃrambhaduṣprekṣyakarālalocano vyāttānanāntaṃ vilihan svajihvayā  |
asṛglavāktāruṇakeśarānano yathāntramālī dvipahatyayā hariḥ  || 07.08.030 ||
nakhāṅkurotpāṭitahṛtsaroruhaṃ visṛjya tasyānucarānudāyudhān  |
ahan samastānnakhaśastrapāṇibhirdordaṇḍayūtho'nupathān sahasraśaḥ  || 07.08.031 ||
saṭāvadhūtā jaladāḥ parāpatan grahāśca taddṛṣṭivimuṣṭarociṣaḥ  |
ambhodhayaḥ śvāsahatā vicukṣubhurnirhrādabhītā digibhā vicukruśuḥ  || 07.08.032 ||
dyaustatsaṭotkṣiptavimānasaṅkulā protsarpata kṣmā ca padābhipīḍitā  |
śailāḥ samutpeturamuṣya raṃhasā tattejasā khaṃ kakubho na rejire  || 07.08.033 ||
tataḥ sabhāyāmupaviṣṭamuttame nṛpāsane sambhṛtatejasaṃ vibhum  |
alakṣitadvairathamatyamarṣaṇaṃ pracaṇḍavaktraṃ na babhāja kaścana  || 07.08.034 ||
niśāmya lokatrayamastakajvaraṃ tamādidaityaṃ hariṇā hataṃ mṛdhe  |
praharṣavegotkalitānanā muhuḥ prasūnavarṣairvavṛṣuḥ surastriyaḥ  || 07.08.035 ||
tadā vimānāvalibhirnabhastalaṃ didṛkṣatāṃ saṅkulamāsa nākinām  |
surānakā dundubhayo'tha jaghnire gandharvamukhyā nanṛturjaguḥ striyaḥ  || 07.08.036 ||
tatropavrajya vibudhā brahmendragiriśādayaḥ  |
ṛṣayaḥ pitaraḥ siddhā vidyādharamahoragāḥ  || 07.08.037 ||
manavaḥ prajānāṃ patayo gandharvāpsaracāraṇāḥ  |
yakṣāḥ kimpuruṣāstāta vetālāḥ sahakinnarāḥ  || 07.08.038 ||
te viṣṇupārṣadāḥ sarve sunandakumudādayaḥ  |
mūrdhni baddhāñjalipuṭā āsīnaṃ tīvratejasam  |
īḍire naraśārdulaṃ nātidūracarāḥ pṛthak || 07.08.039 ||
07.08.040|0 śrībrahmovāca
nato'smyanantāya durantaśaktaye vicitravīryāya pavitrakarmaṇe  |
viśvasya sargasthitisaṃyamān guṇaiḥ svalīlayā sandadhate'vyayātmane  || 07.08.040 ||
07.08.041|0 śrīrudra uvāca
kopakālo yugāntaste hato'yamasuro'lpakaḥ  |
tatsutaṃ pāhyupasṛtaṃ bhaktaṃ te bhaktavatsala  || 07.08.041 ||
07.08.042|0 śrīindra uvāca
pratyānītāḥ parama bhavatā trāyatā naḥ svabhāgā   daityākrāntaṃ hṛdayakamalaṃ tadgṛhaṃ pratyabodhi  |
kālagrastaṃ kiyadidamaho nātha śuśrūṣatāṃ te   muktisteṣāṃ na hi bahumatā nārasiṃhāparaiḥ kim  || 07.08.042 ||*
07.08.043|0 śrīṛṣaya ūcuḥ
tvaṃ nastapaḥ paramamāttha yadātmatejo   yenedamādipuruṣātmagataṃ sasarktha  |
tadvipraluptamamunādya śaraṇyapāla   rakṣāgṛhītavapuṣā punaranvamaṃsthāḥ  || 07.08.043 ||*
07.08.044|0 śrīpitara ūcuḥ
śrāddhāni no'dhibubhuje prasabhaṃ tanūjair  dattāni tīrthasamaye'pyapibattilāmbu  |
tasyodarānnakhavidīrṇavapādya ārcchat  tasmai namo nṛharaye'khiladharmagoptre  || 07.08.044 ||*
07.08.045|0 śrīsiddhā ūcuḥ
yo no gatiṃ yogasiddhāmasādhurahārṣīdyogatapobalena  |
nānā darpaṃ taṃ nakhairvidadāra tasmai tubhyaṃ praṇatāḥ smo nṛsiṃha  || 07.08.045 ||
07.08.046|0 śrīvidyādharā ūcuḥ
vidyāṃ pṛthagdhāraṇayānurāddhāṃ nyaṣedhadajño balavīryadṛptaḥ  |
sa yena saṅkhye paśuvaddhatastaṃ māyānṛsiṃhaṃ praṇatāḥ sma nityam  || 07.08.046 ||
07.08.047|0 śrīnāgā ūcuḥ
yena pāpena ratnāni strīratnāni hṛtāni naḥ  |
tadvakṣaḥpāṭanenāsāṃ dattānanda namo'stu te  || 07.08.047 ||
07.08.048|0 śrīmanava ūcuḥ
manavo vayaṃ tava nideśakāriṇo ditijena deva paribhūtasetavaḥ  |
bhavatā khalaḥ sa upasaṃhṛtaḥ prabho karavāma te kimanuśādhi kiṅkarān  || 07.08.048 ||
07.08.049|0 śrīprajāpataya ūcuḥ
prajeśā vayaṃ te pareśābhisṛṣṭā na yena prajā vai sṛjāmo niṣiddhāḥ  |
sa eṣa tvayā bhinnavakṣā nu śete jaganmaṅgalaṃ sattvamūrte'vatāraḥ  || 07.08.049 ||
07.08.050|0 śrīgandharvā ūcuḥ
vayaṃ vibho te naṭanāṭyagāyakā yenātmasādvīryabalaujasā kṛtāḥ  |
sa eṣa nīto bhavatā daśāmimāṃ kimutpathasthaḥ kuśalāya kalpate  || 07.08.050 ||
07.08.051|0 śrīcāraṇā ūcuḥ
hare tavāṅghripaṅkajaṃ bhavāpavargamāśritāḥ  |

07.08.052|0 śrīyakṣā ūcuḥ
vayamanucaramukhyāḥ karmabhiste manojñais  ta iha ditisutena prāpitā vāhakatvam  |
sa tu janaparitāpaṃ tatkṛtaṃ jānatā te   narahara upanītaḥ pañcatāṃ pañcaviṃśa  || 07.08.052 ||*

vayaṃ kimpuruṣāstvaṃ tu mahāpuruṣa īśvaraḥ  |

sabhāsu satreṣu tavāmalaṃ yaśo gītvā saparyāṃ mahatīṃ labhāmahe  |

adyaitaddharinararūpamadbhutaṃ te dṛṣṭaṃ naḥ śaraṇada sarvalokaśarma  |

07.09.001|0 śrīnārada uvāca
evaṃ surādayaḥ sarve brahmarudrapuraḥ sarāḥ  |
nopaitumaśakanmanyu saṃrambhaṃ sudurāsadam  || 07.09.001 ||
sākṣātśrīḥ preṣitā devairdṛṣṭvā taṃ mahadadbhutam  |
adṛṣṭāśrutapūrvatvātsā nopeyāya śaṅkitā  || 07.09.002 ||
prahrādaṃ preṣayāmāsa brahmāvasthitamantike  |
tāta praśamayopehi svapitre kupitaṃ prabhum  || 07.09.003 ||
tatheti śanakai rājanmahābhāgavato'rbhakaḥ  |
upetya bhuvi kāyena nanāma vidhṛtāñjaliḥ  || 07.09.004 ||
svapādamūle patitaṃ tamarbhakaṃ vilokya devaḥ kṛpayā pariplutaḥ  |
utthāpya tacchīrṣṇyadadhātkarāmbujaṃ kālāhivitrastadhiyāṃ kṛtābhayam  || 07.09.005 ||
sa tatkarasparśadhutākhilāśubhaḥ sapadyabhivyaktaparātmadarśanaḥ  |
tatpādapadmaṃ hṛdi nirvṛto dadhau hṛṣyattanuḥ klinnahṛdaśrulocanaḥ  || 07.09.006 ||
astauṣīddharimekāgra manasā susamāhitaḥ  |
premagadgadayā vācā tannyastahṛdayekṣaṇaḥ  || 07.09.007 ||
07.09.008|0 śrīprahrāda uvāca
brahmādayaḥ suragaṇā munayo'tha siddhāḥ   sattvaikatānagatayo vacasāṃ pravāhaiḥ  |
nārādhituṃ puruguṇairadhunāpi pipruḥ   kiṃ toṣṭumarhati sa me harirugrajāteḥ  || 07.09.008 ||*
manye dhanābhijanarūpatapaḥśrutaujas  tejaḥprabhāvabalapauruṣabuddhiyogāḥ  |
nārādhanāya hi bhavanti parasya puṃso   bhaktyā tutoṣa bhagavān gajayūthapāya  || 07.09.009 ||*
viprāddviṣaḍguṇayutādaravindanābha   pādāravindavimukhātśvapacaṃ variṣṭham  |
manye tadarpitamanovacanehitārtha   prāṇaṃ punāti sa kulaṃ na tu bhūrimānaḥ  || 07.09.010 ||*
naivātmanaḥ prabhurayaṃ nijalābhapūrṇo   mānaṃ janādaviduṣaḥ karuṇo vṛṇīte  |
yadyajjano bhagavate vidadhīta mānaṃ   taccātmane pratimukhasya yathā mukhaśrīḥ  || 07.09.011 ||*
tasmādahaṃ vigataviklava īśvarasya   sarvātmanā mahi gṛṇāmi yathā manīṣam  |
nīco'jayā guṇavisargamanupraviṣṭaḥ   pūyeta yena hi pumānanuvarṇitena  || 07.09.012 ||*
sarve hyamī vidhikarāstava sattvadhāmno   brahmādayo vayamiveśa na codvijantaḥ  |
kṣemāya bhūtaya utātmasukhāya cāsya   vikrīḍitaṃ bhagavato rucirāvatāraiḥ  || 07.09.013 ||*
tadyaccha manyumasuraśca hatastvayādya   modeta sādhurapi vṛścikasarpahatyā  |
lokāśca nirvṛtimitāḥ pratiyanti sarve   rūpaṃ nṛsiṃha vibhayāya janāḥ smaranti  || 07.09.014 ||*
nāhaṃ bibhemyajita te'tibhayānakāsya   jihvārkanetrabhrukuṭīrabhasogradaṃṣṭrāt |
āntrasrajaḥkṣatajakeśaraśaṅkukarṇān   nirhrādabhītadigibhādaribhinnakhāgrāt || 07.09.015 ||*
trasto'smyahaṃ kṛpaṇavatsala duḥsahogra   saṃsāracakrakadanādgrasatāṃ praṇītaḥ  |
baddhaḥ svakarmabhiruśattama te'ṅghrimūlaṃ   prīto'pavargaśaraṇaṃ hvayase kadā nu  || 07.09.016 ||*
yasmātpriyāpriyaviyogasaṃyogajanma   śokāgninā sakalayoniṣu dahyamānaḥ  |
duḥkhauṣadhaṃ tadapi duḥkhamataddhiyāhaṃ   bhūman bhramāmi vada me tava dāsyayogam  || 07.09.017 ||*
so'haṃ priyasya suhṛdaḥ paradevatāyā   līlākathāstava nṛsiṃha viriñcagītāḥ  |
añjastitarmyanugṛṇan guṇavipramukto   durgāṇi te padayugālayahaṃsasaṅgaḥ  || 07.09.018 ||*
bālasya neha śaraṇaṃ pitarau nṛsiṃha   nārtasya cāgadamudanvati majjato nauḥ  |
taptasya tatpratividhirya ihāñjaseṣṭas  tāvadvibho tanubhṛtāṃ tvadupekṣitānām  || 07.09.019 ||*
yasmin yato yarhi yena ca yasya yasmād  yasmai yathā yaduta yastvaparaḥ paro vā  |
bhāvaḥ karoti vikaroti pṛthaksvabhāvaḥ   sañcoditastadakhilaṃ bhavataḥ svarūpam  || 07.09.020 ||*
māyā manaḥ sṛjati karmamayaṃ balīyaḥ   kālena coditaguṇānumatena puṃsaḥ  |
chandomayaṃ yadajayārpitaṣoḍaśāraṃ   saṃsāracakramaja ko'titarettvadanyaḥ  || 07.09.021 ||*
sa tvaṃ hi nityavijitātmaguṇaḥ svadhāmnā   kālo vaśīkṛtavisṛjyavisargaśaktiḥ  |
cakre visṛṣṭamajayeśvara ṣoḍaśāre   niṣpīḍyamānamupakarṣa vibho prapannam  || 07.09.022 ||*
dṛṣṭā mayā divi vibho'khiladhiṣṇyapānām   āyuḥ śriyo vibhava icchati yān jano'yam  |
ye'smatpituḥ kupitahāsavijṛmbhitabhrū   visphūrjitena lulitāḥ sa tu te nirastaḥ  || 07.09.023 ||*
tasmādamūstanubhṛtāmahamāśiṣo'jña   āyuḥ śriyaṃ vibhavamaindriyamāviriñcyāt |
necchāmi te vilulitānuruvikrameṇa   kālātmanopanaya māṃ nijabhṛtyapārśvam  || 07.09.024 ||*
kutrāśiṣaḥ śrutisukhā mṛgatṛṣṇirūpāḥ   kvedaṃ kalevaramaśeṣarujāṃ virohaḥ  |
nirvidyate na tu jano yadapīti vidvān   kāmānalaṃ madhulavaiḥ śamayan durāpaiḥ  || 07.09.025 ||*
kvāhaṃ rajaḥprabhava īśa tamo'dhike'smin   jātaḥ suretarakule kva tavānukampā  |
na brahmaṇo na tu bhavasya na vai ramāyā   yanme'rpitaḥ śirasi padmakaraḥ prasādaḥ  || 07.09.026 ||*
naiṣā parāvaramatirbhavato nanu syāj  jantoryathātmasuhṛdo jagatastathāpi  |
saṃsevayā surataroriva te prasādaḥ   sevānurūpamudayo na parāvaratvam  || 07.09.027 ||*
evaṃ janaṃ nipatitaṃ prabhavāhikūpe   kāmābhikāmamanu yaḥ prapatan prasaṅgāt |
kṛtvātmasātsurarṣiṇā bhagavan gṛhītaḥ   so'haṃ kathaṃ nu visṛje tava bhṛtyasevām  || 07.09.028 ||*
matprāṇarakṣaṇamananta piturvadhaśca   manye svabhṛtyaṛṣivākyamṛtaṃ vidhātum  |
khaḍgaṃ pragṛhya yadavocadasadvidhitsus  tvāmīśvaro madaparo'vatu kaṃ harāmi  || 07.09.029 ||*
ekastvameva jagadetamamuṣya yattvam   ādyantayoḥ pṛthagavasyasi madhyataśca  |
sṛṣṭvā guṇavyatikaraṃ nijamāyayedaṃ   nāneva tairavasitastadanupraviṣṭaḥ  || 07.09.030 ||*
tvamvā idaṃ sadasadīśa bhavāṃstato'nyo   māyā yadātmaparabuddhiriyaṃ hyapārthā  |
yadyasya janma nidhanaṃ sthitirīkṣaṇaṃ ca   tadvaitadeva vasukālavadaṣṭitarvoḥ  || 07.09.031 ||*
nyasyedamātmani jagadvilayāmbumadhye   śeṣetmanā nijasukhānubhavo nirīhaḥ  |
yogena mīlitadṛgātmanipītanidras  turye sthito na tu tamo na guṇāṃśca yuṅkṣe  || 07.09.032 ||*
tasyaiva te vapuridaṃ nijakālaśaktyā   sañcoditaprakṛtidharmaṇa ātmagūḍham  |
ambhasyanantaśayanādviramatsamādher  nābherabhūtsvakaṇikāvaṭavanmahābjam  || 07.09.033 ||*
tatsambhavaḥ kavirato'nyadapaśyamānas  tvāṃ bījamātmani tataṃ sa bahirvicintya  |
nāvindadabdaśatamapsu nimajjamāno   jāte'ṅkure kathamuhopalabheta bījam  || 07.09.034 ||*
sa tvātmayonirativismita āśrito'bjaṃ   kālena tīvratapasā pariśuddhabhāvaḥ  |
tvāmātmanīśa bhuvi gandhamivātisūkṣmaṃ   bhūtendriyāśayamaye vitataṃ dadarśa  || 07.09.035 ||*
evaṃ sahasravadanāṅghriśiraḥkaroru   nāsādyakarṇanayanābharaṇāyudhāḍhyam  |
māyāmayaṃ sadupalakṣitasanniveśaṃ   dṛṣṭvā mahāpuruṣamāpa mudaṃ viriñcaḥ  || 07.09.036 ||*
tasmai bhavān hayaśirastanuvaṃ hi bibhrad  vedadruhāvatibalau madhukaiṭabhākhyau  |
hatvānayacchrutigaṇāṃśca rajastamaśca   sattvaṃ tava priyatamāṃ tanumāmananti  || 07.09.037 ||*
itthaṃ nṛtiryagṛṣidevajhaṣāvatārair  lokān vibhāvayasi haṃsi jagatpratīpān  |
dharmaṃ mahāpuruṣa pāsi yugānuvṛttaṃ   channaḥ kalau yadabhavastriyugo'tha sa tvam  || 07.09.038 ||*
naitanmanastava kathāsu vikuṇṭhanātha   samprīyate duritaduṣṭamasādhu tīvram  |
kāmāturaṃ harṣaśokabhayaiṣaṇārtaṃ   tasmin kathaṃ tava gatiṃ vimṛśāmi dīnaḥ  || 07.09.039 ||*
jihvaikato'cyuta vikarṣati māvitṛptā   śiśno'nyatastvagudaraṃ śravaṇaṃ kutaścit |
ghrāṇo'nyataścapaladṛkkva ca karmaśaktir  bahvyaḥ sapatnya iva gehapatiṃ lunanti  || 07.09.040 ||*
evaṃ svakarmapatitaṃ bhavavaitaraṇyām   anyonyajanmamaraṇāśanabhītabhītam  |
paśyan janaṃ svaparavigrahavairamaitraṃ   hanteti pāracara pīpṛhi mūḍhamadya  || 07.09.041 ||*
ko nvatra te'khilaguro bhagavan prayāsa   uttāraṇe'sya bhavasambhavalopahetoḥ  |
mūḍheṣu vai mahadanugraha ārtabandho   kiṃ tena te priyajanānanusevatāṃ naḥ  || 07.09.042 ||*
naivodvije para duratyayavaitaraṇyās  tvadvīryagāyanamahāmṛtamagnacittaḥ  |
śoce tato vimukhacetasa indriyārtha   māyāsukhāya bharamudvahato vimūḍhān  || 07.09.043 ||*
prāyeṇa deva munayaḥ svavimuktikāmā   maunaṃ caranti vijane na parārthaniṣṭhāḥ  |
naitān vihāya kṛpaṇān vimumukṣa eko   nānyaṃ tvadasya śaraṇaṃ bhramato'nupaśye  || 07.09.044 ||*
yanmaithunādigṛhamedhisukhaṃ hi tucchaṃ   kaṇḍūyanena karayoriva duḥkhaduḥkham  |
tṛpyanti neha kṛpaṇā bahuduḥkhabhājaḥ   kaṇḍūtivanmanasijaṃ viṣaheta dhīraḥ  || 07.09.045 ||*
maunavrataśrutatapo'dhyayanasvadharma   vyākhyārahojapasamādhaya āpavargyāḥ  |
prāyaḥ paraṃ puruṣa te tvajitendriyāṇāṃ   vārtā bhavantyuta na vātra tu dāmbhikānām  || 07.09.046 ||*
rūpe ime sadasatī tava vedasṛṣṭe   bījāṅkurāviva na cānyadarūpakasya  |
yuktāḥ samakṣamubhayatra vicakṣante tvāṃ   yogena vahnimiva dāruṣu nānyataḥ syāt || 07.09.047 ||*
tvaṃ vāyuragniravanirviyadambu mātrāḥ   prāṇendriyāṇi hṛdayaṃ cidanugrahaśca  |
sarvaṃ tvameva saguṇo viguṇaśca bhūman   nānyattvadastyapi manovacasā niruktam  || 07.09.048 ||*
naite guṇā na guṇino mahadādayo ye   sarve manaḥ prabhṛtayaḥ sahadevamartyāḥ  |
ādyantavanta urugāya vidanti hi tvām   evaṃ vimṛśya sudhiyo viramanti śabdāt || 07.09.049 ||*
tatte'rhattama namaḥ stutikarmapūjāḥ   karma smṛtiścaraṇayoḥ śravaṇaṃ kathāyām  |
saṃsevayā tvayi vineti ṣaḍaṅgayā kiṃ   bhaktiṃ janaḥ paramahaṃsagatau labheta  || 07.09.050 ||*

siddhāmṛtarasaspṛṣṭā vajrasārā mahaujasaḥ  |

vilokya bhagnasaṅkalpaṃ vimanaskaṃ vṛṣadhvajam  |

vatsaścāsīttadā brahmā svayaṃ viṣṇurayaṃ hi gauḥ  |

te'surā hyapi paśyanto na nyaṣedhan vimohitāḥ  |
tadvijñāya mahāyogī rasapālānidaṃ jagau  || 07.10.063 ||
smayan viśokaḥ śokārtān smaran daivagatiṃ ca tām  |
devo'suro naro'nyo vā neśvaro'stīha kaścana  || 07.10.064 ||
ātmano'nyasya vā diṣṭaṃ daivenāpohituṃ dvayoḥ  |

dharmajñānaviraktyṛddhi tapovidyākriyādibhiḥ  |

divi dundubhayo nedurvimānaśatasaṅkulāḥ  || 07.10.068 ||

evaṃ dagdhvā purastisro bhagavān purahā nṛpa  |

evaṃ vidhānyasya hareḥ svamāyayā viḍambamānasya nṛlokamātmanaḥ  |
