viprasyādhyayanādīni ṣaḍanyasyāpratigrahaḥ  |
rājño vṛttiḥ prajāgopturaviprādvā karādibhiḥ  || 07.11.014 ||
vaiśyastu vārtāvṛttiḥ syānnityaṃ brahmakulānugaḥ  |
śūdrasya dvijaśuśrūṣā vṛttiśca svāmino bhavet || 07.11.015 ||
vārtā vicitrā śālīna yāyāvaraśiloñchanam  |
vipravṛttiścaturdheyaṃ śreyasī cottarottarā  || 07.11.016 ||
jaghanyo nottamāṃ vṛttimanāpadi bhajennaraḥ  |
ṛte rājanyamāpatsu sarveṣāmapi sarvaśaḥ  || 07.11.017 ||
ṛtāmṛtābhyāṃ jīveta mṛtena pramṛtena vā  |
satyānṛtābhyāmapi vā na śvavṛttyā kadācana  || 07.11.018 ||
ṛtamuñchaśilaṃ proktamamṛtaṃ yadayācitam  |
mṛtaṃ tu nityayācñā syātpramṛtaṃ karṣaṇaṃ smṛtam  || 07.11.019 ||
satyānṛtaṃ ca vāṇijyaṃ śvavṛttirnīcasevanam  |
varjayettāṃ sadā vipro rājanyaśca jugupsitām  |
sarvavedamayo vipraḥ sarvadevamayo nṛpaḥ  || 07.11.020 ||
śamo damastapaḥ śaucaṃ santoṣaḥ kṣāntirārjavam  |
jñānaṃ dayācyutātmatvaṃ satyaṃ ca brahmalakṣaṇam  || 07.11.021 ||
śauryaṃ vīryaṃ dhṛtistejastyāgaścātmajayaḥ kṣamā  |
brahmaṇyatā prasādaśca satyaṃ ca kṣatralakṣaṇam  || 07.11.022 ||
devagurvacyute bhaktistrivargaparipoṣaṇam  |
āstikyamudyamo nityaṃ naipuṇyaṃ vaiśyalakṣaṇam  || 07.11.023 ||
śūdrasya sannatiḥ śaucaṃ sevā svāminyamāyayā  |
amantrayajño hyasteyaṃ satyaṃ goviprarakṣaṇam  || 07.11.024 ||
strīṇāṃ ca patidevānāṃ tacchuśrūṣānukūlatā  |
tadbandhuṣvanuvṛttiśca nityaṃ tadvratadhāraṇam  || 07.11.025 ||
sammārjanopalepābhyāṃ gṛhamaṇḍanavartanaiḥ  |
svayaṃ ca maṇḍitā nityaṃ parimṛṣṭaparicchadā  || 07.11.026 ||
kāmairuccāvacaiḥ sādhvī praśrayeṇa damena ca  |
vākyaiḥ satyaiḥ priyaiḥ premṇā kāle kāle bhajetpatim  || 07.11.027 ||
santuṣṭālolupā dakṣā dharmajñā priyasatyavāk |
apramattā śuciḥ snigdhā patiṃ tvapatitaṃ bhajet || 07.11.028 ||
yā patiṃ haribhāvena bhajetśrīriva tatparā  |
haryātmanā harerloke patyā śrīriva modate  || 07.11.029 ||
vṛttiḥ saṅkarajātīnāṃ tattatkulakṛtā bhavet |
acaurāṇāmapāpānāmantyajāntevasāyinām  || 07.11.030 ||
prāyaḥ svabhāvavihito nṛṇāṃ dharmo yuge yuge  |
vedadṛgbhiḥ smṛto rājan pretya ceha ca śarmakṛt || 07.11.031 ||
vṛttyā svabhāvakṛtayā vartamānaḥ svakarmakṛt |
hitvā svabhāvajaṃ karma śanairnirguṇatāmiyāt || 07.11.032 ||
upyamānaṃ muhuḥ kṣetraṃ svayaṃ nirvīryatāmiyāt |
na kalpate punaḥ sūtyai uptaṃ bījaṃ ca naśyati  || 07.11.033 ||
evaṃ kāmāśayaṃ cittaṃ kāmānāmatisevayā  |
virajyeta yathā rājannagnivatkāmabindubhiḥ  || 07.11.034 ||
yasya yallakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ puṃso varṇābhivyañjakam  |
yadanyatrāpi dṛśyeta tattenaiva vinirdiśet || 07.11.035 ||
07.12.001|0 śrīnārada uvāca
brahmacārī gurukule vasan dānto gurorhitam  |
ācaran dāsavannīco gurau sudṛḍhasauhṛdaḥ  || 07.12.001 ||
sāyaṃ prātarupāsīta gurvagnyarkasurottamān  |
sandhye ubhe ca yatavāgjapan brahma samāhitaḥ  || 07.12.002 ||
chandāṃsyadhīyīta gurorāhūtaścetsuyantritaḥ  |
upakrame'vasāne ca caraṇau śirasā namet || 07.12.003 ||
mekhalājinavāsāṃsi jaṭādaṇḍakamaṇḍalūn  |
bibhṛyādupavītaṃ ca darbhapāṇiryathoditam  || 07.12.004 ||
sāyaṃ prātaścaredbhaikṣyaṃ gurave tannivedayet |
bhuñjīta yadyanujñāto no cedupavasetkvacit || 07.12.005 ||
suśīlo mitabhugdakṣaḥ śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ  |
yāvadarthaṃ vyavaharetstrīṣu strīnirjiteṣu ca  || 07.12.006 ||
varjayetpramadāgāthāmagṛhastho bṛhadvrataḥ  |
indriyāṇi pramāthīni harantyapi yatermanaḥ  || 07.12.007 ||
keśaprasādhanonmarda snapanābhyañjanādikam  |
gurustrībhiryuvatibhiḥ kārayennātmano yuvā  || 07.12.008 ||
nanvagniḥ pramadā nāma ghṛtakumbhasamaḥ pumān  |
sutāmapi raho jahyādanyadā yāvadarthakṛt || 07.12.009 ||
kalpayitvātmanā yāvadābhāsamidamīśvaraḥ  |
dvaitaṃ tāvanna viramettato hyasya viparyayaḥ  || 07.12.010 ||
etatsarvaṃ gṛhasthasya samāmnātaṃ yaterapi  |
guruvṛttirvikalpena gṛhasthasyartugāminaḥ  || 07.12.011 ||
añjanābhyañjanonmarda stryavalekhāmiṣaṃ madhu  |
sraggandhalepālaṅkārāṃstyajeyurye bṛhadvratāḥ  || 07.12.012 ||
uṣitvaivaṃ gurukule dvijo'dhītyāvabudhya ca  |
trayīṃ sāṅgopaniṣadaṃ yāvadarthaṃ yathābalam  || 07.12.013 ||
dattvā varamanujñāto guroḥ kāmaṃ yadīśvaraḥ  |
gṛhaṃ vanaṃ vā praviśetpravrajettatra vā vaset || 07.12.014 ||
agnau gurāvātmani ca sarvabhūteṣvadhokṣajam  |
bhūtaiḥ svadhāmabhiḥ paśyedapraviṣṭaṃ praviṣṭavat || 07.12.015 ||
evaṃ vidho brahmacārī vānaprastho yatirgṛhī  |
caran viditavijñānaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati  || 07.12.016 ||
vānaprasthasya vakṣyāmi niyamānmunisammatān  |
yānāsthāya munirgacchedṛṣilokamuhāñjasā  || 07.12.017 ||
na kṛṣṭapacyamaśnīyādakṛṣṭaṃ cāpyakālataḥ  |
agnipakvamathāmaṃ vā arkapakvamutāharet || 07.12.018 ||
vanyaiścarupuroḍāśānnirvapetkālacoditān  |
labdhe nave nave'nnādye purāṇaṃ ca parityajet || 07.12.019 ||
agnyarthameva śaraṇamuṭajaṃ vādrikandaram  |
śrayeta himavāyvagni varṣārkātapaṣāṭsvayam  || 07.12.020 ||
keśaromanakhaśmaśru malāni jaṭilo dadhat |
kamaṇḍalvajine daṇḍa valkalāgniparicchadān  || 07.12.021 ||
caredvane dvādaśābdānaṣṭau vā caturo muniḥ  |
dvāvekaṃ vā yathā buddhirna vipadyeta kṛcchrataḥ  || 07.12.022 ||
yadākalpaḥ svakriyāyāṃ vyādhibhirjarayāthavā  |
ānvīkṣikyāṃ vā vidyāyāṃ kuryādanaśanādikam  || 07.12.023 ||
ātmanyagnīn samāropya sannyasyāhaṃ mamātmatām  |
kāraṇeṣu nyasetsamyaksaṅghātaṃ tu yathārhataḥ  || 07.12.024 ||
khe khāni vāyau niśvāsāṃstejaḥsūṣmāṇamātmavān  |
apsvasṛkśleṣmapūyāni kṣitau śeṣaṃ yathodbhavam  || 07.12.025 ||
vācamagnau savaktavyāmindre śilpaṃ karāvapi  |
padāni gatyā vayasi ratyopasthaṃ prajāpatau  || 07.12.026 ||
mṛtyau pāyuṃ visargaṃ ca yathāsthānaṃ vinirdiśet |
dikṣu śrotraṃ sanādena sparśenādhyātmani tvacam  || 07.12.027 ||
rūpāṇi cakṣuṣā rājan jyotiṣyabhiniveśayet |
apsu pracetasā jihvāṃ ghreyairghrāṇaṃ kṣitau nyaset || 07.12.028 ||
mano manorathaiścandre buddhiṃ bodhyaiḥ kavau pare  |
karmāṇyadhyātmanā rudre yadahaṃ mamatākriyā  |
sattvena cittaṃ kṣetrajñe guṇairvaikārikaṃ pare  || 07.12.029 ||
apsu kṣitimapo jyotiṣyado vāyau nabhasyamum  |
kūṭasthe tacca mahati tadavyakte'kṣare ca tat || 07.12.030 ||
ityakṣaratayātmānaṃ cinmātramavaśeṣitam  |
jñātvādvayo'tha virameddagdhayonirivānalaḥ  || 07.12.031 ||
07.13.001|0 śrīnārada uvāca
kalpastvevaṃ parivrajya dehamātrāvaśeṣitaḥ  |
grāmaikarātravidhinā nirapekṣaścarenmahīm  || 07.13.001 ||
bibhṛyādyadyasau vāsaḥ kaupīnācchādanaṃ param  |
tyaktaṃ na liṅgāddaṇḍāderanyatkiñcidanāpadi  || 07.13.002 ||
eka eva caredbhikṣurātmārāmo'napāśrayaḥ  |
sarvabhūtasuhṛcchānto nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ  || 07.13.003 ||
paśyedātmanyado viśvaṃ pare sadasato'vyaye  |
ātmānaṃ ca paraṃ brahma sarvatra sadasanmaye  || 07.13.004 ||
suptiprabodhayoḥ sandhāvātmano gatimātmadṛk |
paśyan bandhaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca māyāmātraṃ na vastutaḥ  || 07.13.005 ||
nābhinandeddhruvaṃ mṛtyumadhruvaṃ vāsya jīvitam  |
kālaṃ paraṃ pratīkṣeta bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayam  || 07.13.006 ||
nāsacchāstreṣu sajjeta nopajīveta jīvikām  |
vādavādāṃstyajettarkān pakṣaṃ kaṃca na saṃśrayet || 07.13.007 ||
na śiṣyānanubadhnīta granthānnaivābhyasedbahūn  |
na vyākhyāmupayuñjīta nārambhānārabhetkvacit || 07.13.008 ||
na yaterāśramaḥ prāyo dharmaheturmahātmanaḥ  |
śāntasya samacittasya bibhṛyāduta vā tyajet || 07.13.009 ||
avyaktaliṅgo vyaktārtho manīṣyunmattabālavat |
kavirmūkavadātmānaṃ sa dṛṣṭyā darśayennṛṇām  || 07.13.010 ||
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam  |
prahrādasya ca saṃvādaṃ munerājagarasya ca  || 07.13.011 ||
taṃ śayānaṃ dharopasthe kāveryāṃ sahyasānuni  |
rajasvalaistanūdeśairnigūḍhāmalatejasam  || 07.13.012 ||
dadarśa lokān vicaran lokatattvavivitsayā  |
vṛto'mātyaiḥ katipayaiḥ prahrādo bhagavatpriyaḥ  || 07.13.013 ||
karmaṇākṛtibhirvācā liṅgairvarṇāśramādibhiḥ  |
na vidanti janā yaṃ vai so'sāviti na veti ca  || 07.13.014 ||
taṃ natvābhyarcya vidhivatpādayoḥ śirasā spṛśan  |
vivitsuridamaprākṣīnmahābhāgavato'suraḥ  || 07.13.015 ||
bibharṣi kāyaṃ pīvānaṃ sodyamo bhogavān yathā  |
vittaṃ caivodyamavatāṃ bhogo vittavatāmiha  |
bhogināṃ khalu deho'yaṃ pīvā bhavati nānyathā  || 07.13.016 ||
na te śayānasya nirudyamasya brahmannu hārtho yata eva bhogaḥ  |
abhogino'yaṃ tava vipra dehaḥ pīvā yatastadvada naḥ kṣamaṃ cet || 07.13.017 ||
kaviḥ kalpo nipuṇadṛkcitrapriyakathaḥ samaḥ  |
lokasya kurvataḥ karma śeṣe tadvīkṣitāpi vā  || 07.13.018 ||
07.13.019|0 śrīnārada uvāca
sa itthaṃ daityapatinā paripṛṣṭo mahāmuniḥ  |
smayamānastamabhyāha tadvāgamṛtayantritaḥ  || 07.13.019 ||
07.13.020|0 śrībrāhmaṇa uvāca
vededamasuraśreṣṭha bhavānnanvāryasammataḥ  |
īhoparamayornṝṇāṃ padānyadhyātmacakṣuṣā  || 07.13.020 ||
yasya nārāyaṇo devo bhagavān hṛdgataḥ sadā  |
bhaktyā kevalayājñānaṃ dhunoti dhvāntamarkavat || 07.13.021 ||
tathāpi brūmahe praśnāṃstava rājan yathāśrutam  |
sambhāṣaṇīyo hi bhavānātmanaḥ śuddhimicchatā  || 07.13.022 ||
tṛṣṇayā bhavavāhinyā yogyaiḥ kāmairapūryayā  |
karmāṇi kāryamāṇo'haṃ nānāyoniṣu yojitaḥ  || 07.13.023 ||
yadṛcchayā lokamimaṃ prāpitaḥ karmabhirbhraman  |
svargāpavargayordvāraṃ tiraścāṃ punarasya ca  || 07.13.024 ||
tatrāpi dampatīnāṃ ca sukhāyānyāpanuttaye  |
karmāṇi kurvatāṃ dṛṣṭvā nivṛtto'smi viparyayam  || 07.13.025 ||
sukhamasyātmano rūpaṃ sarvehoparatistanuḥ  |
manaḥsaṃsparśajān dṛṣṭvā bhogān svapsyāmi saṃviśan  || 07.13.026 ||
ityetadātmanaḥ svārthaṃ santaṃ vismṛtya vai pumān  |
vicitrāmasati dvaite ghorāmāpnoti saṃsṛtim  || 07.13.027 ||
jalaṃ tadudbhavaiśchannaṃ hitvājño jalakāmyayā  |
mṛgatṛṣṇāmupādhāvettathānyatrārthadṛksvataḥ  || 07.13.028 ||
dehādibhirdaivatantrairātmanaḥ sukhamīhataḥ  |
duḥkhātyayaṃ cānīśasya kriyā moghāḥ kṛtāḥ kṛtāḥ  || 07.13.029 ||
ādhyātmikādibhirduḥkhairavimuktasya karhicit |
martyasya kṛcchropanatairarthaiḥ kāmaiḥ kriyeta kim  || 07.13.030 ||
paśyāmi dhanināṃ kleśaṃ lubdhānāmajitātmanām  |
bhayādalabdhanidrāṇāṃ sarvato'bhiviśaṅkinām  || 07.13.031 ||
rājataścaurataḥ śatroḥ svajanātpaśupakṣitaḥ  |
arthibhyaḥ kālataḥ svasmānnityaṃ prāṇārthavadbhayam  || 07.13.032 ||
śokamohabhayakrodha rāgaklaibyaśramādayaḥ  |
yanmūlāḥ syurnṛṇāṃ jahyātspṛhāṃ prāṇārthayorbudhaḥ  || 07.13.033 ||
madhukāramahāsarpau loke'sminno gurūttamau  |
vairāgyaṃ paritoṣaṃ ca prāptā yacchikṣayā vayam  || 07.13.034 ||
virāgaḥ sarvakāmebhyaḥ śikṣito me madhuvratāt |
kṛcchrāptaṃ madhuvadvittaṃ hatvāpyanyo haretpatim  || 07.13.035 ||
anīhaḥ parituṣṭātmā yadṛcchopanatādaham  |
no cecchaye bahvahāni mahāhiriva sattvavān  || 07.13.036 ||
kvacidalpaṃ kvacidbhūri bhuñje'nnaṃ svādvasvādu vā  |
kvacidbhūri guṇopetaṃ guṇahīnamuta kvacit || 07.13.037 ||
śraddhayopahṛtaṃ kvāpi kadācinmānavarjitam  |
bhuñje bhuktvātha kasmiṃściddivā naktaṃ yadṛcchayā  || 07.13.038 ||
kṣaumaṃ dukūlamajinaṃ cīraṃ valkalameva vā  |
vase'nyadapi samprāptaṃ diṣṭabhuktuṣṭadhīraham  || 07.13.039 ||
kvacicchaye dharopasthe tṛṇaparṇāśmabhasmasu  |
kvacitprāsādaparyaṅke kaśipau vā parecchayā  || 07.13.040 ||
kvacitsnāto'nuliptāṅgaḥ suvāsāḥ sragvyalaṅkṛtaḥ  |
rathebhāśvaiścare kvāpi digvāsā grahavadvibho  || 07.13.041 ||
nāhaṃ ninde na ca staumi svabhāvaviṣamaṃ janam  |
eteṣāṃ śreya āśāse utaikātmyaṃ mahātmani  || 07.13.042 ||
vikalpaṃ juhuyāccittau tāṃ manasyarthavibhrame  |
mano vaikārike hutvā taṃ māyāyāṃ juhotyanu  || 07.13.043 ||
ātmānubhūtau tāṃ māyāṃ juhuyātsatyadṛṅmuniḥ  |
tato nirīho virametsvānubhūtyātmani sthitaḥ  || 07.13.044 ||
svātmavṛttaṃ mayetthaṃ te suguptamapi varṇitam  |
vyapetaṃ lokaśāstrābhyāṃ bhavān hi bhagavatparaḥ  || 07.13.045 ||
07.13.046|0 śrīnārada uvāca
dharmaṃ pāramahaṃsyaṃ vai muneḥ śrutvāsureśvaraḥ  |
pūjayitvā tataḥ prīta āmantrya prayayau gṛham  || 07.13.046 ||
07.14.001|0 śrīyudhiṣṭhira uvāca
gṛhastha etāṃ padavīṃ vidhinā yena cāñjasā  |
yāyāddevaṛṣe brūhi mādṛśo gṛhamūḍhadhīḥ  || 07.14.001 ||
07.14.002|0 śrīnārada uvāca
gṛheṣvavasthito rājan kriyāḥ kurvan yathocitāḥ  |
vāsudevārpaṇaṃ sākṣādupāsīta mahāmunīn  || 07.14.002 ||
śṛṇvan bhagavato'bhīkṣṇamavatārakathāmṛtam  |
śraddadhāno yathākālamupaśāntajanāvṛtaḥ  || 07.14.003 ||
satsaṅgācchanakaiḥ saṅgamātmajāyātmajādiṣu  |
vimuñcenmucyamāneṣu svayaṃ svapnavadutthitaḥ  || 07.14.004 ||
yāvadarthamupāsīno dehe gehe ca paṇḍitaḥ  |
virakto raktavattatra nṛloke naratāṃ nyaset || 07.14.005 ||
jñātayaḥ pitarau putrā bhrātaraḥ suhṛdo'pare  |
yadvadanti yadicchanti cānumodeta nirmamaḥ  || 07.14.006 ||
divyaṃ bhaumaṃ cāntarīkṣaṃ vittamacyutanirmitam  |
tatsarvamupayuñjāna etatkuryātsvato budhaḥ  || 07.14.007 ||
yāvadbhriyeta jaṭharaṃ tāvatsvatvaṃ hi dehinām  |
adhikaṃ yo'bhimanyeta sa steno daṇḍamarhati  || 07.14.008 ||
mṛgoṣṭrakharamarkākhu sarīsṛpkhagamakṣikāḥ  |
ātmanaḥ putravatpaśyettaireṣāmantaraṃ kiyat || 07.14.009 ||
trivargaṃ nātikṛcchreṇa bhajeta gṛhamedhyapi  |
yathādeśaṃ yathākālaṃ yāvaddaivopapāditam  || 07.14.010 ||
āśvāghānte'vasāyibhyaḥ kāmān saṃvibhajedyathā  |
apyekāmātmano dārāṃ nṛṇāṃ svatvagraho yataḥ  || 07.14.011 ||
jahyādyadarthe svān prāṇān hanyādvā pitaraṃ gurum  |
tasyāṃ svatvaṃ striyāṃ jahyādyastena hyajito jitaḥ  || 07.14.012 ||
kṛmiviḍbhasmaniṣṭhāntaṃ kvedaṃ tucchaṃ kalevaram  |
kva tadīyaratirbhāryā kvāyamātmā nabhaśchadiḥ  || 07.14.013 ||
siddhairyajñāvaśiṣṭārthaiḥ kalpayedvṛttimātmanaḥ  |
śeṣe svatvaṃ tyajan prājñaḥ padavīṃ mahatāmiyāt || 07.14.014 ||
devānṛṣīnnṛbhūtāni pitṝnātmānamanvaham  |
svavṛttyāgatavittena yajeta puruṣaṃ pṛthak || 07.14.015 ||
yarhyātmano'dhikārādyāḥ sarvāḥ syuryajñasampadaḥ  |
vaitānikena vidhinā agnihotrādinā yajet || 07.14.016 ||
na hyagnimukhato'yaṃ vai bhagavān sarvayajñabhuk |
ijyeta haviṣā rājan yathā vipramukhe hutaiḥ  || 07.14.017 ||
tasmādbrāhmaṇadeveṣu martyādiṣu yathārhataḥ  |
taistaiḥ kāmairyajasvainaṃ kṣetrajñaṃ brāhmaṇānanu  || 07.14.018 ||
kuryādaparapakṣīyaṃ māsi prauṣṭhapade dvijaḥ  |
śrāddhaṃ pitroryathāvittaṃ tadbandhūnāṃ ca vittavān  || 07.14.019 ||
ayane viṣuve kuryādvyatīpāte dinakṣaye  |
candrādityoparāge ca dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇeṣu ca  || 07.14.020 ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śuklapakṣe navamyāmatha kārtike  |
catasṛṣvapyaṣṭakāsu hemante śiśire tathā  || 07.14.021 ||
māghe ca sitasaptamyāṃ maghārākāsamāgame  |
rākayā cānumatyā ca māsarkṣāṇi yutānyapi  || 07.14.022 ||
dvādaśyāmanurādhā syācchravaṇastisra uttarāḥ  |
tisṛṣvekādaśī vāsu janmarkṣaśroṇayogayuk || 07.14.023 ||
ta ete śreyasaḥ kālā nṝṇāṃ śreyovivardhanāḥ  |
kuryātsarvātmanaiteṣu śreyo'moghaṃ tadāyuṣaḥ  || 07.14.024 ||
eṣu snānaṃ japo homo vrataṃ devadvijārcanam  |
pitṛdevanṛbhūtebhyo yaddattaṃ taddhyanaśvaram  || 07.14.025 ||
saṃskārakālo jāyāyā apatyasyātmanastathā  |
pretasaṃsthā mṛtāhaśca karmaṇyabhyudaye nṛpa  || 07.14.026 ||
atha deśān pravakṣyāmi dharmādiśreyāavahān  |
sa vai puṇyatamo deśaḥ satpātraṃ yatra labhyate  || 07.14.027 ||
bimbaṃ bhagavato yatra sarvametaccarācaram  |
yatra ha brāhmaṇakulaṃ tapovidyādayānvitam  || 07.14.028 ||
yatra yatra harerarcā sa deśaḥ śreyasāṃ padam  |
yatra gaṅgādayo nadyaḥ purāṇeṣu ca viśrutāḥ  || 07.14.029 ||
sarāṃsi puṣkarādīni kṣetrāṇyarhāśritānyuta  |
kurukṣetraṃ gayaśiraḥ prayāgaḥ pulahāśramaḥ  || 07.14.030 ||
naimiṣaṃ phālgunaṃ setuḥ prabhāso'tha kuśasthalī  |
vārāṇasī madhupurī pampā bindusarastathā  || 07.14.031 ||
nārāyaṇāśramo nandā sītārāmāśramādayaḥ  |
sarve kulācalā rājanmahendramalayādayaḥ  || 07.14.032 ||
ete puṇyatamā deśā harerarcāśritāśca ye  |
etān deśānniṣeveta śreyaskāmo hyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ  |
dharmo hyatrehitaḥ puṃsāṃ sahasrādhiphalodayaḥ  || 07.14.033 ||
pātraṃ tvatra niruktaṃ vai kavibhiḥ pātravittamaiḥ  |
harirevaika urvīśa yanmayaṃ vai carācaram  || 07.14.034 ||
devarṣyarhatsu vai satsu tatra brahmātmajādiṣu  |
rājan yadagrapūjāyāṃ mataḥ pātratayācyutaḥ  || 07.14.035 ||
jīvarāśibhirākīrṇa aṇḍakośāṅghripo mahān  |
tanmūlatvādacyutejyā sarvajīvātmatarpaṇam  || 07.14.036 ||
purāṇyanena sṛṣṭāni nṛtiryagṛṣidevatāḥ  |
śete jīvena rūpeṇa pureṣu puruṣo hyasau  || 07.14.037 ||
teṣveva bhagavān rājaṃstāratamyena vartate  |
tasmātpātraṃ hi puruṣo yāvānātmā yatheyate  || 07.14.038 ||
dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ mitho nṛṇāmavajñānātmatāṃ nṛpa  |
tretādiṣu harerarcā kriyāyai kavibhiḥ kṛtā  || 07.14.039 ||
tato'rcāyāṃ hariṃ kecitsaṃśraddhāya saparyayā  |
upāsata upāstāpi nārthadā puruṣadviṣām  || 07.14.040 ||
puruṣeṣvapi rājendra supātraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ  |
tapasā vidyayā tuṣṭyā dhatte vedaṃ harestanum  || 07.14.041 ||
nanvasya brāhmaṇā rājan kṛṣṇasya jagadātmanaḥ  |
punantaḥ pādarajasā trilokīṃ daivataṃ mahat || 07.14.042 ||
07.15.001|0 śrīnārada uvāca
karmaniṣṭhā dvijāḥ kecittaponiṣṭhā nṛpāpare  |
svādhyāye'nye pravacane kecana jñānayogayoḥ  || 07.15.001 ||
jñānaniṣṭhāya deyāni kavyānyānantyamicchatā  |
daive ca tadabhāve syāditarebhyo yathārhataḥ  || 07.15.002 ||
dvau daive pitṛkārye trīnekaikamubhayatra vā  |
bhojayetsusamṛddho'pi śrāddhe kuryānna vistaram  || 07.15.003 ||
deśakālocitaśraddhā dravyapātrārhaṇāni ca  |
samyagbhavanti naitāni vistarātsvajanārpaṇāt || 07.15.004 ||
deśe kāle ca samprāpte munyannaṃ haridaivatam  |
śraddhayā vidhivatpātre nyastaṃ kāmadhugakṣayam  || 07.15.005 ||
devarṣipitṛbhūtebhya ātmane svajanāya ca  |
annaṃ saṃvibhajan paśyetsarvaṃ tatpuruṣātmakam  || 07.15.006 ||
na dadyādāmiṣaṃ śrāddhe na cādyāddharmatattvavit |
munyannaiḥ syātparā prītiryathā na paśuhiṃsayā  || 07.15.007 ||
naitādṛśaḥ paro dharmo nṛṇāṃ saddharmamicchatām  |
nyāso daṇḍasya bhūteṣu manovākkāyajasya yaḥ  || 07.15.008 ||
eke karmamayān yajñān jñānino yajñavittamāḥ  |
ātmasaṃyamane'nīhā juhvati jñānadīpite  || 07.15.009 ||
dravyayajñairyakṣyamāṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūtāni bibhyati  |
eṣa mākaruṇo hanyādatajjño hyasutṛpdhruvam  || 07.15.010 ||
tasmāddaivopapannena munyannenāpi dharmavit |
santuṣṭo'harahaḥ kuryānnityanaimittikīḥ kriyāḥ  || 07.15.011 ||
vidharmaḥ paradharmaśca ābhāsa upamā chalaḥ  |
adharmaśākhāḥ pañcemā dharmajño'dharmavattyajet || 07.15.012 ||
dharmabādho vidharmaḥ syātparadharmo'nyacoditaḥ  |
upadharmastu pākhaṇḍo dambho vā śabdabhicchalaḥ  || 07.15.013 ||
yastvicchayā kṛtaḥ pumbhirābhāso hyāśramātpṛthak |
svabhāvavihito dharmaḥ kasya neṣṭaḥ praśāntaye  || 07.15.014 ||
dharmārthamapi neheta yātrārthaṃ vādhano dhanam  |
anīhānīhamānasya mahāheriva vṛttidā  || 07.15.015 ||
santuṣṭasya nirīhasya svātmārāmasya yatsukham  |
kutastatkāmalobhena dhāvato'rthehayā diśaḥ  || 07.15.016 ||
sadā santuṣṭamanasaḥ sarvāḥ śivamayā diśaḥ  |
śarkarākaṇṭakādibhyo yathopānatpadaḥ śivam  || 07.15.017 ||
santuṣṭaḥ kena vā rājanna vartetāpi vāriṇā  |
aupasthyajaihvyakārpaṇyādgṛhapālāyate janaḥ  || 07.15.018 ||
asantuṣṭasya viprasya tejo vidyā tapo yaśaḥ  |
sravantīndriyalaulyena jñānaṃ caivāvakīryate  || 07.15.019 ||
kāmasyāntaṃ hi kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ krodhasyaitatphalodayāt |
jano yāti na lobhasya jitvā bhuktvā diśo bhuvaḥ  || 07.15.020 ||
paṇḍitā bahavo rājan bahujñāḥ saṃśayacchidaḥ  |
sadasaspatayo'pyeke asantoṣātpatantyadhaḥ  || 07.15.021 ||
asaṅkalpājjayetkāmaṃ krodhaṃ kāmavivarjanāt |
arthānarthekṣayā lobhaṃ bhayaṃ tattvāvamarśanāt || 07.15.022 ||
ānvīkṣikyā śokamohau dambhaṃ mahadupāsayā  |
yogāntarāyānmaunena hiṃsāṃ kāmādyanīhayā  || 07.15.023 ||
kṛpayā bhūtajaṃ duḥkhaṃ daivaṃ jahyātsamādhinā  |
ātmajaṃ yogavīryeṇa nidrāṃ sattvaniṣevayā  || 07.15.024 ||
rajastamaśca sattvena sattvaṃ copaśamena ca  |
etatsarvaṃ gurau bhaktyā puruṣo hyañjasā jayet || 07.15.025 ||
yasya sākṣādbhagavati jñānadīpaprade gurau  |
martyāsaddhīḥ śrutaṃ tasya sarvaṃ kuñjaraśaucavat || 07.15.026 ||
eṣa vai bhagavān sākṣātpradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ  |
yogeśvarairvimṛgyāṅghrirloko yaṃ manyate naram  || 07.15.027 ||
ṣaḍvargasaṃyamaikāntāḥ sarvā niyamacodanāḥ  |
tadantā yadi no yogānāvaheyuḥ śramāvahāḥ  || 07.15.028 ||
yathā vārtādayo hyarthā yogasyārthaṃ na bibhrati  |
anarthāya bhaveyuḥ sma pūrtamiṣṭaṃ tathāsataḥ  || 07.15.029 ||
yaścittavijaye yattaḥ syānniḥsaṅgo'parigrahaḥ  |
eko viviktaśaraṇo bhikṣurbhaikṣyamitāśanaḥ  || 07.15.030 ||
deśe śucau same rājan saṃsthāpyāsanamātmanaḥ  |
sthiraṃ sukhaṃ samaṃ tasminnāsītarjvaṅga omiti  || 07.15.031 ||
prāṇāpānau sannirundhyātpūrakumbhakarecakaiḥ  |
yāvanmanastyajetkāmān svanāsāgranirīkṣaṇaḥ  || 07.15.032 ||
yato yato niḥsarati manaḥ kāmahataṃ bhramat |
tatastata upāhṛtya hṛdi rundhyācchanairbudhaḥ  || 07.15.033 ||
evamabhyasyataścittaṃ kālenālpīyasā yateḥ  |
aniśaṃ tasya nirvāṇaṃ yātyanindhanavahnivat || 07.15.034 ||
kāmādibhiranāviddhaṃ praśāntākhilavṛtti yat |
cittaṃ brahmasukhaspṛṣṭaṃ naivottiṣṭheta karhicit || 07.15.035 ||
yaḥ pravrajya gṛhātpūrvaṃ trivargāvapanātpunaḥ  |
yadi seveta tān bhikṣuḥ sa vai vāntāśyapatrapaḥ  || 07.15.036 ||
yaiḥ svadehaḥ smṛto'nātmā martyo viṭkṛmibhasmavat |
ta enamātmasātkṛtvā ślāghayanti hyasattamāḥ  || 07.15.037 ||
gṛhasthasya kriyātyāgo vratatyāgo vaṭorapi  |
tapasvino grāmasevā bhikṣorindriyalolatā  || 07.15.038 ||
āśramāpasadā hyete khalvāśramaviḍambanāḥ  |
devamāyāvimūḍhāṃstānupekṣetānukampayā  || 07.15.039 ||
ātmānaṃ cedvijānīyātparaṃ jñānadhutāśayaḥ  |
kimicchan kasya vā hetordehaṃ puṣṇāti lampaṭaḥ  || 07.15.040 ||
āhuḥ śarīraṃ rathamindriyāṇi hayānabhīṣūnmana indriyeśam  |
vartmāni mātrā dhiṣaṇāṃ ca sūtaṃ sattvaṃ bṛhadbandhuramīśasṛṣṭam  || 07.15.041 ||
akṣaṃ daśaprāṇamadharmadharmau cakre'bhimānaṃ rathinaṃ ca jīvam  |
dhanurhi tasya praṇavaṃ paṭhanti śaraṃ tu jīvaṃ parameva lakṣyam  || 07.15.042 ||
rāgo dveṣaśca lobhaśca śokamohau bhayaṃ madaḥ  |
māno'vamāno'sūyā ca māyā hiṃsā ca matsaraḥ  || 07.15.043 ||
rajaḥ pramādaḥ kṣunnidrā śatravastvevamādayaḥ  |
rajastamaḥprakṛtayaḥ sattvaprakṛtayaḥ kvacit || 07.15.044 ||
yāvannṛkāyarathamātmavaśopakalpaṃ   dhatte gariṣṭhacaraṇārcanayā niśātam  |
jñānāsimacyutabalo dadhadastaśatruḥ   svānandatuṣṭa upaśānta idaṃ vijahyāt || 07.15.045 ||*
nocetpramattamasadindriyavājisūtā   nītvotpathaṃ viṣayadasyuṣu nikṣipanti  |
te dasyavaḥ sahayasūtamamuṃ tamo'ndhe   saṃsārakūpa urumṛtyubhaye kṣipanti  || 07.15.046 ||*
pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca dvividhaṃ karma vaidikam  |
āvartate pravṛttena nivṛttenāśnute'mṛtam  || 07.15.047 ||
hiṃsraṃ dravyamayaṃ kāmyamagnihotrādyaśāntidam  |
darśaśca pūrṇamāsaśca cāturmāsyaṃ paśuḥ sutaḥ  || 07.15.048 ||
etadiṣṭaṃ pravṛttākhyaṃ hutaṃ prahutameva ca  |
pūrtaṃ surālayārāma kūpājīvyādilakṣaṇam  || 07.15.049 ||
dravyasūkṣmavipākaśca dhūmo rātrirapakṣayaḥ  |
ayanaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ somo darśa oṣadhivīrudhaḥ  || 07.15.050 ||
annaṃ reta iti kṣmeśa pitṛyānaṃ punarbhavaḥ  |
ekaikaśyenānupūrvaṃ bhūtvā bhūtveha jāyate  || 07.15.051 ||
niṣekādiśmaśānāntaiḥ saṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛto dvijaḥ  |
indriyeṣu kriyāyajñān jñānadīpeṣu juhvati  || 07.15.052 ||
indriyāṇi manasyūrmau vāci vaikārikaṃ manaḥ  |
vācaṃ varṇasamāmnāye tamoṃkāre svare nyaset |
oṃkāraṃ bindau nāde taṃ taṃ tu prāṇe mahatyamum  || 07.15.053 ||
agniḥ sūryo divā prāhṇaḥ śuklo rākottaraṃ svarāṭ |
viśvo'tha taijasaḥ prājñasturya ātmā samanvayāt || 07.15.054 ||
devayānamidaṃ prāhurbhūtvā bhūtvānupūrvaśaḥ  |
ātmayājyupaśāntātmā hyātmastho na nivartate  || 07.15.055 ||
ya ete pitṛdevānāmayane vedanirmite  |
śāstreṇa cakṣuṣā veda janastho'pi na muhyati  || 07.15.056 ||
ādāvante janānāṃ sadbahirantaḥ parāvaram  |
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ vaco vācyaṃ tamo jyotistvayaṃ svayam  || 07.15.057 ||
ābādhito'pi hyābhāso yathā vastutayā smṛtaḥ  |
durghaṭatvādaindriyakaṃ tadvadarthavikalpitam  || 07.15.058 ||
kṣityādīnāmihārthānāṃ chāyā na katamāpi hi  |
na saṅghāto vikāro'pi na pṛthaṅnānvito mṛṣā  || 07.15.059 ||
dhātavo'vayavitvācca tanmātrāvayavairvinā  |
na syurhyasatyavayavinyasannavayavo'ntataḥ  || 07.15.060 ||
syātsādṛśyabhramastāvadvikalpe sati vastunaḥ  |
jāgratsvāpau yathā svapne tathā vidhiniṣedhatā  || 07.15.061 ||
bhāvādvaitaṃ kriyādvaitaṃ dravyādvaitaṃ tathātmanaḥ  |
vartayan svānubhūtyeha trīn svapnān dhunute muniḥ  || 07.15.062 ||
kāryakāraṇavastvaikya darśanaṃ paṭatantuvat |
avastutvādvikalpasya bhāvādvaitaṃ taducyate  || 07.15.063 ||
yadbrahmaṇi pare sākṣātsarvakarmasamarpaṇam  |
manovāktanubhiḥ pārtha kriyādvaitaṃ taducyate  || 07.15.064 ||
ātmajāyāsutādīnāmanyeṣāṃ sarvadehinām  |
yatsvārthakāmayoraikyaṃ dravyādvaitaṃ taducyate  || 07.15.065 ||
yadyasya vāniṣiddhaṃ syādyena yatra yato nṛpa  |
sa teneheta kāryāṇi naro nānyairanāpadi  || 07.15.066 ||
etairanyaiśca vedoktairvartamānaḥ svakarmabhiḥ  |
gṛhe'pyasya gatiṃ yāyādrājaṃstadbhaktibhāṅnaraḥ  || 07.15.067 ||
yathā hi yūyaṃ nṛpadeva dustyajādāpadgaṇāduttaratātmanaḥ prabhoḥ  |
yatpādapaṅkeruhasevayā bhavānahāraṣīnnirjitadiggajaḥ kratūn  || 07.15.068 ||
ahaṃ purābhavaṃ kaścidgandharva upabarhaṇaḥ  |
nāmnātīte mahākalpe gandharvāṇāṃ susammataḥ  || 07.15.069 ||
rūpapeśalamādhurya saugandhyapriyadarśanaḥ  |
strīṇāṃ priyatamo nityaṃ mattaḥ svapuralampaṭaḥ  || 07.15.070 ||
ekadā devasatre tu gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ  |
upahūtā viśvasṛgbhirharigāthopagāyane  || 07.15.071 ||
ahaṃ ca gāyaṃstadvidvān strībhiḥ parivṛto gataḥ  |
jñātvā viśvasṛjastanme helanaṃ śepurojasā  |
yāhi tvaṃ śūdratāmāśu naṣṭaśrīḥ kṛtahelanaḥ  || 07.15.072 ||
tāvaddāsyāmahaṃ jajñe tatrāpi brahmavādinām  |
śuśrūṣayānuṣaṅgeṇa prāpto'haṃ brahmaputratām  || 07.15.073 ||
dharmaste gṛhamedhīyo varṇitaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ  |
gṛhastho yena padavīmañjasā nyāsināmiyāt || 07.15.074 ||
yūyaṃ nṛloke bata bhūribhāgā lokaṃ punānā munayo'bhiyanti  |
yeṣāṃ gṛhānāvasatīti sākṣādgūḍhaṃ paraṃ brahma manuṣyaliṅgam  || 07.15.075 ||
sa vā ayaṃ brahma mahadvimṛgya kaivalyanirvāṇasukhānubhūtiḥ  |
priyaḥ suhṛdvaḥ khalu mātuleya ātmārhaṇīyo vidhikṛdguruśca  || 07.15.076 ||
na yasya sākṣādbhavapadmajādibhī rūpaṃ dhiyā vastutayopavarṇitam  |
maunena bhaktyopaśamena pūjitaḥ prasīdatāmeṣa sa sātvatāṃ patiḥ  || 07.15.077 ||
07.15.078|0 śrīśuka uvāca
iti devarṣiṇā proktaṃ niśamya bharatarṣabhaḥ  |
pūjayāmāsa suprītaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ ca premavihvalaḥ  || 07.15.078 ||
kṛṣṇapārthāvupāmantrya pūjitaḥ prayayau muniḥ  |
śrutvā kṛṣṇaṃ paraṃ brahma pārthaḥ paramavismitaḥ  || 07.15.079 ||
iti dākṣāyiṇīnāṃ te pṛthagvaṃśā prakīrtitāḥ  |
devāsuramanuṣyādyā lokā yatra carācarāḥ  || 07.15.080 ||



08.01.001|0 śrīrājovāca
svāyambhuvasyeha guro vaṃśo'yaṃ vistarācchrutaḥ  |
yatra viśvasṛjāṃ sargo manūnanyān vadasva naḥ  || 08.01.001 ||
manvantare harerjanma karmāṇi ca mahīyasaḥ  |
gṛṇanti kavayo brahmaṃstāni no vada śṛṇvatām  || 08.01.002 ||
yadyasminnantare brahman bhagavān viśvabhāvanaḥ  |
kṛtavān kurute kartā hyatīte'nāgate'dya vā  || 08.01.003 ||
08.01.004|0 śrīṛṣiruvāca
manavo'smin vyatītāḥ ṣaṭkalpe svāyambhuvādayaḥ  |
ādyaste kathito yatra devādīnāṃ ca sambhavaḥ  || 08.01.004 ||
ākūtyāṃ devahūtyāṃ ca duhitrostasya vai manoḥ  |
dharmajñānopadeśārthaṃ bhagavān putratāṃ gataḥ  || 08.01.005 ||
kṛtaṃ purā bhagavataḥ kapilasyānuvarṇitam  |
ākhyāsye bhagavān yajño yaccakāra kurūdvaha  || 08.01.006 ||
viraktaḥ kāmabhogeṣu śatarūpāpatiḥ prabhuḥ  |
visṛjya rājyaṃ tapase sabhāryo vanamāviśat || 08.01.007 ||
sunandāyāṃ varṣaśataṃ padaikena bhuvaṃ spṛśan  |
tapyamānastapo ghoramidamanvāha bhārata  || 08.01.008 ||
08.01.009|0 śrīmanuruvāca
yena cetayate viśvaṃ viśvaṃ cetayate na yam  |
yo jāgarti śayāne'sminnāyaṃ taṃ veda veda saḥ  || 08.01.009 ||
ātmāvāsyamidaṃ viśvaṃ yatkiñcijjagatyāṃ jagat |
tena tyaktena bhuñjīthā mā gṛdhaḥ kasya sviddhanam  || 08.01.010 ||
yaṃ paśyati na paśyantaṃ cakṣuryasya na riṣyati  |
taṃ bhūtanilayaṃ devaṃ suparṇamupadhāvata  || 08.01.011 ||
na yasyādyantau madhyaṃ ca svaḥ paro nāntaraṃ bahiḥ  |
viśvasyāmūni yadyasmādviśvaṃ ca tadṛtaṃ mahat || 08.01.012 ||
sa viśvakāyaḥ puruhūtaīśaḥ satyaḥ svayaṃjyotirajaḥ purāṇaḥ  |
dhatte'sya janmādyajayātmaśaktyā tāṃ vidyayodasya nirīha āste  || 08.01.013 ||
athāgre ṛṣayaḥ karmāṇīhante'karmahetave  |
īhamāno hi puruṣaḥ prāyo'nīhāṃ prapadyate  || 08.01.014 ||
īhate bhagavānīśo na hi tatra visajjate  |
ātmalābhena pūrṇārtho nāvasīdanti ye'nu tam  || 08.01.015 ||
tamīhamānaṃ nirahaṅkṛtaṃ budhaṃ nirāśiṣaṃ pūrṇamananyacoditam  |
nṝn śikṣayantaṃ nijavartmasaṃsthitaṃ prabhuṃ prapadye'khiladharmabhāvanam  || 08.01.016 ||
08.01.017|0 śrīśuka uvāca
iti mantropaniṣadaṃ vyāharantaṃ samāhitam  |
dṛṣṭvāsurā yātudhānā jagdhumabhyadravan kṣudhā  || 08.01.017 ||
tāṃstathāvasitān vīkṣya yajñaḥ sarvagato hariḥ  |
yāmaiḥ parivṛto devairhatvāśāsattriviṣṭapam  || 08.01.018 ||
svārociṣo dvitīyastu manuragneḥ suto'bhavat |
dyumatsuṣeṇarociṣmatpramukhāstasya cātmajāḥ  || 08.01.019 ||
tatrendro rocanastvāsīddevāśca tuṣitādayaḥ  |
ūrjastambhādayaḥ sapta ṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ  || 08.01.020 ||
ṛṣestu vedaśirasastuṣitā nāma patnyabhūt |
tasyāṃ jajñe tato devo vibhurityabhiviśrutaḥ  || 08.01.021 ||
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi munayo ye dhṛtavratāḥ  |
anvaśikṣan vrataṃ tasya kaumārabrahmacāriṇaḥ  || 08.01.022 ||
tṛtīya uttamo nāma priyavratasuto manuḥ  |
pavanaḥ sṛñjayo yajña hotrādyāstatsutā nṛpa  || 08.01.023 ||
vasiṣṭhatanayāḥ sapta ṛṣayaḥ pramadādayaḥ  |
satyā vedaśrutā bhadrā devā indrastu satyajit || 08.01.024 ||
dharmasya sūnṛtāyāṃ tu bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ  |
satyasena iti khyāto jātaḥ satyavrataiḥ saha  || 08.01.025 ||
so'nṛtavrataduḥśīlānasato yakṣarākṣasān  |
bhūtadruho bhūtagaṇāṃścāvadhītsatyajitsakhaḥ  || 08.01.026 ||
caturtha uttamabhrātā manurnāmnā ca tāmasaḥ  |
pṛthuḥ khyātirnaraḥ keturityādyā daśa tatsutāḥ  || 08.01.027 ||
satyakā harayo vīrā devāstriśikha īśvaraḥ  |
jyotirdhāmādayaḥ sapta ṛṣayastāmase'ntare  || 08.01.028 ||
devā vaidhṛtayo nāma vidhṛtestanayā nṛpa  |
naṣṭāḥ kālena yairvedā vidhṛtāḥ svena tejasā  || 08.01.029 ||
tatrāpi jajñe bhagavān hariṇyāṃ harimedhasaḥ  |
harirityāhṛto yena gajendro mocito grahāt || 08.01.030 ||
08.01.031|0 śrīrājovāca
bādarāyaṇa etatte śrotumicchāmahe vayam  |
hariryathā gajapatiṃ grāhagrastamamūmucat || 08.01.031 ||
tatkathāsu mahatpuṇyaṃ dhanyaṃ svastyayanaṃ śubham  |
yatra yatrottamaśloko bhagavān gīyate hariḥ  || 08.01.032 ||
08.01.033|0 śrīsūta uvāca
parīkṣitaivaṃ sa tu bādarāyaṇiḥ prāyopaviṣṭena kathāsu coditaḥ  |
uvāca viprāḥ pratinandya pārthivaṃ mudā munīnāṃ sadasi sma śṛṇvatām  || 08.01.033 ||
08.02.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
āsīdgirivaro rājaṃstrikūṭa iti viśrutaḥ  |
kṣīrodenāvṛtaḥ śrīmān yojanāyutamucchritaḥ  || 08.02.001 ||
tāvatā vistṛtaḥ paryaktribhiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ payonidhim  |
diśaḥ khaṃ rocayannāste raupyāyasahiraṇmayaiḥ  || 08.02.002 ||
anyaiśca kakubhaḥ sarvā ratnadhātuvicitritaiḥ  |
nānādrumalatāgulmairnirghoṣairnirjharāmbhasām  || 08.02.003 ||
sa cāvanijyamānāṅghriḥ samantātpayaūrmibhiḥ  |
karoti śyāmalāṃ bhūmiṃ harinmarakatāśmabhiḥ  || 08.02.004 ||
siddhacāraṇagandharvairvidyādharamahoragaiḥ  |
kinnarairapsarobhiśca krīḍadbhirjuṣṭakandaraḥ  || 08.02.005 ||
yatra saṅgītasannādairnadadguhamamarṣayā  |
abhigarjanti harayaḥ ślāghinaḥ paraśaṅkayā  || 08.02.006 ||
nānāraṇyapaśuvrāta saṅkuladroṇyalaṅkṛtaḥ  |
citradrumasurodyāna kalakaṇṭhavihaṅgamaḥ  || 08.02.007 ||
saritsarobhiracchodaiḥ pulinairmaṇivālukaiḥ  |
devastrīmajjanāmoda saurabhāmbvanilairyutaḥ  || 08.02.008 ||
tasya droṇyāṃ bhagavato varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ  |
udyānamṛtumannāma ākrīḍaṃ surayoṣitām  || 08.02.009 ||
sarvato'laṅkṛtaṃ divyairnityapuṣpaphaladrumaiḥ  |
mandāraiḥ pārijātaiśca pāṭalāśokacampakaiḥ  || 08.02.010 ||
cūtaiḥ piyālaiḥ panasairāmrairāmrātakairapi  |
kramukairnārikelaiśca kharjūrairbījapūrakaiḥ  || 08.02.011 ||
madhukaiḥ śālatālaiśca tamālairasanārjunaiḥ  |
ariṣṭoḍumbaraplakṣairvaṭaiḥ kiṃśukacandanaiḥ  || 08.02.012 ||
picumardaiḥ kovidāraiḥ saralaiḥ suradārubhiḥ  |
drākṣekṣurambhājambubhirbadaryakṣābhayāmalaiḥ  || 08.02.013 ||
bilvaiḥ kapitthairjambīrairvṛto bhallātakādibhiḥ  |
tasmin saraḥ suvipulaṃ lasatkāñcanapaṅkajam  || 08.02.014 ||
kumudotpalakahlāra śatapatraśriyorjitam  |
mattaṣaṭpadanirghuṣṭaṃ śakuntaiśca kalasvanaiḥ  || 08.02.015 ||
haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ cakrāhvaiḥ sārasairapi  |
jalakukkuṭakoyaṣṭi dātyūhakulakūjitam  || 08.02.016 ||
matsyakacchapasañcāra calatpadmarajaḥpayaḥ  |
kadambavetasanala nīpavañjulakairvṛtam  || 08.02.017 ||
kundaiḥ kurubakāśokaiḥ śirīṣaiḥ kūṭajeṅgudaiḥ  |
kubjakaiḥ svarṇayūthībhirnāgapunnāgajātibhiḥ  || 08.02.018 ||
mallikāśatapatraiśca mādhavījālakādibhiḥ  |
śobhitaṃ tīrajaiścānyairnityartubhiralaṃ drumaiḥ  || 08.02.019 ||
tatraikadā tadgirikānanāśrayaḥ kareṇubhirvāraṇayūthapaścaran  |
sakaṇṭakaṃ kīcakaveṇuvetravadviśālagulmaṃ prarujan vanaspatīn  || 08.02.020 ||
yadgandhamātrāddharayo gajendrā vyāghrādayo vyālamṛgāḥ sakhaḍgāḥ  |
mahoragāścāpi bhayāddravanti sagaurakṛṣṇāḥ sarabhāścamaryaḥ  || 08.02.021 ||
vṛkā varāhā mahiṣarkṣaśalyā gopucchaśālāvṛkamarkaṭāśca  |
anyatra kṣudrā hariṇāḥ śaśādayaścarantyabhītā yadanugraheṇa  || 08.02.022 ||
sa gharmataptaḥ karibhiḥ kareṇubhirvṛto madacyutkarabhairanudrutaḥ  |
giriṃ garimṇā paritaḥ prakampayanniṣevyamāṇo'likulairmadāśanaiḥ  || 08.02.023 ||
saro'nilaṃ paṅkajareṇurūṣitaṃ jighran vidūrānmadavihvalekṣaṇaḥ  |
vṛtaḥ svayūthena tṛṣārditena tatsarovarābhyāsamathāgamaddrutam  || 08.02.024 ||
vigāhya tasminnamṛtāmbu nirmalaṃ hemāravindotpalareṇurūṣitam  |
papau nikāmaṃ nijapuṣkaroddhṛtamātmānamadbhiḥ snapayan gataklamaḥ  || 08.02.025 ||
sa puṣkareṇoddhṛtaśīkarāmbubhirnipāyayan saṃsnapayan yathā gṛhī  |
ghṛṇī kareṇuḥ karabhāṃśca durmado nācaṣṭa kṛcchraṃ kṛpaṇo'jamāyayā  || 08.02.026 ||
taṃ tatra kaścinnṛpa daivacodito grāho balīyāṃścaraṇe ruṣāgrahīt |
yadṛcchayaivaṃ vyasanaṃ gato gajo yathābalaṃ so'tibalo vicakrame  || 08.02.027 ||
tathāturaṃ yūthapatiṃ kareṇavo vikṛṣyamāṇaṃ tarasā balīyasā  |
vicukruśurdīnadhiyo'pare gajāḥ pārṣṇigrahāstārayituṃ na cāśakan  || 08.02.028 ||
niyudhyatorevamibhendranakrayorvikarṣatorantarato bahirmithaḥ  |
samāḥ sahasraṃ vyagamanmahīpate saprāṇayościtramamaṃsatāmarāḥ  || 08.02.029 ||
tato gajendrasya manobalaujasāṃ kālena dīrgheṇa mahānabhūdvyayaḥ  |
vikṛṣyamāṇasya jale'vasīdato viparyayo'bhūtsakalaṃ jalaukasaḥ  || 08.02.030 ||
itthaṃ gajendraḥ sa yadāpa saṅkaṭaṃ prāṇasya dehī vivaśo yadṛcchayā  |
apārayannātmavimokṣaṇe ciraṃ dadhyāvimāṃ buddhimathābhyapadyata  || 08.02.031 ||
na māmime jñātaya āturaṃ gajāḥ kutaḥ kariṇyaḥ prabhavanti mocitum  |
grāheṇa pāśena vidhāturāvṛto'pyahaṃ ca taṃ yāmi paraṃ parāyaṇam  || 08.02.032 ||
yaḥ kaścaneśo balino'ntakoragātpracaṇḍavegādabhidhāvato bhṛśam  |
bhītaṃ prapannaṃ paripāti yadbhayānmṛtyuḥ pradhāvatyaraṇaṃ tamīmahi  || 08.02.033 ||
08.03.001|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
evaṃ vyavasito buddhyā samādhāya mano hṛdi  |
jajāpa paramaṃ jāpyaṃ prāgjanmanyanuśikṣitam  || 08.03.001 ||
08.03.003|0 śrīgajendra uvāca
oṃ namo bhagavate tasmai yata etaccidātmakam  |
puruṣāyādibījāya pareśāyābhidhīmahi  || 08.03.002 ||
yasminnidaṃ yataścedaṃ yenedaṃ ya idaṃ svayam  |
yo'smātparasmācca parastaṃ prapadye svayambhuvam  || 08.03.003 ||
yaḥ svātmanīdaṃ nijamāyayārpitaṃ kvacidvibhātaṃ kva ca tattirohitam  |
aviddhadṛksākṣyubhayaṃ tadīkṣate sa ātmamūlo'vatu māṃ parātparaḥ  || 08.03.004 ||
kālena pañcatvamiteṣu kṛtsnaśo lokeṣu pāleṣu ca sarvahetuṣu  |
tamastadāsīdgahanaṃ gabhīraṃ yastasya pāre'bhivirājate vibhuḥ  || 08.03.005 ||
na yasya devā ṛṣayaḥ padaṃ vidurjantuḥ punaḥ ko'rhati gantumīritum  |
yathā naṭasyākṛtibhirviceṣṭato duratyayānukramaṇaḥ sa māvatu  || 08.03.006 ||
didṛkṣavo yasya padaṃ sumaṅgalaṃ vimuktasaṅgā munayaḥ susādhavaḥ  |
carantyalokavratamavraṇaṃ vane bhūtātmabhūtāḥ suhṛdaḥ sa me gatiḥ  || 08.03.007 ||
na vidyate yasya ca janma karma vā na nāmarūpe guṇadoṣa eva vā  |
tathāpi lokāpyayasambhavāya yaḥ svamāyayā tānyanukālamṛcchati  || 08.03.008 ||
tasmai namaḥ pareśāya brahmaṇe'nantaśaktaye  |
arūpāyorurūpāya nama āścaryakarmaṇe  || 08.03.009 ||
nama ātmapradīpāya sākṣiṇe paramātmane  |
namo girāṃ vidūrāya manasaścetasāmapi  || 08.03.010 ||
sattvena pratilabhyāya naiṣkarmyeṇa vipaścitā  |
namaḥ kaivalyanāthāya nirvāṇasukhasaṃvide  || 08.03.011 ||
namaḥ śāntāya ghorāya mūḍhāya guṇadharmiṇe  |
nirviśeṣāya sāmyāya namo jñānaghanāya ca  || 08.03.012 ||
kṣetrajñāya namastubhyaṃ sarvādhyakṣāya sākṣiṇe  |
puruṣāyātmamūlāya mūlaprakṛtaye namaḥ  || 08.03.013 ||
sarvendriyaguṇadraṣṭre sarvapratyayahetave  |
asatā cchāyayoktāya sadābhāsāya te namaḥ  || 08.03.014 ||
namo namaste'khilakāraṇāya niṣkāraṇāyādbhutakāraṇāya  |
sarvāgamāmnāyamahārṇavāya namo'pavargāya parāyaṇāya  || 08.03.015 ||
guṇāraṇicchannaciduṣmapāya tatkṣobhavisphūrjitamānasāya  |
naiṣkarmyabhāvena vivarjitāgama svayaṃprakāśāya namaskaromi  || 08.03.016 ||
mādṛkprapannapaśupāśavimokṣaṇāya muktāya bhūrikaruṇāya namo'layāya  |
svāṃśena sarvatanubhṛnmanasi pratīta pratyagdṛśe bhagavate bṛhate namaste  || 08.03.017 ||
ātmātmajāptagṛhavittajaneṣu saktairduṣprāpaṇāya guṇasaṅgavivarjitāya  |
muktātmabhiḥ svahṛdaye paribhāvitāya jñānātmane bhagavate nama īśvarāya  || 08.03.018 ||
yaṃ dharmakāmārthavimuktikāmā bhajanta iṣṭāṃ gatimāpnuvanti  |
kiṃ cāśiṣo rātyapi dehamavyayaṃ karotu me'dabhradayo vimokṣaṇam  || 08.03.019 ||
ekāntino yasya na kañcanārthaṃ vāñchanti ye vai bhagavatprapannāḥ  |
atyadbhutaṃ taccaritaṃ sumaṅgalaṃ gāyanta ānandasamudramagnāḥ  || 08.03.020 ||
tamakṣaraṃ brahma paraṃ pareśamavyaktamādhyātmikayogagamyam  |
atīndriyaṃ sūkṣmamivātidūramanantamādyaṃ paripūrṇamīḍe  || 08.03.021 ||
yasya brahmādayo devā vedā lokāścarācarāḥ  |
nāmarūpavibhedena phalgvyā ca kalayā kṛtāḥ  || 08.03.022 ||
yathārciṣo'gneḥ saviturgabhastayo niryānti saṃyāntyasakṛtsvarociṣaḥ  |
tathā yato'yaṃ guṇasampravāho buddhirmanaḥ khāni śarīrasargāḥ  || 08.03.023 ||
sa vai na devāsuramartyatiryaṅna strī na ṣaṇḍho na pumānna jantuḥ  |
nāyaṃ guṇaḥ karma na sanna cāsanniṣedhaśeṣo jayatādaśeṣaḥ  || 08.03.024 ||
jijīviṣe nāhamihāmuyā kimantarbahiścāvṛtayebhayonyā  |
icchāmi kālena na yasya viplavastasyātmalokāvaraṇasya mokṣam  || 08.03.025 ||
so'haṃ viśvasṛjaṃ viśvamaviśvaṃ viśvavedasam  |
viśvātmānamajaṃ brahma praṇato'smi paraṃ padam  || 08.03.026 ||
yogarandhitakarmāṇo hṛdi yogavibhāvite  |
yogino yaṃ prapaśyanti yogeśaṃ taṃ nato'smyaham  || 08.03.027 ||
namo namastubhyamasahyavega śaktitrayāyākhiladhīguṇāya  |
prapannapālāya durantaśaktaye kadindriyāṇāmanavāpyavartmane  || 08.03.028 ||
nāyaṃ veda svamātmānaṃ yacchaktyāhaṃdhiyā hatam  |
taṃ duratyayamāhātmyaṃ bhagavantamito'smyaham  || 08.03.029 ||
08.03.030|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃ gajendramupavarṇitanirviśeṣaṃ   brahmādayo vividhaliṅgabhidābhimānāḥ  |
naite yadopasasṛpurnikhilātmakatvāt  tatrākhilāmaramayo harirāvirāsīt || 08.03.030 ||*
taṃ tadvadārtamupalabhya jagannivāsaḥ   stotraṃ niśamya divijaiḥ saha saṃstuvadbhiḥ  |
chandomayena garuḍena samuhyamānaś  cakrāyudho'bhyagamadāśu yato gajendraḥ  || 08.03.031 ||*
so'ntaḥsarasyurubalena gṛhīta ārto   dṛṣṭvā garutmati hariṃ kha upāttacakram  |
utkṣipya sāmbujakaraṃ giramāha kṛcchrān   nārāyaṇākhilaguro bhagavannamaste  || 08.03.032 ||*
taṃ vīkṣya pīḍitamajaḥ sahasāvatīrya   sagrāhamāśu sarasaḥ kṛpayojjahāra  |
grāhādvipāṭitamukhādariṇā gajendraṃ   saṃpaśyatāṃ hariramūmucaducchriyāṇām  || 08.03.033 ||*
08.04.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
tadā devarṣigandharvā brahmeśānapurogamāḥ  |
mumucuḥ kusumāsāraṃ śaṃsantaḥ karma taddhareḥ  || 08.04.001 ||
nedurdundubhayo divyā gandharvā nanṛturjaguḥ  |
ṛṣayaścāraṇāḥ siddhāstuṣṭuvuḥ puruṣottamam  || 08.04.002 ||
yo'sau grāhaḥ sa vai sadyaḥ paramāścaryarūpadhṛk |
mukto devalaśāpena hūhūrgandharvasattamaḥ  || 08.04.003 ||
praṇamya śirasādhīśamuttamaślokamavyayam  |
agāyata yaśodhāma kīrtanyaguṇasatkatham  || 08.04.004 ||
so'nukampita īśena parikramya praṇamya tam  |
lokasya paśyato lokaṃ svamagānmuktakilbiṣaḥ  || 08.04.005 ||
gajendro bhagavatsparśādvimukto'jñānabandhanāt |
prāpto bhagavato rūpaṃ pītavāsāścaturbhujaḥ  || 08.04.006 ||
sa vai pūrvamabhūdrājā pāṇḍyo draviḍasattamaḥ  |
indradyumna iti khyāto viṣṇuvrataparāyaṇaḥ  || 08.04.007 ||
sa ekadārādhanakāla ātmavān gṛhītamaunavrata īśvaraṃ harim  |
jaṭādharastāpasa āpluto'cyutaṃ samarcayāmāsa kulācalāśramaḥ  || 08.04.008 ||
yadṛcchayā tatra mahāyaśā muniḥ samāgamacchiṣyagaṇaiḥ pariśritaḥ  |
taṃ vīkṣya tūṣṇīmakṛtārhaṇādikaṃ rahasyupāsīnamṛṣiścukopa ha  || 08.04.009 ||
tasmā imaṃ śāpamadādasādhurayaṃ durātmākṛtabuddhiradya  |
viprāvamantā viśatāṃ tamisraṃ yathā gajaḥ stabdhamatiḥ sa eva  || 08.04.010 ||
08.04.011|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃ śaptvā gato'gastyo bhagavānnṛpa sānugaḥ  |
indradyumno'pi rājarṣirdiṣṭaṃ tadupadhārayan  || 08.04.011 ||
āpannaḥ kauñjarīṃ yonimātmasmṛtivināśinīm  |
haryarcanānubhāvena yadgajatve'pyanusmṛtiḥ  || 08.04.012 ||
evaṃ vimokṣya gajayūthapamabjanābhas  tenāpi pārṣadagatiṃ gamitena yuktaḥ  |
gandharvasiddhavibudhairupagīyamāna   karmādbhutaṃ svabhavanaṃ garuḍāsano'gāt || 08.04.013 ||*
etanmahārāja taverito mayā kṛṣṇānubhāvo gajarājamokṣaṇam  |
svargyaṃ yaśasyaṃ kalikalmaṣāpahaṃ duḥsvapnanāśaṃ kuruvarya śṛṇvatām  || 08.04.014 ||
yathānukīrtayantyetacchreyaskāmā dvijātayaḥ  |
śucayaḥ prātarutthāya duḥsvapnādyupaśāntaye  || 08.04.015 ||
idamāha hariḥ prīto gajendraṃ kurusattama  |
śṛṇvatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvabhūtamayo vibhuḥ  || 08.04.016 ||
08.04.017|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
ye māṃ tvāṃ ca saraścedaṃ girikandarakānanam  |
vetrakīcakaveṇūnāṃ gulmāni surapādapān  || 08.04.017 ||
śṛṅgāṇīmāni dhiṣṇyāni brahmaṇo me śivasya ca  |
kṣīrodaṃ me priyaṃ dhāma śvetadvīpaṃ ca bhāsvaram  || 08.04.018 ||
śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ mālāṃ gadāṃ kaumodakīṃ mama  |
sudarśanaṃ pāñcajanyaṃ suparṇaṃ patageśvaram  || 08.04.019 ||
śeṣaṃ ca matkalāṃ sūkṣmāṃ śriyaṃ devīṃ madāśrayām  |
brahmāṇaṃ nāradamṛṣiṃ bhavaṃ prahrādameva ca  || 08.04.020 ||
matsyakūrmavarāhādyairavatāraiḥ kṛtāni me  |

praṇavaṃ satyamavyaktaṃ goviprān dharmamavyayam  |

gaṅgāṃ sarasvatīṃ nandāṃ kālindīṃ sitavāraṇam  |

utthāyāpararātrānte prayatāḥ susamāhitāḥ  |

08.04.026|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ityādiśya hṛṣīkeśaḥ prādhmāya jalajottamam  |

08.05.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
rājannuditametatte hareḥ karmāghanāśanam  |

pañcamo raivato nāma manustāmasasodaraḥ  |

vibhurindraḥ suragaṇā rājan bhūtarayādayaḥ  |

payodhiṃ yena nirmathya surāṇāṃ sādhitā sudhā  |
bhramamāṇo'mbhasi dhṛtaḥ kūrmarūpeṇa mandaraḥ  || 08.05.010 ||
08.05.011|0 śrīrājovāca
yathā bhagavatā brahmanmathitaḥ kṣīrasāgaraḥ  |

08.05.015|0 śrīśuka uvāca
yadā yuddhe'surairdevā badhyamānāḥ śitāyudhaiḥ  |

08.05.024|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ityābhāṣya surān vedhāḥ saha devairarindama  |

08.05.026|0 śrībrahmovāca
avikriyaṃ satyamanantamādyaṃ guhāśayaṃ niṣkalamapratarkyam  |

na yasya kaścātititarti māyāṃ yayā jano muhyati veda nārtham  |

ime vayaṃ yatpriyayaiva tanvā sattvena sṛṣṭā bahirantarāviḥ  |

ambhastu yadreta udāravīryaṃ sidhyanti jīvantyuta vardhamānāḥ  |

agnirmukhaṃ yasya tu jātavedā jātaḥ kriyākāṇḍanimittajanmā  |

prāṇādabhūdyasya carācarāṇāṃ prāṇaḥ saho balamojaśca vāyuḥ  |

śrotrāddiśo yasya hṛdaśca khāni prajajñire khaṃ puruṣasya nābhyāḥ  |

balānmahendrastridaśāḥ prasādānmanyorgirīśo dhiṣaṇādviriñcaḥ  |

śrīrvakṣasaḥ pitaraśchāyayāsan dharmaḥ stanāditaraḥ pṛṣṭhato'bhūt |

vipro mukhādbrahma ca yasya guhyaṃ rājanya āsīdbhujayorbalaṃ ca  |
ūrvorviḍojo'ṅghriravedaśūdrau prasīdatāṃ naḥ sa mahāvibhūtiḥ  || 08.05.041 ||
lobho'dharātprītiruparyabhūddyutirnastaḥ paśavyaḥ sparśena kāmaḥ  |

taistaiḥ svecchābhūtai rūpaiḥ kāle kāle svayaṃ vibho  |
karma durviṣahaṃ yanno bhagavāṃstatkaroti hi  || 08.05.046 ||
kleśabhūryalpasārāṇi karmāṇi viphalāni vā  |
dehināṃ viṣayārtānāṃ na tathaivārpitaṃ tvayi  || 08.05.047 ||
nāvamaḥ karmakalpo'pi viphalāyeśvarārpitaḥ  |
kalpate puruṣasyaiva sa hyātmā dayito hitaḥ  || 08.05.048 ||
yathā hi skandhaśākhānāṃ tarormūlāvasecanam  |

namastubhyamanantāya durvitarkyātmakarmaṇe  |
nirguṇāya guṇeśāya sattvasthāya ca sāmpratam  || 08.05.050 ||
08.06.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃ stutaḥ suragaṇairbhagavān harirīśvaraḥ  |

kāñcīkalāpavalaya hāranūpuraśobhitām  |

08.06.008|0 śrībrahmovāca
ajātajanmasthitisaṃyamāyā guṇāya nirvāṇasukhārṇavāya  |

hanta brahmannaho śambho he devā mama bhāṣitam  |

08.06.026|0 śrīśuka uvāca
iti devān samādiśya bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ  |
teṣāmantardadhe rājan svacchandagatirīśvaraḥ  || 08.06.026 ||

dṛṣṭvārīnapyasaṃyattān jātakṣobhān svanāyakān  |

te vairocanimāsīnaṃ guptaṃ cāsurayūthapaiḥ  |
śriyā paramayā juṣṭaṃ jitāśeṣamupāgaman  || 08.06.029 ||
mahendraḥ ślakṣṇayā vācā sāntvayitvā mahāmatiḥ  |
abhyabhāṣata tatsarvaṃ śikṣitaṃ puruṣottamāt || 08.06.030 ||
tattvarocata daityasya tatrānye ye'surādhipāḥ  |
śambaro'riṣṭanemiśca ye ca tripuravāsinaḥ  || 08.06.031 ||
tato devāsurāḥ kṛtvā saṃvidaṃ kṛtasauhṛdāḥ  |
udyamaṃ paramaṃ cakruramṛtārthe parantapa  || 08.06.032 ||
tataste mandaragirimojasotpāṭya durmadāḥ  |
nadanta udadhiṃ ninyuḥ śaktāḥ parighabāhavaḥ  || 08.06.033 ||
dūrabhārodvahaśrāntāḥ śakravairocanādayaḥ  |
apārayantastaṃ voḍhuṃ vivaśā vijahuḥ pathi  || 08.06.034 ||
nipatan sa giristatra bahūnamaradānavān  |
cūrṇayāmāsa mahatā bhāreṇa kanakācalaḥ  || 08.06.035 ||
tāṃstathā bhagnamanaso bhagnabāhūrukandharān  |
vijñāya bhagavāṃstatra babhūva garuḍadhvajaḥ  || 08.06.036 ||
giripātaviniṣpiṣṭān vilokyāmaradānavān  |
īkṣayā jīvayāmāsa nirjarānnirvraṇān yathā  || 08.06.037 ||
giriṃ cāropya garuḍe hastenaikena līlayā  |
āruhya prayayāvabdhiṃ surāsuragaṇairvṛtaḥ  || 08.06.038 ||
avaropya giriṃ skandhātsuparṇaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ  |

08.07.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
te nāgarājamāmantrya phalabhāgena vāsukim  |
parivīya girau tasminnetramabdhiṃ mudānvitāḥ  || 08.07.001 ||
ārebhire surā yattā amṛtārthe kurūdvaha  |
hariḥ purastājjagṛhe pūrvaṃ devāstato'bhavan  || 08.07.002 ||
tannaicchan daityapatayo mahāpuruṣaceṣṭitam  |
na gṛhṇīmo vayaṃ pucchamaheraṅgamamaṅgalam  || 08.08.003 ||
svādhyāyaśrutasampannāḥ prakhyātā janmakarmabhiḥ  |
iti tūṣṇīṃ sthitān daityān vilokya puruṣottamaḥ  |
smayamāno visṛjyāgraṃ pucchaṃ jagrāha sāmaraḥ  || 08.07.004 ||
kṛtasthānavibhāgāsta evaṃ kaśyapanandanāḥ  |
mamanthuḥ paramaṃ yattā amṛtārthaṃ payonidhim  || 08.07.006 ||
mathyamāne'rṇave so'driranādhāro hyapo'viśat |
dhriyamāṇo'pi balibhirgauravātpāṇḍunandana  || 08.07.007 ||
te sunirviṇṇamanasaḥ parimlānamukhaśriyaḥ  |
āsan svapauruṣe naṣṭe daivenātibalīyasā  || 08.07.008 ||
vilokya vighneśavidhiṃ tadeśvaro durantavīryo'vitathābhisandhiḥ  |
kṛtvā vapuḥ kacchapamadbhutaṃ mahatpraviśya toyaṃ girimujjahāra  || 08.07.009 ||
tamutthitaṃ vīkṣya kulācalaṃ punaḥ samudyatā nirmathituṃ surāsurāḥ  |
dadhāra pṛṣṭhena sa lakṣayojana prastāriṇā dvīpa ivāparo mahān  || 08.07.010 ||
surāsurendrairbhujavīryavepitaṃ paribhramantaṃ girimaṅga pṛṣṭhataḥ  |
bibhrattadāvartanamādikacchapo mene'ṅgakaṇḍūyanamaprameyaḥ  || 08.07.011 ||
tathāsurānāviśadāsureṇa rūpeṇa teṣāṃ balavīryamīrayan  |
uddīpayan devagaṇāṃśca viṣṇurdaivena nāgendramabodharūpaḥ  || 08.07.012 ||
uparyagendraṃ girirāḍivānya ākramya hastena sahasrabāhuḥ  |
tasthau divi brahmabhavendramukhyairabhiṣṭuvadbhiḥ sumano'bhivṛṣṭaḥ  || 08.07.013 ||
uparyadhaścātmani gotranetrayoḥ pareṇa te prāviśatā samedhitāḥ  |
mamanthurabdhiṃ tarasā madotkaṭā mahādriṇā kṣobhitanakracakram  || 08.07.014 ||
ahīndrasāhasrakaṭhoradṛṅmukha śvāsāgnidhūmāhatavarcaso'surāḥ  |

devāṃśca tacchvāsaśikhāhataprabhān dhūmrāmbarasragvarakañcukānanān  |

mathyamānāttathā sindhordevāsuravarūthapaiḥ  |

tadugravegaṃ diśi diśyuparyadho visarpadutsarpadasahyamaprati  |

08.07.022|0 śrīprajāpataya ūcuḥ

tvaṃ brahma paramaṃ guhyaṃ sadasadbhāvabhāvanam  |

tvaṃ śabdayonirjagadādirātmā prāṇendriyadravyaguṇaḥ svabhāvaḥ  |

mukhāni pañcopaniṣadastaveśa yaistriṃśadaṣṭottaramantravargaḥ  |

na te giritrākhilalokapāla viriñcavaikuṇṭhasurendragamyam  |

kāmādhvaratripurakālagarādyaneka   bhūtadruhaḥ kṣapayataḥ stutaye na tatte  |

ye tvātmarāmagurubhirhṛdi cintitāṅghri   dvandvaṃ carantamumayā tapasābhitaptam  |

mṛḍanāya hi lokasya vyaktiste'vyaktakarmaṇaḥ  || 08.07.036 ||
08.07.037|0 śrīśuka uvāca
tadvīkṣya vyasanaṃ tāsāṃ kṛpayā bhṛśapīḍitaḥ  |
sarvabhūtasuhṛddeva idamāha satīṃ priyām  || 08.07.037 ||
08.07.038|0 śrīśiva uvāca
aho bata bhavānyetatprajānāṃ paśya vaiśasam  |

āsāṃ prāṇaparīpsūnāṃ vidheyamabhayaṃ hi me  |

prāṇaiḥ svaiḥ prāṇinaḥ pānti sādhavaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅguraiḥ  |

08.07.042|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evamāmantrya bhagavān bhavānīṃ viśvabhāvanaḥ  |

tataḥ karatalīkṛtya vyāpi hālāhalaṃ viṣam  |
abhakṣayanmahādevaḥ kṛpayā bhūtabhāvanaḥ  || 08.07.043 ||

niśamya karma tacchambhordevadevasya mīḍhuṣaḥ  |

praskannaṃ pibataḥ pāṇeryatkiñcijjagṛhuḥ sma tat |

08.08.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
pīte gare vṛṣāṅkeṇa prītāste'maradānavāḥ  |
mamanthustarasā sindhuṃ havirdhānī tato'bhavat || 08.08.001 ||
tāmagnihotrīmṛṣayo jagṛhurbrahmavādinaḥ  |
yajñasya devayānasya medhyāya haviṣe nṛpa  || 08.08.002 ||
tata uccaiḥśravā nāma hayo'bhūccandrapāṇḍuraḥ  |
tasmin baliḥ spṛhāṃ cakre nendra īśvaraśikṣayā  || 08.08.003 ||
tata airāvato nāma vāraṇendro vinirgataḥ  |
dantaiścaturbhiḥ śvetādrerharan bhagavato mahim  || 08.08.004 ||
airāvaṇādayastvaṣṭau diggajā abhavaṃstataḥ  |
abhramuprabhṛtayo'ṣṭau ca kariṇyastvabhavannṛpa  || 08.08.005 ||
kaustubhākhyamabhūdratnaṃ padmarāgo mahodadheḥ  |
tasminmaṇau spṛhāṃ cakre vakṣo'laṅkaraṇe hariḥ  || 08.08.006 ||
tato'bhavatpārijātaḥ suralokavibhūṣaṇam  |
pūrayatyarthino yo'rthaiḥ śaśvadbhuvi yathā bhavān  || 08.08.007 ||
tataścāpsaraso jātā niṣkakaṇṭhyaḥ suvāsasaḥ  |
ramaṇyaḥ svargiṇāṃ valgu gatilīlāvalokanaiḥ  || 08.08.008 ||
tataścāvirabhūtsākṣācchrī ramā bhagavatparā  |
rañjayantī diśaḥ kāntyā vidyutsaudāmanī yathā  || 08.08.009 ||
tasyāṃ cakruḥ spṛhāṃ sarve sasurāsuramānavāḥ  |
rūpaudāryavayovarṇa mahimākṣiptacetasaḥ  || 08.08.010 ||
tasyā āsanamāninye mahendro mahadadbhutam  |
mūrtimatyaḥ saricchreṣṭhā hemakumbhairjalaṃ śuci  || 08.08.011 ||
ābhiṣecanikā bhūmirāharatsakalauṣadhīḥ  |
gāvaḥ pañca pavitrāṇi vasanto madhumādhavau  || 08.08.012 ||
ṛṣayaḥ kalpayāṃ cakrurābhiṣekaṃ yathāvidhi  |
jagurbhadrāṇi gandharvā naṭyaśca nanṛturjaguḥ  || 08.08.013 ||
meghā mṛdaṅgapaṇava murajānakagomukhān  |
vyanādayan śaṅkhaveṇu vīṇāstumulaniḥsvanān  || 08.08.014 ||
tato'bhiṣiṣicurdevīṃ śriyaṃ padmakarāṃ satīm  |
digibhāḥ pūrṇakalaśaiḥ sūktavākyairdvijeritaiḥ  || 08.08.015 ||
samudraḥ pītakauśeya vāsasī samupāharat |
varuṇaḥ srajaṃ vaijayantīṃ madhunā mattaṣaṭpadām  || 08.08.016 ||
bhūṣaṇāni vicitrāṇi viśvakarmā prajāpatiḥ  |
hāraṃ sarasvatī padmamajo nāgāśca kuṇḍale  || 08.08.017 ||
tataḥ kṛtasvastyayanotpalasrajaṃ nadaddvirephāṃ parigṛhya pāṇinā  |

stanadvayaṃ cātikṛśodarī samaṃ nirantaraṃ candanakuṅkumokṣitam  |

vilokayantī niravadyamātmanaḥ padaṃ dhruvaṃ cāvyabhicārisadguṇam  |

nūnaṃ tapo yasya na manyunirjayo jñānaṃ kvacittacca na saṅgavarjitam  |

dharmaḥ kvacittatra na bhūtasauhṛdaṃ tyāgaḥ kvacittatra na muktikāraṇam  |
vīryaṃ na puṃso'styajaveganiṣkṛtaṃ na hi dvitīyo guṇasaṅgavarjitaḥ  || 08.08.022 ||
kvaciccirāyurna hi śīlamaṅgalaṃ kvacittadapyasti na vedyamāyuṣaḥ  |
yatrobhayaṃ kutra ca so'pyamaṅgalaḥ sumaṅgalaḥ kaśca na kāṅkṣate hi mām  || 08.08.023 ||
evaṃ vimṛśyāvyabhicārisadguṇairvaraṃ nijaikāśrayatayāguṇāśrayam  |

tasyāṃsadeśa uśatīṃ navakañjamālāṃ   mādyanmadhuvratavarūthagiropaghuṣṭām  |
tasthau nidhāya nikaṭe taduraḥ svadhāma   savrīḍahāsavikasannayanena yātā  || 08.08.025 ||*
tasyāḥ śriyastrijagato janako jananyā   vakṣo nivāsamakarotparamaṃ vibhūteḥ  |
śrīḥ svāḥ prajāḥ sakaruṇena nirīkṣaṇena   yatra sthitaidhayata sādhipatīṃstrilokān  || 08.08.026 ||*
śaṅkhatūryamṛdaṅgānāṃ vāditrāṇāṃ pṛthuḥ svanaḥ  |
devānugānāṃ sastrīṇāṃ nṛtyatāṃ gāyatāmabhūt || 08.08.027 ||
brahmarudrāṅgiromukhyāḥ sarve viśvasṛjo vibhum  |
īḍire'vitathairmantraistalliṅgaiḥ puṣpavarṣiṇaḥ  || 08.08.028 ||
śriyāvalokitā devāḥ saprajāpatayaḥ prajāḥ  |
śīlādiguṇasampannā lebhire nirvṛtiṃ parām  || 08.08.029 ||
niḥsattvā lolupā rājannirudyogā gatatrapāḥ  |
yadā copekṣitā lakṣmyā babhūvurdaityadānavāḥ  || 08.08.030 ||
athāsīdvāruṇī devī kanyā kamalalocanā  |
asurā jagṛhustāṃ vai hareranumatena te  || 08.08.031 ||
athodadhermathyamānātkāśyapairamṛtārthibhiḥ  |
udatiṣṭhanmahārāja puruṣaḥ paramādbhutaḥ  || 08.08.032 ||
dīrghapīvaradordaṇḍaḥ kambugrīvo'ruṇekṣaṇaḥ  |
śyāmalastaruṇaḥ sragvī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ  || 08.08.033 ||
pītavāsā mahoraskaḥ sumṛṣṭamaṇikuṇḍalaḥ  |
snigdhakuñcitakeśānta subhagaḥ siṃhavikramaḥ  || 08.08.034 ||
amṛtāpūrṇakalasaṃ bibhradvalayabhūṣitaḥ  |
sa vai bhagavataḥ sākṣādviṣṇoraṃśāṃśasambhavaḥ  || 08.08.035 ||
dhanvantaririti khyāta āyurvedadṛgijyabhāk |
tamālokyāsurāḥ sarve kalasaṃ cāmṛtābhṛtam  || 08.08.036 ||
lipsantaḥ sarvavastūni kalasaṃ tarasāharan  |
nīyamāne'suraistasmin kalase'mṛtabhājane  || 08.08.037 ||
viṣaṇṇamanaso devā hariṃ śaraṇamāyayuḥ  |
iti taddainyamālokya bhagavān bhṛtyakāmakṛt |
mā khidyata mitho'rthaṃ vaḥ sādhayiṣye svamāyayā  || 08.08.038 ||
mithaḥ kalirabhūtteṣāṃ tadarthe tarṣacetasām  |
ahaṃ pūrvamahaṃ pūrvaṃ na tvaṃ na tvamiti prabho  || 08.08.039 ||
devāḥ svaṃ bhāgamarhanti ye tulyāyāsahetavaḥ  |
satrayāga ivaitasminneṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ  || 08.08.040 ||
iti svān pratyaṣedhan vai daiteyā jātamatsarāḥ  |
durbalāḥ prabalān rājan gṛhītakalasānmuhuḥ  || 08.08.041 ||
etasminnantare viṣṇuḥ sarvopāyavidīśvaraḥ  |
yoṣidrūpamanirdeśyaṃ dadhāraparamādbhutam  || 08.08.042 ||
prekṣaṇīyotpalaśyāmaṃ sarvāvayavasundaram  |
samānakarṇābharaṇaṃ sukapolonnasānanam  || 08.08.043 ||
navayauvananirvṛtta stanabhārakṛśodaram  |
mukhāmodānuraktāli jhaṅkārodvignalocanam  || 08.08.044 ||
bibhratsukeśabhāreṇa mālāmutphullamallikām  |
sugrīvakaṇṭhābharaṇaṃ subhujāṅgadabhūṣitam  || 08.08.045 ||
virajāmbarasaṃvīta nitambadvīpaśobhayā  |
kāñcyā pravilasadvalgu calaccaraṇanūpuram  || 08.08.046 ||
savrīḍasmitavikṣipta bhrūvilāsāvalokanaiḥ  |
daityayūthapacetaḥsu kāmamuddīpayanmuhuḥ  || 08.08.047 ||
08.09.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
te'nyonyato'surāḥ pātraṃ harantastyaktasauhṛdāḥ  |

ityupāmantrito daityairmāyāyoṣidvapurhariḥ  |

08.09.009|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
kathaṃ kaśyapadāyādāḥ puṃścalyāṃ mayi saṅgatāḥ  |

08.09.011|0 śrīśuka uvāca

tasyāṃ narendra karabhoruruśaddukūla śroṇītaṭālasagatirmadavihvalākṣī  |

asurāṇāṃ sudhādānaṃ sarpāṇāmiva durnayam  |
matvā jātinṛśaṃsānāṃ na tāṃ vyabhajadacyutaḥ  || 08.09.019 ||
kalpayitvā pṛthakpaṅktīrubhayeṣāṃ jagatpatiḥ  |

daityān gṛhītakalaso vañcayannupasañcaraiḥ  |
dūrasthān pāyayāmāsajarāmṛtyuharāṃ sudhām  || 08.09.021 ||
te pālayantaḥ samayamasurāḥ svakṛtaṃ nṛpa  |
tūṣṇīmāsan kṛtasnehāḥ strīvivādajugupsayā  || 08.09.022 ||
tasyāṃ kṛtātipraṇayāḥ praṇayāpāyakātarāḥ  |
bahumānena cābaddhā nocuḥ kiñcana vipriyam  || 08.09.023 ||
devaliṅgapraticchannaḥ svarbhānurdevasaṃsadi  |

cakreṇa kṣuradhāreṇa jahāra pibataḥ śiraḥ  |
haristasya kabandhastu sudhayāplāvito'patat || 08.09.025 ||
śirastvamaratāṃ nītamajo grahamacīkḷpat |
yastu parvaṇi candrārkāvabhidhāvati vairadhīḥ  || 08.09.026 ||
pītaprāye'mṛte devairbhagavān lokabhāvanaḥ  |
paśyatāmasurendrāṇāṃ svaṃ rūpaṃ jagṛhe hariḥ  || 08.09.027 ||
evaṃ surāsuragaṇāḥ samadeśakāla    hetvarthakarmamatayo'pi phale vikalpāḥ  |
tatrāmṛtaṃ suragaṇāḥ phalamañjasāpur  yatpādapaṅkajarajaḥśrayaṇānna daityāḥ  || 08.09.028 ||*
yadyujyate'suvasukarmamanovacobhir  dehātmajādiṣu nṛbhistadasatpṛthaktvāt |
taireva sadbhavati yatkriyate'pṛthaktvāt  sarvasya tadbhavati mūlaniṣecanaṃ yat || 08.09.029 ||*
08.10.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
iti dānavadaiteyā nāvindannamṛtaṃ nṛpa  |
yuktāḥ karmaṇi yattāśca vāsudevaparāṅmukhāḥ  || 08.10.001 ||
sādhayitvāmṛtaṃ rājan pāyayitvā svakān surān  |
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yayau garuḍavāhanaḥ  || 08.10.002 ||
sapatnānāṃ parāmṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā te ditinandanāḥ  |
amṛṣyamāṇā utpeturdevān pratyudyatāyudhāḥ  || 08.10.003 ||
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve sudhayā pītayaidhitāḥ  |
pratisaṃyuyudhuḥ śastrairnārāyaṇapadāśrayāḥ  || 08.10.004 ||
tatra daivāsuro nāma raṇaḥ paramadāruṇaḥ  |
rodhasyudanvato rājaṃstumulo romaharṣaṇaḥ  || 08.10.005 ||
tatrānyonyaṃ sapatnāste saṃrabdhamanaso raṇe  |
samāsādyāsibhirbāṇairnijaghnurvividhāyudhaiḥ  || 08.10.006 ||
śaṅkhatūryamṛdaṅgānāṃ bherīḍamariṇāṃ mahān  |
hastyaśvarathapattīnāṃ nadatāṃ nisvano'bhavat || 08.10.007 ||
rathino rathibhistatra pattibhiḥ saha pattayaḥ  |
hayā hayairibhāścebhaiḥ samasajjanta saṃyuge  || 08.10.008 ||
uṣṭraiḥ kecidibhaiḥ kecidapare yuyudhuḥ kharaiḥ  |
kecidgauramukhairṛkṣairdvīpibhirharibhirbhaṭāḥ  || 08.10.009 ||
gṛdhraiḥ kaṅkairbakairanye śyenabhāsaistimiṅgilaiḥ  |
śarabhairmahiṣaiḥ khaḍgairgovṛṣairgavayāruṇaiḥ  || 08.10.010 ||
śivābhirākhubhiḥ kecitkṛkalāsaiḥ śaśairnaraiḥ  |
bastaireke kṛṣṇasārairhaṃsairanye ca sūkaraiḥ  || 08.10.011 ||
anye jalasthalakhagaiḥ sattvairvikṛtavigrahaiḥ  |
senayorubhayo rājan viviśuste'grato'grataḥ  || 08.10.012 ||
citradhvajapaṭai rājannātapatraiḥ sitāmalaiḥ  |
mahādhanairvajradaṇḍairvyajanairbārhacāmaraiḥ  || 08.10.013 ||
vātoddhūtottaroṣṇīṣairarcirbhirvarmabhūṣaṇaiḥ  |
sphuradbhirviśadaiḥ śastraiḥ sutarāṃ sūryaraśmibhiḥ  || 08.10.014 ||
devadānavavīrāṇāṃ dhvajinyau pāṇḍunandana  |
rejaturvīramālābhiryādasāmiva sāgarau  || 08.10.015 ||
vairocano baliḥ saṅkhye so'surāṇāṃ camūpatiḥ  |
yānaṃ vaihāyasaṃ nāma kāmagaṃ mayanirmitam  || 08.10.016 ||
sarvasāṅgrāmikopetaṃ sarvāścaryamayaṃ prabho  |
apratarkyamanirdeśyaṃ dṛśyamānamadarśanam  || 08.10.017 ||
āsthitastadvimānāgryaṃ sarvānīkādhipairvṛtaḥ  |
bālavyajanachatrāgryai reje candra ivodaye  || 08.10.018 ||
tasyāsan sarvato yānairyūthānāṃ patayo'surāḥ  |
namuciḥ śambaro bāṇo vipracittirayomukhaḥ  || 08.10.019 ||
dvimūrdhā kālanābho'tha prahetirhetirilvalaḥ  |
śakunirbhūtasantāpo vajradaṃṣṭro virocanaḥ  || 08.10.020 ||
hayagrīvaḥ śaṅkuśirāḥ kapilo meghadundubhiḥ  |
tārakaścakradṛkśumbho niśumbho jambha utkalaḥ  || 08.10.021 ||
ariṣṭo'riṣṭanemiśca mayaśca tripurādhipaḥ  |
anye paulomakāleyā nivātakavacādayaḥ  || 08.10.022 ||
alabdhabhāgāḥ somasya kevalaṃ kleśabhāginaḥ  |
sarva ete raṇamukhe bahuśo nirjitāmarāḥ  || 08.10.023 ||
siṃhanādān vimuñcantaḥ śaṅkhān dadhmurmahāravān  |
dṛṣṭvā sapatnānutsiktān balabhitkupito bhṛśam  || 08.10.024 ||
airāvataṃ dikkariṇamārūḍhaḥ śuśubhe svarāṭ |
yathā sravatprasravaṇamudayādrimaharpatiḥ  || 08.10.025 ||
tasyāsan sarvato devā nānāvāhadhvajāyudhāḥ  |
lokapālāḥ sahagaṇairvāyvagnivaruṇādayaḥ  || 08.10.026 ||
te'nyonyamabhisaṃsṛtya kṣipanto marmabhirmithaḥ  |
āhvayanto viśanto'gre yuyudhurdvandvayodhinaḥ  || 08.10.027 ||
yuyodha balirindreṇa tārakeṇa guho'syata  |
varuṇo hetināyudhyanmitro rājan prahetinā  || 08.10.028 ||
yamastu kālanābhena viśvakarmā mayena vai  |
śambaro yuyudhe tvaṣṭrā savitrā tu virocanaḥ  || 08.10.029 ||
aparājitena namuciraśvinau vṛṣaparvaṇā  |
sūryo balisutairdevo bāṇajyeṣṭhaiḥ śatena ca  || 08.10.030 ||
rāhuṇā ca tathā somaḥ pulomnā yuyudhe'nilaḥ  |
niśumbhaśumbhayordevī bhadrakālī tarasvinī  || 08.10.031 ||
vṛṣākapistu jambhena mahiṣeṇa vibhāvasuḥ  |
ilvalaḥ saha vātāpirbrahmaputrairarindama  || 08.10.032 ||
kāmadevena durmarṣa utkalo mātṛbhiḥ saha  |
bṛhaspatiścośanasā narakeṇa śanaiścaraḥ  || 08.10.033 ||
maruto nivātakavacaiḥ kāleyairvasavo'marāḥ  |
viśvedevāstu paulomai rudrāḥ krodhavaśaiḥ saha  || 08.10.034 ||
ta evamājāvasurāḥ surendrā dvandvena saṃhatya ca yudhyamānāḥ  |
anyonyamāsādya nijaghnurojasā jigīṣavastīkṣṇaśarāsitomaraiḥ  || 08.10.035 ||
bhuśuṇḍibhiścakragadarṣṭipaṭṭiśaiḥ śaktyulmukaiḥ prāsaparaśvadhairapi  |
nistriṃśabhallaiḥ parighaiḥ samudgaraiḥ sabhindipālaiśca śirāṃsi cicchiduḥ  || 08.10.036 ||
gajāsturaṅgāḥ sarathāḥ padātayaḥ sārohavāhā vividhā vikhaṇḍitāḥ  |
nikṛttabāhūruśirodharāṅghrayaśchinnadhvajeṣvāsatanutrabhūṣaṇāḥ  || 08.10.037 ||
teṣāṃ padāghātarathāṅgacūrṇitādāyodhanādulbaṇa utthitastadā  |
reṇurdiśaḥ khaṃ dyumaṇiṃ ca chādayannyavartatāsṛksrutibhiḥ pariplutāt || 08.10.038 ||
śirobhiruddhūtakirīṭakuṇḍalaiḥ saṃrambhadṛgbhiḥ paridaṣṭadacchadaiḥ  |
mahābhujaiḥ sābharaṇaiḥ sahāyudhaiḥ sā prāstṛtā bhūḥ karabhorubhirbabhau  || 08.10.039 ||
kabandhāstatra cotpetuḥ patitasvaśiro'kṣibhiḥ  |
udyatāyudhadordaṇḍairādhāvanto bhaṭānmṛdhe  || 08.10.040 ||
balirmahendraṃ daśabhistribhirairāvataṃ śaraiḥ  |
caturbhiścaturo vāhānekenārohamārcchayat || 08.10.041 ||
sa tānāpatataḥ śakrastāvadbhiḥ śīghravikramaḥ  |
ciccheda niśitairbhallairasamprāptān hasanniva  || 08.10.042 ||
tasya karmottamaṃ vīkṣya durmarṣaḥ śaktimādade  |
tāṃ jvalantīṃ maholkābhāṃ hastasthāmacchinaddhariḥ  || 08.10.043 ||
tataḥ śūlaṃ tataḥ prāsaṃ tatastomaramṛṣṭayaḥ  |
yadyacchastraṃ samādadyātsarvaṃ tadacchinadvibhuḥ  || 08.10.044 ||
sasarjāthāsurīṃ māyāmantardhānagato'suraḥ  |
tataḥ prādurabhūcchailaḥ surānīkopari prabho  || 08.10.045 ||
tato nipetustaravo dahyamānā davāgninā  |
śilāḥ saṭaṅkaśikharāścūrṇayantyo dviṣadbalam  || 08.10.046 ||
mahoragāḥ samutpeturdandaśūkāḥ savṛścikāḥ  |
siṃhavyāghravarāhāśca mardayanto mahāgajāḥ  || 08.10.047 ||
yātudhānyaśca śataśaḥ śūlahastā vivāsasaḥ  |
chindhi bhindhīti vādinyastathā rakṣogaṇāḥ prabho  || 08.10.048 ||
tato mahāghanā vyomni gambhīraparuṣasvanāḥ  |
aṅgārānmumucurvātairāhatāḥ stanayitnavaḥ  || 08.10.049 ||
sṛṣṭo daityena sumahān vahniḥ śvasanasārathiḥ  |
sāṃvartaka ivātyugro vibudhadhvajinīmadhāk || 08.10.050 ||
tataḥ samudra udvelaḥ sarvataḥ pratyadṛśyata  |
pracaṇḍavātairuddhūta taraṅgāvartabhīṣaṇaḥ  || 08.10.051 ||
evaṃ daityairmahāmāyairalakṣyagatibhī raṇe  |
sṛjyamānāsu māyāsu viṣeduḥ surasainikāḥ  || 08.10.052 ||
na tatpratividhiṃ yatra vidurindrādayo nṛpa  |
dhyātaḥ prādurabhūttatra bhagavān viśvabhāvanaḥ  || 08.10.053 ||
tataḥ suparṇāṃsakṛtāṅghripallavaḥ piśaṅgavāsā navakañjalocanaḥ  |
adṛśyatāṣṭāyudhabāhurullasacchrīkaustubhānarghyakirīṭakuṇḍalaḥ  || 08.10.054 ||
tasmin praviṣṭe'surakūṭakarmajā māyā vineśurmahinā mahīyasaḥ  |
svapno yathā hi pratibodha āgate harismṛtiḥ sarvavipadvimokṣaṇam  || 08.10.055 ||
dṛṣṭvā mṛdhe garuḍavāhamibhārivāha āvidhya śūlamahinodatha kālanemiḥ  |
tallīlayā garuḍamūrdhni patadgṛhītvā tenāhanannṛpa savāhamariṃ tryadhīśaḥ  || 08.10.056 ||
mālī sumālyatibalau yudhi petaturyaccakreṇa kṛttaśirasāvatha mālyavāṃstam  |
āhatya tigmagadayāhanadaṇḍajendraṃ tāvacchiro'cchinadarernadato'riṇādyaḥ  || 08.10.057 ||
08.11.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
atho surāḥ pratyupalabdhacetasaḥ parasya puṃsaḥ parayānukampayā  |
jaghnurbhṛśaṃ śakrasamīraṇādayastāṃstān raṇe yairabhisaṃhatāḥ purā  || 08.11.001 ||
vairocanāya saṃrabdho bhagavān pākaśāsanaḥ  |
udayacchadyadā vajraṃ prajā hā heti cukruśuḥ  || 08.11.002 ||
vajrapāṇistamāhedaṃ tiraskṛtya puraḥsthitam  |
manasvinaṃ susampannaṃ vicarantaṃ mahāmṛdhe  || 08.11.003 ||
naṭavanmūḍha māyābhirmāyeśānno jigīṣasi  |
jitvā bālānnibaddhākṣānnaṭo harati taddhanam  || 08.11.004 ||
ārurukṣanti māyābhirutsisṛpsanti ye divam  |
tān dasyūn vidhunomyajñān pūrvasmācca padādadhaḥ  || 08.11.005 ||
so'haṃ durmāyinaste'dya vajreṇa śataparvaṇā  |
śiro hariṣye mandātmanghaṭasva jñātibhiḥ saha  || 08.11.006 ||
08.11.007|0 śrībaliruvāca
saṅgrāme vartamānānāṃ kālacoditakarmaṇām  |
kīrtirjayo'jayo mṛtyuḥ sarveṣāṃ syuranukramāt || 08.11.007 ||
tadidaṃ kālaraśanaṃ jagatpaśyanti sūrayaḥ  |
na hṛṣyanti na śocanti tatra yūyamapaṇḍitāḥ  || 08.11.008 ||
na vayaṃ manyamānānāmātmānaṃ tatra sādhanam  |
giro vaḥ sādhuśocyānāṃ gṛhṇīmo marmatāḍanāḥ  || 08.11.009 ||
08.11.010|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ityākṣipya vibhuṃ vīro nārācairvīramardanaḥ  |
ākarṇapūrṇairahanadākṣepairāha taṃ punaḥ  || 08.11.010 ||
evaṃ nirākṛto devo vairiṇā tathyavādinā  |
nāmṛṣyattadadhikṣepaṃ totrāhata iva dvipaḥ  || 08.11.011 ||
prāharatkuliśaṃ tasmā amoghaṃ paramardanaḥ  |
sayāno nyapatadbhūmau chinnapakṣa ivācalaḥ  || 08.11.012 ||
sakhāyaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā jambho balisakhaḥ suhṛt |
abhyayātsauhṛdaṃ sakhyurhatasyāpi samācaran  || 08.11.013 ||
sa siṃhavāha āsādya gadāmudyamya raṃhasā  |
jatrāvatāḍayacchakraṃ gajaṃ ca sumahābalaḥ  || 08.11.014 ||
gadāprahāravyathito bhṛśaṃ vihvalito gajaḥ  |
jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ spṛṣṭvā kaśmalaṃ paramaṃ yayau  || 08.11.015 ||
tato ratho mātalinā haribhirdaśaśatairvṛtaḥ  |
ānīto dvipamutsṛjya rathamāruruhe vibhuḥ  || 08.11.016 ||
tasya tatpūjayan karma yanturdānavasattamaḥ  |
śūlena jvalatā taṃ tu smayamāno'hananmṛdhe  || 08.11.017 ||
sehe rujaṃ sudurmarṣāṃ sattvamālambya mātaliḥ  |
indro jambhasya saṅkruddho vajreṇāpāharacchiraḥ  || 08.11.018 ||
jambhaṃ śrutvā hataṃ tasya jñātayo nāradādṛṣeḥ  |
namuciśca balaḥ pākastatrāpetustvarānvitāḥ  || 08.11.019 ||
vacobhiḥ paruṣairindramardayanto'sya marmasu  |
śarairavākiranmeghā dhārābhiriva parvatam  || 08.11.020 ||
harīn daśaśatānyājau haryaśvasya balaḥ śaraiḥ  |
tāvadbhirardayāmāsa yugapallaghuhastavān  || 08.11.021 ||
śatābhyāṃ mātaliṃ pāko rathaṃ sāvayavaṃ pṛthak |
sakṛtsandhānamokṣeṇa tadadbhutamabhūdraṇe  || 08.11.022 ||
namuciḥ pañcadaśabhiḥ svarṇapuṅkhairmaheṣubhiḥ  |
āhatya vyanadatsaṅkhye satoya iva toyadaḥ  || 08.11.023 ||
sarvataḥ śarakūṭena śakraṃ sarathasārathim  |
chādayāmāsurasurāḥ prāvṛṭsūryamivāmbudāḥ  || 08.11.024 ||
alakṣayantastamatīva vihvalā vicukruśurdevagaṇāḥ sahānugāḥ  |
anāyakāḥ śatrubalena nirjitā vaṇikpathā bhinnanavo yathārṇave  || 08.11.025 ||
tatasturāṣāḍiṣubaddhapañjarādvinirgataḥ sāśvarathadhvajāgraṇīḥ  |
babhau diśaḥ khaṃ pṛthivīṃ ca rocayan svatejasā sūrya iva kṣapātyaye  || 08.11.026 ||
nirīkṣya pṛtanāṃ devaḥ parairabhyarditāṃ raṇe  |
udayacchadripuṃ hantuṃ vajraṃ vajradharo ruṣā  || 08.11.027 ||
sa tenaivāṣṭadhāreṇa śirasī balapākayoḥ  |
jñātīnāṃ paśyatāṃ rājan jahāra janayan bhayam  || 08.11.028 ||
namucistadvadhaṃ dṛṣṭvā śokāmarṣaruṣānvitaḥ  |
jighāṃsurindraṃ nṛpate cakāra paramodyamam  || 08.11.029 ||
aśmasāramayaṃ śūlaṃ ghaṇṭāvaddhemabhūṣaṇam  |
pragṛhyābhyadravatkruddho hato'sīti vitarjayan  |
prāhiṇoddevarājāya ninadanmṛgarāḍiva  || 08.11.030 ||
tadāpatadgaganatale mahājavaṃ vicicchide haririṣubhiḥ sahasradhā  |
tamāhanannṛpa kuliśena kandhare ruṣānvitastridaśapatiḥ śiro haran  || 08.11.031 ||
na tasya hi tvacamapi vajra ūrjito bibheda yaḥ surapatinaujaseritaḥ  |
tadadbhutaṃ paramativīryavṛtrabhittiraskṛto namuciśirodharatvacā  || 08.11.032 ||
tasmādindro'bibhecchatrorvajraḥ pratihato yataḥ  |
kimidaṃ daivayogena bhūtaṃ lokavimohanam  || 08.11.033 ||
yena me pūrvamadrīṇāṃ pakṣacchedaḥ prajātyaye  |
kṛto niviśatāṃ bhāraiḥ patattraiḥ patatāṃ bhuvi  || 08.11.034 ||
tapaḥsāramayaṃ tvāṣṭraṃ vṛtro yena vipāṭitaḥ  |
anye cāpi balopetāḥ sarvāstrairakṣatatvacaḥ  || 08.11.035 ||
so'yaṃ pratihato vajro mayā mukto'sure'lpake  |
nāhaṃ tadādade daṇḍaṃ brahmatejo'pyakāraṇam  || 08.11.036 ||
iti śakraṃ viṣīdantamāha vāgaśarīriṇī  |
nāyaṃ śuṣkairatho nārdrairvadhamarhati dānavaḥ  || 08.11.037 ||
mayāsmai yadvaro datto mṛtyurnaivārdraśuṣkayoḥ  |
ato'nyaścintanīyaste upāyo maghavan ripoḥ  || 08.11.038 ||
tāṃ daivīṃ giramākarṇya maghavān susamāhitaḥ  |
dhyāyan phenamathāpaśyadupāyamubhayātmakam  || 08.11.039 ||
na śuṣkeṇa na cārdreṇa jahāra namuceḥ śiraḥ  |
taṃ tuṣṭuvurmunigaṇā mālyaiścāvākiran vibhum  || 08.11.040 ||
gandharvamukhyau jagaturviśvāvasuparāvasū  |
devadundubhayo nedurnartakyo nanṛturmudā  || 08.11.041 ||
anye'pyevaṃ pratidvandvān vāyvagnivaruṇādayaḥ  |
sūdayāmāsurasurānmṛgān kesariṇo yathā  || 08.11.042 ||
brahmaṇā preṣito devān devarṣirnārado nṛpa  |
vārayāmāsa vibudhān dṛṣṭvā dānavasaṅkṣayam  || 08.11.043 ||
08.11.044|0 śrīnārada uvāca
bhavadbhiramṛtaṃ prāptaṃ nārāyaṇabhujāśrayaiḥ  |
śriyā samedhitāḥ sarva upāramata vigrahāt || 08.11.044 ||
08.11.045|0 śrīśuka uvāca
saṃyamya manyusaṃrambhaṃ mānayanto munervacaḥ  |
upagīyamānānucarairyayuḥ sarve triviṣṭapam  || 08.11.045 ||
ye'vaśiṣṭā raṇe tasminnāradānumatena te  |
baliṃ vipannamādāya astaṃ girimupāgaman  || 08.11.046 ||
tatrāvinaṣṭāvayavān vidyamānaśirodharān  |
uśanā jīvayāmāsa saṃjīvanyā svavidyayā  || 08.11.047 ||
baliścośanasā spṛṣṭaḥ pratyāpannendriyasmṛtiḥ  |
parājito'pi nākhidyallokatattvavicakṣaṇaḥ  || 08.11.048 ||
08.12.001|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
vṛṣadhvajo niśamyedaṃ yoṣidrūpeṇa dānavān  |
mohayitvā suragaṇān hariḥ somamapāyayat || 08.12.001 ||
vṛṣamāruhya giriśaḥ sarvabhūtagaṇairvṛtaḥ  |
saha devyā yayau draṣṭuṃ yatrāste madhusūdanaḥ  || 08.12.002 ||
sabhājito bhagavatā sādaraṃ somayā bhavaḥ  |
sūpaviṣṭa uvācedaṃ pratipūjya smayan harim  || 08.12.003 ||
08.12.004|0 śrīmahādeva uvāca
devadeva jagadvyāpin jagadīśa jaganmaya  |
sarveṣāmapi bhāvānāṃ tvamātmā heturīśvaraḥ  || 08.12.004 ||
ādyantāvasya yanmadhyamidamanyadahaṃ bahiḥ  |
yato'vyayasya naitāni tatsatyaṃ brahma cidbhavān  || 08.12.005 ||
tavaiva caraṇāmbhojaṃ śreyaskāmā nirāśiṣaḥ  |
visṛjyobhayataḥ saṅgaṃ munayaḥ samupāsate  || 08.12.006 ||
tvaṃ brahma pūrṇamamṛtaṃ viguṇaṃ viśokam   ānandamātramavikāramananyadanyat |

tvāṃ brahma kecidavayantyuta dharmameke   eke paraṃ sadasatoḥ puruṣaṃ pareśam  |

avatārā mayā dṛṣṭā ramamāṇasya te guṇaiḥ  |

08.12.017|0 śrīśuka uvāca

tayāpahṛtavijñānastatkṛtasmaravihvalaḥ  |
bhavānyā api paśyantyā gatahrīstatpadaṃ yayau  || 08.12.025 ||
sā tamāyāntamālokya vivastrā vrīḍitā bhṛśam  |

tāmanvagacchadbhagavān bhavaḥ pramuṣitendriyaḥ  |

so'nuvrajyātivegena gṛhītvānicchatīṃ striyam  |
keśabandha upānīya bāhubhyāṃ pariṣasvaje  || 08.12.028 ||
sopagūḍhā bhagavatā kariṇā kariṇī yathā  |
itastataḥ prasarpantī viprakīrṇaśiroruhā  || 08.12.029 ||
ātmānaṃ mocayitvāṅga surarṣabhabhujāntarāt |
prādravatsā pṛthuśroṇī māyā devavinirmitā  || 08.12.030 ||
tasyāsau padavīṃ rudro viṣṇoradbhutakarmaṇaḥ  |
pratyapadyata kāmena vairiṇeva vinirjitaḥ  || 08.12.031 ||

śuṣmiṇo yūthapasyeva vāsitāmanudhāvataḥ  || 08.12.032 ||
yatra yatrāpatanmahyāṃ retastasya mahātmanaḥ  |

saritsaraḥsu śaileṣu vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca  |

aparijñeyavīryasya na mene tadu hādbhutam  || 08.12.036 ||

uvāca paramaprīto bibhratsvāṃ pauruṣīṃ tanum  || 08.12.037 ||
08.12.038|0 śrībhagavānuvāca

08.13.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
manurvivasvataḥ putraḥ śrāddhadeva iti śrutaḥ  |
saptamo vartamāno yastadapatyāni me śṛṇu  || 08.13.001 ||
ikṣvākurnabhagaścaiva dhṛṣṭaḥ śaryātireva ca  |
nariṣyanto'tha nābhāgaḥ saptamo diṣṭa ucyate  || 08.13.002 ||
tarūṣaśca pṛṣadhraśca daśamo vasumān smṛtaḥ  |
manorvaivasvatasyaite daśaputrāḥ parantapa  || 08.13.003 ||
ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ  |
aśvināvṛbhavo rājannindrasteṣāṃ purandaraḥ  || 08.13.004 ||
kaśyapo'trirvasiṣṭhaśca viśvāmitro'tha gautamaḥ  |

atrāpi bhagavajjanma kaśyapādaditerabhūt |
ādityānāmavarajo viṣṇurvāmanarūpadhṛk || 08.13.006 ||
saṅkṣepato mayoktāni saptamanvantarāṇi te  |
bhaviṣyāṇyatha vakṣyāmi viṣṇoḥ śaktyānvitāni ca  || 08.13.007 ||
vivasvataśca dve jāye viśvakarmasute ubhe  |
saṃjñā chāyā ca rājendra ye prāgabhihite tava  || 08.13.008 ||
tṛtīyāṃ vaḍavāmeke tāsāṃ saṃjñāsutāstrayaḥ  |
yamo yamī śrāddhadevaśchāyāyāśca sutān chṛṇu  || 08.13.009 ||
sāvarṇistapatī kanyā bhāryā saṃvaraṇasya yā  |
śanaiścarastṛtīyo'bhūdaśvinau vaḍavātmajau  || 08.13.010 ||
aṣṭame'ntara āyāte sāvarṇirbhavitā manuḥ  |
nirmokavirajaskādyāḥ sāvarṇitanayā nṛpa  || 08.13.011 ||
tatra devāḥ sutapaso virajā amṛtaprabhāḥ  |
teṣāṃ virocanasuto balirindro bhaviṣyati  || 08.13.012 ||
dattvemāṃ yācamānāya viṣṇave yaḥ padatrayam  |
rāddhamindrapadaṃ hitvā tataḥ siddhimavāpsyati  || 08.13.013 ||
yo'sau bhagavatā baddhaḥ prītena sutale punaḥ  |
niveśito'dhike svargādadhunāste svarāḍiva  || 08.13.014 ||
gālavo dīptimān rāmo droṇaputraḥ kṛpastathā  |
ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ pitāsmākaṃ bhagavān bādarāyaṇaḥ  || 08.13.015 ||
ime saptarṣayastatra bhaviṣyanti svayogataḥ  |
idānīmāsate rājan sve sva āśramamaṇḍale  || 08.13.016 ||
devaguhyātsarasvatyāṃ sārvabhauma iti prabhuḥ  |
sthānaṃ purandarāddhṛtvā balaye dāsyatīśvaraḥ  || 08.13.017 ||
navamo dakṣasāvarṇirmanurvaruṇasambhavaḥ  |
bhūtaketurdīptaketurityādyāstatsutā nṛpa  || 08.13.018 ||
pārāmarīcigarbhādyā devā indro'dbhutaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
dyutimatpramukhāstatra bhaviṣyantyṛṣayastataḥ  || 08.13.019 ||
āyuṣmato'mbudhārāyāmṛṣabho bhagavatkalā  |
bhavitā yena saṃrāddhāṃ trilokīṃ bhokṣyate'dbhutaḥ  || 08.13.020 ||
daśamo brahmasāvarṇirupaślokasuto manuḥ  |
tatsutā bhūriṣeṇādyā haviṣmatpramukhā dvijāḥ  || 08.13.021 ||
haviṣmān sukṛtaḥ satyo jayo mūrtistadā dvijāḥ  |

viṣvakseno viṣūcyāṃ tu śambhoḥ sakhyaṃ kariṣyati  |

manurvai dharmasāvarṇirekādaśama ātmavān  |
anāgatāstatsutāśca satyadharmādayo daśa  || 08.13.024 ||
vihaṅgamāḥ kāmagamā nirvāṇarucayaḥ surāḥ  |
indraśca vaidhṛtasteṣāmṛṣayaścāruṇādayaḥ  || 08.13.025 ||
āryakasya sutastatra dharmaseturiti smṛtaḥ  |
vaidhṛtāyāṃ hareraṃśastrilokīṃ dhārayiṣyati  || 08.13.026 ||
bhavitā rudrasāvarṇī rājan dvādaśamo manuḥ  |
devavānupadevaśca devaśreṣṭhādayaḥ sutāḥ  || 08.13.027 ||
ṛtadhāmā ca tatrendro devāśca haritādayaḥ  |
ṛṣayaśca tapomūrtistapasvyāgnīdhrakādayaḥ  || 08.13.028 ||
svadhāmākhyo hareraṃśaḥ sādhayiṣyati tanmanoḥ  |
antaraṃ satyasahasaḥ sunṛtāyāḥ suto vibhuḥ  || 08.13.029 ||
manustrayodaśo bhāvyo devasāvarṇirātmavān  |
citrasenavicitrādyā devasāvarṇidehajāḥ  || 08.13.030 ||
devāḥ sukarmasutrāma saṃjñā indro divaspatiḥ  |
nirmokatattvadarśādyā bhaviṣyantyṛṣayastadā  || 08.13.031 ||
devahotrasya tanaya upahartā divaspateḥ  |
yogeśvaro hareraṃśo bṛhatyāṃ sambhaviṣyati  || 08.13.032 ||
manurvā indrasāvarṇiścaturdaśama eṣyati  |
urugambhīrabudhādyā indrasāvarṇivīryajāḥ  || 08.13.033 ||
pavitrāścākṣuṣā devāḥ śucirindro bhaviṣyati  |
agnirbāhuḥ śuciḥ śuddho māgadhādyāstapasvinaḥ  || 08.13.034 ||
satrāyaṇasya tanayo bṛhadbhānustadā hariḥ  |
vitānāyāṃ mahārāja kriyātantūn vitāyitā  || 08.13.035 ||
rājaṃścaturdaśaitāni trikālānugatāni te  |
proktānyebhirmitaḥ kalpo yugasāhasraparyayaḥ  || 08.13.036 ||

08.15.003|0 śrīśuka uvāca
parājitaśrīrasubhiśca hāpito hīndreṇa rājan bhṛgubhiḥ sa jīvitaḥ  |

pravālaphalapuṣporu bhāraśākhāmaradrumaiḥ  |

ākāśagaṅgayā devyā vṛtāṃ parikhabhūtayā  |

muktāvitānairmaṇihemaketubhirnānāpatākāvalabhībhirāvṛtām  |

yāṃ na vrajantyadharmiṣṭhāḥ khalā bhūtadruhaḥ śaṭhāḥ  |

08.16.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca

08.16.011|0 śrīaditiruvāca

08.16.024|0 śrīkaśyapa uvāca

bhojayettān guṇavatā sadannena śucismite  |

tasyā dīnataraṃ vākyamāśrutya sa mahīpatiḥ  |
kalaśāpsu nidhāyaināṃ dayālurninya āśramam  || 08.24.016 ||
sā tu tatraikarātreṇa vardhamānā kamaṇḍalau  |
alabdhvātmāvakāśaṃ vā idamāha mahīpatim  || 08.24.017 ||
nāhaṃ kamaṇḍalāvasmin kṛcchraṃ vastumihotsahe  |
kalpayaukaḥ suvipulaṃ yatrāhaṃ nivase sukham  || 08.24.018 ||
sa enāṃ tata ādāya nyadhādaudañcanodake  |
tatra kṣiptā muhūrtena hastatrayamavardhata  || 08.24.019 ||
na ma etadalaṃ rājan sukhaṃ vastumudañcanam  |
pṛthu dehi padaṃ mahyaṃ yattvāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā  || 08.24.020 ||
tata ādāya sā rājñā kṣiptā rājan sarovare  |
tadāvṛtyātmanā so'yaṃ mahāmīno'nvavardhata  || 08.24.021 ||
naitanme svastaye rājannudakaṃ salilaukasaḥ  |
nidhehi rakṣāyogena hrade māmavidāsini  || 08.24.022 ||
ityuktaḥ so'nayanmatsyaṃ tatra tatrāvidāsini  |
jalāśaye'sammitaṃ taṃ samudre prākṣipajjhaṣam  || 08.24.023 ||
kṣipyamāṇastamāhedamiha māṃ makarādayaḥ  |
adantyatibalā vīra māṃ nehotsraṣṭumarhasi  || 08.24.024 ||
evaṃ vimohitastena vadatā valgubhāratīm  |
tamāha ko bhavānasmānmatsyarūpeṇa mohayan  || 08.24.025 ||
naivaṃ vīryo jalacaro dṛṣṭo'smābhiḥ śruto'pi vā  |
yo bhavān yojanaśatamahnābhivyānaśe saraḥ  || 08.24.026 ||
nūnaṃ tvaṃ bhagavān sākṣāddharirnārāyaṇo'vyayaḥ  |
anugrahāya bhūtānāṃ dhatse rūpaṃ jalaukasām  || 08.24.027 ||
namaste puruṣaśreṣṭha sthityutpattyapyayeśvara  |
bhaktānāṃ naḥ prapannānāṃ mukhyo hyātmagatirvibho  || 08.24.028 ||
sarve līlāvatārāste bhūtānāṃ bhūtihetavaḥ  |
jñātumicchāmyado rūpaṃ yadarthaṃ bhavatā dhṛtam  || 08.24.029 ||
na te'ravindākṣa padopasarpaṇaṃ mṛṣā bhavetsarvasuhṛtpriyātmanaḥ  |
yathetareṣāṃ pṛthagātmanāṃ satāmadīdṛśo yadvapuradbhutaṃ hi naḥ  || 08.24.030 ||
08.24.031|0 śrīśuka uvāca
iti bruvāṇaṃ nṛpatiṃ jagatpatiḥ satyavrataṃ matsyavapuryugakṣaye  |
vihartukāmaḥ pralayārṇave'bravīccikīrṣurekāntajanapriyaḥ priyam  || 08.24.031 ||
08.24.032|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
saptame hyadyatanādūrdhvamahanyetadarindama  |
nimaṅkṣyatyapyayāmbhodhau trailokyaṃ bhūrbhuvādikam  || 08.24.032 ||
trilokyāṃ līyamānāyāṃ saṃvartāmbhasi vai tadā  |
upasthāsyati nauḥ kācidviśālā tvāṃ mayeritā  || 08.24.033 ||
tvaṃ tāvadoṣadhīḥ sarvā bījānyuccāvacāni ca  |
saptarṣibhiḥ parivṛtaḥ sarvasattvopabṛṃhitaḥ  || 08.24.034 ||
āruhya bṛhatīṃ nāvaṃ vicariṣyasyaviklavaḥ  |
ekārṇave nirāloke ṛṣīṇāmeva varcasā  || 08.24.035 ||
dodhūyamānāṃ tāṃ nāvaṃ samīreṇa balīyasā  |
upasthitasya me śṛṅge nibadhnīhi mahāhinā  || 08.24.036 ||
ahaṃ tvāmṛṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ sahanāvamudanvati  |
vikarṣan vicariṣyāmi yāvadbrāhmī niśā prabho  || 08.24.037 ||
madīyaṃ mahimānaṃ ca paraṃ brahmeti śabditam  |
vetsyasyanugṛhītaṃ me sampraśnairvivṛtaṃ hṛdi  || 08.24.038 ||
itthamādiśya rājānaṃ harirantaradhīyata  |
so'nvavaikṣata taṃ kālaṃ yaṃ hṛṣīkeśa ādiśat || 08.24.039 ||
āstīrya darbhān prākkūlān rājarṣiḥ prāgudaṅmukhaḥ  |
niṣasāda hareḥ pādau cintayanmatsyarūpiṇaḥ  || 08.24.040 ||
tataḥ samudra udvelaḥ sarvataḥ plāvayanmahīm  |
vardhamāno mahāmeghairvarṣadbhiḥ samadṛśyata  || 08.24.041 ||
dhyāyan bhagavadādeśaṃ dadṛśe nāvamāgatām  |
tāmāruroha viprendrairādāyauṣadhivīrudhaḥ  || 08.24.042 ||
tamūcurmunayaḥ prītā rājan dhyāyasva keśavam  |
sa vai naḥ saṅkaṭādasmādavitā śaṃ vidhāsyati  || 08.24.043 ||
so'nudhyātastato rājñā prādurāsīnmahārṇave  |
ekaśṛṅgadharo matsyo haimo niyutayojanaḥ  || 08.24.044 ||
nibadhya nāvaṃ tacchṛṅge yathokto hariṇā purā  |
varatreṇāhinā tuṣṭastuṣṭāva madhusūdanam  || 08.24.045 ||
08.24.046|0 śrīrājovāca
anādyavidyopahatātmasaṃvidastanmūlasaṃsārapariśramāturāḥ  |
yadṛcchayopasṛtā yamāpnuyurvimuktido naḥ paramo gururbhavān  || 08.24.046 ||
jano'budho'yaṃ nijakarmabandhanaḥ sukhecchayā karma samīhate'sukham  |
yatsevayā tāṃ vidhunotyasanmatiṃ granthiṃ sa bhindyāddhṛdayaṃ sa no guruḥ  || 08.24.047 ||
yatsevayāgneriva rudrarodanaṃ pumān vijahyānmalamātmanastamaḥ  |
bhajeta varṇaṃ nijameṣa so'vyayo bhūyātsa īśaḥ paramo gurorguruḥ  || 08.24.048 ||
na yatprasādāyutabhāgaleśamanye ca devā guravo janāḥ svayam  |
kartuṃ sametāḥ prabhavanti puṃsastamīśvaraṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye  || 08.24.049 ||
acakṣurandhasya yathāgraṇīḥ kṛtastathā janasyāviduṣo'budho guruḥ  |
tvamarkadṛksarvadṛśāṃ samīkṣaṇo vṛto gururnaḥ svagatiṃ bubhutsatām  || 08.24.050 ||
jano janasyādiśate'satīṃ gatiṃ yayā prapadyeta duratyayaṃ tamaḥ  |
tvaṃ tvavyayaṃ jñānamamoghamañjasā prapadyate yena jano nijaṃ padam  || 08.24.051 ||
tvaṃ sarvalokasya suhṛtpriyeśvaro hyātmā gururjñānamabhīṣṭasiddhiḥ  |
tathāpi loko na bhavantamandhadhīrjānāti santaṃ hṛdi baddhakāmaḥ  || 08.24.052 ||
taṃ tvāmahaṃ devavaraṃ vareṇyaṃ prapadya īśaṃ pratibodhanāya  |
chindhyarthadīpairbhagavan vacobhirgranthīn hṛdayyān vivṛṇu svamokaḥ  || 08.24.053 ||
08.24.054|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ityuktavantaṃ nṛpatiṃ bhagavānādipūruṣaḥ  |
matsyarūpī mahāmbhodhau viharaṃstattvamabravīt || 08.24.054 ||
purāṇasaṃhitāṃ divyāṃ sāṅkhyayogakriyāvatīm  |
satyavratasya rājarṣerātmaguhyamaśeṣataḥ  || 08.24.055 ||
aśrauṣīdṛṣibhiḥ sākamātmatattvamasaṃśayam  |
nāvyāsīno bhagavatā proktaṃ brahma sanātanam  || 08.24.056 ||
atītapralayāpāya utthitāya sa vedhase  |
hatvāsuraṃ hayagrīvaṃ vedān pratyāharaddhariḥ  || 08.24.057 ||
sa tu satyavrato rājā jñānavijñānasaṃyutaḥ  |
viṣṇoḥ prasādātkalpe'sminnāsīdvaivasvato manuḥ  || 08.24.058 ||
satyavratasya rājarṣermāyāmatsyasya śārṅgiṇaḥ  |
saṃvādaṃ mahadākhyānaṃ śrutvā mucyeta kilbiṣāt || 08.24.059 ||
avatāraṃ hareryo'yaṃ kīrtayedanvahaṃ naraḥ  |
saṅkalpāstasya sidhyanti sa yāti paramāṃ gatim  || 08.24.060 ||
pralayapayasi dhātuḥ suptaśaktermukhebhyaḥ   śrutigaṇamapanītaṃ pratyupādatta hatvā  |
ditijamakathayadyo brahma satyavratānāṃ   tamahamakhilahetuṃ jihmamīnaṃ nato'smi  || 08.24.061 ||*



09.01.001|0 śrīrājovāca
manvantarāṇi sarvāṇi tvayoktāni śrutāni me  |
vīryāṇyanantavīryasya harestatra kṛtāni ca  || 09.01.001 ||
yo'sau satyavrato nāma rājarṣirdraviḍeśvaraḥ  |
jñānaṃ yo'tītakalpānte lebhe puruṣasevayā  || 09.01.002 ||
sa vai vivasvataḥ putro manurāsīditi śrutam  |
tvattastasya sutāḥ proktā ikṣvākupramukhā nṛpāḥ  || 09.01.003 ||
teṣāṃ vaṃśaṃ pṛthagbrahman vaṃśānucaritāni ca  |
kīrtayasva mahābhāga nityaṃ śuśrūṣatāṃ hi naḥ  || 09.01.004 ||
ye bhūtā ye bhaviṣyāśca bhavantyadyatanāśca ye  |
teṣāṃ naḥ puṇyakīrtīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ vada vikramān  || 09.01.005 ||
09.01.006|0 śrīsūta uvāca
evaṃ parīkṣitā rājñā sadasi brahmavādinām  |
pṛṣṭaḥ provāca bhagavāñchukaḥ paramadharmavit || 09.01.006 ||
09.01.007|0 śrīśuka uvāca
śrūyatāṃ mānavo vaṃśaḥ prācuryeṇa parantapa  |
na śakyate vistarato vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi  || 09.01.007 ||
parāvareṣāṃ bhūtānāmātmā yaḥ puruṣaḥ paraḥ  |
sa evāsīdidaṃ viśvaṃ kalpānte'nyanna kiñcana  || 09.01.008 ||
tasya nābheḥ samabhavatpadmakoṣo hiraṇmayaḥ  |
tasmin jajñe mahārāja svayambhūścaturānanaḥ  || 09.01.009 ||
marīcirmanasastasya jajñe tasyāpi kaśyapaḥ  |
dākṣāyaṇyāṃ tato'dityāṃ vivasvānabhavatsutaḥ  || 09.01.010 ||
tato manuḥ śrāddhadevaḥ saṃjñāyāmāsa bhārata  |
śraddhāyāṃ janayāmāsa daśa putrān sa ātmavān  || 09.01.011 ||
ikṣvākunṛgaśaryāti diṣṭadhṛṣṭakarūṣakān  |
nariṣyantaṃ pṛṣadhraṃ ca nabhagaṃ ca kaviṃ vibhuḥ  || 09.01.012 ||
aprajasya manoḥ pūrvaṃ vasiṣṭho bhagavān kila  |
mitrāvaruṇayoriṣṭiṃ prajārthamakarodvibhuḥ  || 09.01.013 ||
tatra śraddhā manoḥ patnī hotāraṃ samayācata  |
duhitrarthamupāgamya praṇipatya payovratā  || 09.01.014 ||
preṣito'dhvaryuṇā hotā vyacarattatsamāhitaḥ  |
gṛhīte haviṣi vācā vaṣaṭkāraṃ gṛṇan dvijaḥ  || 09.01.015 ||
hotustadvyabhicāreṇa kanyelā nāma sābhavat |
tāṃ vilokya manuḥ prāha nātituṣṭamanā gurum  || 09.01.016 ||
bhagavan kimidaṃ jātaṃ karma vo brahmavādinām  |
viparyayamaho kaṣṭaṃ maivaṃ syādbrahmavikriyā  || 09.01.017 ||
yūyaṃ brahmavido yuktāstapasā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ  |
kutaḥ saṅkalpavaiṣamyamanṛtaṃ vibudheṣviva  || 09.01.018 ||
niśamya tadvacastasya bhagavān prapitāmahaḥ  |
hoturvyatikramaṃ jñātvā babhāṣe ravinandanam  || 09.01.019 ||
etatsaṅkalpavaiṣamyaṃ hotuste vyabhicārataḥ  |
tathāpi sādhayiṣye te suprajāstvaṃ svatejasā  || 09.01.020 ||
evaṃ vyavasito rājan bhagavān sa mahāyaśāḥ  |
astauṣīdādipuruṣamilāyāḥ puṃstvakāmyayā  || 09.01.021 ||
tasmai kāmavaraṃ tuṣṭo bhagavān harirīśvaraḥ  |
dadāvilābhavattena sudyumnaḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ  || 09.01.022 ||
sa ekadā mahārāja vicaranmṛgayāṃ vane  |
vṛtaḥ katipayāmātyairaśvamāruhya saindhavam  || 09.01.023 ||
pragṛhya ruciraṃ cāpaṃ śarāṃśca paramādbhutān  |
daṃśito'numṛgaṃ vīro jagāma diśamuttarām  || 09.01.024 ||
sukumāravanaṃ meroradhastātpraviveśa ha  |
yatrāste bhagavān charvo ramamāṇaḥ sahomayā  || 09.01.025 ||
tasmin praviṣṭa evāsau sudyumnaḥ paravīrahā  |
apaśyatstriyamātmānamaśvaṃ ca vaḍavāṃ nṛpa  || 09.01.026 ||
tathā tadanugāḥ sarve ātmaliṅgaviparyayam  |
dṛṣṭvā vimanaso'bhūvan vīkṣamāṇāḥ parasparam  || 09.01.027 ||
09.01.028|0 śrīrājovāca
kathamevaṃ guṇo deśaḥ kena vā bhagavan kṛtaḥ  |
praśnamenaṃ samācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ  || 09.01.028 ||
09.01.029|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ekadā giriśaṃ draṣṭumṛṣayastatra suvratāḥ  |
diśo vitimirābhāsāḥ kurvantaḥ samupāgaman  || 09.01.029 ||
