tān vilokyāmbikā devī vivāsā vrīḍitā bhṛśam  |
bharturaṅkātsamutthāya nīvīmāśvatha paryadhāt || 09.01.030 ||
ṛṣayo'pi tayorvīkṣya prasaṅgaṃ ramamāṇayoḥ  |
nivṛttāḥ prayayustasmānnaranārāyaṇāśramam  || 09.01.031 ||
tadidaṃ bhagavānāha priyāyāḥ priyakāmyayā  |
sthānaṃ yaḥ praviśedetatsa vai yoṣidbhavediti  || 09.01.032 ||
tata ūrdhvaṃ vanaṃ tadvai puruṣā varjayanti hi  |
sā cānucarasaṃyuktā vicacāra vanādvanam  || 09.01.033 ||
atha tāmāśramābhyāśe carantīṃ pramadottamām  |
strībhiḥ parivṛtāṃ vīkṣya cakame bhagavān budhaḥ  || 09.01.034 ||
sāpi taṃ cakame subhrūḥ somarājasutaṃ patim  |
sa tasyāṃ janayāmāsa purūravasamātmajam  || 09.01.035 ||
evaṃ strītvamanuprāptaḥ sudyumno mānavo nṛpaḥ  |
sasmāra sa kulācāryaṃ vasiṣṭhamiti śuśruma  || 09.01.036 ||
sa tasya tāṃ daśāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛpayā bhṛśapīḍitaḥ  |
sudyumnasyāśayan puṃstvamupādhāvata śaṅkaram  || 09.01.037 ||
tuṣṭastasmai sa bhagavānṛṣaye priyamāvahan  |
svāṃ ca vācamṛtāṃ kurvannidamāha viśāmpate  || 09.01.038 ||
māsaṃ pumān sa bhavitā māsaṃ strī tava gotrajaḥ  |
itthaṃ vyavasthayā kāmaṃ sudyumno'vatu medinīm  || 09.01.039 ||
ācāryānugrahātkāmaṃ labdhvā puṃstvaṃ vyavasthayā  |
pālayāmāsa jagatīṃ nābhyanandan sma taṃ prajāḥ  || 09.01.040 ||
tasyotkalo gayo rājan vimalaśca trayaḥ sutāḥ  |
dakṣiṇāpatharājāno babhūvurdharmavatsalāḥ  || 09.01.041 ||
tataḥ pariṇate kāle pratiṣṭhānapatiḥ prabhuḥ  |
purūravasa utsṛjya gāṃ putrāya gato vanam  || 09.01.042 ||
09.02.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃ gate'tha sudyumne manurvaivasvataḥ sute  |
putrakāmastapastepe yamunāyāṃ śataṃ samāḥ  || 09.02.001 ||
tato'yajanmanurdevamapatyārthaṃ hariṃ prabhum  |
ikṣvākupūrvajān putrān lebhe svasadṛśān daśa  || 09.02.002 ||
pṛṣadhrastu manoḥ putro gopālo guruṇā kṛtaḥ  |
pālayāmāsa gā yatto rātryāṃ vīrāsanavrataḥ  || 09.02.003 ||
ekadā prāviśadgoṣṭhaṃ śārdūlo niśi varṣati  |
śayānā gāva utthāya bhītāstā babhramurvraje  || 09.02.004 ||
ekāṃ jagrāha balavān sā cukrośa bhayāturā  |
tasyāstu kranditaṃ śrutvā pṛṣadhro'nusasāra ha  || 09.02.005 ||
khaḍgamādāya tarasā pralīnoḍugaṇe niśi  |
ajānannacchinodbabhroḥ śiraḥ śārdūlaśaṅkayā  || 09.02.006 ||
vyāghro'pi vṛkṇaśravaṇo nistriṃśāgrāhatastataḥ  |
niścakrāma bhṛśaṃ bhīto raktaṃ pathi samutsṛjan  || 09.02.007 ||
manyamāno hataṃ vyāghraṃ pṛṣadhraḥ paravīrahā  |
adrākṣītsvahatāṃ babhruṃ vyuṣṭāyāṃ niśi duḥkhitaḥ  || 09.02.008 ||
taṃ śaśāpa kulācāryaḥ kṛtāgasamakāmataḥ  |
na kṣatrabandhuḥ śūdrastvaṃ karmaṇā bhavitāmunā  || 09.02.009 ||
evaṃ śaptastu guruṇā pratyagṛhṇātkṛtāñjaliḥ  |
adhārayadvrataṃ vīra ūrdhvaretā munipriyam  || 09.02.010 ||
vāsudeve bhagavati sarvātmani pare'male  |
ekāntitvaṃ gato bhaktyā sarvabhūtasuhṛtsamaḥ  || 09.02.011 ||
vimuktasaṅgaḥ śāntātmā saṃyatākṣo'parigrahaḥ  |
yadṛcchayopapannena kalpayan vṛttimātmanaḥ  || 09.02.012 ||
ātmanyātmānamādhāya jñānatṛptaḥ samāhitaḥ  |
vicacāra mahīmetāṃ jaḍāndhabadhirākṛtiḥ  || 09.02.013 ||
evaṃ vṛtto vanaṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā dāvāgnimutthitam  |
tenopayuktakaraṇo brahma prāpa paraṃ muniḥ  || 09.02.014 ||
kaviḥ kanīyān viṣayeṣu niḥspṛho visṛjya rājyaṃ saha bandhubhirvanam  |
niveśya citte puruṣaṃ svarociṣaṃ viveśa kaiśoravayāḥ paraṃ gataḥ  || 09.02.015 ||
karūṣānmānavādāsan kārūṣāḥ kṣatrajātayaḥ  |
uttarāpathagoptāro brahmaṇyā dharmavatsalāḥ  || 09.02.016 ||
dhṛṣṭāddhārṣṭamabhūtkṣatraṃ brahmabhūyaṃ gataṃ kṣitau  |
nṛgasya vaṃśaḥ sumatirbhūtajyotistato vasuḥ  || 09.02.017 ||
vasoḥ pratīkastatputra oghavānoghavatpitā  |
kanyā caughavatī nāma sudarśana uvāha tām  || 09.02.018 ||
citraseno nariṣyantādṛkṣastasya suto'bhavat |
tasya mīḍhvāṃstataḥ pūrṇa indrasenastu tatsutaḥ  || 09.02.019 ||
vītihotrastvindrasenāttasya satyaśravā abhūt |
uruśravāḥ sutastasya devadattastato'bhavat || 09.02.020 ||
tato'gniveśyo bhagavānagniḥ svayamabhūtsutaḥ  |
kānīna iti vikhyāto jātūkarṇyo mahānṛṣiḥ  || 09.02.021 ||
tato brahmakulaṃ jātamāgniveśyāyanaṃ nṛpa  |
nariṣyantānvayaḥ prokto diṣṭavaṃśamataḥ śṛṇu  || 09.02.022 ||
nābhāgo diṣṭaputro'nyaḥ karmaṇā vaiśyatāṃ gataḥ  |
bhalandanaḥ sutastasya vatsaprītirbhalandanāt || 09.02.023 ||
vatsaprīteḥ sutaḥ prāṃśustatsutaṃ pramatiṃ viduḥ  |
khanitraḥ pramatestasmāccākṣuṣo'tha viviṃśatiḥ  || 09.02.024 ||
viviṃśateḥ suto rambhaḥ khanīnetro'sya dhārmikaḥ  |
karandhamo mahārāja tasyāsīdātmajo nṛpa  || 09.02.025 ||
tasyāvīkṣitsuto yasya maruttaścakravartyabhūt |
saṃvarto'yājayadyaṃ vai mahāyogyaṅgiraḥsutaḥ  || 09.02.026 ||
maruttasya yathā yajño na tathānyo'sti kaścana  |
sarvaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ tvāsīdyatkiñciccāsya śobhanam  || 09.02.027 ||
amādyadindraḥ somena dakṣiṇābhirdvijātayaḥ  |
marutaḥ pariveṣṭāro viśvedevāḥ sabhāsadaḥ  || 09.02.028 ||
maruttasya damaḥ putrastasyāsīdrājyavardhanaḥ  |
sudhṛtistatsuto jajñe saudhṛteyo naraḥ sutaḥ  || 09.02.029 ||
tatsutaḥ kevalastasmāddhundhumān vegavāṃstataḥ  |
budhastasyābhavadyasya tṛṇabindurmahīpatiḥ  || 09.02.030 ||
taṃ bheje'lambuṣā devī bhajanīyaguṇālayam  |
varāpsarā yataḥ putrāḥ kanyā celavilābhavat || 09.02.031 ||
yasyāmutpādayāmāsa viśravā dhanadaṃ sutam  |
prādāya vidyāṃ paramāmṛṣiryogeśvaraḥ pituḥ  || 09.02.032 ||
viśālaḥ śūnyabandhuśca dhūmraketuśca tatsutāḥ  |
viśālo vaṃśakṛdrājā vaiśālīṃ nirmame purīm  || 09.02.033 ||
hemacandraḥ sutastasya dhūmrākṣastasya cātmajaḥ  |
tatputrātsaṃyamādāsītkṛśāśvaḥ sahadevajaḥ  || 09.02.034 ||
kṛśāśvātsomadatto'bhūdyo'śvamedhairiḍaspatim  |
iṣṭvā puruṣamāpāgryāṃ gatiṃ yogeśvarāśritām  || 09.02.035 ||
saumadattistu sumatistatputro janamejayaḥ  |
ete vaiśālabhūpālāstṛṇabindoryaśodharāḥ  || 09.02.036 ||
09.03.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
śaryātirmānavo rājā brahmiṣṭhaḥ sambabhūva ha  |
yo vā aṅgirasāṃ satre dvitīyamaharūcivān  || 09.03.001 ||
sukanyā nāma tasyāsītkanyā kamalalocanā  |
tayā sārdhaṃ vanagato hyagamaccyavanāśramam  || 09.03.002 ||
sā sakhībhiḥ parivṛtā vicinvantyaṅghripān vane  |
valmīkarandhre dadṛśe khadyote iva jyotiṣī  || 09.03.003 ||
te daivacoditā bālā jyotiṣī kaṇṭakena vai  |
avidhyanmugdhabhāvena susrāvāsṛktato bahiḥ  || 09.03.004 ||
śakṛnmūtranirodho'bhūtsainikānāṃ ca tatkṣaṇāt |
rājarṣistamupālakṣya puruṣān vismito'bravīt || 09.03.005 ||
apyabhadraṃ na yuṣmābhirbhārgavasya viceṣṭitam  |
vyaktaṃ kenāpi nastasya kṛtamāśramadūṣaṇam  || 09.03.006 ||
sukanyā prāha pitaraṃ bhītā kiñcitkṛtaṃ mayā  |
dve jyotiṣī ajānantyā nirbhinne kaṇṭakena vai  || 09.03.007 ||
duhitustadvacaḥ śrutvā śaryātirjātasādhvasaḥ  |
muniṃ prasādayāmāsa valmīkāntarhitaṃ śanaiḥ  || 09.03.008 ||
tadabhiprāyamājñāya prādādduhitaraṃ muneḥ  |
kṛcchrānmuktastamāmantrya puraṃ prāyātsamāhitaḥ  || 09.03.009 ||
sukanyā cyavanaṃ prāpya patiṃ paramakopanam  |
prīṇayāmāsa cittajñā apramattānuvṛttibhiḥ  || 09.03.010 ||
kasyacittvatha kālasya nāsatyāvāśramāgatau  |
tau pūjayitvā provāca vayo me dattamīśvarau  || 09.03.011 ||
grahaṃ grahīṣye somasya yajñe vāmapyasomapoḥ  |
kriyatāṃ me vayorūpaṃ pramadānāṃ yadīpsitam  || 09.03.012 ||
bāḍhamityūcaturvipramabhinandya bhiṣaktamau  |
nimajjatāṃ bhavānasmin hrade siddhavinirmite  || 09.03.013 ||
ityukto jarayā grasta deho dhamanisantataḥ  |
hradaṃ praveśito'śvibhyāṃ valīpalitavigrahaḥ  || 09.03.014 ||
puruṣāstraya uttasthurapīvyā vanitāpriyāḥ  |
padmasrajaḥ kuṇḍalinastulyarūpāḥ suvāsasaḥ  || 09.03.015 ||
tānnirīkṣya varārohā sarūpān sūryavarcasaḥ  |
ajānatī patiṃ sādhvī aśvinau śaraṇaṃ yayau  || 09.03.016 ||
darśayitvā patiṃ tasyai pātivratyena toṣitau  |
ṛṣimāmantrya yayaturvimānena triviṣṭapam  || 09.03.017 ||
yakṣyamāṇo'tha śaryātiścyavanasyāśramaṃ gataḥ  |
dadarśa duhituḥ pārśve puruṣaṃ sūryavarcasam  || 09.03.018 ||
rājā duhitaraṃ prāha kṛtapādābhivandanām  |
āśiṣaścāprayuñjāno nātiprītimanā iva  || 09.03.019 ||
cikīrṣitaṃ te kimidaṃ patistvayā pralambhito lokanamaskṛto muniḥ  |
yattvaṃ jarāgrastamasatyasammataṃ vihāya jāraṃ bhajase'mumadhvagam  || 09.03.020 ||
kathaṃ matiste'vagatānyathā satāṃ kulaprasūte kuladūṣaṇaṃ tvidam  |
bibharṣi jāraṃ yadapatrapā kulaṃ pituśca bhartuśca nayasyadhastamaḥ  || 09.03.021 ||
evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ pitaraṃ smayamānā śucismitā  |
uvāca tāta jāmātā tavaiṣa bhṛgunandanaḥ  || 09.03.022 ||
śaśaṃsa pitre tatsarvaṃ vayorūpābhilambhanam  |
vismitaḥ paramaprītastanayāṃ pariṣasvaje  || 09.03.023 ||
somena yājayan vīraṃ grahaṃ somasya cāgrahīt |
asomaporapyaśvinoścyavanaḥ svena tejasā  || 09.03.024 ||
hantuṃ tamādade vajraṃ sadyo manyuramarṣitaḥ  |
savajraṃ stambhayāmāsa bhujamindrasya bhārgavaḥ  || 09.03.025 ||
anvajānaṃstataḥ sarve grahaṃ somasya cāśvinoḥ  |
bhiṣajāviti yatpūrvaṃ somāhutyā bahiṣkṛtau  || 09.03.026 ||
uttānabarhirānarto bhūriṣeṇa iti trayaḥ  |
śaryāterabhavan putrā ānartādrevato'bhavat || 09.03.027 ||
so'ntaḥsamudre nagarīṃ vinirmāya kuśasthalīm  |
āsthito'bhuṅkta viṣayānānartādīnarindama  || 09.03.028 ||
tasya putraśataṃ jajñe kakudmijyeṣṭhamuttamam  |
kakudmī revatīṃ kanyāṃ svāmādāya vibhuṃ gataḥ  || 09.03.029 ||
putryā varaṃ paripraṣṭuṃ brahmalokamapāvṛtam  |
āvartamāne gāndharve sthito'labdhakṣaṇaḥ kṣaṇam  || 09.03.030 ||
tadanta ādyamānamya svābhiprāyaṃ nyavedayat |
tacchrutvā bhagavān brahmā prahasya tamuvāca ha  || 09.03.031 ||
aho rājanniruddhāste kālena hṛdi ye kṛtāḥ  |
tatputrapautranaptṇāṃ gotrāṇi ca na śṛṇmahe  || 09.03.032 ||
kālo'bhiyātastriṇava caturyugavikalpitaḥ  |
tadgaccha devadevāṃśo baladevo mahābalaḥ  || 09.03.033 ||
kanyāratnamidaṃ rājannararatnāya dehi bhoḥ  |
bhuvo bhārāvatārāya bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ  || 09.03.034 ||
avatīrṇo nijāṃśena puṇyaśravaṇakīrtanaḥ  |
ityādiṣṭo'bhivandyājaṃ nṛpaḥ svapuramāgataḥ  |
tyaktaṃ puṇyajanatrāsādbhrātṛbhirdikṣvavasthitaiḥ  || 09.03.035 ||
sutāṃ dattvānavadyāṅgīṃ balāya balaśāline  |
badaryākhyaṃ gato rājā taptuṃ nārāyaṇāśramam  || 09.03.036 ||
09.04.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
nābhāgo nabhagāpatyaṃ yaṃ tataṃ bhrātaraḥ kavim  |
yaviṣṭhaṃ vyabhajan dāyaṃ brahmacāriṇamāgatam  || 09.04.001 ||
bhrātaro'bhāṅkta kiṃ mahyaṃ bhajāma pitaraṃ tava  |
tvāṃ mamāryāstatābhāṅkṣurmā putraka tadādṛthāḥ  || 09.04.002 ||
ime aṅgirasaḥ satramāsate'dya sumedhasaḥ  |
ṣaṣṭhaṃ ṣaṣṭhamupetyāhaḥ kave muhyanti karmaṇi  || 09.04.003 ||
tāṃstvaṃ śaṃsaya sūkte dve vaiśvadeve mahātmanaḥ  |
te svaryanto dhanaṃ satra pariśeṣitamātmanaḥ  || 09.04.004 ||
dāsyanti te'tha tānarccha tathā sa kṛtavān yathā  |
tasmai dattvā yayuḥ svargaṃ te satrapariśeṣaṇam  || 09.04.005 ||
taṃ kaścitsvīkariṣyantaṃ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇadarśanaḥ  |
uvācottarato'bhyetya mamedaṃ vāstukaṃ vasu  || 09.04.006 ||
mamedamṛṣibhirdattamiti tarhi sma mānavaḥ  |
syānnau te pitari praśnaḥ pṛṣṭavān pitaraṃ yathā  || 09.04.007 ||
yajñavāstugataṃ sarvamucchiṣṭamṛṣayaḥ kvacit |
cakrurhi bhāgaṃ rudrāya sa devaḥ sarvamarhati  || 09.04.008 ||
nābhāgastaṃ praṇamyāha taveśa kila vāstukam  |
ityāha me pitā brahmañchirasā tvāṃ prasādaye  || 09.04.009 ||
yatte pitāvadaddharmaṃ tvaṃ ca satyaṃ prabhāṣase  |
dadāmi te mantradṛśo jñānaṃ brahma sanātanam  || 09.04.010 ||
gṛhāṇa draviṇaṃ dattaṃ matsatrapariśeṣitam  |
ityuktvāntarhito rudro bhagavān dharmavatsalaḥ  || 09.04.011 ||
ya etatsaṃsmaretprātaḥ sāyaṃ ca susamāhitaḥ  |
kavirbhavati mantrajño gatiṃ caiva tathātmanaḥ  || 09.04.012 ||
nābhāgādambarīṣo'bhūnmahābhāgavataḥ kṛtī  |
nāspṛśadbrahmaśāpo'pi yaṃ na pratihataḥ kvacit || 09.04.013 ||
09.04.014|0 śrīrājovāca
bhagavan chrotumicchāmi rājarṣestasya dhīmataḥ  |
na prābhūdyatra nirmukto brahmadaṇḍo duratyayaḥ  || 09.04.014 ||
09.04.015|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ambarīṣo mahābhāgaḥ saptadvīpavatīṃ mahīm  |
avyayāṃ ca śriyaṃ labdhvā vibhavaṃ cātulaṃ bhuvi  || 09.04.015 ||
mene'tidurlabhaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvaṃ tatsvapnasaṃstutam  |
vidvān vibhavanirvāṇaṃ tamo viśati yatpumān  || 09.04.016 ||
vāsudeve bhagavati tadbhakteṣu ca sādhuṣu  |
prāpto bhāvaṃ paraṃ viśvaṃ yenedaṃ loṣṭravatsmṛtam  || 09.04.017 ||
sa vai manaḥ kṛṣṇapadāravindayorvacāṃsi vaikuṇṭhaguṇānuvarṇane  |
karau harermandiramārjanādiṣu śrutiṃ cakārācyutasatkathodaye  || 09.04.018 ||
mukundaliṅgālayadarśane dṛśau tadbhṛtyagātrasparśe'ṅgasaṅgamam  |
ghrāṇaṃ ca tatpādasarojasaurabhe śrīmattulasyā rasanāṃ tadarpite  || 09.04.019 ||
pādau hareḥ kṣetrapadānusarpaṇe śiro hṛṣīkeśapadābhivandane  |
kāmaṃ ca dāsye na tu kāmakāmyayā yathottamaślokajanāśrayā ratiḥ  || 09.04.020 ||
evaṃ sadā karmakalāpamātmanaḥ pare'dhiyajñe bhagavatyadhokṣaje  |
sarvātmabhāvaṃ vidadhanmahīmimāṃ tanniṣṭhaviprābhihitaḥ śaśāsa ha  || 09.04.021 ||
īje'śvamedhairadhiyajñamīśvaraṃ mahāvibhūtyopacitāṅgadakṣiṇaiḥ  |
tatairvasiṣṭhāsitagautamādibhirdhanvanyabhisrotamasau sarasvatīm  || 09.04.022 ||
yasya kratuṣu gīrvāṇaiḥ sadasyā ṛtvijo janāḥ  |
tulyarūpāścānimiṣā vyadṛśyanta suvāsasaḥ  || 09.04.023 ||
svargo na prārthito yasya manujairamarapriyaḥ  |
śṛṇvadbhirupagāyadbhiruttamaślokaceṣṭitam  || 09.04.024 ||
saṃvardhayanti yatkāmāḥ svārājyaparibhāvitāḥ  |
durlabhā nāpi siddhānāṃ mukundaṃ hṛdi paśyataḥ  || 09.04.025 ||
sa itthaṃ bhaktiyogena tapoyuktena pārthivaḥ  |
svadharmeṇa hariṃ prīṇan sarvān kāmān śanairjahau  || 09.04.026 ||
gṛheṣu dāreṣu suteṣu bandhuṣu dvipottamasyandanavājivastuṣu  |
akṣayyaratnābharaṇāmbarādiṣvanantakośeṣvakarodasanmatim  || 09.04.027 ||
tasmā adāddhariścakraṃ pratyanīkabhayāvaham  |
ekāntabhaktibhāvena prīto bhaktābhirakṣaṇam  || 09.04.028 ||
ārirādhayiṣuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ mahiṣyā tulyaśīlayā  |
yuktaḥ sāṃvatsaraṃ vīro dadhāra dvādaśīvratam  || 09.04.029 ||
vratānte kārtike māsi trirātraṃ samupoṣitaḥ  |
snātaḥ kadācitkālindyāṃ hariṃ madhuvane'rcayat || 09.04.030 ||
mahābhiṣekavidhinā sarvopaskarasampadā  |
abhiṣicyāmbarākalpairgandhamālyārhaṇādibhiḥ  || 09.04.031 ||
tadgatāntarabhāvena pūjayāmāsa keśavam  |
brāhmaṇāṃśca mahābhāgān siddhārthānapi bhaktitaḥ  || 09.04.032 ||
gavāṃ rukmaviṣāṇīnāṃ rūpyāṅghrīṇāṃ suvāsasām  |
payaḥśīlavayorūpa vatsopaskarasampadām  || 09.04.033 ||
prāhiṇotsādhuviprebhyo gṛheṣu nyarbudāni ṣaṭ |
bhojayitvā dvijānagre svādvannaṃ guṇavattamam  || 09.04.034 ||
labdhakāmairanujñātaḥ pāraṇāyopacakrame  |
tasya tarhyatithiḥ sākṣāddurvāsā bhagavānabhūt || 09.04.035 ||
tamānarcātithiṃ bhūpaḥ pratyutthānāsanārhaṇaiḥ  |
yayāce'bhyavahārāya pādamūlamupāgataḥ  || 09.04.036 ||
pratinandya sa tāṃ yācñāṃ kartumāvaśyakaṃ gataḥ  |
nimamajja bṛhaddhyāyan kālindīsalile śubhe  || 09.04.037 ||
muhūrtārdhāvaśiṣṭāyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ prati  |
cintayāmāsa dharmajño dvijaistaddharmasaṅkaṭe  || 09.04.038 ||
brāhmaṇātikrame doṣo dvādaśyāṃ yadapāraṇe  |
yatkṛtvā sādhu me bhūyādadharmo vā na māṃ spṛśet || 09.04.039 ||
ambhasā kevalenātha kariṣye vratapāraṇam  |
āhurabbhakṣaṇaṃ viprā hyaśitaṃ nāśitaṃ ca tat || 09.04.040 ||
ityapaḥ prāśya rājarṣiścintayanmanasācyutam  |
pratyacaṣṭa kuruśreṣṭha dvijāgamanameva saḥ  || 09.04.041 ||
durvāsā yamunākūlātkṛtāvaśyaka āgataḥ  |
rājñābhinanditastasya bubudhe ceṣṭitaṃ dhiyā  || 09.04.042 ||
manyunā pracaladgātro bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanaḥ  |
bubhukṣitaśca sutarāṃ kṛtāñjalimabhāṣata  || 09.04.043 ||
aho asya nṛśaṃsasya śriyonmattasya paśyata  |
dharmavyatikramaṃ viṣṇorabhaktasyeśamāninaḥ  || 09.04.044 ||
yo māmatithimāyātamātithyena nimantrya ca  |
adattvā bhuktavāṃstasya sadyaste darśaye phalam  || 09.04.045 ||
evaṃ bruvāṇa utkṛtya jaṭāṃ roṣapradīpitaḥ  |
tayā sa nirmame tasmai kṛtyāṃ kālānalopamām  || 09.04.046 ||
tāmāpatantīṃ jvalatīmasihastāṃ padā bhuvam  |
vepayantīṃ samudvīkṣya na cacāla padānnṛpaḥ  || 09.04.047 ||
prāgdiṣṭaṃ bhṛtyarakṣāyāṃ puruṣeṇa mahātmanā  |
dadāha kṛtyāṃ tāṃ cakraṃ kruddhāhimiva pāvakaḥ  || 09.04.048 ||
tadabhidravadudvīkṣya svaprayāsaṃ ca niṣphalam  |
durvāsā dudruve bhīto dikṣu prāṇaparīpsayā  || 09.04.049 ||
tamanvadhāvadbhagavadrathāṅgaṃ dāvāgniruddhūtaśikho yathāhim  |
tathānuṣaktaṃ munirīkṣamāṇo guhāṃ vivikṣuḥ prasasāra meroḥ  || 09.04.050 ||
diśo nabhaḥ kṣmāṃ vivarān samudrān lokān sapālāṃstridivaṃ gataḥ saḥ  |
yato yato dhāvati tatra tatra sudarśanaṃ duṣprasahaṃ dadarśa  || 09.04.051 ||
alabdhanāthaḥ sa sadā kutaścitsantrastacitto'raṇameṣamāṇaḥ  |
devaṃ viriñcaṃ samagādvidhātastrāhyātmayone'jitatejaso mām  || 09.04.052 ||
09.04.053|0 śrībrahmovāca
sthānaṃ madīyaṃ sahaviśvametatkrīḍāvasāne dviparārdhasaṃjñe  |
bhrūbhaṅgamātreṇa hi sandidhakṣoḥ kālātmano yasya tirobhaviṣyati  || 09.04.053 ||
ahaṃ bhavo dakṣabhṛgupradhānāḥ prajeśabhūteśasureśamukhyāḥ  |
sarve vayaṃ yanniyamaṃ prapannā mūrdhnyārpitaṃ lokahitaṃ vahāmaḥ  || 09.04.054 ||
pratyākhyāto viriñcena viṣṇucakropatāpitaḥ  |
durvāsāḥ śaraṇaṃ yātaḥ śarvaṃ kailāsavāsinam  || 09.04.055 ||
09.04.056|0 śrīśaṅkara uvāca
vayaṃ na tāta prabhavāma bhūmni yasmin pare'nye'pyajajīvakośāḥ  |
bhavanti kāle na bhavanti hīdṛśāḥ sahasraśo yatra vayaṃ bhramāmaḥ  || 09.04.056 ||
ahaṃ sanatkumāraśca nārado bhagavānajaḥ  |
kapilo'pāntaratamo devalo dharma āsuriḥ  || 09.04.057 ||
marīcipramukhāścānye siddheśāḥ pāradarśanāḥ  |
vidāma na vayaṃ sarve yanmāyāṃ māyayāvṛtāḥ  || 09.04.058 ||
tasya viśveśvarasyedaṃ śastraṃ durviṣahaṃ hi naḥ  |
tamevaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāhi hariste śaṃ vidhāsyati  || 09.04.059 ||
tato nirāśo durvāsāḥ padaṃ bhagavato yayau  |
vaikuṇṭhākhyaṃ yadadhyāste śrīnivāsaḥ śriyā saha  || 09.04.060 ||
sandahyamāno'jitaśastravahninā tatpādamūle patitaḥ savepathuḥ  |
āhācyutānanta sadīpsita prabho kṛtāgasaṃ māvahi viśvabhāvana  || 09.04.061 ||
ajānatā te paramānubhāvaṃ kṛtaṃ mayāghaṃ bhavataḥ priyāṇām  |
vidhehi tasyāpacitiṃ vidhātarmucyeta yannāmnyudite nārako'pi  || 09.04.062 ||
09.04.063|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
ahaṃ bhaktaparādhīno hyasvatantra iva dvija  |
sādhubhirgrastahṛdayo bhaktairbhaktajanapriyaḥ  || 09.04.063 ||
nāhamātmānamāśāse madbhaktaiḥ sādhubhirvinā  |
śriyaṃ cātyantikīṃ brahman yeṣāṃ gatirahaṃ parā  || 09.04.064 ||
ye dārāgāraputrāpta prāṇān vittamimaṃ param  |
hitvā māṃ śaraṇaṃ yātāḥ kathaṃ tāṃstyaktumutsahe  || 09.04.065 ||
mayi nirbaddhahṛdayāḥ sādhavaḥ samadarśanāḥ  |
vaśe kurvanti māṃ bhaktyā satstriyaḥ satpatiṃ yathā  || 09.04.066 ||
matsevayā pratītaṃ te sālokyādicatuṣṭayam  |
necchanti sevayā pūrṇāḥ kuto'nyatkālaviplutam  || 09.04.067 ||
sādhavo hṛdayaṃ mahyaṃ sādhūnāṃ hṛdayaṃ tvaham  |
madanyatte na jānanti nāhaṃ tebhyo manāgapi  || 09.04.068 ||
upāyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi tava vipra śṛṇuṣva tat |
ayaṃ hyātmābhicāraste yatastaṃ yāhi mā ciram  |
sādhuṣu prahitaṃ tejaḥ prahartuḥ kurute'śivam  || 09.04.069 ||
tapo vidyā ca viprāṇāṃ niḥśreyasakare ubhe  |
te eva durvinītasya kalpete karturanyathā  || 09.04.070 ||
brahmaṃstadgaccha bhadraṃ te nābhāgatanayaṃ nṛpam  |
kṣamāpaya mahābhāgaṃ tataḥ śāntirbhaviṣyati  || 09.04.071 ||
09.05.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃ bhagavatādiṣṭo durvāsāścakratāpitaḥ  |
ambarīṣamupāvṛtya tatpādau duḥkhito'grahīt || 09.05.001 ||
tasya sodyamamāvīkṣya pādasparśavilajjitaḥ  |
astāvīttaddharerastraṃ kṛpayā pīḍito bhṛśam  || 09.05.002 ||
09.05.003|0 ambarīṣa uvāca
tvamagnirbhagavān sūryastvaṃ somo jyotiṣāṃ patiḥ  |
tvamāpastvaṃ kṣitirvyoma vāyurmātrendriyāṇi ca  || 09.05.003 ||
sudarśana namastubhyaṃ sahasrārācyutapriya  |
sarvāstraghātin viprāya svasti bhūyā iḍaspate  || 09.05.004 ||
tvaṃ dharmastvamṛtaṃ satyaṃ tvaṃ yajño'khilayajñabhuk |
tvaṃ lokapālaḥ sarvātmā tvaṃ tejaḥ pauruṣaṃ param  || 09.05.005 ||
namaḥ sunābhākhiladharmasetave hyadharmaśīlāsuradhūmaketave  |
trailokyagopāya viśuddhavarcase manojavāyādbhutakarmaṇe gṛṇe  || 09.05.006 ||
tvattejasā dharmamayena saṃhṛtaṃ tamaḥ prakāśaśca dṛśo mahātmanām  |
duratyayaste mahimā girāṃ pate tvadrūpametatsadasatparāvaram  || 09.05.007 ||
yadā visṛṣṭastvamanañjanena vai balaṃ praviṣṭo'jita daityadānavam  |
bāhūdarorvaṅghriśirodharāṇi vṛścannajasraṃ pradhane virājase  || 09.05.008 ||
sa tvaṃ jagattrāṇa khalaprahāṇaye nirūpitaḥ sarvasaho gadābhṛtā  |
viprasya cāsmatkuladaivahetave vidhehi bhadraṃ tadanugraho hi naḥ  || 09.05.009 ||
yadyasti dattamiṣṭaṃ vā svadharmo vā svanuṣṭhitaḥ  |
kulaṃ no vipradaivaṃ ceddvijo bhavatu vijvaraḥ  || 09.05.010 ||
yadi no bhagavān prīta ekaḥ sarvaguṇāśrayaḥ  |
sarvabhūtātmabhāvena dvijo bhavatu vijvaraḥ  || 09.05.011 ||
09.05.012|0 śrīśuka uvāca
iti saṃstuvato rājño viṣṇucakraṃ sudarśanam  |
aśāmyatsarvato vipraṃ pradahadrājayācñayā  || 09.05.012 ||
sa mukto'strāgnitāpena durvāsāḥ svastimāṃstataḥ  |
praśaśaṃsa tamurvīśaṃ yuñjānaḥ paramāśiṣaḥ  || 09.05.013 ||
09.05.014|0 durvāsā uvāca
aho anantadāsānāṃ mahattvaṃ dṛṣṭamadya me  |
kṛtāgaso'pi yadrājanmaṅgalāni samīhase  || 09.05.014 ||
duṣkaraḥ ko nu sādhūnāṃ dustyajo vā mahātmanām  |
yaiḥ saṅgṛhīto bhagavān sātvatāmṛṣabho hariḥ  || 09.05.015 ||
yannāmaśrutimātreṇa pumān bhavati nirmalaḥ  |
tasya tīrthapadaḥ kiṃ vā dāsānāmavaśiṣyate  || 09.05.016 ||
rājannanugṛhīto'haṃ tvayātikaruṇātmanā  |
madaghaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā prāṇā yanme'bhirakṣitāḥ  || 09.05.017 ||
rājā tamakṛtāhāraḥ pratyāgamanakāṅkṣayā  |
caraṇāvupasaṅgṛhya prasādya samabhojayat || 09.05.018 ||
so'śitvādṛtamānītamātithyaṃ sārvakāmikam  |
tṛptātmā nṛpatiṃ prāha bhujyatāmiti sādaram  || 09.05.019 ||
prīto'smyanugṛhīto'smi tava bhāgavatasya vai  |
darśanasparśanālāpairātithyenātmamedhasā  || 09.05.020 ||
karmāvadātametatte gāyanti svaḥstriyo muhuḥ  |
kīrtiṃ paramapuṇyāṃ ca kīrtayiṣyati bhūriyam  || 09.05.021 ||
09.05.022|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃ saṅkīrtya rājānaṃ durvāsāḥ paritoṣitaḥ  |
yayau vihāyasāmantrya brahmalokamahaitukam  || 09.05.022 ||
saṃvatsaro'tyagāttāvadyāvatā nāgato gataḥ  |
munistaddarśanākāṅkṣo rājābbhakṣo babhūva ha  || 09.05.023 ||
gate'tha durvāsasi so'mbarīṣo dvijopayogātipavitramāharat |
ṛṣervimokṣaṃ vyasanaṃ ca vīkṣya mene svavīryaṃ ca parānubhāvam  || 09.05.024 ||
evaṃ vidhānekaguṇaḥ sa rājā parātmani brahmaṇi vāsudeve  |
kriyākalāpaiḥ samuvāha bhaktiṃ yayāviriñcyānnirayāṃścakāra  || 09.05.025 ||
09.05.026|0 śrīśuka uvāca
athāmbarīṣastanayeṣu rājyaṃ samānaśīleṣu visṛjya dhīraḥ  |
vanaṃ viveśātmani vāsudeve mano dadhaddhvastaguṇapravāhaḥ  || 09.05.026 ||
ityetatpuṇyamākhyānamambarīṣasya bhūpate  |
saṅkīrtayannanudhyāyan bhakto bhagavato bhavet || 09.05.027 ||
ambarīṣasya caritaṃ ye śṛṇvanti mahātmanaḥ  |
muktiṃ prayānti te sarve bhaktyā viṣṇoḥ prasādataḥ  || 09.05.028 ||
09.06.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
virūpaḥ ketumān chambhurambarīṣasutāstrayaḥ  |
virūpātpṛṣadaśvo'bhūttatputrastu rathītaraḥ  || 09.06.001 ||
rathītarasyāprajasya bhāryāyāṃ tantave'rthitaḥ  |
aṅgirā janayāmāsa brahmavarcasvinaḥ sutān  || 09.06.002 ||
ete kṣetraprasūtā vai punastvāṅgirasāḥ smṛtāḥ  |
rathītarāṇāṃ pravarāḥ kṣetropetā dvijātayaḥ  || 09.06.003 ||
kṣuvatastu manorjajñe ikṣvākurghrāṇataḥ sutaḥ  |
tasya putraśatajyeṣṭhā vikukṣinimidaṇḍakāḥ  || 09.06.004 ||
teṣāṃ purastādabhavannāryāvarte nṛpā nṛpa  |
pañcaviṃśatiḥ paścācca trayo madhye'pare'nyataḥ  || 09.06.005 ||
sa ekadāṣṭakāśrāddhe ikṣvākuḥ sutamādiśat |
māṃsamānīyatāṃ medhyaṃ vikukṣe gaccha mā ciram  || 09.06.006 ||
tatheti sa vanaṃ gatvā mṛgān hatvā kriyārhaṇān  |
śrānto bubhukṣito vīraḥ śaśaṃ cādadapasmṛtiḥ  || 09.06.007 ||
śeṣaṃ nivedayāmāsa pitre tena ca tadguruḥ  |
coditaḥ prokṣaṇāyāha duṣṭametadakarmakam  || 09.06.008 ||
jñātvā putrasya tatkarma guruṇābhihitaṃ nṛpaḥ  |
deśānniḥsārayāmāsa sutaṃ tyaktavidhiṃ ruṣā  || 09.06.009 ||
sa tu vipreṇa saṃvādaṃ jñāpakena samācaran  |
tyaktvā kalevaraṃ yogī sa tenāvāpa yatparam  || 09.06.010 ||
pitaryuparate'bhyetya vikukṣiḥ pṛthivīmimām  |
śāsadīje hariṃ yajñaiḥ śaśāda iti viśrutaḥ  || 09.06.011 ||
purañjayastasya suta indravāha itīritaḥ  |
kakutstha iti cāpyuktaḥ śṛṇu nāmāni karmabhiḥ  || 09.06.012 ||
kṛtānta āsītsamaro devānāṃ saha dānavaiḥ  |
pārṣṇigrāho vṛto vīro devairdaityaparājitaiḥ  || 09.06.013 ||
vacanāddevadevasya viṣṇorviśvātmanaḥ prabhoḥ  |
vāhanatve vṛtastasya babhūvendro mahāvṛṣaḥ  || 09.06.014 ||
sa sannaddho dhanurdivyamādāya viśikhān chitān  |
stūyamānastamāruhya yuyutsuḥ kakudi sthitaḥ  || 09.06.015 ||
tejasāpyāyito viṣṇoḥ puruṣasya mahātmanaḥ  |
pratīcyāṃ diśi daityānāṃ nyaruṇattridaśaiḥ puram  || 09.06.016 ||
taistasya cābhūtpradhanaṃ tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam  |
yamāya bhallairanayaddaityānabhiyayurmṛdhe  || 09.06.017 ||
tasyeṣupātābhimukhaṃ yugāntāgnimivolbaṇam  |
visṛjya dudruvurdaityā hanyamānāḥ svamālayam  || 09.06.018 ||
jitvā paraṃ dhanaṃ sarvaṃ sastrīkaṃ vajrapāṇaye  |
pratyayacchatsa rājarṣiriti nāmabhirāhṛtaḥ  || 09.06.019 ||
purañjayasya putro'bhūdanenāstatsutaḥ pṛthuḥ  |
viśvagandhistataścandro yuvanāśvastu tatsutaḥ  || 09.06.020 ||
śrāvastastatsuto yena śrāvastī nirmame purī  |
bṛhadaśvastu śrāvastistataḥ kuvalayāśvakaḥ  || 09.06.021 ||
yaḥ priyārthamutaṅkasya dhundhunāmāsuraṃ balī  |
sutānāmekaviṃśatyā sahasrairahanadvṛtaḥ  || 09.06.022 ||
dhundhumāra iti khyātastatsutāste ca jajvaluḥ  |
dhundhormukhāgninā sarve traya evāvaśeṣitāḥ  || 09.06.023 ||
dṛḍhāśvaḥ kapilāśvaśca bhadrāśva iti bhārata  |
dṛḍhāśvaputro haryaśvo nikumbhastatsutaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 09.06.024 ||
bahulāśvo nikumbhasya kṛśāśvo'thāsya senajit |
yuvanāśvo'bhavattasya so'napatyo vanaṃ gataḥ  || 09.06.025 ||
bhāryāśatena nirviṇṇa ṛṣayo'sya kṛpālavaḥ  |
iṣṭiṃ sma vartayāṃ cakruraindrīṃ te susamāhitāḥ  || 09.06.026 ||
rājā tadyajñasadanaṃ praviṣṭo niśi tarṣitaḥ  |
dṛṣṭvā śayānān viprāṃstān papau mantrajalaṃ svayam  || 09.06.027 ||
utthitāste niśamyātha vyudakaṃ kalaśaṃ prabho  |
papracchuḥ kasya karmedaṃ pītaṃ puṃsavanaṃ jalam  || 09.06.028 ||
rājñā pītaṃ viditvā vai īśvaraprahitena te  |
īśvarāya namaścakruraho daivabalaṃ balam  || 09.06.029 ||
tataḥ kāla upāvṛtte kukṣiṃ nirbhidya dakṣiṇam  |
yuvanāśvasya tanayaścakravartī jajāna ha  || 09.06.030 ||
kaṃ dhāsyati kumāro'yaṃ stanye rorūyate bhṛśam  |
māṃ dhātā vatsa mā rodīritīndro deśinīmadāt || 09.06.031 ||
na mamāra pitā tasya vipradevaprasādataḥ  |
yuvanāśvo'tha tatraiva tapasā siddhimanvagāt || 09.06.032 ||
trasaddasyuritīndro'ṅga vidadhe nāma yasya vai  |
yasmāttrasanti hyudvignā dasyavo rāvaṇādayaḥ  || 09.06.033 ||
yauvanāśvo'tha māndhātā cakravartyavanīṃ prabhuḥ  |
saptadvīpavatīmekaḥ śaśāsācyutatejasā  || 09.06.034 ||
īje ca yajñaṃ kratubhirātmavidbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ  |
sarvadevamayaṃ devaṃ sarvātmakamatīndriyam  || 09.06.035 ||
dravyaṃ mantro vidhiryajño yajamānastathartvijaḥ  |
dharmo deśaśca kālaśca sarvametadyadātmakam  || 09.06.036 ||
yāvatsūrya udeti sma yāvacca pratitiṣṭhati  |
tatsarvaṃ yauvanāśvasya māndhātuḥ kṣetramucyate  || 09.06.037 ||
śaśabindorduhitari bindumatyāmadhānnṛpaḥ  |
purukutsamambarīṣaṃ mucukundaṃ ca yoginam  |
teṣāṃ svasāraḥ pañcāśatsaubhariṃ vavrire patim  || 09.06.038 ||
yamunāntarjale magnastapyamānaḥ paraṃ tapaḥ  |
nirvṛtiṃ mīnarājasya dṛṣṭvā maithunadharmiṇaḥ  || 09.06.039 ||
jātaspṛho nṛpaṃ vipraḥ kanyāmekāmayācata  |
so'pyāha gṛhyatāṃ brahman kāmaṃ kanyā svayaṃvare  || 09.06.040 ||
sa vicintyāpriyaṃ strīṇāṃ jaraṭho'hamasanmataḥ  |
valīpalita ejatka ityahaṃ pratyudāhṛtaḥ  || 09.06.041 ||
sādhayiṣye tathātmānaṃ surastrīṇāmabhīpsitam  |
kiṃ punarmanujendrāṇāmiti vyavasitaḥ prabhuḥ  || 09.06.042 ||
muniḥ praveśitaḥ kṣatrā kanyāntaḥpuramṛddhimat |
vṛtaḥ sa rājakanyābhirekaṃ pañcāśatā varaḥ  || 09.06.043 ||
tāsāṃ kalirabhūdbhūyāṃstadarthe'pohya sauhṛdam  |
mamānurūpo nāyaṃ va iti tadgatacetasām  || 09.06.044 ||
sa bahvṛcastābhirapāraṇīya tapaḥśriyānarghyaparicchadeṣu  |
gṛheṣu nānopavanāmalāmbhaḥ saraḥsu saugandhikakānaneṣu  || 09.06.045 ||
mahārhaśayyāsanavastrabhūṣaṇa snānānulepābhyavahāramālyakaiḥ  |
svalaṅkṛtastrīpuruṣeṣu nityadā reme'nugāyaddvijabhṛṅgavandiṣu  || 09.06.046 ||
yadgārhasthyaṃ tu saṃvīkṣya saptadvīpavatīpatiḥ  |
vismitaḥ stambhamajahātsārvabhaumaśriyānvitam  || 09.06.047 ||
evaṃ gṛheṣvabhirato viṣayān vividhaiḥ sukhaiḥ  |
sevamāno na cātuṣyadājyastokairivānalaḥ  || 09.06.048 ||
sa kadācidupāsīna ātmāpahnavamātmanaḥ  |
dadarśa bahvṛcācāryo mīnasaṅgasamutthitam  || 09.06.049 ||
aho imaṃ paśyata me vināśaṃ tapasvinaḥ saccaritavratasya  |
antarjale vāricaraprasaṅgātpracyāvitaṃ brahma ciraṃ dhṛtaṃ yat || 09.06.050 ||
saṅgaṃ tyajeta mithunavratīnāṃ mumukṣuḥ   sarvātmanā na visṛjedbahirindriyāṇi  |
ekaścaran rahasi cittamananta īśe   yuñjīta tadvratiṣu sādhuṣu cetprasaṅgaḥ  || 09.06.051 ||*
ekastapasvyahamathāmbhasi matsyasaṅgāt  pañcāśadāsamuta pañcasahasrasargaḥ  |
nāntaṃ vrajāmyubhayakṛtyamanorathānāṃ   māyāguṇairhṛtamatirviṣaye'rthabhāvaḥ  || 09.06.052 ||*
evaṃ vasan gṛhe kālaṃ virakto nyāsamāsthitaḥ  |
vanaṃ jagāmānuyayustatpatnyaḥ patidevatāḥ  || 09.06.053 ||
tatra taptvā tapastīkṣṇamātmadarśanamātmavān  |
sahaivāgnibhirātmānaṃ yuyoja paramātmani  || 09.06.054 ||
tāḥ svapatyurmahārāja nirīkṣyādhyātmikīṃ gatim  |
anvīyustatprabhāveṇa agniṃ śāntamivārciṣaḥ  || 09.06.055 ||
09.07.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
māndhātuḥ putrapravaro yo'mbarīṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ  |
pitāmahena pravṛto yauvanāśvastu tatsutaḥ  |
hārītastasya putro'bhūnmāndhātṛpravarā ime  || 09.07.001 ||
narmadā bhrātṛbhirdattā purukutsāya yoragaiḥ  |
tayā rasātalaṃ nīto bhujagendraprayuktayā  || 09.07.002 ||
gandharvānavadhīttatra vadhyān vai viṣṇuśaktidhṛk |
nāgāllabdhavaraḥ sarpādabhayaṃ smaratāmidam  || 09.07.003 ||
trasaddasyuḥ paurukutso yo'naraṇyasya dehakṛt |
haryaśvastatsutastasmātprāruṇo'tha tribandhanaḥ  || 09.07.004 ||
tasya satyavrataḥ putrastriśaṅkuriti viśrutaḥ  |
prāptaścāṇḍālatāṃ śāpādguroḥ kauśikatejasā  || 09.07.005 ||
saśarīro gataḥ svargamadyāpi divi dṛśyate  |
pātito'vākśirā devaistenaiva stambhito balāt || 09.07.006 ||
traiśaṅkavo hariścandro viśvāmitravasiṣṭhayoḥ  |
yannimittamabhūdyuddhaṃ pakṣiṇorbahuvārṣikam  || 09.07.007 ||
so'napatyo viṣaṇṇātmā nāradasyopadeśataḥ  |
varuṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yātaḥ putro me jāyatāṃ prabho  || 09.07.008 ||
yadi vīro mahārāja tenaiva tvāṃ yaje iti  |
tatheti varuṇenāsya putro jātastu rohitaḥ  || 09.07.009 ||
jātaḥ suto hyanenāṅga māṃ yajasveti so'bravīt |
yadā paśurnirdaśaḥ syādatha medhyo bhavediti  || 09.07.010 ||
nirdaśe ca sa āgatya yajasvetyāha so'bravīt |
dantāḥ paśoryajjāyerannatha medhyo bhavediti  || 09.07.011 ||
dantā jātā yajasveti sa pratyāhātha so'bravīt |
yadā patantyasya dantā atha medhyo bhavediti  || 09.07.012 ||
paśornipatitā dantā yajasvetyāha so'bravīt |
yadā paśoḥ punardantā jāyante'tha paśuḥ śuciḥ  || 09.07.013 ||
punarjātā yajasveti sa pratyāhātha so'bravīt |
sānnāhiko yadā rājan rājanyo'tha paśuḥ śuciḥ  || 09.07.014 ||
iti putrānurāgeṇa snehayantritacetasā  |
kālaṃ vañcayatā taṃ tamukto devastamaikṣata  || 09.07.015 ||
rohitastadabhijñāya pituḥ karma cikīrṣitam  |
prāṇaprepsurdhanuṣpāṇiraraṇyaṃ pratyapadyata  || 09.07.016 ||
pitaraṃ varuṇagrastaṃ śrutvā jātamahodaram  |
rohito grāmameyāya tamindraḥ pratyaṣedhata  || 09.07.017 ||
bhūmeḥ paryaṭanaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthakṣetraniṣevaṇaiḥ  |
rohitāyādiśacchakraḥ so'pyaraṇye'vasatsamām  || 09.07.018 ||
evaṃ dvitīye tṛtīye caturthe pañcame tathā  |
abhyetyābhyetya sthaviro vipro bhūtvāha vṛtrahā  || 09.07.019 ||
ṣaṣṭhaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ tatra caritvā rohitaḥ purīm  |
upavrajannajīgartādakrīṇānmadhyamaṃ sutam  || 09.07.020 ||
śunaḥśephaṃ paśuṃ pitre pradāya samavandata  |
tataḥ puruṣamedhena hariścandro mahāyaśāḥ  || 09.07.021 ||
muktodaro'yajaddevān varuṇādīnmahatkathaḥ  |
viśvāmitro'bhavattasmin hotā cādhvaryurātmavān  || 09.07.022 ||
jamadagnirabhūdbrahmā vasiṣṭho'yāsyaḥ sāmagaḥ  |
tasmai tuṣṭo dadāvindraḥ śātakaumbhamayaṃ ratham  || 09.07.023 ||
śunaḥśephasya māhātmyamupariṣṭātpracakṣyate  |
satyaṃ sāraṃ dhṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā sabhāryasya ca bhūpateḥ  || 09.07.024 ||
viśvāmitro bhṛśaṃ prīto dadāvavihatāṃ gatim  |
manaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tāmadbhistejasāpo'nilena tat || 09.07.025 ||
khe vāyuṃ dhārayaṃstacca bhūtādau taṃ mahātmani  |
tasmin jñānakalāṃ dhyātvā tayājñānaṃ vinirdahan  || 09.07.026 ||
hitvā tāṃ svena bhāvena nirvāṇasukhasaṃvidā  |
anirdeśyāpratarkyeṇa tasthau vidhvastabandhanaḥ  || 09.07.027 ||
09.08.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
harito rohitasutaścampastasmādvinirmitā  |
campāpurī sudevo'to vijayo yasya cātmajaḥ  || 09.08.001 ||
bharukastatsutastasmādvṛkastasyāpi bāhukaḥ  |
so'ribhirhṛtabhū rājā sabhāryo vanamāviśat || 09.08.002 ||
vṛddhaṃ taṃ pañcatāṃ prāptaṃ mahiṣyanumariṣyatī  |
aurveṇa jānatātmānaṃ prajāvantaṃ nivāritā  || 09.08.003 ||
ājñāyāsyai sapatnībhirgaro datto'ndhasā saha  |
saha tenaiva sañjātaḥ sagarākhyo mahāyaśāḥ  || 09.08.004 ||
sagaraścakravartyāsītsāgaro yatsutaiḥ kṛtaḥ  |
yastālajaṅghān yavanāñchakān haihayabarbarān  || 09.08.005 ||
nāvadhīdguruvākyena cakre vikṛtaveṣiṇaḥ  |
muṇḍān chmaśrudharān kāṃścinmuktakeśārdhamuṇḍitān  || 09.08.006 ||
anantarvāsasaḥ kāṃścidabahirvāsaso'parān  |
so'śvamedhairayajata sarvavedasurātmakam  || 09.08.007 ||
aurvopadiṣṭayogena harimātmānamīśvaram  |
tasyotsṛṣṭaṃ paśuṃ yajñe jahārāśvaṃ purandaraḥ  || 09.08.008 ||
sumatyāstanayā dṛptāḥ piturādeśakāriṇaḥ  |
hayamanveṣamāṇāste samantānnyakhananmahīm  || 09.08.009 ||
prāgudīcyāṃ diśi hayaṃ dadṛśuḥ kapilāntike  |
eṣa vājiharaścaura āste mīlitalocanaḥ  || 09.08.010 ||
hanyatāṃ hanyatāṃ pāpa iti ṣaṣṭisahasriṇaḥ  |
udāyudhā abhiyayurunmimeṣa tadā muniḥ  || 09.08.011 ||
svaśarīrāgninā tāvanmahendrahṛtacetasaḥ  |
mahadvyatikramahatā bhasmasādabhavan kṣaṇāt || 09.08.012 ||
na sādhuvādo munikopabharjitā nṛpendraputrā iti sattvadhāmani  |
kathaṃ tamo roṣamayaṃ vibhāvyate jagatpavitrātmani khe rajo bhuvaḥ  || 09.08.013 ||
yasyeritā sāṅkhyamayī dṛḍheha nauryayā mumukṣustarate duratyayam  |
bhavārṇavaṃ mṛtyupathaṃ vipaścitaḥ parātmabhūtasya kathaṃ pṛthaṅmatiḥ  || 09.08.014 ||
yo'samañjasa ityuktaḥ sa keśinyā nṛpātmajaḥ  |
tasya putro'ṃśumānnāma pitāmahahite rataḥ  || 09.08.015 ||
asamañjasa ātmānaṃ darśayannasamañjasam  |
jātismaraḥ purā saṅgādyogī yogādvicālitaḥ  || 09.08.016 ||
ācaran garhitaṃ loke jñātīnāṃ karma vipriyam  |
sarayvāṃ krīḍato bālān prāsyadudvejayan janam  || 09.08.017 ||
evaṃ vṛttaḥ parityaktaḥ pitrā snehamapohya vai  |
yogaiśvaryeṇa bālāṃstān darśayitvā tato yayau  || 09.08.018 ||
ayodhyāvāsinaḥ sarve bālakān punarāgatān  |
dṛṣṭvā visismire rājan rājā cāpyanvatapyata  || 09.08.019 ||
aṃśumāṃścodito rājñā turagānveṣaṇe yayau  |
pitṛvyakhātānupathaṃ bhasmānti dadṛśe hayam  || 09.08.020 ||
tatrāsīnaṃ muniṃ vīkṣya kapilākhyamadhokṣajam  |
astautsamāhitamanāḥ prāñjaliḥ praṇato mahān  || 09.08.021 ||
09.08.022|0 aṃśumānuvāca
na paśyati tvāṃ paramātmano'jano na budhyate'dyāpi samādhiyuktibhiḥ  |
kuto'pare tasya manaḥśarīradhī visargasṛṣṭā vayamaprakāśāḥ  || 09.08.022 ||
ye dehabhājastriguṇapradhānā guṇān vipaśyantyuta vā tamaśca  |
yanmāyayā mohitacetasastvāṃ viduḥ svasaṃsthaṃ na bahiḥprakāśāḥ  || 09.08.023 ||
taṃ tvāṃ ahaṃ jñānaghanaṃ svabhāva pradhvastamāyāguṇabhedamohaiḥ  |
sanandanādyairmunibhirvibhāvyaṃ kathaṃ vimūḍhaḥ paribhāvayāmi  || 09.08.024 ||
praśānta māyāguṇakarmaliṅgamanāmarūpaṃ sadasadvimuktam  |
jñānopadeśāya gṛhītadehaṃ namāmahe tvāṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam  || 09.08.025 ||
tvanmāyāracite loke vastubuddhyā gṛhādiṣu  |
bhramanti kāmalobherṣyā mohavibhrāntacetasaḥ  || 09.08.026 ||
adya naḥ sarvabhūtātman kāmakarmendriyāśayaḥ  |
mohapāśo dṛḍhaśchinno bhagavaṃstava darśanāt || 09.08.027 ||
09.08.028|0 śrīśuka uvāca
itthaṃ gītānubhāvastaṃ bhagavān kapilo muniḥ  |
aṃśumantamuvācedamanugrāhya dhiyā nṛpa  || 09.08.028 ||
09.08.029|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
aśvo'yaṃ nīyatāṃ vatsa pitāmahapaśustava  |
ime ca pitaro dagdhā gaṅgāmbho'rhanti netarat || 09.08.029 ||
taṃ parikramya śirasā prasādya hayamānayat |
sagarastena paśunā yajñaśeṣaṃ samāpayat || 09.08.030 ||
rājyamaṃśumate nyasya niḥspṛho muktabandhanaḥ  |
aurvopadiṣṭamārgeṇa lebhe gatimanuttamām  || 09.08.031 ||
09.09.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
aṃśumāṃśca tapastepe gaṅgānayanakāmyayā  |
kālaṃ mahāntaṃ nāśaknottataḥ kālena saṃsthitaḥ  || 09.09.001 ||
dilīpastatsutastadvadaśaktaḥ kālameyivān  |
bhagīrathastasya sutastepe sa sumahattapaḥ  || 09.09.002 ||
darśayāmāsa taṃ devī prasannā varadāsmi te  |
ityuktaḥ svamabhiprāyaṃ śaśaṃsāvanato nṛpaḥ  || 09.09.003 ||
ko'pi dhārayitā vegaṃ patantyā me mahītale  |
anyathā bhūtalaṃ bhittvā nṛpa yāsye rasātalam  || 09.09.004 ||
kiṃ cāhaṃ na bhuvaṃ yāsye narā mayyāmṛjantyagham  |
mṛjāmi tadaghaṃ kvāhaṃ rājaṃstatra vicintyatām  || 09.09.005 ||
09.09.006|0 śrībhagīratha uvāca
sādhavo nyāsinaḥ śāntā brahmiṣṭhā lokapāvanāḥ  |
harantyaghaṃ te'ṅgasaṅgātteṣvāste hyaghabhiddhariḥ  || 09.09.006 ||
dhārayiṣyati te vegaṃ rudrastvātmā śarīriṇām  |
yasminnotamidaṃ protaṃ viśvaṃ śāṭīva tantuṣu  || 09.09.007 ||
ityuktvā sa nṛpo devaṃ tapasātoṣayacchivam  |
kālenālpīyasā rājaṃstasyeśaścāśvatuṣyata  || 09.09.008 ||
tatheti rājñābhihitaṃ sarvalokahitaḥ śivaḥ  |
dadhārāvahito gaṅgāṃ pādapūtajalāṃ hareḥ  || 09.09.009 ||
bhagīrathaḥ sa rājarṣirninye bhuvanapāvanīm  |
yatra svapitṇāṃ dehā bhasmībhūtāḥ sma śerate  || 09.09.010 ||
rathena vāyuvegena prayāntamanudhāvatī  |
deśān punantī nirdagdhānāsiñcatsagarātmajān  || 09.09.011 ||
yajjalasparśamātreṇa brahmadaṇḍahatā api  |
sagarātmajā divaṃ jagmuḥ kevalaṃ dehabhasmabhiḥ  || 09.09.012 ||
bhasmībhūtāṅgasaṅgena svaryātāḥ sagarātmajāḥ  |
kiṃ punaḥ śraddhayā devīṃ sevante ye dhṛtavratāḥ  || 09.09.013 ||
na hyetatparamāścaryaṃ svardhunyā yadihoditam  |
anantacaraṇāmbhoja prasūtāyā bhavacchidaḥ  || 09.09.014 ||
sanniveśya mano yasmiñchraddhayā munayo'malāḥ  |
traiguṇyaṃ dustyajaṃ hitvā sadyo yātāstadātmatām  || 09.09.015 ||
śruto bhagīrathājjajñe tasya nābho'paro'bhavat |
sindhudvīpastatastasmādayutāyustato'bhavat || 09.09.016 ||
ṛtūparṇo nalasakho yo'śvavidyāmayānnalāt |
dattvākṣahṛdayaṃ cāsmai sarvakāmastu tatsutam  || 09.09.017 ||
tataḥ sudāsastatputro damayantīpatirnṛpaḥ  |
āhurmitrasahaṃ yaṃ vai kalmāṣāṅghrimuta kvacit |
vasiṣṭhaśāpādrakṣo'bhūdanapatyaḥ svakarmaṇā  || 09.09.018 ||
09.09.019|0 śrīrājovāca
kiṃ nimitto guroḥ śāpaḥ saudāsasya mahātmanaḥ  |
etadveditumicchāmaḥ kathyatāṃ na raho yadi  || 09.09.019 ||
09.09.020|0 śrīśuka uvāca
saudāso mṛgayāṃ kiñciccaran rakṣo jaghāna ha  |
mumoca bhrātaraṃ so'tha gataḥ praticikīrṣayā  || 09.09.020 ||
sañcintayannaghaṃ rājñaḥ sūdarūpadharo gṛhe  |
gurave bhoktukāmāya paktvā ninye narāmiṣam  || 09.09.021 ||
parivekṣyamāṇaṃ bhagavān vilokyābhakṣyamañjasā  |
rājānamaśapatkruddho rakṣo hyevaṃ bhaviṣyasi  || 09.09.022 ||
rakṣaḥkṛtaṃ tadviditvā cakre dvādaśavārṣikam  |
so'pyapo'ñjalimādāya guruṃ śaptuṃ samudyataḥ  || 09.09.023 ||
vārito madayantyāpo ruśatīḥ pādayorjahau  |
diśaḥ khamavanīṃ sarvaṃ paśyan jīvamayaṃ nṛpaḥ  || 09.09.024 ||
rākṣasaṃ bhāvamāpannaḥ pāde kalmāṣatāṃ gataḥ  |
vyavāyakāle dadṛśe vanaukodampatī dvijau  || 09.09.025 ||
kṣudhārto jagṛhe vipraṃ tatpatnyāhākṛtārthavat |
na bhavān rākṣasaḥ sākṣādikṣvākūṇāṃ mahārathaḥ  || 09.09.026 ||
madayantyāḥ patirvīra nādharmaṃ kartumarhasi  |
dehi me'patyakāmāyā akṛtārthaṃ patiṃ dvijam  || 09.09.027 ||
deho'yaṃ mānuṣo rājan puruṣasyākhilārthadaḥ  |
tasmādasya vadho vīra sarvārthavadha ucyate  || 09.09.028 ||
eṣa hi brāhmaṇo vidvāṃstapaḥśīlaguṇānvitaḥ  |
ārirādhayiṣurbrahma mahāpuruṣasaṃjñitam  |
sarvabhūtātmabhāvena bhūteṣvantarhitaṃ guṇaiḥ  || 09.09.029 ||
so'yaṃ brahmarṣivaryaste rājarṣipravarādvibho  |
kathamarhati dharmajña vadhaṃ piturivātmajaḥ  || 09.09.030 ||
tasya sādhorapāpasya bhrūṇasya brahmavādinaḥ  |
kathaṃ vadhaṃ yathā babhrormanyate sanmato bhavān  || 09.09.031 ||
yadyayaṃ kriyate bhakṣyastarhi māṃ khāda pūrvataḥ  |
na jīviṣye vinā yena kṣaṇaṃ ca mṛtakaṃ yathā  || 09.09.032 ||
evaṃ karuṇabhāṣiṇyā vilapantyā anāthavat |
vyāghraḥ paśumivākhādatsaudāsaḥ śāpamohitaḥ  || 09.09.033 ||
brāhmaṇī vīkṣya didhiṣuṃ puruṣādena bhakṣitam  |
śocantyātmānamurvīśamaśapatkupitā satī  || 09.09.034 ||
yasmānme bhakṣitaḥ pāpa kāmārtāyāḥ patistvayā  |
tavāpi mṛtyurādhānādakṛtaprajña darśitaḥ  || 09.09.035 ||
evaṃ mitrasahaṃ śaptvā patilokaparāyaṇā  |
tadasthīni samiddhe'gnau prāsya bharturgatiṃ gatā  || 09.09.036 ||
viśāpo dvādaśābdānte maithunāya samudyataḥ  |
vijñāpya brāhmaṇīśāpaṃ mahiṣyā sa nivāritaḥ  || 09.09.037 ||
ata ūrdhvaṃ sa tatyāja strīsukhaṃ karmaṇāprajāḥ  |
vasiṣṭhastadanujñāto madayantyāṃ prajāmadhāt || 09.09.038 ||
sā vai sapta samā garbhamabibhranna vyajāyata  |
jaghne'śmanodaraṃ tasyāḥ so'śmakastena kathyate  || 09.09.039 ||
aśmakādbāliko jajñe yaḥ strībhiḥ parirakṣitaḥ  |
nārīkavaca ityukto niḥkṣatre mūlako'bhavat || 09.09.040 ||
tato daśarathastasmātputra aiḍaviḍistataḥ  |
rājā viśvasaho yasya khaṭvāṅgaścakravartyabhūt || 09.09.041 ||
yo devairarthito daityānavadhīdyudhi durjayaḥ  |
muhūrtamāyurjñātvaitya svapuraṃ sandadhe manaḥ  || 09.09.042 ||
na me brahmakulātprāṇāḥ kuladaivānna cātmajāḥ  |
na śriyo na mahī rājyaṃ na dārāścātivallabhāḥ  || 09.09.043 ||
na bālye'pi matirmahyamadharme ramate kvacit |
nāpaśyamuttamaślokādanyatkiñcana vastvaham  || 09.09.044 ||
devaiḥ kāmavaro datto mahyaṃ tribhuvaneśvaraiḥ  |
na vṛṇe tamahaṃ kāmaṃ bhūtabhāvanabhāvanaḥ  || 09.09.045 ||
ye vikṣiptendriyadhiyo devāste svahṛdi sthitam  |
na vindanti priyaṃ śaśvadātmānaṃ kimutāpare  || 09.09.046 ||
atheśamāyāraciteṣu saṅgaṃ guṇeṣu gandharvapuropameṣu  |
rūḍhaṃ prakṛtyātmani viśvakarturbhāvena hitvā tamahaṃ prapadye  || 09.09.047 ||
iti vyavasito buddhyā nārāyaṇagṛhītayā  |
hitvānyabhāvamajñānaṃ tataḥ svaṃ bhāvamāsthitaḥ  || 09.09.048 ||
yattadbrahma paraṃ sūkṣmamaśūnyaṃ śūnyakalpitam  |
bhagavān vāsudeveti yaṃ gṛṇanti hi sātvatāḥ  || 09.09.049 ||
09.10.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
khaṭvāṅgāddīrghabāhuśca raghustasmātpṛthuśravāḥ  |
ajastato mahārājastasmāddaśaratho'bhavat || 09.10.001 ||
tasyāpi bhagavāneṣa sākṣādbrahmamayo hariḥ  |
aṃśāṃśena caturdhāgātputratvaṃ prārthitaḥ suraiḥ  |
rāmalakṣmaṇabharata śatrughnā iti saṃjñayā  || 09.10.002 ||
tasyānucaritaṃ rājannṛṣibhistattvadarśibhiḥ  |
śrutaṃ hi varṇitaṃ bhūri tvayā sītāpatermuhuḥ  || 09.10.003 ||
gurvarthe tyaktarājyo vyacaradanuvanaṃ padmapadbhyāṃ priyāyāḥ   pāṇisparśākṣamābhyāṃ mṛjitapatharujo yo harīndrānujābhyām  |
vairūpyācchūrpaṇakhyāḥ priyaviraharuṣāropitabhrūvijṛmbha   trastābdhirbaddhasetuḥ khaladavadahanaḥ kosalendro'vatānnaḥ  || 09.10.004 ||*
viśvāmitrādhvare yena mārīcādyā niśācarāḥ  |
paśyato lakṣmaṇasyaiva hatā nairṛtapuṅgavāḥ  || 09.10.005 ||
yo lokavīrasamitau dhanuraiśamugraṃ   sītāsvayaṃvaragṛhe triśatopanītam  |
ādāya bālagajalīla ivekṣuyaṣṭiṃ   sajjyīkṛtaṃ nṛpa vikṛṣya babhañja madhye  || 09.10.006 ||*
jitvānurūpaguṇaśīlavayo'ṅgarūpāṃ   sītābhidhāṃ śriyamurasyabhilabdhamānām  |
mārge vrajan bhṛgupatervyanayatprarūḍhaṃ   darpaṃ mahīmakṛta yastrirarājabījām  || 09.10.007 ||*
yaḥ satyapāśaparivītapiturnideśaṃ   straiṇasya cāpi śirasā jagṛhe sabhāryaḥ  |
rājyaṃ śriyaṃ praṇayinaḥ suhṛdo nivāsaṃ   tyaktvā yayau vanamasūniva muktasaṅgaḥ  || 09.10.008 ||*
rakṣaḥsvasurvyakṛta rūpamaśuddhabuddhes  tasyāḥ kharatriśiradūṣaṇamukhyabandhūn  |
jaghne caturdaśasahasramapāraṇīya   kodaṇḍapāṇiraṭamāna uvāsa kṛcchram  || 09.10.009 ||*
sītākathāśravaṇadīpitahṛcchayena   sṛṣṭaṃ vilokya nṛpate daśakandhareṇa  |
jaghne'dbhutaiṇavapuṣāśramato'pakṛṣṭo   mārīcamāśu viśikhena yathā kamugraḥ  || 09.10.010 ||*
rakṣo'dhamena vṛkavadvipine'samakṣaṃ   vaideharājaduhitaryapayāpitāyām  |
bhrātrā vane kṛpaṇavatpriyayā viyuktaḥ   strīsaṅgināṃ gatimiti prathayaṃścacāra  || 09.10.011 ||*
dagdhvātmakṛtyahatakṛtyamahan kabandhaṃ   sakhyaṃ vidhāya kapibhirdayitāgatiṃ taiḥ  |
buddhvātha vālini hate plavagendrasainyair  velāmagātsa manujo'jabhavārcitāṅghriḥ  || 09.10.012 ||*
yadroṣavibhramavivṛttakaṭākṣapāta   sambhrāntanakramakaro bhayagīrṇaghoṣaḥ  |
sindhuḥ śirasyarhaṇaṃ parigṛhya rūpī   pādāravindamupagamya babhāṣa etat || 09.10.013 ||*
na tvāṃ vayaṃ jaḍadhiyo nu vidāma bhūman   kūṭasthamādipuruṣaṃ jagatāmadhīśam  |
yatsattvataḥ suragaṇā rajasaḥ prajeśā   manyośca bhūtapatayaḥ sa bhavān guṇeśaḥ  || 09.10.014 ||*
kāmaṃ prayāhi jahi viśravaso'vamehaṃ   trailokyarāvaṇamavāpnuhi vīra patnīm  |
badhnīhi setumiha te yaśaso vitatyai   gāyanti digvijayino yamupetya bhūpāḥ  || 09.10.015 ||*
baddhvodadhau raghupatirvividhādrikūṭaiḥ   setuṃ kapīndrakarakampitabhūruhāṅgaiḥ  |
sugrīvanīlahanumatpramukhairanīkair  laṅkāṃ vibhīṣaṇadṛśāviśadagradagdhām  || 09.10.016 ||*
sā vānarendrabalaruddhavihārakoṣṭha   śrīdvāragopurasadovalabhīviṭaṅkā  |
nirbhajyamānadhiṣaṇadhvajahemakumbha   śṛṅgāṭakā gajakulairhradinīva ghūrṇā  || 09.10.017 ||*
rakṣaḥpatistadavalokya nikumbhakumbha   dhūmrākṣadurmukhasurāntakanarāntakādīn  |
putraṃ prahastamatikāyavikampanādīn   sarvānugān samahinodatha kumbhakarṇam  || 09.10.018 ||*
tāṃ yātudhānapṛtanāmasiśūlacāpa   prāsarṣṭiśaktiśaratomarakhaḍgadurgām  |
sugrīvalakṣmaṇamarutsutagandhamāda   nīlāṅgadarkṣapanasādibhiranvito'gāt || 09.10.019 ||*
te'nīkapā raghupaterabhipatya sarve   dvandvaṃ varūthamibhapattirathāśvayodhaiḥ  |
jaghnurdrumairgirigadeṣubhiraṅgadādyāḥ   sītābhimarṣahatamaṅgalarāvaṇeśān  || 09.10.020 ||*
rakṣaḥpatiḥ svabalanaṣṭimavekṣya ruṣṭa   āruhya yānakamathābhisasāra rāmam  |
svaḥsyandane dyumati mātalinopanīte   vibhrājamānamahananniśitaiḥ kṣurapraiḥ  || 09.10.021 ||*
rāmastamāha puruṣādapurīṣa yannaḥ   kāntāsamakṣamasatāpahṛtā śvavatte  |
tyaktatrapasya phalamadya jugupsitasya   yacchāmi kāla iva karturalaṅghyavīryaḥ  || 09.10.022 ||*
evaṃ kṣipan dhanuṣi sandhitamutsasarja   bāṇaṃ sa vajramiva taddhṛdayaṃ bibheda  |
so'sṛgvaman daśamukhairnyapatadvimānād  dhāheti jalpati jane sukṛtīva riktaḥ  || 09.10.023 ||*
tato niṣkramya laṅkāyā yātudhānyaḥ sahasraśaḥ  |
mandodaryā samaṃ tatra prarudantya upādravan  || 09.10.024 ||
svān svān bandhūn pariṣvajya lakṣmaṇeṣubhirarditān  |
ruruduḥ susvaraṃ dīnā ghnantya ātmānamātmanā  || 09.10.025 ||
hā hatāḥ sma vayaṃ nātha lokarāvaṇa rāvaṇa  |
kaṃ yāyāccharaṇaṃ laṅkā tvadvihīnā parārditā  || 09.10.026 ||
na vai veda mahābhāga bhavān kāmavaśaṃ gataḥ  |
tejo'nubhāvaṃ sītāyā yena nīto daśāmimām  || 09.10.027 ||
kṛtaiṣā vidhavā laṅkā vayaṃ ca kulanandana  |
dehaḥ kṛto'nnaṃ gṛdhrāṇāmātmā narakahetave  || 09.10.028 ||
09.10.029|0 śrīśuka uvāca
svānāṃ vibhīṣaṇaścakre kosalendrānumoditaḥ  |
pitṛmedhavidhānena yaduktaṃ sāmparāyikam  || 09.10.029 ||
tato dadarśa bhagavānaśokavanikāśrame  |
kṣāmāṃ svavirahavyādhiṃ śiṃśapāmūlamāśritām  || 09.10.030 ||
rāmaḥ priyatamāṃ bhāryāṃ dīnāṃ vīkṣyānvakampata  |
ātmasandarśanāhlāda vikasanmukhapaṅkajām  || 09.10.031 ||
āropyāruruhe yānaṃ bhrātṛbhyāṃ hanumadyutaḥ  |
vibhīṣaṇāya bhagavān dattvā rakṣogaṇeśatām  || 09.10.032 ||
laṅkāmāyuśca kalpāntaṃ yayau cīrṇavrataḥ purīm  |
avakīryamāṇaḥ sukusumairlokapālārpitaiḥ pathi  || 09.10.033 ||
upagīyamānacaritaḥ śatadhṛtyādibhirmudā  |
gomūtrayāvakaṃ śrutvā bhrātaraṃ valkalāmbaram  || 09.10.034 ||
mahākāruṇiko'tapyajjaṭilaṃ sthaṇḍileśayam  |
bharataḥ prāptamākarṇya paurāmātyapurohitaiḥ  || 09.10.035 ||
pāduke śirasi nyasya rāmaṃ pratyudyato'grajam  |
nandigrāmātsvaśibirādgītavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ  || 09.10.036 ||
brahmaghoṣeṇa ca muhuḥ paṭhadbhirbrahmavādibhiḥ  |
svarṇakakṣapatākābhirhaimaiścitradhvajai rathaiḥ  || 09.10.037 ||
sadaśvai rukmasannāhairbhaṭaiḥ puraṭavarmabhiḥ  |
śreṇībhirvāramukhyābhirbhṛtyaiścaiva padānugaiḥ  || 09.10.038 ||
pārameṣṭhyānyupādāya paṇyānyuccāvacāni ca  |
pādayornyapatatpremṇā praklinnahṛdayekṣaṇaḥ  || 09.10.039 ||
pāduke nyasya purataḥ prāñjalirbāṣpalocanaḥ  |
tamāśliṣya ciraṃ dorbhyāṃ snāpayannetrajairjalaiḥ  || 09.10.040 ||
rāmo lakṣmaṇasītābhyāṃ viprebhyo ye'rhasattamāḥ  |
tebhyaḥ svayaṃ namaścakre prajābhiśca namaskṛtaḥ  || 09.10.041 ||
dhunvanta uttarāsaṅgān patiṃ vīkṣya cirāgatam  |
uttarāḥ kosalā mālyaiḥ kiranto nanṛturmudā  || 09.10.042 ||
pāduke bharato'gṛhṇāccāmaravyajanottame  |
vibhīṣaṇaḥ sasugrīvaḥ śvetacchatraṃ marutsutaḥ  || 09.10.043 ||
dhanurniṣaṅgān chatrughnaḥ sītā tīrthakamaṇḍalum  |
abibhradaṅgadaḥ khaḍgaṃ haimaṃ carmarkṣarāṇnṛpa  || 09.10.044 ||
puṣpakastho nutaḥ strībhiḥ stūyamānaśca vandibhiḥ  |
vireje bhagavān rājan grahaiścandra ivoditaḥ  || 09.10.045 ||
bhrātrābhinanditaḥ so'tha sotsavāṃ prāviśatpurīm  |
praviśya rājabhavanaṃ gurupatnīḥ svamātaram  || 09.10.046 ||
gurūn vayasyāvarajān pūjitaḥ pratyapūjayat |
vaidehī lakṣmaṇaścaiva yathāvatsamupeyatuḥ  || 09.10.047 ||
putrān svamātarastāstu prāṇāṃstanva ivotthitāḥ  |
āropyāṅke'bhiṣiñcantyo bāṣpaughairvijahuḥ śucaḥ  || 09.10.048 ||
jaṭā nirmucya vidhivatkulavṛddhaiḥ samaṃ guruḥ  |
abhyaṣiñcadyathaivendraṃ catuḥsindhujalādibhiḥ  || 09.10.049 ||
evaṃ kṛtaśiraḥsnānaḥ suvāsāḥ sragvyalaṅkṛtaḥ  |
svalaṅkṛtaiḥ suvāsobhirbhrātṛbhirbhāryayā babhau  || 09.10.050 ||
agrahīdāsanaṃ bhrātrā praṇipatya prasāditaḥ  |
prajāḥ svadharmaniratā varṇāśramaguṇānvitāḥ  |
jugopa pitṛvadrāmo menire pitaraṃ ca tam  || 09.10.051 ||
tretāyāṃ vartamānāyāṃ kālaḥ kṛtasamo'bhavat |
rāme rājani dharmajñe sarvabhūtasukhāvahe  || 09.10.052 ||
vanāni nadyo girayo varṣāṇi dvīpasindhavaḥ  |
sarve kāmadughā āsan prajānāṃ bharatarṣabha  || 09.10.053 ||
nādhivyādhijarāglāni duḥkhaśokabhayaklamāḥ  |
mṛtyuścānicchatāṃ nāsīdrāme rājanyadhokṣaje  || 09.10.054 ||
ekapatnīvratadharo rājarṣicaritaḥ śuciḥ  |
svadharmaṃ gṛhamedhīyaṃ śikṣayan svayamācarat || 09.10.055 ||
premṇānuvṛttyā śīlena praśrayāvanatā satī  |
bhiyā hriyā ca bhāvajñā bhartuḥ sītāharanmanaḥ  || 09.10.056 ||
09.11.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
bhagavānātmanātmānaṃ rāma uttamakalpakaiḥ  |
sarvadevamayaṃ devamīje'thācāryavānmakhaiḥ  || 09.11.001 ||
hotre'dadāddiśaṃ prācīṃ brahmaṇe dakṣiṇāṃ prabhuḥ  |
adhvaryave pratīcīṃ vā uttarāṃ sāmagāya saḥ  || 09.11.002 ||
ācāryāya dadau śeṣāṃ yāvatī bhūstadantarā  |
anyamāna idaṃ kṛtsnaṃ brāhmaṇo'rhati niḥspṛhaḥ  || 09.11.003 ||
ityayaṃ tadalaṅkāra vāsobhyāmavaśeṣitaḥ  |
tathā rājñyapi vaidehī saumaṅgalyāvaśeṣitā  || 09.11.004 ||
te tu brāhmaṇadevasya vātsalyaṃ vīkṣya saṃstutam  |
prītāḥ klinnadhiyastasmai pratyarpyedaṃ babhāṣire  || 09.11.005 ||
aprattaṃ nastvayā kiṃ nu bhagavan bhuvaneśvara  |
yanno'ntarhṛdayaṃ viśya tamo haṃsi svarociṣā  || 09.11.006 ||
namo brahmaṇyadevāya rāmāyākuṇṭhamedhase  |
uttamaślokadhuryāya nyastadaṇḍārpitāṅghraye  || 09.11.007 ||
kadācillokajijñāsurgūḍho rātryāmalakṣitaḥ  |
caran vāco'śṛṇodrāmo bhāryāmuddiśya kasyacit || 09.11.008 ||
nāhaṃ bibharmi tvāṃ duṣṭāmasatīṃ paraveśmagām  |
straiṇo hi bibhṛyātsītāṃ rāmo nāhaṃ bhaje punaḥ  || 09.11.009 ||
iti lokādbahumukhāddurārādhyādasaṃvidaḥ  |
patyā bhītena sā tyaktā prāptā prācetasāśramam  || 09.11.010 ||
antarvatnyāgate kāle yamau sā suṣuve sutau  |
kuśo lava iti khyātau tayoścakre kriyā muniḥ  || 09.11.011 ||
aṅgadaścitraketuśca lakṣmaṇasyātmajau smṛtau  |
takṣaḥ puṣkala ityāstāṃ bharatasya mahīpate  || 09.11.012 ||
subāhuḥ śrutasenaśca śatrughnasya babhūvatuḥ  |
gandharvān koṭiśo jaghne bharato vijaye diśām  || 09.11.013 ||
tadīyaṃ dhanamānīya sarvaṃ rājñe nyavedayat |
śatrughnaśca madhoḥ putraṃ lavaṇaṃ nāma rākṣasam  |
hatvā madhuvane cakre mathurāṃ nāma vai purīm  || 09.11.014 ||
munau nikṣipya tanayau sītā bhartrā vivāsitā  |
dhyāyantī rāmacaraṇau vivaraṃ praviveśa ha  || 09.11.015 ||
tacchrutvā bhagavān rāmo rundhannapi dhiyā śucaḥ  |
smaraṃstasyā guṇāṃstāṃstānnāśaknodroddhumīśvaraḥ  || 09.11.016 ||
strīpuṃprasaṅga etādṛksarvatra trāsamāvahaḥ  |
apīśvarāṇāṃ kimuta grāmyasya gṛhacetasaḥ  || 09.11.017 ||
tata ūrdhvaṃ brahmacaryaṃ dhāryannajuhotprabhuḥ  |
trayodaśābdasāhasramagnihotramakhaṇḍitam  || 09.11.018 ||
smaratāṃ hṛdi vinyasya viddhaṃ daṇḍakakaṇṭakaiḥ  |
svapādapallavaṃ rāma ātmajyotiragāttataḥ  || 09.11.019 ||
nedaṃ yaśo raghupateḥ surayācñayātta   līlātanoradhikasāmyavimuktadhāmnaḥ  |
rakṣovadho jaladhibandhanamastrapūgaiḥ   kiṃ tasya śatruhanane kapayaḥ sahāyāḥ  || 09.10.020 ||*
yasyāmalaṃ nṛpasadaḥsu yaśo'dhunāpi   gāyantyaghaghnamṛṣayo digibhendrapaṭṭam  |
taṃ nākapālavasupālakirīṭajuṣṭa   pādāmbujaṃ raghupatiṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye  || 09.11.021 ||*
sa yaiḥ spṛṣṭo'bhidṛṣṭo vā saṃviṣṭo'nugato'pi vā  |
kosalāste yayuḥ sthānaṃ yatra gacchanti yoginaḥ  || 09.11.022 ||
puruṣo rāmacaritaṃ śravaṇairupadhārayan  |
ānṛśaṃsyaparo rājan karmabandhairvimucyate  || 09.11.023 ||
09.11.024|0 śrīrājovāca
kathaṃ sa bhagavān rāmo bhrātn vā svayamātmanaḥ  |
tasmin vā te'nvavartanta prajāḥ paurāśca īśvare  || 09.11.024 ||
09.11.025|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
athādiśaddigvijaye bhrātṃstribhuvaneśvaraḥ  |
ātmānaṃ darśayan svānāṃ purīmaikṣata sānugaḥ  || 09.11.025 ||
āsiktamārgāṃ gandhodaiḥ kariṇāṃ madaśīkaraiḥ  |
svāminaṃ prāptamālokya mattāṃ vā sutarāmiva  || 09.11.026 ||
prāsādagopurasabhā caityadevagṛhādiṣu  |
vinyastahemakalaśaiḥ patākābhiśca maṇḍitām  || 09.11.027 ||
pūgaiḥ savṛntai rambhābhiḥ paṭṭikābhiḥ suvāsasām  |
ādarśairaṃśukaiḥ sragbhiḥ kṛtakautukatoraṇām  || 09.11.028 ||
tamupeyustatra tatra paurā arhaṇapāṇayaḥ  |
āśiṣo yuyujurdeva pāhīmāṃ prāktvayoddhṛtām  || 09.11.029 ||
tataḥ prajā vīkṣya patiṃ cirāgataṃ didṛkṣayotsṛṣṭagṛhāḥ striyo narāḥ  |
āruhya harmyāṇyaravindalocanamatṛptanetrāḥ kusumairavākiran  || 09.11.030 ||
atha praviṣṭaḥ svagṛhaṃ juṣṭaṃ svaiḥ pūrvarājabhiḥ  |
anantākhilakoṣāḍhyamanarghyoruparicchadam  || 09.11.031 ||
vidrumodumbaradvārairvaidūryastambhapaṅktibhiḥ  |
sthalairmārakataiḥ svacchairbhrājatsphaṭikabhittibhiḥ  || 09.11.032 ||
citrasragbhiḥ paṭṭikābhirvāsomaṇigaṇāṃśukaiḥ  |
muktāphalaiścidullāsaiḥ kāntakāmopapattibhiḥ  || 09.11.033 ||
dhūpadīpaiḥ surabhibhirmaṇḍitaṃ puṣpamaṇḍanaiḥ  |
strīpumbhiḥ surasaṅkāśairjuṣṭaṃ bhūṣaṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ  || 09.11.034 ||
tasmin sa bhagavān rāmaḥ snigdhayā priyayeṣṭayā  |
reme svārāmadhīrāṇāmṛṣabhaḥ sītayā kila  || 09.11.035 ||
bubhuje ca yathākālaṃ kāmān dharmamapīḍayan  |
varṣapūgān bahūnnṝṇāmabhidhyātāṅghripallavaḥ  || 09.11.036 ||
09.12.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
kuśasya cātithistasmānniṣadhastatsuto nabhaḥ  |
puṇḍarīko'tha tatputraḥ kṣemadhanvābhavattataḥ  || 09.12.001 ||
devānīkastato'nīhaḥ pāriyātro'tha tatsutaḥ  |
tato balasthalastasmādvajranābho'rkasambhavaḥ  || 09.12.002 ||
sagaṇastatsutastasmādvidhṛtiścābhavatsutaḥ  |
tato hiraṇyanābho'bhūdyogācāryastu jaimineḥ  || 09.12.003 ||
śiṣyaḥ kauśalya ādhyātmaṃ yājñavalkyo'dhyagādyataḥ  |
yogaṃ mahodayamṛṣirhṛdayagranthibhedakam  || 09.12.004 ||
puṣpo hiraṇyanābhasya dhruvasandhistato'bhavat |
sudarśano'thāgnivarṇaḥ śīghrastasya maruḥ sutaḥ  || 09.12.005 ||
so'sāvāste yogasiddhaḥ kalāpagrāmamāsthitaḥ  |
kalerante sūryavaṃśaṃ naṣṭaṃ bhāvayitā punaḥ  || 09.12.006 ||
tasmātprasuśrutastasya sandhistasyāpyamarṣaṇaḥ  |
mahasvāṃstatsutastasmādviśvabāhurajāyata  || 09.12.007 ||
tataḥ prasenajittasmāttakṣako bhavitā punaḥ  |
tato bṛhadbalo yastu pitrā te samare hataḥ  || 09.12.008 ||
ete hīkṣvākubhūpālā atītāḥ śṛṇvanāgatān  |
bṛhadbalasya bhavitā putro nāmnā bṛhadraṇaḥ  || 09.12.009 ||
ūrukriyaḥ sutastasya vatsavṛddho bhaviṣyati  |
prativyomastato bhānurdivāko vāhinīpatiḥ  || 09.12.010 ||
sahadevastato vīro bṛhadaśvo'tha bhānumān  |
pratīkāśvo bhānumataḥ supratīko'tha tatsutaḥ  || 09.12.011 ||
bhavitā marudevo'tha sunakṣatro'tha puṣkaraḥ  |
tasyāntarikṣastatputraḥ sutapāstadamitrajit || 09.12.012 ||
bṛhadrājastu tasyāpi barhistasmātkṛtañjayaḥ  |
raṇañjayastasya sutaḥ sañjayo bhavitā tataḥ  || 09.12.013 ||
tasmācchākyo'tha śuddhodo lāṅgalastatsutaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
tataḥ prasenajittasmātkṣudrako bhavitā tataḥ  || 09.12.014 ||
raṇako bhavitā tasmātsurathastanayastataḥ  |
sumitro nāma niṣṭhānta ete bārhadbalānvayāḥ  || 09.12.015 ||
ikṣvākūṇāmayaṃ vaṃśaḥ sumitrānto bhaviṣyati  |
yatastaṃ prāpya rājānaṃ saṃsthāṃ prāpsyati vai kalau  || 09.12.016 ||
09.13.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
nimirikṣvākutanayo vasiṣṭhamavṛtartvijam  |
ārabhya satraṃ so'pyāha śakreṇa prāgvṛto'smi bhoḥ  || 09.13.001 ||
taṃ nirvartyāgamiṣyāmi tāvanmāṃ pratipālaya  |
tūṣṇīmāsīdgṛhapatiḥ so'pīndrasyākaronmakham  || 09.13.002 ||
nimittaścalamidaṃ vidvān satramārabhatāmātmavān  |
ṛtvigbhiraparaistāvannāgamadyāvatā guruḥ  || 09.13.003 ||
śiṣyavyatikramaṃ vīkṣya taṃ nirvartyāgato guruḥ  |
aśapatpatatāddeho nimeḥ paṇḍitamāninaḥ  || 09.13.004 ||
nimiḥ pratidadau śāpaṃ gurave'dharmavartine  |
tavāpi patatāddeho lobhāddharmamajānataḥ  || 09.13.005 ||
ityutsasarja svaṃ dehaṃ nimiradhyātmakovidaḥ  |
mitrāvaruṇayorjajñe urvaśyāṃ prapitāmahaḥ  || 09.13.006 ||
gandhavastuṣu taddehaṃ nidhāya munisattamāḥ  |
samāpte satrayāge ca devānūcuḥ samāgatān  || 09.13.007 ||
rājño jīvatu deho'yaṃ prasannāḥ prabhavo yadi  |
tathetyukte nimiḥ prāha mā bhūnme dehabandhanam  || 09.13.008 ||
yasya yogaṃ na vāñchanti viyogabhayakātarāḥ  |
bhajanti caraṇāmbhojaṃ munayo harimedhasaḥ  || 09.13.009 ||
dehaṃ nāvarurutse'haṃ duḥkhaśokabhayāvaham  |
sarvatrāsya yato mṛtyurmatsyānāmudake yathā  || 09.13.010 ||
09.13.011|0 devā ūcuḥ
videha uṣyatāṃ kāmaṃ locaneṣu śarīriṇām  |
unmeṣaṇanimeṣābhyāṃ lakṣito'dhyātmasaṃsthitaḥ  || 09.13.011 ||
arājakabhayaṃ nṇāṃ manyamānā maharṣayaḥ  |
dehaṃ mamanthuḥ sma nimeḥ kumāraḥ samajāyata  || 09.13.012 ||
janmanā janakaḥ so'bhūdvaidehastu videhajaḥ  |
mithilo mathanājjāto mithilā yena nirmitā  || 09.13.013 ||
tasmādudāvasustasya putro'bhūnnandivardhanaḥ  |
tataḥ suketustasyāpi devarāto mahīpate  || 09.13.014 ||
tasmādbṛhadrathastasya mahāvīryaḥ sudhṛtpitā  |
sudhṛterdhṛṣṭaketurvai haryaśvo'tha marustataḥ  || 09.13.015 ||
maroḥ pratīpakastasmājjātaḥ kṛtaratho yataḥ  |
devamīḍhastasya putro viśruto'tha mahādhṛtiḥ  || 09.13.016 ||
kṛtirātastatastasmānmahāromā ca tatsutaḥ  |
svarṇaromā sutastasya hrasvaromā vyajāyata  || 09.13.017 ||
tataḥ śīradhvajo jajñe yajñārthaṃ karṣato mahīm  |
sītā śīrāgrato jātā tasmātśīradhvajaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 09.13.018 ||
kuśadhvajastasya putrastato dharmadhvajo nṛpaḥ  |
dharmadhvajasya dvau putrau kṛtadhvajamitadhvajau  || 09.13.019 ||
kṛtadhvajātkeśidhvajaḥ khāṇḍikyastu mitadhvajāt |
kṛtadhvajasuto rājannātmavidyāviśāradaḥ  || 09.13.020 ||
khāṇḍikyaḥ karmatattvajño bhītaḥ keśidhvajāddrutaḥ  |
bhānumāṃstasya putro'bhūcchatadyumnastu tatsutaḥ  || 09.13.021 ||
śucistu tanayastasmātsanadvājaḥ suto'bhavat |
ūrjaketuḥ sanadvājādajo'tha purujitsutaḥ  || 09.13.022 ||
ariṣṭanemistasyāpi śrutāyustatsupārśvakaḥ  |
tataścitraratho yasya kṣemādhirmithilādhipaḥ  || 09.13.023 ||
tasmātsamarathastasya sutaḥ satyarathastataḥ  |
āsīdupagurustasmādupagupto'gnisambhavaḥ  || 09.13.024 ||
vasvananto'tha tatputro yuyudho yatsubhāṣaṇaḥ  |
śrutastato jayastasmādvijayo'smādṛtaḥ sutaḥ  || 09.13.025 ||
śunakastatsuto jajñe vītahavyo dhṛtistataḥ  |
bahulāśvo dhṛtestasya kṛtirasya mahāvaśī  || 09.13.026 ||
ete vai maithilā rājannātmavidyāviśāradāḥ  |
yogeśvaraprasādena dvandvairmuktā gṛheṣvapi  || 09.13.027 ||
09.14.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
athātaḥ śrūyatāṃ rājan vaṃśaḥ somasya pāvanaḥ  |
yasminnailādayo bhūpāḥ kīrtyante puṇyakīrtayaḥ  || 09.14.001 ||
sahasraśirasaḥ puṃso nābhihradasaroruhāt |
jātasyāsītsuto dhāturatriḥ pitṛsamo guṇaiḥ  || 09.14.002 ||
tasya dṛgbhyo'bhavatputraḥ somo'mṛtamayaḥ kila  |
viprauṣadhyuḍugaṇānāṃ brahmaṇā kalpitaḥ patiḥ  || 09.14.003 ||
so'yajadrājasūyena vijitya bhuvanatrayam  |
patnīṃ bṛhaspaterdarpāttārāṃ nāmāharadbalāt || 09.14.004 ||
yadā sa devaguruṇā yācito'bhīkṣṇaśo madāt |
nātyajattatkṛte jajñe suradānavavigrahaḥ  || 09.14.005 ||
śukro bṛhaspaterdveṣādagrahītsāsuroḍupam  |
haro gurusutaṃ snehātsarvabhūtagaṇāvṛtaḥ  || 09.14.006 ||
sarvadevagaṇopeto mahendro gurumanvayāt |
surāsuravināśo'bhūtsamarastārakāmayaḥ  || 09.14.007 ||
nivedito'thāṅgirasā somaṃ nirbhartsya viśvakṛt |
tārāṃ svabhartre prāyacchadantarvatnīmavaitpatiḥ  || 09.14.008 ||
tyaja tyajāśu duṣprajñe matkṣetrādāhitaṃ paraiḥ  |
nāhaṃ tvāṃ bhasmasātkuryāṃ striyaṃ sāntānike'sati  || 09.14.009 ||
tatyāja vrīḍitā tārā kumāraṃ kanakaprabham  |
spṛhāmāṅgirasaścakre kumāre soma eva ca  || 09.14.010 ||
mamāyaṃ na tavetyuccaistasmin vivadamānayoḥ  |
papracchurṛṣayo devā naivoce vrīḍitā tu sā  || 09.14.011 ||
kumāro mātaraṃ prāha kupito'līkalajjayā  |
kiṃ na vacasyasadvṛtte ātmāvadyaṃ vadāśu me  || 09.14.012 ||
brahmā tāṃ raha āhūya samaprākṣīcca sāntvayan  |
somasyetyāha śanakaiḥ somastaṃ tāvadagrahīt || 09.14.013 ||
tasyātmayonirakṛta budha ityabhidhāṃ nṛpa  |
buddhyā gambhīrayā yena putreṇāpoḍurāṇmudam  || 09.14.014 ||
tataḥ purūravā jajñe ilāyāṃ ya udāhṛtaḥ  |
tasya rūpaguṇaudārya śīladraviṇavikramān  || 09.14.015 ||
śrutvorvaśīndrabhavane gīyamānān surarṣiṇā  |
tadantikamupeyāya devī smaraśarārditā  || 09.14.016 ||
mitrāvaruṇayoḥ śāpādāpannā naralokatām  |
niśamya puruṣaśreṣṭhaṃ kandarpamiva rūpiṇam  |
dhṛtiṃ viṣṭabhya lalanā upatasthe tadantike  || 09.14.017 ||
sa tāṃ vilokya nṛpatirharṣeṇotphullalocanaḥ  |
uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā devīṃ hṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ  || 09.14.018 ||
09.14.019|0 śrīrājovāca
svāgataṃ te varārohe āsyatāṃ karavāma kim  |
saṃramasva mayā sākaṃ ratirnau śāśvatīḥ samāḥ  || 09.14.019 ||
09.14.020|0 urvaśyuvāca
kasyāstvayi na sajjeta mano dṛṣṭiśca sundara  |
yadaṅgāntaramāsādya cyavate ha riraṃsayā  || 09.14.020 ||
etāvuraṇakau rājannyāsau rakṣasva mānada  |
saṃraṃsye bhavatā sākaṃ ślāghyaḥ strīṇāṃ varaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 09.14.021 ||
ghṛtaṃ me vīra bhakṣyaṃ syānnekṣe tvānyatra maithunāt |
vivāsasaṃ tattatheti pratipede mahāmanāḥ  || 09.14.022 ||
aho rūpamaho bhāvo naralokavimohanam  |
ko na seveta manujo devīṃ tvāṃ svayamāgatām  || 09.14.023 ||
tayā sa puruṣaśreṣṭho ramayantyā yathārhataḥ  |
reme suravihāreṣu kāmaṃ caitrarathādiṣu  || 09.14.024 ||
ramamāṇastayā devyā padmakiñjalkagandhayā  |
tanmukhāmodamuṣito mumude'hargaṇān bahūn  || 09.14.025 ||
apaśyannurvaśīmindro gandharvān samacodayat |
urvaśīrahitaṃ mahyamāsthānaṃ nātiśobhate  || 09.14.026 ||
te upetya mahārātre tamasi pratyupasthite  |
urvaśyā uraṇau jahrurnyastau rājani jāyayā  || 09.14.027 ||
niśamyākranditaṃ devī putrayornīyamānayoḥ  |
hatāsmyahaṃ kunāthena napuṃsā vīramāninā  || 09.14.028 ||
yadviśrambhādahaṃ naṣṭā hṛtāpatyā ca dasyubhiḥ  |
yaḥ śete niśi santrasto yathā nārī divā pumān  || 09.14.029 ||
iti vāksāyakairbiddhaḥ pratottrairiva kuñjaraḥ  |
niśi nistriṃśamādāya vivastro'bhyadravadruṣā  || 09.14.030 ||
te visṛjyoraṇau tatra vyadyotanta sma vidyutaḥ  |
ādāya meṣāvāyāntaṃ nagnamaikṣata sā patim  || 09.14.031 ||
ailo'pi śayane jāyāmapaśyan vimanā iva  |
taccitto vihvalaḥ śocan babhrāmonmattavanmahīm  || 09.14.032 ||
sa tāṃ vīkṣya kurukṣetre sarasvatyāṃ ca tatsakhīḥ  |
pañca prahṛṣṭavadanaḥ prāha sūktaṃ purūravāḥ  || 09.14.033 ||
aho jāye tiṣṭha tiṣṭha ghore na tyaktumarhasi  |
māṃ tvamadyāpyanirvṛtya vacāṃsi kṛṇavāvahai  || 09.14.034 ||
sudeho'yaṃ patatyatra devi dūraṃ hṛtastvayā  |
khādantyenaṃ vṛkā gṛdhrāstvatprasādasya nāspadam  || 09.14.035 ||
09.14.036|0 urvaśyuvāca
mā mṛthāḥ puruṣo'si tvaṃ mā sma tvādyurvṛkā ime  |
kvāpi sakhyaṃ na vai strīṇāṃ vṛkāṇāṃ hṛdayaṃ yathā  || 09.14.036 ||
striyo hyakaruṇāḥ krūrā durmarṣāḥ priyasāhasāḥ  |
ghnantyalpārthe'pi viśrabdhaṃ patiṃ bhrātaramapyuta  || 09.14.037 ||
vidhāyālīkaviśrambhamajñeṣu tyaktasauhṛdāḥ  |
navaṃ navamabhīpsantyaḥ puṃścalyaḥ svairavṛttayaḥ  || 09.14.038 ||
saṃvatsarānte hi bhavānekarātraṃ mayeśvaraḥ  |
raṃsyatyapatyāni ca te bhaviṣyantyaparāṇi bhoḥ  || 09.14.039 ||
antarvatnīmupālakṣya devīṃ sa prayayau purīm  |
punastatra gato'bdānte urvaśīṃ vīramātaram  || 09.14.040 ||
upalabhya mudā yuktaḥ samuvāsa tayā niśām  |
athainamurvaśī prāha kṛpaṇaṃ virahāturam  || 09.14.041 ||
gandharvānupadhāvemāṃstubhyaṃ dāsyanti māmiti  |
tasya saṃstuvatastuṣṭā agnisthālīṃ dadurnṛpa  |
urvaśīṃ manyamānastāṃ so'budhyata caran vane  || 09.14.042 ||
sthālīṃ nyasya vane gatvā gṛhānādhyāyato niśi  |
tretāyāṃ sampravṛttāyāṃ manasi trayyavartata  || 09.14.043 ||
sthālīsthānaṃ gato'śvatthaṃ śamīgarbhaṃ vilakṣya saḥ  |
tena dve araṇī kṛtvā urvaśīlokakāmyayā  || 09.14.044 ||
urvaśīṃ mantrato dhyāyannadharāraṇimuttarām  |
ātmānamubhayormadhye yattatprajananaṃ prabhuḥ  || 09.14.045 ||
tasya nirmanthanājjāto jātavedā vibhāvasuḥ  |
trayyā sa vidyayā rājñā putratve kalpitastrivṛt || 09.14.046 ||
tenāyajata yajñeśaṃ bhagavantamadhokṣajam  |
urvaśīlokamanvicchan sarvadevamayaṃ harim  || 09.14.047 ||
eka eva purā vedaḥ praṇavaḥ sarvavāṅmayaḥ  |
devo nārāyaṇo nānya eko'gnirvarṇa eva ca  || 09.14.048 ||
purūravasa evāsīttrayī tretāmukhe nṛpa  |
agninā prajayā rājā lokaṃ gāndharvameyivān  || 09.14.049 ||
09.15.001|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
ailasya corvaśīgarbhātṣaḍāsannātmajā nṛpa  |
āyuḥ śrutāyuḥ satyāyū rayo'tha vijayo jayaḥ  || 09.15.001 ||
śrutāyorvasumān putraḥ satyāyośca śrutañjayaḥ  |
rayasya suta ekaśca jayasya tanayo'mitaḥ  || 09.15.002 ||
bhīmastu vijayasyātha kāñcano hotrakastataḥ  |
tasya jahnuḥ suto gaṅgāṃ gaṇḍūṣīkṛtya yo'pibat |
jahnostu purustasyātha balākaścātmajo'jakaḥ  || 09.15.003 ||
tataḥ kuśaḥ kuśasyāpi kuśāmbustanayo vasuḥ  |
kuśanābhaśca catvāro gādhirāsītkuśāmbujaḥ  || 09.15.004 ||
tasya satyavatīṃ kanyāmṛcīko'yācata dvijaḥ  |
varaṃ visadṛśaṃ matvā gādhirbhārgavamabravīt || 09.15.005 ||
ekataḥ śyāmakarṇānāṃ hayānāṃ candravarcasām  |
sahasraṃ dīyatāṃ śulkaṃ kanyāyāḥ kuśikā vayam  || 09.15.006 ||
ityuktastanmataṃ jñātvā gataḥ sa varuṇāntikam  |
ānīya dattvā tānaśvānupayeme varānanām  || 09.15.007 ||
sa ṛṣiḥ prārthitaḥ patnyā śvaśrvā cāpatyakāmyayā  |
śrapayitvobhayairmantraiścaruṃ snātuṃ gato muniḥ  || 09.15.008 ||
tāvatsatyavatī mātrā svacaruṃ yācitā satī  |
śreṣṭhaṃ matvā tayāyacchanmātre māturadatsvayam  || 09.15.009 ||
tadviditvā muniḥ prāha patnīṃ kaṣṭamakāraṣīḥ  |
ghoro daṇḍadharaḥ putro bhrātā te brahmavittamaḥ  || 09.15.010 ||
prasāditaḥ satyavatyā maivaṃ bhūriti bhārgavaḥ  |
atha tarhi bhavetpautrojamadagnistato'bhavat || 09.15.011 ||
sā cābhūtsumahatpuṇyā kauśikī lokapāvanī  |
reṇoḥ sutāṃ reṇukāṃ vai jamadagniruvāha yām  || 09.15.012 ||
tasyāṃ vai bhārgavaṛṣeḥ sutā vasumadādayaḥ  |
yavīyān jajña eteṣāṃ rāma ityabhiviśrutaḥ  || 09.15.013 ||
yamāhurvāsudevāṃśaṃ haihayānāṃ kulāntakam  |
triḥsaptakṛtvo ya imāṃ cakre niḥkṣatriyāṃ mahīm  || 09.15.014 ||
dṛptaṃ kṣatraṃ bhuvo bhāramabrahmaṇyamanīnaśat |
rajastamovṛtamahan phalgunyapi kṛte'ṃhasi  || 09.15.015 ||
09.15.016|0 śrīrājovāca
kiṃ tadaṃho bhagavato rājanyairajitātmabhiḥ  |
kṛtaṃ yena kulaṃ naṣṭaṃ kṣatriyāṇāmabhīkṣṇaśaḥ  || 09.15.016 ||
09.15.017|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
haihayānāmadhipatirarjunaḥ kṣatriyarṣabhaḥ  |
dattaṃ nārāyaṇāṃśāṃśamārādhya parikarmabhiḥ  || 09.15.017 ||
bāhūn daśaśataṃ lebhe durdharṣatvamarātiṣu  |
avyāhatendriyaujaḥ śrī tejovīryayaśobalam  || 09.15.018 ||
yogeśvaratvamaiśvaryaṃ guṇā yatrāṇimādayaḥ  |
cacārāvyāhatagatirlokeṣu pavano yathā  || 09.15.019 ||
strīratnairāvṛtaḥ krīḍan revāmbhasi madotkaṭaḥ  |
vaijayantīṃ srajaṃ bibhradrurodha saritaṃ bhujaiḥ  || 09.15.020 ||
viplāvitaṃ svaśibiraṃ pratisrotaḥsarijjalaiḥ  |
nāmṛṣyattasya tadvīryaṃ vīramānī daśānanaḥ  || 09.15.021 ||
gṛhīto līlayā strīṇāṃ samakṣaṃ kṛtakilbiṣaḥ  |
māhiṣmatyāṃ sanniruddho mukto yena kapiryathā  || 09.15.022 ||
sa ekadā tu mṛgayāṃ vicaran vijane vane  |
yadṛcchayāśramapadaṃ jamadagnerupāviśat || 09.15.023 ||
tasmai sa naradevāya munirarhaṇamāharat |
sasainyāmātyavāhāya haviṣmatyā tapodhanaḥ  || 09.15.024 ||
sa vai ratnaṃ tu taddṛṣṭvā ātmaiśvaryātiśāyanam  |
tannādriyatāgnihotryāṃ sābhilāṣaḥ sahaihayaḥ  || 09.15.025 ||
havirdhānīmṛṣerdarpānnarān hartumacodayat |
te ca māhiṣmatīṃ ninyuḥ savatsāṃ krandatīṃ balāt || 09.15.026 ||
atha rājani niryāte rāma āśrama āgataḥ  |
śrutvā tattasya daurātmyaṃ cukrodhāhirivāhataḥ  || 09.15.027 ||
ghoramādāya paraśuṃ satūṇaṃ varma kārmukam  |
anvadhāvata durmarṣo mṛgendra iva yūthapam  || 09.15.028 ||
tamāpatantaṃ bhṛguvaryamojasā dhanurdharaṃ bāṇaparaśvadhāyudham  |
aiṇeyacarmāmbaramarkadhāmabhiryutaṃ jaṭābhirdadṛśe purīṃ viśan  || 09.15.029 ||
acodayaddhastirathāśvapattibhirgadāsibāṇarṣṭiśataghniśaktibhiḥ  |
akṣauhiṇīḥ saptadaśātibhīṣaṇāstā rāma eko bhagavānasūdayat || 09.15.030 ||
yato yato'sau praharatparaśvadho mano'nilaujāḥ paracakrasūdanaḥ  |
tataśtataschinnabhujorukandharā nipetururvyāṃ hatasūtavāhanāḥ  || 09.15.031 ||
dṛṣṭvā svasainyaṃ rudhiraughakardame raṇājire rāmakuṭhārasāyakaiḥ  |
vivṛkṇavarmadhvajacāpavigrahaṃ nipātitaṃ haihaya āpatadruṣā  || 09.15.032 ||
athārjunaḥ pañcaśateṣu bāhubhirdhanuḥṣu bāṇān yugapatsa sandadhe  |
rāmāya rāmo'strabhṛtāṃ samagraṇīstānyekadhanveṣubhirācchinatsamam  || 09.15.033 ||
punaḥ svahastairacalānmṛdhe'ṅghripānutkṣipya vegādabhidhāvato yudhi  |
bhujān kuṭhāreṇa kaṭhoraneminā ciccheda rāmaḥ prasabhaṃ tvaheriva  || 09.15.034 ||
kṛttabāhoḥ śirastasya gireḥ śṛṅgamivāharat |
hate pitari tatputrā ayutaṃ dudruvurbhayāt || 09.15.035 ||
agnihotrīmupāvartya savatsāṃ paravīrahā  |
samupetyāśramaṃ pitre parikliṣṭāṃ samarpayat || 09.15.036 ||
svakarma tatkṛtaṃ rāmaḥ pitre bhrātṛbhya eva ca  |
varṇayāmāsa tacchrutvājamadagnirabhāṣata  || 09.15.037 ||
rāma rāma mahābāho bhavān pāpamakāraṣīt |
avadhīnnaradevaṃ yatsarvadevamayaṃ vṛthā  || 09.15.038 ||
vayaṃ hi brāhmaṇāstāta kṣamayārhaṇatāṃ gatāḥ  |
yayā lokagururdevaḥ pārameṣṭhyamagātpadam  || 09.15.039 ||
kṣamayā rocate lakṣmīrbrāhmī saurī yathā prabhā  |
kṣamiṇāmāśu bhagavāṃstuṣyate harirīśvaraḥ  || 09.15.040 ||
rājño mūrdhābhiṣiktasya vadho brahmavadhādguruḥ  |
tīrthasaṃsevayā cāṃho jahyaṅgācyutacetanaḥ  || 09.15.041 ||
09.16.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
pitropaśikṣito rāmastatheti kurunandana  |
saṃvatsaraṃ tīrthayātrāṃ caritvāśramamāvrajat || 09.16.001 ||
kadācidreṇukā yātā gaṅgāyāṃ padmamālinam  |
gandharvarājaṃ krīḍantamapsarobhirapaśyata  || 09.16.002 ||
vilokayantī krīḍantamudakārthaṃ nadīṃ gatā  |
homavelāṃ na sasmāra kiñciccitrarathaspṛhā  || 09.16.003 ||
kālātyayaṃ taṃ vilokya muneḥ śāpaviśaṅkitā  |
āgatya kalaśaṃ tasthau purodhāya kṛtāñjaliḥ  || 09.16.004 ||
vyabhicāraṃ munirjñātvā patnyāḥ prakupito'bravīt |
ghnataināṃ putrakāḥ pāpāmityuktāste na cakrire  || 09.16.005 ||
rāmaḥ sañcoditaḥ pitrā bhrātnmātrā sahāvadhīt |
prabhāvajño muneḥ samyaksamādhestapasaśca saḥ  || 09.16.006 ||
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa prītaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ  |
vavre hatānāṃ rāmo'pi jīvitaṃ cāsmṛtiṃ vadhe  || 09.16.007 ||
uttasthuste kuśalino nidrāpāya ivāñjasā  |
piturvidvāṃstapovīryaṃ rāmaścakre suhṛdvadham  || 09.16.008 ||
ye'rjunasya sutā rājan smarantaḥ svapiturvadham  |
rāmavīryaparābhūtā lebhire śarma na kvacit || 09.16.009 ||
ekadāśramato rāme sabhrātari vanaṃ gate  |
vairaṃ siṣādhayiṣavo labdhacchidrā upāgaman  || 09.16.010 ||
dṛṣṭvāgnyāgāra āsīnamāveśitadhiyaṃ munim  |
bhagavatyuttamaśloke jaghnuste pāpaniścayāḥ  || 09.16.011 ||
yācyamānāḥ kṛpaṇayā rāmamātrātidāruṇāḥ  |
prasahya śira utkṛtya ninyuste kṣatrabandhavaḥ  || 09.16.012 ||
reṇukā duḥkhaśokārtā nighnantyātmānamātmanā  |
rāma rāmeti tāteti vicukrośoccakaiḥ satī  || 09.16.013 ||
tadupaśrutya dūrasthā hā rāmetyārtavatsvanam  |
tvarayāśramamāsādya dadṛśuḥ pitaraṃ hatam  || 09.16.014 ||
te duḥkharoṣāmarṣārti śokavegavimohitāḥ  |
hā tāta sādho dharmiṣṭha tyaktvāsmān svargato bhavān  || 09.16.015 ||
vilapyaivaṃ piturdehaṃ nidhāya bhrātṛṣu svayam  |
pragṛhya paraśuṃ rāmaḥ kṣatrāntāya mano dadhe  || 09.16.016 ||
gatvā māhiṣmatīṃ rāmo brahmaghnavihataśriyam  |
teṣāṃ sa śīrṣabhī rājanmadhye cakre mahāgirim  || 09.16.017 ||
tadraktena nadīṃ ghorāmabrahmaṇyabhayāvahām  |
hetuṃ kṛtvā pitṛvadhaṃ kṣatre'maṅgalakāriṇi  || 09.16.018 ||
triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyāṃ prabhuḥ  |
samantapañcake cakre śoṇitodān hradānnava  || 09.16.019 ||
pituḥ kāyena sandhāya śira ādāya barhiṣi  |
sarvadevamayaṃ devamātmānamayajanmakhaiḥ  || 09.16.020 ||
dadau prācīṃ diśaṃ hotre brahmaṇe dakṣiṇāṃ diśam  |
adhvaryave pratīcīṃ vai udgātre uttarāṃ diśam  || 09.16.021 ||
anyebhyo'vāntaradiśaḥ kaśyapāya ca madhyataḥ  |
āryāvartamupadraṣṭre sadasyebhyastataḥ param  || 09.16.022 ||
tataścāvabhṛthasnāna vidhūtāśeṣakilbiṣaḥ  |
sarasvatyāṃ mahānadyāṃ reje vyabbhra ivāṃśumān  || 09.16.023 ||
svadehaṃ jamadagnistu labdhvā saṃjñānalakṣaṇam  |
ṛṣīṇāṃ maṇḍale so'bhūtsaptamo rāmapūjitaḥ  || 09.16.024 ||
jāmadagnyo'pi bhagavān rāmaḥ kamalalocanaḥ  |
āgāminyantare rājan vartayiṣyati vai bṛhat || 09.16.025 ||
āste'dyāpi mahendrādrau nyastadaṇḍaḥ praśāntadhīḥ  |
upagīyamānacaritaḥ siddhagandharvacāraṇaiḥ  || 09.16.026 ||
evaṃ bhṛguṣu viśvātmā bhagavān harirīśvaraḥ  |
avatīrya paraṃ bhāraṃ bhuvo'han bahuśo nṛpān  || 09.16.027 ||
gādherabhūnmahātejāḥ samiddha iva pāvakaḥ  |
tapasā kṣātramutsṛjya yo lebhe brahmavarcasam  || 09.16.028 ||
viśvāmitrasya caivāsan putrā ekaśataṃ nṛpa  |
madhyamastu madhucchandā madhucchandasa eva te  || 09.16.029 ||
putraṃ kṛtvā śunaḥśephaṃ devarātaṃ ca bhārgavam  |
ājīgartaṃ sutānāha jyeṣṭha eṣa prakalpyatām  || 09.16.030 ||
yo vai hariścandramakhe vikrītaḥ puruṣaḥ paśuḥ  |
stutvā devān prajeśādīnmumuce pāśabandhanāt || 09.16.031 ||
yo rāto devayajane devairgādhiṣu tāpasaḥ  |
devarāta iti khyātaḥ śunaḥśephastu bhārgavaḥ  || 09.16.032 ||
ye madhucchandaso jyeṣṭhāḥ kuśalaṃ menire na tat |
aśapattānmuniḥ kruddho mlecchā bhavata durjanāḥ  || 09.16.033 ||
sa hovāca madhucchandāḥ sārdhaṃ pañcāśatā tataḥ  |
yanno bhavān sañjānīte tasmiṃstiṣṭhāmahe vayam  || 09.16.034 ||
jyeṣṭhaṃ mantradṛśaṃ cakrustvāmanvañco vayaṃ sma hi  |
viśvāmitraḥ sutānāha vīravanto bhaviṣyatha  |
ye mānaṃ me'nugṛhṇanto vīravantamakarta mām  || 09.16.035 ||
eṣa vaḥ kuśikā vīro devarātastamanvita  |
anye cāṣṭakahārīta jayakratumadādayaḥ  || 09.16.036 ||
evaṃ kauśikagotraṃ tu viśvāmitraiḥ pṛthagvidham  |
pravarāntaramāpannaṃ taddhi caivaṃ prakalpitam  || 09.16.037 ||
09.17.001|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
yaḥ purūravasaḥ putra āyustasyābhavan sutāḥ  |
nahuṣaḥ kṣatravṛddhaśca rajī rābhaśca vīryavān  || 09.17.001 ||
anenā iti rājendra śṛṇu kṣatravṛdho'nvayam  |
kṣatravṛddhasutasyāsan suhotrasyātmajāstrayaḥ  || 09.17.002 ||
kāśyaḥ kuśo gṛtsamada iti gṛtsamadādabhūt |
śunakaḥ śaunako yasya bahvṛcapravaro muniḥ  || 09.17.003 ||
kāśyasya kāśistatputro rāṣṭro dīrghatamaḥpitā  |
dhanvantarirdīrghatamasa āyurvedapravartakaḥ  || 09.17.004 ||
yajñabhugvāsudevāṃśaḥ smṛtamātrārtināśanaḥ  |
tatputraḥ ketumānasya jajñe bhīmarathastataḥ  || 09.17.005 ||
divodāso dyumāṃstasmātpratardana iti smṛtaḥ  |
sa eva śatrujidvatsa ṛtadhvaja itīritaḥ  |
tathā kuvalayāśveti prokto'larkādayastataḥ  || 09.17.006 ||
ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣaśatāni ca  |
nālarkādaparo rājan bubhuje medinīṃ yuvā  || 09.17.007 ||
alarkātsantatistasmātsunītho'tha niketanaḥ  |
dharmaketuḥ sutastasmātsatyaketurajāyata  || 09.17.008 ||
dhṛṣṭaketustatastasmātsukumāraḥ kṣitīśvaraḥ  |
vītihotro'sya bhargo'to bhārgabhūmirabhūnnṛpa  || 09.17.009 ||
itīme kāśayo bhūpāḥ kṣatravṛddhānvayāyinaḥ  |
rābhasya rabhasaḥ putro gambhīraścākriyastataḥ  || 09.17.010 ||
tadgotraṃ brahmavijjajñe śṛṇu vaṃśamanenasaḥ  |
śuddhastataḥ śucistasmāccitrakṛddharmasārathiḥ  || 09.17.011 ||
tataḥ śāntarajo jajñe kṛtakṛtyaḥ sa ātmavān  |
rajeḥ pañcaśatānyāsan putrāṇāmamitaujasām  || 09.17.012 ||
devairabhyarthito daityān hatvendrāyādadāddivam  |
indrastasmai punardattvā gṛhītvā caraṇau rajeḥ  || 09.17.013 ||
ātmānamarpayāmāsa prahrādādyariśaṅkitaḥ  |
pitaryuparate putrā yācamānāya no daduḥ  || 09.17.014 ||
triviṣṭapaṃ mahendrāya yajñabhāgān samādaduḥ  |
guruṇā hūyamāne'gnau balabhittanayān rajeḥ  || 09.17.015 ||
avadhīdbhraṃśitānmārgānna kaścidavaśeṣitaḥ  |
kuśātpratiḥ kṣātravṛddhātsañjayastatsuto jayaḥ  || 09.17.016 ||
tataḥ kṛtaḥ kṛtasyāpi jajñe haryabalo nṛpaḥ  |
sahadevastato hīno jayasenastu tatsutaḥ  || 09.17.017 ||
saṅkṛtistasya ca jayaḥ kṣatradharmā mahārathaḥ  |
kṣatravṛddhānvayā bhūpā ime śṛṇvatha nāhuṣān  || 09.17.018 ||
09.18.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
yatiryayātiḥ saṃyātirāyatirviyatiḥ kṛtiḥ  |
ṣaḍime nahuṣasyāsannindriyāṇīva dehinaḥ  || 09.18.001 ||
rājyaṃ naicchadyatiḥ pitrā dattaṃ tatpariṇāmavit |
yatra praviṣṭaḥ puruṣa ātmānaṃ nāvabudhyate  || 09.18.002 ||
pitari bhraṃśite sthānādindrāṇyā dharṣaṇāddvijaiḥ  |
prāpite'jagaratvaṃ vai yayātirabhavannṛpaḥ  || 09.18.003 ||
catasṛṣvādiśaddikṣu bhrātn bhrātā yavīyasaḥ  |
kṛtadāro jugoporvīṃ kāvyasya vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ  || 09.18.004 ||
09.18.005|0 śrīrājovāca
brahmarṣirbhagavān kāvyaḥ kṣatrabandhuśca nāhuṣaḥ  |
rājanyaviprayoḥ kasmādvivāhaḥ pratilomakaḥ  || 09.18.005 ||
09.18.006|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ekadā dānavendrasya śarmiṣṭhā nāma kanyakā  |
sakhīsahasrasaṃyuktā guruputryā ca bhāminī  || 09.18.006 ||
devayānyā purodyāne puṣpitadrumasaṅkule  |
vyacaratkalagītāli nalinīpuline'balā  || 09.18.007 ||
tā jalāśayamāsādya kanyāḥ kamalalocanāḥ  |
tīre nyasya dukūlāni vijahruḥ siñcatīrmithaḥ  || 09.18.008 ||
vīkṣya vrajantaṃ giriśaṃ saha devyā vṛṣasthitam  |
sahasottīrya vāsāṃsi paryadhurvrīḍitāḥ striyaḥ  || 09.18.009 ||
śarmiṣṭhājānatī vāso guruputryāḥ samavyayat |
svīyaṃ matvā prakupitā devayānīdamabravīt || 09.18.010 ||
aho nirīkṣyatāmasyā dāsyāḥ karma hyasāmpratam  |
asmaddhāryaṃ dhṛtavatī śunīva haviradhvare  || 09.18.011 ||
yairidaṃ tapasā sṛṣṭaṃ mukhaṃ puṃsaḥ parasya ye  |
dhāryate yairiha jyotiḥ śivaḥ panthāḥ pradarśitaḥ  || 09.18.012 ||
yān vandantyupatiṣṭhante lokanāthāḥ sureśvarāḥ  |
bhagavānapi viśvātmā pāvanaḥ śrīniketanaḥ  || 09.18.013 ||
vayaṃ tatrāpi bhṛgavaḥ śiṣyo'syā naḥ pitāsuraḥ  |
asmaddhāryaṃ dhṛtavatī śūdro vedamivāsatī  || 09.18.014 ||
evaṃ kṣipantīṃ śarmiṣṭhā guruputrīmabhāṣata  |
ruṣā śvasantyuraṅgīva dharṣitā daṣṭadacchadā  || 09.18.015 ||
ātmavṛttamavijñāya katthase bahu bhikṣuki  |
kiṃ na pratīkṣase'smākaṃ gṛhān balibhujo yathā  || 09.18.016 ||
evaṃvidhaiḥ suparuṣaiḥ kṣiptvācāryasutāṃ satīm  |
śarmiṣṭhā prākṣipatkūpe vāsaścādāya manyunā  || 09.18.017 ||
tasyāṃ gatāyāṃ svagṛhaṃ yayātirmṛgayāṃ caran  |
prāpto yadṛcchayā kūpe jalārthī tāṃ dadarśa ha  || 09.18.018 ||
dattvā svamuttaraṃ vāsastasyai rājā vivāsase  |
gṛhītvā pāṇinā pāṇimujjahāra dayāparaḥ  || 09.18.019 ||
taṃ vīramāhauśanasī premanirbharayā girā  |
rājaṃstvayā gṛhīto me pāṇiḥ parapurañjaya  || 09.18.020 ||
hastagrāho'paro mā bhūdgṛhītāyāstvayā hi me  |
eṣa īśakṛto vīra sambandho nau na pauruṣaḥ  |
yadidaṃ kūpamagnāyā bhavato darśanaṃ mama  || 09.18.021 ||
na brāhmaṇo me bhavitā hastagrāho mahābhuja  |
kacasya bārhaspatyasya śāpādyamaśapaṃ purā  || 09.18.022 ||
yayātiranabhipretaṃ daivopahṛtamātmanaḥ  |
manastu tadgataṃ buddhvā pratijagrāha tadvacaḥ  || 09.18.023 ||
gate rājani sā dhīre tatra sma rudatī pituḥ  |
nyavedayattataḥ sarvamuktaṃ śarmiṣṭhayā kṛtam  || 09.18.024 ||
durmanā bhagavān kāvyaḥ paurohityaṃ vigarhayan  |
stuvan vṛttiṃ ca kāpotīṃ duhitrā sa yayau purāt || 09.18.025 ||
vṛṣaparvā tamājñāya pratyanīkavivakṣitam  |
guruṃ prasādayanmūrdhnā pādayoḥ patitaḥ pathi  || 09.18.026 ||
kṣaṇārdhamanyurbhagavān śiṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭa bhārgavaḥ  |
kāmo'syāḥ kriyatāṃ rājannaināṃ tyaktumihotsahe  || 09.18.027 ||
tathetyavasthite prāha devayānī manogatam  |
pitrā dattā yato yāsye sānugā yātu māmanu  || 09.18.028 ||
pitrā dattā devayānyai śarmiṣṭhā sānugā tadā  |
svānāṃ tatsaṅkaṭaṃ vīkṣya tadarthasya ca gauravam  |
devayānīṃ paryacaratstrīsahasreṇa dāsavat || 09.18.029 ||
nāhuṣāya sutāṃ dattvā saha śarmiṣṭhayośanā  |
tamāha rājan charmiṣṭhāmādhāstalpe na karhicit || 09.18.030 ||
vilokyauśanasīṃ rājañcharmiṣṭhā suprajāṃ kvacit |
tameva vavre rahasi sakhyāḥ patimṛtau satī  || 09.18.031 ||
rājaputryārthito'patye dharmaṃ cāvekṣya dharmavit |
smaran chukravacaḥ kāle diṣṭamevābhyapadyata  || 09.18.032 ||
yaduṃ ca turvasuṃ caiva devayānī vyajāyata  |
druhyuṃ cānuṃ ca pūruṃ ca śarmiṣṭhā vārṣaparvaṇī  || 09.18.033 ||
garbhasambhavamāsuryā bharturvijñāya māninī  |
devayānī piturgehaṃ yayau krodhavimūrchitā  || 09.18.034 ||
priyāmanugataḥ kāmī vacobhirupamantrayan  |
na prasādayituṃ śeke pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ  || 09.18.035 ||
śukrastamāha kupitaḥ strīkāmānṛtapūruṣa  |
tvāṃ jarā viśatāṃ manda virūpakaraṇī nṛṇām  || 09.18.036 ||
09.18.037|0 śrīyayātiruvāca
atṛpto'smyadya kāmānāṃ brahman duhitari sma te  |
vyatyasyatāṃ yathākāmaṃ vayasā yo'bhidhāsyati  || 09.18.037 ||
iti labdhavyavasthānaḥ putraṃ jyeṣṭhamavocata  |
yado tāta pratīcchemāṃ jarāṃ dehi nijaṃ vayaḥ  || 09.18.038 ||
mātāmahakṛtāṃ vatsa na tṛpto viṣayeṣvaham  |
vayasā bhavadīyena raṃsye katipayāḥ samāḥ  || 09.18.039 ||
09.18.040|0 śrīyaduruvāca
notsahe jarasā sthātumantarā prāptayā tava  |
aviditvā sukhaṃ grāmyaṃ vaitṛṣṇyaṃ naiti pūruṣaḥ  || 09.18.040 ||
turvasuścoditaḥ pitrā druhyuścānuśca bhārata  |
pratyācakhyuradharmajñā hyanitye nityabuddhayaḥ  || 09.18.041 ||
apṛcchattanayaṃ pūruṃ vayasonaṃ guṇādhikam  |
na tvamagrajavadvatsa māṃ pratyākhyātumarhasi  || 09.18.042 ||
09.18.043|0 śrīpūruruvāca
ko nu loke manuṣyendra piturātmakṛtaḥ pumān  |
pratikartuṃ kṣamo yasya prasādādvindate param  || 09.18.043 ||
uttamaścintitaṃ kuryātproktakārī tu madhyamaḥ  |
adhamo'śraddhayā kuryādakartoccaritaṃ pituḥ  || 09.18.044 ||
iti pramuditaḥ pūruḥ pratyagṛhṇājjarāṃ pituḥ  |
so'pi tadvayasā kāmān yathāvajjujuṣe nṛpa  || 09.18.045 ||
saptadvīpapatiḥ saṃyakpitṛvatpālayan prajāḥ  |
yathopajoṣaṃ viṣayāñjujuṣe'vyāhatendriyaḥ  || 09.18.046 ||
devayānyapyanudinaṃ manovāgdehavastubhiḥ  |
preyasaḥ paramāṃ prītimuvāha preyasī rahaḥ  || 09.18.047 ||
ayajadyajñapuruṣaṃ kratubhirbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ  |
sarvadevamayaṃ devaṃ sarvavedamayaṃ harim  || 09.18.048 ||
yasminnidaṃ viracitaṃ vyomnīva jaladāvaliḥ  |
nāneva bhāti nābhāti svapnamāyāmanorathaḥ  || 09.18.049 ||
tameva hṛdi vinyasya vāsudevaṃ guhāśayam  |
nārāyaṇamaṇīyāṃsaṃ nirāśīrayajatprabhum  || 09.18.050 ||
evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi manaḥṣaṣṭhairmanaḥsukham  |
vidadhāno'pi nātṛpyatsārvabhaumaḥ kadindriyaiḥ  || 09.18.051 ||
09.19.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
sa itthamācaran kāmān straiṇo'pahnavamātmanaḥ  |
buddhvā priyāyai nirviṇṇo gāthāmetāmagāyata  || 09.19.001 ||
śṛṇu bhārgavyamūṃ gāthāṃ madvidhācaritāṃ bhuvi  |
dhīrā yasyānuśocanti vane grāmanivāsinaḥ  || 09.19.002 ||
basta eko vane kaścidvicinvan priyamātmanaḥ  |
dadarśa kūpe patitāṃ svakarmavaśagāmajām  || 09.19.003 ||
tasyā uddharaṇopāyaṃ bastaḥ kāmī vicintayan  |
vyadhatta tīrthamuddhṛtya viṣāṇāgreṇa rodhasī  || 09.19.004 ||
sottīrya kūpātsuśroṇī tameva cakame kila  |
tayā vṛtaṃ samudvīkṣya bahvyo'jāḥ kāntakāminīḥ  || 09.19.005 ||
pīvānaṃ śmaśrulaṃ preṣṭhaṃ mīḍhvāṃsaṃ yābhakovidam  |
sa eko'javṛṣastāsāṃ bahvīnāṃ rativardhanaḥ  |
reme kāmagrahagrasta ātmānaṃ nāvabudhyata  || 09.19.006 ||
tameva preṣṭhatamayā ramamāṇamajānyayā  |
vilokya kūpasaṃvignā nāmṛṣyadbastakarma tat || 09.19.007 ||
taṃ durhṛdaṃ suhṛdrūpaṃ kāminaṃ kṣaṇasauhṛdam  |
indriyārāmamutsṛjya svāminaṃ duḥkhitā yayau  || 09.19.008 ||
so'pi cānugataḥ straiṇaḥ kṛpaṇastāṃ prasāditum  |
kurvanniḍaviḍākāraṃ nāśaknotpathi sandhitum  || 09.19.009 ||
tasya tatra dvijaḥ kaścidajāsvāmyacchinadruṣā  |
lambantaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ bhūyaḥ sandadhe'rthāya yogavit || 09.19.010 ||
sambaddhavṛṣaṇaḥ so'pi hyajayā kūpalabdhayā  |
kālaṃ bahutithaṃ bhadre kāmairnādyāpi tuṣyati  || 09.19.011 ||
tathāhaṃ kṛpaṇaḥ subhru bhavatyāḥ premayantritaḥ  |
ātmānaṃ nābhijānāmi mohitastava māyayā  || 09.19.012 ||
