yatpṛthivyāṃ vrīhiyavaṃ hiraṇyaṃ paśavaḥ striyaḥ  |
na duhyanti manaḥprītiṃ puṃsaḥ kāmahatasya te  || 09.19.013 ||
na jātu kāmaḥ kāmānāmupabhogena śāṃyati  |
haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmeva bhūya evābhivardhate  || 09.19.014 ||
yadā na kurute bhāvaṃ sarvabhūteṣvamaṅgalam  |
samadṛṣṭestadā puṃsaḥ sarvāḥ sukhamayā diśaḥ  || 09.19.015 ||
yā dustyajā durmatibhirjīryato yā na jīryate  |
tāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ duḥkhanivahāṃ śarmakāmo drutaṃ tyajet || 09.19.016 ||
mātrā svasrā duhitrā vā nāviviktāsano bhavet |
balavānindriyagrāmo vidvāṃsamapi karṣati  || 09.19.017 ||
pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ me viṣayān sevato'sakṛt |
tathāpi cānusavanaṃ tṛṣṇā teṣūpajāyate  || 09.19.018 ||
tasmādetāmahaṃ tyaktvā brahmaṇyadhyāya mānasam  |
nirdvandvo nirahaṅkāraścariṣyāmi mṛgaiḥ saha  || 09.19.019 ||
dṛṣṭaṃ śrutamasadbuddhvā nānudhyāyenna sandiśet |
saṃsṛtiṃ cātmanāśaṃ ca tatra vidvān sa ātmadṛk || 09.19.020 ||
ityuktvā nāhuṣo jāyāṃ tadīyaṃ pūrave vayaḥ  |
dattvā svajarasaṃ tasmādādade vigataspṛhaḥ  || 09.19.021 ||
diśi dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ druhyuṃ dakṣiṇato yadum  |
pratīcyāṃ turvasuṃ cakra udīcyāmanumīśvaram  || 09.19.022 ||
bhūmaṇḍalasya sarvasya pūrumarhattamaṃ viśām  |
abhiṣicyāgrajāṃstasya vaśe sthāpya vanaṃ yayau  || 09.19.023 ||
āsevitaṃ varṣapūgān ṣaḍvargaṃ viṣayeṣu saḥ  |
kṣaṇena mumuce nīḍaṃ jātapakṣa iva dvijaḥ  || 09.19.024 ||
sa tatra nirmuktasamastasaṅga ātmānubhūtyā vidhutatriliṅgaḥ  |
pare'male brahmaṇi vāsudeve lebhe gatiṃ bhāgavatīṃ pratītaḥ  || 09.19.025 ||
śrutvā gāthāṃ devayānī mene prastobhamātmanaḥ  |
strīpuṃsoḥ snehavaiklavyātparihāsamiveritam  || 09.19.026 ||
sā sannivāsaṃ suhṛdāṃ prapāyāmiva gacchatām  |
vijñāyeśvaratantrāṇāṃ māyāviracitaṃ prabhoḥ  || 09.19.027 ||
sarvatra saṅgamutsṛjya svapnaupamyena bhārgavī  |
kṛṣṇe manaḥ samāveśya vyadhunolliṅgamātmanaḥ  || 09.19.028 ||
namastubhyaṃ bhagavate vāsudevāya vedhase  |
sarvabhūtādhivāsāya śāntāya bṛhate namaḥ  || 09.19.029 ||
09.20.001|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
pūrorvaṃśaṃ pravakṣyāmi yatra jāto'si bhārata  |
yatra rājarṣayo vaṃśyā brahmavaṃśyāśca jajñire  || 09.20.001 ||
janamejayo hyabhūtpūroḥ pracinvāṃstatsutastataḥ  |
pravīro'tha manusyurvai tasmāccārupado'bhavat || 09.20.002 ||
tasya sudyurabhūtputrastasmādbahugavastataḥ  |
saṃyātistasyāhaṃyātī raudrāśvastatsutaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 09.20.003 ||
ṛteyustasya kakṣeyuḥ sthaṇḍileyuḥ kṛteyukaḥ  |
jaleyuḥ sannateyuśca dharmasatyavrateyavaḥ  || 09.20.004 ||
daśaite'psarasaḥ putrā vaneyuścāvamaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
ghṛtācyāmindriyāṇīva mukhyasya jagadātmanaḥ  || 09.20.005 ||
ṛteyo rantināvo'bhūttrayastasyātmajā nṛpa  |
sumatirdhruvo'pratirathaḥ kaṇvo'pratirathātmajaḥ  || 09.20.006 ||
tasya medhātithistasmātpraskannādyā dvijātayaḥ  |
putro'bhūtsumate rebhirduṣmantastatsuto mataḥ  || 09.20.007 ||
duṣmanto mṛgayāṃ yātaḥ kaṇvāśramapadaṃ gataḥ  |
tatrāsīnāṃ svaprabhayā maṇḍayantīṃ ramāmiva  || 09.20.008 ||
vilokya sadyo mumuhe devamāyāmiva striyam  |
babhāṣe tāṃ varārohāṃ bhaṭaiḥ katipayairvṛtaḥ  || 09.20.009 ||
taddarśanapramuditaḥ sannivṛttapariśramaḥ  |
papraccha kāmasantaptaḥ prahasañślakṣṇayā girā  || 09.20.010 ||
kā tvaṃ kamalapatrākṣi kasyāsi hṛdayaṅgame  |
kiṃ sviccikīrṣitaṃ tatra bhavatyā nirjane vane  || 09.20.011 ||
vyaktaṃ rājanyatanayāṃ vedmyahaṃ tvāṃ sumadhyame  |
na hi cetaḥ pauravāṇāmadharme ramate kvacit || 09.20.012 ||
09.20.013|0 śrīśakuntalovāca
viśvāmitrātmajaivāhaṃ tyaktā menakayā vane  |
vedaitadbhagavān kaṇvo vīra kiṃ karavāma te  || 09.20.013 ||
āsyatāṃ hyaravindākṣa gṛhyatāmarhaṇaṃ ca naḥ  |
bhujyatāṃ santi nīvārā uṣyatāṃ yadi rocate  || 09.20.014 ||
09.20.015|0 śrīduṣmanta uvāca
upapannamidaṃ subhru jātāyāḥ kuśikānvaye  |
svayaṃ hi vṛṇute rājñāṃ kanyakāḥ sadṛśaṃ varam  || 09.20.015 ||
omityukte yathādharmamupayeme śakuntalām  |
gāndharvavidhinā rājā deśakālavidhānavit || 09.20.016 ||
amoghavīryo rājarṣirmahiṣyāṃ vīryamādadhe  |
śvobhūte svapuraṃ yātaḥ kālenāsūta sā sutam  || 09.20.017 ||
kaṇvaḥ kumārasya vane cakre samucitāḥ kriyāḥ  |
baddhvā mṛgendraṃ tarasā krīḍati sma sa bālakaḥ  || 09.20.018 ||
taṃ duratyayavikrāntamādāya pramadottamā  |
hareraṃśāṃśasambhūtaṃ bharturantikamāgamat || 09.20.019 ||
yadā na jagṛhe rājā bhāryāputrāvaninditau  |
śṛṇvatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ khe vāgāhāśarīriṇī  || 09.20.020 ||
mātā bhastrā pituḥ putro yena jātaḥ sa eva saḥ  |
bharasva putraṃ duṣmanta māvamaṃsthāḥ śakuntalām  || 09.20.021 ||
retodhāḥ putro nayati naradeva yamakṣayāt |
tvaṃ cāsya dhātā garbhasya satyamāha śakuntalā  || 09.20.022 ||
pitaryuparate so'pi cakravartī mahāyaśāḥ  |
mahimā gīyate tasya hareraṃśabhuvo bhuvi  || 09.20.023 ||
cakraṃ dakṣiṇahaste'sya padmakośo'sya pādayoḥ  |
īje mahābhiṣekeṇa so'bhiṣikto'dhirāḍvibhuḥ  || 09.20.024 ||
pañcapañcāśatā medhyairgaṅgāyāmanu vājibhiḥ  |
māmateyaṃ purodhāya yamunāmanu ca prabhuḥ  || 09.20.025 ||
aṣṭasaptatimedhyāśvān babandha pradadadvasu  |
bharatasya hi dauṣmanteragniḥ sācīguṇe citaḥ  |
sahasraṃ badvaśo yasmin brāhmaṇā gā vibhejire  || 09.20.026 ||
trayastriṃśacchataṃ hyaśvān baddhvā vismāpayannṛpān  |
dauṣmantiratyagānmāyāṃ devānāṃ gurumāyayau  || 09.20.027 ||
mṛgān chukladataḥ kṛṣṇān hiraṇyena parīvṛtān  |
adātkarmaṇi maṣṇāre niyutāni caturdaśa  || 09.20.028 ||
bharatasya mahatkarma na pūrve nāpare nṛpāḥ  |
naivāpurnaiva prāpsyanti bāhubhyāṃ tridivaṃ yathā  || 09.20.029 ||
kirātahūṇān yavanān pauṇḍrān kaṅkān khaśān chakān  |
abrahmaṇyanṛpāṃścāhanmlecchān digvijaye'khilān  || 09.20.030 ||
jitvā purāsurā devān ye rasaukāṃsi bhejire  |
devastriyo rasāṃ nītāḥ prāṇibhiḥ punarāharat || 09.20.031 ||
sarvān kāmān duduhatuḥ prajānāṃ tasya rodasī  |
samāstriṇavasāhasrīrdikṣu cakramavartayat || 09.20.032 ||
sa saṃrāḍlokapālākhyamaiśvaryamadhirāṭśriyam  |
cakraṃ cāskhalitaṃ prāṇānmṛṣetyupararāma ha  || 09.20.033 ||
tasyāsannṛpa vaidarbhyaḥ patnyastisraḥ susammatāḥ  |
jaghnustyāgabhayātputrānnānurūpā itīrite  || 09.20.034 ||
tasyaivaṃ vitathe vaṃśe tadarthaṃ yajataḥ sutam  |
marutstomena maruto bharadvājamupādaduḥ  || 09.20.035 ||
antarvatnyāṃ bhrātṛpatnyāṃ maithunāya bṛhaspatiḥ  |
pravṛtto vārito garbhaṃ śaptvā vīryamupāsṛjat || 09.20.036 ||
taṃ tyaktukāmāṃ mamatāṃ bhartustyāgaviśaṅkitām  |
nāmanirvācanaṃ tasya ślokamenaṃ surā jaguḥ  || 09.20.037 ||
mūḍhe bhara dvājamimaṃ bhara dvājaṃ bṛhaspate  |
yātau yaduktvā pitarau bharadvājastatastvayam  || 09.20.038 ||
codyamānā surairevaṃ matvā vitathamātmajam  |
vyasṛjanmaruto'bibhran datto'yaṃ vitathe'nvaye  || 09.20.039 ||
09.21.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
vitathasya sutānmanyorbṛhatkṣatro jayastataḥ  |
mahāvīryo naro gargaḥ saṅkṛtistu narātmajaḥ  || 09.21.001 ||
guruśca rantidevaśca saṅkṛteḥ pāṇḍunandana  |
rantidevasya mahimā ihāmutra ca gīyate  || 09.21.002 ||
viyadvittasya dadato labdhaṃ labdhaṃ bubhukṣataḥ  |
niṣkiñcanasya dhīrasya sakuṭumbasya sīdataḥ  || 09.21.003 ||
vyatīyuraṣṭacatvāriṃśadahānyapibataḥ kila  |
ghṛtapāyasasaṃyāvaṃ toyaṃ prātarupasthitam  || 09.21.004 ||
kṛcchraprāptakuṭumbasya kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ jātavepathoḥ  |
atithirbrāhmaṇaḥ kāle bhoktukāmasya cāgamat || 09.21.005 ||
tasmai saṃvyabhajatso'nnamādṛtya śraddhayānvitaḥ  |
hariṃ sarvatra sampaśyan sa bhuktvā prayayau dvijaḥ  || 09.21.006 ||
athānyo bhokṣyamāṇasya vibhaktasya mahīpateḥ  |
vibhaktaṃ vyabhajattasmai vṛṣalāya hariṃ smaran  || 09.21.007 ||
yāte śūdre tamanyo'gādatithiḥ śvabhirāvṛtaḥ  |
rājanme dīyatāmannaṃ sagaṇāya bubhukṣate  || 09.21.008 ||
sa ādṛtyāvaśiṣṭaṃ yadbahumānapuraskṛtam  |
tacca dattvā namaścakre śvabhyaḥ śvapataye vibhuḥ  || 09.21.009 ||
pānīyamātramuccheṣaṃ taccaikaparitarpaṇam  |
pāsyataḥ pulkaso'bhyāgādapo dehyaśubhāya me  || 09.21.010 ||
tasya tāṃ karuṇāṃ vācaṃ niśamya vipulaśramām  |
kṛpayā bhṛśasantapta idamāhāmṛtaṃ vacaḥ  || 09.21.011 ||
na kāmaye'haṃ gatimīśvarātparāmaṣṭarddhiyuktāmapunarbhavaṃ vā  |
ārtiṃ prapadye'khiladehabhājāmantaḥsthito yena bhavantyaduḥkhāḥ  || 09.21.012 ||
kṣuttṛṭśramo gātraparibhramaśca dainyaṃ klamaḥ śokaviṣādamohāḥ  |
sarve nivṛttāḥ kṛpaṇasya jantorjijīviṣorjīvajalārpaṇānme  || 09.21.013 ||
iti prabhāṣya pānīyaṃ mriyamāṇaḥ pipāsayā  |
pulkasāyādadāddhīro nisargakaruṇo nṛpaḥ  || 09.21.014 ||
tasya tribhuvanādhīśāḥ phaladāḥ phalamicchatām  |
ātmānaṃ darśayāṃ cakrurmāyā viṣṇuvinirmitāḥ  || 09.21.015 ||
sa vai tebhyo namaskṛtya niḥsaṅgo vigataspṛhaḥ  |
vāsudeve bhagavati bhaktyā cakre manaḥ param  || 09.21.016 ||
īśvarālambanaṃ cittaṃ kurvato'nanyarādhasaḥ  |
māyā guṇamayī rājan svapnavatpratyalīyata  || 09.21.017 ||
tatprasaṅgānubhāvena rantidevānuvartinaḥ  |
abhavan yoginaḥ sarve nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ  || 09.21.018 ||
gargācchinistato gārgyaḥ kṣatrādbrahma hyavartata  |
duritakṣayo mahāvīryāttasya trayyāruṇiḥ kaviḥ  || 09.21.019 ||
puṣkarāruṇirityatra ye brāhmaṇagatiṃ gatāḥ  |
bṛhatkṣatrasya putro'bhūddhastī yaddhastināpuram  || 09.21.020 ||
ajamīḍho dvimīḍhaśca purumīḍhaśca hastinaḥ  |
ajamīḍhasya vaṃśyāḥ syuḥ priyamedhādayo dvijāḥ  || 09.21.021 ||
ajamīḍhādbṛhadiṣustasya putro bṛhaddhanuḥ  |
bṛhatkāyastatastasya putra āsījjayadrathaḥ  || 09.21.022 ||
tatsuto viśadastasya syenajitsamajāyata  |
rucirāśvo dṛḍhahanuḥ kāśyo vatsaśca tatsutāḥ  || 09.21.023 ||
rucirāśvasutaḥ pāraḥ pṛthusenastadātmajaḥ  |
pārasya tanayo nīpastasya putraśataṃ tvabhūt || 09.21.024 ||
sa kṛtvyāṃ śukakanyāyāṃ brahmadattamajījanat |
yogī sa gavi bhāryāyāṃ viṣvaksenamadhātsutam  || 09.21.025 ||
jaigīṣavyopadeśena yogatantraṃ cakāra ha  |
udaksenastatastasmādbhallāṭo bārhadīṣavāḥ  || 09.21.026 ||
yavīnaro dvimīḍhasya kṛtimāṃstatsutaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
nāmnā satyadhṛtistasya dṛḍhanemiḥ supārśvakṛt || 09.21.027 ||
supārśvātsumatistasya putraḥ sannatimāṃstataḥ  |
kṛtī hiraṇyanābhādyo yogaṃ prāpya jagau sma ṣaṭ || 09.21.028 ||
saṃhitāḥ prācyasāmnāṃ vai nīpo hyudgrāyudhastataḥ  |
tasya kṣemyaḥ suvīro'tha suvīrasya ripuñjayaḥ  || 09.21.029 ||
tato bahuratho nāma purumīḍho'prajo'bhavat |
nalinyāmajamīḍhasya nīlaḥ śāntistu tatsutaḥ  || 09.21.030 ||
śānteḥ suśāntistatputraḥ purujo'rkastato'bhavat |
bharmyāśvastanayastasya pañcāsanmudgalādayaḥ  || 09.21.031 ||
yavīnaro bṛhadviśvaḥ kāmpillaḥ sañjayaḥ sutāḥ  |
bharmyāśvaḥ prāha putrā me pañcānāṃ rakṣaṇāya hi  || 09.21.032 ||
viṣayāṇāmalamime iti pañcālasaṃjñitāḥ  |
mudgalādbrahmanirvṛttaṃ gotraṃ maudgalyasaṃjñitam  || 09.21.033 ||
mithunaṃ mudgalādbhārmyāddivodāsaḥ pumānabhūt |
ahalyā kanyakā yasyāṃ śatānandastu gautamāt || 09.21.034 ||
tasya satyadhṛtiḥ putro dhanurvedaviśāradaḥ  |
śaradvāṃstatsuto yasmādurvaśīdarśanātkila  || 09.21.035 ||
śarastambe'patadreto mithunaṃ tadabhūcchubham  |
taddṛṣṭvā kṛpayāgṛhṇācchāntanurmṛgayāṃ caran  |
kṛpaḥ kumāraḥ kanyā ca droṇapatnyabhavatkṛpī  || 09.21.036 ||
09.22.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
mitrāyuśca divodāsāccyavanastatsuto nṛpa  |
sudāsaḥ sahadevo'tha somako jantujanmakṛt || 09.22.001 ||
tasya putraśataṃ teṣāṃ yavīyān pṛṣataḥ sutaḥ  |
sa tasmāddrupado jajñe sarvasampatsamanvitaḥ  |
drupadāddraupadī tasya dhṛṣṭadyumnādayaḥ sutāḥ  || 09.22.002 ||
dhṛṣṭadyumnāddhṛṣṭaketurbhārmyāḥ pāñcālakā ime  |
yo'jamīḍhasuto hyanya ṛkṣaḥ saṃvaraṇastataḥ  || 09.22.003 ||
tapatyāṃ sūryakanyāyāṃ kurukṣetrapatiḥ kuruḥ  |
parīkṣiḥ sudhanurjahnurniṣadhaśca kuroḥ sutāḥ  || 09.22.004 ||
suhotro'bhūtsudhanuṣaścyavano'tha tataḥ kṛtī  |
vasustasyoparicaro bṛhadrathamukhāstataḥ  || 09.22.005 ||
kuśāmbamatsyapratyagra cedipādyāśca cedipāḥ  |
bṛhadrathātkuśāgro'bhūdṛṣabhastasya tatsutaḥ  || 09.22.006 ||
jajñe satyahito'patyaṃ puṣpavāṃstatsuto jahuḥ  |
anyasyāmapi bhāryāyāṃ śakale dve bṛhadrathāt || 09.22.007 ||
ye mātrā bahirutsṛṣṭe jarayā cābhisandhite  |
jīva jīveti krīḍantyā jarāsandho'bhavatsutaḥ  || 09.22.008 ||
tataśca sahadevo'bhūtsomāpiryacchrutaśravāḥ  |
parīkṣiranapatyo'bhūtsuratho nāma jāhnavaḥ  || 09.22.009 ||
tato vidūrathastasmātsārvabhaumastato'bhavat |
jayasenastattanayo rādhiko'to'yutāyvabhūt || 09.22.010 ||
tataścākrodhanastasmāddevātithiramuṣya ca  |
ṛkṣastasya dilīpo'bhūtpratīpastasya cātmajaḥ  || 09.22.011 ||
devāpiḥ śāntanustasya bāhlīka iti cātmajāḥ  |
pitṛrājyaṃ parityajya devāpistu vanaṃ gataḥ  || 09.22.012 ||
abhavacchāntanū rājā prāṅmahābhiṣasaṃjñitaḥ  |
yaṃ yaṃ karābhyāṃ spṛśati jīrṇaṃ yauvanameti saḥ  || 09.22.013 ||
śāntimāpnoti caivāgryāṃ karmaṇā tena śāntanuḥ  |
samā dvādaśa tadrājye na vavarṣa yadā vibhuḥ  || 09.22.014 ||
śāntanurbrāhmaṇairuktaḥ parivettāyamagrabhuk |
rājyaṃ dehyagrajāyāśu purarāṣṭravivṛddhaye  || 09.22.015 ||
evamukto dvijairjyeṣṭhaṃ chandayāmāsa so'bravīt |
tanmantriprahitairviprairvedādvibhraṃśito girā  || 09.22.016 ||
vedavādātivādān vai tadā devo vavarṣa ha  |
devāpiryogamāsthāya kalāpagrāmamāśritaḥ  || 09.22.017 ||
somavaṃśe kalau naṣṭe kṛtādau sthāpayiṣyati  |
bāhlīkātsomadatto'bhūdbhūrirbhūriśravāstataḥ  || 09.22.018 ||
śalaśca śāntanorāsīdgaṅgāyāṃ bhīṣma ātmavān  |
sarvadharmavidāṃ śreṣṭho mahābhāgavataḥ kaviḥ  || 09.22.019 ||
vīrayūthāgraṇīryena rāmo'pi yudhi toṣitaḥ  |
śāntanordāsakanyāyāṃ jajñe citrāṅgadaḥ sutaḥ  || 09.22.020 ||
vicitravīryaścāvarajo nāmnā citrāṅgado hataḥ  |
yasyāṃ parāśarātsākṣādavatīrṇo hareḥ kalā  || 09.22.021 ||
vedagupto muniḥ kṛṣṇo yato'hamidamadhyagām  |
hitvā svaśiṣyān pailādīn bhagavān bādarāyaṇaḥ  || 09.22.022 ||
mahyaṃ putrāya śāntāya paraṃ guhyamidaṃ jagau  |
vicitravīryo'thovāha kāśīrājasute balāt || 09.22.023 ||
svayaṃvarādupānīte ambikāmbālike ubhe  |
tayorāsaktahṛdayo gṛhīto yakṣmaṇā mṛtaḥ  || 09.22.024 ||
kṣetre'prajasya vai bhrāturmātrokto bādarāyaṇaḥ  |
dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca pāṇḍuṃ ca viduraṃ cāpyajījanat || 09.22.025 ||
gāndhāryāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya jajñe putraśataṃ nṛpa  |
tatra duryodhano jyeṣṭho duḥśalā cāpi kanyakā  || 09.22.026 ||
śāpānmaithunaruddhasya pāṇḍoḥ kuntyāṃ mahārathāḥ  |
jātā dharmānilendrebhyo yudhiṣṭhiramukhāstrayaḥ  || 09.22.027 ||
nakulaḥ sahadevaśca mādryāṃ nāsatyadasrayoḥ  |
draupadyāṃ pañca pañcabhyaḥ putrāste pitaro'bhavan  || 09.22.028 ||
yudhiṣṭhirātprativindhyaḥ śrutaseno vṛkodarāt |
arjunācchrutakīrtistu śatānīkastu nākuliḥ  || 09.22.029 ||
sahadevasuto rājan chrutakarmā tathāpare  |
yudhiṣṭhirāttu pauravyāṃ devako'tha ghaṭotkacaḥ  || 09.22.030 ||
bhīmasenāddhiḍimbāyāṃ kālyāṃ sarvagatastataḥ  |
sahadevātsuhotraṃ tu vijayāsūta pārvatī  || 09.22.031 ||
kareṇumatyāṃ nakulo naramitraṃ tathārjunaḥ  |
irāvantamulupyāṃ vai sutāyāṃ babhruvāhanam  |
maṇipurapateḥ so'pi tatputraḥ putrikāsutaḥ  || 09.22.032 ||
tava tātaḥ subhadrāyāmabhimanyurajāyata  |
sarvātirathajidvīra uttarāyāṃ tato bhavān  || 09.22.033 ||
parikṣīṇeṣu kuruṣu drauṇerbrahmāstratejasā  |
tvaṃ ca kṛṣṇānubhāvena sajīvo mocito'ntakāt || 09.22.034 ||
taveme tanayāstāta janamejayapūrvakāḥ  |
śrutaseno bhīmasena ugrasenaśca vīryavān  || 09.22.035 ||
janamejayastvāṃ viditvā takṣakānnidhanaṃ gatam  |
sarpān vai sarpayāgāgnau sa hoṣyati ruṣānvitaḥ  || 09.22.036 ||
kālaṣeyaṃ purodhāya turaṃ turagamedhaṣāṭ |
samantātpṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ jitvā yakṣyati cādhvaraiḥ  || 09.22.037 ||
tasya putraḥ śatānīko yājñavalkyāttrayīṃ paṭhan  |
astrajñānaṃ kriyājñānaṃ śaunakātparameṣyati  || 09.22.038 ||
sahasrānīkastatputrastataścaivāśvamedhajaḥ  |
asīmakṛṣṇastasyāpi nemicakrastu tatsutaḥ  || 09.22.039 ||
gajāhvaye hṛte nadyā kauśāmbyāṃ sādhu vatsyati  |
uktastataścitrarathastasmācchucirathaḥ sutaḥ  || 09.22.040 ||
tasmācca vṛṣṭimāṃstasya suṣeṇo'tha mahīpatiḥ  |
sunīthastasya bhavitā nṛcakṣuryatsukhīnalaḥ  || 09.22.041 ||
pariplavaḥ sutastasmānmedhāvī sunayātmajaḥ  |
nṛpañjayastato dūrvastimistasmājjaniṣyati  || 09.22.042 ||
timerbṛhadrathastasmācchatānīkaḥ sudāsajaḥ  |
śatānīkāddurdamanastasyāpatyaṃ mahīnaraḥ  || 09.22.043 ||
daṇḍapāṇirnimistasya kṣemako bhavitā yataḥ  |
brahmakṣatrasya vai yonirvaṃśo devarṣisatkṛtaḥ  || 09.22.044 ||
kṣemakaṃ prāpya rājānaṃ saṃsthāṃ prāpsyati vai kalau  |
atha māgadharājāno bhāvino ye vadāmi te  || 09.22.045 ||
bhavitā sahadevasya mārjāriryacchrutaśravāḥ  |
tato yutāyustasyāpi niramitro'tha tatsutaḥ  || 09.22.046 ||
sunakṣatraḥ sunakṣatrādbṛhatseno'tha karmajit |
tataḥ sutañjayādvipraḥ śucistasya bhaviṣyati  || 09.22.047 ||
kṣemo'tha suvratastasmāddharmasūtraḥ samastataḥ  |
dyumatseno'tha sumatiḥ subalo janitā tataḥ  || 09.22.048 ||
sunīthaḥ satyajidatha viśvajidyadripuñjayaḥ  |
bārhadrathāśca bhūpālā bhāvyāḥ sāhasravatsaram  || 09.22.049 ||
09.23.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
anoḥ sabhānaraścakṣuḥ pareṣṇuśca trayaḥ sutāḥ  |
sabhānarātkālanaraḥ sṛñjayastatsutastataḥ  || 09.23.001 ||
janamejayastasya putro mahāśālo mahāmanāḥ  |
uśīnarastitikṣuśca mahāmanasa ātmajau  || 09.23.002 ||
śibirvaraḥ kṛmirdakṣaścatvārośīnarātmajāḥ  |
vṛṣādarbhaḥ sudhīraśca madraḥ kekaya ātmavān  || 09.23.003 ||
śibeścatvāra evāsaṃstitikṣośca ruṣadrathaḥ  |
tato homo'tha sutapā baliḥ sutapaso'bhavat || 09.23.004 ||
aṅgavaṅgakaliṅgādyāḥ suhmapuṇḍrauḍrasaṃjñitāḥ  |
jajñire dīrghatamaso baleḥ kṣetre mahīkṣitaḥ  || 09.23.005 ||
cakruḥ svanāmnā viṣayān ṣaḍimān prācyakāṃśca te  |
khalapāno'ṅgato jajñe tasmāddivirathastataḥ  || 09.23.006 ||
suto dharmaratho yasya jajñe citraratho'prajāḥ  |
romapāda iti khyātastasmai daśarathaḥ sakhā  || 09.23.007 ||
śāntāṃ svakanyāṃ prāyacchadṛṣyaśṛṅga uvāha yām  |
deve'varṣati yaṃ rāmā āninyurhariṇīsutam  || 09.23.008 ||
nāṭyasaṅgītavāditrairvibhramāliṅganārhaṇaiḥ  |
sa tu rājño'napatyasya nirūpyeṣṭiṃ marutvate  || 09.23.009 ||
prajāmadāddaśaratho yena lebhe'prajāḥ prajāḥ  |
caturaṅgo romapādātpṛthulākṣastu tatsutaḥ  || 09.23.010 ||
bṛhadratho bṛhatkarmā bṛhadbhānuśca tatsutāḥ  |
ādyādbṛhanmanāstasmājjayadratha udāhṛtaḥ  || 09.23.011 ||
vijayastasya sambhūtyāṃ tato dhṛtirajāyata  |
tato dhṛtavratastasya satkarmādhirathastataḥ  || 09.23.012 ||
yo'sau gaṅgātaṭe krīḍanmañjūṣāntargataṃ śiśum  |
kuntyāpaviddhaṃ kānīnamanapatyo'karotsutam  || 09.23.013 ||
vṛṣasenaḥ sutastasya karṇasya jagatīpate  |
druhyośca tanayo babhruḥ setustasyātmajastataḥ  || 09.23.014 ||
ārabdhastasya gāndhārastasya dharmastato dhṛtaḥ  |
dhṛtasya durmadastasmātpracetāḥ prācetasaḥ śatam  || 09.23.015 ||
mlecchādhipatayo'bhūvannudīcīṃ diśamāśritāḥ  |
turvasośca suto vahnirvahnerbhargo'tha bhānumān  || 09.23.016 ||
tribhānustatsuto'syāpi karandhama udāradhīḥ  |
marutastatsuto'putraḥ putraṃ pauravamanvabhūt || 09.23.017 ||
duṣmantaḥ sa punarbheje svavaṃśaṃ rājyakāmukaḥ  |
yayāterjyeṣṭhaputrasya yadorvaṃśaṃ nararṣabha  || 09.23.018 ||
varṇayāmi mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇām  |
yadorvaṃśaṃ naraḥ śrutvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  || 09.23.019 ||
yatrāvatīrṇo bhagavān paramātmā narākṛtiḥ  |
yadoḥ sahasrajitkroṣṭā nalo ripuriti śrutāḥ  || 09.23.020 ||
catvāraḥ sūnavastatra śatajitprathamātmajaḥ  |
mahāhayo reṇuhayo haihayaśceti tatsutāḥ  || 09.23.021 ||
dharmastu haihayasuto netraḥ kunteḥ pitā tataḥ  |
sohañjirabhavatkuntermahiṣmān bhadrasenakaḥ  || 09.23.022 ||
durmado bhadrasenasya dhanakaḥ kṛtavīryasūḥ  |
kṛtāgniḥ kṛtavarmā ca kṛtaujā dhanakātmajāḥ  || 09.23.023 ||
arjunaḥ kṛtavīryasya saptadvīpeśvaro'bhavat |
dattātreyāddhareraṃśātprāptayogamahāguṇaḥ  || 09.23.024 ||
na nūnaṃ kārtavīryasya gatiṃ yāsyanti pārthivāḥ  |
yajñadānatapoyogaiḥ śrutavīryadayādibhiḥ  || 09.23.025 ||
pañcāśīti sahasrāṇi hyavyāhatabalaḥ samāḥ  |
anaṣṭavittasmaraṇo bubhuje'kṣayyaṣaḍvasu  || 09.23.026 ||
tasya putrasahasreṣu pañcaivorvaritā mṛdhe  |
jayadhvajaḥ śūraseno vṛṣabho madhurūrjitaḥ  || 09.23.027 ||
jayadhvajāttālajaṅghastasya putraśataṃ tvabhūt |
kṣatraṃ yattālajaṅghākhyamaurvatejopasaṃhṛtam  || 09.23.028 ||
teṣāṃ jyeṣṭho vītihotro vṛṣṇiḥ putro madhoḥ smṛtaḥ  |
tasya putraśataṃ tvāsīdvṛṣṇijyeṣṭhaṃ yataḥ kulam  || 09.23.029 ||
mādhavā vṛṣṇayo rājan yādavāśceti saṃjñitāḥ  |
yaduputrasya ca kroṣṭoḥ putro vṛjinavāṃstataḥ  || 09.23.030 ||
svāhito'to viṣadgurvai tasya citrarathastataḥ  |
śaśabindurmahāyogī mahābhāgo mahānabhūt || 09.23.031 ||
caturdaśamahāratnaścakravartyaparājitaḥ  |
tasya patnīsahasrāṇāṃ daśānāṃ sumahāyaśāḥ  || 09.23.032 ||
daśalakṣasahasrāṇi putrāṇāṃ tāsvajījanat |
teṣāṃ tu ṣaṭpradhānānāṃ pṛthuśravasa ātmajaḥ  || 09.23.033 ||
dharmo nāmośanā tasya hayamedhaśatasya yāṭ |
tatsuto rucakastasya pañcāsannātmajāḥ śṛṇu  || 09.23.034 ||
purujidrukmarukmeṣu pṛthujyāmaghasaṃjñitāḥ  |
jyāmaghastvaprajo'pyanyāṃ bhāryāṃ śaibyāpatirbhayāt || 09.23.035 ||
nāvindacchatrubhavanādbhojyāṃ kanyāmahāraṣīt |
rathasthāṃ tāṃ nirīkṣyāha śaibyā patimamarṣitā  || 09.23.036 ||
keyaṃ kuhaka matsthānaṃ rathamāropiteti vai  |
snuṣā tavetyabhihite smayantī patimabravīt || 09.23.037 ||
ahaṃ bandhyāsapatnī ca snuṣā me yujyate katham  |
janayiṣyasi yaṃ rājñi tasyeyamupayujyate  || 09.23.038 ||
anvamodanta tadviśve devāḥ pitara eva ca  |
śaibyā garbhamadhātkāle kumāraṃ suṣuve śubham  |
sa vidarbha iti prokta upayeme snuṣāṃ satīm  || 09.23.039 ||
09.24.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
tasyāṃ vidarbho'janayatputrau nāmnā kuśakrathau  |
tṛtīyaṃ romapādaṃ ca vidarbhakulanandanam  || 09.24.001 ||
romapādasuto babhrurbabhroḥ kṛtirajāyata  |
uśikastatsutastasmāccediścaidyādayo nṛpāḥ  || 09.24.002 ||
krathasya kuntiḥ putro'bhūdvṛṣṇistasyātha nirvṛtiḥ  |
tato daśārho nāmnābhūttasya vyomaḥ sutastataḥ  || 09.24.003 ||
jīmūto vikṛtistasya yasya bhīmarathaḥ sutaḥ  |
tato navarathaḥ putro jāto daśarathastataḥ  || 09.24.004 ||
karambhiḥ śakuneḥ putro devarātastadātmajaḥ  |
devakṣatrastatastasya madhuḥ kuruvaśādanuḥ  || 09.24.005 ||
puruhotrastvanoḥ putrastasyāyuḥ sātvatastataḥ  |
bhajamāno bhajirdivyo vṛṣṇirdevāvṛdho'ndhakaḥ  || 09.24.006 ||
sātvatasya sutāḥ sapta mahābhojaśca māriṣa  |
bhajamānasya nimlociḥ kiṅkaṇo dhṛṣṭireva ca  || 09.24.007 ||
ekasyāmātmajāḥ patnyāmanyasyāṃ ca trayaḥ sutāḥ  |
śatājicca sahasrājidayutājiditi prabho  || 09.24.008 ||
babhrurdevāvṛdhasutastayoḥ ślokau paṭhantyamū  |
yathaiva śṛṇumo dūrātsampaśyāmastathāntikāt || 09.24.009 ||
babhruḥ śreṣṭho manuṣyāṇāṃ devairdevāvṛdhaḥ samaḥ  |
puruṣāḥ pañcaṣaṣṭiśca ṣaṭsahasrāṇi cāṣṭa ca  || 09.24.010 ||
ye'mṛtatvamanuprāptā babhrordevāvṛdhādapi  |
mahābhojo'tidharmātmā bhojā āsaṃstadanvaye  || 09.24.011 ||
vṛṣṇeḥ sumitraḥ putro'bhūdyudhājicca parantapa  |
śinistasyānamitraśca nighno'bhūdanamitrataḥ  || 09.24.012 ||
satrājitaḥ prasenaśca nighnasyāthāsatuḥ sutau  |
anamitrasuto yo'nyaḥ śinistasya ca satyakaḥ  || 09.24.013 ||
yuyudhānaḥ sātyakirvai jayastasya kuṇistataḥ  |
yugandharo'namitrasya vṛṣṇiḥ putro'parastataḥ  || 09.24.014 ||
śvaphalkaścitrarathaśca gāndinyāṃ ca śvaphalkataḥ  |
akrūrapramukhā āsan putrā dvādaśa viśrutāḥ  || 09.24.015 ||
āsaṅgaḥ sārameyaśca mṛduro mṛduvidgiriḥ  |
dharmavṛddhaḥ sukarmā ca kṣetropekṣo'rimardanaḥ  || 09.24.016 ||
śatrughno gandhamādaśca pratibāhuśca dvādaśa  |
teṣāṃ svasā sucārākhyā dvāvakrūrasutāvapi  || 09.24.017 ||
devavānupadevaśca tathā citrarathātmajāḥ  |
pṛthurvidūrathādyāśca bahavo vṛṣṇinandanāḥ  || 09.24.018 ||
kukuro bhajamānaśca śuciḥ kambalabarhiṣaḥ  |
kukurasya suto vahnirvilomā tanayastataḥ  || 09.24.019 ||
kapotaromā tasyānuḥ sakhā yasya ca tumburuḥ  |
andhakāddundubhistasmādavidyotaḥ punarvasuḥ  || 09.24.020 ||
tasyāhukaścāhukī ca kanyā caivāhukātmajau  |
devakaścograsenaśca catvāro devakātmajāḥ  || 09.24.021 ||
devavānupadevaśca sudevo devavardhanaḥ  |
teṣāṃ svasāraḥ saptāsan dhṛtadevādayo nṛpa  || 09.24.022 ||
śāntidevopadevā ca śrīdevā devarakṣitā  |
sahadevā devakī ca vasudeva uvāha tāḥ  || 09.24.023 ||
kaṃsaḥ sunāmā nyagrodhaḥ kaṅkaḥ śaṅkuḥ suhūstathā  |
rāṣṭrapālo'tha dhṛṣṭiśca tuṣṭimānaugrasenayaḥ  || 09.24.024 ||
kaṃsā kaṃsavatī kaṅkā śūrabhū rāṣṭrapālikā  |
ugrasenaduhitaro vasudevānujastriyaḥ  || 09.24.025 ||
śūro vidūrathādāsīdbhajamānastu tatsutaḥ  |
śinistasmātsvayaṃ bhojo hṛdikastatsuto mataḥ  || 09.24.026 ||
devamīḍhaḥ śatadhanuḥ kṛtavarmeti tatsutāḥ  |
devamīḍhasya śūrasya māriṣā nāma patnyabhūt || 09.24.027 ||
tasyāṃ sa janayāmāsa daśa putrānakalmaṣān  |
vasudevaṃ devabhāgaṃ devaśravasamānakam  || 09.24.028 ||
sṛñjayaṃ śyāmakaṃ kaṅkaṃ śamīkaṃ vatsakaṃ vṛkam  |
devadundubhayo nedurānakā yasya janmani  || 09.24.029 ||
vasudevaṃ hareḥ sthānaṃ vadantyānakadundubhim  |
pṛthā ca śrutadevā ca śrutakīrtiḥ śrutaśravāḥ  || 09.24.030 ||
rājādhidevī caiteṣāṃ bhaginyaḥ pañca kanyakāḥ  |
kunteḥ sakhyuḥ pitā śūro hyaputrasya pṛthāmadāt || 09.24.031 ||
sāpa durvāsaso vidyāṃ devahūtīṃ pratoṣitāt |
tasyā vīryaparīkṣārthamājuhāva raviṃ śuciḥ  || 09.24.032 ||
tadaivopāgataṃ devaṃ vīkṣya vismitamānasā  |
pratyayārthaṃ prayuktā me yāhi deva kṣamasva me  || 09.24.033 ||
amoghaṃ devasandarśamādadhe tvayi cātmajam  |
yoniryathā na duṣyeta kartāhaṃ te sumadhyame  || 09.24.034 ||
iti tasyāṃ sa ādhāya garbhaṃ sūryo divaṃ gataḥ  |
sadyaḥ kumāraḥ sañjajñe dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ  || 09.24.035 ||
taṃ sātyajannadītoye kṛcchrāllokasya bibhyatī  |
prapitāmahastāmuvāha pāṇḍurvai satyavikramaḥ  || 09.24.036 ||
śrutadevāṃ tu kārūṣo vṛddhaśarmā samagrahīt |
yasyāmabhūddantavakra ṛṣiśapto diteḥ sutaḥ  || 09.24.037 ||
kaikeyo dhṛṣṭaketuśca śrutakīrtimavindata  |
santardanādayastasyāṃ pañcāsan kaikayāḥ sutāḥ  || 09.24.038 ||
rājādhidevyāmāvantyau jayaseno'janiṣṭa ha  |
damaghoṣaścedirājaḥ śrutaśravasamagrahīt || 09.24.039 ||
śiśupālaḥ sutastasyāḥ kathitastasya sambhavaḥ  |
devabhāgasya kaṃsāyāṃ citraketubṛhadbalau  || 09.24.040 ||
kaṃsavatyāṃ devaśravasaḥ suvīra iṣumāṃstathā  |
bakaḥ kaṅkāttu kaṅkāyāṃ satyajitpurujittathā  || 09.24.041 ||
sṛñjayo rāṣṭrapālyāṃ ca vṛṣadurmarṣaṇādikān  |
harikeśahiraṇyākṣau śūrabhūmyāṃ ca śyāmakaḥ  || 09.24.042 ||
miśrakeśyāmapsarasi vṛkādīn vatsakastathā  |
takṣapuṣkaraśālādīn durvākṣyāṃ vṛka ādadhe  || 09.24.043 ||
sumitrārjunapālādīn samīkāttu sudāmanī  |
ānakaḥ karṇikāyāṃ vai ṛtadhāmājayāvapi  || 09.24.044 ||
pauravī rohiṇī bhadrā madirā rocanā ilā  |
devakīpramukhāścāsan patnya ānakadundubheḥ  || 09.24.045 ||
balaṃ gadaṃ sāraṇaṃ ca durmadaṃ vipulaṃ dhruvam  |
vasudevastu rohiṇyāṃ kṛtādīnudapādayat || 09.24.046 ||
subhadro bhadrabāhuśca durmado bhadra eva ca  |
pauravyāstanayā hyete bhūtādyā dvādaśābhavan  || 09.24.047 ||
nandopanandakṛtaka śūrādyā madirātmajāḥ  |
kauśalyā keśinaṃ tvekamasūta kulanandanam  || 09.24.048 ||
rocanāyāmato jātā hastahemāṅgadādayaḥ  |
ilāyāmuruvalkādīn yadumukhyānajījanat || 09.24.049 ||
vipṛṣṭho dhṛtadevāyāmeka ānakadundubheḥ  |
śāntidevātmajā rājan praśamaprasitādayaḥ  || 09.24.050 ||
rājanyakalpavarṣādyā upadevāsutā daśa  |
vasuhaṃsasuvaṃśādyāḥ śrīdevāyāstu ṣaṭsutāḥ  || 09.24.051 ||
devarakṣitayā labdhā nava cātra gadādayaḥ  |
vasudevaḥ sutānaṣṭāvādadhe sahadevayā  || 09.24.052 ||
pravaraśrutamukhyāṃśca sākṣāddharmo vasūniva  |
vasudevastu devakyāmaṣṭa putrānajījanat || 09.24.053 ||
kīrtimantaṃ suṣeṇaṃ ca bhadrasenamudāradhīḥ  |
ṛjuṃ sammardanaṃ bhadraṃ saṅkarṣaṇamahīśvaram  || 09.24.054 ||
aṣṭamastu tayorāsītsvayameva hariḥ kila  |
subhadrā ca mahābhāgā tava rājan pitāmahī  || 09.24.055 ||
yadā yadā hi dharmasya kṣayo vṛddhiśca pāpmanaḥ  |
tadā tu bhagavānīśa ātmānaṃ sṛjate hariḥ  || 09.24.056 ||
na hyasya janmano hetuḥ karmaṇo vā mahīpate  |
ātmamāyāṃ vineśasya parasya draṣṭurātmanaḥ  || 09.24.057 ||
yanmāyāceṣṭitaṃ puṃsaḥ sthityutpattyapyayāya hi  |
anugrahastannivṛtterātmalābhāya ceṣyate  || 09.24.058 ||
akṣauhiṇīnāṃ patibhirasurairnṛpalāñchanaiḥ  |
bhuva ākramyamāṇāyā abhārāya kṛtodyamaḥ  || 09.24.059 ||
karmāṇyaparimeyāṇi manasāpi sureśvaraiḥ  |
sahasaṅkarṣaṇaścakre bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ  || 09.24.060 ||
kalau janiṣyamāṇānāṃ duḥkhaśokatamonudam  |
anugrahāya bhaktānāṃ supuṇyaṃ vyatanodyaśaḥ  || 09.24.061 ||
yasmin satkarṇapīyuṣe yaśastīrthavare sakṛt |
śrotrāñjalirupaspṛśya dhunute karmavāsanām  || 09.24.062 ||
bhojavṛṣṇyandhakamadhu śūrasenadaśārhakaiḥ  |
ślāghanīyehitaḥ śaśvatkurusṛñjayapāṇḍubhiḥ  || 09.24.063 ||
snigdhasmitekṣitodārairvākyairvikramalīlayā  |
nṛlokaṃ ramayāmāsa mūrtyā sarvāṅgaramyayā  || 09.24.064 ||
yasyānanaṃ makarakuṇḍalacārukarṇa bhrājatkapolasubhagaṃ savilāsahāsam  |
nityotsavaṃ na tatṛpurdṛśibhiḥ pibantyo nāryo narāśca muditāḥ kupitā nimeśca  || 09.24.065 ||
jāto gataḥ pitṛgṛhādvrajamedhitārtho hatvā ripūn sutaśatāni kṛtorudāraḥ  |
utpādya teṣu puruṣaḥ kratubhiḥ samīje ātmānamātmanigamaṃ prathayan janeṣu  || 09.24.066 ||
pṛthvyāḥ sa vai gurubharaṃ kṣapayan kurūṇāmantaḥsamutthakalinā yudhi bhūpacamvaḥ  |
dṛṣṭyā vidhūya vijaye jayamudvighoṣya procyoddhavāya ca paraṃ samagātsvadhāma  || 09.24.067 ||


10.01.001|0 śrīrājovāca
kathito vaṃśavistāro bhavatā somasūryayoḥ  |
rājñāṃ cobhayavaṃśyānāṃ caritaṃ paramādbhutam  || 10.01.001 ||
yadośca dharmaśīlasya nitarāṃ munisattama  |
tatrāṃśenāvatīrṇasya viṣṇorvīryāṇi śaṃsa naḥ  || 10.01.002 ||
avatīrya yadorvaṃśe bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ  |
kṛtavān yāni viśvātmā tāni no vada vistarāt || 10.01.003 ||
nivṛttatarṣairupagīyamānādbhavauṣadhācchrotramano'bhirāmāt |
ka uttamaślokaguṇānuvādātpumān virajyeta vinā paśughnāt || 10.01.004 ||
pitāmahā me samare'marañjayairdevavratādyātirathaistimiṅgilaiḥ  |
duratyayaṃ kauravasainyasāgaraṃ kṛtvātaran vatsapadaṃ sma yatplavāḥ  || 10.01.005 ||
drauṇyastravipluṣṭamidaṃ madaṅgaṃ santānabījaṃ kurupāṇḍavānām  |
jugopa kukṣiṃ gata āttacakro mātuśca me yaḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāyāḥ  || 10.01.006 ||
vīryāṇi tasyākhiladehabhājāmantarbahiḥ pūruṣakālarūpaiḥ  |
prayacchato mṛtyumutāmṛtaṃ ca māyāmanuṣyasya vadasva vidvan  || 10.01.007 ||
rohiṇyāstanayaḥ prokto rāmaḥ saṅkarṣaṇastvayā  |
devakyā garbhasambandhaḥ kuto dehāntaraṃ vinā  || 10.01.008 ||
kasmānmukundo bhagavān piturgehādvrajaṃ gataḥ  |
kva vāsaṃ jñātibhiḥ sārdhaṃ kṛtavān sātvatāṃ patiḥ  || 10.01.009 ||
vraje vasan kimakaronmadhupuryāṃ ca keśavaḥ  |
bhrātaraṃ cāvadhītkaṃsaṃ māturaddhātadarhaṇam  || 10.01.010 ||
dehaṃ mānuṣamāśritya kati varṣāṇi vṛṣṇibhiḥ  |
yadupuryāṃ sahāvātsītpatnyaḥ katyabhavan prabhoḥ  || 10.01.011 ||
etadanyacca sarvaṃ me mune kṛṣṇaviceṣṭitam  |
vaktumarhasi sarvajña śraddadhānāya vistṛtam  || 10.01.012 ||
naiṣātiduḥsahā kṣunmāṃ tyaktodamapi bādhate  |
pibantaṃ tvanmukhāmbhoja cyutaṃ harikathāmṛtam  || 10.01.013 ||
10.01.014|0 sūta uvāca
evaṃ niśamya bhṛgunandana sādhuvādaṃ   vaiyāsakiḥ sa bhagavānatha viṣṇurātam  |
pratyarcya kṛṣṇacaritaṃ kalikalmaṣaghnaṃ   vyāhartumārabhata bhāgavatapradhānaḥ  || 10.01.014 ||*
10.01.015|0 śrīśuka uvāca
samyagvyavasitā buddhistava rājarṣisattama  |
vāsudevakathāyāṃ te yajjātā naiṣṭhikī ratiḥ  || 10.01.015 ||
vāsudevakathāpraśnaḥ puruṣāṃstrīn punāti hi  |
vaktāraṃ pracchakaṃ śrotṝṃstatpādasalilaṃ yathā  || 10.01.016 ||
bhūmirdṛptanṛpavyāja daityānīkaśatāyutaiḥ  |
ākrāntā bhūribhāreṇa brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau  || 10.01.017 ||
gaurbhūtvāśrumukhī khinnā krandantī karuṇaṃ vibhoḥ  |
upasthitāntike tasmai vyasanaṃ samavocata  || 10.01.018 ||
brahmā tadupadhāryātha saha devaistayā saha  |
jagāma satrinayanastīraṃ kṣīrapayonidheḥ  || 10.01.019 ||
tatra gatvā jagannāthaṃ devadevaṃ vṛṣākapim  |
puruṣaṃ puruṣasūktena upatasthe samāhitaḥ  || 10.01.020 ||
giraṃ samādhau gagane samīritāṃ niśamya vedhāstridaśānuvāca ha  |
gāṃ pauruṣīṃ me śṛṇutāmarāḥ punarvidhīyatāmāśu tathaiva mā ciram  || 10.01.021 ||
puraiva puṃsāvadhṛto dharājvaro bhavadbhiraṃśairyaduṣūpajanyatām  |
sa yāvadurvyā bharamīśvareśvaraḥ svakālaśaktyā kṣapayaṃścaredbhuvi  || 10.01.022 ||
vasudevagṛhe sākṣādbhagavān puruṣaḥ paraḥ  |
janiṣyate tatpriyārthaṃ sambhavantu surastriyaḥ  || 10.01.023 ||
vāsudevakalānantaḥ sahasravadanaḥ svarāṭ |
agrato bhavitā devo hareḥ priyacikīrṣayā  || 10.01.024 ||
viṣṇormāyā bhagavatī yayā sammohitaṃ jagat |
ādiṣṭā prabhuṇāṃśena kāryārthe sambhaviṣyati  || 10.01.025 ||
10.01.026|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ityādiśyāmaragaṇān prajāpatipatirvibhuḥ  |
āśvāsya ca mahīṃ gīrbhiḥ svadhāma paramaṃ yayau  || 10.01.026 ||
śūraseno yadupatirmathurāmāvasan purīm  |
māthurāñchūrasenāṃśca viṣayān bubhuje purā  || 10.01.027 ||
rājadhānī tataḥ sābhūtsarvayādavabhūbhujām  |
mathurā bhagavān yatra nityaṃ sannihito hariḥ  || 10.01.028 ||
tasyāṃ tu karhicicchaurirvasudevaḥ kṛtodvahaḥ  |
devakyā sūryayā sārdhaṃ prayāṇe rathamāruhat || 10.01.029 ||
ugrasenasutaḥ kaṃsaḥ svasuḥ priyacikīrṣayā  |
raśmīn hayānāṃ jagrāha raukmai rathaśatairvṛtaḥ  || 10.01.030 ||
catuḥśataṃ pāribarhaṃ gajānāṃ hemamālinām  |
aśvānāmayutaṃ sārdhaṃ rathānāṃ ca triṣaṭśatam  || 10.01.031 ||
dāsīnāṃ sukumārīṇāṃ dve śate samalaṅkṛte  |
duhitre devakaḥ prādādyāne duhitṛvatsalaḥ  || 10.01.032 ||
śaṅkhatūryamṛdaṅgāśca nedurdundubhayaḥ samam  |
prayāṇaprakrame tāta varavadhvoḥ sumaṅgalam  || 10.01.033 ||
pathi pragrahiṇaṃ kaṃsamābhāṣyāhāśarīravāk |
asyāstvāmaṣṭamo garbho hantā yāṃ vahase'budha  || 10.01.034 ||
ityuktaḥ sa khalaḥ pāpo bhojānāṃ kulapāṃsanaḥ  |
bhaginīṃ hantumārabdhaṃ khaḍgapāṇiḥ kace'grahīt || 10.01.035 ||
taṃ jugupsitakarmāṇaṃ nṛśaṃsaṃ nirapatrapam  |
vasudevo mahābhāga uvāca parisāntvayan  || 10.01.036 ||
10.01.037|0 śrīvasudeva uvāca
ślāghanīyaguṇaḥ śūrairbhavān bhojayaśaskaraḥ  |
sa kathaṃ bhaginīṃ hanyātstriyamudvāhaparvaṇi  || 10.01.037 ||
mṛtyurjanmavatāṃ vīra dehena saha jāyate  |
adya vābdaśatānte vā mṛtyurvai prāṇināṃ dhruvaḥ  || 10.01.038 ||
dehe pañcatvamāpanne dehī karmānugo'vaśaḥ  |
dehāntaramanuprāpya prāktanaṃ tyajate vapuḥ  || 10.01.039 ||
vrajaṃstiṣṭhan padaikena yathaivaikena gacchati  |
yathā tṛṇajalaukaivaṃ dehī karmagatiṃ gataḥ  || 10.01.040 ||
svapne yathā paśyati dehamīdṛśaṃ manorathenābhiniviṣṭacetanaḥ  |
dṛṣṭaśrutābhyāṃ manasānucintayan prapadyate tatkimapi hyapasmṛtiḥ  || 10.01.041 ||
yato yato dhāvati daivacoditaṃ mano vikārātmakamāpa pañcasu  |
guṇeṣu māyārociteṣu dehyasau prapadyamānaḥ saha tena jāyate  || 10.01.042 ||
jyotiryathaivodakapārthiveṣvadaḥ   samīravegānugataṃ vibhāvyate  |
evaṃ svamāyāraciteṣvasau pumān   guṇeṣu rāgānugato vimuhyati  || 10.01.043 ||*
tasmānna kasyaciddrohamācaretsa tathāvidhaḥ  |
ātmanaḥ kṣemamanvicchan drogdhurvai parato bhayam  || 10.01.044 ||
eṣā tavānujā bālā kṛpaṇā putrikopamā  |
hantuṃ nārhasi kalyāṇīmimāṃ tvaṃ dīnavatsalaḥ  || 10.01.045 ||
10.01.046|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃ sa sāmabhirbhedairbodhyamāno'pi dāruṇaḥ  |
na nyavartata kauravya puruṣādānanuvrataḥ  || 10.01.046 ||
nirbandhaṃ tasya taṃ jñātvā vicintyānakadundubhiḥ  |
prāptaṃ kālaṃ prativyoḍhumidaṃ tatrānvapadyata  || 10.01.047 ||
mṛtyurbuddhimatāpohyo yāvadbuddhibalodayam  |
yadyasau na nivarteta nāparādho'sti dehinaḥ  || 10.01.048 ||
pradāya mṛtyave putrānmocaye kṛpaṇāmimām  |
sutā me yadi jāyeranmṛtyurvā na mriyeta cet || 10.01.049 ||
viparyayo vā kiṃ na syādgatirdhāturduratyayā  |
upasthito nivarteta nivṛttaḥ punarāpatet || 10.01.050 ||
agneryathā dāruviyogayogayoradṛṣṭato'nyanna nimittamasti  |
evaṃ hi jantorapi durvibhāvyaḥ śarīrasaṃyogaviyogahetuḥ  || 10.01.051 ||
evaṃ vimṛśya taṃ pāpaṃ yāvadātmanidarśanam  |
pūjayāmāsa vai śaurirbahumānapuraḥsaram  || 10.01.052 ||
prasannavadanāmbhojo nṛśaṃsaṃ nirapatrapam  |
manasā dūyamānena vihasannidamabravīt || 10.01.053 ||
10.01.054|0 śrīvasudeva uvāca
na hyasyāste bhayaṃ saumya yadvai sāhāśarīravāk |
putrān samarpayiṣye'syā yataste bhayamutthitam  || 10.01.054 ||
10.01.055|0 śrīśuka uvāca
svasurvadhānnivavṛte kaṃsastadvākyasāravit |
vasudevo'pi taṃ prītaḥ praśasya prāviśadgṛham  || 10.01.055 ||
atha kāla upāvṛtte devakī sarvadevatā  |
putrān prasuṣuve cāṣṭau kanyāṃ caivānuvatsaram  || 10.01.056 ||
kīrtimantaṃ prathamajaṃ kaṃsāyānakadundubhiḥ  |
arpayāmāsa kṛcchreṇa so'nṛtādativihvalaḥ  || 10.01.057 ||
kiṃ duḥsahaṃ nu sādhūnāṃ viduṣāṃ kimapekṣitam  |
kimakāryaṃ kadaryāṇāṃ dustyajaṃ kiṃ dhṛtātmanām  || 10.01.058 ||
dṛṣṭvā samatvaṃ tacchaureḥ satye caiva vyavasthitim  |
kaṃsastuṣṭamanā rājan prahasannidamabravīt || 10.01.059 ||
pratiyātu kumāro'yaṃ na hyasmādasti me bhayam  |
aṣṭamādyuvayorgarbhānmṛtyurme vihitaḥ kila  || 10.01.060 ||
tatheti sutamādāya yayāvānakadundubhiḥ  |
nābhyanandata tadvākyamasato'vijitātmanaḥ  || 10.01.061 ||
nandādyā ye vraje gopā yāścāmīṣāṃ ca yoṣitaḥ  |
vṛṣṇayo vasudevādyā devakyādyā yadustriyaḥ  || 10.01.062 ||
sarve vai devatāprāyā ubhayorapi bhārata  |
jñātayo bandhusuhṛdo ye ca kaṃsamanuvratāḥ  || 10.01.063 ||
etatkaṃsāya bhagavāñchaśaṃsābhyetya nāradaḥ  |
bhūmerbhārāyamāṇānāṃ daityānāṃ ca vadhodyamam  || 10.01.064 ||
ṛṣervinirgame kaṃso yadūnmatvā surāniti  |
devakyā garbhasambhūtaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca svavadhaṃ prati  || 10.01.065 ||
devakīṃ vasudevaṃ ca nigṛhya nigaḍairgṛhe  |
jātaṃ jātamahan putraṃ tayorajanaśaṅkayā  || 10.01.066 ||
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhrātṝn sarvāṃśca suhṛdastathā  |
ghnanti hyasutṛpo lubdhā rājānaḥ prāyaśo bhuvi  || 10.01.067 ||
ātmānamiha sañjātaṃ jānan prāgviṣṇunā hatam  |
mahāsuraṃ kālanemiṃ yadubhiḥ sa vyarudhyata  || 10.01.068 ||
ugrasenaṃ ca pitaraṃ yadubhojāndhakādhipam  |
svayaṃ nigṛhya bubhuje śūrasenānmahābalaḥ  || 10.01.069 ||
10.02.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
pralambabakacāṇūra tṛṇāvartamahāśanaiḥ  |
muṣṭikāriṣṭadvivida pūtanākeśīdhenukaiḥ  || 10.02.001 ||
anyaiścāsurabhūpālairbāṇabhaumādibhiryutaḥ  |
yadūnāṃ kadanaṃ cakre balī māgadhasaṃśrayaḥ  || 10.02.002 ||
te pīḍitā niviviśuḥ kurupañcālakekayān  |
śālvān vidarbhānniṣadhān videhān kośalānapi  || 10.02.003 ||
eke tamanurundhānā jñātayaḥ paryupāsate  |
hateṣu ṣaṭsu bāleṣu devakyā augraseninā  || 10.02.004 ||
saptamo vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma yamanantaṃ pracakṣate  |
garbho babhūva devakyā harṣaśokavivardhanaḥ  || 10.02.005 ||
bhagavānapi viśvātmā viditvā kaṃsajaṃ bhayam  |
yadūnāṃ nijanāthānāṃ yogamāyāṃ samādiśat || 10.02.006 ||
gaccha devi vrajaṃ bhadre gopagobhiralaṅkṛtam  |
rohiṇī vasudevasya bhāryāste nandagokule  |
anyāśca kaṃsasaṃvignā vivareṣu vasanti hi  || 10.02.007 ||
devakyā jaṭhare garbhaṃ śeṣākhyaṃ dhāma māmakam  |
tatsannikṛṣya rohiṇyā udare sanniveśaya  || 10.02.008 ||
athāhamaṃśabhāgena devakyāḥ putratāṃ śubhe  |
prāpsyāmi tvaṃ yaśodāyāṃ nandapatnyāṃ bhaviṣyasi  || 10.02.009 ||
arciṣyanti manuṣyāstvāṃ sarvakāmavareśvarīm  |
dhūpopahārabalibhiḥ sarvakāmavarapradām  || 10.02.010 ||
nāmadheyāni kurvanti sthānāni ca narā bhuvi  |
durgeti bhadrakālīti vijayā vaiṣṇavīti ca  || 10.02.011 ||
kumudā caṇḍikā kṛṣṇā mādhavī kanyaketi ca  |
māyā nārāyaṇīśānī śāradetyambiketi ca  || 10.02.012 ||
garbhasaṅkarṣaṇāttaṃ vai prāhuḥ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ bhuvi  |
rāmeti lokaramaṇādbalabhadraṃ balocchrayāt || 10.02.013 ||
sandiṣṭaivaṃ bhagavatā tathetyomiti tadvacaḥ  |
pratigṛhya parikramya gāṃ gatā tattathākarot || 10.02.014 ||
garbhe praṇīte devakyā rohiṇīṃ yoganidrayā  |
aho visraṃsito garbha iti paurā vicukruśuḥ  || 10.02.015 ||
bhagavānapi viśvātmā bhaktānāmabhayaṅkaraḥ  |
āviveśāṃśabhāgena mana ānakadundubheḥ  || 10.02.016 ||
sa bibhratpauruṣaṃ dhāma bhrājamāno yathā raviḥ  |
durāsado'tidurdharṣo bhūtānāṃ sambabhūva ha  || 10.02.017 ||
tato jaganmaṅgalamacyutāṃśaṃ samāhitaṃ śūrasutena devī  |
dadhāra sarvātmakamātmabhūtaṃ kāṣṭhā yathānandakaraṃ manastaḥ  || 10.02.018 ||
sā devakī sarvajagannivāsa nivāsabhūtā nitarāṃ na reje  |
bhojendragehe'gniśikheva ruddhā sarasvatī jñānakhale yathā satī  || 10.02.019 ||
tāṃ vīkṣya kaṃsaḥ prabhayājitāntarāṃ   virocayantīṃ bhavanaṃ śucismitām  |
āhaiṣa me prāṇaharo harirguhāṃ   dhruvaṃ śrito yanna pureyamīdṛśī  || 10.02.020 ||*
kimadya tasmin karaṇīyamāśu me yadarthatantro na vihanti vikramam  |
striyāḥ svasurgurumatyā vadho'yaṃ yaśaḥ śriyaṃ hantyanukālamāyuḥ  || 10.02.021 ||
sa eṣa jīvan khalu sampareto varteta yo'tyantanṛśaṃsitena  |
dehe mṛte taṃ manujāḥ śapanti gantā tamo'ndhaṃ tanumānino dhruvam  || 10.02.022 ||
iti ghoratamādbhāvātsannivṛttaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ  |
āste pratīkṣaṃstajjanma harervairānubandhakṛt || 10.02.023 ||
āsīnaḥ saṃviśaṃstiṣṭhan bhuñjānaḥ paryaṭanmahīm  |
cintayāno hṛṣīkeśamapaśyattanmayaṃ jagat || 10.02.024 ||
brahmā bhavaśca tatraitya munibhirnāradādibhiḥ  |
devaiḥ sānucaraiḥ sākaṃ gīrbhirvṛṣaṇamaiḍayan  || 10.02.025 ||
satyavrataṃ satyaparaṃ trisatyaṃ   satyasya yoniṃ nihitaṃ ca satye  |
satyasya satyamṛtasatyanetraṃ   satyātmakaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ  || 10.02.026 ||*
ekāyano'sau dviphalastrimūlaścatūrasaḥ pañcavidhaḥ ṣaḍātmā  |
saptatvagaṣṭaviṭapo navākṣo daśacchadī dvikhago hyādivṛkṣaḥ  || 10.02.027 ||
tvameka evāsya sataḥ prasūtistvaṃ sannidhānaṃ tvamanugrahaśca  |
tvanmāyayā saṃvṛtacetasastvāṃ paśyanti nānā na vipaścito ye  || 10.02.028 ||
bibharṣi rūpāṇyavabodha ātmā kṣemāya lokasya carācarasya  |
sattvopapannāni sukhāvahāni satāmabhadrāṇi muhuḥ khalānām  || 10.02.029 ||
tvayyambujākṣākhilasattvadhāmni samādhināveśitacetasaike  |
tvatpādapotena mahatkṛtena kurvanti govatsapadaṃ bhavābdhim  || 10.02.030 ||
svayaṃ samuttīrya sudustaraṃ dyuman   bhavārṇavaṃ bhīmamadabhrasauhṛdāḥ  |
bhavatpadāmbhoruhanāvamatra te   nidhāya yātāḥ sadanugraho bhavān  || 10.02.031 ||*
ye'nye'ravindākṣa vimuktamāninas  tvayyastabhāvādaviśuddhabuddhayaḥ  |
āruhya kṛcchreṇa paraṃ padaṃ tataḥ   patantyadho'nādṛtayuṣmadaṅghrayaḥ  || 10.02.032 ||*
tathā na te mādhava tāvakāḥ kvacidbhraśyanti mārgāttvayi baddhasauhṛdāḥ  |
tvayābhiguptā vicaranti nirbhayā vināyakānīkapamūrdhasu prabho  || 10.02.033 ||
sattvaṃ viśuddhaṃ śrayate bhavān sthitau   śarīriṇāṃ śreyaupāyanaṃ vapuḥ  |
vedakriyāyogatapaḥsamādhibhis  tavārhaṇaṃ yena janaḥ samīhate  || 10.02.034 ||*
sattvaṃ na ceddhātaridaṃ nijaṃ bhaved  vijñānamajñānabhidāpamārjanam  |
guṇaprakāśairanumīyate bhavān   prakāśate yasya ca yena vā guṇaḥ  || 10.02.035 ||*
na nāmarūpe guṇajanmakarmabhirnirūpitavye tava tasya sākṣiṇaḥ  |
manovacobhyāmanumeyavartmano deva kriyāyāṃ pratiyantyathāpi hi  || 10.02.036 ||
śṛṇvan gṛṇan saṃsmarayaṃśca cintayan   nāmāni rūpāṇi ca maṅgalāni te  |
kriyāsu yastvaccaraṇāravindayor  āviṣṭacetā na bhavāya kalpate  || 10.02.037 ||*
diṣṭyā hare'syā bhavataḥ pado bhuvo   bhāro'panītastava janmaneśituḥ  |
diṣṭyāṅkitāṃ tvatpadakaiḥ suśobhanair  drakṣyāma gāṃ dyāṃ ca tavānukampitām  || 10.02.038 ||*
na te'bhavasyeśa bhavasya kāraṇaṃ vinā vinodaṃ bata tarkayāmahe  |
bhavo nirodhaḥ sthitirapyavidyayā kṛtā yatastvayyabhayāśrayātmani  || 10.02.039 ||
matsyāśvakacchapanṛsiṃhavarāhahaṃsa   rājanyavipravibudheṣu kṛtāvatāraḥ  |
tvaṃ pāsi nastribhuvanaṃ ca yathādhuneśa   bhāraṃ bhuvo hara yadūttama vandanaṃ te  || 10.02.040 ||*
diṣṭyāmba te kukṣigataḥ paraḥ pumān   aṃśena sākṣādbhagavān bhavāya naḥ  |
mābhūdbhayaṃ bhojapatermumūrṣor  goptā yadūnāṃ bhavitā tavātmajaḥ  || 10.02.041 ||*
10.02.042|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ityabhiṣṭūya puruṣaṃ yadrūpamanidaṃ yathā  |
brahmeśānau purodhāya devāḥ pratiyayurdivam  || 10.02.042 ||
10.03.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
atha sarvaguṇopetaḥ kālaḥ paramaśobhanaḥ  |
yarhyevājanajanmarkṣaṃ śāntarkṣagrahatārakam  || 10.03.001 ||
diśaḥ prasedurgaganaṃ nirmaloḍugaṇodayam  |
mahī maṅgalabhūyiṣṭha puragrāmavrajākarā  || 10.03.002 ||
nadyaḥ prasannasalilā hradā jalaruhaśriyaḥ  |
dvijālikulasannāda stavakā vanarājayaḥ  || 10.03.003 ||
vavau vāyuḥ sukhasparśaḥ puṇyagandhavahaḥ śuciḥ  |
agnayaśca dvijātīnāṃ śāntāstatra samindhata  || 10.03.004 ||
manāṃsyāsan prasannāni sādhūnāmasuradruhām  |
jāyamāne'jane tasminnedurdundubhayaḥ samam  || 10.03.005 ||
jaguḥ kinnaragandharvāstuṣṭuvuḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ  |
vidyādharyaśca nanṛturapsarobhiḥ samaṃ mudā  || 10.03.006 ||
mumucurmunayo devāḥ sumanāṃsi mudānvitāḥ  |
mandaṃ mandaṃ jaladharā jagarjuranusāgaram  || 10.03.007 ||
niśīthe tamaudbhūte jāyamāne janārdane  |
devakyāṃ devarūpiṇyāṃ viṣṇuḥ sarvaguhāśayaḥ  |
āvirāsīdyathā prācyāṃ diśīnduriva puṣkalaḥ  || 10.03.008 ||
tamadbhutaṃ bālakamambujekṣaṇaṃ caturbhujaṃ śaṅkhagadādyudāyudham  |
śrīvatsalakṣmaṃ galaśobhikaustubhaṃ pītāmbaraṃ sāndrapayodasaubhagam  || 10.03.009 ||
mahārhavaidūryakirīṭakuṇḍala tviṣā pariṣvaktasahasrakuntalam  |
uddāmakāñcyaṅgadakaṅkaṇādibhirvirocamānaṃ vasudeva aikṣata  || 10.03.010 ||
sa vismayotphullavilocano hariṃ sutaṃ vilokyānakadundubhistadā  |
kṛṣṇāvatārotsavasambhramo'spṛśanmudā dvijebhyo'yutamāpluto gavām  || 10.03.011 ||
athainamastaudavadhārya pūruṣaṃ paraṃ natāṅgaḥ kṛtadhīḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ  |
svarociṣā bhārata sūtikāgṛhaṃ virocayantaṃ gatabhīḥ prabhāvavit || 10.03.012 ||
10.03.013|0 śrīvasudeva uvāca
vidito'si bhavān sākṣātpuruṣaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ  |
kevalānubhavānanda svarūpaḥ sarvabuddhidṛk || 10.03.013 ||
sa eva svaprakṛtyedaṃ sṛṣṭvāgre triguṇātmakam  |
tadanu tvaṃ hyapraviṣṭaḥ praviṣṭa iva bhāvyase  || 10.03.014 ||
yatheme'vikṛtā bhāvāstathā te vikṛtaiḥ saha  |
nānāvīryāḥ pṛthagbhūtā virājaṃ janayanti hi  || 10.03.015 ||
sannipatya samutpādya dṛśyante'nugatā iva  |
prāgeva vidyamānatvānna teṣāmiha sambhavaḥ  || 10.03.016 ||
evaṃ bhavān buddhyanumeyalakṣaṇairgrāhyairguṇaiḥ sannapi tadguṇāgrahaḥ  |
anāvṛtatvādbahirantaraṃ na te sarvasya sarvātmana ātmavastunaḥ  || 10.03.017 ||
ya ātmano dṛśyaguṇeṣu sanniti vyavasyate svavyatirekato'budhaḥ  |
vinānuvādaṃ na ca tanmanīṣitaṃ samyagyatastyaktamupādadatpumān  || 10.03.018 ||
tvatto'sya janmasthitisaṃyamān vibho   vadantyanīhādaguṇādavikriyāt |
tvayīśvare brahmaṇi no virudhyate   tvadāśrayatvādupacaryate guṇaiḥ  || 10.03.019 ||*
sa tvaṃ trilokasthitaye svamāyayā   bibharṣi śuklaṃ khalu varṇamātmanaḥ  |
sargāya raktaṃ rajasopabṛṃhitaṃ   kṛṣṇaṃ ca varṇaṃ tamasā janātyaye  || 10.03.020 ||*
tvamasya lokasya vibho rirakṣiṣurgṛhe'vatīrṇo'si mamākhileśvara  |
rājanyasaṃjñāsurakoṭiyūthapairnirvyūhyamānā nihaniṣyase camūḥ  || 10.03.021 ||
ayaṃ tvasabhyastava janma nau gṛhe   śrutvāgrajāṃste nyavadhītsureśvara  |

10.04.028|0 śrīśuka uvāca

10.05.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
nandastvātmaja utpanne jātāhlādo mahāmanāḥ  |

na yatra śravaṇādīni rakṣoghnāni svakarmasu  |
kurvanti sātvatāṃ bharturyātudhānyaśca tatra hi  || 10.06.003 ||
sā khecaryekadotpatya pūtanā nandagokulam  |
yoṣitvā māyayātmānaṃ prāviśatkāmacāriṇī  || 10.06.004 ||
tāṃ keśabandhavyatiṣaktamallikāṃ   bṛhannitambastanakṛcchramadhyamām  |
suvāsasaṃ kalpitakarṇabhūṣaṇa   tviṣollasatkuntalamaṇḍitānanām  || 10.06.005 ||*
valgusmitāpāṅgavisargavīkṣitair  mano harantīṃ vanitāṃ vrajaukasām  |
amaṃsatāmbhojakareṇa rūpiṇīṃ   gopyaḥ śriyaṃ draṣṭumivāgatāṃ patim  || 10.06.006 ||*
bālagrahastatra vicinvatī śiśūn yadṛcchayā nandagṛhe'sadantakam  |
bālaṃ praticchannanijorutejasaṃ dadarśa talpe'gnimivāhitaṃ bhasi  || 10.06.007 ||
vibudhya tāṃ bālakamārikāgrahaṃ carācarātmā sa nimīlitekṣaṇaḥ  |
anantamāropayadaṅkamantakaṃ yathoragaṃ suptamabuddhirajjudhīḥ  || 10.06.008 ||
tāṃ tīkṣṇacittāmativāmaceṣṭitāṃ vīkṣyāntarā koṣaparicchadāsivat |
varastriyaṃ tatprabhayā ca dharṣite nirīkṣyamāṇe jananī hyatiṣṭhatām  || 10.06.009 ||
tasmin stanaṃ durjaravīryamulbaṇaṃ   ghorāṅkamādāya śiśordadāvatha  |
gāḍhaṃ karābhyāṃ bhagavān prapīḍya tat  prāṇaiḥ samaṃ roṣasamanvito'pibat || 10.06.010 ||*
sā muñca muñcālamiti prabhāṣiṇī niṣpīḍyamānākhilajīvamarmaṇi  |
vivṛtya netre caraṇau bhujau muhuḥ prasvinnagātrā kṣipatī ruroda ha  || 10.06.011 ||
tasyāḥ svanenātigabhīraraṃhasā sādrirmahī dyauśca cacāla sagrahā  |
rasā diśaśca pratinedire janāḥ petuḥ kṣitau vajranipātaśaṅkayā  || 10.06.012 ||
niśācarītthaṃ vyathitastanā vyasur  vyādāya keśāṃścaraṇau bhujāvapi  |
prasārya goṣṭhe nijarūpamāsthitā   vajrāhato vṛtra ivāpatannṛpa  || 10.06.013 ||*
patamāno'pi taddehastrigavyūtyantaradrumān  |
cūrṇayāmāsa rājendra mahadāsīttadadbhutam  || 10.06.014 ||
īṣāmātrogradaṃṣṭrāsyaṃ girikandaranāsikam  |
gaṇḍaśailastanaṃ raudraṃ prakīrṇāruṇamūrdhajam  || 10.06.015 ||
andhakūpagabhīrākṣaṃ pulinārohabhīṣaṇam  |
baddhasetubhujorvaṅghri śūnyatoyahradodaram  || 10.06.016 ||
santatrasuḥ sma tadvīkṣya gopā gopyaḥ kalevaram  |
pūrvaṃ tu tanniḥsvanita bhinnahṛtkarṇamastakāḥ  || 10.06.017 ||
bālaṃ ca tasyā urasi krīḍantamakutobhayam  |
gopyastūrṇaṃ samabhyetya jagṛhurjātasambhramāḥ  || 10.06.018 ||
yaśodārohiṇībhyāṃ tāḥ samaṃ bālasya sarvataḥ  |
rakṣāṃ vidadhire samyaggopucchabhramaṇādibhiḥ  || 10.06.019 ||
gomūtreṇa snāpayitvā punargorajasārbhakam  |
rakṣāṃ cakruśca śakṛtā dvādaśāṅgeṣu nāmabhiḥ  || 10.06.020 ||
gopyaḥ saṃspṛṣṭasalilā aṅgeṣu karayoḥ pṛthak |
nyasyātmanyatha bālasya bījanyāsamakurvata  || 10.06.021 ||
avyādajo'ṅghri maṇimāṃstava jānvathorū   yajño'cyutaḥ kaṭitaṭaṃ jaṭharaṃ hayāsyaḥ  |
hṛtkeśavastvadura īśa inastu kaṇṭhaṃ   viṣṇurbhujaṃ mukhamurukrama īśvaraḥ kam  || 10.06.022 ||*
cakryagrataḥ sahagado harirastu paścāt  tvatpārśvayordhanurasī madhuhājanaśca  |
koṇeṣu śaṅkha urugāya uparyupendras  tārkṣyaḥ kṣitau haladharaḥ puruṣaḥ samantāt || 10.06.023 ||*
indriyāṇi hṛṣīkeśaḥ prāṇānnārāyaṇo'vatu  |
śvetadvīpapatiścittaṃ mano yogeśvaro'vatu  || 10.06.024 ||
pṛśnigarbhastu te buddhimātmānaṃ bhagavān paraḥ  |
krīḍantaṃ pātu govindaḥ śayānaṃ pātu mādhavaḥ  || 10.06.025 ||
vrajantamavyādvaikuṇṭha āsīnaṃ tvāṃ śriyaḥ patiḥ  |
bhuñjānaṃ yajñabhukpātu sarvagrahabhayaṅkaraḥ  || 10.06.026 ||
ḍākinyo yātudhānyaśca kuṣmāṇḍā ye'rbhakagrahāḥ  |
bhūtapretapiśācāśca yakṣarakṣovināyakāḥ  || 10.06.027 ||
koṭarā revatī jyeṣṭhā pūtanā mātṛkādayaḥ  |
unmādā ye hyapasmārā dehaprāṇendriyadruhaḥ  || 10.06.028 ||
svapnadṛṣṭā mahotpātā vṛddhā bālagrahāśca ye  |
sarve naśyantu te viṣṇornāmagrahaṇabhīravaḥ  || 10.06.029 ||
10.06.030|0 śrīśuka uvāca
iti praṇayabaddhābhirgopībhiḥ kṛtarakṣaṇam  |
pāyayitvā stanaṃ mātā sannyaveśayadātmajam  || 10.06.030 ||
tāvannandādayo gopā mathurāyā vrajaṃ gatāḥ  |
vilokya pūtanādehaṃ babhūvurativismitāḥ  || 10.06.031 ||
nūnaṃ batarṣiḥ sañjāto yogeśo vā samāsa saḥ  |
sa eva dṛṣṭo hyutpāto yadāhānakadundubhiḥ  || 10.06.032 ||
kalevaraṃ paraśubhiśchittvā tatte vrajaukasaḥ  |
dūre kṣiptvāvayavaśo nyadahan kāṣṭhaveṣṭitam  || 10.06.033 ||
dahyamānasya dehasya dhūmaścāgurusaurabhaḥ  |
utthitaḥ kṛṣṇanirbhukta sapadyāhatapāpmanaḥ  || 10.06.034 ||
pūtanā lokabālaghnī rākṣasī rudhirāśanā  |
jighāṃsayāpi haraye stanaṃ dattvāpa sadgatim  || 10.06.035 ||
kiṃ punaḥ śraddhayā bhaktyā kṛṣṇāya paramātmane  |
yacchan priyatamaṃ kiṃ nu raktāstanmātaro yathā  || 10.06.036 ||
padbhyāṃ bhaktahṛdisthābhyāṃ vandyābhyāṃ lokavanditaiḥ  |
aṅgaṃ yasyāḥ samākramya bhagavānapi tatstanam  || 10.06.037 ||
yātudhānyapi sā svargamavāpa jananīgatim  |
kṛṣṇabhuktastanakṣīrāḥ kimu gāvo'numātaraḥ  || 10.06.038 ||
payāṃsi yāsāmapibatputrasnehasnutānyalam  |
bhagavān devakīputraḥ kaivalyādyakhilapradaḥ  || 10.06.039 ||
tāsāmavirataṃ kṛṣṇe kurvatīnāṃ sutekṣaṇam  |
na punaḥ kalpate rājan saṃsāro'jñānasambhavaḥ  || 10.06.040 ||
kaṭadhūmasya saurabhyamavaghrāya vrajaukasaḥ  |
kimidaṃ kuta eveti vadanto vrajamāyayuḥ  || 10.06.041 ||
te tatra varṇitaṃ gopaiḥ pūtanāgamanādikam  |
śrutvā tannidhanaṃ svasti śiśoścāsan suvismitāḥ  || 10.06.042 ||
nandaḥ svaputramādāya pretyāgatamudāradhīḥ  |
mūrdhnyupāghrāya paramāṃ mudaṃ lebhe kurūdvaha  || 10.06.043 ||
ya etatpūtanāmokṣaṃ kṛṣṇasyārbhakamadbhutam  |
śṛṇuyācchraddhayā martyo govinde labhate ratim  || 10.06.044 ||
10.07.001|0 śrīrājovāca
yena yenāvatāreṇa bhagavān harirīśvaraḥ  |
karoti karṇaramyāṇi manojñāni ca naḥ prabho  || 10.07.001 ||
yacchṛṇvato'paityaratirvitṛṣṇā sattvaṃ ca śuddhyatyacireṇa puṃsaḥ  |
bhaktirharau tatpuruṣe ca sakhyaṃ tadeva hāraṃ vada manyase cet || 10.07.002 ||
athānyadapi kṛṣṇasya tokācaritamadbhutam  |
mānuṣaṃ lokamāsādya tajjātimanurundhataḥ  || 10.07.003 ||
10.07.004|0 śrīśuka uvāca
kadācidautthānikakautukāplave janmarkṣayoge samavetayoṣitām  |
vāditragītadvijamantravācakaiścakāra sūnorabhiṣecanaṃ satī  || 10.07.004 ||
nandasya patnī kṛtamajjanādikaṃ vipraiḥ kṛtasvastyayanaṃ supūjitaiḥ  |
annādyavāsaḥsragabhīṣṭadhenubhiḥ sañjātanidrākṣamaśīśayacchanaiḥ  || 10.07.005 ||
autthānikautsukyamanā manasvinī samāgatān pūjayatī vrajaukasaḥ  |
naivāśṛṇodvai ruditaṃ sutasya sā rudan stanārthī caraṇāvudakṣipat || 10.07.006 ||
adhaḥśayānasya śiśorano'lpaka pravālamṛdvaṅghrihataṃ vyavartata  |
vidhvastanānārasakupyabhājanaṃ vyatyastacakrākṣavibhinnakūbaram  || 10.07.007 ||
dṛṣṭvā yaśodāpramukhā vrajastriya   autthānike karmaṇi yāḥ samāgatāḥ  |
nandādayaścādbhutadarśanākulāḥ   kathaṃ svayaṃ vai śakaṭaṃ viparyagāt || 10.07.008 ||*
ūcuravyavasitamatīn gopān gopīśca bālakāḥ  |
rudatānena pādena kṣiptametanna saṃśayaḥ  || 10.07.009 ||
na te śraddadhire gopā bālabhāṣitamityuta  |
aprameyaṃ balaṃ tasya bālakasya na te viduḥ  || 10.07.010 ||
rudantaṃ sutamādāya yaśodā grahaśaṅkitā  |
kṛtasvastyayanaṃ vipraiḥ sūktaiḥ stanamapāyayat || 10.07.011 ||
pūrvavatsthāpitaṃ gopairbalibhiḥ saparicchadam  |
viprā hutvārcayāṃ cakrurdadhyakṣatakuśāmbubhiḥ  || 10.07.012 ||
ye'sūyānṛtadambherṣā hiṃsāmānavivarjitāḥ  |
na teṣāṃ satyaśīlānāmāśiṣo viphalāḥ kṛtāḥ  || 10.07.013 ||
iti bālakamādāya sāmargyajurupākṛtaiḥ  |
jalaiḥ pavitrauṣadhibhirabhiṣicya dvijottamaiḥ  || 10.07.014 ||
vācayitvā svastyayanaṃ nandagopaḥ samāhitaḥ  |
hutvā cāgniṃ dvijātibhyaḥ prādādannaṃ mahāguṇam  || 10.07.015 ||
gāvaḥ sarvaguṇopetā vāsaḥsragrukmamālinīḥ  |
ātmajābhyudayārthāya prādātte cānvayuñjata  || 10.07.016 ||
viprā mantravido yuktāstairyāḥ proktāstathāśiṣaḥ  |
tā niṣphalā bhaviṣyanti na kadācidapi sphuṭam  || 10.07.017 ||
ekadārohamārūḍhaṃ lālayantī sutaṃ satī  |
garimāṇaṃ śiśorvoḍhuṃ na sehe girikūṭavat || 10.07.018 ||
bhūmau nidhāya taṃ gopī vismitā bhārapīḍitā  |
mahāpuruṣamādadhyau jagatāmāsa karmasu  || 10.07.019 ||
daityo nāmnā tṛṇāvartaḥ kaṃsabhṛtyaḥ praṇoditaḥ  |
cakravātasvarūpeṇa jahārāsīnamarbhakam  || 10.07.020 ||
gokulaṃ sarvamāvṛṇvanmuṣṇaṃścakṣūṃṣi reṇubhiḥ  |
īrayan sumahāghora śabdena pradiśo diśaḥ  || 10.07.021 ||
muhūrtamabhavadgoṣṭhaṃ rajasā tamasāvṛtam  |
sutaṃ yaśodā nāpaśyattasminnyastavatī yataḥ  || 10.07.022 ||
nāpaśyatkaścanātmānaṃ paraṃ cāpi vimohitaḥ  |
tṛṇāvartanisṛṣṭābhiḥ śarkarābhirupadrutaḥ  || 10.07.023 ||
iti kharapavanacakrapāṃśuvarṣe sutapadavīmabalāvilakṣya mātā  |
atikaruṇamanusmarantyaśocadbhuvi patitā mṛtavatsakā yathā gauḥ  || 10.07.024 ||
ruditamanuniśamya tatra gopyo bhṛśamanutaptadhiyo'śrupūrṇamukhyaḥ  |
ruruduranupalabhya nandasūnuṃ pavana upāratapāṃśuvarṣavege  || 10.07.025 ||
tṛṇāvartaḥ śāntarayo vātyārūpadharo haran  |
kṛṣṇaṃ nabhogato gantuṃ nāśaknodbhūribhārabhṛt || 10.07.026 ||
tamaśmānaṃ manyamāna ātmano gurumattayā  |
gale gṛhīta utsraṣṭuṃ nāśaknodadbhutārbhakam  || 10.07.027 ||
galagrahaṇaniśceṣṭo daityo nirgatalocanaḥ  |
avyaktarāvo nyapatatsahabālo vyasurvraje  || 10.07.028 ||
tamantarikṣātpatitaṃ śilāyāṃ viśīrṇasarvāvayavaṃ karālam  |
puraṃ yathā rudraśareṇa viddhaṃ striyo rudatyo dadṛśuḥ sametāḥ  || 10.07.029 ||
prādāya mātre pratihṛtya vismitāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ ca tasyorasi lambamānam  |
taṃ svastimantaṃ puruṣādanītaṃ vihāyasā mṛtyumukhātpramuktam  |
gopyaśca gopāḥ kila nandamukhyā labdhvā punaḥ prāpuratīva modam  || 10.07.030 ||
aho batātyadbhutameṣa rakṣasā bālo nivṛttiṃ gamito'bhyagātpunaḥ  |
hiṃsraḥ svapāpena vihiṃsitaḥ khalaḥ sādhuḥ samatvena bhayādvimucyate  || 10.07.031 ||
kiṃ nastapaścīrṇamadhokṣajārcanaṃ   pūrteṣṭadattamuta bhūtasauhṛdam  |
yatsamparetaḥ punareva bālako   diṣṭyā svabandhūn praṇayannupasthitaḥ  || 10.07.032 ||*
dṛṣṭvādbhutāni bahuśo nandagopo bṛhadvane  |
vasudevavaco bhūyo mānayāmāsa vismitaḥ  || 10.07.033 ||
ekadārbhakamādāya svāṅkamāropya bhāminī  |
prasnutaṃ pāyayāmāsa stanaṃ snehapariplutā  || 10.07.034 ||
pītaprāyasya jananī sutasya rucirasmitam  |
mukhaṃ lālayatī rājañjṛmbhato dadṛśe idam  || 10.07.035 ||
khaṃ rodasī jyotiranīkamāśāḥ sūryenduvahniśvasanāmbudhīṃśca  |
dvīpānnagāṃstadduhitṝrvanāni bhūtāni yāni sthirajaṅgamāni  || 10.07.036 ||
sā vīkṣya viśvaṃ sahasā rājan sañjātavepathuḥ  |
sammīlya mṛgaśāvākṣī netre āsītsuvismitā  || 10.07.037 ||
10.08.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
gargaḥ purohito rājan yadūnāṃ sumahātapāḥ  |
vrajaṃ jagāma nandasya vasudevapracoditaḥ  || 10.08.001 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaprītaḥ pratyutthāya kṛtāñjaliḥ  |
ānarcādhokṣajadhiyā praṇipātapuraḥsaram  || 10.08.002 ||
sūpaviṣṭaṃ kṛtātithyaṃ girā sūnṛtayā munim  |
nandayitvābravīdbrahman pūrṇasya karavāma kim  || 10.08.003 ||
mahadvicalanaṃ nṝṇāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ dīnacetasām  |
niḥśreyasāya bhagavan kalpate nānyathā kvacit || 10.08.004 ||
jyotiṣāmayanaṃ sākṣādyattajjñānamatīndriyam  |
praṇītaṃ bhavatā yena pumān veda parāvaram  || 10.08.005 ||
tvaṃ hi brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ saṃskārān kartumarhasi  |
bālayoranayornṝṇāṃ janmanā brāhmaṇo guruḥ  || 10.08.006 ||
10.08.007|0 śrīgarga uvāca
yadūnāmahamācāryaḥ khyātaśca bhuvi sarvadā  |
sutaṃ mayā saṃskṛtaṃ te manyate devakīsutam  || 10.08.007 ||
kaṃsaḥ pāpamatiḥ sakhyaṃ tava cānakadundubheḥ  |
devakyā aṣṭamo garbho na strī bhavitumarhati  || 10.08.008 ||
iti sañcintayañchrutvā devakyā dārikāvacaḥ  |
api hantā gatāśaṅkastarhi tanno'nayo bhavet || 10.08.009 ||
10.08.010|0 śrīnanda uvāca
alakṣito'smin rahasi māmakairapi govraje  |
kuru dvijātisaṃskāraṃ svastivācanapūrvakam  || 10.08.010 ||
10.08.011|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃ samprārthito vipraḥ svacikīrṣitameva tat |
cakāra nāmakaraṇaṃ gūḍho rahasi bālayoḥ  || 10.08.011 ||
10.08.012|0 śrīgarga uvāca
ayaṃ hi rohiṇīputro ramayan suhṛdo guṇaiḥ  |
ākhyāsyate rāma iti balādhikyādbalaṃ viduḥ  |
yadūnāmapṛthagbhāvātsaṅkarṣaṇamuśantyapi  || 10.08.012 ||
āsan varṇāstrayo hyasya gṛhṇato'nuyugaṃ tanūḥ  |
śuklo raktastathā pīta idānīṃ kṛṣṇatāṃ gataḥ  || 10.08.013 ||
prāgayaṃ vasudevasya kvacijjātastavātmajaḥ  |
vāsudeva iti śrīmānabhijñāḥ sampracakṣate  || 10.08.014 ||
bahūni santi nāmāni rūpāṇi ca sutasya te  |
guṇakarmānurūpāṇi tānyahaṃ veda no janāḥ  || 10.08.015 ||
eṣa vaḥ śreya ādhāsyadgopagokulanandanaḥ  |
anena sarvadurgāṇi yūyamañjastariṣyatha  || 10.08.016 ||
purānena vrajapate sādhavo dasyupīḍitāḥ  |
arājake rakṣyamāṇā jigyurdasyūn samedhitāḥ  || 10.08.017 ||
ya etasminmahābhāgāḥ prītiṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ  |
nārayo'bhibhavantyetān viṣṇupakṣānivāsurāḥ  || 10.08.018 ||
tasmānnandātmajo'yaṃ te nārāyaṇasamo guṇaiḥ  |
śriyā kīrtyānubhāvena gopāyasva samāhitaḥ  || 10.08.019 ||
10.08.020|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ityātmānaṃ samādiśya garge ca svagṛhaṃ gate  |
nandaḥ pramudito mene ātmānaṃ pūrṇamāśiṣām  || 10.08.020 ||
kālena vrajatālpena gokule rāmakeśavau  |
jānubhyāṃ saha pāṇibhyāṃ riṅgamāṇau vijahratuḥ  || 10.08.021 ||
tāvaṅghriyugmamanukṛṣya sarīsṛpantau   ghoṣapraghoṣaruciraṃ vrajakardameṣu  |
tannādahṛṣṭamanasāvanusṛtya lokaṃ   mugdhaprabhītavadupeyaturanti mātroḥ  || 10.08.022 ||*
tanmātarau nijasutau ghṛṇayā snuvantyau   paṅkāṅgarāgarucirāvupagṛhya dorbhyām  |
dattvā stanaṃ prapibatoḥ sma mukhaṃ nirīkṣya   mugdhasmitālpadaśanaṃ yayatuḥ pramodam  || 10.08.023 ||*
yarhyaṅganādarśanīyakumāralīlāv  antarvraje tadabalāḥ pragṛhītapucchaiḥ  |
vatsairitastata ubhāvanukṛṣyamāṇau   prekṣantya ujjhitagṛhā jahṛṣurhasantyaḥ  || 10.08.024 ||*
śṛṅgyagnidaṃṣṭryasijaladvijakaṇṭakebhyaḥ   krīḍāparāvaticalau svasutau niṣeddhum  |
gṛhyāṇi kartumapi yatra na tajjananyau   śekāta āpaturalaṃ manaso'navasthām  || 10.08.025 ||*
kālenālpena rājarṣe rāmaḥ kṛṣṇaśca gokule  |
aghṛṣṭajānubhiḥ padbhirvicakramaturañjasā  || 10.08.026 ||
tatastu bhagavān kṛṣṇo vayasyairvrajabālakaiḥ  |
saharāmo vrajastrīṇāṃ cikrīḍe janayanmudam  || 10.08.027 ||
kṛṣṇasya gopyo ruciraṃ vīkṣya kaumāracāpalam  |
śṛṇvantyāḥ kila tanmāturiti hocuḥ samāgatāḥ  || 10.08.028 ||
