itthaṃ yaśodā tamaśeṣaśekharaṃ matvā sutaṃ snehanibaddhadhīrnṛpa  |
haste gṛhītvā saharāmamacyutaṃ nītvā svavāṭaṃ kṛtavatyathodayam  || 10.11.020 ||
10.11.021|0 śrīśuka uvāca
gopavṛddhā mahotpātānanubhūya bṛhadvane  |
nandādayaḥ samāgamya vrajakāryamamantrayan  || 10.11.021 ||
tatropānandanāmāha gopo jñānavayo'dhikaḥ  |
deśakālārthatattvajñaḥ priyakṛdrāmakṛṣṇayoḥ  || 10.11.022 ||
utthātavyamito'smābhirgokulasya hitaiṣibhiḥ  |
āyāntyatra mahotpātā bālānāṃ nāśahetavaḥ  || 10.11.023 ||
muktaḥ kathañcidrākṣasyā bālaghnyā bālako hyasau  |
hareranugrahānnūnamanaścopari nāpatat || 10.11.024 ||
cakravātena nīto'yaṃ daityena vipadaṃ viyat |
śilāyāṃ patitastatra paritrātaḥ sureśvaraiḥ  || 10.11.025 ||
yanna mriyeta drumayorantaraṃ prāpya bālakaḥ  |
asāvanyatamo vāpi tadapyacyutarakṣaṇam  || 10.11.026 ||
yāvadautpātiko'riṣṭo vrajaṃ nābhibhaveditaḥ  |
tāvadbālānupādāya yāsyāmo'nyatra sānugāḥ  || 10.11.027 ||
vanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ nāma paśavyaṃ navakānanam  |
gopagopīgavāṃ sevyaṃ puṇyādritṛṇavīrudham  || 10.11.028 ||
tattatrādyaiva yāsyāmaḥ śakaṭān yuṅkta mā ciram  |
godhanānyagrato yāntu bhavatāṃ yadi rocate  || 10.11.029 ||
tacchrutvaikadhiyo gopāḥ sādhu sādhviti vādinaḥ  |
vrajān svān svān samāyujya yayū rūḍhaparicchadāḥ  || 10.11.030 ||
vṛddhān bālān striyo rājan sarvopakaraṇāni ca  |
anaḥsvāropya gopālā yattā āttaśarāsanāḥ  || 10.11.031 ||
godhanāni puraskṛtya śṛṅgāṇyāpūrya sarvataḥ  |
tūryaghoṣeṇa mahatā yayuḥ sahapurohitāḥ  || 10.11.032 ||
gopyo rūḍharathā nūtna kucakuṅkumakāntayaḥ  |
kṛṣṇalīlā jaguḥ prītyā niṣkakaṇṭhyaḥ suvāsasaḥ  || 10.11.033 ||
tathā yaśodārohiṇyāvekaṃ śakaṭamāsthite  |
rejatuḥ kṛṣṇarāmābhyāṃ tatkathāśravaṇotsuke  || 10.11.034 ||
vṛndāvanaṃ sampraviśya sarvakālasukhāvaham  |
tatra cakrurvrajāvāsaṃ śakaṭairardhacandravat || 10.11.035 ||
vṛndāvanaṃ govardhanaṃ yamunāpulināni ca  |
vīkṣyāsīduttamā prītī rāmamādhavayornṛpa  || 10.11.036 ||
evaṃ vrajaukasāṃ prītiṃ yacchantau bālaceṣṭitaiḥ  |
kalavākyaiḥ svakālena vatsapālau babhūvatuḥ  || 10.11.037 ||
avidūre vrajabhuvaḥ saha gopāladārakaiḥ  |
cārayāmāsaturvatsānnānākrīḍāparicchadau  || 10.11.038 ||
kvacidvādayato veṇuṃ kṣepaṇaiḥ kṣipataḥ kvacit |
kvacitpādaiḥ kiṅkiṇībhiḥ kvacitkṛtrimagovṛṣaiḥ  || 10.11.039 ||
vṛṣāyamāṇau nardantau yuyudhāte parasparam  |
anukṛtya rutairjantūṃśceratuḥ prākṛtau yathā  || 10.11.040 ||
kadācidyamunātīre vatsāṃścārayatoḥ svakaiḥ  |
vayasyaiḥ kṛṣṇabalayorjighāṃsurdaitya āgamat || 10.11.041 ||
taṃ vatsarūpiṇaṃ vīkṣya vatsayūthagataṃ hariḥ  |
darśayan baladevāya śanairmugdha ivāsadat || 10.11.042 ||
gṛhītvāparapādābhyāṃ sahalāṅgūlamacyutaḥ  |
bhrāmayitvā kapitthāgre prāhiṇodgatajīvitam  |
sa kapitthairmahākāyaḥ pātyamānaiḥ papāta ha  || 10.11.043 ||
taṃ vīkṣya vismitā bālāḥ śaśaṃsuḥ sādhu sādhviti  |
devāśca parisantuṣṭā babhūvuḥ puṣpavarṣiṇaḥ  || 10.11.044 ||
tau vatsapālakau bhūtvā sarvalokaikapālakau  |
saprātarāśau govatsāṃścārayantau viceratuḥ  || 10.11.045 ||
svaṃ svaṃ vatsakulaṃ sarve pāyayiṣyanta ekadā  |
gatvā jalāśayābhyāśaṃ pāyayitvā papurjalam  || 10.11.046 ||
te tatra dadṛśurbālā mahāsattvamavasthitam  |
tatrasurvajranirbhinnaṃ gireḥ śṛṅgamiva cyutam  || 10.11.047 ||
sa vai bako nāma mahānasuro bakarūpadhṛk |
āgatya sahasā kṛṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇatuṇḍo'grasadbalī  || 10.11.048 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ mahābakagrastaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmādayo'rbhakāḥ  |
babhūvurindriyāṇīva vinā prāṇaṃ vicetasaḥ  || 10.11.049 ||
taṃ tālumūlaṃ pradahantamagnivadgopālasūnuṃ pitaraṃ jagadguroḥ  |
caccharda sadyo'tiruṣākṣataṃ bakastuṇḍena hantuṃ punarabhyapadyata  || 10.11.050 ||
tamāpatantaṃ sa nigṛhya tuṇḍayordorbhyāṃ bakaṃ kaṃsasakhaṃ satāṃ patiḥ  |
paśyatsu bāleṣu dadāra līlayā mudāvaho vīraṇavaddivaukasām  || 10.11.051 ||
tadā bakāriṃ suralokavāsinaḥ samākirannandanamallikādibhiḥ  |
samīḍire cānakaśaṅkhasaṃstavaistadvīkṣya gopālasutā visismire  || 10.11.052 ||
muktaṃ bakāsyādupalabhya bālakā rāmādayaḥ prāṇamivendriyo gaṇaḥ  |
sthānāgataṃ taṃ parirabhya nirvṛtāḥ praṇīya vatsān vrajametya tajjaguḥ  || 10.11.053 ||
śrutvā tadvismitā gopā gopyaścātipriyādṛtāḥ  |
pretyāgatamivotsukyādaikṣanta tṛṣitekṣaṇāḥ  || 10.11.054 ||
aho batāsya bālasya bahavo mṛtyavo'bhavan  |
apyāsīdvipriyaṃ teṣāṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ yato bhayam  || 10.11.055 ||
athāpyabhibhavantyenaṃ naiva te ghoradarśanāḥ  |
jighāṃsayainamāsādya naśyantyagnau pataṅgavat || 10.11.056 ||
aho brahmavidāṃ vāco nāsatyāḥ santi karhicit |
gargo yadāha bhagavānanvabhāvi tathaiva tat || 10.11.057 ||
iti nandādayo gopāḥ kṛṣṇarāmakathāṃ mudā  |
kurvanto ramamāṇāśca nāvindan bhavavedanām  || 10.11.058 ||
evaṃ vihāraiḥ kaumāraiḥ kaumāraṃ jahaturvraje  |
nilāyanaiḥ setubandhairmarkaṭotplavanādibhiḥ  || 10.11.059 ||
10.12.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
kvacidvanāśāya mano dadhadvrajātprātaḥ samutthāya vayasyavatsapān  |
prabodhayañchṛṅgaraveṇa cāruṇā vinirgato vatsapuraḥsaro hariḥ  || 10.12.001 ||
tenaiva sākaṃ pṛthukāḥ sahasraśaḥ snigdhāḥ suśigvetraviṣāṇaveṇavaḥ  |
svān svān sahasroparisaṅkhyayānvitān vatsān puraskṛtya viniryayurmudā  || 10.12.002 ||
kṛṣṇavatsairasaṅkhyātairyūthīkṛtya svavatsakān  |
cārayanto'rbhalīlābhirvijahrustatra tatra ha  || 10.12.003 ||
phalaprabālastavaka sumanaḥpicchadhātubhiḥ  |
kācaguñjāmaṇisvarṇa bhūṣitā apyabhūṣayan  || 10.12.004 ||
muṣṇanto'nyonyaśikyādīn jñātānārācca cikṣipuḥ  |
tatratyāśca punardūrāddhasantaśca punardaduḥ  || 10.12.005 ||
yadi dūraṃ gataḥ kṛṣṇo vanaśobhekṣaṇāya tam  |
ahaṃ pūrvamahaṃ pūrvamiti saṃspṛśya remire  || 10.12.006 ||
kecidveṇūn vādayanto dhmāntaḥ śṛṅgāṇi kecana  |
kecidbhṛṅgaiḥ pragāyantaḥ kūjantaḥ kokilaiḥ pare  || 10.12.007 ||
vicchāyābhiḥ pradhāvanto gacchantaḥ sādhuhaṃsakaiḥ  |
bakairupaviśantaśca nṛtyantaśca kalāpibhiḥ  || 10.12.008 ||
vikarṣantaḥ kīśabālānārohantaśca tairdrumān  |
vikurvantaśca taiḥ sākaṃ plavantaśca palāśiṣu  || 10.12.009 ||
sākaṃ bhekairvilaṅghantaḥ saritaḥ sravasamplutāḥ  |
vihasantaḥ praticchāyāḥ śapantaśca pratisvanān  || 10.12.010 ||
itthaṃ satāṃ brahmasukhānubhūtyā dāsyaṃ gatānāṃ paradaivatena  |
māyāśritānāṃ naradārakeṇa sākaṃ vijahruḥ kṛtapuṇyapuñjāḥ  || 10.12.011 ||
yatpādapāṃsurbahujanmakṛcchrato   dhṛtātmabhiryogibhirapyalabhyaḥ  |
sa eva yaddṛgviṣayaḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ   kiṃ varṇyate diṣṭamato vrajaukasām  || 10.12.012 ||*
athāghanāmābhyapatanmahāsurasteṣāṃ sukhakrīḍanavīkṣaṇākṣamaḥ  |
nityaṃ yadantarnijajīvitepsubhiḥ pītāmṛtairapyamaraiḥ pratīkṣyate  || 10.12.013 ||
dṛṣṭvārbhakān kṛṣṇamukhānaghāsuraḥ   kaṃsānuśiṣṭaḥ sa bakībakānujaḥ  |
ayaṃ tu me sodaranāśakṛttayor  dvayormamainaṃ sabalaṃ haniṣye  || 10.12.014 ||*
ete yadā matsuhṛdostilāpaḥ kṛtāstadā naṣṭasamā vrajaukasaḥ  |
prāṇe gate varṣmasu kā nu cintā prajāsavaḥ prāṇabhṛto hi ye te  || 10.12.015 ||
iti vyavasyājagaraṃ bṛhadvapuḥ sa yojanāyāmamahādripīvaram  |
dhṛtvādbhutaṃ vyāttaguhānanaṃ tadā pathi vyaśeta grasanāśayā khalaḥ  || 10.12.016 ||
dharādharoṣṭho jaladottaroṣṭho daryānanānto giriśṛṅgadaṃṣṭraḥ  |
dhvāntāntarāsyo vitatādhvajihvaḥ paruṣānilaśvāsadavekṣaṇoṣṇaḥ  || 10.12.017 ||
dṛṣṭvā taṃ tādṛśaṃ sarve matvā vṛndāvanaśriyam  |
vyāttājagaratuṇḍena hyutprekṣante sma līlayā  || 10.12.018 ||
aho mitrāṇi gadata sattvakūṭaṃ puraḥ sthitam  |
asmatsaṅgrasanavyātta vyālatuṇḍāyate na vā  || 10.12.019 ||
satyamarkakarāraktamuttarāhanuvadghanam  |
adharāhanuvadrodhastatpraticchāyayāruṇam  || 10.12.020 ||
pratispardhete sṛkkabhyāṃ savyāsavye nagodare  |
tuṅgaśṛṅgālayo'pyetāstaddaṃṣṭrābhiśca paśyata  || 10.12.021 ||
āstṛtāyāmamārgo'yaṃ rasanāṃ pratigarjati  |
eṣāṃ antargataṃ dhvāntametadapyantarānanam  || 10.12.022 ||
dāvoṣṇakharavāto'yaṃ śvāsavadbhāti paśyata  |
taddagdhasattvadurgandho'pyantarāmiṣagandhavat || 10.12.023 ||
asmān kimatra grasitā niviṣṭānayaṃ tathā cedbakavadvinaṅkṣyati  |
kṣaṇādaneneti bakāryuśanmukhaṃ vīkṣyoddhasantaḥ karatāḍanairyayuḥ  || 10.12.024 ||
itthaṃ mitho'tathyamatajjñabhāṣitaṃ   śrutvā vicintyetyamṛṣā mṛṣāyate  |
rakṣo viditvākhilabhūtahṛtsthitaḥ   svānāṃ niroddhuṃ bhagavānmano dadhe  || 10.12.025 ||*
tāvatpraviṣṭāstvasurodarāntaraṃ paraṃ na gīrṇāḥ śiśavaḥ savatsāḥ  |
pratīkṣamāṇena bakāriveśanaṃ hatasvakāntasmaraṇena rakṣasā  || 10.12.026 ||
tān vīkṣya kṛṣṇaḥ sakalābhayaprado   hyananyanāthān svakarādavacyutān  |
dīnāṃśca mṛtyorjaṭharāgnighāsān   ghṛṇārdito diṣṭakṛtena vismitaḥ  || 10.12.027 ||*
kṛtyaṃ kimatrāsya khalasya jīvanaṃ   na vā amīṣāṃ ca satāṃ vihiṃsanam  |
dvayaṃ kathaṃ syāditi saṃvicintya   jñātvāviśattuṇḍamaśeṣadṛgghariḥ  || 10.12.028 ||*
tadā ghanacchadā devā bhayāddhāheti cukruśuḥ  |
jahṛṣurye ca kaṃsādyāḥ kauṇapāstvaghabāndhavāḥ  || 10.12.029 ||
tacchrutvā bhagavān kṛṣṇastvavyayaḥ sārbhavatsakam  |
cūrṇīcikīrṣorātmānaṃ tarasā vavṛdhe gale  || 10.12.030 ||
tato'tikāyasya niruddhamārgiṇo hyudgīrṇadṛṣṭerbhramatastvitastataḥ  |
pūrṇo'ntaraṅge pavano niruddho mūrdhan vinirbhidya vinirgato bahiḥ  || 10.12.031 ||
tenaiva sarveṣu bahirgateṣu prāṇeṣu vatsān suhṛdaḥ paretān  |
dṛṣṭyā svayotthāpya tadanvitaḥ punarvaktrānmukundo bhagavān viniryayau  || 10.12.032 ||
pīnāhibhogotthitamadbhutaṃ mahajjyotiḥ svadhāmnā jvalayaddiśo daśa  |
pratīkṣya khe'vasthitamīśanirgamaṃ viveśa tasminmiṣatāṃ divaukasām  || 10.12.033 ||
tato'tihṛṣṭāḥ svakṛto'kṛtārhaṇaṃ   puṣpaiḥ sugā apsarasaśca nartanaiḥ  |
gītaiḥ surā vādyadharāśca vādyakaiḥ   stavaiśca viprā jayaniḥsvanairgaṇāḥ  || 10.12.034 ||*
tadadbhutastotrasuvādyagītikā jayādinaikotsavamaṅgalasvanān  |
śrutvā svadhāmno'ntyaja āgato'cirāddṛṣṭvā mahīśasya jagāma vismayam  || 10.12.035 ||
rājannājagaraṃ carma śuṣkaṃ vṛndāvane'dbhutam  |
vrajaukasāṃ bahutithaṃ babhūvākrīḍagahvaram  || 10.12.036 ||
etatkaumārajaṃ karma harerātmāhimokṣaṇam  |
mṛtyoḥ paugaṇḍake bālā dṛṣṭvocurvismitā vraje  || 10.12.037 ||
naitadvicitraṃ manujārbhamāyinaḥ parāvarāṇāṃ paramasya vedhasaḥ  |
agho'pi yatsparśanadhautapātakaḥ prāpātmasāmyaṃ tvasatāṃ sudurlabham  || 10.12.038 ||
sakṛdyadaṅgapratimāntarāhitā manomayī bhāgavatīṃ dadau gatim  |
sa eva nityātmasukhānubhūtyabhi vyudastamāyo'ntargato hi kiṃ punaḥ  || 10.12.039 ||
10.12.040|0 śrīsūta uvāca
itthaṃ dvijā yādavadevadattaḥ śrutvā svarātuścaritaṃ vicitram  |
papraccha bhūyo'pi tadeva puṇyaṃ vaiyāsakiṃ yannigṛhītacetāḥ  || 10.12.040 ||
10.12.041|0 śrīrājovāca
brahman kālāntarakṛtaṃ tatkālīnaṃ kathaṃ bhavet |
yatkaumāre harikṛtaṃ jaguḥ paugaṇḍake'rbhakāḥ  || 10.12.041 ||
tadbrūhi me mahāyogin paraṃ kautūhalaṃ guro  |
nūnametaddharereva māyā bhavati nānyathā  || 10.12.042 ||
vayaṃ dhanyatamā loke guro'pi kṣatrabandhavaḥ  |
vayaṃ pibāmo muhustvattaḥ puṇyaṃ kṛṣṇakathāmṛtam  || 10.12.043 ||
10.12.044|0 śrīsūta uvāca
itthaṃ sma pṛṣṭaḥ sa tu bādarāyaṇis  tatsmāritānantahṛtākhilendriyaḥ  |
kṛcchrātpunarlabdhabahirdṛśiḥ śanaiḥ   pratyāha taṃ bhāgavatottamottama  || 10.12.044 ||*
10.13.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ mahābhāga tvayā bhāgavatottama  |
yannūtanayasīśasya śṛṇvannapi kathāṃ muhuḥ  || 10.13.001 ||
satāmayaṃ sārabhṛtāṃ nisargo yadarthavāṇīśruticetasāmapi  |
pratikṣaṇaṃ navyavadacyutasya yatstriyā viṭānāmiva sādhu vārtā  || 10.13.002 ||
śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājannapi guhyaṃ vadāmi te  |
brūyuḥ snigdhasya śiṣyasya guravo guhyamapyuta  || 10.13.003 ||
tathāghavadanānmṛtyo rakṣitvā vatsapālakān  |
saritpulinamānīya bhagavānidamabravīt || 10.13.004 ||
aho'tiramyaṃ pulinaṃ vayasyāḥ svakelisampanmṛdulācchabālukam  |
sphuṭatsarogandhahṛtālipatrika dhvanipratidhvānalasaddrumākulam  || 10.13.005 ||
atra bhoktavyamasmābhirdivārūḍhaṃ kṣudhārditāḥ  |
vatsāḥ samīpe'paḥ pītvā carantu śanakaistṛṇam  || 10.13.006 ||
tatheti pāyayitvārbhā vatsānārudhya śādvale  |
muktvā śikyāni bubhujuḥ samaṃ bhagavatā mudā  || 10.13.007 ||
kṛṣṇasya viṣvakpururājimaṇḍalair  abhyānanāḥ phulladṛśo vrajārbhakāḥ  |
sahopaviṣṭā vipine virejuś  chadā yathāmbhoruhakarṇikāyāḥ  || 10.13.008 ||*
kecitpuṣpairdalaiḥ kecitpallavairaṅkuraiḥ phalaiḥ  |
śigbhistvagbhirdṛṣadbhiśca bubhujuḥ kṛtabhājanāḥ  || 10.13.009 ||
sarve mitho darśayantaḥ svasvabhojyaruciṃ pṛthak |
hasanto hāsayantaścā bhyavajahruḥ saheśvarāḥ  || 10.13.010 ||
bibhradveṇuṃ jaṭharapaṭayoḥ śṛṅgavetre ca kakṣe   vāme pāṇau masṛṇakavalaṃ tatphalānyaṅgulīṣu  |
tiṣṭhanmadhye svaparisuhṛdo hāsayannarmabhiḥ svaiḥ   svarge loke miṣati bubhuje yajñabhugbālakeliḥ  || 10.13.011 ||*
bhārataivaṃ vatsapeṣu bhuñjāneṣvacyutātmasu  |
vatsāstvantarvane dūraṃ viviśustṛṇalobhitāḥ  || 10.13.012 ||
tān dṛṣṭvā bhayasantrastānūce kṛṣṇo'sya bhībhayam  |
mitrāṇyāśānmā viramate hāneṣye vatsakānaham  || 10.13.013 ||
ityuktvādridarīkuñja gahvareṣvātmavatsakān  |
vicinvan bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ sapāṇikavalo yayau  || 10.13.014 ||
ambhojanmajanistadantaragato māyārbhakasyeśitur  draṣṭuṃ mañju mahitvamanyadapi tadvatsānito vatsapān  |
nītvānyatra kurūdvahāntaradadhātkhe'vasthito yaḥ purā   dṛṣṭvāghāsuramokṣaṇaṃ prabhavataḥ prāptaḥ paraṃ vismayam  || 10.13.015 ||*
tato vatsānadṛṣṭvaitya puline'pi ca vatsapān  |
ubhāvapi vane kṛṣṇo vicikāya samantataḥ  || 10.13.016 ||
kvāpyadṛṣṭvāntarvipine vatsān pālāṃśca viśvavit |
sarvaṃ vidhikṛtaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sahasāvajagāma ha  || 10.13.017 ||
tataḥ kṛṣṇo mudaṃ kartuṃ tanmātṝṇāṃ ca kasya ca  |
ubhayāyitamātmānaṃ cakre viśvakṛdīśvaraḥ  || 10.13.018 ||
yāvadvatsapavatsakālpakavapuryāvatkarāṅghryādikaṃ   yāvadyaṣṭiviṣāṇaveṇudalaśigyāvadvibhūṣāmbaram  |
yāvacchīlaguṇābhidhākṛtivayo yāvadvihārādikaṃ   sarvaṃ viṣṇumayaṃ giro'ṅgavadajaḥ sarvasvarūpo babhau  || 10.13.019 ||*
svayamātmātmagovatsān prativāryātmavatsapaiḥ  |
krīḍannātmavihāraiśca sarvātmā prāviśadvrajam  || 10.13.020 ||
tattadvatsān pṛthaṅnītvā tattadgoṣṭhe niveśya saḥ  |
tattadātmābhavadrājaṃstattatsadma praviṣṭavān  || 10.13.021 ||
tanmātaro veṇuravatvarotthitā utthāpya dorbhiḥ parirabhya nirbharam  |
snehasnutastanyapayaḥsudhāsavaṃ matvā paraṃ brahma sutānapāyayan  || 10.13.022 ||
tato nṛponmardanamajjalepanā laṅkārarakṣātilakāśanādibhiḥ  |
saṃlālitaḥ svācaritaiḥ praharṣayan sāyaṃ gato yāmayamena mādhavaḥ  || 10.13.023 ||
gāvastato goṣṭhamupetya satvaraṃ huṅkāraghoṣaiḥ parihūtasaṅgatān  |
svakān svakān vatsatarānapāyayanmuhurlihantyaḥ sravadaudhasaṃ payaḥ  || 10.13.024 ||
gogopīnāṃ mātṛtāsminnāsītsnehardhikāṃ vinā  |
purovadāsvapi harestokatā māyayā vinā  || 10.13.025 ||
vrajaukasāṃ svatokeṣu snehavallyābdamanvaham  |
śanairniḥsīma vavṛdhe yathā kṛṣṇe tvapūrvavat || 10.13.026 ||
itthamātmātmanātmānaṃ vatsapālamiṣeṇa saḥ  |
pālayan vatsapo varṣaṃ cikrīḍe vanagoṣṭhayoḥ  || 10.13.027 ||
ekadā cārayan vatsān sarāmo vanamāviśat |
pañcaṣāsu triyāmāsu hāyanāpūraṇīṣvajaḥ  || 10.13.028 ||
tato vidūrāccarato gāvo vatsānupavrajam  |
govardhanādriśirasi carantyo dadṛśustṛṇam  || 10.13.029 ||
dṛṣṭvātha tatsnehavaśo'smṛtātmā sa govrajo'tyātmapadurgamārgaḥ  |
dvipātkakudgrīva udāsyapuccho'gāddhuṅkṛtairāsrupayā javena  || 10.13.030 ||
sametya gāvo'dho vatsān vatsavatyo'pyapāyayan  |
gilantya iva cāṅgāni lihantyaḥ svaudhasaṃ payaḥ  || 10.13.031 ||
gopāstadrodhanāyāsa maughyalajjorumanyunā  |
durgādhvakṛcchrato'bhyetya govatsairdadṛśuḥ sutān  || 10.13.032 ||
tadīkṣaṇotpremarasāplutāśayā jātānurāgā gatamanyavo'rbhakān  |
uduhya dorbhiḥ parirabhya mūrdhani ghrāṇairavāpuḥ paramāṃ mudaṃ te  || 10.13.033 ||
tataḥ pravayaso gopāstokāśleṣasunirvṛtāḥ  |
kṛcchrācchanairapagatāstadanusmṛtyudaśravaḥ  || 10.13.034 ||
vrajasya rāmaḥ premardhervīkṣyautkaṇṭhyamanukṣaṇam  |
muktastaneṣvapatyeṣvapyahetuvidacintayat || 10.13.035 ||
kimetadadbhutamiva vāsudeve'khilātmani  |
vrajasya sātmanastokeṣvapūrvaṃ prema vardhate  || 10.13.036 ||
keyaṃ vā kuta āyātā daivī vā nāryutāsurī  |
prāyo māyāstu me bharturnānyā me'pi vimohinī  || 10.13.037 ||
iti sañcintya dāśārho vatsān savayasānapi  |
sarvānācaṣṭa vaikuṇṭhaṃ cakṣuṣā vayunena saḥ  || 10.13.038 ||
naite sureśā ṛṣayo na caite tvameva bhāsīśa bhidāśraye'pi  |
sarvaṃ pṛthaktvaṃ nigamātkathaṃ vadetyuktena vṛttaṃ prabhuṇā balo'vait || 10.13.039 ||
tāvadetyātmabhūrātma mānena truṭyanehasā  |
purovadābdaṃ krīḍantaṃ dadṛśe sakalaṃ harim  || 10.13.040 ||
yāvanto gokule bālāḥ savatsāḥ sarva eva hi  |
māyāśaye śayānā me nādyāpi punarutthitāḥ  || 10.13.041 ||
ita ete'tra kutratyā manmāyāmohitetare  |
tāvanta eva tatrābdaṃ krīḍanto viṣṇunā samam  || 10.13.042 ||
evameteṣu bhedeṣu ciraṃ dhyātvā sa ātmabhūḥ  |
satyāḥ ke katare neti jñātuṃ neṣṭe kathañcana  || 10.13.043 ||
evaṃ sammohayan viṣṇuṃ vimohaṃ viśvamohanam  |
svayaiva māyayājo'pi svayameva vimohitaḥ  || 10.13.044 ||
tamyāṃ tamovannaihāraṃ khadyotārcirivāhani  |
mahatītaramāyaiśyaṃ nihantyātmani yuñjataḥ  || 10.13.045 ||
tāvatsarve vatsapālāḥ paśyato'jasya tatkṣaṇāt |
vyadṛśyanta ghanaśyāmāḥ pītakauśeyavāsasaḥ  || 10.13.046 ||
caturbhujāḥ śaṅkhacakra gadārājīvapāṇayaḥ  |
kirīṭinaḥ kuṇḍalino hāriṇo vanamālinaḥ  || 10.13.047 ||
śrīvatsāṅgadadoratna kambukaṅkaṇapāṇayaḥ  |
nūpuraiḥ kaṭakairbhātāḥ kaṭisūtrāṅgulīyakaiḥ  || 10.13.048 ||
āṅghrimastakamāpūrṇāstulasīnavadāmabhiḥ  |
komalaiḥ sarvagātreṣu bhūripuṇyavadarpitaiḥ  || 10.13.049 ||
candrikāviśadasmeraiḥ sāruṇāpāṅgavīkṣitaiḥ  |
svakārthānāmiva rajaḥ sattvābhyāṃ sraṣṭṛpālakāḥ  || 10.13.050 ||
ātmādistambaparyantairmūrtimadbhiścarācaraiḥ  |
nṛtyagītādyanekārhaiḥ pṛthakpṛthagupāsitāḥ  || 10.13.051 ||
aṇimādyairmahimabhirajādyābhirvibhūtibhiḥ  |
caturviṃśatibhistattvaiḥ parītā mahadādibhiḥ  || 10.13.052 ||
kālasvabhāvasaṃskāra kāmakarmaguṇādibhiḥ  |
svamahidhvastamahibhirmūrtimadbhirupāsitāḥ  || 10.13.053 ||
satyajñānānantānanda mātraikarasamūrtayaḥ  |
aspṛṣṭabhūrimāhātmyā api hyupaniṣaddṛśām  || 10.13.054 ||
evaṃ sakṛddadarśājaḥ parabrahmātmano'khilān  |
yasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ vibhāti sacarācaram  || 10.13.055 ||
tato'tikutukodvṛtya stimitaikādaśendriyaḥ  |
taddhāmnābhūdajastūṣṇīṃ pūrdevyantīva putrikā  || 10.13.056 ||
itīreśe'tarkye nijamahimani svapramitike   paratrājāto'tannirasanamukhabrahmakamitau  |
anīśe'pi draṣṭuṃ kimidamiti vā muhyati sati   cacchādājo jñātvā sapadi paramo'jājavanikām  || 10.13.057 ||*
tato'rvākpratilabdhākṣaḥ kaḥ paretavadutthitaḥ  |
kṛcchrādunmīlya vai dṛṣṭīrācaṣṭedaṃ sahātmanā  || 10.13.058 ||
sapadyevābhitaḥ paśyan diśo'paśyatpuraḥsthitam  |
vṛndāvanaṃ janājīvya drumākīrṇaṃ samāpriyam  || 10.13.059 ||
yatra naisargadurvairāḥ sahāsannṛmṛgādayaḥ  |
mitrāṇīvājitāvāsa drutaruṭtarṣakādikam  || 10.13.060 ||
tatrodvahatpaśupavaṃśaśiśutvanāṭyaṃ   brahmādvayaṃ paramanantamagādhabodham  |
vatsān sakhīniva purā parito vicinvad  ekaṃ sapāṇikavalaṃ parameṣṭhyacaṣṭa  || 10.13.061 ||*
dṛṣṭvā tvareṇa nijadhoraṇato'vatīrya   pṛthvyāṃ vapuḥ kanakadaṇḍamivābhipātya  |
spṛṣṭvā caturmukuṭakoṭibhiraṅghriyugmaṃ   natvā mudaśrusujalairakṛtābhiṣekam  || 10.13.062 ||*
utthāyotthāya kṛṣṇasya cirasya pādayoḥ patan  |
āste mahitvaṃ prāgdṛṣṭaṃ smṛtvā smṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ  || 10.13.063 ||
śanairathotthāya vimṛjya locane mukundamudvīkṣya vinamrakandharaḥ  |
kṛtāñjaliḥ praśrayavān samāhitaḥ savepathurgadgadayailatelayā  || 10.13.064 ||
10.14.001|0 śrībrahmovāca
naumīḍya te'bhravapuṣe taḍidambarāya   guñjāvataṃsaparipicchalasanmukhāya  |
vanyasraje kavalavetraviṣāṇaveṇu   lakṣmaśriye mṛdupade paśupāṅgajāya  || 10.14.001 ||*
asyāpi deva vapuṣo madanugrahasya svecchāmayasya na tu bhūtamayasya ko'pi  |
neśe mahi tvavasituṃ manasāntareṇa sākṣāttavaiva kimutātmasukhānubhūteḥ  || 10.14.002 ||
jñāne prayāsamudapāsya namanta eva   jīvanti sanmukharitāṃ bhavadīyavārtām  |
sthāne sthitāḥ śrutigatāṃ tanuvāṅmanobhir  ye prāyaśo'jita jito'pyasi taistrilokyām  || 10.14.003 ||*
śreyaḥsṛtiṃ bhaktimudasya te vibho   kliśyanti ye kevalabodhalabdhaye  |
teṣāmasau kleśala eva śiṣyate   nānyadyathā sthūlatuṣāvaghātinām  || 10.14.004 ||*
pureha bhūman bahavo'pi yoginastvadarpitehā nijakarmalabdhayā  |
vibudhya bhaktyaiva kathopanītayā prapedire'ñjo'cyuta te gatiṃ parām  || 10.14.005 ||
tathāpi bhūmanmahimāguṇasya te viboddhumarhatyamalāntarātmabhiḥ  |
avikriyātsvānubhavādarūpato hyananyabodhyātmatayā na cānyathā  || 10.14.006 ||
guṇātmanaste'pi guṇān vimātuṃ hitāvatīṛnasya ka īśire'sya  |
kālena yairvā vimitāḥ sukalpairbhūpāṃśavaḥ khe mihikā dyubhāsaḥ  || 10.14.007 ||
tatte'nukampāṃ susamīkṣamāṇo bhuñjāna evātmakṛtaṃ vipākam  |
hṛdvāgvapurbhirvidadhannamaste jīveta yo muktipade sa dāyabhāk || 10.14.008 ||
paśyeśa me'nāryamananta ādye parātmani tvayyapi māyimāyini  |
māyāṃ vitatyekṣitumātmavaibhavaṃ hyahaṃ kiyānaicchamivārciragnau  || 10.14.009 ||
ataḥ kṣamasvācyuta me rajobhuvo hyajānatastvatpṛthagīśamāninaḥ  |
ajāvalepāndhatamo'ndhacakṣuṣa eṣo'nukampyo mayi nāthavāniti  || 10.14.010 ||
kvāhaṃ tamomahadahaṃkhacarāgnivārbhū   saṃveṣṭitāṇḍaghaṭasaptavitastikāyaḥ  |
kvedṛgvidhāvigaṇitāṇḍaparāṇucaryā   vātādhvaromavivarasya ca te mahitvam  || 10.14.011 ||*
utkṣepaṇaṃ garbhagatasya pādayoḥ kiṃ kalpate māturadhokṣajāgase  |
kimastināstivyapadeśabhūṣitaṃ tavāsti kukṣeḥ kiyadapyanantaḥ  || 10.14.012 ||
jagattrayāntodadhisamplavode nārāyaṇasyodaranābhinālāt |
vinirgato'jastviti vāṅna vai mṛṣā kintvīśvara tvanna vinirgato'smi  || 10.14.013 ||
nārāyaṇastvaṃ na hi sarvadehināmātmāsyadhīśākhilalokasākṣī  |
nārāyaṇo'ṅgaṃ narabhūjalāyanāttaccāpi satyaṃ na tavaiva māyā  || 10.14.014 ||
taccejjalasthaṃ tava sajjagadvapuḥ   kiṃ me na dṛṣṭaṃ bhagavaṃstadaiva  |
kiṃ vā sudṛṣṭaṃ hṛdi me tadaiva   kiṃ no sapadyeva punarvyadarśi  || 10.14.015 ||*
atraiva māyādhamanāvatāre hyasya prapañcasya bahiḥ sphuṭasya  |
kṛtsnasya cāntarjaṭhare jananyā māyātvameva prakaṭīkṛtaṃ te  || 10.14.016 ||
yasya kukṣāvidaṃ sarvaṃ sātmaṃ bhāti yathā tathā  |
tattvayyapīha tatsarvaṃ kimidaṃ māyayā vinā  || 10.14.017 ||
adyaiva tvadṛte'sya kiṃ mama na te māyātvamādarśitam   eko'si prathamaṃ tato vrajasuhṛdvatsāḥ samastā api  |
tāvanto'si caturbhujāstadakhilaiḥ sākaṃ mayopāsitās  tāvantyeva jagantyabhūstadamitaṃ brahmādvayaṃ śiṣyate  || 10.14.018 ||*
ajānatāṃ tvatpadavīmanātmanyātmātmanā bhāsi vitatya māyām  |
sṛṣṭāvivāhaṃ jagato vidhāna iva tvameṣo'nta iva trinetraḥ  || 10.14.019 ||
sureṣvṛṣiṣvīśa tathaiva nṛṣvapi tiryakṣu yādaḥsvapi te'janasya  |
janmāsatāṃ durmadanigrahāya prabho vidhātaḥ sadanugrahāya ca  || 10.14.020 ||
ko vetti bhūman bhagavan parātman yogeśvarotīrbhavatastrilokyām  |
kva vā kathaṃ vā kati vā kadeti vistārayan krīḍasi yogamāyām  || 10.14.021 ||
tasmādidaṃ jagadaśeṣamasatsvarūpaṃ   svapnābhamastadhiṣaṇaṃ puruduḥkhaduḥkham  |
tvayyeva nityasukhabodhatanāvanante   māyāta udyadapi yatsadivāvabhāti  || 10.14.022 ||*
ekastvamātmā puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ satyaḥ svayaṃjyotirananta ādyaḥ  |
nityo'kṣaro'jasrasukho nirañjanaḥ pūrṇādvayo mukta upādhito'mṛtaḥ  || 10.14.023 ||
evaṃvidhaṃ tvāṃ sakalātmanāmapi svātmānamātmātmatayā vicakṣate  |
gurvarkalabdhopaniṣatsucakṣuṣā ye te tarantīva bhavānṛtāmbudhim  || 10.14.024 ||
ātmānamevātmatayāvijānatāṃ tenaiva jātaṃ nikhilaṃ prapañcitam  |
jñānena bhūyo'pi ca tatpralīyate rajjvāmaherbhogabhavābhavau yathā  || 10.14.025 ||
ajñānasaṃjñau bhavabandhamokṣau dvau nāma nānyau sta ṛtajñabhāvāt |
ajasracityātmani kevale pare vicāryamāṇe taraṇāvivāhanī  || 10.14.026 ||
tvāmātmānaṃ paraṃ matvā paramātmānameva ca  |
ātmā punarbahirmṛgya aho'jñajanatājñatā  || 10.14.027 ||
antarbhave'nanta bhavantameva hyatattyajanto mṛgayanti santaḥ  |
asantamapyantyahimantareṇa santaṃ guṇaṃ taṃ kimu yanti santaḥ  || 10.14.028 ||
athāpi te deva padāmbujadvaya prasādaleśānugṛhīta eva hi  |
jānāti tattvaṃ bhagavanmahimno na cānya eko'pi ciraṃ vicinvan  || 10.14.029 ||
tadastu me nātha sa bhūribhāgo bhave'tra vānyatra tu vā tiraścām  |
yenāhameko'pi bhavajjanānāṃ bhūtvā niṣeve tava pādapallavam  || 10.14.030 ||
aho'tidhanyā vrajagoramaṇyaḥ stanyāmṛtaṃ pītamatīva te mudā  |
yāsāṃ vibho vatsatarātmajātmanā yattṛptaye'dyāpi na cālamadhvarāḥ  || 10.14.031 ||
aho bhāgyamaho bhāgyaṃ nandagopavrajaukasām  |
yanmitraṃ paramānandaṃ pūrṇaṃ brahma sanātanam  || 10.14.032 ||
eṣāṃ tu bhāgyamahimācyuta tāvadāstām   ekādaśaiva hi vayaṃ bata bhūribhāgāḥ  |
etaddhṛṣīkacaṣakairasakṛtpibāmaḥ   śarvādayo'ṅghryudajamadhvamṛtāsavaṃ te  || 10.14.033 ||*
tadbhūribhāgyamiha janma kimapyaṭavyāṃ   yadgokule'pi katamāṅghrirajo'bhiṣekam  |
yajjīvitaṃ tu nikhilaṃ bhagavānmukundas  tvadyāpi yatpadarajaḥ śrutimṛgyameva  || 10.14.034 ||*
eṣāṃ ghoṣanivāsināmuta bhavān kiṃ deva rāteti naś  ceto viśvaphalātphalaṃ tvadaparaṃ kutrāpyayanmuhyati  |
sadveṣādiva pūtanāpi sakulā tvāmeva devāpitā   yaddhāmārthasuhṛtpriyātmatanayaprāṇāśayāstvatkṛte  || 10.14.035 ||*
tāvadrāgādayaḥ stenāstāvatkārāgṛhaṃ gṛham  |
tāvanmoho'ṅghrinigaḍo yāvatkṛṣṇa na te janāḥ  || 10.14.036 ||
prapañcaṃ niṣprapañco'pi viḍambayasi bhūtale  |
prapannajanatānanda sandohaṃ prathituṃ prabho  || 10.14.037 ||
jānanta eva jānantu kiṃ bahūktyā na me prabho  |
manaso vapuṣo vāco vaibhavaṃ tava gocaraḥ  || 10.14.038 ||
anujānīhi māṃ kṛṣṇa sarvaṃ tvaṃ vetsi sarvadṛk |
tvameva jagatāṃ nātho jagadetattavārpitam  || 10.14.039 ||
śrīkṛṣṇa vṛṣṇikulapuṣkarajoṣadāyin   kṣmānirjaradvijapaśūdadhivṛddhikārin  |
uddharmaśārvarahara kṣitirākṣasadhrug  ākalpamārkamarhan bhagavannamaste  || 10.14.040 ||*
10.14.041|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ityabhiṣṭūya bhūmānaṃ triḥ parikramya pādayoḥ  |
natvābhīṣṭaṃ jagaddhātā svadhāma pratyapadyata  || 10.14.041 ||
tato'nujñāpya bhagavān svabhuvaṃ prāgavasthitān  |
vatsān pulinamāninye yathāpūrvasakhaṃ svakam  || 10.14.042 ||
ekasminnapi yāte'bde prāṇeśaṃ cāntarātmanaḥ  |
kṛṣṇamāyāhatā rājan kṣaṇārdhaṃ menire'rbhakāḥ  || 10.14.043 ||
kiṃ kiṃ na vismarantīha māyāmohitacetasaḥ  |
yanmohitaṃ jagatsarvamabhīkṣṇaṃ vismṛtātmakam  || 10.14.044 ||
ūcuśca suhṛdaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ svāgataṃ te'tiraṃhasā  |
naiko'pyabhoji kavala ehītaḥ sādhu bhujyatām  || 10.14.045 ||
tato hasan hṛṣīkeśo'bhyavahṛtya sahārbhakaiḥ  |
darśayaṃścarmājagaraṃ nyavartata vanādvrajam  || 10.14.046 ||
barhaprasūnavanadhātuvicitritāṅgaḥ   proddāmaveṇudalaśṛṅgaravotsavāḍhyaḥ  |
vatsān gṛṇannanugagītapavitrakīrtir  gopīdṛgutsavadṛśiḥ praviveśa goṣṭham  || 10.14.047 ||*
adyānena mahāvyālo yaśodānandasūnunā  |
hato'vitā vayaṃ cāsmāditi bālā vraje jaguḥ  || 10.14.048 ||
10.14.049|0 śrīrājovāca
brahman parodbhave kṛṣṇe iyān premā kathaṃ bhavet |
yo'bhūtapūrvastokeṣu svodbhaveṣvapi kathyatām  || 10.14.049 ||
10.14.050|0 śrīśuka uvāca
sarveṣāmapi bhūtānāṃ nṛpa svātmaiva vallabhaḥ  |
itare'patyavittādyāstadvallabhatayaiva hi  || 10.14.050 ||
tadrājendra yathā snehaḥ svasvakātmani dehinām  |
na tathā mamatālambi putravittagṛhādiṣu  || 10.14.051 ||
dehātmavādināṃ puṃsāmapi rājanyasattama  |
yathā dehaḥ priyatamastathā na hyanu ye ca tam  || 10.14.052 ||
deho'pi mamatābhākcettarhyasau nātmavatpriyaḥ  |
yajjīryatyapi dehe'smin jīvitāśā balīyasī  || 10.14.053 ||
tasmātpriyatamaḥ svātmā sarveṣāmapi dehinām  |
tadarthameva sakalaṃ jagadetaccarācaram  || 10.14.054 ||
kṛṣṇamenamavehi tvamātmānamakhilātmanām  |
jagaddhitāya so'pyatra dehīvābhāti māyayā  || 10.14.055 ||
vastuto jānatāmatra kṛṣṇaṃ sthāsnu cariṣṇu ca  |
bhagavadrūpamakhilaṃ nānyadvastviha kiñcana  || 10.14.056 ||
sarveṣāmapi vastūnāṃ bhāvārtho bhavati sthitaḥ  |
tasyāpi bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ kimatadvastu rūpyatām  || 10.14.057 ||
samāśritā ye padapallavaplavaṃ mahatpadaṃ puṇyayaśo murāreḥ  |
bhavāmbudhirvatsapadaṃ paraṃ padaṃ padaṃ padaṃ yadvipadāṃ na teṣām  || 10.14.058 ||
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'hamiha tvayā  |
tatkaumāre harikṛtaṃ paugaṇḍe parikīrtitam  || 10.14.059 ||
etatsuhṛdbhiścaritaṃ murāreraghārdanaṃ śādvalajemanaṃ ca  |
vyaktetaradrūpamajorvabhiṣṭavaṃ śṛṇvan gṛṇanneti naro'khilārthān  || 10.14.060 ||
evaṃ vihāraiḥ kaumāraiḥ kaumāraṃ jahaturvraje  |
nilāyanaiḥ setubandhairmarkaṭotplavanādibhiḥ  || 10.14.061 ||
10.15.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
tataśca paugaṇḍavayaḥśrītau vraje   babhūvatustau paśupālasammatau  |
gāścārayantau sakhibhiḥ samaṃ padair  vṛndāvanaṃ puṇyamatīva cakratuḥ  || 10.15.001 ||*
tanmādhavo veṇumudīrayan vṛto gopairgṛṇadbhiḥ svayaśo balānvitaḥ  |
paśūn puraskṛtya paśavyamāviśadvihartukāmaḥ kusumākaraṃ vanam  || 10.15.002 ||
tanmañjughoṣālimṛgadvijākulaṃ mahanmanaḥprakhyapayaḥsarasvatā  |
vātena juṣṭaṃ śatapatragandhinā nirīkṣya rantuṃ bhagavānmano dadhe  || 10.15.003 ||
sa tatra tatrāruṇapallavaśriyā phalaprasūnorubhareṇa pādayoḥ  |
spṛśacchikhān vīkṣya vanaspatīnmudā smayannivāhāgrajamādipūruṣaḥ  || 10.15.004 ||
10.15.005|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
aho amī devavarāmarārcitaṃ pādāmbujaṃ te sumanaḥphalārhaṇam  |
namantyupādāya śikhābhirātmanastamo'pahatyai tarujanma yatkṛtam  || 10.15.005 ||
ete'linastava yaśo'khilalokatīrthaṃ   gāyanta ādipuruṣānupathaṃ bhajante  |
prāyo amī munigaṇā bhavadīyamukhyā   gūḍhaṃ vane'pi na jahatyanaghātmadaivam  || 10.15.006 ||*
nṛtyantyamī śikhina īḍya mudā hariṇyaḥ   kurvanti gopya iva te priyamīkṣaṇena  |
sūktaiśca kokilagaṇā gṛhamāgatāya   dhanyā vanaukasa iyān hi satāṃ nisargaḥ  || 10.15.007 ||*
dhanyeyamadya dharaṇī tṛṇavīrudhastvat  pādaspṛśo drumalatāḥ karajābhimṛṣṭāḥ  |
nadyo'drayaḥ khagamṛgāḥ sadayāvalokair  gopyo'ntareṇa bhujayorapi yatspṛhā śrīḥ  || 10.15.008 ||*
10.15.009|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇaḥ prītamanāḥ paśūn  |
reme sañcārayannadreḥ saridrodhaḥsu sānugaḥ  || 10.15.009 ||
kvacidgāyati gāyatsu madāndhāliṣvanuvrataiḥ  |
upagīyamānacaritaḥ pathi saṅkarṣaṇānvitaḥ  || 10.15.010 ||
anujalpati jalpantaṃ kalavākyaiḥ śukaṃ kvacit |
kvacitsavalgu kūjantamanukūjati kokilam  || 10.15.011_1 ||
kvacicca kālahaṃsānāmanukūjati kūjitam  |
abhinṛtyati nṛtyantaṃ barhiṇaṃ hāsayan kvacit || 10.15.011_2 ||
meghagambhīrayā vācā nāmabhirdūragān paśūn  |
kvacidāhvayati prītyā gogopālamanojñayā  || 10.15.012 ||
cakorakrauñcacakrāhva bhāradvājāṃśca barhiṇaḥ  |
anurauti sma sattvānāṃ bhītavadvyāghrasiṃhayoḥ  || 10.15.013 ||
kvacitkrīḍāpariśrāntaṃ gopotsaṅgopabarhaṇam  |
svayaṃ viśramayatyāryaṃ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ  || 10.15.014 ||
nṛtyato gāyataḥ kvāpi valgato yudhyato mithaḥ  |
gṛhītahastau gopālān hasantau praśaśaṃsatuḥ  || 10.15.015 ||
kvacitpallavatalpeṣu niyuddhaśramakarśitaḥ  |
vṛkṣamūlāśrayaḥ śete gopotsaṅgopabarhaṇaḥ  || 10.15.016 ||
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakruḥ kecittasya mahātmanaḥ  |
apare hatapāpmāno vyajanaiḥ samavījayan  || 10.15.017 ||
anye tadanurūpāṇi manojñāni mahātmanaḥ  |
gāyanti sma mahārāja snehaklinnadhiyaḥ śanaiḥ  || 10.15.018 ||
evaṃ nigūḍhātmagatiḥ svamāyayā gopātmajatvaṃ caritairviḍambayan  |
reme ramālālitapādapallavo grāmyaiḥ samaṃ grāmyavadīśaceṣṭitaḥ  || 10.15.019 ||
śrīdāmā nāma gopālo rāmakeśavayoḥ sakhā  |
subalastokakṛṣṇādyā gopāḥ premṇedamabruvan  || 10.15.020 ||
rāma rāma mahābāho kṛṣṇa duṣṭanibarhaṇa  |
ito'vidūre sumahadvanaṃ tālālisaṅkulam  || 10.15.021 ||
phalāni tatra bhūrīṇi patanti patitāni ca  |
santi kintvavaruddhāni dhenukena durātmanā  || 10.15.022 ||
so'tivīryo'suro rāma he kṛṣṇa khararūpadhṛk |
ātmatulyabalairanyairjñātibhirbahubhirvṛtaḥ  || 10.15.023 ||
tasmātkṛtanarāhārādbhītairnṛbhiramitrahan  |
na sevyate paśugaṇaiḥ pakṣisaṅghairvivarjitam  || 10.15.024 ||
vidyante'bhuktapūrvāṇi phalāni surabhīṇi ca  |
eṣa vai surabhirgandho viṣūcīno'vagṛhyate  || 10.15.025 ||
prayaccha tāni naḥ kṛṣṇa gandhalobhitacetasām  |
vāñchāsti mahatī rāma gamyatāṃ yadi rocate  || 10.15.026 ||
evaṃ suhṛdvacaḥ śrutvā suhṛtpriyacikīrṣayā  |
prahasya jagmaturgopairvṛtau tālavanaṃ prabhū  || 10.15.027 ||
balaḥ praviśya bāhubhyāṃ tālān samparikampayan  |
phalāni pātayāmāsa mataṅgaja ivaujasā  || 10.15.028 ||
phalānāṃ patatāṃ śabdaṃ niśamyāsurarāsabhaḥ  |
abhyadhāvatkṣititalaṃ sanagaṃ parikampayan  || 10.15.029 ||
sametya tarasā pratyagdvābhyāṃ padbhyāṃ balaṃ balī  |
nihatyorasi kāśabdaṃ muñcan paryasaratkhalaḥ  || 10.15.030 ||
punarāsādya saṃrabdha upakroṣṭā parāksthitaḥ  |
caraṇāvaparau rājan balāya prākṣipadruṣā  || 10.15.031 ||
sa taṃ gṛhītvā prapadorbhrāmayitvaikapāṇinā  |
cikṣepa tṛṇarājāgre bhrāmaṇatyaktajīvitam  || 10.15.032 ||
tenāhato mahātālo vepamāno bṛhacchirāḥ  |
pārśvasthaṃ kampayan bhagnaḥ sa cānyaṃ so'pi cāparam  || 10.15.033 ||
balasya līlayotsṛṣṭa kharadehahatāhatāḥ  |
tālāścakampire sarve mahāvāteritā iva  || 10.15.034 ||
naitaccitraṃ bhagavati hyanante jagadīśvare  |
otaprotamidaṃ yasmiṃstantuṣvaṅga yathā paṭaḥ  || 10.15.035 ||
tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ ca rāmaṃ ca jñātayo dhenukasya ye  |
kroṣṭāro'bhyadravan sarve saṃrabdhā hatabāndhavāḥ  || 10.15.036 ||
tāṃstānāpatataḥ kṛṣṇo rāmaśca nṛpa līlayā  |
gṛhītapaścāccaraṇān prāhiṇottṛṇarājasu  || 10.15.037 ||
phalaprakarasaṅkīrṇaṃ daityadehairgatāsubhiḥ  |
rarāja bhūḥ satālāgrairghanairiva nabhastalam  || 10.15.038 ||
tayostatsumahatkarma niśamya vibudhādayaḥ  |
mumucuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi cakrurvādyāni tuṣṭuvuḥ  || 10.15.039 ||
atha tālaphalānyādanmanuṣyā gatasādhvasāḥ  |
tṛṇaṃ ca paśavaścerurhatadhenukakānane  || 10.15.040 ||
kṛṣṇaḥ kamalapatrākṣaḥ puṇyaśravaṇakīrtanaḥ  |
stūyamāno'nugairgopaiḥ sāgrajo vrajamāvrajat || 10.15.041 ||
taṃ gorajaśchuritakuntalabaddhabarha   vanyaprasūnarucirekṣaṇacāruhāsam  |
veṇuṃ kvaṇantamanugairupagītakīrtiṃ   gopyo didṛkṣitadṛśo'bhyagaman sametāḥ  || 10.15.042 ||*
pītvā mukundamukhasāraghamakṣibhṛṅgais  tāpaṃ jahurvirahajaṃ vrajayoṣito'hni  |
tatsatkṛtiṃ samadhigamya viveśa goṣṭhaṃ   savrīḍahāsavinayaṃ yadapāṅgamokṣam  || 10.15.043 ||*
tayoryaśodārohiṇyau putrayoḥ putravatsale  |
yathākāmaṃ yathākālaṃ vyadhattāṃ paramāśiṣaḥ  || 10.15.044 ||
gatādhvānaśramau tatra majjanonmardanādibhiḥ  |
nīvīṃ vasitvā rucirāṃ divyasraggandhamaṇḍitau  || 10.15.045 ||
jananyupahṛtaṃ prāśya svādyannamupalālitau  |
saṃviśya varaśayyāyāṃ sukhaṃ suṣupaturvraje  || 10.15.046 ||
evaṃ sa bhagavān kṛṣṇo vṛndāvanacaraḥ kvacit |
yayau rāmamṛte rājan kālindīṃ sakhibhirvṛtaḥ  || 10.15.047 ||
atha gāvaśca gopāśca nidāghātapapīḍitāḥ  |
duṣṭaṃ jalaṃ papustasyāstṛṣṇārtā viṣadūṣitam  || 10.15.048 ||
viṣāmbhastadupaspṛśya daivopahatacetasaḥ  |
nipeturvyasavaḥ sarve salilānte kurūdvaha  || 10.15.049 ||
vīkṣya tān vai tathābhūtān kṛṣṇo yogeśvareśvaraḥ  |
īkṣayāmṛtavarṣiṇyā svanāthān samajīvayat || 10.15.050 ||
te sampratītasmṛtayaḥ samutthāya jalāntikāt |
āsan suvismitāḥ sarve vīkṣamāṇāḥ parasparam  || 10.15.051 ||
anvamaṃsata tadrājan govindānugrahekṣitam  |
pītvā viṣaṃ paretasya punarutthānamātmanaḥ  || 10.15.052 ||
10.16.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
vilokya dūṣitāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇāhinā vibhuḥ  |
tasyā viśuddhimanvicchan sarpaṃ tamudavāsayat || 10.16.001 ||
10.16.002|0 śrīrājovāca
kathamantarjale'gādhe nyagṛhṇādbhagavānahim  |
sa vai bahuyugāvāsaṃ yathāsīdvipra kathyatām  || 10.16.002 ||
brahman bhagavatastasya bhūmnaḥ svacchandavartinaḥ  |
gopālodāracaritaṃ kastṛpyetāmṛtaṃ juṣan  || 10.16.003 ||
10.16.004|0 śrīśuka uvāca
kālindyāṃ kāliyasyāsīdhradaḥ kaścidviṣāgninā  |
śrapyamāṇapayā yasmin patantyuparigāḥ khagāḥ  || 10.16.004 ||
vipruṣmatā viṣadormi mārutenābhimarśitāḥ  |
mriyante tīragā yasya prāṇinaḥ sthirajaṅgamāḥ  || 10.16.005 ||
taṃ caṇḍavegaviṣavīryamavekṣya tena   duṣṭāṃ nadīṃ ca khalasaṃyamanāvatāraḥ  |
kṛṣṇaḥ kadambamadhiruhya tato'tituṅgam   āsphoṭya gāḍharaśano nyapatadviṣode  || 10.16.006 ||*
sarpahradaḥ puruṣasāranipātavega   saṅkṣobhitoragaviṣocchvasitāmburāśiḥ  |
paryakpluto viṣakaṣāyabibhīṣaṇormir  dhāvan dhanuḥśatamanantabalasya kiṃ tat || 10.16.007 ||*
tasya hrade viharato bhujadaṇḍaghūrṇa   vārghoṣamaṅga varavāraṇavikramasya  |
āśrutya tatsvasadanābhibhavaṃ nirīkṣya   cakṣuḥśravāḥ samasarattadamṛṣyamāṇaḥ  || 10.16.008 ||*
taṃ prekṣaṇīyasukumāraghanāvadātaṃ   śrīvatsapītavasanaṃ smitasundarāsyam  |
krīḍantamapratibhayaṃ kamalodarāṅghriṃ   sandaśya marmasu ruṣā bhujayā cachāda  || 10.16.009 ||*
taṃ nāgabhogaparivītamadṛṣṭaceṣṭam   ālokya tatpriyasakhāḥ paśupā bhṛśārtāḥ  |
kṛṣṇe'rpitātmasuhṛdarthakalatrakāmā   duḥkhānuśokabhayamūḍhadhiyo nipetuḥ  || 10.16.010 ||*
gāvo vṛṣā vatsataryaḥ krandamānāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ  |
kṛṣṇe nyastekṣaṇā bhītā rudantya iva tasthire  || 10.16.011 ||
atha vraje mahotpātāstrividhā hyatidāruṇāḥ  |
utpeturbhuvi divyātmanyāsannabhayaśaṃsinaḥ  || 10.16.012 ||
tānālakṣya bhayodvignā gopā nandapurogamāḥ  |
vinā rāmeṇa gāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ jñātvā cārayituṃ gatam  || 10.16.013 ||
tairdurnimittairnidhanaṃ matvā prāptamatadvidaḥ  |
tatprāṇāstanmanaskāste duḥkhaśokabhayāturāḥ  || 10.16.014 ||
ābālavṛddhavanitāḥ sarve'ṅga paśuvṛttayaḥ  |
nirjagmurgokulāddīnāḥ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ  || 10.16.015 ||
tāṃstathā kātarān vīkṣya bhagavānmādhavo balaḥ  |
prahasya kiñcinnovāca prabhāvajño'nujasya saḥ  || 10.16.016 ||
te'nveṣamāṇā dayitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sūcitayā padaiḥ  |
bhagavallakṣaṇairjagmuḥ padavyā yamunātaṭam  || 10.16.017 ||
te tatra tatrābjayavāṅkuśāśani dhvajopapannāni padāni viśpateḥ  |
mārge gavāmanyapadāntarāntare nirīkṣamāṇā yayuraṅga satvarāḥ  || 10.16.018 ||
antarhrade bhujagabhogaparītamārāt  kṛṣṇaṃ nirīhamupalabhya jalāśayānte  |
gopāṃśca mūḍhadhiṣaṇān paritaḥ paśūṃśca   saṅkrandataḥ paramakaśmalamāpurārtāḥ  || 10.16.019 ||*
gopyo'nuraktamanaso bhagavatyanante   tatsauhṛdasmitavilokagiraḥ smarantyaḥ  |
graste'hinā priyatame bhṛśaduḥkhataptāḥ   śūnyaṃ priyavyatihṛtaṃ dadṛśustrilokam  || 10.16.020 ||*
tāḥ kṛṣṇamātaramapatyamanupraviṣṭāṃ   tulyavyathāḥ samanugṛhya śucaḥ sravantyaḥ  |
tāstā vrajapriyakathāḥ kathayantya āsan   kṛṣṇānane'rpitadṛśo mṛtakapratīkāḥ  || 10.16.021 ||*
kṛṣṇaprāṇānnirviśato nandādīn vīkṣya taṃ hradam  |
pratyaṣedhatsa bhagavān rāmaḥ kṛṣṇānubhāvavit || 10.16.022 ||
itthaṃ svagokulamananyagatiṃ nirīkṣya   sastrīkumāramatiduḥkhitamātmahetoḥ  |
ājñāya martyapadavīmanuvartamānaḥ   sthitvā muhūrtamudatiṣṭhaduraṅgabandhāt || 10.16.023 ||*
tatprathyamānavapuṣā vyathitātmabhogas  tyaktvonnamayya kupitaḥ svaphaṇān bhujaṅgaḥ  |
tasthau śvasañchvasanarandhraviṣāmbarīṣa   stabdhekṣaṇolmukamukho harimīkṣamāṇaḥ  || 10.16.024 ||*
taṃ jihvayā dviśikhayā parilelihānaṃ   dve sṛkvaṇī hyatikarālaviṣāgnidṛṣṭim  |
krīḍannamuṃ parisasāra yathā khagendro   babhrāma so'pyavasaraṃ prasamīkṣamāṇaḥ  || 10.16.025 ||*
evaṃ paribhramahataujasamunnatāṃsam   ānamya tatpṛthuśiraḥsvadhirūḍha ādyaḥ  |
tanmūrdharatnanikarasparśātitāmra   pādāmbujo'khilakalādigururnanarta  || 10.16.026 ||*
taṃ nartumudyatamavekṣya tadā tadīya   gandharvasiddhamunicāraṇadevavadhvaḥ  |
prītyā mṛdaṅgapaṇavānakavādyagīta   puṣpopahāranutibhiḥ sahasopaseduḥ  || 10.16.027 ||*
yadyacchiro na namate'ṅga śataikaśīrṣṇas  tattanmamarda kharadaṇḍadharo'ṅghripātaiḥ  |
kṣīṇāyuṣo bhramata ulbaṇamāsyato'sṛṅ  nasto vaman paramakaśmalamāpa nāgaḥ  || 10.16.028 ||*
tasyākṣibhirgaralamudvamataḥ śiraḥsu   yadyatsamunnamati niḥśvasato ruṣoccaiḥ  |
nṛtyan padānunamayan damayāṃ babhūva   puṣpaiḥ prapūjita iveha pumān purāṇaḥ  || 10.16.029 ||*
taccitratāṇḍavavirugnaphaṇāsahasro   raktaṃ mukhairuru vamannṛpa bhagnagātraḥ  |
smṛtvā carācaraguruṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ   nārāyaṇaṃ tamaraṇaṃ manasā jagāma  || 10.16.030 ||*
kṛṣṇasya garbhajagato'tibharāvasannaṃ   pārṣṇiprahāraparirugnaphaṇātapatram  |
dṛṣṭvāhimādyamupaseduramuṣya patnya   ārtāḥ ślathadvasanabhūṣaṇakeśabandhāḥ  || 10.16.031 ||*
tāstaṃ suvignamanaso'tha puraskṛtārbhāḥ   kāyaṃ nidhāya bhuvi bhūtapatiṃ praṇemuḥ  |
sādhvyaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ śamalasya bhartur  mokṣepsavaḥ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ  || 10.16.032 ||*
10.16.033|0 nāgapatnya ūcuḥ
nyāyyo hi daṇḍaḥ kṛtakilbiṣe'smiṃs  tavāvatāraḥ khalanigrahāya  |
ripoḥ sutānāmapi tulyadṛṣṭir  dhatse damaṃ phalamevānuśaṃsan  || 10.16.033 ||*
anugraho'yaṃ bhavataḥ kṛto hi no daṇḍo'satāṃ te khalu kalmaṣāpahaḥ  |
yaddandaśūkatvamamuṣya dehinaḥ krodho'pi te'nugraha eva sammataḥ  || 10.16.034 ||
tapaḥ sutaptaṃ kimanena pūrvaṃ nirastamānena ca mānadena  |
dharmo'tha vā sarvajanānukampayā yato bhavāṃstuṣyati sarvajīvaḥ  || 10.16.035 ||
kasyānubhāvo'sya na deva vidmahe tavāṅghrireṇusparaśādhikāraḥ  |
yadvāñchayā śrīrlalanācarattapo vihāya kāmān suciraṃ dhṛtavratā  || 10.16.036 ||
na nākapṛṣṭhaṃ na ca sārvabhaumaṃ   na pārameṣṭhyaṃ na rasādhipatyam  |
na yogasiddhīrapunarbhavaṃ vā   vāñchanti yatpādarajaḥprapannāḥ  || 10.16.037 ||*
tadeṣa nāthāpa durāpamanyaistamojaniḥ krodhavaśo'pyahīśaḥ  |
saṃsāracakre bhramataḥ śarīriṇo yadicchataḥ syādvibhavaḥ samakṣaḥ  || 10.16.038 ||
namastubhyaṃ bhagavate puruṣāya mahātmane  |
bhūtāvāsāya bhūtāya parāya paramātmane  || 10.16.039 ||
jñānavijñānanīdhaye brahmaṇe'nantaśaktaye  |
aguṇāyāvikārāya namaste prākṛtāya ca  || 10.16.040 ||
kālāya kālanābhāya kālāvayavasākṣiṇe  |
viśvāya tadupadraṣṭre tatkartre viśvahetave  || 10.16.041 ||
bhūtamātrendriyaprāṇa manobuddhyāśayātmane  |
triguṇenābhimānena gūḍhasvātmānubhūtaye  || 10.16.042 ||
namo'nantāya sūkṣmāya kūṭasthāya vipaścite  |
nānāvādānurodhāya vācyavācakaśaktaye  || 10.16.043 ||
namaḥ pramāṇamūlāya kavaye śāstrayonaye  |
pravṛttāya nivṛttāya nigamāya namo namaḥ  || 10.16.044 ||
namaḥ kṛṣṇāya rāmāya vasudevasutāya ca  |
pradyumnāyāniruddhāya sātvatāṃ pataye namaḥ  || 10.16.045 ||
namo guṇapradīpāya guṇātmacchādanāya ca  |
guṇavṛttyupalakṣyāya guṇadraṣṭre svasaṃvide  || 10.16.046 ||
avyākṛtavihārāya sarvavyākṛtasiddhaye  |
hṛṣīkeśa namaste'stu munaye maunaśīline  || 10.16.047 ||

10.16.056|0 kāliya uvāca

10.17.002|0 śrīśuka uvāca

kṛṣṇaṃ hradādviniṣkrāntaṃ divyasraggandhavāsasam  |

rāmaścācyutamāliṅgya jahāsāsyānubhāvavit |

10.18.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
atha kṛṣṇaḥ parivṛto jñātibhirmuditātmabhiḥ  |

krīḍiṣyamāṇastatkrṣṇo bhagavān balasaṃyutaḥ  |
veṇuṃ viraṇayan gopairgodhanaiḥ saṃvṛto'viśat || 10.18.008 ||
pravālabarhastabaka sragdhātukṛtabhūṣaṇāḥ  |
rāmakṛṣṇādayo gopā nanṛturyuyudhurjaguḥ  || 10.18.009 ||
kṛṣṇasya nṛtyataḥ kecijjaguḥ kecidavādayan  |

kvacinnṛtyatsu cānyeṣu gāyakau vādakau svayam  |

paśūṃścārayatorgopaistadvane rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ  |
goparūpī pralambo'gādasurastajjihīrṣayā  || 10.18.017 ||

anvamodata tatsakhyaṃ vadhaṃ tasya vicintayan  || 10.18.018 ||

tatra cakruḥ parivṛḍhau gopā rāmajanārdanau  |

ācerurvividhāḥ krīḍā vāhyavāhakalakṣaṇāḥ  |

10.19.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca

10.19.011|0 śrīśuka uvāca
vaco niśamya kṛpaṇaṃ bandhūnāṃ bhagavān hariḥ  |

10.20.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
tayostadadbhutaṃ karma dāvāgnermokṣamātmanaḥ  |

vyakte guṇavyatikare'guṇavān puruṣo yathā  || 10.20.018 ||
na rarājoḍupaśchannaḥ svajyotsnārājitairghanaiḥ  |
ahaṃmatyā bhāsitayā svabhāsā puruṣo yathā  || 10.20.019 ||
meghāgamotsavā hṛṣṭāḥ pratyanandañchikhaṇḍinaḥ  |
gṛheṣu taptanirviṇṇā yathācyutajanāgame  || 10.20.020 ||
pītvāpaḥ pādapāḥ padbhirāsannānātmamūrtayaḥ  |
prākkṣāmāstapasā śrāntā yathā kāmānusevayā  || 10.20.021 ||
saraḥsvaśāntarodhaḥsu nyūṣuraṅgāpi sārasāḥ  |
gṛheṣvaśāntakṛtyeṣu grāmyā iva durāśayāḥ  || 10.20.022 ||
jalaughairnirabhidyanta setavo varṣatīśvare  |
pāṣaṇḍināmasadvādairvedamārgāḥ kalau yathā  || 10.20.023 ||
vyamuñcan vāyubhirnunnā bhūtebhyaścāmṛtaṃ ghanāḥ  |
yathāśiṣo viśpatayaḥ kāle kāle dvijeritāḥ  || 10.20.024 ||
evaṃ vanaṃ tadvarṣiṣṭhaṃ pakvakharjurajambumat |
gogopālairvṛto rantuṃ sabalaḥ prāviśaddhariḥ  || 10.20.025 ||
dhenavo mandagāminya ūdhobhāreṇa bhūyasā  |
yayurbhagavatāhūtā drutaṃ prītyā snutastanāḥ  || 10.20.026 ||
vanaukasaḥ pramuditā vanarājīrmadhucyutaḥ  |
jaladhārā girernādādāsannā dadṛśe guhāḥ  || 10.20.027 ||
kvacidvanaspatikroḍe guhāyāṃ cābhivarṣati  |
nirviśya bhagavān reme kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ  || 10.20.028 ||
dadhyodanaṃ samānītaṃ śilāyāṃ salilāntike  |
sambhojanīyairbubhuje gopaiḥ saṅkarṣaṇānvitaḥ  || 10.20.029 ||
śādvalopari saṃviśya carvato mīlitekṣaṇān  |
tṛptān vṛṣān vatsatarān gāśca svodhobharaśramāḥ  || 10.20.030 ||
prāvṛṭśriyaṃ ca tāṃ vīkṣya sarvakālasukhāvahām  |
bhagavān pūjayāṃ cakre ātmaśaktyupabṛṃhitām  || 10.20.031 ||
evaṃ nivasatostasmin rāmakeśavayorvraje  |
śaratsamabhavadvyabhrā svacchāmbvaparuṣānilā  || 10.20.032 ||
śaradā nīrajotpattyā nīrāṇi prakṛtiṃ yayuḥ  |
bhraṣṭānāmiva cetāṃsi punaryoganiṣevayā  || 10.20.033 ||
vyomno'bbhraṃ bhūtaśābalyaṃ bhuvaḥ paṅkamapāṃ malam  |
śarajjahārāśramiṇāṃ kṛṣṇe bhaktiryathāśubham  || 10.20.034 ||
sarvasvaṃ jaladā hitvā virejuḥ śubhravarcasaḥ  |
yathā tyaktaiṣaṇāḥ śāntā munayo muktakilbiṣāḥ  || 10.20.035 ||
girayo mumucustoyaṃ kvacinna mumucuḥ śivam  |
yathā jñānāmṛtaṃ kāle jñānino dadate na vā  || 10.20.036 ||
naivāvidan kṣīyamāṇaṃ jalaṃ gādhajalecarāḥ  |
yathāyuranvahaṃ kṣayyaṃ narā mūḍhāḥ kuṭumbinaḥ  || 10.20.037 ||
gādhavāricarāstāpamavindañcharadarkajam  |
yathā daridraḥ kṛpaṇaḥ kuṭumbyavijitendriyaḥ  || 10.20.038 ||
śanaiḥ śanairjahuḥ paṅkaṃ sthalānyāmaṃ ca vīrudhaḥ  |
yathāhaṃmamatāṃ dhīrāḥ śarīrādiṣvanātmasu  || 10.20.039 ||
niścalāmburabhūttūṣṇīṃ samudraḥ śaradāgame  |
ātmanyuparate samyaṅmunirvyuparatāgamaḥ  || 10.20.040 ||
kedārebhyastvapo'gṛhṇan karṣakā dṛḍhasetubhiḥ  |
yathā prāṇaiḥ sravajjñānaṃ tannirodhena yoginaḥ  || 10.20.041 ||
śaradarkāṃśujāṃstāpān bhūtānāmuḍupo'harat |
dehābhimānajaṃ bodho mukundo vrajayoṣitām  || 10.20.042 ||
khamaśobhata nirmeghaṃ śaradvimalatārakam  |
sattvayuktaṃ yathā cittaṃ śabdabrahmārthadarśanam  || 10.20.043 ||
akhaṇḍamaṇḍalo vyomni rarājoḍugaṇaiḥ śaśī  |
yathā yadupatiḥ kṛṣṇo vṛṣṇicakrāvṛto bhuvi  || 10.20.044 ||
āśliṣya samaśītoṣṇaṃ prasūnavanamārutam  |
janāstāpaṃ jahurgopyo na kṛṣṇahṛtacetasaḥ  || 10.20.045 ||
gāvo mṛgāḥ khagā nāryaḥ puṣpiṇyaḥ śaradābhavan  |
anvīyamānāḥ svavṛṣaiḥ phalairīśakriyā iva  || 10.20.046 ||
udahṛṣyan vārijāni sūryotthāne kumudvinā  |
rājñā tu nirbhayā lokā yathā dasyūn vinā nṛpa  || 10.20.047 ||
puragrāmeṣvāgrayaṇairindriyaiśca mahotsavaiḥ  |
babhau bhūḥ pakvaśaṣyāḍhyā kalābhyāṃ nitarāṃ hareḥ  || 10.20.048 ||
vaṇiṅmuninṛpasnātā nirgamyārthān prapedire  |
varṣaruddhā yathā siddhāḥ svapiṇḍān kāla āgate  || 10.20.049 ||
10.21.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
itthaṃ śaratsvacchajalaṃ padmākarasugandhinā  |
nyaviśadvāyunā vātaṃ sa gogopālako'cyutaḥ  || 10.21.001 ||
kusumitavanarājiśuṣmibhṛṅga dvijakulaghuṣṭasaraḥsarinmahīdhram  |
madhupatiravagāhya cārayan gāḥ sahapaśupālabalaścukūja veṇum  || 10.21.002 ||
tadvrajastriya āśrutya veṇugītaṃ smarodayam  |
kāścitparokṣaṃ kṛṣṇasya svasakhībhyo'nvavarṇayan  || 10.21.003 ||
tadvarṇayitumārabdhāḥ smarantyaḥ kṛṣṇaceṣṭitam  |
nāśakan smaravegena vikṣiptamanaso nṛpa  || 10.21.004 ||
barhāpīḍaṃ naṭavaravapuḥ karṇayoḥ karṇikāraṃ   bibhradvāsaḥ kanakakapiśaṃ vaijayantīṃ ca mālām  |
randhrān veṇoradharasudhayāpūrayan gopavṛndair  vṛndāraṇyaṃ svapadaramaṇaṃ prāviśadgītakīrtiḥ  || 10.21.005 ||*
iti veṇuravaṃ rājan sarvabhūtamanoharam  |
śrutvā vrajastriyaḥ sarvā varṇayantyo'bhirebhire  || 10.21.006 ||
10.21.007|0 śrīgopya ūcuḥ
akṣaṇvatāṃ phalamidaṃ na paraṃ vidāmaḥ   sakhyaḥ paśūnanaviveśayatorvayasyaiḥ  |
vaktraṃ vrajeśasutayoranaveṇujuṣṭaṃ   yairvā nipītamanuraktakaṭākṣamokṣam  || 10.21.007 ||*
cūtapravālabarhastabakotpalābja mālānupṛktaparidhānavicitraveśau  |
madhye virejaturalaṃ paśupālagoṣṭhyāṃ raṅge yathā naṭavarau kvaca gāyamānau  || 10.21.008 ||
gopyaḥ kimācaradayaṃ kuśalaṃ sma veṇur  dāmodarādharasudhāmapi gopikānām  |
bhuṅkte svayaṃ yadavaśiṣṭarasaṃ hradinyo   hṛṣyattvaco'śru mumucustaravo yathāryaḥ  || 10.21.009 ||*
vṛndāvanaṃ sakhi bhuvo vitanoti kīṛtiṃ   yaddevakīsutapadāmbujalabdhalakṣmi  |
govindaveṇumanu mattamayūranṛtyaṃ   prekṣyādrisānvavaratānyasamastasattvam  || 10.21.010 ||*
dhanyāḥ sma mūḍhagatayo'pi hariṇya etā   yā nandanandanamupāttavicitraveśam  |
ākarṇya veṇuraṇitaṃ sahakṛṣṇasārāḥ   pūjāṃ dadhurviracitāṃ praṇayāvalokaiḥ  || 10.21.011 ||*
kṛṣṇaṃ nirīkṣya vanitotsavarūpaśīlaṃ   śrutvā ca tatkvaṇitaveṇuviviktagītam  |
devyo vimānagatayaḥ smaranunnasārā   bhraśyatprasūnakabarā mumuhurvinīvyaḥ  || 10.21.012 ||*
gāvaśca kṛṣṇamukhanirgataveṇugīta   pīyūṣamuttabhitakarṇapuṭaiḥ pibantyaḥ  |
śāvāḥ snutastanapayaḥkavalāḥ sma tasthur  govindamātmani dṛśāśrukalāḥ spṛśantyaḥ  || 10.21.013 ||*
prāyo batāmba vihagā munayo vane'smin   kṛṣṇekṣitaṃ taduditaṃ kalaveṇugītam  |
āruhya ye drumabhujān rucirapravālān   śṛṇvanti mīlitadṛśo vigatānyavācaḥ  || 10.21.014 ||*
nadyastadā tadupadhārya mukundagītam   āvartalakṣitamanobhavabhagnavegāḥ  |
āliṅganasthagitamūrmibhujairmurārer  gṛhṇanti pādayugalaṃ kamalopahārāḥ  || 10.21.015 ||*
dṛṣṭvātape vrajapaśūn saha rāmagopaiḥ   sañcārayantamanu veṇumudīrayantam  |
premapravṛddha uditaḥ kusumāvalībhiḥ   sakhyurvyadhātsvavapuṣāmbuda ātapatram  || 10.21.016 ||*
pūrṇāḥ pulindya urugāyapadābjarāga   śrīkuṅkumena dayitāstanamaṇḍitena  |
taddarśanasmararujastṛṇarūṣitena   limpantya ānanakuceṣu jahustadādhim  || 10.21.017 ||*
hantāyamadrirabalā haridāsavaryo   yadrāmakṛṣṇacaraṇasparaśapramodaḥ  |
mānaṃ tanoti sahagogaṇayostayoryat  pānīyasūyavasakandarakandamūlaiḥ  || 10.21.018 ||*
gā gopakairanuvanaṃ nayatorudāra   veṇusvanaiḥ kalapadaistanubhṛtsu sakhyaḥ  |
aspandanaṃ gatimatāṃ pulakastaruṇāṃ   niryogapāśakṛtalakṣaṇayorvicitram  || 10.21.019 ||*
evaṃvidhā bhagavato yā vṛndāvanacāriṇaḥ  |
varṇayantyo mitho gopyaḥ krīḍāstanmayatāṃ yayuḥ  || 10.21.020 ||
10.22.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
hemante prathame māsi nandavrajakamārikāḥ  |
cerurhaviṣyaṃ bhuñjānāḥ kātyāyanyarcanavratam  || 10.22.001 ||
āplutyāmbhasi kālindyā jalānte codite'ruṇe  |
kṛtvā pratikṛtiṃ devīmānarcurnṛpa saikatīm  || 10.22.002 ||
gandhairmālyaiḥ surabhibhirbalibhirdhūpadīpakaiḥ  |
uccāvacaiścopahāraiḥ pravālaphalataṇḍulaiḥ  || 10.22.003 ||
kātyāyani mahāmāye mahāyoginyadhīśvari  |
nandagopasutaṃ devi patiṃ me kuru te namaḥ  |
iti mantraṃ japantyastāḥ pūjāṃ cakruḥ kamārikāḥ  || 10.22.004 ||
evaṃ māsaṃ vrataṃ ceruḥ kumāryaḥ kṛṣṇacetasaḥ  |
bhadrakālīṃ samānarcurbhūyānnandasutaḥ patiḥ  || 10.22.005 ||
ūṣasyutthāya gotraiḥ svairanyonyābaddhabāhavaḥ  |
kṛṣṇamuccairjaguryāntyaḥ kālindyāṃ snātumanvaham  || 10.22.006 ||
nadyāḥ kadācidāgatya tīre nikṣipya pūrvavat |
vāsāṃsi kṛṣṇaṃ gāyantyo vijahruḥ salile mudā  || 10.22.007 ||
bhagavāṃstadabhipretya kṛṣno yogeśvareśvaraḥ  |
vayasyairāvṛtastatra gatastatkarmasiddhaye  || 10.22.008 ||
tāsāṃ vāsāṃsyupādāya nīpamāruhya satvaraḥ  |
hasadbhiḥ prahasan bālaiḥ parihāsamuvāca ha  || 10.22.009 ||
atrāgatyābalāḥ kāmaṃ svaṃ svaṃ vāsaḥ pragṛhyatām  |
satyaṃ bravāṇi no narma yadyūyaṃ vratakarśitāḥ  || 10.22.010 ||
na mayoditapūrvaṃ vā anṛtaṃ tadime viduḥ  |
ekaikaśaḥ pratīcchadhvaṃ sahaiveti sumadhyamāḥ  || 10.22.011 ||
tasya tatkṣvelitaṃ dṛṣṭvā gopyaḥ premapariplutāḥ  |
vrīḍitāḥ prekṣya cānyonyaṃ jātahāsā na niryayuḥ  || 10.22.012 ||
evaṃ bruvati govinde narmaṇākṣiptacetasaḥ  |
ākaṇṭhamagnāḥ śītode vepamānāstamabruvan  || 10.22.013 ||
mānayaṃ bhoḥ kṛthāstvāṃ tu nandagopasutaṃ priyam  |
jānīmo'ṅga vrajaślāghyaṃ dehi vāsāṃsi vepitāḥ  || 10.22.014 ||
śyāmasundara te dāsyaḥ karavāma tavoditam  |
dehi vāsāṃsi dharmajña no cedrājñe bruvāma he  || 10.22.015 ||
10.22.016|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
bhavatyo yadi me dāsyo mayoktaṃ vā kariṣyatha  |
atrāgatya svavāsāṃsi pratīcchata śucismitāḥ  |
no cennāhaṃ pradāsye kiṃ kruddho rājā kariṣyati  || 10.22.016 ||
tato jalāśayātsarvā dārikāḥ śītavepitāḥ  |
pāṇibhyāṃ yonimācchādya protteruḥ śītakarśitāḥ  || 10.22.017 ||
bhagavānāhatā vīkṣya śuddha bhāvaprasāditaḥ  |
skandhe nidhāya vāsāṃsi prītaḥ provāca sasmitam  || 10.22.018 ||
yūyaṃ vivastrā yadapo dhṛtavratā vyagāhataitattadu devahelanam  |
baddhvāñjaliṃ mūrdhnyapanuttaye'ṃhasaḥ kṛtvā namo'dhovasanaṃ pragṛhyatām  || 10.22.019 ||
ityacyutenābhihitaṃ vrajābalā matvā vivastrāplavanaṃ vratacyutim  |
tatpūrtikāmāstadaśeṣakarmaṇāṃ sākṣātkṛtaṃ nemuravadyamṛgyataḥ  || 10.22.020 ||
tāstathāvanatā dṛṣṭvā bhagavān devakīsutaḥ  |
vāsāṃsi tābhyaḥ prāyacchatkaruṇastena toṣitaḥ  || 10.22.021 ||
dṛḍhaṃ pralabdhāstrapayā ca hāpitāḥ   prastobhitāḥ krīḍanavacca kāritāḥ  |
vastrāṇi caivāpahṛtānyathāpyamuṃ   tā nābhyasūyan priyasaṅganirvṛtāḥ  || 10.22.022 ||*
paridhāya svavāsāṃsi preṣṭhasaṅgamasajjitāḥ  |
gṛhītacittā no celustasmin lajjāyitekṣaṇāḥ  || 10.22.023 ||
tāsāṃ vijñāya bhagavān svapādasparśakāmyayā  |
dhṛtavratānāṃ saṅkalpamāha dāmodaro'balāḥ  || 10.22.024 ||
saṅkalpo viditaḥ sādhvyo bhavatīnāṃ madarcanam  |
mayānumoditaḥ so'sau satyo bhavitumarhati  || 10.22.025 ||
na mayyāveśitadhiyāṃ kāmaḥ kāmāya kalpate  |
bharjitā kvathitā dhānāḥ prāyo bījāya neśate  || 10.22.026 ||
yātābalā vrajaṃ siddhā mayemā raṃsyathā kṣapāḥ  |
yaduddiśya vratamidaṃ cerurāryārcanaṃ satīḥ  || 10.22.027 ||
10.22.028|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ityādiṣṭā bhagavatā labdhakāmāḥ kumārikāḥ  |
dhyāyantyastatpadāmbhojaṃ kṛcchrānnirviviśurvrajam  || 10.22.028 ||
atha gopaiḥ parivṛto bhagavān devakīsutaḥ  |
vṛndāvanādgato dūraṃ cārayan gāḥ sahāgrajaḥ  || 10.22.029 ||
nidaghārkātape tigme chāyābhiḥ svābhirātmanaḥ  |
ātapatrāyitān vīkṣya drumānāha vrajaukasaḥ  || 10.22.030 ||
he stokakṛṣṇa he aṃśo śrīdāman subalārjuna  |
viśāla vṛṣabhaujasvin devaprastha varūthapa  || 10.22.031 ||
paśyataitānmahābhāgān parārthaikāntajīvitān  |
vātavarṣātapahimān sahanto vārayanti naḥ  || 10.22.032 ||
aho eṣāṃ varaṃ janma sarva prāṇyupajīvanam  |
sujanasyeva yeṣāṃ vai vimukhā yānti nārthinaḥ  || 10.22.033 ||
patrapuṣpaphalacchāyā mūlavalkaladārubhiḥ  |
gandhaniryāsabhasmāsthi tokmaiḥ kāmān vitanvate  || 10.22.034 ||
etāvajjanmasāphalyaṃ dehināmiha dehiṣu  |
prāṇairarthairdhiyā vācā śreyaācaraṇaṃ sadā  || 10.22.035 ||
iti pravālastabaka phalapuṣpadalotkaraiḥ  |
tarūṇāṃ namraśākhānāṃ madhyato yamunāṃ gataḥ  || 10.22.036 ||
tatra gāḥ pāyayitvāpaḥ sumṛṣṭāḥ śītalāḥ śivāḥ  |
tato nṛpa svayaṃ gopāḥ kāmaṃ svādu papurjalam  || 10.22.037 ||
tasyā upavane kāmaṃ cārayantaḥ paśūnnṛpa  |
kṛṣṇarāmāvupāgamya kṣudhārtā idamabravan  || 10.22.038 ||
10.23.001|0 śrīgopa ūcuḥ
rāma rāma mahābāho kṛṣṇa duṣṭanibarhaṇa  |
eṣā vai bādhate kṣunnastacchāntiṃ kartumarhathaḥ  || 10.23.001 ||
10.23.002|0 śrīśuka uvāca
iti vijñāpito gopairbhagavān devakīsutaḥ  |
bhaktāyā viprabhāryāyāḥ prasīdannidamabravīt || 10.23.002 ||
prayāta devayajanaṃ brāhmaṇā brahmavādinaḥ  |
satramāṅgirasaṃ nāma hyāsate svargakāmyayā  || 10.23.003 ||
tatra gatvaudanaṃ gopā yācatāsmadvisarjitāḥ  |
kīrtayanto bhagavata āryasya mama cābhidhām  || 10.23.004 ||
ityādiṣṭā bhagavatā gatvā yācanta te tathā  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭā viprān daṇḍavatpatitā bhuvi  || 10.23.005 ||
he bhūmidevāḥ śṛṇuta kṛṣṇasyādeśakāriṇaḥ  |
prāptāñjānīta bhadraṃ vo gopānno rāmacoditān  || 10.23.006 ||
gāścārayantāvavidūra odanaṃ rāmācyutau vo laṣato bubhukṣitau  |
tayordvijā odanamarthinoryadi śraddhā ca vo yacchata dharmavittamāḥ  || 10.23.007 ||
dīkṣāyāḥ paśusaṃsthāyāḥ sautrāmaṇyāśca sattamāḥ  |
anyatra dīkṣitasyāpi nānnamaśnan hi duṣyati  || 10.23.008 ||
iti te bhagavadyācñāṃ śṛṇvanto'pi na śuśruvuḥ  |
kṣudrāśā bhūrikarmāṇo bāliśā vṛddhamāninaḥ  || 10.23.009 ||
deśaḥ kālaḥ pṛthagdravyaṃ mantratantrartvijo'gnayaḥ  |
devatā yajamānaśca kraturdharmaśca yanmayaḥ  || 10.23.010 ||
taṃ brahma paramaṃ sākṣādbhagavantamadhokṣajam  |
manuṣyadṛṣṭyā duṣprajñā martyātmāno na menire  || 10.23.011 ||
na te yadomiti procurna neti ca parantapa  |
gopā nirāśāḥ pratyetya tathocuḥ kṛṣṇarāmayoḥ  || 10.23.012 ||
tadupākarṇya bhagavān prahasya jagadīśvaraḥ  |
vyājahāra punargopān darśayan laukikīṃ gatim  || 10.23.013 ||
māṃ jñāpayata patnībhyaḥ sasaṅkarṣaṇamāgatam  |
dāsyanti kāmamannaṃ vaḥ snigdhā mayyuṣitā dhiyā  || 10.23.014 ||
gatvātha patnīśālāyāṃ dṛṣṭvāsīnāḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ  |
natvā dvijasatīrgopāḥ praśritā idamabruvan  || 10.23.015 ||
namo vo viprapatnībhyo nibodhata vacāṃsi naḥ  |
ito'vidūre caratā kṛṣṇeneheṣitā vayam  || 10.23.016 ||
gāścārayan sa gopālaiḥ sarāmo dūramāgataḥ  |
bubhukṣitasya tasyānnaṃ sānugasya pradīyatām  || 10.23.017 ||
śrutvācyutamupāyātaṃ nityaṃ taddarśanotsukāḥ  |
tatkathākṣiptamanaso babhūvurjātasambhramāḥ  || 10.23.018 ||
caturvidhaṃ bahuguṇamannamādāya bhājanaiḥ  |
abhisasruḥ priyaṃ sarvāḥ samudramiva nimnagāḥ  || 10.23.019 ||
niṣidhyamānāḥ patibhirbhrātṛbhirbandhubhiḥ sutaiḥ  |
bhagavatyuttamaśloke dīrghaśruta dhṛtāśayāḥ  || 10.23.020 ||
yamunopavane'śoka navapallavamaṇḍite  |
vicarantaṃ vṛtaṃ gopaiḥ sāgrajaṃ dadṛśuḥ striyaḥ  || 10.23.021 ||
śyāmaṃ hiraṇyaparidhiṃ vanamālyabarha   dhātupravālanaṭaveṣamanavratāṃse  |
vinyastahastamitareṇa dhunānamabjaṃ   karṇotpalālakakapolamukhābjahāsam  || 10.23.022 ||*
prāyaḥśrutapriyatamodayakarṇapūrair  yasminnimagnamanasastamathākṣirandraiḥ  |
antaḥ praveśya suciraṃ parirabhya tāpaṃ   prājñaṃ yathābhimatayo vijahurnarendra  || 10.23.023 ||*
tāstathā tyaktasarvāśāḥ prāptā ātmadidṛkṣayā  |
vijñāyākhiladṛgdraṣṭā prāha prahasitānanaḥ  || 10.23.024 ||
svāgataṃ vo mahābhāgā āsyatāṃ karavāma kim  |
yanno didṛkṣayā prāptā upapannamidaṃ hi vaḥ  || 10.23.025 ||
nanvaddhā mayi kurvanti kuśalāḥ svārthadarśinaḥ  |
ahaitukyavyavahitāṃ bhaktimātmapriye yathā  || 10.23.026 ||
prāṇabuddhimanaḥsvātma dārāpatyadhanādayaḥ  |
yatsamparkātpriyā āsaṃstataḥ ko nvaparaḥ priyaḥ  || 10.23.027 ||
tadyāta devayajanaṃ patayo vo dvijātayaḥ  |
svasatraṃ pārayiṣyanti yuṣmābhirgṛhamedhinaḥ  || 10.23.028 ||
10.23.029|0 śrīpatnya ūcuḥ
maivaṃ vibho'rhati bhavān gadituṃ nrśaṃsaṃ   satyaṃ kuruṣva nigamaṃ tava padamūlam  |
prāptā vayaṃ tulasidāma padāvasṛṣṭaṃ   keśairnivoḍhumatilaṅghya samastabandhūn  || 10.23.029 ||*
gṛhṇanti no na patayaḥ pitarau sutā vā   na bhrātṛbandhusuhṛdaḥ kuta eva cānye  |
tasmādbhavatprapadayoḥ patitātmanāṃ no   nānyā bhavedgatirarindama tadvidhehi  || 10.23.030 ||*
10.23.031|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
patayo nābhyasūyeran pitṛbhrātṛsutādayaḥ  |

na prītaye'nurāgāya hyaṅgasaṅgo nṛṇāmiha  |
tanmano mayi yuñjānā acirānmāmavāpsyatha  || 10.23.032 ||
śravaṇāddarśanāddhyānānmayi bhāvo'nukīrtanāt |
na tathā sannikarṣeṇa pratiyāta tato gṛhān  || 10.23.033 ||
10.23.034|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ityuktā dvijapatnyastā yajñavāṭaṃ punargatāḥ  |
te cānasūyavastābhiḥ strībhiḥ satramapārayan  || 10.23.034 ||
tatraikā vidhṛtā bhartrā bhagavantaṃ yathāśrutam  |
hṛḍopaguhya vijahau dehaṃ karmānubandhanam  || 10.23.035 ||
bhagavānapi govindastenaivānnena gopakān  |
caturvidhenāśayitvā svayaṃ ca bubhuje prabhuḥ  || 10.23.036 ||
evaṃ līlānaravapurnrlokamanuśīlayan  |
reme gogopagopīnāṃ ramayan rūpavākkṛtaiḥ  || 10.23.037 ||
athānusmṛtya viprāste anvatapyan kṛtāgasaḥ  |

dṛṣṭvā strīṇāṃ bhagavati kṛṣṇe bhaktimalaukikīm  |

dhigjanma nastrivṛdyattaddhigvrataṃ dhigbahujñatām  |

nūnaṃ bhagavato māyā yogināmapi mohinī  |
yadvayaṃ guravo nṛṇāṃ svārthe muhyāmahe dvijāḥ  || 10.23.041 ||
aho paśyata nārīṇāmapi kṛṣṇe jagadgurau  |

nāsāṃ dvijātisaṃskāro na nivāso gurāvapi  |
na tapo nātmamīmāṃsā na śaucaṃ na kriyāḥ śubhāḥ  || 10.23.043 ||
tathāpi hyuttamaḥśloke kṛṣṇe yogeśvareśvare  |
bhaktirdṛḍhā na cāsmākaṃ saṃskārādimatāmapi  || 10.23.044 ||
nanu svārthavimūḍhānāṃ pramattānāṃ gṛhehayā  |
aho naḥ smārayāmāsa gopavākyaiḥ satāṃ gatiḥ  || 10.23.045 ||
anyathā pūrṇakāmasya kaivalyādyaśiṣāṃ pateḥ  |
īśitavyaiḥ kimasmābhirīśasyaitadviḍambanam  || 10.23.046 ||
hitvānyān bhajate yaṃ śrīḥ pādasparśāśayāsakṛt |
svātmadoṣāpavargeṇa tadyācñā janamohinī  || 10.23.047 ||
deśaḥ kālaḥ pṛthagdravyaṃ mantratantrartvijo'gnayaḥ  |
devatā yajamānaśca kraturdharmaśca yanmayaḥ  || 10.23.048 ||
sa eva bhagavān sākṣādviṣṇuryogeśvareśvaraḥ  |
jāto yaduṣvityāśṛṇma hyapi mūḍhā na vidmahe  || 10.23.049 ||
tasmai namo bhagavate kṛṣṇāyākuṇṭhamedhase  |
yanmāyāmohitadhiyo bhramāmaḥ karmavartmasu  || 10.23.050 ||
sa vai na ādyaḥ puruṣaḥ svamāyāmohitātmanām  |
avijñatānubhāvānāṃ kṣantumarhatyatikramam  || 10.23.051 ||
iti svāghamanusmṛtya kṛṣṇe te kṛtahelanāḥ  |
didṛkṣavo vrajamatha kaṃsādbhītā na cācalan  || 10.23.052 ||
10.24.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
bhagavānapi tatraiva baladevena saṃyutaḥ  |
apaśyannivasan gopānindrayāgakṛtodyamān  || 10.24.001 ||
tadabhijño'pi bhagavān sarvātmā sarvadarśanaḥ  |
praśrayāvanato'pṛcchadvṛddhānnandapurogamān  || 10.24.002 ||
kathyatāṃ me pitaḥ ko'yaṃ sambhramo va upāgataḥ  |
kiṃ phalaṃ kasya voddeśaḥ kena vā sādhyate makhaḥ  || 10.24.003 ||
etadbrūhi mahān kāmo mahyaṃ śuśrūṣave pitaḥ  |
na hi gopyaṃ hi sadhūnāṃ kṛtyaṃ sarvātmanāmiha  || 10.24.004 ||
astyasvaparadṛṣṭīnāmamitrodāstavidviṣām  |
udāsīno'rivadvarjya ātmavatsuhṛducyate  || 10.24.005 ||

tatra tāvatkriyāyogo bhavatāṃ kiṃ vicāritaḥ  |
atha vā laukikastanme pṛcchataḥ sādhu bhaṇyatām  || 10.24.007 ||
10.24.008|0 śrīnanda uvāca
parjanyo bhagavānindro meghāstasyātmamūrtayaḥ  |
te'bhivarṣanti bhūtānāṃ prīṇanaṃ jīvanaṃ payaḥ  || 10.24.008 ||
taṃ tāta vayamanye ca vārmucāṃ patimīśvaram  |
dravyaistadretasā siddhairyajante kratubhirnarāḥ  || 10.24.009 ||
taccheṣeṇopajīvanti trivargaphalahetave  |
puṃsāṃ puruṣakārāṇāṃ parjanyaḥ phalabhāvanaḥ  || 10.24.010 ||
ya enaṃ visṛjeddharmaṃ paramparyāgataṃ naraḥ  |
kāmāddveṣādbhayāllobhātsa vai nāpnoti śobhanam  || 10.24.011 ||
10.24.012|0 śrīśuka uvāca
vaco niśamya nandasya tathānyeṣāṃ vrajaukasām  |
indrāya manyuṃ janayan pitaraṃ prāha keśavaḥ  || 10.24.012 ||
10.24.013|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
karmaṇā jāyate jantuḥ karmaṇaiva pralīyate  |
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ kṣemaṃ karmaṇaivābhipadyate  || 10.24.013 ||
asti cedīśvaraḥ kaścitphalarūpyanyakarmaṇām  |
kartāraṃ bhajate so'pi na hyakartuḥ prabhurhi saḥ  || 10.24.014 ||
kimindreṇeha bhūtānāṃ svasvakarmānuvartinām  |
anīśenānyathā kartuṃ svabhāvavihitaṃ nṛṇām  || 10.24.015 ||
svabhāvatantro hi janaḥ svabhāvamanuvartate  |
svabhāvasthamidaṃ sarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam  || 10.24.016 ||
dehānuccāvacāñjantuḥ prāpyotsṛjati karmaṇā  |
śatrurmitramudāsīnaḥ karmaiva gururīśvaraḥ  || 10.24.017 ||
tasmātsampūjayetkarma svabhāvasthaḥ svakarmakṛt |
anjasā yena varteta tadevāsya hi daivatam  || 10.24.018 ||
ājīvyaikataraṃ bhāvaṃ yastvanyamupajīvati  |
na tasmādvindate kṣemaṃ jārānnāryasatī yathā  || 10.24.019 ||
varteta brahmaṇā vipro rājanyo rakṣayā bhuvaḥ  |
vaiśyastu vārtayā jīvecchūdrastu dvijasevayā  || 10.24.020 ||
kṛṣivāṇijyagorakṣā kusīdaṃ tūryamucyate  |
vārtā caturvidhā tatra vayaṃ govṛttayo'niśam  || 10.24.021 ||
sattvaṃ rajastama iti sthityutpattyantahetavaḥ  |
rajasotpadyate viśvamanyonyaṃ vividhaṃ jagat || 10.24.022 ||
rajasā coditā meghā varṣantyambūni sarvataḥ  |
prajāstaireva sidhyanti mahendraḥ kiṃ kariṣyati  || 10.24.023 ||
na naḥ purojanapadā na grāmā na gṛhā vayam  |
vanaukasastāta nityaṃ vanaśailanivāsinaḥ  || 10.24.024 ||
tasmādgavāṃ brāhmaṇānāmadreścārabhyatāṃ makhaḥ  |
ya indrayāgasambhārāstairayaṃ sādhyatāṃ makhaḥ  || 10.24.025 ||
pacyantāṃ vividhāḥ pākāḥ sūpāntāḥ pāyasādayaḥ  |
saṃyāvāpūpaśaṣkulyaḥ sarvadohaśca gṛhyatām  || 10.24.026 ||
hūyantāmagnayaḥ samyagbrāhmaṇairbrahmavādibhiḥ  |
annaṃ bahuguṇaṃ tebhyo deyaṃ vo dhenudakṣiṇāḥ  || 10.24.027 ||
anyebhyaścāśvacāṇḍāla patitebhyo yathārhataḥ  |
yavasaṃ ca gavāṃ dattvā giraye dīyatāṃ baliḥ  || 10.24.028 ||
svalaṅkṛtā bhuktavantaḥ svanuliptāḥ suvāsasaḥ  |
pradakṣiṇāṃ ca kuruta goviprānalaparvatān  || 10.24.029 ||
etanmama mataṃ tāta kriyatāṃ yadi rocate  |
ayaṃ gobrāhmaṇādrīṇāṃ mahyaṃ ca dayito makhaḥ  || 10.24.030 ||
10.24.031|0 śrīśuka uvāca
kālātmanā bhagavatā śakradarpajighāṃsayā  |
proktaṃ niśamya nandādyāḥ sādhvagṛhṇanta tadvacaḥ  || 10.24.031 ||
tathā ca vyadadhuḥ sarvaṃ yathāha madhusūdanaḥ  |
vācayitvā svastyayanaṃ taddravyeṇa giridvijān  || 10.24.032 ||
upahṛtya balīn samyagādṛtā yavasaṃ gavām  |
godhanāni puraskṛtya giriṃ cakruḥ pradakṣiṇam  || 10.24.033 ||
anāṃsyanaḍudyuktāni te cāruhya svalaṅkṛtāḥ  |
gopyaśca kṛṣṇavīryāṇi gāyantyaḥ sadvijāśiṣaḥ  || 10.24.034 ||
kṛṣṇastvanyatamaṃ rūpaṃ gopaviśrambhaṇaṃ gataḥ  |
śailo'smīti bruvan bhūri balimādadbṛhadvapuḥ  || 10.24.035 ||
tasmai namo vrajajanaiḥ saha cakra ātmanātmane  |
aho paśyata śailo'sau rūpī no'nugrahaṃ vyadhāt || 10.24.036 ||
eṣo'vajānato martyān kāmarūpī vanaukasaḥ  |
hanti hyasmai namasyāmaḥ śarmaṇe ātmano gavām  || 10.24.037 ||
ityadrigodvijamakhaṃ vāsudevapracoditāḥ  |
yathā vidhāya te gopā sahakṛṣṇā vrajaṃ yayuḥ  || 10.24.038 ||
10.25.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
indrastadātmanaḥ pūjāṃ vijñāya vihatāṃ nṛpa  |
gopebhyaḥ kṛṣṇanāthebhyo nandādibhyaścukopa ha  || 10.25.001 ||
gaṇaṃ sāṃvartakaṃ nāma meghānāṃ cāntakārīṇām  |
indraḥ pracodayatkruddho vākyaṃ cāheśamānyuta  || 10.25.002 ||
aho śrīmadamāhātmyaṃ gopānāṃ kānanaukasām  |
kṛṣṇaṃ martyamupāśritya ye cakrurdevahelanam  || 10.25.003 ||
yathādṛḍhaiḥ karmamayaiḥ kratubhirnāmanaunibhaiḥ  |
vidyāmānvīkṣikīṃ hitvā titīrṣanti bhavārṇavam  || 10.25.004 ||
vācālaṃ bāliśaṃ stabdhamajñaṃ paṇḍitamāninam  |

eṣāṃ śriyāvaliptānāṃ kṛṣṇenādhmāpitātmanām  |
dhunuta śrīmadastambhaṃ paśūnnayata saṅkṣayam  || 10.25.006 ||
ahaṃ cairāvataṃ nāgamāruhyānuvraje vrajam  |
marudgaṇairmahāvegairnandagoṣṭhajighāṃsayā  || 10.25.007 ||
10.25.008|0 śrīśuka uvāca
itthaṃ maghavatājñaptā meghā nirmuktabandhanāḥ  |
nandagokulamāsāraiḥ pīḍayāmāsurojasā  || 10.25.008 ||
vidyotamānā vidyudbhiḥ stanantaḥ stanayitnubhiḥ  |
tīvrairmarudgaṇairnunnā vavṛṣurjalaśarkarāḥ  || 10.25.009 ||
sthūṇāsthūlā varṣadhārā muñcatsvabhreṣvabhīkṣṇaśaḥ  |
jalaughaiḥ plāvyamānā bhūrnādṛśyata natonnatam  || 10.25.010 ||
atyāsārātivātena paśavo jātavepanāḥ  |
gopā gopyaśca śītārtā govindaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ  || 10.25.011 ||
śiraḥ sutāṃśca kāyena pracchādyāsārapīḍitāḥ  |
vepamānā bhagavataḥ pādamūlamupāyayuḥ  || 10.25.012 ||
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābhāga tvannāthaṃ gokulaṃ prabho  |
trātumarhasi devānnaḥ kupitādbhaktavatsala  || 10.25.013 ||
śilāvarṣātivātena hanyamānamacetanam  |
nirīkṣya bhagavānmene kupitendrakṛtaṃ hariḥ  || 10.25.014 ||
apartvatyulbaṇaṃ varṣamativātaṃ śilāmayam  |
svayāge vihate'smābhirindro nāśāya varṣati  || 10.25.015 ||
tatra pratividhiṃ samyagātmayogena sādhaye  |
lokeśamānināṃ mauḍhyāddhaniṣye śrīmadaṃ tamaḥ  || 10.25.016 ||
na hi sadbhāvayuktānāṃ surāṇāmīśavismayaḥ  |
matto'satāṃ mānabhaṅgaḥ praśamāyopakalpate  || 10.25.017 ||
tasmānmaccharaṇaṃ goṣṭhaṃ mannāthaṃ matparigraham  |
gopāye svātmayogena so'yaṃ me vrata āhitaḥ  || 10.25.018 ||
ityuktvaikena hastena kṛtvā govardhanācalam  |
dadhāra līlayā viṣṇuśchatrākamiva bālakaḥ  || 10.25.019 ||
athāha bhagavān gopān he'mba tāta vrajaukasaḥ  |
yathopajoṣaṃ viśata girigartaṃ sagodhanāḥ  || 10.25.020 ||
na trāsa iha vaḥ kāryo maddhastādrinipātanāt |
vātavarṣabhayenālaṃ tattrāṇaṃ vihitaṃ hi vaḥ  || 10.25.021 ||
tathā nirviviśurgartaṃ kṛṣṇāśvāsitamānasaḥ  |
yathāvakāśaṃ sadhanāḥ savrajāḥ sopajīvinaḥ  || 10.25.022 ||
kṣuttṛḍvyathāṃ sukhāpekṣāṃ hitvā tairvrajavāsibhiḥ  |
vīkṣyamāṇo dadhārādriṃ saptāhaṃ nācalatpadāt || 10.25.023 ||
kṛṣṇayogānubhāvaṃ taṃ niśamyendro'tivismitaḥ  |
nistambho bhraṣṭasaṅkalpaḥ svānmeghān sannyavārayat || 10.25.024 ||
khaṃ vyabhramuditādityaṃ vātavarṣaṃ ca dāruṇam  |
niśamyoparataṃ gopān govardhanadharo'bravīt || 10.25.025 ||
niryāta tyajata trāsaṃ gopāḥ sastrīdhanārbhakāḥ  |
upārataṃ vātavarṣaṃ vyudaprāyāśca nimnagāḥ  || 10.25.026 ||
tataste niryayurgopāḥ svaṃ svamādāya godhanam  |
śakaṭoḍhopakaraṇaṃ strībālasthavirāḥ śanaiḥ  || 10.25.027 ||
bhagavānapi taṃ śailaṃ svasthāne pūrvavatprabhuḥ  |
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sthāpayāmāsa līlayā  || 10.25.028 ||
taṃ premavegānnirbhṛtā vrajaukaso   yathā samīyuḥ parirambhaṇādibhiḥ  |
gopyaśca sasnehamapūjayanmudā   dadhyakṣatādbhiryuyujuḥ sadāśiṣaḥ  || 10.25.029 ||*
yaśodā rohiṇī nando rāmaśca balināṃ varaḥ  |
kṛṣṇamāliṅgya yuyujurāśiṣaḥ snehakātarāḥ  || 10.25.030 ||
divi devagaṇāḥ siddhāḥ sādhyā gandharvacāraṇāḥ  |
tuṣṭuvurmumucustuṣṭāḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi pārthiva  || 10.25.031 ||
śaṅkhadundubhayo nedurdivi devapracoditāḥ  |
jagurgandharvapatayastumburupramukhā nṛpa  || 10.25.032 ||
tato'nuraktaiḥ paśupaiḥ pariśrito rājan svagoṣṭhaṃ sabalo'vrajaddhariḥ  |
tathāvidhānyasya kṛtāni gopikā gāyantya īyurmuditā hṛdispṛśaḥ  || 10.25.033 ||
10.26.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃvidhāni karmāṇi gopāḥ kṛṣṇasya vīkṣya te  |
atadvīryavidaḥ procuḥ samabhyetya suvismitāḥ  || 10.26.001 ||
bālakasya yadetāni karmāṇyatyadbhutāni vai  |
kathamarhatyasau janma grāmyeṣvātmajugupsitam  || 10.26.002 ||
yaḥ saptahāyano bālaḥ kareṇaikena līlayā  |
kathaṃ bibhradgirivaraṃ puṣkaraṃ gajarāḍiva  || 10.26.003 ||
tokenāmīlitākṣeṇa pūtanāyā mahaujasaḥ  |
pītaḥ stanaḥ saha prāṇaiḥ kāleneva vayastanoḥ  || 10.26.004 ||
hinvato'dhaḥ śayānasya māsyasya caraṇāvudak |
ano'patadviparyastaṃ rudataḥ prapadāhatam  || 10.26.005 ||
ekahāyana āsīno hriyamāṇo vihāyasā  |
daityena yastṛṇāvartamahan kaṇṭhagrahāturam  || 10.26.006 ||
kvaciddhaiyaṅgavastainye mātrā baddha udūkhale  |
gacchannarjunayormadhye bāhubhyāṃ tāvapātayat || 10.26.007 ||
vane sañcārayan vatsān sarāmo bālakairvṛtaḥ  |
hantukāmaṃ bakaṃ dorbhyāṃ mukhato'rimapāṭayat || 10.26.008 ||
vatseṣu vatsarūpeṇa praviśantaṃ jighāṃsayā  |
hatvā nyapātayattena kapitthāni ca līlayā  || 10.26.009 ||
hatvā rāsabhadaiteyaṃ tadbandhūṃśca balānvitaḥ  |
cakre tālavanaṃ kṣemaṃ paripakvaphalānvitam  || 10.26.010 ||

nadyāḥ pulinamāviśya gopībhirhimavālukam  |
juṣṭaṃ tattaralānandi kumudāmodavāyunā  || 10.29.045 ||
bāhuprasāraparirambhakarālakoru nīvīstanālabhananarmanakhāgrapātaiḥ  |

evaṃ bhagavataḥ kṛṣṇāllabdhamānā mahātmanaḥ  |
ātmānaṃ menire strīṇāṃ māninyo hyadhikaṃ bhuvi  || 10.29.047 ||
tāsāṃ tatsaubhagamadaṃ vīkṣya mānaṃ ca keśavaḥ  |
praśamāya prasādāya tatraivāntaradhīyata  || 10.29.048 ||
10.30.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
antarhite bhagavati sahasaiva vrajāṅganāḥ  |

pṛcchatemā latā bāhūnapyāśliṣṭā vanaspateḥ  |

ityunmattavaco gopyaḥ kṛṣṇānveṣaṇakātarāḥ  |

kasyācitpūtanāyantyāḥ kṛṣṇāyantyapibatstanam  |

daityāyitvā jahārānyāmeko kṛṣṇārbhabhāvanām  |
riṅgayāmāsa kāpyaṅghrī karṣantī ghoṣaniḥsvanaiḥ  || 10.30.016 ||
kṛṣṇarāmāyite dve tu gopāyantyaśca kāścana  |

āhūya dūragā yadvatkṛṣṇastamanuvartatīm  |

kasyāñcitsvabhujaṃ nyasya calantyāhāparā nanu  |

mā bhaiṣṭa vātavarṣābhyāṃ tattrāṇaṃ vihitaṃ maya  |
ityuktvaikena hastena yatantyunnidadhe'mbaram  || 10.30.020 ||
āruhyaikā padākramya śirasyāhāparāṃ nṛpa  |
duṣṭāhe gaccha jāto'haṃ khalānāṃ nanu daṇḍakṛt || 10.30.021 ||

baddhānyayā srajā kācittanvī tatra ulūkhale  |
badhnāmi bhāṇḍabhettāraṃ haiyaṅgavamuṣaṃ tviti  |

evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pṛcchamānā vrṇdāvanalatāstarūn  |
vyacakṣata vanoddeśe padāni paramātmanaḥ  || 10.30.024 ||
padāni vyaktametāni nandasūnormahātmanaḥ  |
lakṣyante hi dhvajāmbhoja vajrāṅkuśayavādibhiḥ  || 10.30.025 ||
taistaiḥ padaistatpadavīmanvicchantyo'grato'balāḥ  |
vadhvāḥ padaiḥ supṛktāni vilokyārtāḥ samabruvan  || 10.30.026 ||
kasyāḥ padāni caitāni yātāyā nandasūnunā  |
aṃsanyastaprakoṣṭhāyāḥ kareṇoḥ kariṇā yathā  || 10.30.027 ||
anayārādhito nūnaṃ bhagavān harirīśvaraḥ  |
yanno vihāya govindaḥ prīto yāmanayadrahaḥ  || 10.30.028 ||
dhanyā aho amī ālyo govindāṅghryabjareṇavaḥ  |
yān brahmeśau ramā devī dadhurmūrdhnyaghanuttaye  || 10.30.029 ||
tasyā amūni naḥ kṣobhaṃ kurvantyuccaiḥ padāni yatyaikāpahṛtya gopīnāṃ raho bhunkte'cyutādharam  |
na lakṣyante padānyatra tasyā nūnaṃ tṛṇāṅkuraiḥ khidyatsujātāṅghritalāmunninye preyasīṃ priyaḥ  || 10.30.030 ||
imānyadhikamagnāni padāni vahato vadhūm  |
gopyaḥ paśyata kṛṣṇasya bhārākrāntasya kāminaḥ  |
atrāvaropitā kāntā puṣpahetormahātmanā  || 10.30.031 ||
atra prasūnāvacayaḥ priyārthe preyasā kṛtaḥ  |
prapadākramaṇa ete paśyatāsakale pade  || 10.30.032 ||
keśaprasādhanaṃ tvatra kāminyāḥ kāminā kṛtam  |
tāni cūḍayatā kāntāmupaviṣṭamiha dhruvam  || 10.30.033 ||
reme tayā cātmarata ātmārāmo'pyakhaṇḍitaḥ  |
kāmināṃ darśayan dainyaṃ strīṇāṃ caiva durātmatām  || 10.30.034 ||
ityevaṃ darśayantyastāścerurgopyo vicetasaḥ  |
yāṃ gopīmanayatkṛṣṇo vihāyānyāḥ striyo vane  || 10.30.035 ||
sā ca mene tadātmānaṃ variṣṭhaṃ sarvayoṣitām  |
hitvā gopīḥ kāmayānā māmasau bhajate priyaḥ  || 10.30.036 ||
tato gatvā vanoddeśaṃ dṛptā keśavamabravīt |
na pāraye'haṃ calituṃ naya māṃ yatra te manaḥ  || 10.30.037 ||
evamuktaḥ priyāmāha skandha āruhyatāmiti  |
tataścāntardadhe kṛṣṇaḥ sā vadhūranvatapyata  || 10.30.038 ||
hā nātha ramaṇa preṣṭha kvāsi kvāsi mahābhuja  |

10.31.001|0 gopya ūcuḥ
jayati te'dhikaṃ janmanā vrajaḥ śrayata indirā śaśvadatra hi  |

śaradudāśaye sādhujātasatsarasijodaraśrīmuṣā dṛśā  |

na khalu gopīkānandano bhavānakhiladehināmantarātmadṛk |
vikhanasārthito viśvaguptaye sakha udeyivān sātvatāṃ kule  || 10.31.004 ||
viracitābhayaṃ vṛṣṇidhūrya te caraṇamīyuṣāṃ saṃsṛterbhayāt |

praṇatadehināṃ pāpakarṣaṇaṃ tṛṇacarānugaṃ śrīniketanam  |

madhurayā girā valguvākyayā budhamanojñayā puṣkarekṣaṇa  |
vidhikarīrimā vīra muhyatīradharasīdhunāpyāyayasva naḥ  || 10.31.008 ||
tava kathāmṛtaṃ taptajīvanaṃ kavibhirīḍitaṃ kalmaṣāpaham  |

prahasitaṃ priyapremavīkṣaṇaṃ viharaṇaṃ ca te dhyānamaṅgalam  |

calasi yadvrajāccārayan paśūnnalinasundaraṃ nātha te padam  |

dinaparikṣaye nīlakuntalairvanaruhānanaṃ bibhradāvṛtam  |

praṇatakāmadaṃ padmajārcitaṃ dharaṇimaṇḍanaṃ dhyeyamāpadi  |

suratavardhanaṃ śokanāśanaṃ svaritaveṇunā suṣṭhu cumbitam  |

aṭati yadbhavānahni kānanaṃ truṭi yugāyate tvāmapaśyatām  |

patisutānvayabhrātṛbāndhavānativilaṅghya te'ntyacyutāgatāḥ  |

rahasi saṃvidaṃ hṛcchayodayaṃ prahasitānanaṃ premavīkṣaṇam  |
