gṛhītakaṇṭhyastaddorbhyāṃ gāyantyastaṃ vijahrire  || 10.33.014 ||
karṇotpalālakaviṭaṅkakapolagharma   vaktraśriyo valayanūpuraghoṣavādyaiḥ  |
gopyaḥ samaṃ bhagavatā nanṛtuḥ svakeśa   srastasrajo bhramaragāyakarāsagoṣṭhyām  || 10.33.015 ||*
evaṃ pariṣvaṅgakarābhimarśa snigdhekṣaṇoddāmavilāsahāsaiḥ  |
reme rameśo vrajasundarībhiryathārbhakaḥ svapratibimbavibhramaḥ  || 10.33.016 ||
tadaṅgasaṅgapramudākulendriyāḥ keśān dukūlaṃ kucapaṭṭikāṃ vā  |
nāñjaḥ prativyoḍhumalaṃ vrajastriyo visrastamālābharaṇāḥ kurūdvaha  || 10.33.017 ||
kṛṣṇavikrīḍitaṃ vīkṣya mumuhuḥ khecarastriyaḥ  |
kāmārditāḥ śaśāṅkaśca sagaṇo vismito'bhavat || 10.33.018 ||
kṛtvā tāvantamātmānaṃ yāvatīrgopayoṣitaḥ  |
reme sa bhagavāṃstābhirātmārāmo'pi līlayā  || 10.33.019 ||
tāsāṃ rativihāreṇa śrāntānāṃ vadanāni saḥ  |
prāmṛjatkaruṇaḥ premṇā śantamenāṅga pāṇinā  || 10.33.020 ||
gopyaḥ sphuratpuraṭakuṇḍalakuntalatviḍ  gaṇḍaśriyā sudhitahāsanirīkṣaṇena  |
mānaṃ dadhatya ṛṣabhasya jaguḥ kṛtāni   puṇyāni tatkararuhasparśapramodāḥ  || 10.33.021 ||*
tābhiryutaḥ śramamapohitumaṅgasaṅga   ghṛṣṭasrajaḥ sa kucakuṅkumarañjitāyāḥ  |
gandharvapālibhiranudruta āviśadvāḥ   śrānto gajībhiribharāḍiva bhinnasetuḥ  || 10.33.022 ||*
so'mbhasyalaṃ yuvatibhiḥ pariṣicyamānaḥ   premṇekṣitaḥ prahasatībhiritastato'ṅga  |
vaimānikaiḥ kusumavarṣibhirīdyamāno   reme svayaṃ svaratiratra gajendralīlaḥ  || 10.33.023 ||*
tataśca kṛṣṇopavane jalasthala prasūnagandhānilajuṣṭadiktaṭe  |
cacāra bhṛṅgapramadāgaṇāvṛto yathā madacyuddviradaḥ kareṇubhiḥ  || 10.33.024 ||
evaṃ śaśāṅkāṃśuvirājitā niśāḥ sa satyakāmo'nuratābalāgaṇaḥ  |
siṣeva ātmanyavaruddhasaurataḥ sarvāḥ śaratkāvyakathārasāśrayāḥ  || 10.33.025 ||
10.33.026|0 śrīparīkṣiduvāca
saṃsthāpanāya dharmasya praśamāyetarasya ca  |
avatīrṇo hi bhagavānaṃśena jagadīśvaraḥ  || 10.33.026 ||
sa kathaṃ dharmasetūnāṃ vaktā kartābhirakṣitā  |
pratīpamācaradbrahman paradārābhimarśanam  || 10.33.027 ||
āptakāmo yadupatiḥ kṛtavān vai jugupsitam  |
kimabhiprāya etannaḥ śaṃśayaṃ chindhi suvrata  || 10.33.028 ||
10.33.029|0 śrīśuka uvāca
dharmavyatikramo dṛṣṭa īśvarāṇāṃ ca sāhasam  |
tejīyasāṃ na doṣāya vahneḥ sarvabhujo yathā  || 10.33.029 ||
naitatsamācarejjātu manasāpi hyanīśvaraḥ  |
vinaśyatyācaranmauḍhyādyathārudro'bdhijaṃ viṣam  || 10.33.030 ||
īśvarāṇāṃ vacaḥ satyaṃ tathaivācaritaṃ kvacit |
teṣāṃ yatsvavacoyuktaṃ buddhimāṃstatsamācaret || 10.33.031 ||
kuśalācaritenaiṣāmiha svārtho na vidyate  |
viparyayeṇa vānartho nirahaṅkāriṇāṃ prabho  || 10.33.032 ||
kimutākhilasattvānāṃ tiryaṅmartyadivaukasām  |
īśituśceśitavyānāṃ kuśalākuśalānvayaḥ  || 10.33.033 ||
yatpādapaṅkajaparāganiṣevatṛptā   yogaprabhāvavidhutākhilakarmabandhāḥ  |
svairaṃ caranti munayo'pi na nahyamānās  tasyecchayāttavapuṣaḥ kuta eva bandhaḥ  || 10.33.034 ||*
gopīnāṃ tatpatīnāṃ ca sarveṣāmeva dehinām  |
yo'ntaścarati so'dhyakṣaḥ krīḍaneneha dehabhāk || 10.33.035 ||
anugrahāya bhaktānāṃ mānuṣaṃ dehamāsthitaḥ  |
bhajate tādṛśīḥ krīḍa yāḥ śrutvā tatparo bhavet || 10.33.036 ||
nāsūyan khalu kṛṣṇāya mohitāstasya māyayā  |
manyamānāḥ svapārśvasthān svān svān dārān vrajaukasaḥ  || 10.33.037 ||
brahmarātra upāvṛtte vāsudevānumoditāḥ  |
anicchantyo yayurgopyaḥ svagṛhān bhagavatpriyāḥ  || 10.33.038 ||
vikrīḍitaṃ vrajavadhūbhiridaṃ ca viṣṇoḥ   śraddhānvito'nuśṛṇuyādatha varṇayedyaḥ  |
bhaktiṃ parāṃ bhagavati pratilabhya kāmaṃ   hṛdrogamāśvapahinotyacireṇa dhīraḥ  || 10.33.039 ||*
10.34.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ekadā devayātrāyāṃ gopālā jātakautukāḥ  |
anobhiranaḍudyuktaiḥ prayayuste'mbikāvanam  || 10.34.001 ||
tatra snātvā sarasvatyāṃ devaṃ paśupatiṃ vibhum  |
ānarcurarhaṇairbhaktyā devīṃ ca ṇṛpate'mbikām  || 10.34.002 ||
gāvo hiraṇyaṃ vāsāṃsi madhu madhvannamādṛtāḥ  |
brāhmaṇebhyo daduḥ sarve devo naḥ prīyatāmiti  || 10.34.003 ||
ūṣuḥ sarasvatītīre jalaṃ prāśya yatavratāḥ  |
rajanīṃ tāṃ mahābhāgā nandasunandakādayaḥ  || 10.34.004 ||
kaścinmahānahistasmin vipine'tibubhukṣitaḥ  |
yadṛcchayāgato nandaṃ śayānamurago'grasīt || 10.34.005 ||
sa cukrośāhinā grastaḥ kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahānayam  |
sarpo māṃ grasate tāta prapannaṃ parimocaya  || 10.34.006 ||
tasya cākranditaṃ śrutvā gopālāḥ sahasotthitāḥ  |
grastaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā vibhrāntāḥ sarpaṃ vivyadhurulmukaiḥ  || 10.34.007 ||
alātairdahyamāno'pi nāmuñcattamuraṅgamaḥ  |
tamaspṛśatpadābhyetya bhagavān sātvatāṃ patiḥ  || 10.34.008 ||
sa vai bhagavataḥ śrīmatpādasparśahatāśubhaḥ  |
bheje sarpavapurhitvā rūpaṃ vidyādharārcitam  || 10.34.009 ||
tamapṛcchaddhṛṣīkeśaḥ praṇataṃ samavasthitam  |
dīpyamānena vapuṣā puruṣaṃ hemamālinam  || 10.34.010 ||
ko bhavān parayā lakṣmyā rocate'dbhutadarśanaḥ  |
kathaṃ jugupsitāmetāṃ gatiṃ vā prāpito'vaśaḥ  || 10.34.011 ||
10.34.012|0 sarpa uvāca
ahaṃ vidyādharaḥ kaścitsudarśana iti śrutaḥ  |
śriyā svarūpasampattyā vimānenācaran diśaḥ  || 10.34.012 ||
ṛṣīn virūpāṅgirasaḥ prāhasaṃ rūpadarpitaḥ  |
tairimāṃ prāpito yoniṃ pralabdhaiḥ svena pāpmanā  || 10.34.013 ||
śāpo me'nugrahāyaiva kṛtastaiḥ karuṇātmabhiḥ  |
yadahaṃ lokaguruṇā padā spṛṣṭo hatāśubhaḥ  || 10.34.014 ||
taṃ tvāhaṃ bhavabhītānāṃ prapannānāṃ bhayāpaham  |
āpṛcche śāpanirmuktaḥ pādasparśādamīvahan  || 10.34.015 ||
prapanno'smi mahāyoginmahāpuruṣa satpate  |
anujānīhi māṃ deva sarvalokeśvareśvara  || 10.34.016 ||
brahmadaṇḍādvimukto'haṃ sadyaste'cyuta darśanāt |
yannāma gṛhṇannakhilān śrotṝnātmānameva ca  |
sadyaḥ punāti kiṃ bhūyastasya spṛṣṭaḥ padā hi te  || 10.34.017 ||
ityanujñāpya dāśārhaṃ parikramyābhivandya ca  |
sudarśano divaṃ yātaḥ kṛcchrānnandaśca mocitaḥ  || 10.34.018 ||
niśāmya kṛṣṇasya tadātmavaibhavaṃ   vrajaukaso vismitacetasastataḥ  |
samāpya tasminniyamaṃ punarvrajaṃ   ṇṛpāyayustatkathayanta ādṛtāḥ  || 10.34.019 ||*
kadācidatha govindo rāmaścādbhutavikramaḥ  |
vijahraturvane rātryāṃ madhyagau vrajayoṣitām  || 10.34.020 ||
upagīyamānau lalitaṃ strījanairbaddhasauhṛdaiḥ  |
svalaṅkṛtānuliptāṅgau sragvinau virajo'mbarau  || 10.34.021 ||
niśāmukhaṃ mānayantāvuditoḍupatārakam  |
mallikāgandhamattāli juṣṭaṃ kumudavāyunā  || 10.34.022 ||
jagatuḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ manaḥśravaṇamaṅgalam  |
tau kalpayantau yugapatsvaramaṇḍalamūrcchitam  || 10.34.023 ||
gopyastadgītamākarṇya mūrcchitā nāvidannṛpa  |
sraṃsaddukūlamātmānaṃ srastakeśasrajaṃ tataḥ  || 10.34.024 ||
evaṃ vikrīḍatoḥ svairaṃ gāyatoḥ sampramattavat |
śaṅkhacūḍa iti khyāto dhanadānucaro'bhyagāt || 10.34.025 ||
tayornirīkṣato rājaṃstannāthaṃ pramadājanam  |
krośantaṃ kālayāmāsa diśyudīcyāmaśaṅkitaḥ  || 10.34.026 ||
krośantaṃ kṛṣṇa rāmeti vilokya svaparigraham  |
yathā gā dasyunā grastā bhrātarāvanvadhāvatām  || 10.34.027 ||
mā bhaiṣṭetyabhayārāvau śālahastau tarasvinau  |
āsedatustaṃ tarasā tvaritaṃ guhyakādhamam  || 10.34.028 ||
sa vīkṣya tāvanuprāptau kālamṛtyū ivodvijan  |
viṣṛjya strījanaṃ mūḍhaḥ prādravajjīvitecchayā  || 10.34.029 ||
tamanvadhāvadgovindo yatra yatra sa dhāvati  |
jihīrṣustacchiroratnaṃ tasthau rakṣan striyo balaḥ  || 10.34.030 ||
avidūra ivābhyetya śirastasya durātmanaḥ  |
jahāra muṣṭinaivāṅga sahacūḍamaṇiṃ vibhuḥ  || 10.34.031 ||
śaṅkhacūḍaṃ nihatyaivaṃ maṇimādāya bhāsvaram  |
agrajāyādadātprītyā paśyantīnāṃ ca yoṣitām  || 10.34.032 ||
10.35.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
gopyaḥ kṛṣṇe vanaṃ yāte tamanudrutacetasaḥ  |
kṛṣṇalīlāḥ pragāyantyo ninyurduḥkhena vāsarān  || 10.35.001 ||
10.35.002|0 śrīgopya ūcuḥ
vāmabāhukṛtavāmakapolo valgitabhruradharārpitaveṇum  |
komalāṅgulibhirāśritamārgaṃ gopya īrayati yatra mukundaḥ  || 10.35.002 ||
vyomayānavanitāḥ saha siddhairvismitāstadupadhārya salajjāḥ  |
kāmamārgaṇasamarpitacittāḥ kaśmalaṃ yayurapasmṛtanīvyaḥ  || 10.35.003 ||
hanta citramabalāḥ śṛṇutedaṃ hārahāsa urasi sthiravidyut |
nandasūnurayamārtajanānāṃ narmado yarhi kūjitaveṇuḥ  || 10.35.004 ||
vṛndaśo vrajavṛṣā mṛgagāvo veṇuvādyahṛtacetasa ārāt |
dantadaṣṭakavalā dhṛtakarṇā nidritā likhitacitramivāsan  || 10.35.005 ||
barhiṇastabakadhātupalāśairbaddhamallaparibarhaviḍambaḥ  |
karhicitsabala āli sa gopairgāḥ samāhvayati yatra mukundaḥ  || 10.35.006 ||
tarhi bhagnagatayaḥ sarito vai tatpadāmbujarajo'nilanītam  |
spṛhayatīrvayamivābahupuṇyāḥ premavepitabhujāḥ stimitāpaḥ  || 10.35.007 ||
anucaraiḥ samanuvarṇitavīrya ādipūruṣa ivācalabhūtiḥ  |
vanacaro giritaṭeṣu carantīrveṇunāhvayati gāḥ sa yadā hi  || 10.35.008 ||
vanalatāstarava ātmani viṣṇuṃ vyañjayantya iva puṣpaphalāḍhyāḥ  |
praṇatabhāraviṭapā madhudhārāḥ premahṛṣṭatanavo vavṛṣuḥ sma  || 10.35.009 ||
darśanīyatilako vanamālā divyagandhatulasīmadhumattaiḥ  |
alikulairalaghu gītāmabhīṣṭamādriyan yarhi sandhitaveṇuḥ  || 10.35.010 ||
sarasi sārasahaṃsavihaṅgāścārugītāhṛtacetasa etya  |
harimupāsata te yatacittā hanta mīlitadṛśo dhṛtamaunāḥ  || 10.35.011 ||
sahabalaḥ sragavataṃsavilāsaḥ sānuṣu kṣitibhṛto vrajadevyaḥ  |
harṣayan yarhi veṇuraveṇa jātaharṣa uparambhati viśvam  || 10.35.012 ||
mahadatikramaṇaśaṅkitacetā mandamandamanugarjati meghaḥ  |
suhṛdamabhyavarṣatsumanobhiśchāyayā ca vidadhatpratapatram  || 10.35.013 ||
vividhagopacaraṇeṣu vidagdho veṇuvādya urudhā nijaśikṣāḥ  |
tava sutaḥ sati yadādharabimbe dattaveṇuranayatsvarajātīḥ  || 10.35.014 ||
savanaśastadupadhārya sureśāḥ śakraśarvaparameṣṭhipurogāḥ  |
kavaya ānatakandharacittāḥ kaśmalaṃ yayuraniścitatattvāḥ  || 10.35.015 ||
nijapadābjadalairdhvajavajra nīrajāṅkuśavicitralalāmaiḥ  |
vrajabhuvaḥ śamayan khuratodaṃ varṣmadhuryagatirīḍitaveṇuḥ  || 10.35.016 ||
vrajati tena vayaṃ savilāsa vīkṣaṇārpitamanobhavavegāḥ  |
kujagatiṃ gamitā na vidāmaḥ kaśmalena kavaraṃ vasanaṃ vā  || 10.35.017 ||
maṇidharaḥ kvacidāgaṇayan gā mālayā dayitagandhatulasyāḥ  |
praṇayino'nucarasya kadāṃse prakṣipan bhujamagāyata yatra  || 10.35.018 ||
kvaṇitaveṇuravavañcitacittāḥ kṛṣṇamanvasata kṛṣṇagṛhiṇyaḥ  |
guṇagaṇārṇamanugatya hariṇyo gopikā iva vimuktagṛhāśāḥ  || 10.35.019 ||
kundadāmakṛtakautukaveṣo gopagodhanavṛto yamunāyām  |
nandasūnuranaghe tava vatso narmadaḥ praṇayiṇāṃ vijahāra  || 10.35.020 ||
mandavāyurupavātyanakūlaṃ mānayanmalayajasparśena  |
vandinastamupadevagaṇā ye vādyagītabalibhiḥ parivavruḥ  || 10.35.021 ||
vatsalo vrajagavāṃ yadagadhro vandyamānacaraṇaḥ pathi vṛddhaiḥ  |
kṛtsnagodhanamupohya dinānte gītaveṇuranugeḍitakīrtiḥ  || 10.35.022 ||
utsavaṃ śramarucāpi dṛśīnāmunnayan khurarajaśchuritasrak |
ditsayaiti suhṛdāsiṣa eṣa devakījaṭharabhūruḍurājaḥ  || 10.35.023 ||
madavighūrṇitalocana īṣatmānadaḥ svasuhṛdāṃ vanamālī  |
badarapāṇḍuvadano mṛdugaṇḍaṃ maṇḍayan kanakakuṇḍalalakṣmyā  || 10.35.024 ||
yadupatirdviradarājavihāro yāminīpatirivaiṣa dinānte  |
muditavaktra upayāti durantaṃ mocayan vrajagavāṃ dinatāpam  || 10.35.025 ||
10.35.026|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃ vrajastriyo rājan kṛṣṇalīlānugāyatīḥ  |
remire'haḥsu taccittāstanmanaskā mahodayāḥ  || 10.35.026 ||
10.36.001|0 śrī bādarāyaṇiruvāca
atha tarhyāgato goṣṭhamariṣṭo vṛṣabhāsuraḥ  |
mahīṃ mahākakutkāyaḥ kampayan khuravikṣatām  || 10.36.001 ||
rambhamāṇaḥ kharataraṃ padā ca vilikhanmahīm  |
udyamya pucchaṃ vaprāṇi viṣāṇāgreṇa coddharan  |
kiñcitkiñcicchakṛnmuñcanmūtrayan stabdhalocanaḥ  || 10.36.002 ||
yasya nirhrāditenāṅga niṣṭhureṇa gavāṃ nṛṇām  |
patantyakālato garbhāḥ sravanti sma bhayena vai  || 10.36.003 ||
nirviśanti ghanā yasya kakudyacalaśaṅkayā  |
taṃ tīkṣṇaśṛṅgamudvīkṣya gopyo gopāśca tatrasuḥ  || 10.36.004 ||
paśavo dudruvurbhītā rājan santyajya gokulam  |
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti te sarve govindaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ  || 10.36.005 ||
bhagavānapi tadvīkṣya gokulaṃ bhayavidrutam  |
mā bhaiṣṭeti girāśvāsya vṛṣāsuramupāhvayat || 10.36.006 ||
gopālaiḥ paśubhirmanda trāsitaiḥ kimasattama  |
mayi śāstari duṣṭānāṃ tvadvidhānāṃ durātmanām  || 10.36.007 ||
ityāsphotyācyuto'riṣṭaṃ talaśabdena kopayan  |
sakhyuraṃse bhujābhogaṃ prasāryāvasthito hariḥ  || 10.36.008 ||
so'pyevaṃ kopito'riṣṭaḥ khureṇāvanimullikhan  |
udyatpucchabhramanmeghaḥ kruddhaḥ kṛṣṇamupādravat || 10.36.009 ||
agranyastaviṣāṇāgraḥ stabdhāsṛglocano'cyutam  |
kaṭākṣipyādravattūrṇamindramukto'śaniryathā  || 10.36.010 ||
gṛhītvā śṛṅgayostaṃ vā aṣṭādaśa padāni saḥ  |
pratyapovāha bhagavān gajaḥ pratigajaṃ yathā  || 10.36.011 ||
so'paviddho bhagavatā punarutthāya satvaram  |
āpatatsvinnasarvāṅgo niḥśvasan krodhamūrcchitaḥ  || 10.36.012 ||
tamāpatantaṃ sa nigṛhya śṛṅgayoḥ padā samākramya nipātya bhūtale  |
niṣpīḍayāmāsa yathārdramambaraṃ kṛtvā viṣāṇena jaghāna so'patat || 10.36.013 ||
asṛgvamanmūtraśakṛtsamutsṛjan kṣipaṃśca pādānanavasthitekṣaṇaḥ  |
jagāma kṛcchraṃ nirṛteratha kṣayaṃ puṣpaiḥ kiranto harimīḍire surāḥ  || 10.36.014 ||
evaṃ kukudminaṃ hatvā stūyamānaḥ dvijātibhiḥ  |
viveśa goṣṭhaṃ sabalo gopīnāṃ nayanotsavaḥ  || 10.36.015 ||
ariṣṭe nihate daitye kṛṣṇenādbhutakarmaṇā  |
kaṃsāyāthāha bhagavānnārado devadarśanaḥ  || 10.36.016 ||
yaśodāyāḥ sutāṃ kanyāṃ devakyāḥ kṛṣṇameva ca  |
rāmaṃ ca rohiṇīputraṃ vasudevena bibhyatā  |
nyastau svamitre nande vai yābhyāṃ te puruṣā hatāḥ  || 10.36.017 ||
niśamya tadbhojapatiḥ kopātpracalitendriyaḥ  |
niśātamasimādatta vasudevajighāṃsayā  || 10.36.018 ||
nivārito nāradena tatsutau mṛtyumātmanaḥ  |
jñātvā lohamayaiḥ pāśairbabandha saha bhāryayā  || 10.36.019 ||
pratiyāte tu devarṣau kaṃsa ābhāṣya keśinam  |
preṣayāmāsa hanyetāṃ bhavatā rāmakeśavau  || 10.36.020 ||
tato muṣṭikacāṇūra śalatośalakādikān  |
amātyān hastipāṃścaiva samāhūyāha bhojarāṭ || 10.36.021 ||
bho bho niśamyatāmetadvīracāṇūramuṣṭikau  |
nandavraje kilāsāte sutāvānakadundubheḥ  || 10.36.022 ||
rāmakṛṣṇau tato mahyaṃ mṛtyuḥ kila nidarśitaḥ  |
bhavadbhyāmiha samprāptau hanyetāṃ mallalīlayā  || 10.36.023 ||
mañcāḥ kriyantāṃ vividhā mallaraṅgapariśritāḥ  |
paurā jānapadāḥ sarve paśyantu svairasaṃyugam  || 10.36.024 ||
mahāmātra tvayā bhadra raṅgadvāryupanīyatām  |
dvipaḥ kuvalayāpīḍo jahi tena mamāhitau  || 10.36.025 ||
ārabhyatāṃ dhanuryāgaścaturdaśyāṃ yathāvidhi  |
viśasantu paśūnmedhyān bhūtarājāya mīḍhuṣe  || 10.36.026 ||
ityājñāpyārthatantrajña āhūya yadupuṅgavam  |
gṛhītvā pāṇinā pāṇiṃ tato'krūramuvāca ha  || 10.36.027 ||
bho bho dānapate mahyaṃ kriyatāṃ maitramādṛtaḥ  |

atastvāmāśritaḥ saumya kāryagauravasādhanam  |

gaccha nandavrajaṃ tatra sutāvānakadundubheḥ  |
āsāte tāvihānena rathenānaya mā ciram  || 10.36.030 ||
nisṛṣṭaḥ kila me mṛtyurdevairvaikuṇṭhasaṃśrayaiḥ  |

ghātayiṣya ihānītau kālakalpena hastinā  |
yadi muktau tato mallairghātaye vaidyutopamaiḥ  || 10.36.032 ||
tayornihatayostaptān vasudevapurogamān  |
tadbandhūnnihaniṣyāmi vṛṣṇibhojadaśārhakān  || 10.36.033 ||
ugrasenaṃ ca pitaraṃ sthaviraṃ rājyakāmukaṃ  |

tataścaiṣā mahī mitra bhavitrī naṣṭakaṇṭakā  |
jarāsandho mama gururdvivido dayitaḥ sakhā  || 10.36.035 ||
śambaro narako bāṇo mayyeva kṛtasauhṛdāḥ  |

etajjñātvānaya kṣipraṃ rāmakṛṣṇāvihārbhakau  |

rājanmanīṣitaṃ sadhryaktava svāvadyamārjanam  |

10.37.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
keśī tu kaṃsaprahitaḥ khurairmahīṃ   mahāhayo nirjarayanmanojavaḥ  |

samedhamānena sa kṛṣṇabāhunā niruddhavāyuścaraṇāṃśca vikṣipan  |
prasvinnagātraḥ parivṛttalocanaḥ papāta laṇḍaṃ visṛjan kṣitau vyasuḥ  || 10.37.007 ||
taddehataḥ karkaṭikāphalopamādvyasorapākṛṣya bhujaṃ mahābhujaḥ  |

devarṣirupasaṅgamya bhāgavatapravaro nṛpa  |

tvamātmā sarvabhūtānāmeko jyotirivaidhasām  |

ātmanātmāśrayaḥ pūrvaṃ māyayā sasṛje guṇān  |

sa tvaṃ bhūdharabhūtānāṃ daityapramatharakṣasām  |
avatīrṇo vināśāya sādhunāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca  || 10.37.013 ||
diṣṭyā te nihato daityo līlayāyaṃ hayākṛtiḥ  |
yasya heṣitasantrastāstyajantyanimiṣā divam  || 10.37.014 ||
cāṇūraṃ muṣṭikaṃ caiva mallānanyāṃśca hastinam  |

tasyānu śaṅkhayavana murāṇāṃ narakasya ca  |
pārijātāpaharaṇamindrasya ca parājayam  || 10.37.016 ||
udvāhaṃ vīrakanyānāṃ vīryaśulkādilakṣaṇam  |

syamantakasya ca maṇerādānaṃ saha bhāryayā  |
mṛtaputrapradānaṃ ca brāhmaṇasya svadhāmataḥ  || 10.37.018 ||
pauṇḍrakasya vadhaṃ paścātkāśipuryāśca dīpanam  |
dantavakrasya nidhanaṃ caidyasya ca mahākratau  || 10.37.019 ||
yāni cānyāni vīryāṇi dvārakāmāvasan bhavān  |
kartā drakṣyāmyahaṃ tāni geyāni kavibhirbhuvi  || 10.37.020 ||
atha te kālarūpasya kṣapayiṣṇoramuṣya vai  |

viśuddhavijñānaghanaṃ svasaṃsthayā   samāptasarvārthamamoghavāñchitam  |

tvāmīśvaraṃ svāśrayamātmamāyayā vinirmitāśeṣaviśeṣakalpanam  |
krīḍārthamadyāttamanuṣyavigrahaṃ nato'smi dhuryaṃ yaduvṛṣṇisātvatām  || 10.37.023 ||
10.37.024|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃ yadupatiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhāgavatapravaro muniḥ  |

cakrurnilāyanakrīḍāścorapālāpadeśataḥ  || 10.37.026 ||

meṣāyitāśca tatraike vijahrurakutobhayāḥ  || 10.37.027 ||

meṣāyitānapovāha prāyaścorāyito bahūn  || 10.37.028 ||

taṃ nigṛhyācyuto dorbhyāṃ pātayitvā mahītale  |

guhāpidhānaṃ nirbhidya gopānniḥsārya kṛcchrataḥ  |
stūyamānaḥ surairgopaiḥ praviveśa svagokulam  || 10.37.033 ||
10.38.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
akrūro'pi ca tāṃ rātriṃ madhupuryāṃ mahāmatiḥ  |

gacchan pathi mahābhāgo bhagavatyambujekṣaṇe  |

mamaitaddurlabhaṃ manya uttamaḥślokadarśanam  |

yadarcitaṃ brahmabhavādibhiḥ suraiḥ   śriyā ca devyā munibhiḥ sasātvataiḥ  |

yasyākhilāmīvahabhiḥ sumaṅgalaiḥ vāco vimiśrā guṇakarmajanmabhiḥ  |

taṃ tvadya nūnaṃ mahatāṃ gatiṃ guruṃ   trailokyakāntaṃ dṛśimanmahotsavam  |
rūpaṃ dadhānaṃ śriya īpsitāspadaṃ   drakṣye mamāsannuṣasaḥ sudarśanāḥ  || 10.38.014 ||*
athāvarūḍhaḥ sapadīśayo rathātpradhānapuṃsoścaraṇaṃ svalabdhaye  |

apyaṅghrimūle patitasya me vibhuḥ   śirasyadhāsyannijahastapaṅkajam  |

na mayyupaiṣyatyaribuddhimacyutaḥ   kaṃsasya dūtaḥ prahito'pi viśvadṛk |

apyaṅghrimūle'vahitaṃ kṛtāñjaliṃ   māmīkṣitā sasmitamārdrayā dṛśā  |

labdhvāṅgasaṅgaṃ praṇataṃ kṛtāñjaliṃ   māṃ vakṣyate'krūra tatetyuruśravāḥ  |

10.38.024|0 śrīśuka uvāca
iti sañcintayan kṛṣṇaṃ śvaphalkatanayo'dhvani  |

padāni tasyākhilalokapāla kirīṭajuṣṭāmalapādareṇoḥ  |

taddarśanāhlādavivṛddhasambhramaḥ   premṇordhvaromāśrukalākulekṣaṇaḥ  |
rathādavaskandya sa teṣvaceṣṭata   prabhoramūnyaṅghrirajāṃsyaho iti  || 10.38.026 ||*
dehaṃbhṛtāmiyānartho hitvā dambhaṃ bhiyaṃ śucam  |
sandeśādyo harerliṅga darśanaśravaṇādibhiḥ  || 10.38.027 ||
dadarśa kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ ca vraje godohanaṃ gatau  |

kiśorau śyāmalaśvetau śrīniketau bṛhadbhujau  |
sumukhau sundaravarau baladviradavikramau  || 10.38.029 ||
dhvajavajrāṅkuśāmbhojaiścihnitairaṅghribhirvrajam  |
śobhayantau mahātmānau sānukrośasmitekṣaṇau  || 10.38.030 ||
udārarucirakrīḍau sragviṇau vanamālinau  |
puṇyagandhānuliptāṅgau snātau virajavāsasau  || 10.38.031 ||
pradhānapuruṣāvādyau jagaddhetū jagatpatī  |
avatīrṇau jagatyarthe svāṃśena balakeśavau  || 10.38.032 ||

rathāttūrṇamavaplutya so'krūraḥ snehavihvalaḥ  |

bhagavaddarśanāhlāda bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ  |

bhagavāṃstamabhipretya rathāṅgāṅkitapāṇinā  |

saṅkarṣaṇaśca praṇatamupaguhya mahāmanāḥ  |
gṛhītvā pāṇinā pāṇī anayatsānujo gṛham  || 10.38.037 ||
pṛṣṭvātha svāgataṃ tasmai nivedya ca varāsanam  |

nivedya gāṃ cātithaye saṃvāhya śrāntamāḍṛtaḥ  |

tasmai bhuktavate prītyā rāmaḥ paramadharmavit |
makhavāsairgandhamālyaiḥ parāṃ prītiṃ vyadhātpunaḥ  || 10.38.040 ||
papraccha satkṛtaṃ nandaḥ kathaṃ stha niranugrahe  |

yo'vadhītsvasvasustokān krośantyā asutṛpkhalaḥ  |
kiṃ nu svittatprajānāṃ vaḥ kuśalaṃ vimṛśāmahe  || 10.38.042 ||
itthaṃ sūnṛtayā vācā nandena susabhājitaḥ  |
akrūraḥ paripṛṣṭena jahāvadhvapariśramam  || 10.38.043 ||
10.39.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca

pṛṣṭo bhagavatā sarvaṃ varṇayāmāsa mādhavaḥ  |

śrutvākrūravacaḥ kṛṣṇo balaśca paravīrahā  |

smarantyaścāparāḥ śaureranurāgasmiteritāḥ  |
hṛdispṛśaścitrapadā giraḥ sammumuhuḥ striyaḥ  || 10.39.016 ||
gatiṃ sulalitāṃ ceṣṭāṃ snigdhahāsāvalokanam  |

cintayantyo mukundasya bhītā virahakātarāḥ  |
sametāḥ saṅghaśaḥ procuraśrumukhyo'cyutāśayāḥ  || 10.39.018 ||
10.39.019|0 śrīgopya ūcuḥ
aho vidhātastava na kvaciddayā saṃyojya maitryā praṇayena dehinaḥ  |
tāṃścākṛtārthān viyunaṅkṣyapārthakaṃ vikrīḍitaṃ te'rbhakaceṣṭitaṃ yathā  || 10.39.019 ||
yastvaṃ pradarśyāsitakuntalāvṛtaṃ   mukundavaktraṃ sukapolamunnasam  |

krūrastvamakrūrasamākhyayā sma naś  cakṣurhi dattaṃ harase batājñavat |

tāsāṃ mukundo madhumañjubhāṣitair  gṛhītacittaḥ paravānmanasvyapi  |

adya dhruvaṃ tatra dṛśo bhaviṣyate dāśārhabhojāndhakavṛṣṇisātvatām  |
mahotsavaḥ śrīramaṇaṃ guṇāspadaṃ drakṣyanti ye cādhvani devakīsutam  || 10.39.025 ||
maitadvidhasyākaruṇasya nāma bhūdakrūra ityetadatīva dāruṇaḥ  |
yo'sāvanāśvāsya suduḥkhitaṃ janaṃ priyātpriyaṃ neṣyati pāramadhvanaḥ  || 10.39.026 ||
anārdradhīreṣa samāsthito rathaṃ tamanvamī ca tvarayanti durmadāḥ  |
gopā anobhiḥ sthavirairupekṣitaṃ daivaṃ ca no'dya pratikūlamīhate  || 10.39.027 ||
nivārayāmaḥ samupetya mādhavaṃ kiṃ no'kariṣyan kulavṛddhabāndhavāḥ  |
mukundasaṅgānnimiṣārdhadustyajāddaivena vidhvaṃsitadīnacetasām  || 10.39.028 ||
yasyānurāgalalitasmitavalgumantra   līlāvalokaparirambhaṇarāsagoṣṭhām  |
nītāḥ sma naḥ kṣaṇamiva kṣaṇadā vinā taṃ   gopyaḥ kathaṃ nvatitarema tamo durantam  || 10.39.029 ||*
yo'hnaḥ kṣaye vrajamanantasakhaḥ parīto   gopairviśan khurarajaśchuritālakasrak |
veṇuṃ kvaṇan smitakatākṣanirīkṣaṇena   cittaṃ kṣiṇotyamumṛte nu kathaṃ bhavema  || 10.39.030 ||*
10.39.031|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃ bruvāṇā virahāturā bhṛśaṃ vrajastriyaḥ kṛṣṇaviṣaktamānasāḥ  |
visṛjya lajjāṃ ruruduḥ sma susvaraṃ govinda dāmodara mādhaveti  || 10.39.031 ||
strīṇāmevaṃ rudantīnāmudite savitaryatha  |
akrūraścodayāmāsa kṛtamaitrādiko ratham  || 10.39.032 ||
gopāstamanvasajjanta nandādyāḥ śakaṭaistataḥ  |
ādāyopāyanaṃ bhūri kumbhān gorasasambhṛtān  || 10.39.033 ||
gopyaśca dayitaṃ kṛṣṇamanuvrajyānurañjitāḥ  |
pratyādeśaṃ bhagavataḥ kāṅkṣantyaścāvatasthire  || 10.39.034 ||
tāstathā tapyatīrvīkṣya svaprasthāṇe yadūttamaḥ  |
sāntvayāmasa sapremairāyāsya iti dautyakaiḥ  || 10.39.035 ||
yāvadālakṣyate keturyāvadreṇū rathasya ca  |
anuprasthāpitātmāno lekhyānīvopalakṣitāḥ  || 10.39.036 ||
tā nirāśā nivavṛturgovindavinivartane  |
viśokā ahanī ninyurgāyantyaḥ priyaceṣṭitam  || 10.39.037 ||
bhagavānapi samprāpto rāmākrūrayuto nṛpa  |
rathena vāyuvegena kālindīmaghanāśinīm  || 10.39.038 ||
tatropaspṛśya pānīyaṃ pītvā mṛṣṭaṃ maṇiprabham  |
vṛkṣaṣaṇḍamupavrajya sarāmo rathamāviśat || 10.39.039 ||
akrūrastāvupāmantrya niveśya ca rathopari  |
kālindyā hradamāgatya snānaṃ vidhivadācarat || 10.39.040 ||
nimajjya tasmin salile japan brahma sanātanam  |
tāveva dadṛśe'krūro rāmakṛṣṇau samanvitau  || 10.39.041 ||
tau rathasthau kathamiha sutāvānakadundubheḥ  |
tarhi svitsyandane na sta ityunmajjya vyacaṣṭa saḥ  || 10.39.042 ||
tatrāpi ca yathāpūrvamāsīnau punareva saḥ  |
nyamajjaddarśanaṃ yanme mṛṣā kiṃ salile tayoḥ  || 10.39.043 ||
bhūyastatrāpi so'drākṣītstūyamānamahīśvaram  |
siddhacāraṇagandharvairasurairnatakandharaiḥ  || 10.39.044 ||
sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ sahasraphaṇamaulinam  |
nīlāmbaraṃ visaśvetaṃ śṛṅgaiḥ śvetamiva sthitam  || 10.39.045 ||
tasyotsaṅge ghanasyāmaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam  |
puruṣaṃ caturbhujaṃ śāntaṃ padmapatrāruṇekṣaṇam  || 10.39.046 ||
cāruprasannavadanaṃ cāruhāsanirīkṣaṇam  |
subhrūnnasaṃ carukarṇaṃ sukapolāruṇādharam  || 10.39.047 ||
pralambapīvarabhujaṃ tuṅgāṃsoraḥsthalaśriyam  |
kambukaṇṭhaṃ nimnanābhiṃ valimatpallavodaram  || 10.39.048 ||
bṛhatkatitataśroṇi karabhorudvayānvitam  |
cārujānuyugaṃ cāru jaṅghāyugalasaṃyutam  || 10.39.049 ||
tuṅgagulphāruṇanakha vrātadīdhitibhirvṛtam  |
navāṅgulyaṅguṣṭhadalairvilasatpādapaṅkajam  || 10.39.050 ||
sumahārhamaṇivrāta kirīṭakaṭakāṅgadaiḥ  |
kaṭisūtrabrahmasūtra hāranūpurakuṇḍalaiḥ  || 10.39.051 ||
bhrājamānaṃ padmakaraṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam  |
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ bhrājatkaustubhaṃ vanamālinam  || 10.39.052 ||
sunandanandapramukhaiḥ parṣadaiḥ sanakādibhiḥ  |
sureśairbrahmarudrādyairnavabhiśca dvijottamaiḥ  || 10.39.053 ||
prahrādanāradavasu pramukhairbhāgavatottamaiḥ  |
stūyamānaṃ pṛthagbhāvairvacobhiramalātmabhiḥ  || 10.39.054 ||
śriyā puṣṭyā girā kāntyā kīrtyā tuṣṭyelayorjayā  |
vidyayāvidyayā śaktyā māyayā ca niṣevitam  || 10.39.055 ||
vilokya subhṛśaṃ prīto bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ  |
hṛṣyattanūruho bhāva pariklinnātmalocanaḥ  || 10.39.056 ||
girā gadgadayāstauṣītsattvamālambya sātvataḥ  |
praṇamya mūrdhnāvahitaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ śanaiḥ  || 10.39.057 ||
10.40.001|0 śrīakrūra uvāca
nato'smyahaṃ tvākhilahetuhetuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pūruṣamādyamavyayam  |
yannābhijātādaravindakoṣādbrahmāvirāsīdyata eṣa lokaḥ  || 10.40.001 ||
bhūstoyamagniḥ pavanaṃ khamādirmahānajādirmana indriyāṇi  |
sarvendriyārthā vibudhāśca sarve ye hetavaste jagato'ṅgabhūtāḥ  || 10.40.002 ||
naite svarūpaṃ vidurātmanaste hyajādayo'nātmatayā gṛhītaḥ  |
ajo'nubaddhaḥ sa guṇairajāyā guṇātparaṃ veda na te svarūpam  || 10.40.003 ||
tvāṃ yogino yajantyaddhā mahāpuruṣamīśvaram  |
sādhyātmaṃ sādhibhūtaṃ ca sādhidaivaṃ ca sādhavaḥ  || 10.40.004 ||
trayyā ca vidyayā kecittvāṃ vai vaitānikā dvijāḥ  |
yajante vitatairyajñairnānārūpāmarākhyayā  || 10.40.005 ||
eke tvākhilakarmāṇi sannyasyopaśamaṃ gatāḥ  |
jñānino jñānayajñena yajanti jñānavigraham  || 10.40.006 ||
anye ca saṃskṛtātmāno vidhinābhihitena te  |
yajanti tvanmayāstvāṃ vai bahumūrtyekamūrtikam  || 10.40.007 ||
tvāmevānye śivoktena mārgeṇa śivarūpiṇam  |
bahvācāryavibhedena bhagavantarnupāsate  || 10.40.008 ||
sarva eva yajanti tvāṃ sarvadevamayeśvaram  |
ye'pyanyadevatābhaktā yadyapyanyadhiyaḥ prabho  || 10.40.009 ||
yathādriprabhavā nadyaḥ parjanyāpūritāḥ prabho  |
viśanti sarvataḥ sindhuṃ tadvattvāṃ gatayo'ntataḥ  || 10.40.010 ||
sattvaṃ rajastama iti bhavataḥ prakṛterguṇāḥ  |
teṣu hi prākṛtāḥ protā ābrahmasthāvarādayaḥ  || 10.40.011 ||
tubhyaṃ namaste tvaviṣaktadṛṣṭaye   sarvātmane sarvadhiyāṃ ca sākṣiṇe  |
guṇapravāho'yamavidyayā kṛtaḥ   pravartate devanṛtiryagātmasu  || 10.40.012 ||*
agnirmukhaṃ te'vaniraṅghrirīkṣaṇaṃ   sūryo nabho nābhiratho diśaḥ śrutiḥ  |
dyauḥ kaṃ surendrāstava bāhavo'rṇavāḥ   kukṣirmarutprāṇabalaṃ prakalpitam  || 10.40.013 ||*
romāṇi vṛkṣauṣadhayaḥ śiroruhā   meghāḥ parasyāsthinakhāni te'drayaḥ  |
nimeṣaṇaṃ rātryahanī prajāpatir  meḍhrastu vṛṣṭistava vīryamiṣyate  || 10.40.014 ||*
tvayyavyayātman puruṣe prakalpitā lokāḥ sapālā bahujīvasaṅkulāḥ  |
yathā jale sañjihate jalaukaso'pyudumbare vā maśakā manomaye  || 10.40.015 ||
yāni yānīha rūpāṇi krīḍanārthaṃ bibharṣi hi  |
tairāmṛṣṭaśuco lokā mudā gāyanti te yaśaḥ  || 10.40.016 ||
namaḥ kāraṇamatsyāya pralayābdhicarāya ca  |
hayaśīrṣṇe namastubhyaṃ madhukaiṭabhamṛtyave  || 10.40.017 ||
akūpārāya bṛhate namo mandaradhāriṇe  |
kṣityuddhāravihārāya namaḥ śūkaramūrtaye  || 10.40.018 ||
namaste'dbhutasiṃhāya sādhulokabhayāpaha  |
vāmanāya namastubhyaṃ krāntatribhuvanāya ca  || 10.40.019 ||
namo bhṛguṇāṃ pataye dṛptakṣatravanacchide  |
namaste raghuvaryāya rāvaṇāntakarāya ca  || 10.40.020 ||
namaste vāsudevāya namaḥ saṅkarṣaṇāya ca  |
pradyumnāyaniruddhāya sātvatāṃ pataye namaḥ  || 10.40.021 ||
namo buddhāya śuddhāya daityadānavamohine  |
mlecchaprāyakṣatrahantre namaste kalkirūpiṇe  || 10.40.022 ||
bhagavan jīvaloko'yaṃ mohitastava māyayā  |
ahaṃ mametyasadgrāho bhrāmyate karmavartmasu  || 10.40.023 ||
ahaṃ cātmātmajāgāra dārārthasvajanādiṣu  |
bhramāmi svapnakalpeṣu mūḍhaḥ satyadhiyā vibho  || 10.40.024 ||
anityānātmaduḥkheṣu viparyayamatirhyaham  |
dvandvārāmastamoviṣṭo na jāne tvātmanaḥ priyam  || 10.40.025 ||
yathābudho jalaṃ hitvā praticchannaṃ tadudbhavaiḥ  |
abhyeti mṛgatṛṣṇāṃ vai tadvattvāhaṃ parāṅmukhaḥ  || 10.40.026 ||
notsahe'haṃ kṛpaṇadhīḥ kāmakarmahataṃ manaḥ  |
roddhuṃ pramāthibhiścākṣairhriyamāṇamitastataḥ  || 10.40.027 ||
so'haṃ tavāṅghryupagato'smyasatāṃ durāpaṃ   taccāpyahaṃ bhavadanugraha īśa manye  |
puṃso bhavedyarhi saṃsaraṇāpavargas  tvayyabjanābha sadupāsanayā matiḥ syāt || 10.40.028 ||*
namo vijñānamātrāya sarvapratyayahetave  |
puruṣeśapradhānāya brahmaṇe'nantaśaktaye  || 10.40.029 ||
namaste vāsudevāya sarvabhūtakṣayāya ca  |
hṛṣīkeśa namastubhyaṃ prapannaṃ pāhi māṃ prabho  || 10.40.030 ||
10.41.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
stuvatastasya bhagavān darśayitvā jale vapuḥ  |
bhūyaḥ samāharatkṛṣṇo naṭo nāṭyamivātmanaḥ  || 10.41.001 ||
so'pi cāntarhitaṃ vīkṣya jalādunmajya satvaraḥ  |
kṛtvā cāvaśyakaṃ sarvaṃ vismito rathamāgamat || 10.41.002 ||
tamapṛcchaddhṛṣīkeśaḥ kiṃ te dṛṣṭamivādbhutam  |

10.41.004|0 śrīakrūra uvāca
adbhutānīha yāvanti bhūmau viyati vā jale  |
tvayi viśvātmake tāni kiṃ me'dṛṣṭaṃ vipaśyataḥ  || 10.41.004 ||
yatrādbhutāni sarvāṇi bhūmau viyati vā jale  |
taṃ tvānupaśyato brahman kiṃ me dṛṣṭamihādbhutam  || 10.41.005 ||
ityuktvā codayāmāsa syandanaṃ gāndinīsutaḥ  |
mathurāmanayadrāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ caiva dinātyaye  || 10.41.006 ||
mārge grāmajanā rājaṃstatra tatropasaṅgatāḥ  |
vasudevasutau vīkṣya prītā dṛṣṭiṃ na cādaduḥ  || 10.41.007 ||
tāvadvrajaukasastatra nandagopādayo'grataḥ  |
puropavanamāsādya pratīkṣanto'vatasthire  || 10.41.008 ||
tān sametyāha bhagavānakrūraṃ jagadīśvaraḥ  |
gṛhītvā pāṇinā pāṇiṃ praśritaṃ prahasanniva  || 10.41.009 ||
bhavān praviśatāmagre sahayānaḥ purīṃ gṛham  |
vayaṃ tvihāvamucyātha tato drakṣyāmahe purīm  || 10.41.010 ||
10.41.011|0 śrīakrūra uvāca
nāhaṃ bhavadbhyāṃ rahitaḥ pravekṣye mathurāṃ prabho  |
tyaktuṃ nārhasi māṃ nātha bhaktaṃ te bhaktavatsala  || 10.41.011 ||
āgaccha yāma gehānnaḥ sanāthān kurvadhokṣaja  |
sahāgrajaḥ sagopālaiḥ suhṛdbhiśca suhṛttama  || 10.41.012 ||
punīhi pādarajasā gṛhānno gṛhamedhinām  |
yacchaucenānutṛpyanti pitaraḥ sāgnayaḥ surāḥ  || 10.41.013 ||
avanijyāṅghriyugalamāsītślokyo balirmahān  |

āpaste'ṅghryavanejanyastrīṃllokān śucayo'punan  |

devadeva jagannātha puṇyaśravaṇakīrtana  |
yadūttamottamaḥśloka nārāyaṇa namo'stu te  || 10.41.016 ||
10.41.017|0 śrībhagavanuvāca
āyāsye bhavato gehamahamaryasamanvitaḥ  |
yaducakradruhaṃ hatvā vitariṣye suhṛtpriyam  || 10.41.017 ||
10.41.018|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evamukto bhagavatā so'krūro vimanā iva  |
purīṃ praviṣṭaḥ kaṃsāya karmāvedya gṛhaṃ yayau  || 10.41.018 ||
athāparāhne bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ saṅkarṣaṇānvitaḥ  |
mathurāṃ prāviśadgopairdidṛkṣuḥ parivāritaḥ  || 10.41.019 ||
dadarśa tāṃ sphāṭikatuṇgagopura dvārāṃ bṛhaddhemakapāṭatoraṇām  |
tāmrārakoṣṭhāṃ parikhādurāsadāmudyānaramyopavanopaśobhitām  || 10.41.020 ||
sauvarṇaśṛṅgāṭakaharmyaniṣkuṭaiḥ śreṇīsabhābhirbhavanairupaskṛtām  |
vaidūryavajrāmalanīlavidrumairmuktāharidbhirvalabhīṣu vediṣu  || 10.41.021 ||
juṣṭeṣu jālāmukharandhrakuṭṭimeṣvāviṣṭapārāvatabarhināditām  |
saṃsiktarathyāpaṇamārgacatvarāṃ prakīrṇamālyāṅkuralājataṇḍulām  || 10.41.022 ||
āpūrṇakumbhairdadhicandanokṣitaiḥ prasūnadīpāvalibhiḥ sapallavaiḥ  |
savṛndarambhākramukaiḥ saketubhiḥ svalaṅkṛtadvāragṛhāṃ sapaṭṭikaiḥ  || 10.41.023 ||
tāṃ sampraviṣṭau vasudevanandanau vṛtau vayasyairnaradevavartmanā  |
draṣṭuṃ samīyustvaritāḥ purastriyo harmyāṇi caivāruruhurnṛpotsukāḥ  || 10.41.024 ||
kāścidviparyagdhṛtavastrabhūṣaṇā   vismṛtya caikaṃ yugaleṣvathāparāḥ  |
kṛtaikapatraśravanaikanūpurā   nāṅktvā dvitīyaṃ tvaparāśca locanam  || 10.41.025 ||*
aśnantya ekāstadapāsya sotsavā abhyajyamānā akṛtopamajjanāḥ  |
svapantya utthāya niśamya niḥsvanaṃ prapāyayantyo'rbhamapohya mātaraḥ  || 10.41.026 ||
manāṃsi tāsāmaravindalocanaḥ pragalbhalīlāhasitāvalokaiḥ  |
jahāra mattadviradendravikramo dṛśāṃ dadacchrīramaṇātmanotsavam  || 10.41.027 ||
dṛṣṭvā muhuḥ śrutamanudrutacetasastaṃ   tatprekṣaṇotsmitasudhokṣaṇalabdhamānāḥ  |
ānandamūrtimupaguhya dṛśātmalabdhaṃ   hṛṣyattvaco jahuranantamarindamādhim  || 10.41.028 ||*
prāsādaśikharārūḍhāḥ prītyutphullamukhāmbujāḥ  |
abhyavarṣan saumanasyaiḥ pramadā balakeśavau  || 10.41.029 ||
dadhyakṣataiḥ sodapātraiḥ sraggandhairabhyupāyanaiḥ  |
tāvānarcuḥ pramuditāstatra tatra dvijātayaḥ  || 10.41.030 ||
ūcuḥ paurā aho gopyastapaḥ kimacaranmahat |
yā hyetāvanupaśyanti naralokamahotsavau  || 10.41.031 ||
rajakaṃ kañcidāyāntaṃ raṅgakāraṃ gadāgrajaḥ  |
dṛṣṭvāyācata vāsāṃsi dhautānyatyuttamāni ca  || 10.41.032 ||
dehyāvayoḥ samucitānyaṅga vāsāṃsi cārhatoḥ  |
bhaviṣyati paraṃ śreyo dātuste nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 10.41.033 ||
sa yācito bhagavatā paripūrṇena sarvataḥ  |
sākṣepaṃ ruṣitaḥ prāha bhṛtyo rājñaḥ sudurmadaḥ  || 10.41.034 ||
īdṛśānyeva vāsāṃsī nityaṃ girivanecaraḥ  |
paridhatta kimudvṛttā rājadravyāṇyabhīpsatha  || 10.41.035 ||
yātāśu bāliśā maivaṃ prārthyaṃ yadi jijīvīṣā  |
badhnanti ghnanti lumpanti dṛptaṃ rājakulāni vai  || 10.41.036 ||
evaṃ vikatthamānasya kupito devakīsutaḥ  |
rajakasya karāgreṇa śiraḥ kāyādapātayat || 10.41.037 ||
tasyānujīvinaḥ sarve vāsaḥkośān visṛjya vai  |
dudruvuḥ sarvato mārgaṃ vāsāṃsi jagṛhe'cyutaḥ  || 10.41.038 ||
vasitvātmapriye vastre kṛṣṇaḥ saṅkarṣaṇastathā  |
śeṣāṇyādatta gopebhyo visṛjya bhuvi kānicit || 10.41.039 ||
tatastu vāyakaḥ prītastayorveṣamakalpayat |
vicitravarṇaiścaileyairākalpairanurūpataḥ  || 10.41.040 ||
nānālakṣaṇaveṣābhyāṃ kṛṣṇarāmau virejatuḥ  |
svalaṅkṛtau bālagajau parvaṇīva sitetarau  || 10.41.041 ||
tasya prasanno bhagavān prādātsārūpyamātmanaḥ  |
śriyaṃ ca paramāṃ loke balaiśvaryasmṛtīndriyam  || 10.41.042 ||
tataḥ sudāmno bhavanaṃ mālākārasya jagmatuḥ  |
tau dṛṣṭvā sa samutthāya nanāma śirasā bhuvi  || 10.41.043 ||
tayorāsanamānīya pādyaṃ cārghyārhaṇādibhiḥ  |
pūjāṃ sānugayoścakre sraktāmbūlānulepanaiḥ  || 10.41.044 ||
prāha naḥ sārthakaṃ janma pāvitaṃ ca kulaṃ prabho  |
pitṛdevarṣayo mahyaṃ tuṣṭā hyāgamanena vām  || 10.41.045 ||
bhavantau kila viśvasya jagataḥ kāraṇaṃ param  |
avatīrṇāvihāṃśena kṣemāya ca bhavāya ca  || 10.41.046 ||
na hi vāṃ viṣamā dṛṣṭiḥ suhṛdorjagadātmanoḥ  |
samayoḥ sarvabhūteṣu bhajantaṃ bhajatorapi  || 10.41.047 ||
tāvajñāpayataṃ bhṛtyaṃ kimahaṃ karavāṇi vām  |
puṃso'tyanugraho hyeṣa bhavadbhiryanniyujyate  || 10.41.048 ||
ityabhipretya rājendra sudāmā prītamānasaḥ  |
śastaiḥ sugandhaiḥ kusumairmālā viracitā dadau  || 10.41.049 ||
tābhiḥ svalaṅkṛtau prītau kṛṣṇarāmau sahānugau  |
praṇatāya prapannāya dadaturvaradau varān  || 10.41.050 ||
so'pi vavre'calāṃ bhaktiṃ tasminnevākhilātmani  |
tadbhakteṣu ca sauhārdaṃ bhūteṣu ca dayāṃ parām  || 10.41.051 ||
iti tasmai varaṃ dattvā śriyaṃ cānvayavardhinīm  |
balamāyuryaśaḥ kāntiṃ nirjagāma sahāgrajaḥ  || 10.41.052 ||
10.42.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
atha vrajan rājapathena mādhavaḥ striyaṃ gṛhītāṅgavilepabhājanām  |
vilokya kubjāṃ yuvatīṃ varānanāṃ papraccha yāntīṃ prahasan rasapradaḥ  || 10.42.001 ||
kā tvaṃ varorvetadu hānulepanaṃ kasyāṅgane vā kathayasva sādhu naḥ  |
dehyāvayoraṅgavilepamuttamaṃ śreyastataste na cirādbhaviṣyati  || 10.42.002 ||
10.42.003|0 sairandhryuvāca
dāsyasmyahaṃ sundara kaṃsasammatā   trivakranāmā hyanulepakarmaṇi  |
madbhāvitaṃ bhojapateratipriyaṃ   vinā yuvāṃ ko'nyatamastadarhati  || 10.42.003 ||*
rūpapeśalamādhurya hasitālāpavīkṣitaiḥ  |
dharṣitātmā dadau sāndramubhayoranulepanam  || 10.42.004 ||
tatastāvaṅgarāgeṇa svavarṇetaraśobhinā  |
samprāptaparabhāgena śuśubhāte'nurañjitau  || 10.42.005 ||
prasanno bhagavān kubjāṃ trivakrāṃ rucirānanām  |
ṛjvīṃ kartuṃ manaścakre darśayan darśane phalam  || 10.42.006 ||
padbhyāmākramya prapade dryaṅgulyuttānapāṇinā  |
pragṛhya cibuke'dhyātmamudanīnamadacyutaḥ  || 10.42.007 ||
sā tadarjusamānāṅgī bṛhacchroṇipayodharā  |
mukundasparśanātsadyo babhūva pramadottamā  || 10.42.008 ||
tato rūpaguṇaudārya sampannā prāha keśavam  |
uttarīyāntamakṛṣya smayantī jātahṛcchayā  || 10.42.009 ||
ehi vīra gṛhaṃ yāmo na tvāṃ tyaktumihotsahe  |
tvayonmathitacittāyāḥ prasīda puruṣarṣabha  || 10.42.010 ||
evaṃ striyā yācyamānaḥ kṛṣṇo rāmasya paśyataḥ  |
mukhaṃ vīkṣyānu gopānāṃ prahasaṃstāmuvāca ha  || 10.42.011 ||
eṣyāmi te gṛhaṃ subhru puṃsāmādhivikarśanam  |
sādhitārtho'gṛhāṇāṃ naḥ pānthānāṃ tvaṃ parāyaṇam  || 10.42.012 ||
visṛjya mādhvyā vāṇyā tāṃ vrajanmārge vaṇikpathaiḥ  |
nānopāyanatāmbūla sraggandhaiḥ sāgrajo'rcitaḥ  || 10.42.013 ||
taddarśanasmarakṣobhādātmānaṃ nāvidan striyaḥ  |
visrastavāsaḥkavara valayā lekhyamūrtayaḥ  || 10.42.014 ||
tataḥ paurān pṛcchamāno dhanuṣaḥ sthānamacyutaḥ  |
tasmin praviṣṭo dadṛśe dhanuraindramivādbhutam  || 10.42.015 ||
puruṣairbahubhirguptamarcitaṃ paramarddhimat |
vāryamāṇo nṛbhiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prasahya dhanurādade  || 10.42.016 ||
kareṇa vāmena salīlamuddhṛtaṃ sajyaṃ ca kṛtvā nimiṣeṇa paśyatām  |
nṛṇāṃ vikṛṣya prababhañja madhyato yathekṣudaṇḍaṃ madakaryurukramaḥ  || 10.42.017 ||
dhanuṣo bhajyamānasya śabdaḥ khaṃ rodasī diśaḥ  |
pūrayāmāsa yaṃ śrutvā kaṃsastrāsamupāgamat || 10.42.018 ||
tadrakṣiṇaḥ sānucaraṃ kupitā ātatāyinaḥ  |
gṛhītukāmā āvavrurgṛhyatāṃ vadhyatāmiti  || 10.42.019 ||
atha tān durabhiprāyān vilokya balakeśavau  |
kruddhau dhanvana ādāya śakale tāṃśca jaghnatuḥ  || 10.42.020 ||
balaṃ ca kaṃsaprahitaṃ hatvā śālāmukhāttataḥ  |
niṣkramya ceraturhṛṣṭau nirīkṣya purasampadaḥ  || 10.42.021 ||
tayostadadbhutaṃ vīryaṃ niśāmya puravāsinaḥ  |
tejaḥ prāgalbhyaṃ rūpaṃ ca menire vibudhottamau  || 10.42.022 ||
tayorvicaratoḥ svairamādityo'stamupeyivān  |
kṛṣṇarāmau vṛtau gopaiḥ purācchakaṭamīyatuḥ  || 10.42.023 ||
gopyo mukundavigame virahāturā yā āśāsatāśiṣa ṛtā madhupuryabhūvan  |
sampaśyatāṃ puruṣabhūṣaṇagātralakṣmīṃ hitvetarānnu bhajataścakame'yanaṃ śrīḥ  || 10.42.024 ||
avaniktāṅghriyugalau bhuktvā kṣīropasecanam  |
ūṣatustāṃ sukhaṃ rātriṃ jñātvā kaṃsacikīrṣitam  || 10.42.025 ||
kaṃsastu dhanuṣo bhaṅgaṃ rakṣiṇāṃ svabalasya ca  |
vadhaṃ niśamya govinda rāmavikrīḍitaṃ param  || 10.42.026 ||
dīrghaprajāgaro bhīto durnimittāni durmatiḥ  |
bahūnyacaṣṭobhayathā mṛtyordautyakarāṇi ca  || 10.42.027 ||
adarśanaṃ svaśirasaḥ pratirūpe ca satyapi  |
asatyapi dvitīye ca dvairūpyaṃ jyotiṣāṃ tathā  || 10.42.028 ||
chidrapratītiśchāyāyāṃ prāṇaghoṣānupaśrutiḥ  |
svarṇapratītirvṛkṣeṣu svapadānāmadarśanam  || 10.42.029 ||
svapne pretapariṣvaṅgaḥ kharayānaṃ viṣādanam  |
yāyānnaladamālyekastailābhyakto digambaraḥ  || 10.42.030 ||
anyāni cetthaṃbhūtāni svapnajāgaritāni ca  |
paśyanmaraṇasantrasto nidrāṃ lebhe na cintayā  || 10.42.031 ||
vyuṣṭāyāṃ niśi kauravya sūrye cādbhyaḥ samutthite  |
kārayāmāsa vai kaṃso mallakrīḍāmahotsavam  || 10.42.032 ||
ānarcuḥ puruṣā raṅgaṃ tūryabheryaśca jaghnire  |
mañcāścālaṅkṛtāḥ sragbhiḥ patākācailatoraṇaiḥ  || 10.42.033 ||
teṣu paurā jānapadā brahmakṣatrapurogamāḥ  |
yathopajoṣaṃ viviśū rājānaśca kṛtāsanāḥ  || 10.42.034 ||
kaṃsaḥ parivṛto'mātyai rājamañca upāviśat |
maṇḍaleśvaramadhyastho hṛdayena vidūyatā  || 10.42.035 ||
vādyamānesu tūryeṣu mallatālottareṣu ca  |
mallāḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ dṛptāḥ sopādhyāyāḥ samāsata  || 10.42.036 ||
cāṇūro muṣṭikaḥ kūtaḥ śalastośala eva ca  |
ta āsedurupasthānaṃ valguvādyapraharṣitāḥ  || 10.42.037 ||
nandagopādayo gopā bhojarājasamāhutāḥ  |
niveditopāyanāsta ekasminmañca āviśan  || 10.42.038 ||
10.43.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
atha kṛṣṇaśca rāmaśca kṛtaśaucau parantapa  |
malladundubhinirghoṣaṃ śrutvā draṣṭumupeyatuḥ  || 10.43.001 ||
raṅgadvāraṃ samāsādya tasminnāgamavasthitam  |
apaśyatkuvalayāpīḍaṃ kṛṣṇo'mbaṣṭhapracoditam  || 10.43.002 ||
baddhvā parikaraṃ śauriḥ samuhya kuṭilālakān  |
uvāca hastipaṃ vācā meghanādagabhīrayā  || 10.43.003 ||
ambaṣṭhāmbaṣṭha mārgaṃ nau dehyapakrama mā ciram  |
no cetsakuñjaraṃ tvādya nayāmi yamasādanam  || 10.43.004 ||
evaṃ nirbhartsito'mbaṣṭhaḥ kupitaḥ kopitaṃ gajam  |
codayāmāsa kṛṣṇāya kālāntakayamopamam  || 10.43.005 ||
karīndrastamabhidrutya kareṇa tarasāgrahīt |
karādvigalitaḥ so'muṃ nihatyāṅghriṣvalīyata  || 10.43.006 ||
saṅkruddhastamacakṣāṇo ghrāṇadṛṣṭiḥ sa keśavam  |
parāmṛśatpuṣkareṇa sa prasahya vinirgataḥ  || 10.43.007 ||
pucche pragṛhyātibalaṃ dhanuṣaḥ pañcaviṃśatim  |
vicakarṣa yathā nāgaṃ suparṇa iva līlayā  || 10.43.008 ||
sa paryāvartamānena savyadakṣiṇato'cyutaḥ  |
babhrāma bhrāmyamāṇena govatseneva bālakaḥ  || 10.43.009 ||
tato'bhimakhamabhyetya pāṇināhatya vāraṇam  |
prādravan pātayāmāsa spṛśyamānaḥ pade pade  || 10.43.010 ||
sa dhāvan kṛīdayā bhūmau patitvā sahasotthitaḥ  |
taṃ matvā patitaṃ kruddho dantābhyāṃ so'hanatkṣitim  || 10.43.011 ||
svavikrame pratihate kuñjarendro'tyamarṣitaḥ  |
codyamāno mahāmātraiḥ kṛṣṇamabhyadravadruṣā  || 10.43.012 ||
tamāpatantamāsādya bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ  |
nigṛhya pāṇinā hastaṃ pātayāmāsa bhūtale  || 10.43.013 ||
patitasya padākramya mṛgendra iva līlayā  |
dantamutpāṭya tenebhaṃ hastipāṃścāhanaddhariḥ  || 10.43.014 ||
mṛtakaṃ dvipamutsṛjya dantapāṇiḥ samāviśat |
aṃsanyastaviṣāṇo'sṛṅmadabindubhiraṅkitaḥ  |
virūḍhasvedakaṇikā vadanāmburuho babhau  || 10.43.015 ||
vṛtau gopaiḥ katipayairbaladevajanārdanau  |
raṅgaṃ viviśatū rājan gajadantavarāyudhau  || 10.43.016 ||
mallānāmaśanirnṛṇāṃ naravaraḥ strīṇāṃ smaro mūrtimān   gopānāṃ svajano'satāṃ kṣitibhujāṃ śāstā svapitroḥ śiśuḥ  |
mṛtyurbhojapatervirāḍaviduṣāṃ tattvaṃ paraṃ yogināṃ   vṛṣṇīnāṃ paradevateti vidito raṅgaṃ gataḥ sāgrajaḥ  || 10.43.017 ||*
hataṃ kuvalayāpīḍaṃ dṛṣṭvā tāvapi durjayau  |
kaṃso manasyapi tadā bhṛśamudvivije nṛpa  || 10.43.018 ||
tau rejatū raṅgagatau mahābhujau vicitraveṣābharaṇasragambarau  |
yathā naṭāvuttamaveṣadhāriṇau manaḥ kṣipantau prabhayā nirīkṣatām  || 10.43.019 ||
nirīkṣya tāvuttamapūruṣau janā mañcasthitā nāgararāṣṭrakā nṛpa  |
praharṣavegotkalitekṣaṇānanāḥ papurna tṛptā nayanaistadānanam  || 10.43.020 ||
pibanta iva cakṣurbhyāṃ lihanta iva jihvayā  |
jighranta iva nāsābhyāṃ śliṣyanta iva bāhubhiḥ  || 10.43.021 ||
ūcuḥ parasparaṃ te vai yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathāśrutam  |
tadrūpaguṇamādhurya prāgalbhyasmāritā iva  || 10.43.022 ||
etau bhagavataḥ sākṣāddharernārāyaṇasya hi  |
avatīrṇāvihāṃśena vasudevasya veśmani  || 10.43.023 ||
eṣa vai kila devakyāṃ jāto nītaśca gokulam  |
kālametaṃ vasan gūḍho vavṛdhe nandaveśmani  || 10.43.024 ||
pūtanānena nītāntaṃ cakravātaśca dānavaḥ  |
arjunau guhyakaḥ keśī dhenuko'nye ca tadvidhāḥ  || 10.43.025 ||
gāvaḥ sapālā etena dāvāgneḥ parimocitāḥ  |
kāliyo damitaḥ sarpa indraśca vimadaḥ kṛtaḥ  || 10.43.026 ||
saptāhamekahastena dhṛto'dripravaro'munā  |
varṣavātāśanibhyaśca paritrātaṃ ca gokulam  || 10.43.027 ||
gopyo'sya nityamudita hasitaprekṣaṇaṃ mukham  |
paśyantyo vividhāṃstāpāṃstaranti smāśramaṃ mudā  || 10.43.028 ||
vadantyanena vaṃśo'yaṃ yadoḥ subahuviśrutaḥ  |
śriyaṃ yaśo mahatvaṃ ca lapsyate parirakṣitaḥ  || 10.43.029 ||
ayaṃ cāsyāgrajaḥ śrīmān rāmaḥ kamalalocanaḥ  |
pralambo nihato yena vatsako ye bakādayaḥ  || 10.43.030 ||
janeṣvevaṃ bruvāṇeṣu tūryeṣu ninadatsu ca  |
kṛṣṇarāmau samābhāṣya cāṇūro vākyamabravīt || 10.43.031 ||
he nandasūno he rāma bhavantau vīrasammatau  |
niyuddhakuśalau śrutvā rājñāhūtau didṛkṣuṇā  || 10.43.032 ||
priyaṃ rājñaḥ prakurvatyaḥ śreyo vindanti vai prajāḥ  |
manasā karmaṇā vācā viparītamato'nyathā  || 10.43.033 ||
nityaṃ pramuditā gopā vatsapālā yathāsphuṭam  |
vaneṣu mallayuddhena krīḍantaścārayanti gāḥ  || 10.43.034 ||
tasmādrājñaḥ priyaṃ yūyaṃ vayaṃ ca karavāma he  |
bhūtāni naḥ prasīdanti sarvabhūtamayo nṛpaḥ  || 10.43.035 ||
tanniśamyābravītkṛṣṇo deśakālocitaṃ vacaḥ  |
niyuddhamātmano'bhīṣṭaṃ manyamāno'bhinandya ca  || 10.43.036 ||
prajā bhojapaterasya vayaṃ cāpi vanecarāḥ  |
karavāma priyaṃ nityaṃ tannaḥ paramanugrahaḥ  || 10.43.037 ||
bālā vayaṃ tulyabalaiḥ krīḍiṣyāmo yathocitam  |
bhavenniyuddhaṃ mādharmaḥ spṛśenmallasabhāsadaḥ  || 10.43.038 ||
10.43.039|0 cāṇūra uvāca
na bālo na kiśorastvaṃ balaśca balināṃ varaḥ  |
līlayebho hato yena sahasradvipasattvabhṛt || 10.43.039 ||
tasmādbhavadbhyāṃ balibhiryoddhavyaṃ nānayo'tra vai  |
mayi vikrama vārṣṇeya balena saha muṣṭikaḥ  || 10.43.040 ||
10.44.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃ carcitasaṅkalpo bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ  |
āsasādātha caṇūraṃ muṣṭtikaṃ rohiṇīsutaḥ  || 10.44.001 ||
hastābhyāṃ hastayorbaddhvā padbhyāmeva ca pādayoḥ  |
vicakarṣaturanyonyaṃ prasahya vijigīṣayā  || 10.44.002 ||
aratnī dve aratnibhyāṃ jānubhyāṃ caiva jānunī  |
śiraḥ śīrṣṇorasorastāvanyonyamabhijaghnatuḥ  || 10.44.003 ||
paribhrāmaṇavikṣepa parirambhāvapātanaiḥ  |
utsarpaṇāpasarpaṇaiścānyonyaṃ pratyarundhatām  || 10.44.004 ||
utthāpanairunnayanaiścālanaiḥ sthāpanairapi  |
parasparaṃ jigīṣantāvapacakraturātmanaḥ  || 10.44.005 ||
tadbalābalavadyuddhaṃ sametāḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ  |
ūcuḥ parasparaṃ rājan sānukampā varūthaśaḥ  || 10.44.006 ||
mahānayaṃ batādharma eṣāṃ rājasabhāsadām  |
ye balābalavadyuddhaṃ rājño'nvicchanti paśyataḥ  || 10.44.007 ||
kva vajrasārasarvāṅgau mallau śailendrasannibhau  |
kva cātisukumārāṅgau kiśorau nāptayauvanau  || 10.44.008 ||
dharmavyatikramo hyasya samājasya dhruvaṃ bhavet |
yatrādharmaḥ samuttiṣṭhenna stheyaṃ tatra karhicit || 10.44.009 ||
na sabhāṃ praviśetprājñaḥ sabhyadoṣānanusmaran  |
abruvan vibruvannajño naraḥ kilbiṣamaśnute  || 10.44.010 ||
valgataḥ śatrumabhitaḥ kṛṣṇasya vadanāmbujam  |
vīkṣyatāṃ śramavāryuptaṃ padmakośamivāmbubhiḥ  || 10.44.011 ||
kiṃ na paśyata rāmasya mukhamātāmralocanam  |
muṣṭikaṃ prati sāmarṣaṃ hāsasaṃrambhaśobhitam  || 10.44.012 ||
puṇyā bata vrajabhuvo yadayaṃ nṛliṅga   gūḍhaḥ purāṇapuruṣo vanacitramālyaḥ  |
gāḥ pālayan sahabalaḥ kvaṇayaṃśca veṇuṃ   vikrīdayāñcati giritraramārcitāṅghriḥ  || 10.44.013 ||*
gopyastapaḥ kimacaran yadamuṣya rūpaṃ   lāvaṇyasāramasamordhvamananyasiddham  |
dṛgbhiḥ pibantyanusavābhinavaṃ durāpam   ekāntadhāma yaśasaḥ śrīya aiśvarasya  || 10.44.014 ||*
yā dohane'vahanane mathanopalepa preṅkheṅkhanārbharuditokṣaṇamārjanādau  |
gāyanti cainamanuraktadhiyo'śrukaṇṭhyo dhanyā vrajastriya urukramacittayānāḥ  || 10.44.015 ||
prātarvrajādvrajata āviśataśca sāyaṃ   gobhiḥ samaṃ kvaṇayato'sya niśamya veṇum  |
nirgamya tūrṇamabalāḥ pathi bhūripuṇyāḥ   paśyanti sasmitamukhaṃ sadayāvalokam  || 10.44.016 ||*
evaṃ prabhāṣamāṇāsu strīṣu yogeśvaro hariḥ  |
śatruṃ hantuṃ manaścakre bhagavān bharatarṣabha  || 10.44.017 ||
sabhayāḥ strīgiraḥ śrutvā putrasnehaśucāturau  |
pitarāvanvatapyetāṃ putrayorabudhau balam  || 10.44.018 ||
taistairniyuddhavidhibhirvividhairacyutetarau  |
yuyudhāte yathānyonyaṃ tathaiva balamuṣṭikau  || 10.44.019 ||
bhagavadgātraniṣpātairvajranīṣpeṣaniṣṭhuraiḥ  |
cāṇūro bhajyamānāṅgo muhurglānimavāpa ha  || 10.44.020 ||
sa śyenavega utpatya muṣṭīkṛtya karāvubhau  |
bhagavantaṃ vāsudevaṃ kruddho vakṣasyabādhata  || 10.44.021 ||
nācalattatprahāreṇa mālāhata iva dvipaḥ  |
bāhvornigṛhya cāṇūraṃ bahuśo bhrāmayan hariḥ  || 10.44.022 ||
bhūpṛṣṭhe pothayāmāsa tarasā kṣīṇa jīvitam  |
visrastākalpakeśasragindradhvaja ivāpatat || 10.44.023 ||
tathaiva muṣṭikaḥ pūrvaṃ svamuṣṭyābhihatena vai  |
balabhadreṇa balinā talenābhihato bhṛśam  || 10.44.024 ||
pravepitaḥ sa rudhiramudvamanmukhato'rditaḥ  |
vyasuḥ papātorvyupasthe vātāhata ivāṅghripaḥ  || 10.44.025 ||
tataḥ kūṭamanuprāptaṃ rāmaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ  |
avadhīllīlayā rājan sāvajñaṃ vāmamuṣṭinā  || 10.44.026 ||
tarhyeva hi śalaḥ kṛṣṇa prapadāhataśīrṣakaḥ  |
dvidhā vidīrṇastośalaka ubhāvapi nipetatuḥ  || 10.44.027 ||
cāṇūre muṣṭike kūṭe śale tośalake hate  |
śeṣāḥ pradudruvurmallāḥ sarve prāṇaparīpsavaḥ  || 10.44.028 ||
gopān vayasyānākṛṣya taiḥ saṃsṛjya vijahratuḥ  |
vādyamāneṣu tūryeṣu valgantau rutanūpurau  || 10.44.029 ||
janāḥ prajahṛṣuḥ sarve karmaṇā rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ  |
ṛte kaṃsaṃ vipramukhyāḥ sādhavaḥ sādhu sādhviti  || 10.44.030 ||
hateṣu mallavaryeṣu vidruteṣu ca bhojarāṭ |
nyavārayatsvatūryāṇi vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha  || 10.44.031 ||
niḥsārayata durvṛttau vasudevātmajau purāt |
dhanaṃ harata gopānāṃ nandaṃ badhnīta durmatim  || 10.44.032 ||
vasudevastu durmedhā hanyatāmāśvasattamaḥ  |
ugrasenaḥ pitā cāpi sānugaḥ parapakṣagaḥ  || 10.44.033 ||
evaṃ vikatthamāne vai kaṃse prakupito'vyayaḥ  |
laghimnotpatya tarasā mañcamuttuṅgamāruhat || 10.44.034 ||
tamāviśantamālokya mṛtyumātmana āsanāt |
manasvī sahasotthāya jagṛhe so'sicarmaṇī  || 10.44.035 ||
taṃ khaḍgapāṇiṃ vicarantamāśu śyenaṃ yathā dakṣiṇasavyamambare  |

pragṛhya keśeṣu calatkirītaṃ nipātya raṅgopari tuṅgamañcāt |
tasyopariṣṭātsvayamabjanābhaḥ papāta viśvāśraya ātmatantraḥ  || 10.44.037 ||
taṃ samparetaṃ vicakarṣa bhūmau hariryathebhaṃ jagato vipaśyataḥ  |
hā heti śabdaḥ sumahāṃstadābhūdudīritaḥ sarvajanairnarendra  || 10.44.038 ||
sa nityadodvignadhiyā tamīśvaraṃ pibannadan vā vicaran svapan śvasan  |
dadarśa cakrāyudhamagrato yatastadeva rūpaṃ duravāpamāpa  || 10.44.039 ||
tasyānujā bhrātaro'ṣṭau kaṅkanyagrodhakādayaḥ  |
abhyadhāvannatikruddhā bhrāturnirveśakāriṇaḥ  || 10.44.040 ||
tathātirabhasāṃstāṃstu saṃyattān rohiṇīsutaḥ  |
ahan parighamudyamya paśūniva mṛgādhipaḥ  || 10.44.041 ||
nedurdundubhayo vyomni brahmeśādyā vibhūtayaḥ  |
puṣpaiḥ kirantastaṃ prītāḥ śaśaṃsurnanṛtuḥ striyaḥ  || 10.44.042 ||
teṣāṃ striyo mahārāja suhṛnmaraṇaduḥkhitāḥ  |

śayānān vīraśayāyāṃ patīnāliṅgya śocatīḥ  |
vilepuḥ susvaraṃ nāryo visṛjantyo muhuḥ śucaḥ  || 10.44.044 ||
hā nātha priya dharmajña karuṇānāthavatsala  |
tvayā hatena nihatā vayaṃ te sagṛhaprajāḥ  || 10.44.045 ||
tvayā virahitā patyā purīyaṃ puruṣarṣabha  |
na śobhate vayamiva nivṛttotsavamaṅgalā  || 10.44.046 ||
anāgasāṃ tvaṃ bhūtānāṃ kṛtavān drohamulbaṇam  |
tenemāṃ bho daśāṃ nīto bhūtadhrukko labheta śam  || 10.44.047 ||
sarveṣāmiha bhūtānāmeṣa hi prabhavāpyayaḥ  |
goptā ca tadavadhyāyī na kvacitsukhamedhate  || 10.44.048 ||
10.44.049|0 śrīśuka uvāca
rājayoṣita āśvāsya bhagavāṃllokabhāvanaḥ  |

10.45.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
pitarāvupalabdhārthau viditvā puruṣottamaḥ  |
mā bhūditi nijāṃ māyāṃ tatāna janamohinīm  || 10.45.001 ||
uvāca pitarāvetya sāgrajaḥ sātvanarṣabhaḥ  |
praśrayāvanataḥ prīṇannamba tāteti sādaram  || 10.45.002 ||

10.45.010|0 śrīśuka uvāca
iti māyāmanuṣyasya harerviśvātmano girā  |
mohitāvaṅkamāropya pariṣvajyāpaturmudam  || 10.45.010 ||
siñcantāvaśrudhārābhiḥ snehapāśena cāvṛtau  |

evamāśvāsya pitarau bhagavān devakīsutaḥ  |

vīkṣanto'harahaḥ prītā mukundavadanāmbujam  |

tatra pravayaso'pyāsan yuvāno'tibalaujasaḥ  |

saṅkarṣaṇaśca rājendra pariṣvajyedamūcatuḥ  || 10.45.020 ||
pitaryuvābhyāṃ snigdhābhyāṃ poṣitau lālitau bhṛśam  |
pitrorabhyadhikā prītirātmajeṣvātmano'pi hi  || 10.45.021 ||
sa pitā sā ca jananī yau puṣṇītāṃ svaputravat |
śiśūn bandhubhirutsṛṣṭānakalpaiḥ poṣarakṣaṇe  || 10.45.022 ||
yāta yūyaṃ vrajaṃn tāta vayaṃ ca snehaduḥkhitān  |

vāso'laṅkārakupyādyairarhayāmāsa sādaram  || 10.45.024 ||
ityuktastau pariṣvajya nandaḥ praṇayavihvalaḥ  |

atha śūrasuto rājan putrayoḥ samakārayat |
purodhasā brāhmaṇaiśca yathāvaddvijasaṃskṛtim  || 10.45.026 ||
tebhyo'dāddakṣiṇā gāvo rukmamālāḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ  |

yāḥ kṛṣṇarāmajanmarkṣe manodattā mahāmatiḥ  |

tataśca labdhasaṃskārau dvijatvaṃ prāpya suvratau  |
gargādyadukulācāryādgāyatraṃ vratamāsthitau  || 10.45.029 ||
prabhavau sarvavidyānāṃ sarvajñau jagadīśvarau  |
nānyasiddhāmalaṃ jñānaṃ gūhamānau narehitaiḥ  || 10.45.030 ||
atho gurukule vāsamicchantāvupajagmatuḥ  |
kāśyaṃ sāndīpaniṃ nāma hyavantipuravāsinam  || 10.45.031 ||
yathopasādya tau dāntau gurau vṛttimaninditām  |
grāhayantāvupetau sma bhaktyā devamivādṛtau  || 10.45.032 ||
tayordvijavarastuṣṭaḥ śuddhabhāvānuvṛttibhiḥ  |
provāca vedānakhilān saṅgopaniṣado guruḥ  || 10.45.033 ||
sarahasyaṃ dhanurvedaṃ dharmānnyāyapathāṃstathā  |

sarvaṃ naravaraśreṣṭhau sarvavidyāpravartakau  |
sakṛnnigadamātreṇa tau sañjagṛhaturnṛpa  || 10.45.035 ||
ahorātraiścatuḥṣaṣṭyā saṃyattau tāvatīḥ kalāḥ  |

dvijastayostaṃ mahimānamadbhutaṃ   saṃlokṣya rājannatimānusīṃ matim  |
sammantrya patnyā sa mahārṇave mṛtaṃ   bālaṃ prabhāse varayāṃ babhūva ha  || 10.45.037 ||*
tethetyathāruhya mahārathau rathaṃ   prabhāsamāsādya durantavikramau  |
velāmupavrajya niṣīdatuḥ kṣanaṃ   sindhurviditvārhanamāharattayoḥ  || 10.45.038 ||*
tamāha bhagavānāśu guruputraḥ pradīyatām  |
yo'sāviha tvayā grasto bālako mahatormiṇā  || 10.45.039 ||
10.45.040|0 śrīsamudra uvāca
na cāhārṣamahaṃ deva daityaḥ pañcajano mahān  |
antarjalacaraḥ kṛṣṇa śaṅkharūpadharo'suraḥ  || 10.45.040 ||
āste tenāhṛto nūnaṃ tacchrutvā satvaraṃ prabhuḥ  |
jalamāviśya taṃ hatvā nāpaśyadudare'rbhakam  || 10.45.041 ||
tadaṅgaprabhavaṃ śaṅkhamādāya rathamāgamat |
tataḥ saṃyamanīṃ nāma yamasya dayitāṃ purīm  || 10.45.042 ||
gatvā janārdanaḥ śaṅkhaṃ pradadhmau sahalāyudhaḥ  |
śaṅkhanirhrādamākarṇya prajāsaṃyamano yamaḥ  || 10.45.043 ||
tayoḥ saparyāṃ mahatīṃ cakre bhaktyupabṛṃhitām  |
uvācāvanataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ sarvabhūtāśayālayam  |

10.45.045|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
guruputramihānītaṃ nijakarmanibandhanam  |

10.45.047|0 śrīgururuvāca
samyaksampādito vatsa bhavadbhyāṃ guruniṣkrayaḥ  |

āyātau svapuraṃ tāta parjanyaninadena vai  || 10.45.049 ||

10.46.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
vṛṣṇīnāṃ pravaro mantrī kṛṣṇasya dayitaḥ sakhā  |

tamāha bhagavān preṣṭhaṃ bhaktamekāntinaṃ kvacit |

10.46.007|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ityukta uddhavo rājan sandeśaṃ bharturādṛtaḥ  |

prāpto nandavrajaṃ śrīmānnimlocati vibhāvasau  |

vāsitārthe'bhiyudhyadbhirnāditaṃ śuśmibhirvṛṣaiḥ  |

itastato vilaṅghadbhirgovatsairmaṇḍitaṃ sitaiḥ  |

gāyantībhiśca karmāṇi śubhāni balakṛṣṇayoḥ  |

agnyarkātithigovipra pitṛdevārcanānvitaiḥ  |

diṣṭyā kaṃso hataḥ pāpaḥ sānugaḥ svena pāpmanā  |

api smarati naḥ kṛṣṇo mātaraṃ suhṛdaḥ sakhīn  |

dāvāgnervātavarṣācca vṛṣasarpācca rakṣitāḥ  |

saricchailavanoddeśānmukundapadabhūṣitān  |

kaṃsaṃ nāgāyutaprāṇaṃ mallau gajapatiṃ yathā  |

tālatrayaṃ mahāsāraṃ dhanuryaṣṭimivebharāṭ |

10.46.027|0 śrīśuka uvāca
iti saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya nandaḥ kṛṣṇānuraktadhīḥ  |

10.46.030|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
yuvāṃ ślāghyatamau nūnaṃ dehināmiha mānada  |

10.48.029|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
tvaṃ no guruḥ pitṛvyaśca ślāghyo bandhuśca nityadā  |

10.49.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca

10.49.014|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ityanusmṛtya svajanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca jagadīśvaram  |

10.49.017|0 akrūra uvāca

eko'nubhuṅkte sukṛtameka eva ca duṣkṛtam  || 10.49.021 ||

10.49.026|0 dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca

10.49.030|0 śrīśuka uvāca

10.50.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
astiḥ prāptiśca kaṃsasya mahiṣyau bharatarṣabha  |

haniṣyāmi balaṃ hyetadbhuvi bhāraṃ samāhitam  |

etadartho'vatāro'yaṃ bhūbhāraharaṇāya me  |

āyudhāni ca divyāni purāṇāni yadṛcchayā  |

etadarthaṃ hi nau janma sādhūnāmīśa śarmakṛt |

10.50.019|0 śrībhagavānuvāca

10.50.020|0 śrīśuka uvāca
jarāsutastāvabhisṛtya mādhavau mahābalaughena balīyasāvṛnot |

suparṇatāladhvajacihitnau rathāv  alakṣayantyo harirāmayormṛdhe  |

jagrāha virathaṃ rāmo jarāsandhaṃ mahābalam  |

hateṣu sarvānīkeṣu nṛpo bārhadrathastadā  |

āyodhanagataṃ vittamanantaṃ vīrabhūṣaṇam  |

evaṃ saptadaśakṛtvastāvatyakṣauhiṇībalaḥ  |

akṣiṇvaṃstadbalaṃ sarvaṃ vṛṣṇayaḥ kṛṣṇatejasā  |

aṣṭādaśama saṅgrāma āgāmini tadantarā  |

āvayoḥ yudhyatorasya yadyāgantā jarāsutaḥ  |

suradrumalatodyāna vicitropavanānvitam  |
hemaśṛṅgairdivispṛgbhiḥ sphaṭikāṭṭālagopuraiḥ  || 10.50.051 ||
rājatārakuṭaiḥ koṣṭhairhemakumbhairalaṅkṛtaiḥ  |
ratnakūtairgṛhairhemairmahāmārakatasthalaiḥ  || 10.50.052 ||
vāstoṣpatīnāṃ ca gṛhairvallabhībhiśca nirmitam  |

sudharmāṃ pārijātaṃ ca mahendraḥ prāhiṇoddhareḥ  |

śyāmaikavarṇān varuṇo hayān śuklānmanojavān  |
aṣṭau nidhipatiḥ kośān lokapālo nijodayān  || 10.50.055 ||
yadyadbhagavatā dattamādhipatyaṃ svasiddhaye  |
sarvaṃ pratyarpayāmāsurharau bhūmigate nṛpa  || 10.50.056 ||
tatra yogaprabhāvena nītvā sarvajanaṃ hariḥ  |
prajāpālena rāmeṇa kṛṣṇaḥ samanumantritaḥ  |
nirjagāma puradvārātpadmamālī nirāyudhaḥ  || 10.50.057 ||
10.51.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca

lakṣaṇairnāradaproktairnānyo bhavitumarhati  |

iti niścitya yavanaḥ prādravadtaṃ parāṅmukham  |

iti kṣipannanugato nainaṃ prāpāhatāśubhaḥ  || 10.51.008 ||

diśo vilokayan pārśve tamadrākṣīdavasthitam  || 10.51.011 ||

10.51.013|0 śrīrājovāca

10.51.014|0 śrīśuka uvāca

10.51.027|0 śrīmucukunda uvāca
ko bhavāniha samprāpto vipine girigahvare  |

10.51.036|0 śrībhagavānuvāca

10.51.045|0 śrīmucukunda uvāca

10.51.058|0 śrībhagavānuvāca

juṣṭaṃ strīpuruṣaiḥ śrīmadgṛhairagurudhūpitaiḥ  || 10.53.009 ||
pitṝn devān samabhyarcya viprāṃśca vidhivannṛpa  |
bhojayitvā yathānyāyaṃ vācayāmāsa maṅgalam  || 10.53.010 ||
susnātāṃ sudatīṃ kanyāṃ kṛtakautukamaṅgalām  |
āhatāṃśukayugmena bhūṣitāṃ bhūṣaṇottamaiḥ  || 10.53.011 ||
cakruḥ sāmargyajurmantrairvadhvā rakṣāṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
purohito'tharvavidvai juhāva grahaśāntaye  || 10.53.012 ||
hiraṇyarūpya vāsāṃsi tilāṃśca guḍamiśritān  |
prādāddhenūśca viprebhyo rājā vidhividāṃ varaḥ  || 10.53.013 ||
evaṃ cedipatī rājā damaghoṣaḥ sutāya vai  |
kārayāmāsa mantrajñaiḥ sarvamabhyudayocitam  || 10.53.014 ||
madacyudbhirgajānīkaiḥ syandanairhemamālibhiḥ  |
pattyaśvasaṅkulaiḥ sainyaiḥ parītaḥ kuṇdīnaṃ yayau  || 10.53.015 ||
taṃ vai vidarbhādhipatiḥ samabhyetyābhipūjya ca  |
niveśayāmāsa mudā kalpitānyaniveśane  || 10.53.016 ||
tatra śālvo jarāsandho dantavakro vidūrathaḥ  |
ājagmuścaidyapakṣīyāḥ pauṇḍrakādyāḥ sahasraśaḥ  || 10.53.017 ||
kṛṣṇarāmadviṣo yattāḥ kanyāṃ caidyāya sādhitum  |
yadyāgatya haretkṛṣno rāmādyairyadubhirvṛtaḥ  || 10.53.018 ||
yotsyāmaḥ saṃhatāstena iti niścitamānasāḥ  |
ājagmurbhūbhujaḥ sarve samagrabalavāhanāḥ  || 10.53.019 ||
śrutvaitadbhagavān rāmo vipakṣīya nṛpodyamam  |
kṛṣṇaṃ caikaṃ gataṃ hartuṃ kanyāṃ kalahaśaṅkitaḥ  || 10.53.020 ||
balena mahatā sārdhaṃ bhrātṛsnehapariplutaḥ  |
tvaritaḥ kuṇḍinaṃ prāgādgajāśvarathapattibhiḥ  || 10.53.021 ||
bhīṣmakanyā varārohā kāṅkṣantyāgamanaṃ hareḥ  |
pratyāpattimapaśyantī dvijasyācintayattadā  || 10.53.022 ||
aho triyāmāntarita udvāho me'lparādhasaḥ  |
nāgacchatyaravindākṣo nāhaṃ vedmyatra kāraṇam  |
so'pi nāvartate'dyāpi matsandeśaharo dvijaḥ  || 10.53.023 ||
api mayyanavadyātmā dṛṣṭvā kiñcijjugupsitam  |
matpāṇigrahaṇe nūnaṃ nāyāti hi kṛtodyamaḥ  || 10.53.024 ||
durbhagāyā na me dhātā nānukūlo maheśvaraḥ  |
devī vā vimukhī gaurī rudrāṇī girijā satī  || 10.53.025 ||
evaṃ cintayatī bālā govindahṛtamānasā  |
nyamīlayata kālajñā netre cāśrukalākule  || 10.53.026 ||
evaṃ vadhvāḥ pratīkṣantyā govindāgamanaṃ nṛpa  |
vāma ūrurbhujo netramasphuran priyabhāṣiṇaḥ  || 10.53.027 ||
atha kṛṣṇavinirdiṣṭaḥ sa eva dvijasattamaḥ  |
antaḥpuracarīṃ devīṃ rājaputrīṃ dadarśa ha  || 10.53.028 ||
sā taṃ prahṛṣṭavadanamavyagrātmagatiṃ satī  |
ālakṣya lakṣaṇābhijñā samapṛcchacchucismitā  || 10.53.029 ||
tasyā āvedayatprāptaṃ śaśaṃsa yadunandanam  |
uktaṃ ca satyavacanamātmopanayanaṃ prati  || 10.53.030 ||
tamāgataṃ samājñāya vaidarbhī hṛṣṭamānasā  |
na paśyantī brāhmaṇāya priyamanyannanāma sā  || 10.53.031 ||
prāptau śrutvā svaduhiturudvāhaprekṣaṇotsukau  |
abhyayāttūryaghoṣeṇa rāmakṛṣṇau samarhaṇaiḥ  || 10.53.032 ||
madhuparkamupānīya vāsāṃsi virajāṃsi saḥ  |
upāyanānyabhīṣṭāni vidhivatsamapūjayat || 10.53.033 ||
tayorniveśanaṃ śrīmadupākalpya mahāmatiḥ  |
sasainyayoḥ sānugayorātithyaṃ vidadhe yathā  || 10.53.034 ||
evaṃ rājñāṃ sametānāṃ yathāvīryaṃ yathāvayaḥ  |
yathābalaṃ yathāvittaṃ sarvaiḥ kāmaiḥ samarhayat || 10.53.035 ||
kṛṣṇamāgatamākarṇya vidarbhapuravāsinaḥ  |
āgatya netrāñjalibhiḥ papustanmukhapaṅkajam  || 10.53.036 ||
asyaiva bhāryā bhavituṃ rukmiṇyarhati nāparā  |
asāvapyanavadyātmā bhaiṣmyāḥ samucitaḥ patiḥ  || 10.53.037 ||
kiñcitsucaritaṃ yannastena tuṣṭastrilokakṛt |
anugṛhṇātu gṛhṇātu vaidarbhyāḥ pāṇimacyutaḥ  || 10.53.038 ||
evaṃ premakalābaddhā vadanti sma puraukasaḥ  |
kanyā cāntaḥpurātprāgādbhaṭairguptāmbikālayam  || 10.53.039 ||
padbhyāṃ viniryayau draṣṭuṃ bhavānyāḥ pādapallavam  |
sā cānudhyāyatī samyaṅmukundacaraṇāmbujam  || 10.53.040 ||
yatavāṅmātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ sakhībhiḥ parivāritā  |
guptā rājabhaṭaiḥ śūraiḥ sannaddhairudyatāyudhaiḥ  |
mṛḍaṅgaśaṅkhapaṇavāstūryabheryaśca jaghnire  || 10.53.041 ||
nānopahāra balibhirvāramukhyāḥ sahasraśaḥ  |
sraggandhavastrābharaṇairdvijapatnyaḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ  || 10.53.042 ||
gāyantyaśca stuvantaśca gāyakā vādyavādakāḥ  |
parivārya vadhūṃ jagmuḥ sūtamāgadhavandinaḥ  || 10.53.043 ||
āsādya devīsadanaṃ dhautapādakarāmbujā  |
upaspṛśya śuciḥ śāntā praviveśāmbikāntikam  || 10.53.044 ||
tāṃ vai pravayaso bālāṃ vidhijñā viprayoṣitaḥ  |
bhavānīṃ vandayāṃ cakrurbhavapatnīṃ bhavānvitām  || 10.53.045 ||
namasye tvāmbike'bhīkṣṇaṃ svasantānayutāṃ śivām  |
bhūyātpatirme bhagavān kṛṣṇastadanumodatām  || 10.53.046 ||
adbhirgandhākṣatairdhūpairvāsaḥsraṅmālya bhūṣaṇaiḥ  |
nānopahārabalibhiḥ pradīpāvalibhiḥ pṛthak || 10.53.047 ||
viprastriyaḥ patimatīstathā taiḥ samapūjayat |
lavaṇāpūpatāmbūla kaṇṭhasūtraphalekṣubhiḥ  || 10.53.048 ||
tasyai striyastāḥ pradaduḥ śeṣāṃ yuyujurāśiṣaḥ  |
tābhyo devyai namaścakre śeṣāṃ ca jagṛhe vadhūḥ  || 10.53.049 ||
munivratamatha tyaktvā niścakrāmāmbikāgṛhāt |
pragṛhya pāṇinā bhṛtyāṃ ratnamudropaśobhinā  || 10.53.050 ||
tāṃ devamāyāmiva dhīramohinīṃ sumadhyamāṃ kuṇḍalamaṇḍitānanām  |
śyāmāṃ nitambārpitaratnamekhalāṃ vyañjatstanīṃ kuntalaśaṅkitekṣaṇām  || 10.53.051 ||
śucismitāṃ bimbaphalādharadyuti śoṇāyamānadvijakundakuḍmalām  |
padā calantīṃ kalahaṃsagāminīṃ siñjatkalānūpuradhāmaśobhinā  || 10.53.052 ||
vilokya vīrā mumuhuḥ samāgatā yaśasvinastatkṛtahṛcchayārditāḥ  |
yāṃ vīkṣya te nṛpatayastadudārahāsa vrīdāvalokahṛtacetasa ujjhitāstrāḥ  || 10.53.053 ||
petuḥ kṣitau gajarathāśvagatā vimūḍhā yātrācchalena haraye'rpayatīṃ svaśobhām  |
saivaṃ śanaiścalayatī calapadmakośau prāptiṃ tadā bhagavataḥ prasamīkṣamāṇā  || 10.53.054 ||
utsārya vāmakarajairalakānapaṅgaiḥ prāptān hriyaikṣata nṛpān dadṛśe'cyutaṃ ca  |
tāṃ rājakanyāṃ rathamārurakṣatīṃ jahāra kṛṣṇo dviṣatāṃ samīkṣatām  || 10.53.055 ||
rathaṃ samāropya suparṇalakṣaṇaṃ rājanyacakraṃ paribhūya mādhavaḥ  |
tato yayau rāmapurogamaḥ śanaiḥ śṛgālamadhyādiva bhāgahṛddhariḥ  || 10.53.056 ||
taṃ māninaḥ svābhibhavaṃ yaśaḥkṣayaṃ   pare jarāsandhamukhā na sehire  |
aho dhigasmān yaśa āttadhanvanāṃ   gopairhṛtaṃ keśariṇāṃ mṛgairiva  || 10.53.057 ||*
10.54.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
iti sarve susaṃrabdhā vāhānāruhya daṃśitāḥ  |
svaiḥ svairbalaiḥ parikrāntā anvīyurdhṛtakārmukāḥ  || 10.54.001 ||
tānāpatata ālokya yādavānīkayūthapāḥ  |
tasthustatsammukhā rājan visphūrjya svadhanūṃṣi te  || 10.54.002 ||
aśvapṛṣṭhe gajaskandhe rathopasthe'stra kovidāḥ  |
mumucuḥ śaravarṣāṇi meghā adriṣvapo yathā  || 10.54.003 ||
patyurbalaṃ śarāsāraiśchannaṃ vīkṣya sumadhyamā  |
savrīḍmaikṣattadvaktraṃ bhayavihvalalocanā  || 10.54.004 ||
prahasya bhagavānāha mā sma bhairvāmalocane  |
vinaṅkṣyatyadhunaivaitattāvakaiḥ śātravaṃ balam  || 10.54.005 ||
teṣāṃ tadvikramaṃ vīrā gadasaṅkarṣanādayaḥ  |
amṛṣyamāṇā nārācairjaghnurhayagajān rathān  || 10.54.006 ||
petuḥ śirāṃsi rathināmaśvināṃ gajināṃ bhuvi  |
sakuṇḍalakirīṭāni soṣṇīṣāṇi ca koṭiśaḥ  || 10.54.007 ||
hastāḥ sāsigadeṣvāsāḥ karabhā ūravo'ṅghrayaḥ  |
aśvāśvataranāgoṣṭra kharamartyaśirāṃsi ca  || 10.54.008 ||
hanyamānabalānīkā vṛṣṇibhirjayakāṅkṣibhiḥ  |
rājāno vimukhā jagmurjarāsandhapuraḥsarāḥ  || 10.54.009 ||
śiśupālaṃ samabhyetya hṛtadāramivāturam  |
naṣṭatviṣaṃ gatotsāhaṃ śuṣyadvadanamabruvan  || 10.54.010 ||
bho bhoḥ puruṣaśārdūla daurmanasyamidaṃ tyaja  |
na priyāpriyayo rājanniṣṭhā dehiṣu dṛśyate  || 10.54.011 ||
yathā dārumayī yoṣitnṛtyate kuhakecchayā  |
evamīśvaratantro'yamīhate sukhaduḥkhayoḥ  || 10.54.012 ||
śaureḥ saptadaśāhaṃ vai saṃyugāni parājitaḥ  |
trayoviṃśatibhiḥ sainyairjigye ekamahaṃ param  || 10.54.013 ||
tathāpyahaṃ na śocāmi na prahṛṣyāmi karhicit |
kālena daivayuktena jānan vidrāvitaṃ jagat || 10.54.014 ||
adhunāpi vayaṃ sarve vīrayūthapayūthapāḥ  |
parājitāḥ phalgutantrairyadubhiḥ kṛṣṇapālitaiḥ  || 10.54.015 ||
ripavo jigyuradhunā kāla ātmānusāriṇi  |
tadā vayaṃ vijeṣyāmo yadā kālaḥ pradakṣiṇaḥ  || 10.54.016 ||
10.54.017|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃ prabodhito mitraiścaidyo'gātsānugaḥ puram  |
hataśeṣāḥ punaste'pi yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ puraṃ nṛpāḥ  || 10.54.017 ||
rukmī tu rākṣasodvāhaṃ kṛṣṇadviḍasahan svasuḥ  |
pṛṣṭhato'nvagamatkṛṣṇamakṣauhiṇyā vṛto balī  || 10.54.018 ||
rukmyamarṣī susaṃrabdhaḥ śṛṇvatāṃ sarvabhūbhujām  |
pratijajñe mahābāhurdaṃśitaḥ saśarāsanaḥ  || 10.54.019 ||
ahatvā samare kṛṣṇamapratyūhya ca rukmiṇīm  |
kuṇḍinaṃ na pravekṣyāmi satyametadbravīmi vaḥ  || 10.54.020 ||
ityuktvā rathamāruhya sārathiṃ prāha satvaraḥ  |
codayāśvān yataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ tasya me saṃyugaṃ bhavet || 10.54.021 ||
adyāhaṃ niśitairbāṇairgopālasya sudurmateḥ  |
neṣye vīryamadaṃ yena svasā me prasabhaṃ hṛtā  || 10.54.022 ||
vikatthamānaḥ kumatirīśvarasyāpramāṇavit |
rathenaikena govindaṃ tiṣṭha tiṣṭhetyathāhvayat || 10.54.023 ||
dhanurvikṛṣya sudṛḍhaṃ jaghne kṛṣṇaṃ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ  |
āha cātra kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha yadūnāṃ kulapāṃsana  || 10.54.024 ||
yatra yāsi svasāraṃ me muṣitvā dhvāṅkṣavaddhaviḥ  |
hariṣye'dya madaṃ manda māyinaḥ kūṭayodhinaḥ  || 10.54.025 ||
yāvanna me hato bāṇaiḥ śayīthā muñca dārīkām  |
smayan kṛṣṇo dhanuśchittvā ṣaḍbhirvivyādha rukmiṇam  || 10.54.026 ||
aṣṭabhiścaturo vāhān dvābhyāṃ sūtaṃ dhvajaṃ tribhiḥ  |
sa cānyaddhanurādhāya kṛṣṇaṃ vivyādha pañcabhiḥ  || 10.54.027 ||
taistāditaḥ śaraughaistu ciccheda dhanuracyutaḥ  |
punaranyadupādatta tadapyacchinadavyayaḥ  || 10.54.028 ||
parighaṃ paṭṭiśaṃ śūlaṃ carmāsī śaktitomarau  |
yadyadāyudhamādatta tatsarvaṃ so'cchinaddhariḥ  || 10.54.029 ||
tato rathādavaplutya khaḍgapāṇirjighāṃsayā  |
kṛṣṇamabhyadravatkruddhaḥ pataṅga iva pāvakam  || 10.54.030 ||
tasya cāpatataḥ khaḍgaṃ tilaśaścarma ceṣubhiḥ  |
chittvāsimādade tigmaṃ rukmiṇaṃ hantumudyataḥ  || 10.54.031 ||
dṛṣṭvā bhrātṛvadhodyogaṃ rukmiṇī bhayavihvalā  |
patitvā pādayorbharturuvāca karuṇaṃ satī  || 10.54.032 ||
10.54.033|0 śrīrukmiṇyuvāca
yogeśvarāprameyātman devadeva jagatpate  |
hantuṃ nārhasi kalyāṇa bhrātaraṃ me mahābhuja  || 10.54.033 ||
10.54.034|0 śrīśuka uvāca
tayā paritrāsavikampitāṅgayā śucāvaśuṣyanmukharuddhakaṇṭhayā  |
kātaryavisraṃsitahemamālayā gṛhītapādaḥ karuṇo nyavartata  || 10.54.034 ||
cailena baddhvā tamasādhukārīṇaṃ saśmaśrukeśaṃ pravapan vyarūpayat |
tāvanmamarduḥ parasainyamadbhutaṃ yadupravīrā nalinīṃ yathā gajāḥ  || 10.54.035 ||
kṛṣṇāntikamupavrajya dadṛśustatra rukmiṇam  |
tathābhūtaṃ hataprāyaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṅkarṣaṇo vibhuḥ  |
vimucya baddhaṃ karuṇo bhagavān kṛṣṇamabravīt || 10.54.036 ||
asādhvidaṃ tvayā kṛṣṇa kṛtamasmajjugupsitam  |
vapanaṃ śmaśrukeśānāṃ vairūpyaṃ suhṛdo vadhaḥ  || 10.54.037 ||
maivāsmān sādhvyasūyethā bhrāturvairūpyacintayā  |
sukhaduḥkhado na cānyo'sti yataḥ svakṛtabhukpumān  || 10.54.038 ||
bandhurvadhārhadoṣo'pi na bandhorvadhamarhati  |
tyājyaḥ svenaiva doṣeṇa hataḥ kiṃ hanyate punaḥ  || 10.54.039 ||
kṣatriyāṇāmayaṃ dharmaḥ prajāpativinirmitaḥ  |
bhrātāpi bhrātaraṃ hanyādyena ghoratamastataḥ  || 10.54.040 ||
rājyasya bhūmervittasya striyo mānasya tejasaḥ  |
mānino'nyasya vā hetoḥ śrīmadāndhāḥ kṣipanti hi  || 10.54.041 ||
taveyaṃ viṣamā buddhiḥ sarvabhūteṣu durhṛdām  |
yanmanyase sadābhadraṃ suhṛdāṃ bhadramajñavat || 10.54.042 ||
ātmamoho nṛṇāmeva kalpate devamāyayā  |
suhṛddurhṛdudāsīna iti dehātmamāninām  || 10.54.043 ||
eka eva paro hyātmā sarveṣāmapi dehinām  |
nāneva gṛhyate mūḍhairyathā jyotiryathā nabhaḥ  || 10.54.044 ||
deha ādyantavāneṣa dravyaprāṇaguṇātmakaḥ  |
ātmanyavidyayā kḷptaḥ saṃsārayati dehinam  || 10.54.045 ||
nātmano'nyena saṃyogo viyogaścasataḥ sati  |
taddhetutvāttatprasiddherdṛgrūpābhyāṃ yathā raveḥ  || 10.54.046 ||
janmādayastu dehasya vikriyā nātmanaḥ kvacit |
kalānāmiva naivendormṛtirhyasya kuhūriva  || 10.54.047 ||
yathā śayāna ātmānaṃ viṣayān phalameva ca  |
anubhuṅkte'pyasatyarthe tathāpnotyabudho bhavam  || 10.54.048 ||
tasmādajñānajaṃ śokamātmaśoṣavimohanam  |
tattvajñānena nirhṛtya svasthā bhava śucismite  || 10.54.049 ||
10.54.050|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃ bhagavatā tanvī rāmeṇa pratibodhitā  |
vaimanasyaṃ parityajya mano buddhyā samādadhe  || 10.54.050 ||
prāṇāvaśeṣa utsṛṣṭo dviḍbhirhatabalaprabhaḥ  |
smaran virūpakaraṇaṃ vitathātmamanorathaḥ  |
cakre bhojakaṭaṃ nāma nivāsāya mahatpuram  || 10.54.051 ||
ahatvā durmatiṃ kṛṣṇamapratyūhya yavīyasīm  |
kuṇḍinaṃ na pravekṣyāmītyuktvā tatrāvasadruṣā  || 10.54.052 ||
bhagavān bhīṣmakasutāmevaṃ nirjitya bhūmipān  |
puramānīya vidhivadupayeme kurūdvaha  || 10.54.053 ||
tadā mahotsavo nṝṇāṃ yadupuryāṃ gṛhe gṛhe  |
abhūdananyabhāvānāṃ kṛṣṇe yadupatau nṛpa  || 10.54.054 ||
narā nāryaśca muditāḥ pramṛṣṭamaṇikuṇḍalāḥ  |
pāribarhamupājahrurvarayościtravāsasoḥ  || 10.54.055 ||
sā vṛṣṇipuryuttambhitendraketubhir  vicitramālyāmbararatnatoraṇaiḥ  |
babhau pratidvāryupakḷptamaṅgalair  āpūrṇakumbhāgurudhūpadīpakaiḥ  || 10.54.056 ||*
siktamārgā madacyudbhirāhūtapreṣṭhabhūbhujām  |
gajairdvāḥsu parāmṛṣṭa rambhāpūgopaśobhitā  || 10.54.057 ||
kurusṛñjayakaikeya vidarbhayadukuntayaḥ  |
mitho mumudire tasmin sambhramātparidhāvatām  || 10.54.058 ||
rukmiṇyā haraṇaṃ śrutvā gīyamānaṃ tatastataḥ  |
rājāno rājakanyāśca babhūvurbhṛśavismitāḥ  || 10.54.059 ||
dvārakāyāmabhūdrājanmahāmodaḥ puraukasām  |
rukmiṇyā ramayopetaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim  || 10.54.060 ||
10.55.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
kāmastu vāsudevāṃśo dagdhaḥ prāgrudramanyunā  |
dehopapattaye bhūyastameva pratyapadyata  || 10.55.001 ||
sa eva jāto vaidarbhyāṃ kṛṣṇavīryasamudbhavaḥ  |
pradyumna iti vikhyātaḥ sarvato'navamaḥ pituḥ  || 10.55.002 ||
taṃ śambaraḥ kāmarūpī hṛtvā tokamanirdaśam  |
sa viditvātmanaḥ śatruṃ prāsyodanvatyagādgṛham  || 10.55.003 ||
taṃ nirjagāra balavānmīnaḥ so'pyaparaiḥ saha  |
vṛto jālena mahatā gṛhīto matsyajīvibhiḥ  || 10.55.004 ||
taṃ śambarāya kaivartā upājahrurupāyanam  |
sūdā mahānasaṃ nītvā vadyan sudhitinādbhutam  || 10.55.005 ||
dṛṣṭvā tadudare bālaṃ māyāvatyai nyavedayan  |
nārado'kathayatsarvaṃ tasyāḥ śaṅkitacetasaḥ  |
bālasya tattvamutpattiṃ matsyodaraniveśanam  || 10.55.006 ||
sā ca kāmasya vai patnī ratirnāma yaśasvinī  |
patyurnirdagdhadehasya dehotpattiṃ pratīkṣatī  || 10.55.007 ||
nirūpitā śambareṇa sā sūdaudanasādhane  |
kāmadevaṃ śiśuṃ buddhvā cakre snehaṃ tadārbhake  || 10.55.008 ||
nātidīrgheṇa kālena sa kārṣṇi rūḍhayauvanaḥ  |
janayāmāsa nārīṇāṃ vīkṣantīnāṃ ca vibhramam  || 10.55.009 ||
sā taṃ patiṃ padmadalāyatekṣaṇaṃ pralambabāhuṃ naralokasundaram  |
savrīḍahāsottabhitabhruvekṣatī prītyopatasthe ratiraṅga saurataiḥ  || 10.55.010 ||
tāmaha bhagavān kārṣṇirmātaste matiranyathā  |
mātṛbhāvamatikramya vartase kāminī yathā  || 10.55.011 ||
10.55.012|0 ratiruvāca
bhavānnārāyaṇasutaḥ śambareṇa hṛto gṛhāt |
ahaṃ te'dhikṛtā patnī ratiḥ kāmo bhavān prabho  || 10.55.012 ||
eṣa tvānirdaśaṃ sindhāvakṣipacchambaro'suraḥ  |
matsyo'grasīttadudarāditaḥ prāpto bhavān prabho  || 10.55.013 ||
tamimaṃ jahi durdharṣaṃ durjayaṃ śatrumātmanaḥ  |
māyāśatavidaṃ taṃ ca māyābhirmohanādibhiḥ  || 10.55.014 ||
parīśocati te mātā kurarīva gataprajā  |
putrasnehākulā dīnā vivatsā gaurivāturā  || 10.55.015 ||
prabhāṣyaivaṃ dadau vidyāṃ pradyumnāya mahātmane  |
māyāvatī mahāmāyāṃ sarvamāyāvināśinīm  || 10.55.016 ||
sa ca śambaramabhyetya saṃyugāya samāhvayat |
aviṣahyaistamākṣepaiḥ kṣipan sañjanayan kalim  || 10.55.017 ||
so'dhikṣipto durvācobhiḥ padāhata ivoragaḥ  |
niścakrāma gadāpāṇiramarṣāttāmralocanaḥ  || 10.55.018 ||
gadāmāvidhya tarasā pradyumnāya mahātmane  |
prakṣipya vyanadannādaṃ vajraniṣpeṣaniṣṭhuram  || 10.55.019 ||
tāmāpatantīṃ bhagavān pradyumno gadayā gadām  |
apāsya śatrave kruddhaḥ prāhiṇotsvagadāṃ nṛpa  || 10.55.020 ||
sa ca māyāṃ samāśritya daiteyīṃ mayadarśitam  |
mumuce'stramayaṃ varṣaṃ kārṣṇau vaihāyaso'suraḥ  || 10.55.021 ||
bādhyamāno'stravarṣeṇa raukmiṇeyo mahārathaḥ  |
sattvātmikāṃ mahāvidyāṃ sarvamāyopamardinīm  || 10.55.022 ||
tato gauhyakagāndharva paiśācoragarākṣasīḥ  |
prāyuṅkta śataśo daityaḥ kārṣṇirvyadhamayatsa tāḥ  || 10.55.023 ||
niśātamasimudyamya sakirīṭaṃ sakuṇḍalam  |
śambarasya śiraḥ kāyāttāmraśmaśrvojasāharat || 10.55.024 ||
ākīryamāṇo divijaiḥ stuvadbhiḥ kusumotkaraiḥ  |
bhāryayāmbaracāriṇyā puraṃ nīto vihāyasā  || 10.55.025 ||
antaḥpuravaraṃ rājan lalanāśatasaṅkulam  |
viveśa patnyā gaganādvidyuteva balāhakaḥ  || 10.55.026 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā jaladaśyāmaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam  |
pralambabāhuṃ tāmrākṣaṃ susmitaṃ rucirānanam  || 10.55.027 ||
svalaṅkṛtamukhāmbhojaṃ nīlavakrālakālibhiḥ  |
kṛṣṇaṃ matvā striyo hrītā nililyustatra tatra ha  || 10.55.028 ||
avadhārya śanairīṣadvailakṣaṇyena yoṣitaḥ  |
upajagmuḥ pramuditāḥ sastrī ratnaṃ suvismitāḥ  || 10.55.029 ||
atha tatrāsitāpāṅgī vaidarbhī valgubhāṣiṇī  |
asmaratsvasutaṃ naṣṭaṃ snehasnutapayodharā  || 10.55.030 ||
ko nvayaṃ naravaidūryaḥ kasya vā kamalekṣaṇaḥ  |
dhṛtaḥ kayā vā jaṭhare keyaṃ labdhā tvanena vā  || 10.55.031 ||
mama cāpyātmajo naṣṭo nīto yaḥ sūtikāgṛhāt |
etattulyavayorūpo yadi jīvati kutracit || 10.55.032 ||
kathaṃ tvanena samprāptaṃ sārūpyaṃ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ  |
ākṛtyāvayavairgatyā svarahāsāvalokanaiḥ  || 10.55.033 ||
sa eva vā bhavennūnaṃ yo me garbhe dhṛto'rbhakaḥ  |
amuṣmin prītiradhikā vāmaḥ sphurati me bhujaḥ  || 10.55.034 ||
evaṃ mīmāṃsamaṇāyāṃ vaidarbhyāṃ devakīsutaḥ  |
devakyānakadundubhyāmuttamaḥśloka āgamat || 10.55.035 ||
vijñātārtho'pi bhagavāṃstūṣṇīmāsa janārdanaḥ  |
nārado'kathayatsarvaṃ śambarāharaṇādikam  || 10.55.036 ||
tacchrutvā mahadāścaryaṃ kṛṣṇāntaḥpurayoṣitaḥ  |
abhyanandan bahūnabdānnaṣṭaṃ mṛtamivāgatam  || 10.55.037 ||
devakī vasudevaśca kṛṣṇarāmau tathā striyaḥ  |
dampatī tau pariṣvajya rukmiṇī ca yayurmudam  || 10.55.038 ||
naṣṭaṃ pradyumnamāyātamākarṇya dvārakaukasaḥ  |
aho mṛta ivāyāto bālo diṣṭyeti hābruvan  || 10.55.039 ||
yaṃ vai muhuḥ pitṛsarūpanijeśabhāvās  tanmātaro yadabhajan raharūḍhabhāvāḥ  |
citraṃ na tatkhalu ramāspadabimbabimbe   kāme smare'kṣaviṣaye kimutānyanāryaḥ  || 10.55.040 ||*
10.56.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
satrājitaḥ svatanayāṃ kṛṣṇāya kṛtakilbiṣaḥ  |
syamantakena maṇinā svayamudyamya dattavān  || 10.56.001 ||
10.56.002|0 śrīrājovāca
satrājitaḥ kimakarodbrahman kṛṣṇasya kilbiṣaḥ  |
syamantakaḥ kutastasya kasmāddattā sutā hareḥ  || 10.56.002 ||
10.56.003|0 śrīśuka uvāca
āsītsatrājitaḥ sūryo bhaktasya paramaḥ sakhā  |
prītastasmai maṇiṃ prādātsa ca tuṣṭaḥ syamantakam  || 10.56.003 ||
sa taṃ bibhranmaṇiṃ kaṇṭhe bhrājamāno yathā raviḥ  |
praviṣṭo dvārakāṃ rājan tejasā nopalakṣitaḥ  || 10.56.004 ||
taṃ vilokya janā dūrāttejasā muṣṭadṛṣṭayaḥ  |
dīvyate'kṣairbhagavate śaśaṃsuḥ sūryaśaṅkitāḥ  || 10.56.005 ||
nārāyaṇa namaste'stu śaṅkhacakragadādhara  |
dāmodarāravindākṣa govinda yadunandana  || 10.56.006 ||
eṣa āyāti savitā tvāṃ didṛkṣurjagatpate  |
muṣṇan gabhasticakreṇa nṛṇāṃ cakṣūṃṣi tigmaguḥ  || 10.56.007 ||
nanvanvicchanti te mārgaṃ trīlokyāṃ vibudharṣabhāḥ  |
jñātvādya gūḍhaṃ yaduṣu draṣṭuṃ tvāṃ yātyajaḥ prabho  || 10.56.008 ||
10.56.009|0 śrīśuka uvāca
niśamya bālavacanaṃ prahasyāmbujalocanaḥ  |
prāha nāsau ravirdevaḥ satrājinmaṇinā jvalan  || 10.56.009 ||
satrājitsvagṛhaṃ śrīmatkṛtakautukamaṅgalam  |
praviśya devasadane maṇiṃ viprairnyaveśayat || 10.56.010 ||
dine dine svarṇabhārānaṣṭau sa sṛjati prabho  |
durbhikṣamāryariṣṭāni sarpādhivyādhayo'śubhāḥ  |
na santi māyinastatra yatrāste'bhyarcito maṇiḥ  || 10.56.011 ||
sa yācito maṇiṃ kvāpi yadurājāya śauriṇā  |
naivārthakāmukaḥ prādādyācñābhaṅgamatarkayan  || 10.56.012 ||
tamekadā maṇiṃ kaṇṭhe pratimucya mahāprabham  |
praseno hayamāruhya mṛgāyāṃ vyacaradvane  || 10.56.013 ||
prasenaṃ sahayaṃ hatvā maṇimācchidya keśarī  |
giriṃ viśan jāmbavatā nihato maṇimicchatā  || 10.56.014 ||
so'pi cakre kumārasya maṇiṃ krīḍanakaṃ bile  |
apaśyan bhrātaraṃ bhrātā satrājitparyatapyata  || 10.56.015 ||
prāyaḥ kṛṣṇena nihato maṇigrīvo vanaṃ gataḥ  |
bhrātā mameti tacchrutvā karṇe karṇe'japan janāḥ  || 10.56.016 ||
bhagavāṃstadupaśrutya duryaśo liptamātmani  |
mārṣṭuṃ prasenapadavīmanvapadyata nāgaraiḥ  || 10.56.017 ||
hataṃ prasenaṃ aśvaṃ ca vīkṣya keśariṇā vane  |
taṃ cādripṛṣṭhe nihatamṛkṣeṇa dadṛśurjanāḥ  || 10.56.018 ||
ṛkṣarājabilaṃ bhīmamandhena tamasāvṛtam  |
eko viveśa bhagavānavasthāpya bahiḥ prajāḥ  || 10.56.019 ||
tatra dṛṣṭvā maṇipreṣṭhaṃ bālakrīḍanakaṃ kṛtam  |
hartuṃ kṛtamatistasminnavatasthe'rbhakāntike  || 10.56.020 ||
tamapūrvaṃ naraṃ dṛṣṭvā dhātrī cukrośa bhītavat |
tacchrutvābhyadravatkruddho jāmbavān balināṃ varaḥ  || 10.56.021 ||
sa vai bhagavatā tena yuyudhe svāmīnātmanaḥ  |
puruṣaṃ prākṛtaṃ matvā kupito nānubhāvavit || 10.56.022 ||
dvandvayuddhaṃ sutumulamubhayorvijigīṣatoḥ  |
āyudhāśmadrumairdorbhiḥ kravyārthe śyenayoriva  || 10.56.023 ||
āsīttadaṣṭāvimśāhamitaretaramuṣṭibhiḥ  |
vajraniṣpeṣaparuṣairaviśramamaharniśam  || 10.56.024 ||
kṛṣṇamuṣṭiviniṣpāta niṣpiṣṭāṅgoru bandhanaḥ  |
kṣīṇasattvaḥ svinnagātrastamāhātīva vismitaḥ  || 10.56.025 ||
jāne tvāṃ saṛvabhūtānāṃ prāṇa ojaḥ saho balam  |
viṣṇuṃ purāṇapuruṣaṃ prabhaviṣṇumadhīśvaram  || 10.56.026 ||
tvaṃ hi viśvasṛjāṃ sraṣṭā sṛṣṭānāmapi yacca sat |
kālaḥ kalayatāmīśaḥ para ātmā tathātmanām  || 10.56.027 ||
yasyeṣadutkalitaroṣakaṭākṣamokṣair  vartmādiśatkṣubhitanakratimiṅgalo'bdhiḥ  |
setuḥ kṛtaḥ svayaśa ujjvalitā ca laṅkā   rakṣaḥśirāṃsi bhuvi peturiṣukṣatāni  || 10.56.028 ||*
iti vijñātaviijñānamṛkṣarājānamacyutaḥ  |
vyājahāra mahārāja bhagavān devakīsutaḥ  || 10.56.029 ||
abhimṛśyāravindākṣaḥ pāṇinā śaṃkareṇa tam  |
kṛpayā parayā bhaktaṃ meghagambhīrayā girā  || 10.56.030 ||
maṇihetoriha prāptā vayamṛkṣapate bilam  |
mithyābhiśāpaṃ pramṛjannātmano maṇināmunā  || 10.56.031 ||
ityuktaḥ svāṃ duhitaraṃ kanyāṃ jāmbavatīṃ mudā  |
arhaṇārthaṃ sa maṇinā kṛṣṇāyopajahāra ha  || 10.56.032 ||
adṛṣṭvā nirgamaṃ śaureḥ praviṣṭasya bilaṃ janāḥ  |
pratīkṣya dvādaśāhāni duḥkhitāḥ svapuraṃ yayuḥ  || 10.56.033 ||
niśamya devakī devī rakmiṇyānakadundubhiḥ  |
suhṛdo jñātayo'śocan bilātkṛṣṇamanirgatam  || 10.56.034 ||
satrājitaṃ śapantaste duḥkhitā dvārakaukasaḥ  |
upatasthuścandrabhāgāṃ durgāṃ kṛṣṇopalabdhaye  || 10.56.035 ||
teṣāṃ tu devyupasthānātpratyādiṣṭāśiṣā sa ca  |
prādurbabhūva siddhārthaḥ sadāro harṣayan hariḥ  || 10.56.036 ||
upalabhya hṛṣīkeśaṃ mṛtaṃ punarivāgatam  |
saha patnyā maṇigrīvaṃ sarve jātamahotsavāḥ  || 10.56.037 ||
satrājitaṃ samāhūya sabhāyāṃ rājasannidhau  |
prāptiṃ cākhyāya bhagavānmaṇiṃ tasmai nyavedayat || 10.56.038 ||
sa cātivrīḍito ratnaṃ gṛhītvāvāṅmukhastataḥ  |
anutapyamāno bhavanamagamatsvena pāpmanā  || 10.56.039 ||
so'nudhyāyaṃstadevāghaṃ balavadvigrahākulaḥ  |
kathaṃ mṛjāmyātmarajaḥ prasīdedvācyutaḥ katham  || 10.56.040 ||
kiṃ kṛtvā sādhu mahyaṃ syānna śapedvā jano yathā  |
adīrghadarśanaṃ kṣudraṃ mūḍhaṃ draviṇalolupam  || 10.56.041 ||
dāsye duhitaraṃ tasmai strīratnaṃ ratnameva ca  |
upāyo'yaṃ samīcīnastasya śāntirna cānyathā  || 10.56.042 ||
evaṃ vyavasito buddhyā satrājitsvasutāṃ śubhām  |
maṇiṃ ca svayamudyamya kṛṣṇāyopajahāra ha  || 10.56.043 ||
tāṃ satyabhāmāṃ bhagavānupayeme yathāvidhi  |
bahubhiryācitāṃ śīla rūpaudāryaguṇānvitām  || 10.56.044 ||
bhagavānāha na maṇiṃ pratīcchāmo vayaṃ nṛpa  |
tavāstāṃ devabhaktasya vayaṃ ca phalabhāginaḥ  || 10.56.045 ||
10.57.001|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
vijñātārtho'pi govindo dagdhānākarṇya pāṇḍavān  |
kuntīṃ ca kulyakaraṇe saharāmo yayau kurūn  || 10.57.001 ||
bhīṣmaṃ kṛpaṃ sa viduraṃ gāndhārīṃ droṇameva ca  |
tulyaduḥkhau ca saṅgamya hā kaṣṭamiti hocatuḥ  || 10.57.002 ||
labdhvaitadantaraṃ rājan śatadhanvānamūcatuḥ  |
akrūrakṛtavarmāṇau maniḥ kasmānna gṛhyate  || 10.57.003 ||
yo'smabhyaṃ sampratiśrutya kanyāratnaṃ vigarhya naḥ  |
kṛṣṇāyādānna satrājitkasmādbhrātaramanviyāt || 10.57.004 ||
evaṃ bhinnamatistābhyāṃ satrājitamasattamaḥ  |
śayānamavadhīllobhātsa pāpaḥ kṣīṇa jīvitaḥ  || 10.57.005 ||
strīṇāṃ vikrośamānānāṃ krandantīnāmanāthavat |
hatvā paśūn saunikavanmaṇimādāya jagmivān  || 10.57.006 ||
satyabhāmā ca pitaraṃ hataṃ vīkṣya śucārpitā  |
vyalapattāta tāteti hā hatāsmīti muhyatī  || 10.57.007 ||
tailadroṇyāṃ mṛtaṃ prāsya jagāma gajasāhvayam  |
kṛṣṇāya viditārthāya taptācakhyau piturvadham  || 10.57.008 ||
tadākarṇyeśvarau rājannanusṛtya nṛlokatām  |
aho naḥ paramaṃ kaṣṭamityasrākṣau vilepatuḥ  || 10.57.009 ||
āgatya bhagavāṃstasmātsabhāryaḥ sāgrajaḥ puram  |
śatadhanvānamārebhe hantuṃ hartuṃ maṇiṃ tataḥ  || 10.57.010 ||
so'pi kṛtodyamaṃ jñātvā bhītaḥ prāṇaparīpsayā  |
sāhāyye kṛtavarmāṇamayācata sa cābravīt || 10.57.011 ||
nāhamīsvarayoḥ kuryāṃ helanaṃ rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ  |
ko nu kṣemāya kalpeta tayorvṛjinamācaran  || 10.57.012 ||
kaṃsaḥ sahānugo'pīto yaddveṣāttyājitaḥ śriyā  |
jarāsandhaḥ saptadaśa saṃyugādviratho gataḥ  || 10.57.013 ||
pratyākhyātaḥ sa cākrūraṃ pārṣṇigrāhamayācata  |
so'pyāha ko virudhyeta vidvānīśvarayorbalam  || 10.57.014 ||
ya idaṃ līlayā viśvaṃ sṛjatyavati hanti ca  |
ceṣṭāṃ viśvasṛjo yasya na vidurmohitājayā  || 10.57.015 ||
yaḥ saptahāyanaḥ śailamutpāṭyaikena pāṇinā  |
dadhāra līlayā bāla ucchilīndhramivārbhakaḥ  || 10.57.016 ||
namastasmai bhagavate kṛṣṇāyādbhutakarmaṇe  |
anantāyādibhūtāya kūṭasthāyātmane namaḥ  || 10.57.017 ||
pratyākhyātaḥ sa tenāpi śatadhanvā mahāmaṇim  |
tasminnyasyāśvamāruhya śatayojanagaṃ yayau  || 10.57.018 ||
garuḍadhvajamāruhya rathaṃ rāmajanārdanau  |
anvayātāṃ mahāvegairaśvai rājan gurudruham  || 10.57.019 ||
mithilāyāmupavane visṛjya patitaṃ hayam  |
padbhyāmadhāvatsantrastaḥ kṛṣṇo'pyanvadravadruṣā  || 10.57.020 ||
padāterbhagavāṃstasya padātistigmaneminā  |
cakreṇa śira utkṛtya vāsasorvyacinonmaṇim  || 10.57.021 ||
alabdhamaṇirāgatya kṛṣṇa āhāgrajāntikam  |
vṛthā hataḥ śatadhanurmaṇistatra na vidyate  || 10.57.022 ||
tata āha balo nūnaṃ sa maṇiḥ śatadhanvanā  |
kasmiṃścitpuruṣe nyastastamanveṣa puraṃ vraja  || 10.57.023 ||
ahaṃ vaidehamicchāmi draṣṭuṃ priyatamaṃ mama  |
ityuktvā mithilāṃ rājan viveśa yadanandanaḥ  || 10.57.024 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya maithilaḥ prītamānasaḥ  |
arhayāṃ āsa vidhivadarhaṇīyaṃ samarhaṇaiḥ  || 10.57.025 ||
uvāsa tasyāṃ katicinmithilāyāṃ samā vibhuḥ  |
mānitaḥ prītiyuktena janakena mahātmanā  |
tato'śikṣadgadāṃ kāle dhārtarāṣṭraḥ suyodhanaḥ  || 10.57.026 ||
keśavo dvārakāmetya nidhanaṃ śatadhanvanaḥ  |
aprāptiṃ ca maṇeḥ prāha priyāyāḥ priyakṛdvibhuḥ  || 10.57.027 ||
tataḥ sa kārayāmāsa kriyā bandhorhatasya vai  |
sākaṃ suhṛdbhirbhagavān yā yāḥ syuḥ sāmparāyikīḥ  || 10.57.028 ||
akrūraḥ kṛtavarmā ca śrutvā śatadhanorvadham  |
vyūṣaturbhayavitrastau dvārakāyāḥ prayojakau  || 10.57.029 ||
akrūre proṣite'riṣṭānyāsan vai dvārakaukasām  |
śārīrā mānasāstāpā muhurdaivikabhautikāḥ  || 10.57.030 ||
ityaṅgopadiśantyeke vismṛtya prāgudāhṛtam  |
munivāsanivāse kiṃ ghaṭetāriṣṭadarśanam  || 10.57.031 ||
deve'varṣati kāśīśaḥ śvaphalkāyāgatāya vai  |
svasutāṃ gāṇdinīṃ prādāttato'varṣatsma kāśiṣu  || 10.57.032 ||
tatsutastatprabhāvo'sāvakrūro yatra yatra ha  |
devo'bhivarṣate tatra nopatāpā na mārīkāḥ  || 10.57.033 ||
iti vṛddhavacaḥ śrutvā naitāvadiha kāraṇam  |
iti matvā samānāyya prāhākrūraṃ janārdanaḥ  || 10.57.034 ||
pūjayitvābhibhāṣyainaṃ kathayitvā priyāḥ kathāḥ  |

10.58.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ekadā pāṇḍavān draṣṭuṃ pratītān puruṣottamaḥ  |

10.58.011|0 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca

10.58.020|0 śrīkālindyuvāca

kālindīti samākhyātā vasāmi yamunājale  |

yasmin duryodhanasyāsījjalasthaladṛśibhramaḥ  || 10.58.027 ||

rājādhidevyāstanayāṃ mitravindāṃ pitṛṣvasuḥ  |

10.58.039|0 śrīśuka uvāca
