10.58.041|0 śrīrājovāca
ko'nyaste'bhyadhiko nātha kanyāvara ihepsitaḥ  |

kintvasmābhiḥ kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ samayaḥ sātvatarṣabha  |

tataḥ prītaḥ sutāṃ rājā dadau kṛṣṇāya vismitaḥ  |

śaṅkhabheryānakā nedurgītavādyadvijāśiṣaḥ  |

tānasyataḥ śaravrātān bandhupriyakṛdarjunaḥ  |

reme yadūnāmṛṣabho bhagavān devakīsutaḥ  || 10.58.055 ||
śrutakīrteḥ sutāṃ bhadrāṃ upayeme pitṛṣvasuḥ  |

anyāścaivaṃvidhā bhāryāḥ kṛṣṇasyāsan sahasraśaḥ  |

10.59.002|0 śrīśuka uvāca

puramevāviśannārtā narako yudhyayudhyata  |

taṃ bhaumaḥ prāharacchaktyā vajraḥ pratihato yataḥ  |

śūlaṃ bhaumo'cyutaṃ hantumādade vitathodyamaḥ  |

10.59.025|0 bhūmiruvāca
namaste devadeveśa śaṅkhacakragadādhara  |
bhaktecchopāttarūpāya paramātmannamo'stu te  || 10.59.025 ||

10.59.032|0 śrīśuka uvāca

pūjitastridaśendreṇa mahendryāṇyā ca sapriyaḥ  || 10.59.038 ||
codito bhāryayotpāṭya pārījātaṃ garutmati  |

sthāpitaḥ satyabhāmāyā gṛhodyānopaśobhanaḥ  |
anvagurbhramarāḥ svargāttadgandhāsavalampaṭāḥ  || 10.59.040 ||
yayāca ānamya kirīṭakoṭibhiḥ pādau spṛśannacyutamarthasādhanam  |

atho muhūrta ekasminnānāgāreṣu tāḥ striyaḥ  |

viyayaścitraketuśca vasumān draviḍaḥ kratuḥ  |

vīraścandro'śvasenaśca citragurvegavān vṛṣaḥ  |

śrutaḥ kavirvṛṣo vīraḥ subāhurbhadra ekalaḥ  |

vṛko harṣo'nilo gṛdhro vardhanonnāda eva ca  |

dīptimāṃstāmrataptādyā rohiṇyāstanayā hareḥ  |

eteṣāṃ putrapautrāśca babhūvuḥ koṭiśo nṛpa  |

10.61.020|0 śrīrājovāca

10.61.022|0 śrīśuka uvāca
vṛtaḥ svayaṃvare sākṣādanaṇgo'ṇgayutastayā  |

yadyapyanusmaran vairaṃ rukmī kṛṣṇāvamānitaḥ  |

rukmiṇyāstanayāṃ rājan kṛtavarmasuto balī  |
upayeme viśālākṣīṃ kanyāṃ cārumatīṃ kila  || 10.61.024 ||
dauhitrāyāniruddhāya pautrīṃ rukmyādadāddhareḥ  |
rocanāṃ baddhavairo'pi svasuḥ priyacikīrṣayā  |
jānannadharmaṃ tadyaunaṃ snehapāśānubandhanaḥ  || 10.61.025 ||
tasminnabhyudaye rājan rukmiṇī rāmakeśavau  |
puraṃ bhojakaṭaṃ jagmuḥ sāmbapradyumnakādayaḥ  || 10.61.026 ||

ityukto balamāhūya tenākṣairrukmyadīvyata  || 10.61.028 ||
śataṃ sahasramayutaṃ rāmastatrādade paṇam  |
taṃ tu rukmyajayattatra kāliṅgaḥ prāhasadbalam  |

tato lakṣaṃ rukmyagṛhṇādglahaṃ tatrājayadbalaḥ  |
jitavānahamityāha rukmī kaitavamāśritaḥ  || 10.61.030 ||
manyunā kṣubhitaḥ śrīmān samudra iva parvaṇi  |

taṃ cāpi jitavān rāmo dharmeṇa chalamāśritaḥ  |
rukmī jitaṃ mayātreme vadantu prāśnikā iti  || 10.61.032 ||
tadābravīnnabhovāṇī balenaiva jito glahaḥ  |
dharmato vacanenaiva rukmī vadati vai mṛṣā  || 10.61.033 ||
tāmanādṛtya vaidarbho duṣṭarājanyacoditaḥ  |
saṅkarṣaṇaṃ parihasan babhāṣe kālacoditaḥ  || 10.61.034 ||
naivākṣakovidā yūyaṃ gopālā vanagocarāḥ  |
akṣairdīvyanti rājāno bāṇaiśca na bhavādṛśāḥ  || 10.61.035 ||
rukmiṇaivamadhikṣipto rājabhiścopahāsitaḥ  |
kruddhaḥ parighamudyamya jaghne taṃ nṛmṇasaṃsadi  || 10.61.036 ||
kaliṅgarājaṃ tarasā gṛhītvā daśame pade  |
dantānapātayatkruddho yo'hasadvivṛtairdvijaiḥ  || 10.61.037 ||
anye nirbhinnabāhūru śiraso rudhirokṣitāḥ  |
rājāno dudravarbhītā balena paṅghārditāḥ  || 10.61.038 ||
nihate rukmiṇi śyāle nābravītsādhvasādhu vā  |
rakmiṇībalayo rājan snehabhaṅgabhayāddhariḥ  || 10.61.039 ||
tato'niruddhaṃ saha sūryayā varaṃ rathaṃ samāropya yayuḥ kuśasthalīm  |
rāmādayo bhojakaṭāddaśārhāḥ siddhākhilārthā madhusūdanāśrayāḥ  || 10.61.040 ||
10.62.001|0 śrīrājovāca
bāṇasya tanayāmūṣāmupayeme yadūttamaḥ  |
tatra yuddhamabhūdghoraṃ hariśaṅkarayormahat |
etatsarvaṃ mahāyogin samākhyātuṃ tvamarhasi  || 10.62.001 ||
10.62.002|0 śrīśuka uvāca
bāṇaḥ putraśatajyeṣṭho balerāsīnmahātmanaḥ  |
yena vāmanarūpāya haraye'dāyi medinī  || 10.62.002 ||
tasyaurasaḥ suto bānaḥ śivabhaktirataḥ sadā  |
mānyo vadānyo dhīmāṃśca satyasandho dṛḍhavrataḥ  || 10.62.003 ||
śoṇitākhye pure ramye sa rājyamakarotpurā  |
tasya śambhoḥ prasādena kiṅkarā iva te'marāḥ  |
sahasrabāhurvādyena tāṇdave'toṣayanmṛḍam  || 10.62.004 ||
bhagavān sarvabhūteśaḥ śaraṇyo bhaktavatsalaḥ  |
vareṇa chandayāmāsa sa taṃ vavre purādhipam  || 10.62.005 ||
sa ekadāha giriśaṃ pārśvasthaṃ vīryadurmadaḥ  |
kirīṭenārkavarṇena saṃspṛśaṃstatpadāmbujam  || 10.62.006 ||
namasye tvāṃ mahādeva lokānāṃ gurumīśvaram  |
puṃsāmapūrṇakāmānāṃ kāmapūrāmarāṅghripam  || 10.62.007 ||
doḥsahasraṃ tvayā dattaṃ paraṃ bhārāya me'bhavat |
trilokyāṃ pratiyoddhāraṃ na labhe tvadṛte samam  || 10.62.008 ||
kaṇḍūtyā nibhṛtairdorbhiryuyutsurdiggajānaham  |
ādyāyāṃ cūrṇayannadrīn bhītāste'pi pradudruvuḥ  || 10.62.009 ||
tacchrutvā bhagavān kruddhaḥ ketuste bhajyate yadā  |
tvaddarpaghnaṃ bhavenmūḍha saṃyugaṃ matsamena te  || 10.62.010 ||
ityuktaḥ kumatirhṛṣṭaḥ svagṛhaṃ prāviśannṛpa  |
pratīkṣan giriśādeśaṃ svavīryanaśanaṃ kudhīḥ  || 10.62.011 ||
tasyoṣā nāma duhitā svapne prādyumninā ratim  |
kanyālabhata kāntena prāgadṛṣṭaśrutena sā  || 10.62.012 ||
sā tatra tamapaśyantī kvāsi kānteti vādinī  |
sakhīnāṃ madhya uttasthau vihvalā vrīḍitā bhṛśam  || 10.62.013 ||
bāṇasya mantrī kumbhāṇḍaścitralekhā ca tatsutā  |
sakhyapṛcchatsakhīmūṣāṃ kautūhalasamanvitā  || 10.62.014 ||
kaṃ tvaṃ mṛgayase subhru kīdṛśaste manorathaḥ  |
hastagrāhaṃ na te'dyāpi rājaputryupalakṣaye  || 10.62.015 ||
dṛṣṭaḥ kaścinnaraḥ svapne śyāmaḥ kamalalocanaḥ  |
pītavāsā bṛhadbāhuryoṣitāṃ hṛdayaṃgamaḥ  || 10.62.016 ||
tamahaṃ mṛgaye kāntaṃ pāyayitvādharaṃ madhu  |
kvāpi yātaḥ spṛhayatīṃ kṣiptvā māṃ vṛjinārṇave  || 10.62.017 ||
10.62.016|0 citralekhovāca
vyasanaṃ te'pakarṣāmi trilokyāṃ yadi bhāvyate  |
tamāneṣye varaṃ yaste manohartā tamādiśa  || 10.62.018 ||
ityuktvā devagandharva siddhacāraṇapannagān  |
daityavidyādharān yakṣānmanujāṃśca yathālikhat || 10.62.019 ||
manujeṣu ca sā vṛṣnīn śūramānakadundubhim  |
vyalikhadrāmakṛṣṇau ca pradyumnaṃ vīkṣya lajjitā  || 10.62.020 ||
aniruddhaṃ vilikhitaṃ vīkṣyoṣāvāṅmukhī hriyā  |
so'sāvasāviti prāha smayamānā mahīpate  || 10.62.021 ||
citralekhā tamājñāya pautraṃ kṛṣṇasya yoginī  |
yayau vihāyasā rājan dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇapālitām  || 10.62.022 ||
tatra suptaṃ suparyaṅke prādyumniṃ yogamāsthitā  |
gṛhītvā śoṇitapuraṃ sakhyai priyamadarśayat || 10.62.023 ||
sā ca taṃ sundaravaraṃ vilokya muditānanā  |
duṣprekṣye svagṛhe pumbhī reme prādyumninā samam  || 10.62.024 ||
parārdhyavāsaḥsraggandha dhūpadīpāsanādibhiḥ  |
pānabhojanabhakṣyaiśca vākyaiḥ śuśrūṣaṇārcitaḥ  || 10.62.025 ||
gūḍhaḥ kanyāpure śaśvatpravṛddhasnehayā tayā  |
nāhargaṇān sa bubudhe ūṣayāpahṛtendriyaḥ  || 10.62.026 ||
tāṃ tathā yaduvīreṇa bhujyamānāṃ hatavratām  |
hetubhirlakṣayāṃ cakrurāpṛītāṃ duravacchadaiḥ  || 10.62.027 ||
bhaṭā āvedayāṃ cakrū rājaṃste duhiturvayam  |
viceṣṭitaṃ lakṣayāma kanyāyāḥ kuladūṣaṇam  || 10.62.028 ||
anapāyibhirasmābhirguptāyāśca gṛhe prabho  |
kanyāyā dūṣaṇaṃ pumbhirduṣprekṣyāyā na vidmahe  || 10.62.029 ||
tataḥ pravyathito bāṇo duhituḥ śrutadūṣaṇaḥ  |
tvaritaḥ kanyakāgāraṃ prāpto'drākṣīdyadūdvaham  || 10.62.030 ||
kāmātmajaṃ taṃ bhuvanaikasundaraṃ śyāmaṃ piśaṅgāmbaramambujekṣaṇam  |
bṛhadbhujaṃ kuṇḍalakuntalatviṣā smitāvalokena ca maṇḍitānanam  || 10.62.031 ||
dīvyantamakṣaiḥ priyayābhinṛmṇayā tadaṅgasaṅgastanakuṅkumasrajam  |
bāhvordadhānaṃ madhumallikāśritāṃ tasyāgra āsīnamavekṣya vismitaḥ  || 10.62.032 ||
sa taṃ praviṣṭaṃ vṛtamātatāyibhirbhaṭairanīkairavalokya mādhavaḥ  |
udyamya maurvaṃ parighaṃ vyavasthito yathāntako daṇḍadharo jighāṃsayā  || 10.62.033 ||
jighṛkṣayā tān paritaḥ prasarpataḥ śuno yathā śūkarayūthapo'hanat |
te hanyamānā bhavanādvinirgatā nirbhinnamūrdhorubhujāḥ pradudruvuḥ  || 10.62.034 ||
taṃ nāgapāśairbalinandano balī ghnantaṃ svasainyaṃ kupito babandha ha  |
ūṣā bhṛśaṃ śokaviṣādavihvalā baddhaṃ niśamyāśrukalākṣyarautsīt || 10.62.035 ||
10.63.001|0 śṛīśuka uvāca
apaśyatāṃ cāniruddhaṃ tadbandhūnāṃ ca bhārata  |
catvāro vārṣikā māsā vyatīyuranuśocatām  || 10.63.001 ||
nāradāttadupākarṇya vārtāṃ baddhasya karma ca  |
prayayuḥ śoṇitapuraṃ vṛṣṇayaḥ kṛṣṇadaivatāḥ  || 10.63.002 ||
pradyumno yuyudhānaśca gadaḥ sāmbo'tha sāraṇaḥ  |
nandopanandabhadrādyā rāmakṛṣṇānuvartinaḥ  || 10.63.003 ||
akṣauhiṇībhirdvādaśabhiḥ sametāḥ sarvato diśam  |
rurudhurbāṇanagaraṃ samantātsātvatarṣabhāḥ  || 10.63.004 ||
bhajyamānapurodyāna prākārāṭṭālagopuram  |
prekṣamāṇo ruṣāviṣṭastulyasainyo'bhiniryayau  || 10.63.005 ||
bāṇārthe bhagavān rudraḥ sasutaḥ pramathairvṛtaḥ  |
āruhya nandivṛṣabhaṃ yuyudhe rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ  || 10.63.006 ||
āsītsutumulaṃ yuddhamadbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam  |
kṛṣṇaśaṅkarayo rājan pradyumnaguhayorapi  || 10.63.007 ||
kumbhāṇḍakūpakarṇābhyāṃ balena saha saṃyugaḥ  |
sāmbasya bāṇaputreṇa bāṇena saha sātyakeḥ  || 10.63.008 ||
brahmādayaḥ surādhīśā munayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ  |
gandharvāpsaraso yakṣā vimānairdraṣṭumāgaman  || 10.63.009 ||
śaṅkarānucarān śaurirbhūtapramathaguhyakān  |
ḍākinīryātudhānāṃśca vetālān savināyakān  || 10.63.010 ||
pretamātṛpiśācāṃśca kuṣmāṇḍān brahmarākṣasān  |
drāvayāmāsa tīkṣṇāgraiḥ śaraiḥ śārṅgadhanuścyutaiḥ  || 10.63.011 ||
pṛthagvidhāni prāyuṅkta piṇākyastrāṇi śārṅgiṇe  |
pratyastraiḥ śamayāmāsa śārṅgapāṇiravismitaḥ  || 10.63.012 ||
brahmāstrasya ca brahmāstraṃ vāyavyasya ca pārvatam  |
āgneyasya ca pārjanyaṃ naijaṃ pāśupatasya ca  || 10.63.013 ||
mohayitvā tu giriśaṃ jṛmbhaṇāstreṇa jṛmbhitam  |
bāṇasya pṛtanāṃ śaurirjaghānāsigadeṣubhiḥ  || 10.63.014 ||
skandaḥ pradyumnabāṇaughairardyamānaḥ samantataḥ  |
asṛgvimuñcan gātrebhyaḥ śikhināpakramadraṇāt || 10.63.015 ||
kumbhāṇḍakūpakarṇaśca petaturmuṣalārditau  |
dudruvustadanīkani hatanāthāni sarvataḥ  || 10.63.016 ||
viśīryamāṇaṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā bāṇo'tyamarṣitaḥ  |
kṛṣṇamabhyadravatsaṅkhye rathī hitvaiva sātyakim  || 10.63.017 ||
dhanūṃṣyākṛṣya yugapadbāṇaḥ pañcaśatāni vai  |
ekaikasmin śarau dvau dvau sandadhe raṇadurmadaḥ  || 10.63.018 ||
tāni ciccheda bhagavān dhanūṃsi yugapaddhariḥ  |
sārathiṃ rathamaśvāṃśca hatvā śaṅkhamapūrayat || 10.63.019 ||
tanmātā koṭarā nāma nagnā maktaśiroruhā  |
puro'vatasthe kṛṣṇasya putraprāṇarirakṣayā  || 10.63.020 ||
tatastiryaṅmukho nagnāmanirīkṣan gadāgrajaḥ  |
bāṇaśca tāvadvirathaśchinnadhanvāviśatpuram  || 10.63.021 ||
vidrāvite bhūtagaṇe jvarastu trīśirāstrīpāt |
abhyadhāvata dāśārhaṃ dahanniva diśo daśa  || 10.63.022 ||
atha nārāyaṇaḥ devaḥ taṃ dṛṣṭvā vyasṛjajjvaram  |
māheśvaro vaiṣṇavaśca yuyudhāte jvarāvubhau  || 10.63.023 ||
māheśvaraḥ samākrandan vaiṣṇavena balārditaḥ  |
alabdhvābhayamanyatra bhīto māheśvaro jvaraḥ  |
śaraṇārthī hṛṣīkeśaṃ tuṣṭāva prayatāñjaliḥ  || 10.63.024 ||
10.63.025|0 jvara uvāca
namāmi tvānantaśaktiṃ pareśaṃ sarvātmānaṃ kevalaṃ jñaptimātram  |
viśvotpattisthānasaṃrodhahetuṃ yattadbrahma brahmaliṅgaṃ praśāntam  || 10.63.025 ||
kālo daivaṃ karma jīvaḥ svabhāvo dravyaṃ kṣetraṃ prāṇa ātmā vikāraḥ  |

nānābhāvairlīlayaivopapannairdevān sādhūn lokasetūn bibharṣi  |

tapto'haṃ te tejasā duḥsahena śāntogreṇātyulbaṇena jvareṇa  |

10.63.029|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
triśiraste prasanno'smi vyetu te majjvarādbhayam  |
yo nau smarati saṃvādaṃ tasya tvanna bhavedbhayam  || 10.63.029 ||
ityukto'cyutamānamya gato māheśvaro jvaraḥ  |
bāṇastu rathamārūḍhaḥ prāgādyotsyan janārdanam  || 10.63.030 ||
tato bāhusahasreṇa nānāyudhadharo'suraḥ  |
mumoca paramakruddho bāṇāṃścakrāyudhe nṛpa  || 10.63.031 ||
tasyāsyato'strāṇyasakṛccakreṇa kṣuraneminā  |
ciccheda bhagavān bāhūn śākhā iva vanaspateḥ  || 10.63.032 ||
bāhuṣu chidyamāneṣu bāṇasya bhagavān bhavaḥ  |
bhaktānakampyupavrajya cakrāyudhamabhāṣata  || 10.63.033 ||
10.63.034|0 śrīrudra uvāca
tvaṃ hi brahma paraṃ jyotirgūḍhaṃ brahmaṇi vāṅmaye  |
yaṃ paśyantyamalātmāna ākāśamiva kevalam  || 10.63.034 ||
nābhirnabho'gnirmukhamambu reto   dyauḥ śīrṣamāśāḥ śrutiraṅghrirurvī  |
candro mano yasya dṛgarka ātmā   ahaṃ samudro jaṭharaṃ bhujendraḥ  || 10.63.035 ||*
romāṇi yasyauṣadhayo'mbuvāhāḥ   keśā viriñco dhiṣaṇā visargaḥ  |
prajāpatirhṛdayaṃ yasya dharmaḥ   sa vai bhavān puruṣo lokakalpaḥ  || 10.63.036 ||*
tavāvatāro'yamakuṇṭhadhāman dharmasya guptyai jagato hitāya  |
vayaṃ ca sarve bhavatānubhāvitā vibhāvayāmo bhuvanāni sapta  || 10.63.037 ||
tvameka ādyaḥ puruṣo'dvitīyasturyaḥ svadṛgdheturaheturīśaḥ  |
pratīyase'thāpi yathāvikāraṃ svamāyayā sarvaguṇaprasiddhyai  || 10.63.038 ||
yathaiva sūryaḥ pihitaśchāyayā svayā   chāyāṃ ca rūpāṇi ca sañcakāsti  |
evaṃ guṇenāpihito guṇāṃstvam   ātmapradīpo guṇinaśca bhūman  || 10.63.039 ||*
yanmāyāmohitadhiyaḥ putradāragṛhādiṣu  |
unmajjanti nimajjanti prasaktā vṛjinārṇave  || 10.63.040 ||
devadattamimaṃ labdhvā nṛlokamajitendriyaḥ  |
yo nādriyeta tvatpādau sa śocyo hyātmavañcakaḥ  || 10.63.041 ||
yastvāṃ visṛjate martya ātmānaṃ priyamīśvaram  |
viparyayendriyārthārthaṃ viṣamattyamṛtaṃ tyajan  || 10.63.042 ||
ahaṃ brahmātha vibudhā munayaścāmalāśayāḥ  |
sarvātmanā prapannāstvāmātmānaṃ preṣṭhamīśvaram  || 10.63.043 ||
taṃ tvā jagatsthityudayāntahetuṃ   samaṃ prasāntaṃ suhṛdātmadaivam  |
ananyamekaṃ jagadātmaketaṃ   bhavāpavargāya bhajāma devam  || 10.63.044 ||*
ayaṃ mameṣṭo dayito'nuvartī mayābhayaṃ dattamamuṣya deva  |
sampādyatāṃ tadbhavataḥ prasādo yathā hi te daityapatau prasādaḥ  || 10.63.045 ||
10.63.046|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
yadāttha bhagavaṃstvaṃ naḥ karavāma priyaṃ tava  |
bhavato yadvyavasitaṃ tanme sādhvanumoditam  || 10.63.046 ||
avadhyo'yaṃ mamāpyeṣa vairocanisuto'suraḥ  |

darpopaśamanāyāsya pravṛkṇā bāhavo mayā  |
sūditaṃ ca balaṃ bhūri yacca bhārāyitaṃ bhuvaḥ  || 10.63.048 ||
catvāro'sya bhujāḥ śiṣṭā bhaviṣyatyajarāmaraḥ  |

iti labdhvābhayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya śirasāsuraḥ  |

akṣauhiṇyā parivṛtaṃ suvāsaḥsamalaṅkṛtam  |

svarājadhānīṃ samalaṅkṛtāṃ dhvajaiḥ   satoraṇairukṣitamārgacatvarām  |
viveśa śaṅkhānakadundubhisvanair  abhyudyataḥ paurasuhṛddvijātibhiḥ  || 10.63.052 ||*
ya evaṃ kṛṣṇavijayaṃ śaṅkareṇa ca saṃyugam  |
saṃsmaretprātarutthāya na tasya syātparājayaḥ  || 10.63.053 ||
10.64.001|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
ekadopavanaṃ rājan jagmuryadukumārakāḥ  |
vihartuṃ sāmbapradyumna cārubhānugadādayaḥ  || 10.64.001 ||
krīḍitvā suciraṃ tatra vicinvantaḥ pipāsitāḥ  |
jalaṃ nirudake kūpe dadṛśuḥ sattvamadbhutam  || 10.64.002 ||
kṛkalāsaṃ girinibhaṃ vīkṣya vismitamānasāḥ  |

carmajaistāntavaiḥ pāśairbaddhvā patitamarbhakāḥ  |

tatrāgatyāravindākṣo bhagavān viśvabhāvanaḥ  |

papraccha vidvānapi tannidānaṃ janeṣu vikhyāpayituṃ mukundaḥ  |

daśāmimāṃ vā katamena karmaṇā samprāpito'syatadarhaḥ subhadra  |

10.64.009|0 śrīśuka uvāca
iti sma rājā sampṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇenānantamūrtinā  |
mādhavaṃ praṇipatyāha kirīṭenārkavarcasā  || 10.64.009 ||
10.64.010|0 nṛga uvāca
nṛgo nāma narendro'hamikṣvākutanayaḥ prabho  |

kiṃ nu te'viditaṃ nātha sarvabhūtātmasākṣiṇaḥ  |

yāvatyaḥ sikatā bhūmeryāvatyo divi tārakāḥ  |

payasvinīstaruṇīḥ śīlarūpa guṇopapannāḥ kapilā hemasṛṅgīḥ  |

svalaṅkṛtebhyo guṇaśīlavadbhyaḥ sīdatkuṭumbebhya ṛtavratebhyaḥ  |

gobhūhiraṇyāyatanāśvahastinaḥ kanyāḥ sadāsīstilarūpyaśayyāḥ  |
vāsāṃsi ratnāni paricchadān rathāniṣṭaṃ ca yajñaiścaritaṃ ca pūrtam  || 10.64.015 ||
kasyaciddvijamukhyasya bhraṣṭā gaurmama godhane  |
sampṛktāviduṣā sā ca mayā dattā dvijātaye  || 10.64.016 ||
tāṃ nīyamānāṃ tatsvāmī dṛṣṭrovāca mameti tam  |
mameti parigrāhyāha nṛgo me dattavāniti  || 10.64.017 ||
viprau vivadamānau māmūcatuḥ svārthasādhakau  |
bhavān dātāpaharteti tacchrutvā me'bhavadbhramaḥ  || 10.64.018 ||
anunītāvubhau viprau dharmakṛcchragatena vai  |
gavāṃ lakṣaṃ prakṛṣṭānāṃ dāsyāmyeṣā pradīyatām  || 10.64.019 ||
bhavantāvanugṛhṇītāṃ kiṅkarasyāvijānataḥ  |
samuddharataṃ māṃ kṛcchrātpatantaṃ niraye'śucau  || 10.64.020 ||
nāhaṃ pratīcche vai rājannityuktvā svāmyapākramat |
nānyadgavāmapyayutamicchāmītyaparo yayau  || 10.64.021 ||
etasminnantare yāmairdūtairnīto yamakṣayam  |
yamena pṛṣṭastatrāhaṃ devadeva jagatpate  || 10.64.022 ||
pūrvaṃ tvamaśubhaṃ bhuṅkṣa utāho nṛpate śubham  |
nāntaṃ dānasya dharmasya paśye lokasya bhāsvataḥ  || 10.64.023 ||
pūrvaṃ devāśubhaṃ bhuñja iti prāha pateti saḥ  |
tāvadadrākṣamātmānaṃ kṛkalāsaṃ patan prabho  || 10.64.024 ||
brahmaṇyasya vadānyasya tava dāsasya keśava  |
smṛtirnādyāpi vidhvastā bhavatsandarśanārthinaḥ  || 10.64.025 ||
sa tvaṃ kathaṃ mama vibho'kṣipathaḥ parātmā   yogeśvaraḥ śrutidṛśāmalahṛdvibhāvyaḥ  |
sākṣādadhokṣaja uruvyasanāndhabuddheḥ   syānme'nudṛśya iha yasya bhavāpavargaḥ  || 10.64.026 ||*
devadeva jagannātha govinda puruṣottama  |
nārāyaṇa hṛṣīkeśa puṇyaślokācyutāvyaya  || 10.64.027 ||
anujānīhi māṃ kṛṣṇa yāntaṃ devagatiṃ prabho  |
yatra kvāpi sataśceto bhūyānme tvatpadāspadam  || 10.64.028 ||
namaste sarvabhāvāya brahmaṇe'nantaśaktaye  |
kṛṣṇāya vāsudevāya yogānāṃ pataye namaḥ  || 10.64.029 ||
ityuktvā taṃ parikramya pādau spṛṣṭvā svamaulinā  |
anujñāto vimānāgryamāruhatpaśyatāṃ nṛṇām  || 10.64.030 ||
kṛṣṇaḥ parijanaṃ prāha bhagavān devakīsutaḥ  |
brahmaṇyadevo dharmātmā rājanyānanuśikṣayan  || 10.64.031 ||
durjaraṃ bata brahmasvaṃ bhuktamagnermanāgapi  |
tejīyaso'pi kimuta rājñāṃ īśvaramāninām  || 10.64.032 ||
nāhaṃ hālāhalaṃ manye viṣaṃ yasya pratikriyā  |
brahmasvaṃ hi viṣaṃ proktaṃ nāsya pratividhirbhuvi  || 10.64.033 ||
hinasti viṣamattāraṃ vahniradbhiḥ praśāmyati  |
kulaṃ samūlaṃ dahati brahmasvāraṇipāvakaḥ  || 10.64.034 ||
brahmasvaṃ duranujñātaṃ bhuktaṃ hanti tripūruṣam  |
prasahya tu balādbhuktaṃ daśa pūrvān daśāparān  || 10.64.035 ||
rājāno rājalakṣmyāndhā nātmapātaṃ vicakṣate  |
nirayaṃ ye'bhimanyante brahmasvaṃ sādhu bāliśāḥ  || 10.64.036 ||
gṛhṇanti yāvataḥ pāṃśūn krandatāmaśrubindavaḥ  |
viprāṇāṃ hṛtavṛttīnāṃ vadānyānāṃ kuṭumbinām  || 10.64.037 ||
rājāno rājakulyāśca tāvato'bdānniraṅkuśāḥ  |
kumbhīpākeṣu pacyante brahmadāyāpahāriṇaḥ  || 10.64.038 ||
svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā brahmavṛttiṃ harecca yaḥ  |
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ  || 10.64.039 ||
na me brahmadhanaṃ bhūyādyadgṛdhvālpāyuṣo narāḥ  |
parājitāścyutā rājyādbhavantyudvejino'hayaḥ  || 10.64.040 ||
vipraṃ kṛtāgasamapi naiva druhyata māmakāḥ  |
ghnantaṃ bahu śapantaṃ vā namaskuruta nityaśaḥ  || 10.64.041 ||
yathāhaṃ praṇame viprānanukālaṃ samāhitaḥ  |
tathā namata yūyaṃ ca yo'nyathā me sa daṇḍabhāk || 10.64.042 ||
brāhmaṇārtho hyapahṛto hartāraṃ pātayatyadhaḥ  |
ajānantamapi hyenaṃ nṛgaṃ brāhmaṇagauriva  || 10.64.043 ||
evaṃ viśrāvya bhagavānmukundo dvārakaukasaḥ  |
pāvanaḥ sarvalokānāṃ viveśa nijamandiram  || 10.64.044 ||
10.65.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
balabhadraḥ kuruśreṣṭha bhagavān rathamāsthitaḥ  |
suhṛddidṛkṣurutkaṇṭhaḥ prayayau nandagokulam  || 10.65.001 ||
pariṣvaktaścirotkaṇṭhairgopairgopībhireva ca  |
rāmo'bhivādya pitarāvāśīrbhirabhinanditaḥ  || 10.65.002 ||
ciraṃ naḥ pāhi dāśārha sānujo jagadīśvaraḥ  |
ityāropyāṅkamāliṅgya netraiḥ siṣicaturjalaiḥ  || 10.65.003 ||
gopavṛddhāṃśca vidhivadyaviṣṭhairabhivanditaḥ  |
yathāvayo yathāsakhyaṃ yathāsambandhamātmanaḥ  || 10.65.004 ||
samupetyātha gopālān hāsyahastagrahādibhiḥ  |
viśrāntaṃ sukhamāsīnaṃ papracchuḥ paryupāgatāḥ  || 10.65.005 ||
pṛṣṭāścānāmayaṃ sveṣu premagadgadayā girā  |
kṛṣṇe kamalapatrākṣe sannyastākhilarādhasaḥ  || 10.65.006 ||
kaccinno bāndhavā rāma sarve kuśalamāsate  |
kaccitsmaratha no rāma yūyaṃ dārasutānvitāḥ  || 10.65.007 ||
diṣṭyā kaṃso hataḥ pāpo diṣṭyā muktāḥ suhṛjjanāḥ  |
nihatya nirjitya ripūn diṣṭyā durgaṃ samāśrītāḥ  || 10.65.008 ||
gopyo hasantyaḥ papracchū rāmasandarśanādṛtāḥ  |
kaccidāste sukhaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ purastrījanavallabhaḥ  || 10.65.009 ||
kaccitsmarati vā bandhūn pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca saḥ  |
apyasau mātaraṃ draṣṭuṃ sakṛdapyāgamiṣyati  |
api vā smarate'smākamanusevāṃ mahābhujaḥ  || 10.65.010 ||
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhrātṝn patīn putrān svasṝnapi  |
yadarthe jahima dāśārha dustyajān svajanān prabho  || 10.65.011 ||
tā naḥ sadyaḥ parityajya gataḥ sañchinnasauhṛdaḥ  |
kathaṃ nu tādṛśaṃ strībhirna śraddhīyeta bhāṣitam  || 10.65.012 ||
kathaṃ nu gṛhṇantyanavasthitātmano   vacaḥ kṛtaghnasya budhāḥ purastriyaḥ  |
gṛhṇanti vai citrakathasya sundara   smitāvalokocchvasitasmarāturāḥ  || 10.65.013 ||*
kiṃ nastatkathayā gopyaḥ kathāḥ kathayatāparāḥ  |
yātyasmābhirvinā kālo yadi tasya tathaiva naḥ  || 10.65.014 ||
iti prahasitaṃ śaurerjalpitaṃ cāruvīkṣitam  |
gatiṃ premapariṣvaṅgaṃ smarantyo ruruduḥ striyaḥ  || 10.65.015 ||
saṅkarṣaṇastāḥ kṛṣṇasya sandeśairhṛdayaṃgamaiḥ  |
sāntvayāmāsa bhagavānnānānunayakovidaḥ  || 10.65.016 ||
dvau māsau tatra cāvātsīnmadhuṃ mādhavaṃ eva ca  |
rāmaḥ kṣapāsu bhagavān gopīnāṃ ratimāvahan  || 10.65.017 ||
pūrṇacandrakalāmṛṣṭe kaumudīgandhavāyunā  |
yamunopavane reme sevite strīgaṇairvṛtaḥ  || 10.65.018 ||
varuṇapreṣitā devī vāruṇī vṛkṣakoṭarāt |
patantī tadvanaṃ sarvaṃ svagandhenādhyavāsayat || 10.65.019 ||
taṃ gandhaṃ madhudhārāyā vāyunopahṛtaṃ balaḥ  |
āghrāyopagatastatra lalanābhiḥ samaṃ papau  || 10.65.020 ||
upagīyamāno gandharvairvanitāśobhimaṇḍale  |
reme kareṇuyūtheśo māhendra iva vāraṇaḥ  || 10.65.021 ||
nedurdundubhayo vyomni vavṛṣuḥ kusumairmudā  |
gandharvā munayo rāmaṃ tadvīryairīḍire tadā  || 10.65.022 ||
upagīyamānacarito vanitābhirhalāyudha  |
vaneṣu vyacaratkṣīvo madavihvalalocanaḥ  || 10.65.023 ||
sragvyekakuṇḍalo matto vaijayantyā ca mālayā  |
bibhratsmitamukhāmbhojaṃ svedaprāleyabhūṣitam  || 10.65.024 ||
sa ājuhāva yamunāṃ jalakrīḍārthamīśvaraḥ  |
nijaṃ vākyamanādṛtya matta ityāpagāṃ balaḥ  || 10.65.025 ||
anāgatāṃ halāgreṇa kupito vicakarṣa ha  |
pāpe tvaṃ māmavajñāya yannāyāsi mayāhutā  |
neṣye tvāṃ lāṅgalāgreṇa śatadhā kāmacāriṇīm  || 10.65.026 ||
evaṃ nirbhartsitā bhītā yamunā yadunandanam  |
uvāca cakitā vācaṃ patitā pādayornṛpa  || 10.65.027 ||
rāma rāma mahābāho na jāne tava vikramam  |
yasyaikāṃśena vidhṛtā jagatī jagataḥ pate  || 10.65.028 ||
paraṃ bhāvaṃ bhagavato bhagavanmāmajānatīm  |
moktumarhasi viśvātman prapannāṃ bhaktavatsala  || 10.65.029 ||
tato vyamuñcadyamunāṃ yācito bhagavān balaḥ  |
vijagāha jalaṃ strībhiḥ kareṇubhirivebharāṭ || 10.65.030 ||
kāmaṃ vihṛtya salilāduttīrṇāyāsītāmbare  |
bhūṣaṇāni mahārhāṇi dadau kāntiḥ śubhāṃ srajam  || 10.65.031 ||
vasitvā vāsasī nīle mālāṃ āmucya kāñcanīm  |
reye svalaṅkṛto lipto māhendra iva vāraṇaḥ  || 10.65.032 ||
adyāpi dṛśyate rājan yamunākṛṣṭavartmanā  |
balasyānantavīryasya vīryaṃ sūcayatīva hi  || 10.65.033 ||
evaṃ sarvā niśā yātā ekeva ramato vraje  |
rāmasyākṣiptacittasya mādhuryairvrajayoṣitām  || 10.65.034 ||
10.66.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
nandavrajaṃ gate rāme karūṣādhipatirnṛpa  |
vāsudevo'hamityajño dūtaṃ kṛṣṇāya prāhiṇot || 10.66.001 ||
tvaṃ vāsudevo bhagavānavatīṛno jagatpatiḥ  |
iti prastobhito bālairmena ātmānamacyutam  || 10.66.002 ||
dūtaṃ ca prāhiṇonmandaḥ kṛṣṇāyāvyaktavartmane  |
dvārakāyāṃ yathā bālo nṛpo bālakṛto'budhaḥ  || 10.66.003 ||
dūtastu dvārakāmetya sabhāyāmāsthitaṃ prabhum  |
kṛṣṇaṃ kamalapatrākṣaṃ rājasandeśamabravīt || 10.66.004 ||
vāsudevo'vatīrno'hameka eva na cāparaḥ  |
bhūtānāmanukampārthaṃ tvaṃ tu mithyābhidhāṃ tyaja  || 10.66.005 ||
yāni tvamasmaccihnāni mauḍhyādbibharṣi sātvata  |
tyaktvaihi māṃ tvaṃ śaraṇaṃ no ceddehi mamāhavam  || 10.66.006 ||
10.66.007|0 śrīśuka uvāca
katthanaṃ tadupākarṇya pauṇḍrakasyālpamedhasaḥ  |
ugrasenādayaḥ sabhyā uccakairjahasustadā  || 10.66.007 ||
uvāca dūtaṃ bhagavān parihāsakathāmanu  |
utsrakṣye mūḍha cihnāni yaistvamevaṃ vikatthase  || 10.66.008 ||
mukhaṃ tadapidhāyājña kaṅkagṛdhravaṭairvṛtaḥ  |
śayiṣyase hatastatra bhavitā śaraṇaṃ śunām  || 10.66.009 ||
iti dūtastamākṣepaṃ svāmine sarvamāharat |
kṛṣṇo'pi rathamāsthāya kāśīmupajagāma ha  || 10.66.010 ||
pauṇḍrako'pi tadudyogamupalabhya mahārathaḥ  |
akṣauhiṇībhyāṃ saṃyukto niścakrāma purāddrutam  || 10.66.011 ||
tasya kāśīpatirmitraṃ pārṣṇigrāho'nvayānnṛpa  |
akṣauhiṇībhistisṛbhirapaśyatpauṇḍrakaṃ hariḥ  || 10.66.012 ||
śaṅkhāryasigadāśārṅga śrīvatsādyupalakṣitam  |
bibhrāṇaṃ kaustubhamaṇiṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam  || 10.66.013 ||
kauśeyavāsasī pīte vasānaṃ garuḍadhvajam  |
amūlyamaulyābharaṇaṃ sphuranmakarakuṇḍalam  || 10.66.014 ||
dṛṣṭvā tamātmanastulyaṃ veṣaṃ kṛtrimamāsthitam  |
yathā naṭaṃ raṅgagataṃ vijahāsa bhṛśaṃ harīḥ  || 10.66.015 ||
śulairgadābhiḥ parighaiḥ śaktyṛṣṭiprāsatomaraiḥ  |
asibhiḥ paṭṭiśairbāṇaiḥ prāharannarayo harim  || 10.66.016 ||
kṛṣṇastu tatpauṇḍrakakāśirājayor  balaṃ gajasyandanavājipattimat |
gadāsicakreṣubhirārdayadbhṛśaṃ   yathā yugānte hutabhukpṛthakprajāḥ  || 10.66.017 ||*
āyodhanaṃ tadrathavājikuñjara dvipatkharoṣṭrairariṇāvakhaṇḍitaiḥ  |
babhau citaṃ modavahaṃ manasvināmākrīḍanaṃ bhūtapaterivolbaṇam  || 10.66.018 ||
athāha pauṇḍrakaṃ śaurirbho bho pauṇḍraka yadbhavān  |
dūtavākyena māmāha tānyastraṇyutsṛjāmi te  || 10.66.019 ||
tyājayiṣye'bhidhānaṃ me yattvayājña mṛṣā dhṛtam  |
vrajāmi śaranaṃ te'dya yadi necchāmi saṃyugam  || 10.66.020 ||
iti kṣiptvā śitairbāṇairvirathīkṛtya pauṇḍrakam  |
śiro'vṛścadrathāṅgena vajreṇendro yathā gireḥ  || 10.66.021 ||
tathā kāśīpateḥ kāyācchira utkṛtya patribhiḥ  |
nyapātayatkāśīpuryāṃ padmakośamivānilaḥ  || 10.66.022 ||
evaṃ matsariṇaṃ hatvā pauṇḍrakaṃ sasakhaṃ hariḥ  |
dvārakāmāviśatsiddhairgīyamānakathāmṛtaḥ  || 10.66.023 ||
sa nityaṃ bhagavaddhyāna pradhvastākhilabandhanaḥ  |
bibhrāṇaśca hare rājan svarūpaṃ tanmayo'bhavat || 10.66.024 ||
śiraḥ patitamālokya rājadvāre sakuṇḍalam  |
kimidaṃ kasya vā vaktramiti saṃśiśire janāḥ  || 10.66.025 ||
rājñaḥ kāśīpaterjñātvā mahiṣyaḥ putrabāndhavāḥ  |
paurāśca hā hatā rājannātha nātheti prārudan  || 10.66.026 ||
sudakṣiṇastasya sutaḥ kṛtvā saṃsthāvidhiṃ pateḥ  |
nihatya pitṛhantāraṃ yāsyāmyapacitiṃ pituḥ  || 10.66.027 ||
ityātmanābhisandhāya sopādhyāyo maheśvaram  |
sudakṣiṇo'rcayāmāsa parameṇa samādhinā  || 10.66.028 ||
prīto'vimukte bhagavāṃstasmai varamadādvibhuḥ  |
pitṛhantṛvadhopāyaṃ sa vavre varamīpsitam  || 10.66.029 ||
dakṣiṇāgniṃ paricara brāhmaṇaiḥ samamṛtvijam  |
abhicāravidhānena sa cāgniḥ pramathairvṛtaḥ  || 10.66.030 ||
sādhayiṣyati saṅkalpamabrahmaṇye prayojitaḥ  |
ityādiṣṭastathā cakre kṛṣṇāyābhicaran vratī  || 10.66.031 ||
tato'gnirutthitaḥ kuṇḍānmūrtimānatibhīṣaṇaḥ  |
taptatāmraśikhāśmaśruraṅgārodgārilocanaḥ  || 10.66.032 ||
daṃṣṭrograbhrukuṭīdaṇḍa kaṭhorāsyaḥ svajihvayā  |
ālihan sṛkvaṇī nagno vidhunvaṃstriśikhaṃ jvalat || 10.66.033 ||
padbhyāṃ tālapramāṇābhyāṃ kampayannavanītalam  |
so'bhyadhāvadvṛto bhūtairdvārakāṃ pradahan diśaḥ  || 10.66.034 ||
tamābhicāradahanamāyāntaṃ dvārakaukasaḥ  |
vilokya tatrasuḥ sarve vanadāhe mṛgā yathā  || 10.66.035 ||
akṣaiḥ sabhāyāṃ krīḍantaṃ bhagavantaṃ bhayāturāḥ  |
trāhi trāhi trilokeśa vahneḥ pradahataḥ puram  || 10.66.036 ||
śrutvā tajjanavaiklavyaṃ dṛṣṭvā svānāṃ ca sādhvasam  |
śaraṇyaḥ samprahasyāha mā bhaiṣṭetyavitāsmyaham  || 10.66.037 ||
sarvasyāntarbahiḥsākṣī kṛtyāṃ māheśvarīṃ vibhuḥ  |
vijñāya tadvighātārthaṃ pārśvasthaṃ cakramādiśat || 10.66.038 ||
tatsūryakoṭipratimaṃ sudarśanaṃ jājvalyamānaṃ pralayānalaprabham  |
svatejasā khaṃ kakubho'tha rodasī cakraṃ mukundāstraṃ athāgnimārdayat || 10.66.039 ||
kṛtyānalaḥ pratihataḥ sa rathāngapāṇer  astraujasā sa nṛpa bhagnamukho nivṛttaḥ  |
vārāṇasīṃ parisametya sudakṣiṇaṃ taṃ   sartvigjanaṃ samadahatsvakṛto'bhicāraḥ  || 10.66.040 ||*
cakraṃ ca viṣṇostadanupraviṣṭaṃ vārānasīṃ sāṭṭasabhālayāpaṇām  |
sagopurāṭṭālakakoṣṭhasaṅkulāṃ sakośahastyaśvarathānnaśālinīm  || 10.66.041 ||
dagdhvā vārāṇasīṃ sarvāṃ viṣṇoścakraṃ sudarśanam  |
bhūyaḥ pārśvamupātiṣṭhatkṛṣṇasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ  || 10.66.042 ||
ya enaṃ śrāvayenmartya uttamaḥślokavikramam  |
samāhito vā śṛṇuyātsarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  || 10.66.043 ||
10.67.001|0 śrīrājovāca
bhuyo'haṃ śrotumicchāmi rāmasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ  |
anantasyāprameyasya yadanyatkṛtavān prabhuḥ  || 10.67.001 ||
10.67.002|0 śrīśuka uvāca
narakasya sakhā kaściddvivido nāma vānaraḥ  |
sugrīvasacivaḥ so'tha bhrātā maindasya vīryavān  || 10.67.002 ||
sakhyuḥ so'pacitiṃ kurvan vānaro rāṣṭraviplavam  |
puragrāmākarān ghoṣānadahadvahnimutsṛjan  || 10.67.003 ||
kvacitsa śailānutpāṭya tairdeśān samacūrṇayat |
ānartān sutarāmeva yatrāste mitrahā hariḥ  || 10.67.004 ||
kvacitsamudramadhyastho dorbhyāmutkṣipya tajjalam  |
deśānnāgāyutaprāṇo velākūle nyamajjayat || 10.67.005 ||
āśramānṛṣimukhyānāṃ kṛtvā bhagnavanaspatīn  |
adūṣayacchakṛnmūtrairagnīn vaitānikān khalaḥ  || 10.67.006 ||
puruṣān yoṣito dṛptaḥ kṣmābhṛddronīguhāsu saḥ  |
nikṣipya cāpyadhācchailaiḥ peśaṣkārīva kīṭakam  || 10.67.007 ||
evaṃ deśān viprakurvan dūṣayaṃśca kulastriyaḥ  |
śrutvā sulalitaṃ gītaṃ giriṃ raivatakaṃ yayau  || 10.67.008 ||
tatrāpaśyadyadupatiṃ rāmaṃ puṣkaramālinam  |
sudarśanīyasarvāṅgaṃ lalanāyūthamadhyagam  || 10.67.009 ||
gāyantaṃ vāruṇīṃ pītvā madavihvalalocanam  |
vibhrājamānaṃ vapuṣā prabhinnamiva vāraṇam  || 10.67.010 ||
duṣṭaḥ śākhāmṛgaḥ śākhāmārūḍhaḥ kampayan drumān  |
cakre kilakilāśabdamātmānaṃ sampradarśayan  || 10.67.011 ||
tasya dhārṣṭyaṃ kapervīkṣya taruṇyo jāticāpalāḥ  |
hāsyapriyā vijahasurbaladevaparigrahāḥ  || 10.67.012 ||
tā helayāmāsa kapirbhrūkṣepairsammukhādibhiḥ  |
darśayan svagudaṃ tāsāṃ rāmasya ca nirīkṣitaḥ  || 10.67.013 ||
taṃ grāvṇā prāharatkruddho balaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ  |
sa vañcayitvā grāvāṇaṃ madirākalaśaṃ kapiḥ  || 10.67.014 ||
gṛhītvā helayāmāsa dhūrtastaṃ kopayan hasan  |
nirbhidya kalaśaṃ duṣṭo vāsāṃsyāsphālayadbalam  || 10.67.015 ||
kadarthīkṛtya balavān vipracakre madoddhataḥ  |
taṃ tasyāvinayaṃ dṛṣṭvā deśāṃśca tadupadrutān  || 10.67.016 ||
kruddho muṣalamādatta halaṃ cārijighāṃsayā  |
dvivido'pi mahāvīryaḥ śālamudyamya pāṇinā  || 10.67.017 ||
abhyetya tarasā tena balaṃ mūrdhanyatāḍayat |
taṃ tu saṅkarṣaṇo mūrdhni patantamacalo yathā  || 10.67.018 ||
pratijagrāha balavān sunandenāhanacca tam  |
mūṣalāhatamastiṣko vireje raktadhārayā  || 10.67.019 ||
giriryathā gairikayā prahāraṃ nānucintayan  |
punaranyaṃ samutkṣipya kṛtvā niṣpatramojasā  || 10.67.020 ||
tenāhanatsusaṅkruddhastaṃ balaḥ śatadhācchinat |
tato'nyena ruṣā jaghne taṃ cāpi śatadhācchinat || 10.67.021 ||
evaṃ yudhyan bhagavatā bhagne bhagne punaḥ punaḥ  |
ākṛṣya sarvato vṛkṣānnirvṛkṣamakarodvanam  || 10.67.022 ||
tato'muñcacchilāvarṣaṃ balasyoparyamarṣitaḥ  |
tatsarvaṃ cūrṇayāṃ āsa līlayā muṣalāyudhaḥ  || 10.67.023 ||
sa bāhū tālasaṅkāśau muṣṭīkṛtya kapīśvaraḥ  |
āsādya rohiṇīputraṃ tābhyāṃ vakṣasyarūrujat || 10.67.024 ||
yādavendro'pi taṃ dorbhyāṃ tyaktvā muṣalalāṅgale  |
jatrāvabhyardayatkruddhaḥ so'patadrudhiraṃ vaman  || 10.67.025 ||
cakampe tena patatā saṭaṅkaḥ savanaspatiḥ  |
parvataḥ kuruśārdūla vāyunā naurivāmbhasi  || 10.67.026 ||
jayaśabdo namaḥśabdaḥ sādhu sādhviti cāmbare  |
surasiddhamunīndrāṇāmāsītkusumavarṣiṇām  || 10.67.027 ||
evaṃ nihatya dvividaṃ jagadvyatikarāvaham  |
saṃstūyamāno bhagavān janaiḥ svapuramāviśat || 10.67.028 ||
10.68.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
duryodhanasutāṃ rājan lakṣmaṇāṃ samitiṃjayaḥ  |
svayaṃvarasthāmaharatsāmbo jāmbavatīsutaḥ  || 10.68.001 ||
kauravāḥ kupitā ūcurdurvinīto'yamarbhakaḥ  |
kadarthīkṛtya naḥ kanyāmakāmāmaharadbalāt || 10.68.002 ||
badhnītemaṃ durvinītaṃ kiṃ kariṣyanti vṛṣṇayaḥ  |
ye'smatprasādopacitāṃ dattāṃ no bhuñjate mahīm  || 10.68.003 ||
nigṛhītaṃ sutaṃ śrutvā yadyeṣyantīha vṛṣṇayaḥ  |
bhagnadarpāḥ śamaṃ yānti prāṇā iva susaṃyatāḥ  || 10.68.004 ||
iti karṇaḥ śalo bhūriryajñaketuḥ suyodhanaḥ  |
sāmbamārebhire yoddhuṃ kuruvṛddhānumoditāḥ  || 10.68.005 ||
dṛṣṭvānudhāvataḥ sāmbo dhārtarāṣṭrānmahārathaḥ  |
pragṛhya ruciraṃ cāpaṃ tasthau siṃha ivaikalaḥ  || 10.68.006 ||
taṃ te jighṛkṣavaḥ kruddhāstiṣṭha tiṣṭheti bhāṣiṇaḥ  |
āsādya dhanvino bāṇaiḥ karṇāgraṇyaḥ samākiran  || 10.68.007 ||
so'paviddhaḥ kuruśreṣṭha kurubhiryadunandanaḥ  |
nāmṛṣyattadacintyārbhaḥ siṃha kṣudramṛgairiva  || 10.68.008 ||
visphūrjya ruciraṃ cāpaṃ sarvān vivyādha sāyakaiḥ  |
karṇādīn ṣaḍrathān vīrastāvadbhiryugapatpṛthak || 10.68.009 ||
caturbhiścaturo vāhānekaikena ca sārathīn  |
rathinaśca maheṣvāsāṃstasya tatte'bhyapūjayan  || 10.68.010 ||
taṃ tu te virathaṃ cakruścatvāraścaturo hayān  |
ekastu sārathiṃ jaghne cicchedaṇyaḥ śarāsanam  || 10.68.011 ||
taṃ baddhvā virathīkṛtya kṛcchreṇa kuravo yudhi  |
kumāraṃ svasya kanyāṃ ca svapuraṃ jayino'viśan  || 10.68.012 ||
tacchrutvā nāradoktena rājan sañjātamanyavaḥ  |
kurūn pratyudyamaṃ cakrurugrasenapracoditāḥ  || 10.68.013 ||
sāntvayitvā tu tān rāmaḥ sannaddhān vṛṣṇipuṅgavān  |
naicchatkurūṇāṃ vṛṣṇīnāṃ kaliṃ kalimalāpahaḥ  || 10.68.014 ||
jagāma hāstinapuraṃ rathenādityavarcasā  |
brāhmaṇaiḥ kulavṛddhaiśca vṛtaścandra iva grahaiḥ  || 10.68.015 ||
gatvā gajāhvayaṃ rāmo bāhyopavanamāsthitaḥ  |
uddhavaṃ preṣayāmāsa dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ bubhutsayā  || 10.68.016 ||
so'bhivandyāmbikāputraṃ bhīṣmaṃ droṇaṃ ca bāhlikam  |
duryodhanaṃ ca vidhivadrāmamāgataṃ abravīt || 10.68.017 ||
te'tiprītāstamākarṇya prāptaṃ rāmaṃ suhṛttamam  |
tamarcayitvābhiyayuḥ sarve maṅgalapāṇayaḥ  || 10.68.018 ||
taṃ saṅgamya yathānyāyaṃ gāmarghyaṃ ca nyavedayan  |
teṣāṃ ye tatprabhāvajñāḥ praṇemuḥ śirasā balam  || 10.68.019 ||
bandhūn kuśalinaḥ śrutvā pṛṣṭvā śivamanāmayam  |
parasparamatho rāmo babhāṣe'viklavaṃ vacaḥ  || 10.68.020 ||
ugrasenaḥ kṣiteśeśo yadva ājñāpayatprabhuḥ  |
tadavyagradhiyaḥ śrutvā kurudhvamavilambitam  || 10.68.021 ||
yadyūyaṃ bahavastvekaṃ jitvādharmeṇa dhārmikam  |
abadhnītātha tanmṛṣye bandhūnāmaikyakāmyayā  || 10.68.022 ||
vīryaśauryabalonnaddhamātmaśaktisamaṃ vacaḥ  |
kuravo baladevasya niśamyocuḥ prakopitāḥ  || 10.68.023 ||
aho mahaccitramidaṃ kālagatyā duratyayā  |
ārurukṣatyupānadvai śiro mukuṭasevitam  || 10.68.024 ||
ete yaunena sambaddhāḥ sahaśayyāsanāśanāḥ  |
vṛṣṇayastulyatāṃ nītā asmaddattanṛpāsanāḥ  || 10.68.025 ||
cāmaravyajane śaṅkhamātapatraṃ ca pāṇḍuram  |
kirīṭamāsanaṃ śayyāṃ bhuñjate'smadupekṣayā  || 10.68.026 ||
alaṃ yadūnāṃ naradevalāñchanairdātuḥ pratīpaiḥ phaṇināmivāmṛtam  |
ye'smatprasādopacitā hi yādavā ājñāpayantyadya gatatrapā bata  || 10.68.027 ||
kathamindro'pi kurubhirbhīṣmadroṇārjunādibhiḥ  |
adattamavarundhīta siṃhagrastamivoraṇaḥ  || 10.68.028 ||
10.68.029|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
janmabandhuśrīyonnaddha madāste bharatarṣabha  |
āśrāvya rāmaṃ durvācyamasabhyāḥ puramāviśan  || 10.68.029 ||
dṛṣṭvā kurūnāṃ dauḥśīlyaṃ śrutvāvācyāni cācyutaḥ  |
avocatkopasaṃrabdho duṣprekṣyaḥ prahasanmuhuḥ  || 10.68.030 ||
nūnaṃ nānāmadonnaddhāḥ śāntiṃ necchantyasādhavaḥ  |
teṣāṃ hi praśamo daṇḍaḥ paśūnāṃ laguḍo yathā  || 10.68.031 ||
aho yadūn susaṃrabdhān kṛṣṇaṃ ca kupitaṃ śanaiḥ  |
sāntvayitvāhameteṣāṃ śamamicchannihāgataḥ  || 10.68.032 ||
ta ime mandamatayaḥ kalahābhiratāḥ khalāḥ  |
taṃ māmavajñāya muhurdurbhāṣānmānino'bruvan  || 10.68.033 ||
nograsenaḥ kila vibhurbhojavṛṣṇyandhakeśvaraḥ  |
śakrādayo lokapālā yasyādeśānuvartinaḥ  || 10.68.034 ||
sudharmākramyate yena pārijāto'marāṅghripaḥ  |
ānīya bhujyate so'sau na kilādhyāsanārhaṇaḥ  || 10.68.035 ||
yasya pādayugaṃ sākṣācchrīrupāste'khileśvarī  |
sa nārhati kila śrīśo naradevaparicchadān  || 10.68.036 ||
yasyāṅghripaṅkajarajo'khilalokapālair  maulyuttamairdhṛtamupāsitatīrthatīrtham  |
brahmā bhavo'hamapi yasya kalāḥ kalāyāḥ   śrīścodvahema ciramasya nṛpāsanaṃ kva  || 10.68.037 ||*
bhuñjate kurubhirdattaṃ bhūkhaṇḍaṃ vṛṣṇayaḥ kila  |
upānahaḥ kila vayaṃ svayaṃ tu kuravaḥ śiraḥ  || 10.68.038 ||
aho aiśvaryamattānāṃ mattānāmiva māninām  |
asambaddhā giṛo rukṣāḥ kaḥ sahetānuśāsītā  || 10.68.039 ||
adya niṣkauravaṃ pṛthvīṃ kariṣyāmītyamarṣitaḥ  |
gṛhītvā halamuttasthau dahanniva jagattrayam  || 10.68.040 ||
lāṅgalāgreṇa nagaramudvidārya gajāhvayam  |
vicakarṣa sa gaṅgāyāṃ prahariṣyannamarṣitaḥ  || 10.68.041 ||
jalayānamivāghūrṇaṃ gaṅgāyāṃ nagaraṃ patat |
ākṛṣyamāṇamālokya kauravāḥ jātasambhramāḥ  || 10.68.042 ||
tameva śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ sakuṭumbā jijīviṣavaḥ  |
salakṣmaṇaṃ puraskṛtya sāmbaṃ prāñjalayaḥ prabhum  || 10.68.043 ||
rāma rāmākhilādhāra prabhāvaṃ na vidāma te  |
mūḍhānāṃ naḥ kubuddhīnāṃ kṣantumarhasyatikramam  || 10.68.044 ||
sthityutpattyapyayānāṃ tvameko heturnirāśrayaḥ  |
lokān krīḍanakānīśa krīḍataste vadanti hi  || 10.68.045 ||
tvameva mūrdhnīdamananta līlayā bhūmaṇḍalaṃ bibharṣi sahasramūrdhan  |
ante ca yaḥ svātmaniruddhaviśvaḥ śeṣe'dvitīyaḥ pariśiṣyamāṇaḥ  || 10.68.046 ||
kopaste'khilaśikṣārthaṃ na dveṣānna ca matsarāt |
bibhrato bhagavan sattvaṃ sthitipālanatatparaḥ  || 10.68.047 ||
namaste sarvabhūtātman sarvaśaktidharāvyaya  |
viśvakarmannamaste'stu tvāṃ vayaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ  || 10.68.048 ||
10.68.049|0 śrīśuka uvāca
evaṃ prapannaiḥ saṃvignairvepamānāyanairbalaḥ  |
prasāditaḥ suprasanno mā bhaiṣṭetyabhayaṃ dadau  || 10.68.049 ||
duryodhanaḥ pāribarhaṃ kuñjarān ṣaṣṭihāyanān  |
dadau ca dvādaśaśatānyayutāni turaṅgamān  || 10.68.050 ||
rathānāṃ ṣaṭsahasrāṇi raukmāṇāṃ sūryavarcasām  |
dāsīnāṃ niṣkakaṇṭhīnāṃ sahasraṃ duhitṛvatsalaḥ  || 10.68.051 ||
pratigṛhya tu tatsarvaṃ bhagavān sātvatarṣabhaḥ  |
sasutaḥ sasnuṣaḥ prāyātsuhṛdbhirabhinanditaḥ  || 10.68.052 ||
tataḥ praviṣṭaḥ svapuraṃ halāyudhaḥ   sametya bandhūnanuraktacetasaḥ  |
śaśaṃsa sarvaṃ yadupuṅgavānāṃ   madhye sabhāyāṃ kuruṣu svaceṣṭitam  || 10.68.053 ||*
adyāpi ca puraṃ hyetatsūcayadrāmavikramam  |
samunnataṃ dakṣiṇato gaṅgāyāmanudṛśyate  || 10.68.054 ||
10.69.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
narakaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā tathodvāhaṃ ca yoṣitām  |
kṛṣṇenaikena bahvīnāṃ taddidṛkṣuḥ sma nāradaḥ  || 10.69.001 ||
citraṃ bataitadekena vapuṣā yugapatpṛthak |
gṛheṣu dvyaṣṭasāhasraṃ striya eka udāvahat || 10.69.002 ||
ityutsuko dvāravatīṃ devarṣirdraṣṭumāgamat |
puṣpitopavanārāma dvijālikulanāditām  || 10.69.003 ||
utphullendīvarāmbhoja kahlārakumudotpalaiḥ  |
churiteṣu saraḥsūccaiḥ kūjitāṃ haṃsasārasaiḥ  || 10.69.004 ||
prāsādalakṣairnavabhirjuṣṭāṃ sphāṭikarājataiḥ  |
mahāmarakataprakhyaiḥ svarṇaratnaparicchadaiḥ  || 10.69.005 ||
vibhaktarathyāpathacatvarāpaṇaiḥ śālāsabhābhī rucirāṃ surālayaiḥ  |
saṃsiktamārgāṅganavīthidehalīṃ patatpatākadhvajavāritātapām  || 10.69.006 ||
tasyāmantaḥpuraṃ śrīmadarcitaṃ sarvadhiṣṇyapaiḥ  |
hareḥ svakauśalaṃ yatra tvaṣṭrā kārtsnyena darśitam  || 10.69.007 ||
tatra ṣoḍaśabhiḥ sadma sahasraiḥ samalaṅkṛtam  |
viveśaikatomaṃ śaureḥ patnīnāṃ bhavanaṃ mahat || 10.69.008 ||
viṣṭabdhaṃ vidrumastambhairvaidūryaphalakottamaiḥ  |
indranīlamayaiḥ kuḍyairjagatyā cāhatatviṣā  || 10.69.009 ||
vitānairnirmitaistvaṣṭrā muktādāmavilambibhiḥ  |
dāntairāsanaparyaṅkairmaṇyuttamapariṣkṛtaiḥ  || 10.69.010 ||
dāsībhirniṣkakaṇṭhībhiḥ suvāsobhiralaṅkṛtam  |
pumbhiḥ sakañcukoṣṇīṣa suvastramaṇikuṇḍalaiḥ  || 10.69.011 ||
ratnapradīpanikaradyutibhirnirasta dhvāntaṃ vicitravalabhīṣu śikhaṇḍino'ṅga  |
nṛtyanti yatra vihitāgurudhūpamakṣairniryāntamīkṣya ghanabuddhaya unnadantaḥ  || 10.69.012 ||
tasmin samānaguṇarūpavayaḥsuveṣa   dāsīsahasrayutayānusavaṃ gṛhiṇyā  |
vipro dadarśa camaravyajanena rukma   daṇḍena sātvatapatiṃ parivījayantyā  || 10.69.013 ||*
taṃ sannirīkṣya bhagavān sahasotthitaśrī   paryaṅkataḥ sakaladharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaḥ  |
ānamya pādayugalaṃ śirasā kirīṭa   juṣṭena sāñjaliravīviśadāsane sve  || 10.69.014 ||*
tasyāvanijya caraṇau tadapaḥ svamūrdhnā   bibhrajjagadgurutamo'pi satāṃ patirhi  |
brahmaṇyadeva iti yadguṇanāma yuktaṃ   tasyaiva yaccaraṇaśaucamaśeṣatīrtham  || 10.69.015 ||*
sampūjya devaṛṣivaryamṛṣiḥ purāṇo   nārāyaṇo narasakho vidhinoditena  |
vāṇyābhibhāṣya mitayāmṛtamiṣṭayā taṃ   prāha prabho bhagavate karavāma he kim  || 10.69.016 ||*
10.69.017|0 śrīnārada uvāca
naivādbhutaṃ tvayi vibho'khilalokanāthe   maitrī janeṣu sakaleṣu damaḥ khalānām  |
niḥśreyasāya hi jagatsthitirakṣaṇābhyāṃ   svairāvatāra urugāya vidāma suṣṭhu  || 10.69.017 ||*
dṛṣṭaṃ tavāṅghriyugalaṃ janatāpavargaṃ   brahmādibhirhṛdi vicintyamagādhabodhaiḥ  |
saṃsārakūpapatitottaraṇāvalambaṃ   dhyāyaṃścarāmyanugṛhāṇa yathā smṛtiḥ syāt || 10.69.018 ||*
tato'nyadāviśadgehaṃ kṛṣṇapatnyāḥ sa nāradaḥ  |
yogeśvareśvarasyāṅga yogamāyāvivitsayā  || 10.69.019 ||
dīvyantamakṣaistatrāpi priyayā coddhavena ca  |
pūjitaḥ parayā bhaktyā pratyutthānāsanādibhiḥ  || 10.69.020 ||
pṛṣṭaścāviduṣevāsau kadāyāto bhavāniti  |
kriyate kiṃ nu pūrṇānāmapūrṇairasmadādibhiḥ  || 10.69.021 ||
athāpi brūhi no brahman janmaitacchobhanaṃ kuru  |
sa tu vismita utthāya tūṣṇīmanyadagādgṛham  || 10.69.022 ||
tatrāpyacaṣṭa govindaṃ lālayantaṃ sutān śiśūn  |
tato'nyasmin gṛhe'paśyanmajjanāya kṛtodyamam  || 10.69.023 ||
juhvantaṃ ca vitānāgnīn yajantaṃ pañcabhirmakhaiḥ  |
bhojayantaṃ dvijān kvāpi bhuñjānamavaśeṣitam  || 10.69.024 ||
kvāpi sandhyāmupāsīnaṃ japantaṃ brahma vāgyatam  |
ekatra cāsicarmābhyāṃ carantamasivartmasu  || 10.69.025 ||
aśvairgajai rathaiḥ kvāpi vicarantaṃ gadāgrajam  |
kvacicchayānaṃ paryaṅke stūyamānaṃ ca vandibhiḥ  || 10.69.026 ||
mantrayantaṃ ca kasmiṃścinmantribhiścoddhavādibhiḥ  |
jalakrīḍārataṃ kvāpi vāramukhyābalāvṛtam  || 10.69.027 ||
kutraciddvijamukhyebhyo dadataṃ gāḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ  |
itihāsapurāṇāni śṛṇvantaṃ maṅgalāni ca  || 10.69.028 ||
hasantaṃ hāsakathayā kadācitpriyayā gṛhe  |
kvāpi dharmaṃ sevamānamarthakāmau ca kutracit || 10.69.029 ||
dhyāyantamekamāsīnaṃ puruṣaṃ prakṛteḥ param  |
śuśrūṣantaṃ gurūn kvāpi kāmairbhogaiḥ saparyayā  || 10.69.030 ||
kurvantaṃ vigrahaṃ kaiścitsandhiṃ cānyatra keśavam  |
kutrāpi saha rāmeṇa cintayantaṃ satāṃ śivam  || 10.69.031 ||
putrāṇāṃ duhitṝṇāṃ ca kāle vidhyupayāpanam  |
dārairvaraistatsadṛśaiḥ kalpayantaṃ vibhūtibhiḥ  || 10.69.032 ||
prasthāpanopanayanairapatyānāṃ mahotsavān  |
vīkṣya yogeśvareśasya yeṣāṃ lokā visismire  || 10.69.033 ||
yajantaṃ sakalān devān kvāpi kratubhirūrjitaiḥ  |
pūrtayantaṃ kvaciddharmaṃ kūrpārāmamaṭhādibhiḥ  || 10.69.034 ||
carantaṃ mṛgayāṃ kvāpi hayamāruhya saindhavam  |
ghnantaṃ tatra paśūnmedhyān parītaṃ yadupuṅgavaiḥ  || 10.69.035 ||
avyaktalingaṃ prakṛtiṣvantaḥpuragṛhādiṣu  |
kvaciccarantaṃ yogeśaṃ tattadbhāvabubhutsayā  || 10.69.036 ||
athovāca hṛṣīkeśaṃ nāradaḥ prahasanniva  |
yogamāyodayaṃ vīkṣya mānuṣīmīyuṣo gatim  || 10.69.037 ||
vidāma yogamāyāste durdarśā api māyinām  |
yogeśvarātmannirbhātā bhavatpādaniṣevayā  || 10.69.038 ||
anujānīhi māṃ deva lokāṃste yaśasāplutān  |
paryaṭāmi tavodgāyan līlā bhuvanapāvanīḥ  || 10.69.039 ||
10.69.040|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
brahman dhannasya vaktāhaṃ kartā tadanumoditā  |
tacchikṣayan lokamimamāsthitaḥ putra mā khidaḥ  || 10.69.040 ||
10.69.041|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ityācarantaṃ saddharmān pāvanān gṛhamedhinām  |
tameva sarvageheṣu santamekaṃ dadarśa ha  || 10.69.041 ||
kṛṣṇasyānantavīryasya yogamāyāmahodayam  |
muhurdṛṣṭvā ṛṣirabhūdvismito jātakautukaḥ  || 10.69.042 ||
ityarthakāmadharmeṣu kṛṣṇena śraddhitātmanā  |

10.71.002|0 śrīuddhava uvāca

10.71.011|0 śrīśuka uvāca

dṛṣṭvā viklinnahṛdayaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ snehena pāṇḍavaḥ  |

tatra tatropasaṅgamya paurā maṅgalapāṇayaḥ  |
cakruḥ saparyāṃ kṛṣṇāya śreṇīmukhyā hatainasaḥ  || 10.71.036 ||
antaḥpurajanaiḥ prītyā mukundaḥ phullalocanaiḥ  |
sasambhramairabhyupetaḥ prāviśadrājamandiram  || 10.71.037 ||
pṛthā vilokya bhrātreyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tribhuvaneśvaram  |

govindaṃ gṛhamānīya devadeveśamādṛtaḥ  |

10.72.007|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
samyagvyavasitaṃ rājan bhavatā śatrukarśana  |

ṛṣīṇāṃ pitṛdevānāṃ suhṛdāmapi naḥ prabho  |

vijitya nṛpatīn sarvān kṛtvā ca jagatīṃ vaśe  |

vibhūtibhirvābhibhaveddevo'pi kimu pārthivaḥ  || 10.72.011 ||
10.72.012|0 śrīśuka uvāca
niśamya bhagavadgītaṃ prītaḥ phullamukhāmbujaḥ  |

śrutvājitaṃ jarāsandhaṃ nṛpaterdhyāyato hariḥ  |
āhopāyaṃ tamevādya uddhavo yamuvāca ha  || 10.72.015 ||
bhīmaseno'rjunaḥ kṛṣṇo brahmalingadharāstrayaḥ  |

te gatvātithyavelāyāṃ gṛheṣu gṛhamedhinam  |

kiṃ durmarṣaṃ titikṣūṇāṃ kimakāryamasādhubhiḥ  |

hariścandro rantideva uñchavṛttiḥ śibirbaliḥ  |

10.72.022|0 śrīśuka uvāca
svarairākṛtibhistāṃstu prakoṣṭhairjyāhatairapi  |

śriyaṃ jihīrṣatendrasya viṣṇave dvijarūpiṇe  |

dehena patamānena nehatā vipulaṃ yaśaḥ  || 10.72.026 ||

10.72.028|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
yuddhaṃ no dehi rājendra dvandvaśo yadi manyase  |

asau vṛkodaraḥ pārthastasya bhrātārjuno hyayam  |
anayormātuleyaṃ māṃ kṛṣṇaṃ jānīhi te ripum  || 10.72.029 ||
evamāvedito rājā jahāsoccaiḥ sma māgadhaḥ  |
āha cāmarṣito mandā yuddhaṃ tarhi dadāmi vaḥ  || 10.72.030 ||
na tvayā bhīruṇā yotsye yudhi viklavatejasā  |
mathurāṃ svapurīṃ tyaktvā samudraṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ  || 10.72.031 ||
ayaṃ tu vayasātulyo nātisattvo na me samaḥ  |
arjuno na bhavedyoddhā bhīmastulyabalo mama  || 10.72.032 ||
ityuktvā bhīmasenāya prādāya mahatīṃ gadām  |
dvitīyāṃ svayamādāya nirjagāma purādbahiḥ  || 10.72.033 ||
tataḥ samekhale vīrau saṃyuktāvitaretaram  |
jaghnaturvajrakalpābhyāṃ gadābhyāṃ raṇadurmadau  || 10.72.034 ||
maṇḍalāni vicitrāṇi savyaṃ dakṣiṇameva ca  |
caratoḥ śuśubhe yuddhaṃ naṭayoriva raṅgiṇoḥ  || 10.72.035 ||
tataścaṭacaṭāśabdo vajraniṣpesasannibhaḥ  |
gadayoḥ kṣiptayo rājan dantayoriva dantinoḥ  || 10.72.036 ||
te vai gade bhujajavena nipātyamāne   anyonyato'ṃsakaṭipādakarorujatrum  |

tayorevaṃ praharatoḥ samaśikṣābalaujasoḥ  |
nirviśeṣamabhūdyuddhamakṣīṇajavayornṛpa  || 10.72.039 ||
śatrorjanmamṛtī vidvāñjīvitaṃ ca jarākṛtam  |
pārthamāpyāyayan svena tejasācintayaddhariḥ  || 10.72.040 ||
sañcintyārīvadhopāyaṃ bhīmasyāmoghadarśanaḥ  |
darśayāmāsa viṭapaṃ pāṭayanniva saṃjñayā  || 10.72.041 ||
tadvijñāya mahāsattvo bhīmaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ  |

ekaṃ pādaṃ padākramya dorbhyāmanyaṃ pragṛhya saḥ  |

ekapādoruvṛṣaṇa kaṭipṛṣṭhastanāṃsake  |

hāhākāro mahānāsīnnihate magadheśvare  |
pūjayāmāsaturbhīmaṃ parirabhya jayācyatau  || 10.72.045 ||
sahadevaṃ tattanayaṃ bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ  |
abhyaṣiñcadameyātmā magadhānāṃ patiṃ prabhuḥ  |

10.73.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ayute dve śatānyaṣṭau niruddhā yudhi nirjitāḥ  |

kṣutkṣāmāḥ śuṣkavadanāḥ saṃrodhaparikarśitāḥ  |

śrīvatsāṅkaṃ caturbāhuṃ padmagarbhāruṇekṣaṇam  |

padmahastaṃ gadāśaṅkha rathāṅgairupalakṣitam  |
kirīṭahārakaṭaka kaṭisūtrāṅgadāñcitam  || 10.73.004 ||
bhrājadvaramaṇigrīvaṃ nivītaṃ vanamālayā  |
pibanta iva cakṣurbhyāṃ lihanta iva jihvayā  || 10.73.005 ||
jighranta iva nāsābhyāṃ rambhanta iva bāhubhiḥ  |

kṛṣṇasandarśanāhlāda dhvastasaṃrodhanaklamāḥ  |

10.73.008|0 rājāna ūcuḥ
namaste devadeveśa prapannārtiharāvyaya  |
prapannān pāhi naḥ kṛṣṇa nirviṇṇān ghorasaṃsṛteḥ  || 10.73.008 ||
nainaṃ nāthānusūyāmo māgadhaṃ madhusūdana  |
anugraho yadbhavato rājñāṃ rājyacyutirvibho  || 10.73.009 ||
rājyaiśvaryamadonnaddho na śreyo vindate nṛpaḥ  |
tvanmāyāmohito'nityā manyate sampado'calāḥ  || 10.73.010 ||
mṛgatṛṣṇāṃ yathā bālā manyanta udakāśayam  |

vayaṃ purā śrīmadanaṣṭadṛṣṭayo jigīṣayāsyā itaretaraspṛdhaḥ  |

upāsitavyaṃ spṛhayāmahe vibho kriyāphalaṃ pretya ca karṇarocanam  || 10.73.014 ||
taṃ naḥ samādiśopāyaṃ yena te caraṇābjayoḥ  |
smṛtiryathā na viramedapi saṃsaratāmiha  || 10.73.015 ||
kṛṣṇāya vāsudevāya haraye paramātmane  |
praṇatakleśanāśāya govindāya namo namaḥ  || 10.73.016 ||
10.73.017|0 śrīśuka uvāca
saṃstūyamāno bhagavān rājabhirmuktabandhanaiḥ  |

10.73.018|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
adya prabhṛti vo bhūpā mayyātmanyakhileśvare  |

diṣṭyā vyavasitaṃ bhūpā bhavanta ṛtabhāṣiṇaḥ  |

10.73.024|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ityādiśya nṛpān kṛṣṇo bhagavān bhuvaneśvaraḥ  |

jagaduḥ prakṛtibhyaste mahāpuruṣaceṣṭitam  |

menire māgadhaṃ śāntaṃ rājā cāptamanorathaḥ  || 10.73.033 ||

10.74.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca

10.74.002|0 śrīyudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ye syustrailokyaguravaḥ sarve lokā maheśvarāḥ  |

10.74.006|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ityuktvā yajñiye kāle vavre yuktān sa ṛtvijaḥ  |
kṛṣṇānumoditaḥ pārtho brāhmaṇān brahmavādinaḥ  || 10.74.006 ||
dvaipāyano bharadvājaḥ sumanturgotamo'sitaḥ  |
vasiṣṭhaścyavanaḥ kaṇvo maitreyaḥ kavaṣastritaḥ  || 10.74.007 ||
viśvāmitro vāmadevaḥ sumatirjaiminiḥ kratuḥ  |
pailaḥ parāśaro gargo vaiśampāyana eva ca  || 10.74.008 ||
atharvā kaśyapo dhaumyo rāmo bhārgava āsuriḥ  |
vītihotro madhucchandā vīraseno'kṛtavraṇaḥ  || 10.74.009 ||
upahūtāstathā cānye droṇabhīṣmakṛpādayaḥ  |
dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ sahasuto viduraśca mahāmatiḥ  || 10.74.010 ||
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā yajñadidṛkṣavaḥ  |
