tataste devayajanaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ svarṇalāṅgalaiḥ  |
kṛṣṭvā tatra yathāmnāyaṃ dīkṣayāṃ cakrire nṛpam  || 10.74.012 ||
haimāḥ kilopakaraṇā varuṇasya yathā purā  |
indrādayo lokapālā viriñcibhavasaṃyutāḥ  || 10.74.013 ||
sagaṇāḥ siddhagandharvā vidyādharamahoragāḥ  |
munayo yakṣarakṣāṃsi khagakinnaracāraṇāḥ  || 10.74.014 ||
rājānaśca samāhūtā rājapatnyaśca sarvaśaḥ  |
rājasūyaṃ samīyuḥ sma rājñaḥ pāṇḍusutasya vai  |
menire kṛṣṇabhaktasya sūpapannamavismitāḥ  || 10.74.015 ||
ayājayanmahārājaṃ yājakā devavarcasaḥ  |
rājasūyena vidhivatpracetasamivāmarāḥ  || 10.74.016 ||
sūtye'hanyavanīpālo yājakān sadasaspatīn  |
apūjayanmahābhāgān yathāvatsusamāhitaḥ  || 10.74.017 ||
sadasyāgryārhaṇārhaṃ vai vimṛśantaḥ sabhāsadaḥ  |
nādhyagacchannanaikāntyātsahadevastadābravīt || 10.74.018 ||
arhati hyacyutaḥ śraiṣṭhyaṃ bhagavān sātvatāṃ patiḥ  |
eṣa vai devatāḥ sarvā deśakāladhanādayaḥ  || 10.74.019 ||
yadātmakamidaṃ viśvaṃ kratavaśca yadātmakāḥ  |
agnirāhutayo mantrā sāṅkhyaṃ yogaśca yatparaḥ  || 10.74.020 ||
eka evādvitīyo'sāvaitadātmyamidaṃ jagat |
ātmanātmāśrayaḥ sabhyāḥ sṛjatyavati hantyajaḥ  || 10.74.021 ||
vividhānīha karmāṇi janayan yadavekṣayā  |
īhate yadayaṃ sarvaḥ śreyo dharmādilakṣaṇam  || 10.74.022 ||
tasmātkṛṣṇāya mahate dīyatāṃ paramārhaṇam  |
evaṃ cetsarvabhūtānāmātmanaścārhaṇaṃ bhavet || 10.74.023 ||
sarvabhūtātmabhūtāya kṛṣṇāyānanyadarśine  |
deyaṃ śāntāya pūrṇāya dattasyānantyamicchatā  || 10.74.024 ||
ityuktvā sahadevo'bhūttūṣṇīṃ kṛṣṇānubhāvavit |
tacchrutvā tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve sādhu sādhviti sattamāḥ  || 10.74.025 ||
śrutvā dvijeritaṃ rājā jñātvā hārdaṃ sabhāsadām  |
samarhayaddhṛṣīkeśaṃ prītaḥ praṇayavihvalaḥ  || 10.74.026 ||
tatpādāvavanijyāpaḥ śirasā lokapāvanīḥ  |
sabhāryaḥ sānujāmātyaḥ sakuṭumbo vahanmudā  || 10.74.027 ||
vāsobhiḥ pītakauṣeyairbhūṣaṇaiśca mahādhanaiḥ  |
arhayitvāśrupūrṇākṣo nāśakatsamavekṣitum  || 10.74.028 ||
itthaṃ sabhājitaṃ vīkṣya sarve prāñjalayo janāḥ  |
namo jayeti nemustaṃ nipetuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭayaḥ  || 10.74.029 ||
itthaṃ niśamya damaghoṣasutaḥ svapīṭhād  utthāya kṛṣṇaguṇavarṇanajātamanyuḥ  |
utkṣipya bāhumidamāha sadasyamarṣī   saṃśrāvayan bhagavate paruṣāṇyabhītaḥ  || 10.74.030 ||*
īśo duratyayaḥ kāla iti satyavatī srutiḥ  |
vṛddhānāmapi yadbuddhirbālavākyairvibhidyate  || 10.74.031 ||
yūyaṃ pātravidāṃ śreṣṭhā mā mandhvaṃ bālabhāṣītam  |
sadasaspatayaḥ sarve kṛṣṇo yatsammato'rhaṇe  || 10.74.032 ||
tapovidyāvratadharān jñānavidhvastakalmaṣān  |
paramaṛṣīn brahmaniṣṭhāṃllokapālaiśca pūjitān  || 10.74.033 ||
sadaspatīnatikramya gopālaḥ kulapāṃsanaḥ  |
yathā kākaḥ puroḍāśaṃ saparyāṃ kathamarhati  || 10.74.034 ||
varṇāśramakulāpetaḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ  |
svairavartī guṇairhīnaḥ saparyāṃ kathamarhati  || 10.74.035 ||
yayātinaiṣāṃ hi kulaṃ śaptaṃ sadbhirbahiṣkṛtam  |
vṛthāpānarataṃ śaśvatsaparyāṃ kathamarhati  || 10.74.036 ||
brahmarṣisevitān deśān hitvaite'brahmavarcasam  |
samudraṃ durgamāśritya bādhante dasyavaḥ prajāḥ  || 10.74.037 ||
evamādīnyabhadrāṇi babhāṣe naṣṭamaṅgalaḥ  |
novāca kiñcidbhagavān yathā siṃhaḥ śivārutam  || 10.74.038 ||
bhagavannindanaṃ śrutvā duḥsahaṃ tatsabhāsadaḥ  |
karṇau pidhāya nirjagmuḥ śapantaścedipaṃ ruṣā  || 10.74.039 ||
nindāṃ bhagavataḥ śṛṇvaṃstatparasya janasya vā  |
tato nāpaiti yaḥ so'pi yātyadhaḥ sukṛtāccyutaḥ  || 10.74.040 ||
tataḥ pāṇḍusutāḥ kruddhā matsyakaikayasṛñjayāḥ  |
udāyudhāḥ samuttasthuḥ śiśupālajighāṃsavaḥ  || 10.74.041 ||
tataścaidyastvasambhrānto jagṛhe khaḍgacarmaṇī  |
bhartsayan kṛṣṇapakṣīyān rājñaḥ sadasi bhārata  || 10.74.042 ||
tāvadutthāya bhagavān svānnivārya svayaṃ ruṣā  |
śiraḥ kṣurāntacakreṇa jahāra patato ripoḥ  || 10.74.043 ||
śabdaḥ kolāhalo'thāsīcchiśupāle hate mahān  |
tasyānuyāyino bhūpā dudruvurjīvitaiṣiṇaḥ  || 10.74.044 ||
caidyadehotthitaṃ jyotirvāsudevamupāviśat |
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāmulkeva bhuvi khāccyutā  || 10.74.045 ||
janmatrayānuguṇita vairasaṃrabdhayā dhiyā  |
dhyāyaṃstanmayatāṃ yāto bhāvo hi bhavakāraṇam  || 10.74.046 ||
ṛtvigbhyaḥ sasadasyebhyo dakṣināṃ vipulāmadāt |
sarvān sampūjya vidhivaccakre'vabhṛthamekarāṭ || 10.74.047 ||
sādhayitvā kratuḥ rājñaḥ kṛṣṇo yogeśvareśvaraḥ  |
uvāsa katicinmāsān suhṛdbhirabhiyācitaḥ  || 10.74.048 ||
tato'nujñāpya rājānamanicchantamapīśvaraḥ  |
yayau sabhāryaḥ sāmātyaḥ svapuraṃ devakīsutaḥ  || 10.74.049 ||
varṇitaṃ tadupākhyānaṃ mayā te bahuvistaram  |
vaikuṇṭhavāsinorjanma vipraśāpātpunaḥ punaḥ  || 10.74.050 ||
rājasūyāvabhṛthyena snāto rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ  |
brahmakṣatrasabhāmadhye śuśubhe surarāḍiva  || 10.74.051 ||
rājñā sabhājitāḥ sarve suramānavakhecarāḥ  |
kṛṣṇaṃ kratuṃ ca śaṃsantaḥ svadhāmāni yayurmudā  || 10.74.052 ||
duryodhanamṛte pāpaṃ kaliṃ kurukulāmayam  |
yo na sehe śrīyaṃ sphītāṃ dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍusutasya tām  || 10.74.053 ||
ya idaṃ kīrtayedviṣṇoḥ karma caidyavadhādikam  |
rājamokṣaṃ vitānaṃ ca sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  || 10.74.054 ||
10.75.001|0 śrīrājovāca
ajātaśatrostaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājasūyamahodayam  |
sarve mumudire brahmannṛdevā ye samāgatāḥ  || 10.75.001 ||
duryodhanaṃ varjayitvā rājānaḥ sarṣayaḥ surāḥ  |
iti śrutaṃ no bhagavaṃstatra kāraṇamucyatām  || 10.75.002 ||
10.75.003|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
pitāmahasya te yajñe rājasūye mahātmanaḥ  |
bāndhavāḥ paricaryāyāṃ tasyāsan premabandhanāḥ  || 10.75.003 ||
bhīmo mahānasādhyakṣo dhanādhyakṣaḥ suyodhanaḥ  |
sahadevastu pūjāyāṃ nakulo dravyasādhane  || 10.75.004 ||
guruśuśrūṣaṇe jiṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pādāvanejane  |
pariveṣaṇe drupadajā karṇo dāne mahāmanāḥ  || 10.75.005 ||
yuyudhāno vikarṇaśca hārdikyo vidurādayaḥ  |
bāhlīkaputrā bhūryādyā ye ca santardanādayaḥ  || 10.75.006 ||
nirūpitā mahāyajñe nānākarmasu te tadā  |
pravartante sma rājendra rājñaḥ priyacikīrṣavaḥ  || 10.75.007 ||
ṛtviksadasyabahuvitsu suhṛttameṣu   sviṣṭeṣu sūnṛtasamarhaṇadakṣiṇābhiḥ  |
caidye ca sātvatapateścaraṇaṃ praviṣṭe   cakrustatastvavabhṛthasnapanaṃ dyunadyām  || 10.75.008 ||*
mṛdaṅgaśaṅkhapaṇava dhundhuryānakagomukhāḥ  |
vāditrāṇi vicitrāṇi nedurāvabhṛthotsave  || 10.75.009 ||
nārtakyo nanṛturhṛṣṭā gāyakā yūthaśo jaguḥ  |
vīṇāveṇutalonnādasteṣāṃ sa divamaspṛśat || 10.75.010 ||
citradhvajapatākāgrairibhendrasyandanārvabhiḥ  |
svalaṅkṛtairbhaṭairbhūpā niryayū rukmamālinaḥ  || 10.75.011 ||
yadusṛñjayakāmboja kurukekayakośalāḥ  |
kampayanto bhuvaṃ sainyairyayamānapuraḥsarāḥ  || 10.75.012 ||
sadasyartvigdvijaśreṣṭhā brahmaghoṣeṇa bhūyasā  |
devarṣipitṛgandharvāstuṣṭuvuḥ puṣpavarṣiṇaḥ  || 10.75.013 ||
svalaṇkṛtā narā nāryo gandhasragbhūṣaṇāmbaraiḥ  |
vilimpantyo'bhisiñcantyo vijahrurvividhai rasaiḥ  || 10.75.014 ||
tailagorasagandhoda haridrāsāndrakuṅkumaiḥ  |
pumbhirliptāḥ pralimpantyo vijahrurvārayoṣitaḥ  || 10.75.015 ||
guptā nṛbhirniragamannupalabdhumetad  devyo yathā divi vimānavarairnṛdevyo  |
tā mātuleyasakhibhiḥ pariṣicyamānāḥ   savrīḍahāsavikasadvadanā virejuḥ  || 10.75.016 ||*
tā devarānuta sakhīn siṣicurdṛtībhiḥ   klinnāmbarā vivṛtagātrakucorumadhyāḥ  |
autsukyamuktakavarāccyavamānamālyāḥ   kṣobhaṃ dadhurmaladhiyāṃ rucirairvihāraiḥ  || 10.75.017 ||*
sa samrāḍrathamāruḍhaḥ sadaśvaṃ rukmamālinam  |
vyarocata svapatnībhiḥ kriyābhiḥ kraturāḍiva  || 10.75.018 ||
patnīsamyājāvabhṛthyaiścaritvā te tamṛtvijaḥ  |
ācāntaṃ snāpayāṃ cakrurgaṅgāyāṃ saha kṛṣṇayā  || 10.75.019 ||
devadundubhayo nedurnaradundubhibhiḥ samam  |
mumucuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ  || 10.75.020 ||
sasnustatra tataḥ sarve varṇāśramayutā narāḥ  |
mahāpātakyapi yataḥ sadyo mucyeta kilbiṣāt || 10.75.021 ||
atha rājāhate kṣaume paridhāya svalaṅkṛtaḥ  |
ṛtviksadasyaviprādīnānarcābharaṇāmbaraiḥ  || 10.75.022 ||
bandhūñjñātīnnṛpānmitra suhṛdo'nyāṃśca sarvaśaḥ  |
abhīkṣnaṃ pūjayāmāsa nārāyaṇaparo nṛpaḥ  || 10.75.023 ||
sarve janāḥ suraruco maṇikuṇḍalasrag  uṣṇīṣakañcukadukūlamahārghyahārāḥ  |
nāryaśca kuṇḍalayugālakavṛndajuṣṭa   vaktraśriyaḥ kanakamekhalayā virejuḥ  || 10.75.024 ||*
athartvijo mahāśīlāḥ sadasyā brahmavādinaḥ  |
brahmakṣatriyaviṭśudrā rājāno ye samāgatāḥ  || 10.75.025 ||
devarṣipitṛbhūtāni lokapālāḥ sahānugāḥ  |
pūjitāstamanujñāpya svadhāmāni yayurnṛpa  || 10.75.026 ||
haridāsasya rājarṣe rājasūyamahodayam  |
naivātṛpyan praśaṃsantaḥ pibanmartyo'mṛtaṃ yathā  || 10.75.027 ||
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā suhṛtsambandhibāndhavān  |
premṇā nivārayāmāsa kṛṣṇaṃ ca tyāgakātaraḥ  || 10.75.028 ||
bhagavānapi tatrāṅga nyāvātsīttatpriyaṃkaraḥ  |
prasthāpya yaduvīrāṃśca sāmbādīṃśca kuśasthalīm  || 10.75.029 ||
itthaṃ rājā dharmasuto manorathamahārṇavam  |
sudustaraṃ samuttīrya kṛṣṇenāsīdgatajvaraḥ  || 10.75.030 ||
ekadāntaḥpure tasya vīkṣya duryodhanaḥ śriyam  |
atapyadrājasūyasya mahitvaṃ cācyutātmanaḥ  || 10.75.031 ||
yasmiṃsnarendraditijendrasurendralakṣmīr  nānā vibhānti kila viśvasṛjopakḷptāḥ  |
tābhiḥ patīn drupadarājasutopatasthe   yasyāṃ viṣaktahṛdayaḥ kururāḍatapyat || 10.75.032 ||*
yasmin tadā madhupatermahiṣīsahasraṃ   śroṇībhareṇa śanakaiḥ kvaṇadaṅghriśobham  |
madhye sucāru kucakuṅkumaśoṇahāraṃ   śrīmanmukhaṃ pracalakuṇḍalakuntalāḍhyam  || 10.75.033 ||*
sabhāyāṃ mayakḷptāyāṃ kvāpi dharmasuto'dhirāṭ |
vṛto'nugairbandhubhiśca kṛṣṇenāpi svacakṣuṣā  || 10.75.034 ||
āsīnaḥ kāñcane sākṣādāsane maghavāniva  |
pārameṣṭhyaśrīyā juṣṭaḥ stūyamānaśca vandibhiḥ  || 10.75.035 ||
tatra duryodhano mānī parīto bhrātṛbhirnṛpa  |
kirīṭamālī nyaviśadasihastaḥ kṣipan ruṣā  || 10.75.036 ||
sthale'bhyagṛhṇādvastrāntaṃ jalaṃ matvā sthale'patat |
jale ca sthalavadbhrāntyā mayamāyāvimohitaḥ  || 10.75.037 ||
jahāsa bhīmastaṃ dṛṣṭvā striyo nṛpatayo pare  |
nivāryamāṇā apyaṅga rājñā kṛṣṇānumoditāḥ  || 10.75.038 ||
sa vrīḍito'vagvadano ruṣā jvalanniṣkramya tūṣṇīṃ prayayau gajāhvayam  |
hāheti śabdaḥ sumahānabhūtsatāmajātaśatrurvimanā ivābhavat |
babhūva tūṣṇīṃ bhagavān bhuvo bharaṃ samujjihīrṣurbhramati sma yaddṛśā  || 10.75.039 ||
etatte'bhihitaṃ rājan yatpṛṣṭo'hamiha tvayā  |
suyodhanasya daurātmyaṃ rājasūye mahākratau  || 10.75.040 ||
10.76.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
athānyadapi kṛṣṇasya śṛṇu karmādbhutaṃ nṛpa  |
krīḍānaraśarīrasya yathā saubhapatirhataḥ  || 10.76.001 ||
śiśupālasakhaḥ śālvo rukmiṇyudvāha āgataḥ  |
yadubhirnirjitaḥ saṅkhye jarāsandhādayastathā  || 10.76.002 ||
śālvaḥ pratijñāmakarocchṛṇvatāṃ sarvabhūbhujām  |
ayādavāṃ kṣmāṃ kariṣye pauruṣaṃ mama paśyata  || 10.76.003 ||
iti mūḍhaḥ pratijñāya devaṃ paśupatiṃ prabhum  |
ārādhayāmāsa nṛpaḥ pāṃśumuṣṭiṃ sakṛdgrasan  || 10.76.004 ||
saṃvatsarānte bhagavānāśutoṣa umāpatiḥ  |
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa śālvaṃ śaraṇamāgatam  || 10.76.005 ||
devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām  |
abhedyaṃ kāmagaṃ vavre sa yānaṃ vṛṣṇibhīṣaṇam  || 10.76.006 ||
tatheti giriśādiṣṭo mayaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ  |
puraṃ nirmāya śālvāya prādātsaubhamayasmayam  || 10.76.007 ||
sa labdhvā kāmagaṃ yānaṃ tamodhāma durāsadam  |
yayasdvāravatīṃ śālvo vairaṃ vṛṣṇikṛtaṃ smaran  || 10.76.008 ||
nirudhya senayā śālvo mahatyā bharatarṣabha  |
purīṃ babhañjopavanānudyānāni ca sarvaśaḥ  || 10.76.009 ||
sagopurāṇi dvārāṇi prāsādāṭṭālatolikāḥ  |
vihārān sa vimānāgryānnipetuḥ śastravṛṣṭayaḥ  || 10.76.010 ||
śilādrumāścāśanayaḥ sarpā āsāraśarkarāḥ  |
pracaṇḍaścakravāto'bhūdrajasācchāditā diśaḥ  || 10.76.011 ||
ityardyamānā saubhena kṛṣṇasya nagarī bhṛśam  |
nābhyapadyata śaṃ rājaṃstripureṇa yathā mahī  || 10.76.012 ||
pradyumno bhagavān vīkṣya bādhyamānā nijāḥ prajāḥ  |
ma bhaiṣṭetyabhyadhādvīro rathārūḍho mahāyaśāḥ  || 10.76.013 ||
sātyakiścārudeṣṇaśca sāmbo'krūraḥ sahānujaḥ  |
hārdikyo bhānuvindaśca gadaśca śukasāraṇau  || 10.76.014 ||
apare ca maheṣvāsā rathayūthapayūthapāḥ  |
niryayurdaṃśitā guptā rathebhāśvapadātibhiḥ  || 10.76.015 ||
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ śālvānāṃ yadubhiḥ saha  |
yathāsurāṇāṃ vibudhaistumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam  || 10.76.016 ||
tāśca saubhapatermāyā divyāstrai rukmiṇīsutaḥ  |
kṣaṇena nāśayāmāsa naiśaṃ tama ivoṣṇaguḥ  || 10.76.017 ||
vivyādha pañcaviṃśatyā svarṇapuṅkhairayomukhaiḥ  |
śālvasya dhvajinīpālaṃ śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ  || 10.76.018 ||
śatenātāḍayacchālvamekaikenāsya sainikān  |
daśabhirdaśabhirnetṝn vāhanāni tribhistribhiḥ  || 10.76.019 ||
tadadbhutaṃ mahatkarma pradyumnasya mahātmanaḥ  |
dṛṣṭvā taṃ pūjayāmāsuḥ sarve svaparasainikāḥ  || 10.76.020 ||
bahurūpaikarūpaṃ taddṛśyate na ca dṛśyate  |
māyāmayaṃ mayakṛtaṃ durvibhāvyaṃ parairabhūt || 10.76.021 ||
kvacidbhūmau kvacidvyomni girimūrdhni jale kvacit |
alātacakravadbhrāmyatsaubhaṃ tadduravasthitam  || 10.76.022 ||
yatra yatropalakṣyeta sasaubhaḥ sahasainikaḥ  |
śālvastatastato'muñcañcharān sātvatayūthapāḥ  || 10.76.023 ||
śarairagnyarkasaṃsparśairāśīviṣadurāsadaiḥ  |
pīḍyamānapurānīkaḥ śālvo'muhyatpareritaiḥ  || 10.76.024 ||
śālvānīkapaśastraughairvṛṣṇivīrā bhṛśārditāḥ  |
na tatyajū raṇaṃ svaṃ svaṃ lokadvayajigīṣavaḥ  || 10.76.025 ||
śālvāmātyo dyumānnāma pradyumnaṃ prakprapīḍitaḥ  |
āsādya gadayā maurvyā vyāhatya vyanadadbalī  || 10.76.026 ||
pradyumnaṃ gadayā sīrṇa vakṣaḥsthalamariṃdamam  |
apovāha raṇātsūto dharmaviddārukātmajaḥ  || 10.76.027 ||
labdhasamjño muhūrtena kārṣṇiḥ sārathimabravīt |
aho asādhvidaṃ sūta yadraṇānme'pasarpaṇam  || 10.76.028 ||
na yadūnāṃ kule jātaḥ śrūyate raṇavicyutaḥ  |
vinā matklībacittena sūtena prāptakilbiṣāt || 10.76.029 ||
kiṃ nu vakṣye'bhisaṅgamya pitarau rāmakeśavau  |
yuddhātsamyagapakrāntaḥ pṛṣṭastatrātmanaḥ kṣamam  || 10.76.030 ||
vyaktaṃ me kathayiṣyanti hasantyo bhrātṛjāmayaḥ  |
klaibyaṃ kathaṃ kathaṃ vīra tavānyaiḥ kathyatāṃ mṛdhe  || 10.76.031 ||
10.76.032|0 sārathiruvāca
dharmaṃ vijānatāyuṣman kṛtametanmayā vibho  |
sūtaḥ kṛcchragataṃ rakṣedrathinaṃ sārathiṃ rathī  || 10.76.032 ||
etadviditvā tu bhavānmayāpovāhito raṇāt |
upasṛṣṭaḥ pareṇeti mūrcchito gadayā hataḥ  || 10.76.033 ||
10.77.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
sa upaspṛśya salilaṃ daṃśito dhṛtakārmukaḥ  |
naya māṃ dyumataḥ pārśvaṃ vīrasyetyāha sārathim  || 10.77.001 ||
vidhamantaṃ svasainyāni dyumantaṃ rukmiṇīsutaḥ  |
pratihatya pratyavidhyānnārācairaṣṭabhiḥ smayan  || 10.77.002 ||
caturbhiścaturo vāhān sūtamekena cāhanat |
dvābhyaṃ dhanuśca ketuṃ ca śareṇānyena vai śiraḥ  || 10.77.003 ||
gadasātyakisāmbādyā jaghnuḥ saubhapaterbalam  |
petuḥ samudre saubheyāḥ sarve sañchinnakandharāḥ  || 10.77.004 ||
evaṃ yadūnāṃ śālvānāṃ nighnatāmitaretaram  |
yuddhaṃ trinavarātraṃ tadabhūttumulamulbaṇam  || 10.77.005 ||
indraprasthaṃ gataḥ kṛṣṇa āhūto dharmasūnunā  |
rājasūye'tha nivṛtte śiśupāle ca saṃsthite  || 10.77.006 ||
kuruvṛddhānanujñāpya munīṃśca sasutāṃ pṛthām  |
nimittānyatighorāṇi paśyan dvāravatīṃ yayau  || 10.77.007 ||
āha cāhamihāyāta āryamiśrābhisaṅgataḥ  |
rājanyāścaidyapakṣīyā nūnaṃ hanyuḥ purīṃ mama  || 10.77.008 ||
vīkṣya tatkadanaṃ svānāṃ nirūpya purarakṣaṇam  |
saubhaṃ ca śālvarājaṃ ca dārukaṃ prāha keśavaḥ  || 10.77.009 ||
rathaṃ prāpaya me sūta śālvasyāntikamāśu vai  |
sambhramaste na kartavyo māyāvī saubharāḍayam  || 10.77.010 ||
ityuktaścodayāmāsa rathamāsthāya dārukaḥ  |
viśantaṃ dadṛśuḥ sarve sve pare cāruṇānujam  || 10.77.011 ||
śālvaśca kṛṣṇamālokya hataprāyabaleśvaraḥ  |
prāharatkṛṣṇasūtaya śaktiṃ bhīmaravāṃ mṛdhe  || 10.77.012 ||
tāmāpatantīṃ nabhasi maholkāmiva raṃhasā  |
bhāsayantīṃ diśaḥ śauriḥ sāyakaiḥ śatadhācchinat || 10.77.013 ||
taṃ ca ṣoḍaśabhirviddhvā bānaiḥ saubhaṃ ca khe bhramat |
avidhyaccharasandohaiḥ khaṃ sūrya iva raśmibhiḥ  || 10.77.014 ||
śālvaḥ śaurestu doḥ savyaṃ saśārṅgaṃ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ  |
bibheda nyapataddhastācchārṅgamāsīttadadbhutam  || 10.77.015 ||
hāhākāro mahānāsīdbhūtānāṃ tatra paśyatām  |
ninadya saubharāḍuccairidamāha janārdanam  || 10.77.016 ||
yattvayā mūḍha naḥ sakhyurbhrāturbhāryā hṛtekṣatām  |
pramattaḥ sa sabhāmadhye tvayā vyāpāditaḥ sakhā  || 10.77.017 ||
taṃ tvādya niśitairbāṇairaparājitamāninam  |
nayāmyapunarāvṛttiṃ yadi tiṣṭhermamāgrataḥ  || 10.77.018 ||
10.77.019|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
vṛthā tvaṃ katthase manda na paśyasyantike'ntakam  |
paurusaṃ darśayanti sma śūrā na bahubhāṣiṇaḥ  || 10.77.019 ||
ityuktvā bhagavāñchālvaṃ gadayā bhīmavegayā  |
tatāḍa jatrau saṃrabdhaḥ sa cakampe vamannasṛk || 10.77.020 ||
gadāyāṃ sannivṛttāyāṃ śālvastvantaradhīyata  |
tato muhūrta āgatya puruṣaḥ śirasācyutam  |
devakyā prahito'smīti natvā prāha vaco rudan  || 10.77.021 ||
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho pitā te pitṛvatsala  |
baddhvāpanītaḥ śālvena saunikena yathā paśuḥ  || 10.77.022 ||
niśamya vipriyaṃ kṛṣṇo mānusīṃ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ  |
vimanasko ghṛṇī snehādbabhāṣe prākṛto yathā  || 10.77.023 ||
kathaṃ rāmamasambhrāntaṃ jitvājeyaṃ surāsuraiḥ  |
śālvenālpīyasā nītaḥ pitā me balavān vidhiḥ  || 10.77.024 ||
iti bruvāṇe govinde saubharāṭpratyupasthitaḥ  |
vasudevamivānīya kṛṣṇaṃ cedamuvāca saḥ  || 10.77.025 ||
eṣa te janitā tāto yadarthamiha jīvasi  |
vadhiṣye vīkṣataste'mumīśaścetpāhi bāliśa  || 10.77.026 ||
evaṃ nirbhartsya māyāvī khaḍgenānakadundubheḥ  |
utkṛtya śira ādāya khasthaṃ saubhaṃ samāviśat || 10.77.027 ||
tato muhūrtaṃ prakṛtāvupaplutaḥ svabodha āste svajanānuṣaṅgataḥ  |
mahānubhāvastadabudhyadāsurīṃ māyāṃ sa śālvaprasṛtāṃ mayoditām  || 10.77.028 ||
na tatra dūtaṃ na pituḥ kalevaraṃ prabuddha ājau samapaśyadacyutaḥ  |
svāpnaṃ yathā cāmbaracāriṇaṃ ripuṃ saubhasthamālokya nihantumudyataḥ  || 10.77.029 ||
evaṃ vadanti rājarṣe ṛṣayaḥ ke ca nānvitāḥ  |
yatsvavāco virudhyeta nūnaṃ te na smarantyuta  || 10.77.030 ||
kva śokamohau sneho vā bhayaṃ vā ye'jñasambhavāḥ  |
kva cākhaṇḍitavijñāna jñānaiśvaryastvakhaṇḍitaḥ  || 10.77.031 ||
yatpādasevorjitayātmavidyayā hinvantyanādyātmaviparyayagraham  |
labhanta ātmīyamanantamaiśvaraṃ kuto nu mohaḥ paramasya sadgateḥ  || 10.77.032 ||
taṃ śastrapūgaiḥ praharantamojasā   śālvaṃ śaraiḥ śauriramoghavikramaḥ  |
viddhvācchinadvarma dhanuḥ śiromaṇiṃ   saubhaṃ ca śatrorgadayā ruroja ha  || 10.77.033 ||*
tatkṛṣṇahasteritayā vicūrṇitaṃ papāta toye gadayā sahasradhā  |
visṛjya tadbhūtalamāsthito gadāmudyamya śālvo'cyutamabhyagāddrutam  || 10.77.034 ||
ādhāvataḥ sagadaṃ tasya bāhuṃ bhallena chittvātha rathāṅgamadbhutam  |
vadhāya śālvasya layārkasannibhaṃ bibhradbabhau sārka ivodayācalaḥ  || 10.77.035 ||
jahāra tenaiva śiraḥ sakuṇḍalaṃ kirīṭayuktaṃ purumāyino hariḥ  |
vajreṇa vṛtrasya yathā purandaro babhūva hāheti vacastadā nṛṇām  || 10.77.036 ||
tasminnipatite pāpe saubhe ca gadayā hate  |
nedurdundubhayo rājan divi devagaṇeritāḥ  |
sakhīnāmapacitiṃ kurvan dantavakro ruṣābhyagāt || 10.77.037 ||
10.78.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
śiśupālasya śālvasya pauṇḍrakasyāpi durmatiḥ  |
paralokagatānāṃ ca kurvan pārokṣyasauhṛdam  || 10.78.001 ||
ekaḥ padātiḥ saṅkruddho gadāpāṇiḥ prakampayan  |
padbhyāmimāṃ mahārāja mahāsattvo vyadṛśyata  || 10.78.002 ||
taṃ tathāyāntamālokya gadāmādāya satvaraḥ  |
avaplutya rathātkṛṣṇaḥ sindhuṃ veleva pratyadhāt || 10.78.003 ||
gadāmudyamya kārūṣo mukundaṃ prāha durmadaḥ  |
diṣṭyā diṣṭyā bhavānadya mama dṛṣṭipathaṃ gataḥ  || 10.78.004 ||
tvaṃ mātuleyo naḥ kṛṣṇa mitradhruṅmāṃ jighāṃsasi  |
atastvāṃ gadayā manda haniṣye vajrakalpayā  || 10.78.005 ||
tarhyānṛṇyamupaimyajña mitrāṇāṃ mitravatsalaḥ  |
bandhurūpamariṃ hatvā vyādhiṃ dehacaraṃ yathā  || 10.78.006 ||
evaṃ rūkṣaistudan vākyaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ totrairiva dvipam  |
gadayātāḍayanmūrdhni siṃhavadvyanadacca saḥ  || 10.78.007 ||
gadayābhihato'pyājau na cacāla yadūdvahaḥ  |
kṛṣṇo'pi tamahan gurvyā kaumodakyā stanāntare  || 10.78.008 ||
gadānirbhinnahṛdaya udvaman rudhiraṃ mukhāt |
prasārya keśabāhvaṅghrīn dharaṇyāṃ nyapatadvyasuḥ  || 10.78.009 ||
tataḥ sūkṣmataraṃ jyotiḥ kṛṣṇamāviśadadbhutam  |
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yathā caidyavadhe nṛpa  || 10.78.010 ||
vidūrathastu tadbhrātā bhrātṛśokapariplutaḥ  |
āgacchadasicarmābhyāmucchvasaṃstajjighāṃsayā  || 10.78.011 ||
tasya cāpatataḥ kṛṣṇaścakreṇa kṣuraneminā  |
śiro jahāra rājendra sakirīṭaṃ sakuṇḍalam  || 10.78.012 ||
evaṃ saubhaṃ ca śālvaṃ ca dantavakraṃ sahānujam  |
hatvā durviṣahānanyairīḍitaḥ suramānavaiḥ  || 10.78.013 ||
munibhiḥ siddhagandharvairvidyādharamahoragaiḥ  |
apsarobhiḥ pitṛgaṇairyakṣaiḥ kinnaracāraṇaiḥ  || 10.78.014 ||
upagīyamānavijayaḥ kusumairabhivarṣitaḥ  |
vṛtaśca vṛṣṇipravarairviveśālaṅkṛtāṃ purīm  || 10.78.015 ||
evaṃ yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo bhagavān jagadīśvaraḥ  |
īyate paśudṛṣṭīnāṃ nirjito jayatīti saḥ  || 10.78.016 ||
śrutvā yuddhodyamaṃ rāmaḥ kurūṇāṃ saha pāṇḍavaiḥ  |
tīrthābhiṣekavyājena madhyasthaḥ prayayau kila  || 10.78.017 ||
snātvā prabhāse santarpya devarṣipitṛmānavān  |
sarasvatīṃ pratisrotaṃ yayau brāhmaṇasaṃvṛtaḥ  || 10.78.018 ||
pṛthūdakaṃ bindusarastritakūpaṃ sudarśanam  |
viśālaṃ brahmatīrthaṃ ca cakraṃ prācīṃ sarasvatīm  || 10.78.019 ||
yamunāmanu yānyeva gaṅgāmanu ca bhārata  |
jagāma naimiṣaṃ yatra ṛṣayaḥ satramāsate  || 10.78.020 ||
tamāgatamabhipretya munayo dīrghasatriṇaḥ  |
abhinandya yathānyāyaṃ praṇamyotthāya cārcayan  || 10.78.021 ||
so'rcitaḥ saparīvāraḥ kṛtāsanaparigrahaḥ  |
romaharṣaṇamāsīnaṃ maharṣeḥ śiṣyamaikṣata  || 10.78.022 ||
apratyutthāyinaṃ sūtamakṛtaprahvaṇāñjalim  |
adhyāsīnaṃ ca tān viprāṃścukopodvīkṣya mādhavaḥ  || 10.78.023 ||
yasmādasāvimān viprānadhyāste pratilomajaḥ  |
dharmapālāṃstathaivāsmān vadhamarhati durmatiḥ  || 10.78.024 ||
ṛṣerbhagavato bhūtvā śiṣyo'dhītya bahūni ca  |
setihāsapurāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi sarvaśaḥ  || 10.78.025 ||
adāntasyāvinītasya vṛthā paṇḍitamāninaḥ  |
na guṇāya bhavanti sma naṭasyevājitātmanaḥ  || 10.78.026 ||
etadartho hi loke'sminnavatāro mayā kṛtaḥ  |
vadhyā me dharmadhvajinaste hi pātakino'dhikāḥ  || 10.78.027 ||
etāvaduktvā bhagavānnivṛtto'sadvadhādapi  |
bhāvitvāttaṃ kuśāgreṇa karasthenāhanatprabhuḥ  || 10.78.028 ||
hāhetivādinaḥ sarve munayaḥ khinnamānasāḥ  |
ūcuḥ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ devamadharmaste kṛtaḥ prabho  || 10.78.029 ||
asya brahmāsanaṃ dattamasmābhiryadunandana  |
āyuścātmāklamaṃ tāvadyāvatsatraṃ samāpyate  || 10.78.030 ||
ajānataivācaritastvayā brahmavadho yathā  |
yogeśvarasya bhavato nāmnāyo'pi niyāmakaḥ  || 10.78.031 ||
yadyetadbrahmahatyāyāḥ pāvanaṃ lokapāvana  |
cariṣyati bhavāṃlloka saṅgraho'nanyacoditaḥ  || 10.78.032 ||
10.78.033|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
cariṣye vadhanirveśaṃ lokānugrahakāmyayā  |
niyamaḥ prathame kalpe yāvān sa tu vidhīyatām  || 10.78.033 ||
dīrghamāyurbataitasya sattvamindriyameva ca  |
āśāsitaṃ yattadbrūte sādhaye yogamāyayā  || 10.78.034 ||
10.78.035|0 ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
astrasya tava vīryasya mṛtyorasmākameva ca  |
yathā bhavedvacaḥ satyaṃ tathā rāma vidhīyatām  || 10.78.035 ||
10.78.036|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
ātmā vai putra utpanna iti vedānuśāsanam  |
tasmādasya bhavedvaktā āyurindriyasattvavān  || 10.78.036 ||
kiṃ vaḥ kāmo muniśreṣṭhā brūtāhaṃ karavāṇyatha  |
ajānatastvapacitiṃ yathā me cintyatāṃ budhāḥ  || 10.78.037 ||
10.78.038|0 ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
ilvalasya suto ghoro balvalo nāma dānavaḥ  |
sa dūṣayati naḥ satrametya parvaṇi parvaṇi  || 10.78.038 ||
taṃ pāpaṃ jahi dāśārha tannaḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ param  |
pūyaśoṇitavinmūtra surāmāṃsābhivarṣiṇam  || 10.78.039 ||
tataśca bhārataṃ varṣaṃ parītya susamāhitaḥ  |
caritvā dvādaśamāsāṃstīrthasnāyī viśudhyasi  || 10.78.040 ||
10.79.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
tataḥ parvaṇyupāvṛtte pracaṇḍaḥ pāṃśuvarṣaṇaḥ  |
bhīmo vāyurabhūdrājan pūyagandhastu sarvaśaḥ  || 10.79.001 ||
tato'medhyamayaṃ varṣaṃ balvalena vinirmitam  |
abhavadyajñaśālāyāṃ so'nvadṛśyata śūladhṛk || 10.79.002 ||
taṃ vilokya bṛhatkāyaṃ bhinnāñjanacayopamam  |
taptatāmraśikhāśmaśruṃ daṃṣṭrograbhrukuṭīmukham  || 10.79.003 ||
sasmāra mūṣalaṃ rāmaḥ parasainyavidāraṇam  |
halaṃ ca daityadamanaṃ te tūrṇamupatasthatuḥ  || 10.79.004 ||
tamākṛṣya halāgreṇa balvalaṃ gaganecaram  |
mūṣalenāhanatkruddho mūrdhni brahmadruhaṃ balaḥ  || 10.79.005 ||
so'patadbhuvi nirbhinna lalāṭo'sṛksamutsṛjan  |
muñcannārtasvaraṃ śailo yathā vajrahato'ruṇaḥ  || 10.79.006 ||
saṃstutya munayo rāmaṃ prayujyāvitathāśiṣaḥ  |
abhyaṣiñcanmahābhāgā vṛtraghnaṃ vibudhā yathā  || 10.79.007 ||
vaijayantīṃ dadurmālāṃ śrīdhāmāmlānapaṅkajāṃ  |
rāmāya vāsasī divye divyānyābharaṇāni ca  || 10.79.008 ||
atha tairabhyanujñātaḥ kauśikīmetya brāhmaṇaiḥ  |
snātvā sarovaramagādyataḥ sarayūrāsravat || 10.79.009 ||
anusrotena sarayūṃ prayāgamupagamya saḥ  |
snātvā santarpya devādīn jagāma pulahāśramam  || 10.79.010 ||
gomatīṃ gaṇḍakīṃ snātvā vipāśāṃ śoṇa āplutaḥ  |
gayāṃ gatvā pitṝniṣṭvā gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgame  || 10.79.011 ||
upaspṛśya mahendrādrau rāmaṃ dṛṣṭvābhivādya ca  |
saptagodāvarīṃ veṇāṃ pampāṃ bhīmarathīṃ tataḥ  || 10.79.012 ||
skandaṃ dṛṣṭvā yayau rāmaḥ śrīśailaṃ giriśālayam  |
draviḍeṣu mahāpuṇyaṃ dṛṣṭvādriṃ veṅkaṭaṃ prabhuḥ  || 10.79.013 ||
kāmakoṣṇīṃ purīṃ kāñcīṃ kāverīṃ ca saridvarām  |
śrīrangākhyaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ yatra sannihito hariḥ  || 10.79.014 ||
ṛṣabhādriṃ hareḥ kṣetraṃ dakṣiṇāṃ mathurāṃ tathā  |
sāmudraṃ setumagamatmahāpātakanāśanam  || 10.79.015 ||
tatrāyutamadāddhenūrbrāhmaṇebhyo halāyudhaḥ  |
kṛtamālāṃ tāmraparṇīṃ malayaṃ ca kulācalam  || 10.79.016 ||
tatrāgastyaṃ samāsīnaṃ namaskṛtyābhivādya ca  |
yojitastena cāśīrbhiranujñāto gato'rṇavam  |
dakṣiṇaṃ tatra kanyākhyāṃ durgāṃ devīṃ dadarśa saḥ  || 10.79.017 ||
tataḥ phālgunamāsādya pañcāpsarasamuttamam  |
viṣṇuḥ sannihito yatra snātvāsparśadgavāyutam  || 10.79.018 ||
tato'bhivrajya bhagavān keralāṃstu trigartakān  |
gokarṇākhyaṃ śivakṣetraṃ sānnidhyaṃ yatra dhūrjaṭeḥ  || 10.79.019 ||
āryāṃ dvaipāyanīṃ dṛṣṭvā śūrpārakamagādbalaḥ  |
tāpīṃ payoṣṇīṃ nirvindhyāmupaspṛśyātha daṇḍakam  || 10.79.020 ||
praviśya revāmagamadyatra māhiṣmatī purī  |
manutīrthamupaspṛśya prabhāsaṃ punarāgamat || 10.79.021 ||
śrutvā dvijaiḥ kathyamānaṃ kurupāṇḍavasaṃyuge  |
sarvarājanyanidhanaṃ bhāraṃ mene hṛtaṃ bhuvaḥ  || 10.79.022 ||
sa bhīmaduryodhanayorgadābhyāṃ yudhyatormṛdhe  |
vārayiṣyan vinaśanaṃ jagāma yadunandanaḥ  || 10.79.023 ||
yudhiṣṭhirastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā yamau kṛṣṇārjunāvapi  |
abhivādyābhavaṃstuṣṇīṃ kiṃ vivakṣurihāgataḥ  || 10.79.024 ||
gadāpāṇī ubhau dṛṣṭvā saṃrabdhau vijayaiṣiṇau  |
maṇḍalāni vicitrāṇi carantāvidamabravīt || 10.79.025 ||
yuvāṃ tulyabalau vīrau he rājan he vṛkodara  |
ekaṃ prāṇādhikaṃ manye utaikaṃ śikṣayādhikam  || 10.79.026 ||
tasmādekatarasyeha yuvayoḥ samavīryayoḥ  |
na lakṣyate jayo'nyo vā viramatvaphalo raṇaḥ  || 10.79.027 ||
na tadvākyaṃ jagṛhaturbaddhavairau nṛpārthavat |
anusmarantāvanyonyaṃ duruktaṃ duṣkṛtāni ca  || 10.79.028 ||
diṣṭaṃ tadanumanvāno rāmo dvāravatīṃ yayau  |
ugrasenādibhiḥ prītairjñātibhiḥ samupāgataḥ  || 10.79.029 ||
taṃ punarnaimiṣaṃ prāptamṛṣayo'yājayanmudā  |
kratvaṅgaṃ kratubhiḥ sarvairnivṛttākhilavigraham  || 10.79.030 ||
tebhyo viśuddhaṃ vijñānaṃ bhagavān vyataradvibhuḥ  |
yenaivātmanyado viśvamātmānaṃ viśvagaṃ viduḥ  || 10.79.031 ||
svapatyāvabhṛthasnāto jñātibandhusuhṛdvṛtaḥ  |
reje svajyotsnayevenduḥ suvāsāḥ suṣṭhvalaṅkṛtaḥ  || 10.79.032 ||
īdṛgvidhānyasaṅkhyāni balasya balaśālinaḥ  |
anantasyāprameyasya māyāmartyasya santi hi  || 10.79.033 ||
yo'nusmareta rāmasya karmāṇyadbhutakarmaṇaḥ  |
sāyaṃ prātaranantasya viṣṇoḥ sa dayito bhavet || 10.79.034 ||
10.80.001|0 śrīrājovāca
bhagavan yāni cānyāni mukundasya mahātmanaḥ  |
vīryāṇyanantavīryasya śrotumicchāmi he prabho  || 10.80.001 ||
ko nu śrutvāsakṛdbrahmannuttamaḥślokasatkathāḥ  |
virameta viśeṣajño viṣaṇṇaḥ kāmamārgaṇaiḥ  || 10.80.002 ||
sā vāgyayā tasya guṇān gṛṇīte karau ca tatkarmakarau manaśca  |
smaredvasantaṃ sthirajaṅgameṣu śṛṇoti tatpuṇyakathāḥ sa karṇaḥ  || 10.80.003 ||
śirastu tasyobhayaliṅgamānamettadeva yatpaśyati taddhi cakṣuḥ  |
aṅgāni viṣṇoratha tajjanānāṃ pādodakaṃ yāni bhajanti nityam  || 10.80.004 ||
10.80.005|0 sūta uvāca
viṣṇurātena sampṛṣṭo bhagavān bādarāyaṇiḥ  |
vāsudeve bhagavati nimagnahṛdayo'bravīt || 10.80.005 ||
10.80.006|0 śrīśuka uvāca
kṛṣṇasyāsītsakhā kaścidbrāhmaṇo brahmavittamaḥ  |
virakta indriyārtheṣu praśāntātmā jitendriyaḥ  || 10.80.006 ||
yadṛcchayopapannena vartamāno gṛhāśramī  |
tasya bhāryā kucailasya kṣutkṣāmā ca tathāvidhā  || 10.80.007 ||
pativratā patiṃ prāha mlāyatā vadanena sā  |
daridraṃ sīdamānā vai vepamānābhigamya ca  || 10.80.008 ||
nanu brahman bhagavataḥ sakhā sākṣācchriyaḥ patiḥ  |
brahmaṇyaśca śaraṇyaśca bhagavān sātvatarṣabhaḥ  || 10.80.009 ||
tamupaihi mahābhāga sādhūnāṃ ca parāyaṇam  |
dāsyati draviṇaṃ bhūri sīdate te kuṭumbine  || 10.80.010 ||
āste'dhunā dvāravatyāṃ bhojavṛṣṇyandhakeśvaraḥ  |
smarataḥ pādakamalamātmānamapi yacchati  |
kiṃ nvarthakāmān bhajato nātyabhīṣṭān jagadguruḥ  || 10.80.011 ||
sa evaṃ bhāryayā vipro bahuśaḥ prārthito muhuḥ  |
ayaṃ hi paramo lābha uttamaḥślokadarśanam  || 10.80.012 ||
iti sañcintya manasā gamanāya matiṃ dadhe  |
apyastyupāyanaṃ kiñcidgṛhe kalyāṇi dīyatām  || 10.80.013 ||
yācitvā caturo muṣṭīn viprān pṛthukataṇḍulān  |
cailakhaṇḍena tān baddhvā bhartre prādādupāyanam  || 10.80.014 ||
sa tānādāya viprāgryaḥ prayayau dvārakāṃ kila  |
kṛṣṇasandarśanaṃ mahyaṃ kathaṃ syāditi cintayan  || 10.80.015 ||
trīṇi gulmānyatīyāya tisraḥ kakṣāśca sadvijaḥ  |
vipro'gamyāndhakavṛṣṇīnāṃ gṛheṣvacyutadharmiṇām  || 10.80.016 ||
gṛhaṃ dvyaṣṭasahasrāṇāṃ mahiṣīṇāṃ harerdvijaḥ  |
viveśaikatamaṃ śrīmadbrahmānandaṃ gato yathā  || 10.80.017 ||
taṃ vilokyācyuto dūrātpriyāparyaṅkamāsthitaḥ  |
sahasotthāya cābhyetya dorbhyāṃ paryagrahīnmudā  || 10.80.018 ||
sakhyuḥ priyasya viprarṣeraṅgasaṅgātinirvṛtaḥ  |
prīto vyamuñcadabbindūnnetrābhyāṃ puṣkarekṣaṇaḥ  || 10.80.019 ||
athopaveśya paryaṅke svayaṃ sakhyuḥ samarhaṇam  |
upahṛtyāvanijyāsya pādau pādāvanejanīḥ  || 10.80.020 ||
agrahīcchirasā rājan bhagavāṃllokapāvanaḥ  |
vyalimpaddivyagandhena candanāgurukuṅkamaiḥ  || 10.80.021 ||
dhūpaiḥ surabhibhirmitraṃ pradīpāvalibhirmudā  |
arcitvāvedya tāmbūlaṃ gāṃ ca svāgatamabravīt || 10.80.022 ||
kucailaṃ malinaṃ kṣāmaṃ dvijaṃ dhamanisantatam  |
devī paryacaratsākṣāccāmaravyajanena vai  || 10.80.023 ||
antaḥpurajano dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇenāmalakīrtinā  |
vismito'bhūdatiprītyā avadhūtaṃ sabhājitam  || 10.80.024 ||
kimanena kṛtaṃ puṇyamavadhūtena bhikṣuṇā  |
śriyā hīnena loke'smin garhitenādhamena ca  || 10.80.025 ||
yo'sau trilokaguruṇā śrīnivāsena sambhṛtaḥ  |
paryaṅkasthāṃ śriyaṃ hitvā pariṣvakto'grajo yathā  || 10.80.026 ||
kathayāṃ cakraturgāthāḥ pūrvā gurukule satoḥ  |
ātmanorlalitā rājan karau gṛhya parasparam  || 10.80.027 ||
10.80.028|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
api brahman gurukulādbhavatā labdhadakṣiṇāt |
samāvṛttena dharmajña bhāryoḍhā sadṛśī na vā  || 10.80.028 ||
prāyo gṛheṣu te cittamakāmavihitaṃ tathā  |
naivātiprīyase vidvan dhaneṣu viditaṃ hi me  || 10.80.029 ||
kecitkurvanti karmāṇi kāmairahatacetasaḥ  |
tyajantaḥ prakṛtīrdaivīryathāhaṃ lokasaṅgraham  || 10.80.030 ||
kaccidgurukule vāsaṃ brahman smarasi nau yataḥ  |
dvijo vijñāya vijñeyaṃ tamasaḥ pāramaśnute  || 10.80.031 ||
sa vai satkarmaṇāṃ sākṣāddvijāteriha sambhavaḥ  |
ādyo'ṅga yatrāśramiṇāṃ yathāhaṃ jñānado guruḥ  || 10.80.032 ||
nanvarthakovidā brahman varṇāśramavatāmiha  |
ye mayā guruṇā vācā tarantyañjo bhavārṇavam  || 10.80.033 ||
nāhamijyāprajātibhyāṃ tapasopaśamena vā  |
tuṣyeyaṃ sarvabhūtātmā guruśuśrūṣayā yathā  || 10.80.034 ||
api naḥ smaryate brahman vṛttaṃ nivasatāṃ gurau  |
gurudāraiścoditānāmindhanānayane kvacit || 10.80.035 ||
praviṣṭānāṃ mahāraṇyamapartau sumahaddvija  |
vātavarṣamabhūttīvraṃ niṣṭhurāḥ stanayitnavaḥ  || 10.80.036 ||
sūryaścāstaṃ gatastāvattamasā cāvṛtā diśaḥ  |
nimnaṃ kūlaṃ jalamayaṃ na prājñāyata kiñcana  || 10.80.037 ||
vayaṃ bhṛśaṃ tatra mahānilāmbubhirnihanyamānā mahurambusamplave  |
diśo'vidanto'tha parasparaṃ vane gṛhītahastāḥ paribabhrimāturāḥ  || 10.80.038 ||
etadviditvā udite ravau sāndīpanirguruḥ  |
anveṣamāṇo naḥ śiṣyānācāryo'paśyadāturān  || 10.80.039 ||
aho he putrakā yūyamasmadarthe'tiduḥkhitāḥ  |
ātmā vai prāṇināṃ preṣṭhastamanādṛtya matparāḥ  || 10.80.040 ||
etadeva hi sacchiṣyaiḥ kartavyaṃ guruniṣkṛtam  |
yadvai viśuddhabhāvena sarvārthātmārpaṇaṃ gurau  || 10.80.041 ||
tuṣṭo'haṃ bho dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ satyāḥ santu manorathāḥ  |
chandāṃsyayātayāmāni bhavantviha paratra ca  || 10.80.042 ||
itthaṃvidhānyanekāni vasatāṃ guruveśmani  |
guroranugraheṇaiva pumān pūrṇaḥ praśāntaye  || 10.80.043 ||
10.80.044|0 śrībrāhmaṇa uvāca
kimasmābhiranirvṛttaṃ devadeva jagadguro  |
bhavatā satyakāmena yeṣāṃ vāso gurorabhūt || 10.80.044 ||
yasya cchandomayaṃ brahma deha āvapanaṃ vibho  |
śreyasāṃ tasya guruṣu vāso'tyantaviḍambanam  || 10.80.045 ||
10.81.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
sa itthaṃ dvijamukhyena saha saṅkathayan hariḥ  |
sarvabhūtamano'bhijñaḥ smayamāna uvāca tam  || 10.81.001 ||
brahmaṇyo brāhmaṇaṃ kṛṣṇo bhagavān prahasan priyam  |
premṇā nirīkṣaṇenaiva prekṣan khalu satāṃ gatiḥ  || 10.81.002 ||
10.81.003|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
kimupāyanamānītaṃ brahmanme bhavatā gṛhāt |
aṇvapyupāhṛtaṃ bhaktaiḥ premṇā bhuryeva me bhavet |
bhūryapyabhaktopahṛtaṃ na me toṣāya kalpate  || 10.81.003 ||
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati  |
tadahaṃ bhaktyupahṛtamaśnāmi prayatātmanaḥ  || 10.81.004 ||
ityukto'pi dviyastasmai vrīḍitaḥ pataye śriyaḥ  |
pṛthukaprasṛtiṃ rājanna prāyacchadavāṅmukhaḥ  || 10.81.005 ||
sarvabhūtātmadṛksākṣāttasyāgamanakāraṇam  |
vijṅāyācintayannāyaṃ śrīkāmo mābhajatpurā  || 10.81.006 ||
patnyāḥ pativratāyāstu sakhā priyacikīrṣayā  |
prāpto māmasya dāsyāmi sampado'martyadurlabhāḥ  || 10.81.007 ||
itthaṃ vicintya vasanāccīrabaddhān dvijanmanaḥ  |
svayaṃ jahāra kimidamiti pṛthukataṇḍulān  || 10.81.008 ||
nanvetadupanītaṃ me paramaprīṇanaṃ sakhe  |
tarpayantyaṅga māṃ viśvamete pṛthukataṇḍulāḥ  || 10.81.009 ||
iti muṣṭiṃ sakṛjjagdhvā dvitīyāṃ jagdhumādade  |
tāvacchrīrjagṛhe hastaṃ tatparā parameṣṭhinaḥ  || 10.81.010 ||
etāvatālaṃ viśvātman sarvasampatsamṛddhaye  |
asmin loke'tha vāmuṣmin puṃsastvattoṣakāraṇam  || 10.81.011 ||
brāhmaṇastāṃ tu rajanīmuṣitvācyutamandire  |
bhuktvā pītvā sukhaṃ mene ātmānaṃ svargataṃ yathā  || 10.81.012 ||
śvobhūte viśvabhāvena svasukhenābhivanditaḥ  |
jagāma svālayaṃ tāta pathyanavrajya nanditaḥ  || 10.81.013 ||
sa cālabdhvā dhanaṃ kṛṣṇānna tu yācitavān svayam  |
svagṛhān vrīḍito'gacchanmahaddarśananirvṛtaḥ  || 10.81.014 ||
aho brahmaṇyadevasya dṛṣṭā brahmaṇyatā mayā  |
yaddaridratamo lakṣmīmāśliṣṭo bibhratorasi  || 10.81.015 ||
kvāhaṃ daridraḥ pāpīyān kva kṛṣṇaḥ śrīniketanaḥ  |
brahmabandhuriti smāhaṃ bāhubhyāṃ parirambhitaḥ  || 10.81.016 ||
nivāsitaḥ priyājuṣṭe paryaṅke bhrātaro yathā  |
mahiṣyā vījitaḥ śrānto bālavyajanahastayā  || 10.81.017 ||
śuśrūṣayā paramayā pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ  |
pūjito devadevena vipradevena devavat || 10.81.018 ||
svargāpavargayoḥ puṃsāṃ rasāyāṃ bhuvi sampadām  |
sarvāsāmapi siddhīnāṃ mūlaṃ taccaraṇārcanam  || 10.81.019 ||
adhano'yaṃ dhanaṃ prāpya mādyannuccairna māṃ smaret |
iti kāruṇiko nūnaṃ dhanaṃ me'bhūri nādadāt || 10.81.020 ||
iti taccintayannantaḥ prāpto niyagṛhāntikam  |
sūryānalendusaṅkāśairvimānaiḥ sarvato vṛtam  || 10.81.021 ||
vicitropavanodyānaiḥ kūjaddvijakulākulaiḥ  |
protphullakamudāmbhoja kahlārotpalavāribhiḥ  || 10.81.022 ||
juṣṭaṃ svalaṅkṛtaiḥ pumbhiḥ strībhiśca hariṇākṣibhiḥ  |
kimidaṃ kasya vā sthānaṃ kathaṃ tadidamityabhūt || 10.81.023 ||
evaṃ mīmāṃsamānaṃ taṃ narā nāryo'maraprabhāḥ  |
pratyagṛhṇanmahābhāgaṃ gītavādyena bhūyasā  || 10.81.024 ||
patimāgatamākarṇya patnyuddharṣātisambhramā  |
niścakrāma gṛhāttūrṇaṃ rūpiṇī śrīrivālayāt || 10.81.025 ||
pativratā patiṃ dṛṣṭvā premotkaṇṭhāśrulocanā  |
mīlitākṣyanamadbuddhyā manasā pariṣasvaje  || 10.81.026 ||
patnīṃ vīkṣya visphurantīṃ devīṃ vaimānikīmiva  |
dāsīnāṃ niṣkakaṇṭhīnāṃ madhye bhāntīṃ sa vismitaḥ  || 10.81.027 ||
prītaḥ svayaṃ tayā yuktaḥ praviṣṭo nijamandiram  |
maṇistambhaśatopetaṃ mahendrabhavanaṃ yathā  || 10.81.028 ||
payaḥphenanibhāḥ śayyā dāntā rukmaparicchadāḥ  |
paryaṅkā hemadaṇḍāni cāmaravyajanāni ca  || 10.81.029 ||
āsanāni ca haimāni mṛdūpastaraṇāni ca  |
muktādāmavilambīni vitānāni dyumanti ca  || 10.81.030 ||
svacchasphaṭikakuḍyeṣu mahāmārakateṣu ca  |
ratnadīpān bhrājamānān lalanā ratnasaṃyutāḥ  || 10.81.031 ||
vilokya brāhmaṇastatra samṛddhīḥ sarvasampadām  |
tarkayāmāsa nirvyagraḥ svasamṛddhimahaitukīm  || 10.81.032 ||
nūnaṃ bataitanmama durbhagasya śaśvaddaridrasya samṛddhihetuḥ  |
mahāvibhūteravalokato'nyo naivopapadyeta yadūttamasya  || 10.81.033 ||
nanvabruvāṇo diśate samakṣaṃ yāciṣṇave bhūryapi bhūribhojaḥ  |
parjanyavattatsvayamīkṣamāṇo dāśārhakāṇāmṛṣabhaḥ sakhā me  || 10.81.034 ||
kiñcitkarotyurvapi yatsvadattaṃ   suhṛtkṛtaṃ phalgvapi bhūrikārī  |
mayopaṇītaṃ pṛthukaikamuṣṭiṃ   pratyagrahītprītiyuto mahātmā  || 10.81.035 ||*
tasyaiva me sauhṛdasakhyamaitrī dāsyaṃ punarjanmani janmani syāt |
mahānubhāvena guṇālayena viṣajjatastatpuruṣaprasaṅgaḥ  || 10.81.036 ||
bhaktāya citrā bhagavān hi sampado rājyaṃ vibhūtīrna samarthayatyajaḥ  |
adīrghabodhāya vicakṣaṇaḥ svayaṃ paśyannipātaṃ dhanināṃ madodbhavam  || 10.81.037 ||
itthaṃ vyavasito buddhyā bhakto'tīva janārdane  |
viṣayān jāyayā tyakṣyan bubhuje nātilampaṭaḥ  || 10.81.038 ||
tasya vai devadevasya hareryajñapateḥ prabhoḥ  |
brāhmaṇāḥ prabhavo daivaṃ na tebhyo vidyate param  || 10.81.039 ||
evaṃ sa vipro bhagavatsuhṛttadā dṛṣṭvā svabhṛtyairajitaṃ parājitam  |
taddhyānavegodgrathitātmabandhanastaddhāma lebhe'cirataḥ satāṃ gatim  || 10.81.040 ||
etadbrahmaṇyadevasya śrutvā brahmaṇyatāṃ naraḥ  |
labdhabhāvo bhagavati karmabandhādvimucyate  || 10.81.041 ||
10.82.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
athaikadā dvāravatyāṃ vasato rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ  |
sūryoparāgaḥ sumahānāsītkalpakṣaye yathā  || 10.82.001 ||
taṃ jñātvā manujā rājan purastādeva sarvataḥ  |
samantapañcakaṃ kṣetraṃ yayuḥ śreyovidhitsayā  || 10.82.002 ||
niḥkṣatriyāṃ mahīṃ kurvan rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ  |
nṛpāṇāṃ rudhiraugheṇa yatra cakre mahāhradān  || 10.82.003 ||
īje ca bhagavān rāmo yatrāspṛṣṭo'pi karmaṇā  |
lokaṃ saṅgrāhayannīśo yathānyo'ghāpanuttaye  || 10.82.004 ||
mahatyāṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ tatrāgan bhāratīḥ prajāḥ  |
vṛṣṇayaśca tathākrūra vasudevāhukādayaḥ  || 10.82.005 ||
yayurbhārata tatkṣetraṃ svamaghaṃ kṣapayiṣṇavaḥ  |
gadapradyumnasāmbādyāḥ sucandraśukasāraṇaiḥ  |
āste'niruddho rakṣāyāṃ kṛtavarmā ca yūthapaḥ  || 10.82.006 ||
te rathairdevadhiṣṇyābhairhayaiśca taralaplavaiḥ  |
gajairnadadbhirabhrābhairnṛbhirvidyādharadyubhiḥ  || 10.82.007 ||
vyarocanta mahātejāḥ pathi kāñcanamālinaḥ  |
divyasragvastrasannāhāḥ kalatraiḥ khecarā iva  || 10.82.008 ||
tatra snātvā mahābhāgā upoṣya susamāhitāḥ  |
brāhmaṇebhyo dadurdhenūrvāsaḥsragrukmamālinīḥ  || 10.82.009 ||
rāmahradeṣu vidhivatpunarāplutya vṛṣṇayaḥ  |
dadaḥ svannaṃ dvijāgryebhyaḥ kṛṣṇe no bhaktirastviti  || 10.82.010 ||
svayaṃ ca tadanujñātā vṛṣṇayaḥ kṛṣṇadevatāḥ  |
bhuktvopaviviśuḥ kāmaṃ snigdhacchāyāṅghripāṅghriṣu  || 10.82.011 ||
tatrāgatāṃste dadṛśuḥ suhṛtsambandhino nṛpān  |
matsyośīnarakauśalya vidarbhakurusṛñjayān  || 10.82.012 ||
kāmbojakaikayānmadrān kuntīnānartakeralān  |
anyāṃścaivātmapakṣīyān parāṃśca śataśo nṛpa  |
nandādīn suhṛdo gopān gopīścotkaṇṭhitāściram  || 10.82.013 ||
anyonyasandarśanaharṣaraṃhasā protphullahṛdvaktrasaroruhaśriyaḥ  |
āśliṣya gāḍhaṃ nayanaiḥ sravajjalā hṛṣyattvaco ruddhagiro yayurmudam  || 10.82.014 ||
striyaśca saṃvīkṣya mitho'tisauhṛda   smitāmalāpāṅgadṛśo'bhirebhire  |
stanaiḥ stanān kuṅkumapaṅkarūṣitān   nihatya dorbhiḥ praṇayāśrulocanāḥ  || 10.82.015 ||*
tato'bhivādya te vṛddhān yaviṣṭhairabhivāditāḥ  |
svāgataṃ kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭvā cakruḥ kṛṣṇakathā mithaḥ  || 10.82.016 ||
pṛthā bhrātṝn svasṝrvīkṣya tatputrān pitarāvapi  |
bhrātṛpatnīrmukundaṃ ca jahau saṅkathayā śucaḥ  || 10.82.017 ||
10.82.018|0 kuntyuvāca
ārya bhrātarahaṃ manye ātmānamakṛtāśiṣam  |
yadvā āpatsu madvārtāṃ nānusmaratha sattamāḥ  || 10.82.018 ||
suhṛdo jñātayaḥ putrā bhrātaraḥ pitarāvapi  |

10.82.020|0 śrīvasudeva uvāca
amba māsmānasūyethā daivakrīḍanakānnarān  |

kaṃsapratāpitāḥ sarve vayaṃ yātā diśaṃ diśam  |

10.82.022|0 śrīśuka uvāca
vasudevograsenādyairyadubhiste'rcitā nṛpāḥ  |
āsannacyutasandarśa paramānandanirvṛtāḥ  || 10.82.022 ||
bhīṣmo droṇo'mbikāputro gāndhārī sasutā tathā  |
sadārāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kuntī sañjayo viduraḥ kṛpaḥ  || 10.82.023 ||
kuntībhojo virāṭaśca bhīṣmako nagnajinmahān  |
purujiddrupadaḥ śalyo dhṛṣṭaketuḥ sa kāśirāṭ || 10.82.024 ||
damaghoṣo viśālākṣo maithilo madrakekayau  |
yudhāmanyuḥ suśarmā ca sasutā bāhlikādayaḥ  || 10.82.025 ||
rājāno ye ca rājendra yudhiṣṭhiramanuvratāḥ  |
śrīniketaṃ vapuḥ śaureḥ sastrīkaṃ vīkṣya vismitāḥ  || 10.82.026 ||

aho bhojapate yūyaṃ janmabhājo nṛṇāmiha  |
yatpaśyathāsakṛtkṛṣṇaṃ durdarśamapi yoginām  || 10.82.028 ||
yadviśrutiḥ śrutinutedamalaṃ punāti   pādāvanejanapayaśca vacaśca śāstram  |
bhūḥ kālabharjitabhagāpi yadaṅghripadma   sparśotthaśaktirabhivarṣati no'khilārthān  || 10.82.029 ||*

yeṣāṃ gṛhe nirayavartmani vartatāṃ vaḥ   svargāpavargaviramaḥ svayamāsa viṣṇuḥ  || 10.82.030 ||*
10.82.031|0 śrīśuka uvāca
nandastatra yadūn prāptān jñātvā kṛṣṇapurogamān  |
tatrāgamadvṛto gopairanaḥsthārthairdidṛkṣayā  || 10.82.031 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛṣṇayo hṛṣṭāstanvaḥ prāṇamivotthitāḥ  |
pariṣasvajire gāḍhaṃ ciradarśanakātarāḥ  || 10.82.032 ||
vasudevaḥ pariṣvajya samprītaḥ premavihvalaḥ  |
smaran kaṃsakṛtān kleśān putranyāsaṃ ca gokule  || 10.82.033 ||
kṛṣṇarāmau pariṣvajya pitarāvabhivādya ca  |
na kiñcanocatuḥ premṇā sāśrukaṇṭhau kurūdvaha  || 10.82.034 ||
tāvātmāsanamāropya bāhubhyāṃ parirabhya ca  |
yaśodā ca mahābhāgā sutau vijahatuḥ śucaḥ  || 10.82.035 ||
rohiṇī devakī cātha pariṣvajya vrajeśvarīm  |
smarantyau tatkṛtāṃ maitrīṃ bāṣpakaṇṭhyau samūcatuḥ  || 10.82.036 ||
kā vismareta vāṃ maitrīmanivṛttāṃ vrajeśvari  |
avāpyāpyaindramaiśvaryaṃ yasyā neha pratikriyā  || 10.82.037 ||
etāvadṛṣṭapitarau yuvayoḥ sma pitroḥ   samprīṇanābhyudayapoṣaṇapālanāni  |
prāpyoṣaturbhavati pakṣma ha yadvadakṣṇor  nyastāvakutra ca bhayau na satāṃ paraḥ svaḥ  || 10.82.038 ||*
10.82.039|0 śrīśuka uvāca
gopyaśca kṛṣṇamupalabhya cirādabhīṣṭaṃ   yatprekṣaṇe dṛśiṣu pakṣmakṛtaṃ śapanti  |
dṛgbhirhṛdīkṛtamalaṃ parirabhya sarvās  tadbhāvamāpurapi nityayujāṃ durāpam  || 10.82.039 ||*
bhagavāṃstāstathābhūtā vivikta upasaṅgataḥ  |
āśliṣyānāmayaṃ pṛṣṭvā prahasannidamabravīt || 10.82.040 ||
api smaratha naḥ sakhyaḥ svānāmarthacikīrṣayā  |
gatāṃścirāyitāñchatru pakṣakṣapaṇacetasaḥ  || 10.82.041 ||
apyavadhyāyathāsmān svidakṛtajñāviśaṅkayā  |
nūnaṃ bhūtāni bhagavān yunakti viyunakti ca  || 10.82.042 ||
vāyuryathā ghanānīkaṃ tṛṇaṃ tūlaṃ rajāṃsi ca  |

10.87.014|0 śrīśrutaya ūcuḥ
jaya jaya jahyajāmajita doṣagṛbhītaguṇāṃ   tvamasi yadātmanā samavaruddhasamastabhagaḥ  |

ka iha nu veda batāvarajanmalayo'grasaraṃ   yata udagādṛṣiryamanu devagaṇā ubhaye  |

kiṃ vā naścalasauhṛdaḥ smarati taṃ kasmādbhajāmo vayaṃ   kṣaudrālāpaya kāmadaṃ śriyamṛte saivaikaniṣṭhā striyām  || 10.90.024 ||*
10.90.025|0 śrīśuka uvāca
itīdṛśena bhāvena kṛṣṇe yogeśvareśvare  |
kriyamāṇena mādhavyo lebhire paramāṃ gatim  || 10.90.025 ||
śrutamātro'pi yaḥ strīṇāṃ prasahyākarṣate manaḥ  |
urugāyorugīto vā paśyantīnāṃ ca kiṃ punaḥ  || 10.90.026 ||
yāḥ samparyacaran premṇā pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ  |
jagadguruṃ bhartṛbuddhyā tāsāṃ kiṃ varṇyate tapaḥ  || 10.90.027 ||
evaṃ vedoditaṃ dharmamanutiṣṭhan satāṃ gatiḥ  |
gṛhaṃ dharmārthakāmānāṃ muhuścādarśayatpadam  || 10.90.028 ||
āsthitasya paraṃ dharmaṃ kṛṣṇasya gṛhamedhinām  |
āsan ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ mahiṣyaśca śatādhikam  || 10.90.029 ||
tāsāṃ strīratnabhūtānāmaṣṭau yāḥ prāgudāhṛtāḥ  |
rukmiṇīpramukhā rājaṃstatputrāścānupūrvaśaḥ  || 10.90.030 ||
ekaikasyāṃ daśa daśa kṛṣṇo'jījanadātmajān  |
yāvatya ātmano bhāryā amoghagatirīśvaraḥ  || 10.90.031 ||
teṣāmuddāmavīryāṇāmaṣṭādaśa mahārathāḥ  |
āsannudārayaśasasteṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu  || 10.90.032 ||
pradyumnaścāniruddhaśca dīptimān bhānureva ca  |
sāmbo madhurbṛhadbhānuścitrabhānurvṛko'ruṇaḥ  || 10.90.033 ||
puṣkaro vedabāhuśca śrutadevaḥ sunandanaḥ  |
citrabāhurvirūpaśca kavirnyagrodha eva ca  || 10.90.034 ||
eteṣāmapi rājendra tanujānāṃ madhudviṣaḥ  |
pradyumna āsītprathamaḥ pitṛvadrukmiṇīsutaḥ  || 10.90.035 ||
sa rukmiṇo duhitaramupayeme mahārathaḥ  |
tasyāṃ tato'niruddho'bhūtnāgāyatabalānvitaḥ  || 10.90.036 ||
sa cāpi rukmiṇaḥ pautrīṃ dauhitro jagṛhe tataḥ  |
vajrastasyābhavadyastu mauṣalādavaśeṣitaḥ  || 10.90.037 ||
pratibāhurabhūttasmātsubāhustasya cātmajaḥ  |
subāhoḥ śāntaseno'bhūcchatasenastu tatsutaḥ  || 10.90.038 ||
na hyetasmin kule jātā adhanā abahuprajāḥ  |
alpāyuṣo'lpavīryāśca abrahmaṇyāśca jajñire  || 10.90.039 ||
yaduvaṃśaprasūtānāṃ puṃsāṃ vikhyātakarmaṇām  |
saṅkhyā na śakyate kartumapi varṣāyutairnṛpa  || 10.90.040 ||
tisraḥ koṭyaḥ sahasrāṇāmaṣṭāśītiśatāni ca  |
āsan yadukulācāryāḥ kumārāṇāmiti śrutam  || 10.90.041 ||
saṅkhyānaṃ yādavānāṃ kaḥ kariṣyati mahātmanām  |
yatrāyutānāmayuta lakṣeṇāste sa āhukaḥ  || 10.90.042 ||
devāsurāhavahatā daiteyā ye sudāruṇāḥ  |
te cotpannā manuṣyeṣu prajā dṛptā babādhire  || 10.90.043 ||
tannigrahāya hariṇā proktā devā yadoḥ kule  |
avatīrṇāḥ kulaśataṃ teṣāmekādhikaṃ nṛpa  || 10.90.044 ||
teṣāṃ pramāṇaṃ bhagavān prabhutvenābhavaddhariḥ  |
ye cānuvartinastasya vavṛdhuḥ sarvayādavāḥ  || 10.90.045 ||
śayyāsanāṭanālāpa krīḍāsnānādikarmasu  |
na viduḥ santamātmānaṃ vṛṣṇayaḥ kṛṣṇacetasaḥ  || 10.90.046 ||
tīrthaṃ cakre nṛponaṃ yadajani yaduṣu svaḥsaritpādaśaucaṃ   vidviṭsnigdhāḥ svarūpaṃ yayurajitapara śrīryadarthe'nyayatnaḥ  |
yannāmāmaṅgalaghnaṃ śrutamatha gaditaṃ yatkṛto gotradharmaḥ   kṛṣṇasyaitanna citraṃ kṣitibharaharaṇaṃ kālacakrāyudhasya  || 10.90.047 ||*
jayati jananivāso devakījanmavādo   yaduvarapariṣatsvairdorbhirasyannadharmam  |
sthiracaravṛjinaghnaḥ susmitaśrīmukhena   vrajapuravanitānāṃ vardhayan kāmadevam  || 10.90.048 ||*
itthaṃ parasya nijavartmarirakṣayātta   līlātanostadanurūpaviḍambanāni  |
karmāṇi karmakaṣaṇāni yadūttamasya   śrūyādamuṣya padayoranuvṛttimicchan  || 10.90.049 ||*
martyastayānusavamedhitayā mukunda   śrīmatkathāśravaṇakīrtanacintayaiti  |
taddhāma dustarakṛtāntajavāpavargaṃ   grāmādvanaṃ kṣitibhujo'pi yayuryadarthāḥ  || 10.90.050 ||*

11.01.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
kṛtvā daityavadhaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sarāmo yadubhirvṛtaḥ  |
bhuvo'vatārayadbhāraṃ javiṣṭhaṃ janayan kalim  || 11.01.001 ||
ye kopitāḥ subahu pāṇḍusutāḥ sapatnair  durdyūtahelanakacagrahaṇādibhistān  |
kṛtvā nimittamitaretarataḥ sametān   hatvā nṛpānniraharatkṣitibhāramīśaḥ  || 11.01.002 ||*
bhūbhārarājapṛtanā yadubhirnirasya   guptaiḥ svabāhubhiracintayadaprameyaḥ  |
manye'vanernanu gato'pyagataṃ hi bhāraṃ   yadyādavaṃ kulamaho aviṣahyamāste  || 11.01.003 ||*

evaṃ vyavasito rājan satyasaṅkalpa īśvaraḥ  |
śāpavyājena viprāṇāṃ sañjahre svakulaṃ vibhuḥ  || 11.01.005 ||
svamūrtyā lokalāvaṇya nirmuktyā locanaṃ nṛṇām  |

ācchidya kīrtiṃ suślokāṃ vitatya hyañjasā nu kau  |

11.01.008|0 śrīrājovāca
brahmaṇyānāṃ vadānyānāṃ nityaṃ vṛddhopasevinām  |
vipraśāpaḥ kathamabhūdvṛṣṇīnāṃ kṛṣṇacetasām  || 11.01.008 ||
yannimittaḥ sa vai śāpo yādṛśo dvijasattama  |
kathamekātmanāṃ bheda etatsarvaṃ vadasva me  || 11.01.009 ||
11.01.010|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
bibhradvapuḥ sakalasundarasanniveśaṃ   karmācaran bhuvi sumaṅgalamāptakāmaḥ  |
āsthāya dhāma ramamāṇa udārakīṛtiḥ   saṃhartumaicchata kulaṃ sthitakṛtyaśeṣaḥ  || 11.01.010 ||*
karmāni puṇyanivahāni sumaṅgalāni   gāyajjagatkalimalāpaharāṇi kṛtvā  |
kālātmanā nivasatā yadudevagehe   piṇḍārakaṃ samagamanmunayo nisṛṣṭāḥ  || 11.01.011 ||*
viśvāmitro'sitaḥ kaṇvo   durvāsā bhṛguraṅgirāḥ  |
kaśyapo vāmadevo'trir  vasiṣṭho nāradādayaḥ  || 11.01.012 ||*
krīḍantastānupavrajya kumārā yadunandanāḥ  |
upasaṅgṛhya papracchuravinītā vinītavat || 11.01.013 ||
te veṣayitvā strīveṣaiḥ sāmbaṃ jāmbavatīsutam  |
eṣā pṛcchati vo viprā antarvatnyasitekṣaṇā  || 11.01.014 ||
praṣṭuṃ vilajjatī sākṣātprabrūtāmoghadarśanāḥ  |
prasoṣyantī putrakāmā kiṃ svitsañjanayiṣyati  || 11.01.015 ||
evaṃ pralabdhā munayastānūcuḥ kupitā nṛpa  |
janayiṣyati vo mandā muṣalaṃ kulanāśanam  || 11.01.016 ||
tacchrutvā te'tisantrastā vimucya sahasodaram  |
sāmbasya dadṛśustasminmuṣalaṃ khalvayasmayam  || 11.01.017 ||
kiṃ kṛtaṃ mandabhāgyairnaḥ kiṃ vadiṣyanti no janāḥ  |
iti vihvalitā gehānādāya muṣalaṃ yayuḥ  || 11.01.018 ||
taccopanīya sadasi parimlānamukhaśriyaḥ  |
rājña āvedayāṃ cakruḥ sarvayādavasannidhau  || 11.01.019 ||
śrutvāmoghaṃ vipraśāpaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca muṣalaṃ nṛpa  |
vismitā bhayasantrastā babhūvurdvārakaukasaḥ  || 11.01.020 ||
taccūrṇayitvā muṣalaṃ yadurājaḥ sa āhukaḥ  |
samudrasalile prāsyallohaṃ cāsyāvaśeṣitam  || 11.01.021 ||
kaścinmatsyo'grasīllohaṃ cūrṇāni taralaistataḥ  |
uhyamānāni velāyāṃ lagnānyāsan kilairakāḥ  || 11.01.022 ||
matsyo gṛhīto matsyaghnairjālenānyaiḥ sahārṇave  |
tasyodaragataṃ lohaṃ sa śalye lubdhako'karot || 11.01.023 ||
bhagavān jñātasarvārtha īśvaro'pi tadanyathā  |
kartuṃ naicchadvipraśāpaṃ kālarūpyanvamodata  || 11.01.024 ||
11.02.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
govindabhujaguptāyāṃ dvāravatyāṃ kurūdvaha  |

11.02.004|0 śrīvasudeva uvāca
bhagavan bhavato yātrā svastaye sarvadehinām  |
kṛpaṇānāṃ yathā pitroruttamaślokavartmanām  || 11.02.004 ||
bhūtānāṃ devacaritaṃ duḥkhāya ca sukhāya ca  |

bhajanti ye yathā devān devā api tathaiva tān  |

ahaṃ kila purānantaṃ prajārtho bhuvi muktidam  |
apūjayaṃ na mokṣāya mohito devamāyayā  || 11.02.008 ||
yathā vicitravyasanādbhavadbhirviśvatobhayāt |

11.02.010|0 śrīśuka uvāca
rājannevaṃ kṛtapraśno vasudevena dhīmatā  |

11.02.011|0 śrīnārada uvāca
samyagetadvyavasitaṃ bhavatā sātvatarṣabha  |

śruto'nupaṭhito dhyāta ādṛto vānumoditaḥ  |
sadyaḥ punāti saddharmo devaviśvadruho'pi hi  || 11.02.012 ||
tvayā paramakalyāṇaḥ puṇyaśravaṇakīrtanaḥ  |
smārito bhagavānadya devo nārāyaṇo mama  || 11.02.013 ||
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam  |
ārṣabhāṇāṃ ca saṃvādaṃ videhasya mahātmanaḥ  || 11.02.014 ||
priyavrato nāma suto manoḥ svāyambhuvasya yaḥ  |

sa bhuktabhogāṃ tyaktvemāṃ nirgatastapasā harim  |
upāsīnastatpadavīṃ lebhe vai janṛnabhistribhiḥ  || 11.02.018 ||
teṣāṃ nava navadvīpa patayo'sya samantataḥ  |
karmatantrapraṇetāra ekāśītirdvijātayaḥ  || 11.02.019 ||
navābhavanmahābhāgā munayo hyarthaśaṃsinaḥ  |
śramaṇā vātarasanā ātmavidyāviśāradāḥ  || 11.02.020 ||
kavirhavirantarīkṣaḥ prabuddhaḥ pippalāyanaḥ  |
āvirhotro'tha drumilaścamasaḥ karabhājanaḥ  || 11.02.021 ||
ta ete bhagavadrūpaṃ viśvaṃ sadasadātmakam  |
ātmano'vyatirekeṇa paśyanto vyacaranmahīm  || 11.02.022 ||
avyāhateṣṭagatayaḥ surasiddhasādhya   gandharvayakṣanarakinnaranāgalokān  |

ta ekadā nimeḥ satramupajagmuryadṛcchayā  |
vitāyamānamṛṣibhirajanābhe mahātmanaḥ  || 11.02.024 ||
tān dṛṣṭvā sūryasaṅkāśānmahābhāgavatānnṛpa  |

videhastānabhipretya nārāyaṇaparāyaṇān  |
prītaḥ sampūjayāṃ cakre āsanasthān yathārhataḥ  || 11.02.026 ||
tān rocamānān svarucā brahmaputropamānnava  |

11.02.028|0 śrīvideha uvāca
manye bhagavataḥ sākṣātpārṣadān vo madhudvisaḥ  |

durlabho mānuṣo deho dehināṃ kṣaṇabhaṅguraḥ  |

ata ātyantikaṃ kṣemaṃ pṛcchāmo bhavato'naghāḥ  |

11.02.033|0 śrīkaviruvāca
manye'kutaścidbhayamacyutasya pādāmbujopāsanamatra nityam  |

bhayaṃ dvitīyābhiniveśataḥ syādīśādapetasya viparyayo'smṛtiḥ  |

evaṃvrataḥ svapriyanāmakīrtyā jātānurāgo drutacitta uccaiḥ  |

khaṃ vāyumagniṃ salilaṃ mahīṃ ca jyotīṃṣi sattvāni diśo drumādīn  |

bhaktiḥ pareśānubhavo viraktiranyatra caiṣa trika ekakālaḥ  |

ityacyutāṅghriṃ bhajato'nuvṛttyā bhaktirviraktirbhagavatprabodhaḥ  |

11.02.044|0 śrīrājovāca

11.02.045|0 śrīhaviruvāca
sarvabhūteṣu yaḥ paśyedbhagavadbhāvamātmanaḥ  |
bhūtāni bhagavatyātmanyeṣa bhāgavatottamaḥ  || 11.02.045 ||
īsvare tadadhīneṣu bāliśeṣu dviṣatsu ca  |
premamaitrīkṛpopekṣā yaḥ karoti sa madhyamaḥ  || 11.02.046 ||

tribhuvanavibhavahetave'pyakuṇṭha   smṛtirajitātmasurādibhirvimṛgyāt |

bhagavata uruvikramāṅghriśākhā nakhamaṇicandrikayā nirastatāpe  |
hṛdi kathamupasīdatāṃ punaḥ sa prabhavati candra ivodite'rkatāpaḥ  || 11.02.054 ||
visṛjati hṛdayaṃ na yasya sākṣāddhariravaśābhihito'pyaghaughanāśaḥ  |

11.07.031|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
yadunaivaṃ mahābhāgo brahmaṇyena sumedhasā  |
pṛṣṭaḥ sabhājitaḥ prāha praśrayāvanataṃ dvijaḥ  || 11.07.031 ||
11.07.032|0 śrībrāhmaṇa uvāca
santi me guravo rājan bahavo buddhyupaśritāḥ  |
yato buddhimupādāya mukto'ṭāmīha tān śṛṇu  || 11.07.032 ||
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo'gniścandramā raviḥ  |
kapoto'jagaraḥ sindhuḥ pataṅgo madhukṛdgajaḥ  || 11.07.033 ||
madhuhā hariṇo mīnaḥ piṅgalā kuraro'rbhakaḥ  |
kumārī śarakṛtsarpa ūrṇanābhiḥ supeśakṛt || 11.07.034 ||
ete me guravo rājan caturviṃśatirāśritāḥ  |
śikṣā vṛttibhireteṣāmanvaśikṣamihātmanaḥ  || 11.07.035 ||
yato yadanuśikṣāmi yathā vā nāhuṣātmaja  |
tattathā puruṣavyāghra nibodha kathayāmi te  || 11.07.036 ||
bhūtairākramyamāṇo'pi dhīro daivavaśānugaiḥ  |
tadvidvānna calenmārgādanvaśikṣaṃ kṣitervratam  || 11.07.037 ||
śaśvatparārthasarvehaḥ parārthaikāntasambhavaḥ  |
sādhuḥ śikṣeta bhūbhṛtto nagaśiṣyaḥ parātmatām  || 11.07.038 ||
prāṇavṛttyaiva santuṣyenmunirnaivendriyapriyaiḥ  |
jñānaṃ yathā na naśyeta nāvakīryeta vāṅmanaḥ  || 11.07.039 ||
viṣayeṣvāviśan yogī nānādharmeṣu sarvataḥ  |
guṇadoṣavyapetātmā na viṣajjeta vāyuvat || 11.07.040 ||
pārthiveṣviha deheṣu praviṣṭastadguṇāśrayaḥ  |
guṇairna yujyate yogī gandhairvāyurivātmadṛk || 11.07.041 ||
antarhitaśca sthirajaṅgameṣu brahmātmabhāvena samanvayena  |
vyāptyāvyavacchedamasaṅgamātmano munirnabhastvaṃ vitatasya bhāvayet || 11.07.042 ||
tejo'bannamayairbhāvairmeghādyairvāyuneritaiḥ  |
na spṛśyate nabhastadvatkālasṛṣṭairguṇaiḥ pumān  || 11.07.043 ||
svacchaḥ prakṛtitaḥ snigdho mādhuryastīrthabhūrnṛṇām  |
muniḥ punātyapāṃ mitramīkṣopasparśakīrtanaiḥ  || 11.07.044 ||
tejasvī tapasā dīpto durdharṣodarabhājanaḥ  |
sarvabhakṣyo'pi yuktātmā nādatte malamagnivat || 11.07.045 ||
kvacicchannaḥ kvacitspaṣṭa upāsyaḥ śreya icchatām  |
bhuṅkte sarvatra dātṛṇāṃ dahan prāguttarāśubham  || 11.07.046 ||
svamāyayā sṛṣṭamidaṃ sadasallakṣaṇaṃ vibhuḥ  |
praviṣṭa īyate tattatsvarūpo'gnirivaidhasi  || 11.07.047 ||
visargādyāḥ śmaśānāntā bhāvā dehasya nātmanaḥ  |
kalānāmiva candrasya kālenāvyaktavartmanā  || 11.07.048 ||
kālena hyoghavegena bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayau  |
nityāvapi na dṛśyete ātmano'gneryathārciṣām  || 11.07.049 ||
guṇairguṇānupādatte yathākālaṃ vimuñcati  |
na teṣu yujyate yogī gobhirgā iva gopatiḥ  || 11.07.050 ||
budhyate sve na bhedena vyaktistha iva tadgataḥ  |
lakṣyate sthūlamatibhirātmā cāvasthito'rkavat || 11.07.051 ||
nātisnehaḥ prasaṅgo vā kartavyaḥ kvāpi kenacit |
kurvan vindeta santāpaṃ kapota iva dīnadhīḥ  || 11.07.052 ||
kapotaḥ kaścanāraṇye kṛtanīḍo vanaspatau  |
kapotyā bhāryayā sārdhamuvāsa katicitsamāḥ  || 11.07.053 ||
kapotau snehaguṇita hṛdayau gṛhadharmiṇau  |
dṛṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭyāṅgamaṅgena buddhiṃ buddhyā babandhatuḥ  || 11.07.054 ||
śayyāsanāṭanasthāna vārtākrīḍāśanādikam  |
mithunībhūya viśrabdhau ceraturvanarājiṣu  || 11.07.055 ||
yaṃ yaṃ vāñchati sā rājan tarpayantyanukampitā  |
taṃ taṃ samanayatkāmaṃ kṛcchreṇāpyajitendriyaḥ  || 11.07.056 ||
kapotī prathamaṃ garbhaṃ gṛhṇantī kāla āgate  |
aṇḍāni suṣuve nīḍe stapatyuḥ sannidhau satī  || 11.07.057 ||
teṣu kāle vyajāyanta racitāvayavā hareḥ  |
śaktibhirdurvibhāvyābhiḥ komalāṅgatanūruhāḥ  || 11.07.058 ||
prajāḥ pupuṣatuḥ prītau dampatī putravatsalau  |
śṛṇvantau kūjitaṃ tāsāṃ nirvṛtau kalabhāṣitaiḥ  || 11.07.059 ||
tāsāṃ patatraiḥ susparśaiḥ kūjitairmugdhaceṣṭitaiḥ  |
pratyudgamairadīnānāṃ pitarau mudamāpatuḥ  || 11.07.060 ||
snehānubaddhahṛdayāvanyonyaṃ viṣṇumāyayā  |
vimohitau dīnadhiyau śiśūn pupuṣatuḥ prajāḥ  || 11.07.061 ||
ekadā jagmatustāsāmannārthaṃ tau kuṭumbinau  |
paritaḥ kānane tasminnarthinau ceratuściram  || 11.07.062 ||
dṛṣṭvā tān lubdhakaḥ kaścidyadṛcchāto vanecaraḥ  |
jagṛhe jālamātatya carataḥ svālayāntike  || 11.07.063 ||
kapotaśca kapotī ca prajāpoṣe sadotsukau  |
gatau poṣaṇamādāya svanīḍamupajagmatuḥ  || 11.07.064 ||
kapotī svātmajān vīkṣya bālakān jālasamvṛtān  |
tānabhyadhāvatkrośantī krośato bhṛśaduḥkhitā  || 11.07.065 ||
sāsakṛtsnehaguṇitā dīnacittājamāyayā  |
svayaṃ cābadhyata śicā baddhān paśyantyapasmṛtiḥ  || 11.07.066 ||
kapotaḥ svātmajān baddhānātmano'pyadhikān priyān  |
bhāryāṃ cātmasamāṃ dīno vilalāpātiduḥkhitaḥ  || 11.07.067 ||
aho me paśyatāpāyamalpapuṇyasya durmateḥ  |
atṛptasyākṛtārthasya gṛhastraivargiko hataḥ  || 11.07.068 ||
anurūpānukūlā ca yasya me patidevatā  |
śūnye gṛhe māṃ santyajya putraiḥ svaryāti sādhubhiḥ  || 11.07.069 ||
so'haṃ śūnye gṛhe dīno mṛtadāro mṛtaprajaḥ  |
jijīviṣe kimarthaṃ vā vidhuro duḥkhajīvitaḥ  || 11.07.070 ||
tāṃstathaivāvṛtān śigbhirmṛtyugrastān viceṣṭataḥ  |
svayaṃ ca kṛpaṇaḥ śikṣu paśyannapyabudho'patat || 11.07.071 ||
taṃ labdhvā lubdhakaḥ krūraḥ kapotaṃ gṛhamedhinam  |
kapotakān kapotīṃ ca siddhārthaḥ prayayau gṛham  || 11.07.072 ||
evaṃ kuṭumbyaśāntātmā dvandvārāmaḥ patatrivat |
puṣṇan kuṭumbaṃ kṛpaṇaḥ sānubandho'vasīdati  || 11.07.073 ||
yaḥ prāpya mānuṣaṃ lokaṃ muktidvāramapāvṛtam  |
gṛheṣu khagavatsaktastamārūḍhacyutaṃ viduḥ  || 11.07.074 ||
11.08.001|0 śrībrāhmaṇa uvāca
sukhamaindriyakaṃ rājan svarge naraka eva ca  |
dehināṃ yadyathā duḥkhaṃ tasmānneccheta tadbudhaḥ  || 11.08.001 ||
grāsaṃ sumṛṣṭaṃ virasaṃ mahāntaṃ stokameva vā  |
yadṛcchayaivāpatitaṃ grasedājagaro'kriyaḥ  || 11.08.002 ||
śayītāhāni bhūrīṇi nirāhāro'nupakramaḥ  |
yadi nopanayedgrāso mahāhiriva diṣṭabhuk || 11.08.003 ||
ojaḥsahobalayutaṃ bibhraddehamakarmakam  |
śayāno vītanidraśca nehetendriyavānapi  || 11.08.004 ||
muniḥ prasannagambhīro durvigāhyo duratyayaḥ  |
anantapāro hyakṣobhyaḥ stimitoda ivārṇavaḥ  || 11.08.005 ||
samṛddhakāmo hīno vā nārāyaṇaparo muniḥ  |
notsarpeta na śuṣyeta saridbhiriva sāgaraḥ  || 11.08.006 ||
dṛṣṭvā striyaṃ devamāyāṃ tadbhāvairajitendriyaḥ  |
pralobhitaḥ patatyandhe tamasyagnau pataṅgavat || 11.08.007 ||
yoṣiddhiraṇyābharaṇāmbarādi dravyeṣu māyāraciteṣu mūḍhaḥ  |
pralobhitātmā hyupabhogabuddhyā pataṅgavannaśyati naṣṭadṛṣṭiḥ  || 11.08.008 ||
stokaṃ stokaṃ grasedgrāsaṃ deho varteta yāvatā  |
gṛhānahiṃsannātiṣṭhedvṛttiṃ mādhukarīṃ muniḥ  || 11.08.009 ||
aṇubhyaśca mahadbhyaśca śāstrebhyaḥ kuśalo naraḥ  |
sarvataḥ sāramādadyātpuṣpebhya iva ṣaṭpadaḥ  || 11.08.010 ||
sāyantanaṃ śvastanaṃ vā na saṅgṛhṇīta bhikṣitam  |
pāṇipātrodarāmatro makṣikeva na saṅgrahī  || 11.08.011 ||
sāyantanaṃ śvastanaṃ vā na saṅgṛhṇīta bhikṣukaḥ  |
makṣikā iva saṅgṛhṇan saha tena vinaśyati  || 11.08.012 ||
padāpi yuvatīṃ bhikṣurna spṛśeddāravīmapi  |
spṛśan karīva badhyeta kariṇyā aṅgasaṅgataḥ  || 11.08.013 ||
nādhigacchetstriyaṃ prājñaḥ karhicinmṛtyumātmanaḥ  |
balādhikaiḥ sa hanyeta gajairanyairgajo yathā  || 11.08.014 ||
na deyaṃ nopabhogyaṃ ca lubdhairyadduḥkhasañcitam  |
bhuṅkte tadapi taccānyo madhuhevārthavinmadhu  || 11.08.015 ||
suduḥkhopārjitairvittairāśāsānāṃ gṛhāśiṣaḥ  |
madhuhevāgrato bhuṅkte yatirvai gṛhamedhinām  || 11.08.016 ||
grāmyagītaṃ na śṛṇuyādyatirvanacaraḥ kvacit |
śikṣeta hariṇādbaddhānmṛgayorgītamohitāt || 11.08.017 ||
nṛtyavāditragītāni juṣan grāmyāṇi yoṣitām  |
āsāṃ krīḍanako vaśya ṛṣyaśṛṅgo mṛgīsutaḥ  || 11.08.018 ||
jihvayātipramāthinyā jano rasavimohitaḥ  |
mṛtyumṛcchatyasadbuddhirmīnastu baḍiśairyathā  || 11.08.019 ||
indriyāṇi jayantyāśu nirāhārā manīṣiṇaḥ  |
varjayitvā tu rasanaṃ tannirannasya vardhate  || 11.08.020 ||
tāvajjitendriyo na syādvijitānyendriyaḥ pumān  |
na jayedrasanaṃ yāvajjitaṃ sarvaṃ jite rase  || 11.08.021 ||
piṅgalā nāma veśyāsīdvidehanagare purā  |
tasyā me śikṣitaṃ kiñcinnibodha nṛpanandana  || 11.08.022 ||
sā svairiṇyekadā kāntaṃ saṅketa upaneṣyatī  |
abhūtkāle bahirdvāre bibhratī rūpamuttamam  || 11.08.023 ||
mārga āgacchato vīkṣya puruṣān puruṣarṣabha  |
tān śulkadān vittavataḥ kāntānmene'rthakāmukī  || 11.08.024 ||
āgateṣvapayāteṣu sā saṅketopajīvinī  |
apyanyo vittavān ko'pi māmupaiṣyati bhūridaḥ  || 11.08.025 ||
evaṃ durāśayā dhvasta nidrā dvāryavalambatī  |
nirgacchantī praviśatī niśīthaṃ samapadyata  || 11.08.026 ||
tasyā vittāśayā śuṣyadvaktrāyā dīnacetasaḥ  |
nirvedaḥ paramo jajñe cintāhetuḥ sukhāvahaḥ  || 11.08.027 ||
tasyā nirviṇṇacittāyā gītaṃ śṛṇu yathā mama  |
nirveda āśāpāśānāṃ puruṣasya yathā hyasiḥ  || 11.08.028 ||
na hyaṅgājātanirvedo dehabandhaṃ jihāsati  |
yathā vijñānarahito manujo mamatāṃ nṛpa  || 11.08.029 ||
11.08.030|0 piṅgalovāca
aho me mohavitatiṃ paśyatāvijitātmanaḥ  |
yā kāntādasataḥ kāmaṃ kāmaye yena bāliśā  || 11.08.030 ||
santaṃ samīpe ramaṇaṃ ratipradaṃ vittapradaṃ nityamimaṃ vihāya  |
akāmadaṃ duḥkhabhayādhiśoka mohapradaṃ tucchamahaṃ bhaje'jñā  || 11.08.031 ||
aho mayātmā paritāpito vṛthā sāṅketyavṛttyātivigarhyavārtayā  |
straiṇānnarādyārthatṛṣo'nuśocyātkrītena vittaṃ ratimātmanecchatī  || 11.08.032 ||
yadasthibhirnirmitavaṃśavaṃsya   sthūṇaṃ tvacā romanakhaiḥ pinaddham  |
kṣarannavadvāramagārametad  viṇmūtrapūrṇaṃ madupaiti kānyā  || 11.08.033 ||*
videhānāṃ pure hyasminnahamekaiva mūḍhadhīḥ  |
yānyamicchantyasatyasmādātmadātkāmamacyutāt || 11.08.034 ||
suhṛtpreṣṭhatamo nātha ātmā cāyaṃ śarīriṇām  |
taṃ vikrīyātmanaivāhaṃ rame'nena yathā ramā  || 11.08.035 ||
kiyatpriyaṃ te vyabhajan kāmā ye kāmadā narāḥ  |
ādyantavanto bhāryāyā devā vā kālavidrutāḥ  || 11.08.036 ||
nūnaṃ me bhagavān prīto viṣṇuḥ kenāpi karmaṇā  |
nirvedo'yaṃ durāśāyā yanme jātaḥ sukhāvahaḥ  || 11.08.037 ||
maivaṃ syurmandabhāgyāyāḥ kleśā nirvedahetavaḥ  |
yenānubandhaṃ nirhṛtya puruṣaḥ śamamṛcchati  || 11.08.038 ||
tenopakṛtamādāya śirasā grāmyasaṅgatāḥ  |
tyaktvā durāśāḥ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi tamadhīśvaram  || 11.08.039 ||
santuṣṭā śraddadhatyetadyathālābhena jīvatī  |
viharāmyamunaivāhamātmanā ramaṇena vai  || 11.08.040 ||
saṃsārakūpe patitaṃ viṣayairmuṣitekṣaṇam  |
grastaṃ kālāhinātmānaṃ ko'nyastrātumadhīśvaraḥ  || 11.08.041 ||
ātmaiva hyātmano goptā nirvidyeta yadākhilāt |
apramatta idaṃ paśyedgrastaṃ kālāhinā jagat || 11.08.042 ||
11.08.043|0 śrībrāhmaṇa uvāca
evaṃ vyavasitamatirdurāśāṃ kāntatarṣajām  |
chittvopaśamamāsthāya śayyāmupaviveśa sā  || 11.08.043 ||
āśā hi paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ nairāśyaṃ paramaṃ sukham  |
yathā sañchidya kāntāśāṃ sukhaṃ suṣvāpa piṅgalā  || 11.08.044 ||
11.09.001|0 śrībrāhmaṇa uvāca
parigraho hi duḥkhāya yadyatpriyatamaṃ nṛṇām  |
anantaṃ sukhamāpnoti tadvidvān yastvakiñcanaḥ  || 11.09.001 ||
sāmiṣaṃ kuraraṃ jaghnurbalino'nye nirāmiṣāḥ  |
tadāmiṣaṃ parityajya sa sukhaṃ samavindata  || 11.09.002 ||
na me mānāpamānau sto na cintā gehaputriṇām  |
ātmakrīḍa ātmaratirvicarāmīha bālavat || 11.09.003 ||
dvāveva cintayā muktau paramānanda āplutau  |
yo vimugdho jaḍo bālo yo guṇebhyaḥ paraṃ gataḥ  || 11.09.004 ||
kvacitkumārī tvātmānaṃ vṛṇānān gṛhamāgatān  |
svayaṃ tānarhayāmāsa kvāpi yāteṣu bandhuṣu  || 11.09.005 ||
teṣāmabhyavahārārthaṃ śālīn rahasi pārthiva  |
avaghnantyāḥ prakoṣṭhasthāścakruḥ śaṅkhāḥ svanaṃ mahat || 11.09.006 ||
sā tajjugupsitaṃ matvā mahatī vṛīḍitā tataḥ  |
babhañjaikaikaśaḥ śaṅkhān dvau dvau pāṇyoraśeṣayat || 11.09.007 ||
ubhayorapyabhūdghoṣo hyavaghnantyāḥ svaśaṅkhayoḥ  |
tatrāpyekaṃ nirabhidadekasmānnābhavaddhvaniḥ  || 11.09.008 ||
anvaśikṣamimaṃ tasyā upadeśamarindama  |
lokānanucarannetān lokatattvavivitsayā  || 11.09.009 ||
vāse bahūnāṃ kalaho bhavedvārtā dvayorapi  |
eka eva vasettasmātkumāryā iva kaṅkaṇaḥ  || 11.09.010 ||
mana ekatra saṃyuñjyājjitaśvāso jitāsanaḥ  |
vairāgyābhyāsayogena dhriyamāṇamatandritaḥ  || 11.09.011 ||
yasminmano labdhapadaṃ yadetacchanaiḥ śanairmuñcati karmareṇūn  |
sattvena vṛddhena rajastamaśca vidhūya nirvāṇamupaityanindhanam  || 11.09.012 ||
tadaivamātmanyavaruddhacitto na veda kiñcidbahirantaraṃ vā  |
yatheṣukāro nṛpatiṃ vrajantamiṣau gatātmā na dadarśa pārśve  || 11.09.013 ||
ekacāryaniketaḥ syādapramatto guhāśayaḥ  |
alakṣyamāṇa ācārairmunireko'lpabhāṣaṇaḥ  || 11.09.014 ||
gṛhārambho hi duḥkhāya viphalaścādhruvātmanaḥ  |
sarpaḥ parakṛtaṃ veśma praviśya sukhamedhate  || 11.09.015 ||
eko nārāyaṇo devaḥ pūrvasṛṣṭaṃ svamāyayā  |
saṃhṛtya kālakalayā kalpānta idamīśvaraḥ  |
eka evādvitīyo'bhūdātmādhāro'khilāśrayaḥ  || 11.09.016 ||
kālenātmānubhāvena sāmyaṃ nītāsu śaktiṣu  |
sattvādiṣvādipuruṣaḥ pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ  || 11.09.017 ||
parāvarāṇāṃ parama āste kaivalyasaṃjñitaḥ  |
kevalānubhavānanda sandoho nirupādhikaḥ  || 11.09.018 ||
kevalātmānubhāvena svamāyāṃ triguṇātmikām  |
saṅkṣobhayan sṛjatyādau tayā sūtramarindama  || 11.09.019 ||
tāmāhustriguṇavyaktiṃ sṛjantīṃ viśvatomukham  |
yasmin protamidaṃ viśvaṃ yena saṃsarate pumān  || 11.09.020 ||
yathorṇanābhirhṛdayādūrṇāṃ santatya vaktrataḥ  |
tayā vihṛtya bhūyastāṃ grasatyevaṃ maheśvaraḥ  || 11.09.021 ||
yatra yatra mano dehī dhārayetsakalaṃ dhiyā  |
snehāddveṣādbhayādvāpi yāti tattatsvarūpatām  || 11.09.022 ||
kīṭaḥ peśaskṛtaṃ dhyāyan kuḍyāṃ tena praveśitaḥ  |
yāti tatsātmatāṃ rājan pūrvarūpamasantyajan  || 11.09.023 ||
evaṃ gurubhya etebhya eṣā me śikṣitā matiḥ  |
svātmopaśikṣitāṃ buddhiṃ śṛṇu me vadataḥ prabho  || 11.09.024 ||
deho gururmama viraktivivekahetur  bibhratsma sattvanidhanaṃ satatārtyudarkam  |
tattvānyanena vimṛśāmi yathā tathāpi   pārakyamityavasito vicarāmyasaṅgaḥ  || 11.09.025 ||*
jāyātmajārthapaśubhṛtyagṛhāptavargān   puṣnāti yatpriyacikīrṣayā vitanvan  |
svānte sakṛcchramavaruddhadhanaḥ sa dehaḥ   sṛṣṭvāsya bījamavasīdati vṛkṣadharmaḥ  || 11.09.026 ||*
jihvaikato'mumapakarṣati karhi tarṣā   śiśno'nyatastvagudaraṃ śravaṇaṃ kutaścit |
ghrāṇo'nyataścapaladṛkkva ca karmaśaktir  bahvyaḥ sapatnya iva gehapatiṃ lunanti  || 11.09.027 ||*
sṛṣṭvā purāṇi vividhānyajayātmaśaktyā   vṛkṣān sarīsṛpapaśūn khagadandaśūkān  |
taistairatuṣṭahṛdayaḥ puruṣaṃ vidhāya   brahmāvalokadhiṣaṇaṃ mudamāpa devaḥ  || 11.09.028 ||*
labdhvā sudurlabhamidaṃ bahusambhavānte   mānuṣyamarthadamanityamapīha dhīraḥ  |
tūrṇaṃ yateta na patedanumṛtyu yāvan   niḥśreyasāya viṣayaḥ khalu sarvataḥ syāt || 11.09.029 ||*
evaṃ sañjātavairāgyo vijñānāloka ātmani  |
vicarāmi mahīmetāṃ muktasaṅgo'nahaṅkṛtaḥ  || 11.09.030 ||
na hyekasmādgurorjñānaṃ susthiraṃ syātsupuṣkalam  |
brahmaitadadvitīyaṃ vai gīyate bahudharṣibhiḥ  || 11.09.031 ||
11.09.032|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
ityuktvā sa yaduṃ viprastamāmantrya gabhīradhīḥ  |
vanditaḥ svarcito rājñā yayau prīto yathāgatam  || 11.09.032 ||
avadhūtavacaḥ śrutvā pūrveṣāṃ naḥ sa pūrvajaḥ  |
sarvasaṅgavinirmuktaḥ samacitto babhūva ha  || 11.09.033 ||
11.10.001|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
mayoditeṣvavahitaḥ svadharmeṣu madāśrayaḥ  |
varṇāśramakulācāramakāmātmā samācaret || 11.10.001 ||
anvīkṣeta viśuddhātmā dehināṃ viṣayātmanām  |
guṇeṣu tattvadhyānena sarvārambhaviparyayam  || 11.10.002 ||
suptasya viṣayāloko dhyāyato vā manorathaḥ  |
nānātmakatvādviphalastathā bhedātmadhīrguṇaiḥ  || 11.10.003 ||
nivṛttaṃ karma seveta pravṛttaṃ matparastyajet |
jijñāsāyāṃ sampravṛtto nādriyetkarmacodanām  || 11.10.004 ||
yamānabhīkṣṇaṃ seveta niyamānmatparaḥ kvacit |
madabhijñaṃ guruṃ śāntamupāsīta madātmakam  || 11.10.005 ||
amānyamatsaro dakṣo nirmamo dṛḍhasauhṛdaḥ  |
asatvaro'rthajijñāsuranasūyuramoghavāk || 11.10.006 ||
jāyāpatyagṛhakṣetra svajanadraviṇādiṣu  |
udāsīnaḥ samaṃ paśyan sarveṣvarthamivātmanaḥ  || 11.10.007 ||
vilakṣaṇaḥ sthūlasūkṣmāddehādātmekṣitā svadṛk |
yathāgnirdāruṇo dāhyāddāhako'nyaḥ prakāśakaḥ  || 11.10.008 ||
nirodhotpattyaṇubṛhannānātvaṃ tatkṛtān guṇān  |
antaḥ praviṣṭa ādhatta evaṃ dehaguṇān paraḥ  || 11.10.009 ||
yo'sau guṇairviracito deho'yaṃ puruṣasya hi  |
saṃsārastannibandho'yaṃ puṃso vidyā cchidātmanaḥ  || 11.10.010 ||
tasmājjijñāsayātmānamātmasthaṃ kevalaṃ param  |
saṅgamya nirasedetadvastubuddhiṃ yathākramam  || 11.10.011 ||
ācāryo'raṇirādyaḥ syādantevāsyuttarāraṇiḥ  |
tatsandhānaṃ pravacanaṃ vidyāsandhiḥ sukhāvahaḥ  || 11.10.012 ||
vaiśāradī sātiviśuddhabuddhirdhunoti māyāṃ guṇasamprasūtām  |
gunāṃśca sandahya yadātmametatsvayaṃ ca śāṃyatyasamidyathāgniḥ  || 11.10.013 ||
athaiṣāṃ karmakartṝṇāṃ bhoktṝṇāṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ  |
nānātvamatha nityatvaṃ lokakālāgamātmanām  || 11.10.014 ||
manyase sarvabhāvānāṃ saṃsthā hyautpattikī yathā  |
tattadākṛtibhedena jāyate bhidyate ca dhīḥ  || 11.10.015 ||
evamapyaṅga sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ dehayogataḥ  |
kālāvayavataḥ santi bhāvā janmādayo'sakṛt || 11.10.016 ||
tatrāpi karmaṇāṃ karturasvātantryaṃ ca lakṣyate  |
bhoktuśca duḥkhasukhayoḥ ko nvartho vivaśaṃ bhajet || 11.10.017 ||
na dehināṃ sukhaṃ kiñcidvidyate viduṣāmapi  |
tathā ca duḥkhaṃ mūḍhānāṃ vṛthāhaṅkaraṇaṃ param  || 11.10.018 ||
yadi prāptiṃ vighātaṃ ca jānanti sukhaduḥkhayoḥ  |
te'pyaddhā na viduryogaṃ mṛtyurna prabhavedyathā  || 11.10.019 ||
ko'nvarthaḥ sukhayatyenaṃ kāmo vā mṛtyurantike  |
āghātaṃ nīyamānasya vadhyasyeva na tuṣṭidaḥ  || 11.10.020 ||
śrutaṃ ca dṛṣṭavadduṣṭaṃ spardhāsūyātyayavyayaiḥ  |
bahvantarāyakāmatvātkṛṣivaccāpi niṣphalam  || 11.10.021 ||
antarāyairavihito yadi dharmaḥ svanuṣṭhitaḥ  |
tenāpi nirjitaṃ sthānaṃ yathā gacchati tacchṛṇu  || 11.10.022 ||
iṣṭveha devatā yajñaiḥ svarlokaṃ yāti yājñikaḥ  |
bhuñjīta devavattatra bhogān divyānnijārjitān  || 11.10.023 ||
svapuṇyopacite śubhre vimāna upagīyate  |
gandharvairviharanmadhye devīnāṃ hṛdyaveṣadhṛk || 11.10.024 ||
strībhiḥ kāmagayānena kiṅkinījālamālinā  |
krīḍanna vedātmapātaṃ surākrīḍeṣu nirvṛtaḥ  || 11.10.025 ||
tāvatsa modate svarge yāvatpuṇyaṃ samāpyate  |
kṣīṇapunyaḥ patatyarvāganicchan kālacālitaḥ  || 11.10.026 ||
yadyadharmarataḥ saṅgādasatāṃ vājitendriyaḥ  |
kāmātmā kṛpaṇo lubdhaḥ straiṇo bhūtavihiṃsakaḥ  || 11.10.027 ||
paśūnavidhinālabhya pretabhūtagaṇān yajan  |
narakānavaśo janturgatvā yātyulbaṇaṃ tamaḥ  || 11.10.028 ||
karmāṇi duḥkhodarkāṇi kurvan dehena taiḥ punaḥ  |
dehamābhajate tatra kiṃ sukhaṃ martyadharmiṇaḥ  || 11.10.029 ||
lokānāṃ lokapālānāṃ madbhayaṃ kalpajīvinām  |
brahmaṇo'pi bhayaṃ matto dviparārdhaparāyuṣaḥ  || 11.10.030 ||
guṇāḥ sṛjanti karmāṇi guṇo'nusṛjate guṇān  |
jīvastu guṇasaṃyukto bhuṅkte karmaphalānyasau  || 11.10.031 ||
yāvatsyādguṇavaiṣamyaṃ tāvannānātvamātmanaḥ  |
nānātvamātmano yāvatpāratantryaṃ tadaiva hi  || 11.10.032 ||
yāvadasyāsvatantratvaṃ tāvadīśvarato bhayam  |
ya etatsamupāsīraṃste muhyanti śucārpitāḥ  || 11.10.033 ||
kāla ātmāgamo lokaḥ svabhāvo dharma eva ca  |
iti māṃ bahudhā prāhurguṇavyatikare sati  || 11.10.034 ||
11.10.035|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
guṇeṣu vartamāno'pi dehajeṣvanapāvṛtaḥ  |
guṇairna badhyate dehī badhyate vā kathaṃ vibho  || 11.10.035 ||
kathaṃ varteta viharetkairvā jñāyeta lakṣaṇaiḥ  |
kiṃ bhuñjītota visṛjecchayītāsīta yāti vā  || 11.10.036 ||
etadacyuta me brūhi praśnaṃ praśnavidāṃ vara  |
nityabaddho nityamukta eka eveti me bhramaḥ  || 11.10.037 ||
11.11.001|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
baddho mukta iti vyākhyā guṇato me na vastutaḥ  |
guṇasya māyāmūlatvānna me mokṣo na bandhanam  || 11.11.001 ||
śokamohau sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ dehāpattiśca māyayā  |
svapno yathātmanaḥ khyātiḥ saṃsṛtirna tu vāstavī  || 11.11.002 ||
vidyāvidye mama tanū viddhyuddhava śarīriṇām  |
mokṣabandhakarī ādye māyayā me vinirmite  || 11.11.003 ||
ekasyaiva mamāṃśasya jīvasyaiva mahāmate  |
bandho'syāvidyayānādirvidyayā ca tathetaraḥ  || 11.11.004 ||
atha baddhasya muktasya vailakṣaṇyaṃ vadāmi te  |
viruddhadharmiṇostāta sthitayorekadharmiṇi  || 11.11.005 ||
suparṇāvetau sadṛśau sakhāyau yadṛcchayaitau kṛtanīḍau ca vṛkṣe  |
ekastayoḥ khādati pippalānnamanyo niranno'pi balena bhūyān  || 11.11.006 ||
ātmānamanyaṃ ca sa veda vidvānapippalādo na tu pippalādaḥ  |
yo'vidyayā yuksa tu nityabaddho vidyāmayo yaḥ sa tu nityamuktaḥ  || 11.11.007 ||
dehastho'pi na dehastho vidvān svapnādyathotthitaḥ  |
adehastho'pi dehasthaḥ kumatiḥ svapnadṛgyathā  || 11.11.008 ||
indriyairindriyārtheṣu guṇairapi guṇeṣu ca  |
gṛhyamāṇeṣvahaṃ kuryānna vidvān yastvavikriyaḥ  || 11.11.009 ||
daivādhīne śarīre'smin guṇabhāvyena karmaṇā  |
vartamāno'budhastatra kartāsmīti nibadhyate  || 11.11.010 ||
evaṃ viraktaḥ śayana āsanāṭanamajjane  |
darśanasparśanaghrāṇa bhojanaśravaṇādiṣu  |
na tathā badhyate vidvān tatra tatrādayan guṇān  || 11.11.011 ||
prakṛtistho'pyasaṃsakto yathā khaṃ savitānilaḥ  |
vaiśāradyekṣayāsaṅga śitayā chinnasaṃśayaḥ  |
pratibuddha iva svapnānnānātvādvinivartate  || 11.11.012 ||
yasya syurvītasaṅkalpāḥ prāṇendriyarnanodhiyām  |
vṛttayaḥ sa vinirmukto dehastho'pi hi tadguṇaiḥ  || 11.11.014 ||
yasyātmā hiṃsyate hiṃsrairyena kiñcidyadṛcchayā  |
arcyate vā kvacittatra na vyatikriyate budhaḥ  || 11.11.015 ||
na stuvīta na nindeta kurvataḥ sādhvasādhu vā  |
vadato guṇadoṣābhyāṃ varjitaḥ samadṛṅmuniḥ  || 11.11.016 ||
na kuryānna vadetkiñcinna dhyāyetsādhvasādhu vā  |
ātmārāmo'nayā vṛttyā vicarejjaḍavanmuniḥ  || 11.11.017 ||
śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇāto na niṣṇāyātpare yadi  |
śramastasya śramaphalo hyadhenumiva rakṣataḥ  || 11.11.018 ||
gāṃ dugdhadohāmasatīṃ ca bhāryāṃ dehaṃ parādhīnamasatprajāṃ ca  |
vittaṃ tvatīrthīkṛtamaṅga vācaṃ hīnāṃ mayā rakṣati duḥkhaduḥkhī  || 11.11.019 ||
yasyāṃ na me pāvanamaṅga karma sthityudbhavaprāṇanirodhamasya  |
līlāvatārepsitajanma vā syādvandhyāṃ giraṃ tāṃ bibhṛyānna dhīraḥ  || 11.11.020 ||
evaṃ jijñāsayāpohya nānātvabhramamātmani  |
upārameta virajaṃ mano mayyarpya sarvage  || 11.11.021 ||
yadyanīśo dhārayituṃ mano brahmaṇi niścalam  |
mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi nirapekṣaḥ samācara  || 11.11.022 ||
śraddhālurmatkathāḥ śṛṇvan subhadrā lokapāvanīḥ  |
gāyannanusmaran karma janma cābhinayanmuhuḥ  || 11.11.023 ||
madarthe dharmakāmārthānācaranmadapāśrayaḥ  |
labhate niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ mayyuddhava sanātane  || 11.11.024 ||
satsaṅgalabdhayā bhaktyā mayi māṃ sa upāsitā  |
sa vai me darśitaṃ sadbhirañjasā vindate padam  || 11.11.025 ||
11.11.026|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
sādhustavottamaśloka mataḥ kīdṛgvidhaḥ prabho  |
bhaktistvayyupayujyeta kīdṛśī sadbhirādṛtā  || 11.11.026 ||
etanme puruṣādhyakṣa lokādhyakṣa jagatprabho  |
praṇatāyānuraktāya prapannāya ca kathyatām  || 11.11.027 ||
tvaṃ brahma paramaṃ vyoma puruṣaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ  |

11.11.029|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
kṛpālurakṛtadrohastitikṣuḥ sarvadehinām  |
satyasāro'navadyātmā samaḥ sarvopakārakaḥ  || 11.11.029 ||
kāmairahatadhīrdānto mṛduḥ śucirakiñcanaḥ  |
anīho mitabhukśāntaḥ sthiro maccharaṇo muniḥ  || 11.11.030 ||
apramatto gabhīrātmā dhṛtimāñjitaṣaḍguṇaḥ  |
amānī mānadaḥ kalyo maitraḥ kāruṇikaḥ kaviḥ  || 11.11.031 ||
ājñāyaivaṃ guṇān doṣānmayādiṣṭānapi svakān  |

jñātvājñātvātha ye vai māṃ yāvān yaścāsmi yādṛśaḥ  |
bhajantyananyabhāvena te me bhaktatamā matāḥ  || 11.11.033 ||
malliṅgamadbhaktajana darśanasparśanārcanam  |
paricaryā stutiḥ prahva guṇakarmānukīrtanam  || 11.11.034 ||
matkathāśravaṇe śraddhā madanudhyānamuddhava  |
sarvalābhopaharaṇaṃ dāsyenātmanivedanam  || 11.11.035 ||
majjanmakarmakathanaṃ mama parvānumodanam  |
gītatāṇḍavavāditra goṣṭhībhirmadgṛhotsavaḥ  || 11.11.036 ||
yātrā balividhānaṃ ca sarvavārṣikaparvasu  |
vaidikī tāntrikī dīkṣā madīyavratadhāraṇam  || 11.11.037 ||
mamārcāsthāpane śraddhā svataḥ saṃhatya codyamaḥ  |
udyānopavanākrīḍa puramandirakarmaṇi  || 11.11.038 ||
sammārjanopalepābhyāṃ sekamaṇḍalavartanaiḥ  |
gṛhaśuśrūṣaṇaṃ mahyaṃ dāsavadyadamāyayā  || 11.11.039 ||
amānitvamadambhitvaṃ kṛtasyāparikīrtanam  |
api dīpāvalokaṃ me nopayuñjyānniveditam  || 11.11.040 ||
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yaccātipriyamātmanaḥ  |
tattannivedayenmahyaṃ tadānantyāya kalpate  || 11.11.041 ||
sūryo'gnirbrāhmaṇā gāvo vaiṣṇavaḥ khaṃ marujjalam  |
bhūrātmā sarvabhūtāni bhadra pūjāpadāni me  || 11.11.042 ||
sūrye tu vidyayā trayyā haviṣāgnau yajeta mām  |
ātithyena tu viprāgrye goṣvaṅga yavasādinā  || 11.11.043 ||
vaiṣṇave bandhusatkṛtyā hṛdi khe dhyānaniṣṭhayā  |
vāyau mukhyadhiyā toye dravyaistoyapuraḥsaraiḥ  || 11.11.044 ||
sthaṇḍile mantrahṛdayairbhogairātmānamātmani  |
kṣetrajñaṃ sarvabhūteṣu samatvena yajeta mām  || 11.11.045 ||
dhiṣṇyeṣvityeṣu madrūpaṃ śaṅkhacakragadāmbujaiḥ  |
yuktaṃ caturbhujaṃ śāntaṃ dhyāyannarcetsamāhitaḥ  || 11.11.046 ||
iṣṭāpūrtena māmevaṃ yo yajeta samāhitaḥ  |
labhate mayi sadbhaktiṃ matsmṛtiḥ sādhusevayā  || 11.11.047 ||
prāyeṇa bhaktiyogena satsaṅgena vinoddhava  |
nopāyo vidyate samyakprāyaṇaṃ hi satāmaham  || 11.11.048 ||
athaitatparamaṃ guhyaṃ śṛṇvato yadunandana  |
sugopyamapi vakṣyāmi tvaṃ me bhṛtyaḥ suhṛtsakhā  || 11.11.049 ||
11.12.001|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
na rodhayati māṃ yogo na sāṅkhyaṃ dharma eva ca  |
na svādhyāyastapastyāgo neṣṭāpūrtaṃ na dakṣiṇā  || 11.12.001 ||
vratāni yajñaśchandāṃsi tīrthāni niyamā yamāḥ  |
yathāvarundhe satsaṅgaḥ sarvasaṅgāpaho hi mām  || 11.12.002 ||
satsaṅgena hi daiteyā yātudhānā mṛgāḥ khagāḥ  |
gandharvāpsaraso nāgāḥ siddhāścāraṇaguhyakāḥ  || 11.12.003 ||
vidyādharā manuṣyeṣu vaiśyāḥ śūdrāḥ striyo'ntyajāḥ  |
rajastamaḥprakṛtayastasmiṃstasmin yuge yuge  || 11.12.004 ||
bahavo matpadaṃ prāptāstvāṣṭrakāyādhavādayaḥ  |
vṛṣaparvā balirbāṇo mayaścātha vibhīṣaṇaḥ  || 11.12.005 ||
sugrīvo hanumānṛkṣo gajo gṛdhro vaṇikpathaḥ  |
vyādhaḥ kubjā vraje gopyo yajñapatnyastathāpare  || 11.12.006 ||
te nādhītaśrutigaṇā nopāsitamahattamāḥ  |
avratātaptatapasaḥ matsaṅgānmāmupāgatāḥ  || 11.12.007 ||
kevalena hi bhāvena gopyo gāvo nagā mṛgāḥ  |
ye'nye mūḍhadhiyo nāgāḥ siddhā māmīyurañjasā  || 11.12.008 ||
yaṃ na yogena sāṅkhyena dānavratatapo'dhvaraiḥ  |
vyākhyāsvādhyāyasannyāsaiḥ prāpnuyādyatnavānapi  || 11.12.009 ||
rāmeṇa sārdhaṃ mathurāṃ praṇīte śvāphalkinā mayyanuraktacittāḥ  |
vigāḍhabhāvena na me viyoga tīvrādhayo'nyaṃ dadṛśuḥ sukhāya  || 11.12.010 ||
tāstāḥ kṣapāḥ preṣṭhatamena nītā mayaiva vṛndāvanagocareṇa  |
kṣaṇārdhavattāḥ punaraṅga tāsāṃ hīnā mayā kalpasamā babhūvuḥ  || 11.12.011 ||
tā nāvidanmayyanuṣaṅgabaddha dhiyaḥ svamātmānamadastathedam  |
yathā samādhau munayo'bdhitoye nadyaḥ praviṣṭā iva nāmarūpe  || 11.12.012 ||
matkāmā ramaṇaṃ jāramasvarūpavido'balāḥ  |
brahma māṃ paramaṃ prāpuḥ saṅgācchatasahasraśaḥ  || 11.12.013 ||
tasmāttvamuddhavotsṛjya codanāṃ praticodanām  |
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca śrotavyaṃ śrutameva ca  || 11.12.014 ||
māmekameva śaraṇamātmānaṃ sarvadehinām  |
yāhi sarvātmabhāvena mayā syā hyakutobhayaḥ  || 11.12.015 ||
11.12.016|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
saṃśayaḥ śṛṇvato vācaṃ tava yogeśvareśvara  |
na nivartata ātmastho yena bhrāmyati me manaḥ  || 11.12.016 ||
11.12.017|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
sa eṣa jīvo vivaraprasūtiḥ prāṇena ghoṣeṇa guhāṃ praviṣṭaḥ  |
manomayaṃ sūkṣmamupetya rūpaṃ mātrā svaro varṇa iti sthaviṣṭhaḥ  || 11.12.017 ||
yathānalaḥ khe'nilabandhuruṣmā balena dāruṇyadhimathyamānaḥ  |
aṇuḥ prajāto haviṣā samedhate tathaiva me vyaktiriyaṃ hi vāṇī  || 11.12.018 ||
evaṃ gadiḥ karma gatirvisargo ghrāṇo raso dṛksparśaḥ śrutiśca  |
saṅkalpavijñānamathābhimānaḥ sūtraṃ rajaḥsattvatamovikāraḥ  || 11.12.019 ||
ayaṃ hi jīvastrivṛdabjayoniravyakta eko vayasā sa ādyaḥ  |
viśliṣṭaśaktirbahudheva bhāti bījāni yoniṃ pratipadya yadvat || 11.12.020 ||
yasminnidaṃ protamaśeṣamotaṃ paṭo yathā tantuvitānasaṃsthaḥ  |
ya eṣa saṃsārataruḥ purāṇaḥ karmātmakaḥ puṣpaphale prasūte  || 11.12.021 ||
dve asya bīje śatamūlastrinālaḥ pañcaskandhaḥ pañcarasaprasūtiḥ  |
daśaikaśākho dvisuparṇanīḍastrivalkalo dviphalo'rkaṃ praviṣṭaḥ  || 11.12.022 ||
adanti caikaṃ phalamasya gṛdhrā grāmecarā ekamaraṇyavāsāḥ  |
haṃsā ya ekaṃ bahurūpamijyairmāyāmayaṃ veda sa veda vedam  || 11.12.023 ||
evaṃ gurūpāsanayaikabhaktyā vidyākuṭhāreṇa śitena dhīraḥ  |
vivṛścya jīvāśayamapramattaḥ sampadya cātmānamatha tyajāstram  || 11.12.024 ||
11.13.001|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
sattvaṃ rajastama iti guṇā buddherna cātmanaḥ  |
sattvenānyatamau hanyātsattvaṃ sattvena caiva hi  || 11.13.001 ||
sattvāddharmo bhavedvṛddhātpuṃso madbhaktilakṣaṇaḥ  |
sāttvikopāsayā sattvaṃ tato dharmaḥ pravartate  || 11.13.002 ||
dharmo rajastamo hanyātsattvavṛddhiranuttamaḥ  |
āśu naśyati tanmūlo hyadharma ubhaye hate  || 11.13.003 ||
āgamo'paḥ prajā deśaḥ kālaḥ karma ca janma ca  |
dhyānaṃ mantro'tha saṃskāro daśaite guṇahetavaḥ  || 11.13.004 ||
tattatsāttvikamevaiṣāṃ yadyadvṛddhāḥ pracakṣate  |
nindanti tāmasaṃ tattadrājasaṃ tadupekṣitam  || 11.13.005 ||
sāttvikānyeva seveta pumān sattvavivṛddhaye  |
tato dharmastato jñānaṃ yāvatsmṛtirapohanam  || 11.13.006 ||
veṇusaṅgharṣajo vahnirdagdhvā śāmyati tadvanam  |
evaṃ guṇavyatyayajo dehaḥ śāmyati tatkriyaḥ  || 11.13.007 ||
11.13.008|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
vidanti martyāḥ prāyeṇa viṣayān padamāpadām  |

11.13.009|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
ahamityanyathābuddhiḥ pramattasya yathā hṛdi  |
utsarpati rajo ghoraṃ tato vaikārikaṃ manaḥ  || 11.13.009 ||
rajoyuktasya manasaḥ saṅkalpaḥ savikalpakaḥ  |
tataḥ kāmo guṇadhyānādduḥsahaḥ syāddhi durmateḥ  || 11.13.010 ||
karoti kāmavaśagaḥ karmāṇyavijitendriyaḥ  |
duḥkhodarkāṇi sampaśyan rajovegavimohitaḥ  || 11.13.011 ||
rajastamobhyāṃ yadapi vidvān vikṣiptadhīḥ punaḥ  |
atandrito mano yuñjan doṣadṛṣṭirna sajjate  || 11.13.012 ||
apramatto'nuyuñjīta mano mayyarpayañchanaiḥ  |
anirviṇṇo yathākālaṃ jitaśvāso jitāsanaḥ  || 11.13.013 ||
etāvān yoga ādiṣṭo macchiṣyaiḥ sanakādibhiḥ  |

11.13.015|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
yadā tvaṃ sanakādibhyo yena rūpeṇa keśava  |

11.13.016|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
putrā hiraṇyagarbhasya mānasāḥ sanakādayaḥ  |

11.13.017|0 sanakādaya ūcuḥ
guṇeṣvāviśate ceto guṇāścetasi ca prabho  |
