11.13.018|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
evaṃ pṛṣṭo mahādevaḥ svayambhūrbhūtabhāvanaḥ  |
dhyāyamānaḥ praśnabījaṃ nābhyapadyata karmadhīḥ  || 11.13.018 ||
sa māmacintayaddevaḥ praśnapāratitīrṣayā  |
tasyāhaṃ haṃsarūpeṇa sakāśamagamaṃ tadā  || 11.13.019 ||
dṛṣṭvā māṃ ta upavrajya kṛtva pādābhivandanam  |
brahmāṇamagrataḥ kṛtvā papracchuḥ ko bhavāniti  || 11.13.020 ||
ityahaṃ munibhiḥ pṛṣṭastattvajijñāsubhistadā  |
yadavocamahaṃ tebhyastaduddhava nibodha me  || 11.13.021 ||
vastuno yadyanānātva ātmanaḥ praśna īdṛśaḥ  |
kathaṃ ghaṭeta vo viprā vakturvā me ka āśrayaḥ  || 11.13.022 ||
pañcātmakeṣu bhūteṣu samāneṣu ca vastutaḥ  |
ko bhavāniti vaḥ praśno vācārambho hyanarthakaḥ  || 11.13.023 ||
manasā vacasā dṛṣṭyā gṛhyate'nyairapīndriyaiḥ  |
ahameva na matto'nyaditi budhyadhvamañjasā  || 11.13.024 ||
guṇeṣvāviśate ceto guṇāścetasi ca prajāḥ  |
jīvasya deha ubhayaṃ guṇāśceto madātmanaḥ  || 11.13.025 ||
guṇeṣu cāviśaccittamabhīkṣṇaṃ guṇasevayā  |
guṇāśca cittaprabhavā madrūpa ubhayaṃ tyajet || 11.13.026 ||
jāgratsvapnaḥ suṣuptaṃ ca guṇato buddhivṛttayaḥ  |
tāsāṃ vilakṣaṇo jīvaḥ sākṣitvena viniścitaḥ  || 11.13.027 ||
yarhi saṃsṛtibandho'yamātmano guṇavṛttidaḥ  |
mayi turye sthito jahyāttyāgastadguṇacetasām  || 11.13.028 ||
ahaṅkārakṛtaṃ bandhamātmano'rthaviparyayam  |
vidvānnirvidya saṃsāra cintāṃ turye sthitastyajet || 11.13.029 ||
yāvannānārthadhīḥ puṃso na nivarteta yuktibhiḥ  |
jāgartyapi svapannajñaḥ svapne jāgaraṇaṃ yathā  || 11.13.030 ||
asattvādātmano'nyeṣāṃ bhāvānāṃ tatkṛtā bhidā  |
gatayo hetavaścāsya mṛṣā svapnadṛśo yathā  || 11.13.031 ||
yo jāgare bahiranukṣaṇadharmiṇo'rthān   bhuṅkte samastakaraṇairhṛdi tatsadṛkṣān  |
svapne suṣupta upasaṃharate sa ekaḥ   smṛtyanvayāttriguṇavṛttidṛgindriyeśaḥ  || 11.13.032 ||*
evaṃ vimṛśya guṇato manasastryavasthā   manmāyayā mayi kṛtā iti niścitārthāḥ  |
sañchidya hārdamanumānasaduktitīkṣṇa   jñānāsinā bhajata mākhilasaṃśayādhim  || 11.13.033 ||*
īkṣeta vibhramamidaṃ manaso vilāsaṃ   dṛṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭamatilolamalātacakram  |
vijñānamekamurudheva vibhāti māyā   svapnastridhā guṇavisargakṛto vikalpaḥ  || 11.13.034 ||*
dṛṣṭiṃ tataḥ pratinivartya nivṛttatṛṣṇas  tūṣṇīṃ bhavennijasukhānubhavo nirīhaḥ  |
sandṛśyate kva ca yadīdamavastubuddhyā   tyaktaṃ bhramāya na bhavetsmṛtirānipātāt || 11.13.035 ||*
dehaṃ ca naśvaramavasthitamutthitaṃ vā   siddho na paśyati yato'dhyagamatsvarūpam  |
daivādapetamatha daivavaśādupetaṃ   vāso yathā parikṛtaṃ madirāmadāndhaḥ  || 11.13.036 ||*
deho'pi daivavaśagaḥ khalu karma yāvat  svārambhakaṃ pratisamīkṣata eva sāsuḥ  |
taṃ saprapañcamadhirūḍhasamādhiyogaḥ   svāpnaṃ punarna bhajate pratibuddhavastuḥ  || 11.13.037 ||*
mayaitaduktaṃ vo viprā guhyaṃ yatsāṅkhyayogayoḥ  |
jānīta māgataṃ yajñaṃ yuṣmaddharmavivakṣayā  || 11.13.038 ||
ahaṃ yogasya sāṅkhyasya satyasyartasya tejasaḥ  |
parāyaṇaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ śriyaḥ kīrterdamasya ca  || 11.13.039 ||
māṃ bhajanti guṇāḥ sarve nirguṇaṃ nirapekṣakam  |
suhṛdaṃ priyamātmānaṃ sāmyāsaṅgādayo'guṇāḥ  || 11.13.040 ||
iti me chinnasandehā munayaḥ sanakādayaḥ  |
sabhājayitvā parayā bhaktyāgṛṇata saṃstavaiḥ  || 11.13.041 ||
tairahaṃ pūjitaḥ saṃyaksaṃstutaḥ paramarṣibhiḥ  |
pratyeyāya svakaṃ dhāma paśyataḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  || 11.13.042 ||
11.14.001|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
vadanti kṛṣṇa śreyāṃsi bahūni brahmavādinaḥ  |
teṣāṃ vikalpaprādhānyamutāho ekamukhyatā  || 11.14.001 ||
bhavatodāhṛtaḥ svāmin bhaktiyogo'napekṣitaḥ  |
nirasya sarvataḥ saṅgaṃ yena tvayyāviśenmanaḥ  || 11.14.002 ||
11.14.003|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
kālena naṣṭā pralaye vāṇīyaṃ vedasaṃjñitā  |
mayādau brahmaṇe proktā dharmo yasyāṃ madātmakaḥ  || 11.14.003 ||
tena proktā svaputrāya manave pūrvajāya sā  |
tato bhṛgvādayo'gṛhṇan sapta brahmamaharṣayaḥ  || 11.14.004 ||
tebhyaḥ pitṛbhyastatputrā devadānavaguhyakāḥ  |
manuṣyāḥ siddhagandharvāḥ savidyādharacāraṇāḥ  || 11.14.005 ||
kindevāḥ kinnarā nāgā rakṣaḥkimpuruṣādayaḥ  |
bahvyasteṣāṃ prakṛtayo rajaḥsattvatamobhuvaḥ  || 11.14.006 ||
yābhirbhūtāni bhidyante bhūtānāṃ patayastathā  |
yathāprakṛti sarveṣāṃ citrā vācaḥ sravanti hi  || 11.14.007 ||
evaṃ prakṛtivaicitryādbhidyante matayo nṛṇām  |
pāramparyeṇa keṣāñcitpāṣaṇḍamatayo'pare  || 11.14.008 ||
manmāyāmohitadhiyaḥ puruṣāḥ puruṣarṣabha  |
śreyo vadantyanekāntaṃ yathākarma yathāruci  || 11.14.009 ||
dharmameke yaśaścānye kāmaṃ satyaṃ damaṃ śamam  |
anye vadanti svārthaṃ vā aiśvaryaṃ tyāgabhojanam  |
kecidyajñaṃ tapo dānaṃ vratāni niyamān yamān  || 11.14.010 ||
ādyantavanta evaiṣāṃ lokāḥ karmavinirmitāḥ  |
duḥkhodarkāstamoniṣṭhāḥ kṣudrā mandāḥ śucārpitāḥ  || 11.14.011 ||
mayyarpitātmanaḥ sabhya nirapekṣasya sarvataḥ  |
mayātmanā sukhaṃ yattatkutaḥ syādviṣayātmanām  || 11.14.012 ||
akiñcanasya dāntasya śāntasya samacetasaḥ  |
mayā santuṣṭamanasaḥ sarvāḥ sukhamayā diśaḥ  || 11.14.013 ||
na pārameṣṭhyaṃ na mahendradhiṣṇyaṃ   na sārvabhaumaṃ na rasādhipatyam  |
na yogasiddhīrapunarbhavaṃ vā   mayyarpitātmecchati madvinānyat || 11.14.014 ||*
na tathā me priyatama ātmayonirna śaṅkaraḥ  |
na ca saṅkarṣaṇo na śrīrnaivātmā ca yathā bhavān  || 11.14.015 ||
nirapekṣaṃ muniṃ śāntaṃ nirvairaṃ samadarśanam  |
anuvrajāmyahaṃ nityaṃ pūyeyetyaṅghrireṇubhiḥ  || 11.14.016 ||
niṣkiñcanā mayyanuraktacetasaḥ śāntā mahānto'khilajīvavatsalāḥ  |
kāmairanālabdhadhiyo juṣanti te yannairapekṣyaṃ na viduḥ sukhaṃ mama  || 11.14.017 ||
bādhyamāno'pi madbhakto viṣayairajitendriyaḥ  |
prāyaḥ pragalbhayā bhaktyā viṣayairnābhibhūyate  || 11.14.018 ||
yathāgniḥ susamṛddhārciḥ karotyedhāṃsi bhasmasāt |
tathā madviṣayā bhaktiruddhavaināṃsi kṛtsnaśaḥ  || 11.14.019 ||
na sādhayati māṃ yogo na sāṅkhyaṃ dharma uddhava  |
na svādhyāyastapastyāgo yathā bhaktirmamorjitā  || 11.14.020 ||
bhaktyāhamekayā grāhyaḥ śraddhayātmā priyaḥ satām  |
bhaktiḥ punāti manniṣṭhā śvapākānapi sambhavāt || 11.14.021 ||
dharmaḥ satyadayopeto vidyā vā tapasānvitā  |
madbhaktyāpetamātmānaṃ na samyakprapunāti hi  || 11.14.022 ||
kathaṃ vinā romaharṣaṃ dravatā cetasā vinā  |
vinānandāśrukalayā śudhyedbhaktyā vināśayaḥ  || 11.14.023 ||
vāggadgadā dravate yasya cittaṃ rudatyabhīkṣṇaṃ hasati kvacicca  |
vilajja udgāyati nṛtyate ca madbhaktiyukto bhuvanaṃ punāti  || 11.14.024 ||
yathāgninā hema malaṃ jahāti dhmātaṃ punaḥ svaṃ bhajate ca rūpam  |
ātmā ca karmānuśayaṃ vidhūya madbhaktiyogena bhajatyatho mām  || 11.14.025 ||
yathā yathātmā parimṛjyate'sau matpuṇyagāthāśravaṇābhidhānaiḥ  |
tathā tathā paśyati vastu sūkṣmaṃ cakṣuryathaivāñjanasamprayuktam  || 11.14.026 ||
viṣayān dhyāyataścittaṃ viṣayeṣu viṣajjate  |
māmanusmarataścittaṃ mayyeva pravilīyate  || 11.14.027 ||
tasmādasadabhidhyānaṃ yathā svapnamanoratham  |
hitvā mayi samādhatsva mano madbhāvabhāvitam  || 11.14.028 ||
strīṇāṃ strīsaṅgināṃ saṅgaṃ tyaktvā dūrata ātmavān  |
kṣeme vivikta āsīnaścintayenmāmatandritaḥ  || 11.14.029 ||
na tathāsya bhavetkleśo bandhaścānyaprasaṅgataḥ  |
yoṣitsaṅgādyathā puṃso yathā tatsaṅgisaṅgataḥ  || 11.14.030 ||
11.14.031|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
yathā tvāmaravindākṣa yādṛśaṃ vā yadātmakam  |
dhyāyenmumukṣuretanme dhyānaṃ tvaṃ vaktumarhasi  || 11.14.031 ||
11.14.032|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
sama āsana āsīnaḥ samakāyo yathāsukham  |
hastāvutsaṅga ādhāya svanāsāgrakṛtekṣaṇaḥ  || 11.14.032 ||
prāṇasya śodhayenmārgaṃ pūrakumbhakarecakaiḥ  |
viparyayeṇāpi śanairabhyasennirjitendriyaḥ  || 11.14.033 ||
hṛdyavicchinamoṃkāraṃ ghaṇṭānādaṃ bisorṇavat |
prāṇenodīrya tatrātha punaḥ saṃveśayetsvaram  || 11.14.034 ||
evaṃ praṇavasaṃyuktaṃ prāṇameva samabhyaset |
daśakṛtvastriṣavaṇaṃ māsādarvāgjitānilaḥ  || 11.14.035 ||
hṛtpuṇḍarīkamantaḥsthamūrdhvanālamadhomukham  |
dhyātvordhvamukhamunnidramaṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam  || 11.14.036 ||
karṇikāyāṃ nyasetsūrya somāgnīnuttarottaram  |
vahnimadhye smaredrūpaṃ mamaitaddhyānamaṅgalam  || 11.14.037 ||
samaṃ praśāntaṃ sumukhaṃ dīrghacārucaturbhujam  |
sucārusundaragrīvaṃ sukapolaṃ śucismitam  || 11.14.038 ||
samānakarṇavinyasta sphuranmakarakuṇḍalam  |
hemāmbaraṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ śrīvatsaśrīniketanam  || 11.14.039 ||
śaṅkhacakragadāpadma vanamālāvibhūṣitam  |
nūpurairvilasatpādaṃ kaustubhaprabhayā yutam  || 11.14.040 ||
dyumatkirīṭakaṭaka kaṭisūtrāṅgadāyutam  |
sarvāṅgasundaraṃ hṛdyaṃ prasādasumukhekṣanam  || 11.14.041 ||
sukumāramabhidhyāyetsarvāṅgeṣu mano dadhat |
indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyo manasākṛṣya tanmanaḥ  |
buddhyā sārathinā dhīraḥ praṇayenmayi sarvataḥ  || 11.14.042 ||
tatsarvavyāpakaṃ cittamākṛṣyaikatra dhārayet |
nānyāni cintayedbhūyaḥ susmitaṃ bhāvayenmukham  || 11.14.043 ||
tatra labdhapadaṃ cittamākṛṣya vyomni dhārayet |
tacca tyaktvā madāroho na kiñcidapi cintayet || 11.14.044 ||
evaṃ samāhitamatirmāmevātmānamātmani  |
vicaṣṭe mayi sarvātman jyotirjyotiṣi saṃyutam  || 11.14.045 ||
dhyānenetthaṃ sutīvreṇa yuñjato yogino manaḥ  |
saṃyāsyatyāśu nirvāṇaṃ dravya jñānakriyābhramaḥ  || 11.14.046 ||
11.15.001|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
jitendriyasya yuktasya jitaśvāsasya yoginaḥ  |
mayi dhārayataśceta upatiṣṭhanti siddhayaḥ  || 11.15.001 ||
11.15.002|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
kayā dhāraṇayā kā svitkathaṃ vā siddhiracyuta  |

11.15.003|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
siddhayo'ṣṭādaśa proktā dhāraṇā yogapāragaiḥ  |
tāsāmaṣṭau matpradhānā daśaiva guṇahetavaḥ  || 11.15.003 ||
aṇimā mahimā mūrterlaghimā prāptirindriyaiḥ  |
prākāmyaṃ śrutadṛṣṭeṣu śaktipreraṇamīśitā  || 11.15.004 ||
guṇeṣvasaṅgo vaśitā yatkāmastadavasyati  |
etā me siddhayaḥ saumya aṣṭāvautpattikā matāḥ  || 11.15.005 ||
anūrmimattvaṃ dehe'smin dūraśravaṇadarśanam  |
manojavaḥ kāmarūpaṃ parakāyapraveśanam  || 11.15.006 ||
svacchandamṛtyurdevānāṃ sahakrīḍānudarśanam  |
yathāsaṅkalpasaṃsiddhirājñāpratihatā gatiḥ  || 11.15.007 ||
trikālajñatvamadvandvaṃ paracittādyabhijñatā  |
agnyarkāmbuviṣādīnāṃ pratiṣṭambho'parājayaḥ  || 11.15.008 ||
etāścoddeśataḥ proktā yogadhāraṇasiddhayaḥ  |
yayā dhāraṇayā yā syādyathā vā syānnibodha me  || 11.15.009 ||
bhūtasūkṣmātmani mayi tanmātraṃ dhārayenmanaḥ  |
aṇimānamavāpnoti tanmātropāsako mama  || 11.15.010 ||
mahattattvātmani mayi yathāsaṃsthaṃ mano dadhat |
mahimānamavāpnoti bhūtānāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak || 11.15.011 ||
paramāṇumaye cittaṃ bhūtānāṃ mayi rañjayan  |
kālasūkṣmārthatāṃ yogī laghimānamavāpnuyāt || 11.15.012 ||
dhārayanmayyahaṃtattve mano vaikārike'khilam  |
sarvendriyāṇāmātmatvaṃ prāptiṃ prāpnoti manmanāḥ  || 11.15.013 ||
mahatyātmani yaḥ sūtre dhārayenmayi mānasam  |
prākāmyaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ me vindate'vyaktajanmanaḥ  || 11.15.014 ||
viṣṇau tryadhīśvare cittaṃ dhārayetkālavigrahe  |
sa īśitvamavāpnoti kṣetrajñakṣetracodanām  || 11.15.015 ||
nārāyaṇe turīyākhye bhagavacchabdaśabdite  |
mano mayyādadhadyogī maddharmā vaśitāmiyāt || 11.15.016 ||
nirguṇe brahmaṇi mayi dhārayan viśadaṃ manaḥ  |
paramānandamāpnoti yatra kāmo'vasīyate  || 11.15.017 ||
śvetadvīpapatau cittaṃ śuddhe dharmamaye mayi  |
dhārayañchvetatāṃ yāti ṣaḍūrmirahito naraḥ  || 11.15.018 ||
mayyākāśātmani prāṇe manasā ghoṣamudvahan  |
tatropalabdhā bhūtānāṃ haṃso vācaḥ śṛṇotyasau  || 11.15.019 ||
cakṣustvaṣṭari saṃyojya tvaṣṭāramapi cakṣuṣi  |
māṃ tatra manasā dhyāyan viśvaṃ paśyati dūrataḥ  || 11.15.020 ||
mano mayi susaṃyojya dehaṃ tadanuvāyunā  |
maddhāraṇānubhāvena tatrātmā yatra vai manaḥ  || 11.15.021 ||
yadā mana upādāya yadyadrūpaṃ bubhūṣati  |
tattadbhavenmanorūpaṃ madyogabalamāśrayaḥ  || 11.15.022 ||
parakāyaṃ viśan siddha ātmānaṃ tatra bhāvayet |
piṇḍaṃ hitvā viśetprāṇo vāyubhūtaḥ ṣaḍaṅghrivat || 11.15.023 ||
pārṣṇyāpīḍya gudaṃ prāṇaṃ hṛduraḥkaṇṭhamūrdhasu  |
āropya brahmarandhreṇa brahma nītvotsṛjettanum  || 11.15.024 ||
vihariṣyan surākrīḍe matsthaṃ sattvaṃ vibhāvayet |
vimānenopatiṣṭhanti sattvavṛttīḥ surastriyaḥ  || 11.15.025 ||
yathā saṅkalpayedbuddhyā yadā vā matparaḥ pumān  |
mayi satye mano yuñjaṃstathā tatsamupāśnute  || 11.15.026 ||
yo vai madbhāvamāpanna īśiturvaśituḥ pumān  |
kutaścinna vihanyeta tasya cājñā yathā mama  || 11.15.027 ||
madbhaktyā śuddhasattvasya yogino dhāraṇāvidaḥ  |
tasya traikālikī buddhirjanmamṛtyūpabṛṃhitā  || 11.15.028 ||
agnyādibhirna hanyeta muneryogamayaṃ vapuḥ  |
madyogaśāntacittasya yādasāmudakaṃ yathā  || 11.15.029 ||
madvibhūtīrabhidhyāyan śrīvatsāstravibhūṣitāḥ  |
dhvajātapatravyajanaiḥ sa bhavedaparājitaḥ  || 11.15.030 ||
upāsakasya māmevaṃ yogadhāraṇayā muneḥ  |
siddhayaḥ pūrvakathitā upatiṣṭhantyaśeṣataḥ  || 11.15.031 ||
jitendriyasya dāntasya jitaśvāsātmano muneḥ  |
maddhāraṇāṃ dhārayataḥ kā sā siddhiḥ sudurlabhā  || 11.15.032 ||
antarāyān vadantyetā yuñjato yogamuttamam  |
mayā sampadyamānasya kālakṣapaṇahetavaḥ  || 11.15.033 ||
janmauṣadhitapomantrairyāvatīriha siddhayaḥ  |
yogenāpnoti tāḥ sarvā nānyairyogagatiṃ vrajet || 11.15.034 ||
sarvāsāmapi siddhīnāṃ hetuḥ patirahaṃ prabhuḥ  |
ahaṃ yogasya sāṅkhyasya dharmasya brahmavādinām  || 11.15.035 ||
ahamātmāntaro bāhyo'nāvṛtaḥ sarvadehinām  |
yathā bhūtāni bhūteṣu bahirantaḥ svayaṃ tathā  || 11.15.036 ||
11.16.001|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
tvaṃ brahma paramaṃ sākṣādanādyantamapāvṛtam  |
sarveṣāmapi bhāvānāṃ trāṇasthityapyayodbhavaḥ  || 11.16.001 ||
uccāvaceṣu bhūteṣu durjñeyamakṛtātmabhiḥ  |
upāsate tvāṃ bhagavan yāthātathyena brāhmaṇāḥ  || 11.16.002 ||
yeṣu yeṣu ca bhūteṣu bhaktyā tvāṃ paramarṣayaḥ  |
upāsīnāḥ prapadyante saṃsiddhiṃ tadvadasva me  || 11.16.003 ||
gūḍhaścarasi bhūtātmā bhūtānāṃ bhūtabhāvana  |
na tvāṃ paśyanti bhūtāni paśyantaṃ mohitāni te  || 11.16.004 ||
yāḥ kāśca bhūmau divi vai rasāyāṃ vibhūtayo dikṣu mahāvibhūte  |
tā mahyamākhyāhyanubhāvitāste namāmi te tīrthapadāṅghripadmam  || 11.16.005 ||
11.16.006|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
evametadahaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ praśnaṃ praśnavidāṃ vara  |
yuyutsunā vinaśane sapatnairarjunena vai  || 11.16.006 ||
jñātvā jñātivadhaṃ garhyamadharmaṃ rājyahetukam  |
tato nivṛtto hantāhaṃ hato'yamiti laukikaḥ  || 11.16.007 ||
sa tadā puruṣavyāghro yuktyā me pratibodhitaḥ  |
abhyabhāṣata māmevaṃ yathā tvaṃ raṇamūrdhani  || 11.16.008 ||
ahamātmoddhavāmīṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ suhṛdīśvaraḥ  |
ahaṃ sarvāṇi bhūtāni teṣāṃ sthityudbhavāpyayaḥ  || 11.16.009 ||
ahaṃ gatirgatimatāṃ kālaḥ kalayatāmaham  |
gunāṇāṃ cāpyahaṃ sāmyaṃ guṇinyautpattiko guṇaḥ  || 11.16.010 ||
guṇināmapyahaṃ sūtraṃ mahatāṃ ca mahānaham  |
sūkṣmāṇāmapyahaṃ jīvo durjayānāmahaṃ manaḥ  || 11.16.011 ||
hiraṇyagarbho vedānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ praṇavastrivṛt |
akṣarāṇāmakāro'smi padāni cchandusāmaham  || 11.16.012 ||
indro'haṃ sarvadevānāṃ vasūnāmasmi havyavāṭ |
ādityānāmahaṃ viṣṇū rudrāṇāṃ nīlalohitaḥ  || 11.16.013 ||
brahmarṣīṇāṃ bhṛgurahaṃ rājarṣīṇāmahaṃ manuḥ  |
devarṣīṇāṃ nārado'haṃ havirdhānyasmi dhenuṣu  || 11.16.014 ||
siddheśvarāṇāṃ kapilaḥ suparṇo'haṃ patatriṇām  |
prajāpatīnāṃ dakṣo'haṃ pitṝṇāmahamaryamā  || 11.16.015 ||
māṃ viddhyuddhava daityānāṃ prahlādamasureśvaram  |
somaṃ nakṣatrauṣadhīnāṃ dhaneśaṃ yakṣarakṣasām  || 11.16.016 ||
airāvataṃ gajendrāṇāṃ yādasāṃ varuṇaṃ prabhum  |
tapatāṃ dyumatāṃ sūryaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ca bhūpatim  || 11.16.017 ||
uccaiḥśravāsturaṅgāṇāṃ dhātūnāmasmi kāñcanam  |
yamaḥ saṃyamatāṃ cāhaṃ sarpāṇāmasmi vāsukiḥ  || 11.16.018 ||
nāgendrāṇāmananto'haṃ mṛgendraḥ śṛṅgidaṃṣṭriṇām  |
āśramāṇāmahaṃ turyo varṇānāṃ prathamo'nagha  || 11.16.019 ||
tīrthānāṃ srotasāṃ gaṅgā samudraḥ sarasāmaham  |
āyudhānāṃ dhanurahaṃ tripuraghno dhanuṣmatām  || 11.16.020 ||
dhiṣṇyānāmasmyahaṃ merurgahanānāṃ himālayaḥ  |
vanaspatīnāmaśvattha oṣadhīnāmahaṃ yavaḥ  || 11.16.021 ||
purodhasāṃ vasiṣṭho'haṃ brahmiṣṭhānāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ  |
skando'haṃ sarvasenānyāmagraṇyāṃ bhagavānajaḥ  || 11.16.022 ||
yajñānāṃ brahmayajño'haṃ vratānāmavihiṃsanam  |
vāyvagnyarkāmbuvāgātmā śucīnāmapyahaṃ śuciḥ  || 11.16.023 ||
yogānāmātmasaṃrodho mantro'smi vijigīṣatām  |
ānvīkṣikī kauśalānāṃ vikalpaḥ khyātivādinām  || 11.16.024 ||
strīṇāṃ tu śatarūpāhaṃ puṃsāṃ svāyambhuvo manuḥ  |
nārāyaṇo munīnāṃ ca kumāro brahmacāriṇām  || 11.16.025 ||
dharmāṇāmasmi sannyāsaḥ kṣemāṇāmabahirmatiḥ  |
guhyānāṃ sunṛtaṃ maunaṃ mithunānāmajastvaham  || 11.16.026 ||
saṃvatsaro'smyanimiṣāmṛtūnāṃ madhumādhavau  |
māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo'haṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ tathābhijit || 11.16.027 ||
ahaṃ yugānāṃ ca kṛtaṃ dhīrāṇāṃ devalo'sitaḥ  |
dvaipāyano'smi vyāsānāṃ kavīnāṃ kāvya ātmavān  || 11.16.028 ||
vāsudevo bhagavatāṃ tvaṃ tu bhāgavateṣvaham  |
kimpuruṣānāṃ hanumān vidyādhrāṇāṃ sudarśanaḥ  || 11.16.029 ||
ratnānāṃ padmarāgo'smi padmakośaḥ supeśasām  |
kuśo'smi darbhajātīnāṃ gavyamājyaṃ haviḥṣvaham  || 11.16.030 ||
vyavasāyināmahaṃ lakṣmīḥ kitavānāṃ chalagrahaḥ  |
titikṣāsmi titikṣūṇāṃ sattvaṃ sattvavatāmaham  || 11.16.031 ||
ojaḥ saho balavatāṃ karmāhaṃ viddhi sātvatām  |
sātvatāṃ navamūrtīnāmādimūrtirahaṃ parā  || 11.16.032 ||
viśvāvasuḥ pūrvacittirgandharvāpsarasāmaham  |
bhūdharāṇāmahaṃ sthairyaṃ gandhamātramahaṃ bhuvaḥ  || 11.16.033 ||
apāṃ rasaśca paramastejiṣṭhānāṃ vibhāvasuḥ  |
prabhā sūryendutārāṇāṃ śabdo'haṃ nabhasaḥ paraḥ  || 11.16.034 ||
brahmaṇyānāṃ balirahaṃ vīrāṇāmahamarjunaḥ  |
bhūtānāṃ sthitirutpattirahaṃ vai pratisaṅkramaḥ  || 11.16.035 ||
gatyuktyutsargopādānamānandasparśalakṣanam  |
āsvādaśrutyavaghrāṇamahaṃ sarvendriyendriyam  || 11.16.036 ||
pṛthivī vāyurākāśa āpo jyotirahaṃ mahān  |
vikāraḥ puruṣo'vyaktaṃ rajaḥ sattvaṃ tamaḥ param  |
ahametatprasaṅkhyānaṃ jñānaṃ tattvaviniścayaḥ  || 11.16.037 ||
mayeśvareṇa jīvena guṇena guṇinā vinā  |
sarvātmanāpi sarveṇa na bhāvo vidyate kvacit || 11.16.038 ||
saṅkhyānaṃ paramāṇūnāṃ kālena kriyate mayā  |
na tathā me vibhūtīnāṃ sṛjato'ṇḍāni koṭiśaḥ  || 11.16.039 ||
tejaḥ śrīḥ kīrtiraiśvaryaṃ hrīstyāgaḥ saubhagaṃ bhagaḥ  |
vīryaṃ titikṣā vijñānaṃ yatra yatra sa me'ṃśakaḥ  || 11.16.040 ||
etāste kīrtitāḥ sarvāḥ saṅkṣepeṇa vibhūtayaḥ  |
manovikārā evaite yathā vācābhidhīyate  || 11.16.041 ||
vācaṃ yaccha mano yaccha prāṇān yacchedriyāṇi ca  |
ātmānamātmanā yaccha na bhūyaḥ kalpase'dhvane  || 11.16.042 ||
yo vai vāṅmanasī saṃyagasaṃyacchan dhiyā yatiḥ  |
tasya vrataṃ tapo dānaṃ sravatyāmaghaṭāmbuvat || 11.16.043 ||
tasmādvaco manaḥ prāṇānniyacchenmatparāyaṇaḥ  |
madbhaktiyuktayā buddhyā tataḥ parisamāpyate  || 11.16.044 ||
11.17.001|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
yastvayābhihitaḥ pūrvaṃ dharmastvadbhaktilakṣaṇaḥ  |
varṇāśamācāravatāṃ sarveṣāṃ dvipadāmapi  || 11.17.001 ||
yathānuṣṭhīyamānena tvayi bhaktirnṛṇāṃ bhavet |
svadharmeṇāravindākṣa tanmamākhyātumarhasi  || 11.17.002 ||
purā kila mahābāho dharmaṃ paramakaṃ prabho  |
yattena haṃsarūpeṇa brahmaṇe'bhyāttha mādhava  || 11.17.003 ||
sa idānīṃ sumahatā kālenāmitrakarśana  |
na prāyo bhavitā martya loke prāganuśāsitaḥ  || 11.17.004 ||
vaktā kartāvitā nānyo dharmasyācyuta te bhuvi  |
sabhāyāmapi vairiñcyāṃ yatra mūrtidharāḥ kalāḥ  || 11.17.005 ||
kartrāvitrā pravaktrā ca bhavatā madhusūdana  |
tyakte mahītale deva vinaṣṭaṃ kaḥ pravakṣyati  || 11.17.006 ||
tattvaṃ naḥ sarvadharmajña dharmastvadbhaktilakṣaṇaḥ  |
yathā yasya vidhīyeta tathā varṇaya me prabho  || 11.17.007 ||
11.17.008|0 śrīśuka uvāca
itthaṃ svabhṛtyamukhyena pṛṣṭaḥ sa bhagavān hariḥ  |
prītaḥ kṣemāya martyānāṃ dharmānāha sanātanān  || 11.17.008 ||
11.17.009|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
dharmya eṣa tava praśno naiḥśreyasakaro nṛṇām  |
varṇāśramācāravatāṃ tamuddhava nibodha me  || 11.17.009 ||
ādau kṛtayuge varṇo nṛṇāṃ haṃsa iti smṛtaḥ  |
kṛtakṛtyāḥ prajā jātyā tasmātkṛtayugaṃ viduḥ  || 11.17.010 ||
vedaḥ praṇava evāgre dharmo'haṃ vṛṣarūpadhṛk |
upāsate taponiṣṭhā haṃsaṃ māṃ muktakilbiṣāḥ  || 11.17.011 ||
tretāmukhe mahābhāga prāṇānme hṛdayāttrayī  |
vidyā prādurabhūttasyā ahamāsaṃ trivṛnmakhaḥ  || 11.17.012 ||
viprakṣatriyaviṭśūdrā mukhabāhūrupādajāḥ  |
vairājātpuruṣājjātā ya ātmācāralakṣaṇāḥ  || 11.17.013 ||
gṛhāśramo jaghanato brahmacaryaṃ hṛdo mama  |
vakṣaḥsthalādvanevāsaḥ sannyāsaḥ śirasi sthitaḥ  || 11.17.014 ||
varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca janmabhūmyanusāriṇīḥ  |
āsan prakṛtayo nṝnāṃ nīcairnīcottamottamāḥ  || 11.17.015 ||
śamo damastapaḥ śaucaṃ santoṣaḥ kṣāntirārjavam  |
madbhaktiśca dayā satyaṃ brahmaprakṛtayastvimāḥ  || 11.17.016 ||
tejo balaṃ dhṛtiḥ śauryaṃ titikṣaudāryamudyamaḥ  |
sthairyaṃ brahmanyamaiśvaryaṃ kṣatraprakṛtayastvimāḥ  || 11.17.017 ||
āstikyaṃ dānaniṣṭhā ca adambho brahmasevanam  |
atuṣṭirarthopacayairvaiśyaprakṛtayastvimāḥ  || 11.17.018 ||
śuśrūṣaṇaṃ dvijagavāṃ devānāṃ cāpyamāyayā  |
tatra labdhena santoṣaḥ śūdraprakṛtayastvimāḥ  || 11.17.019 ||
aśaucamanṛtaṃ steyaṃ nāstikyaṃ śuṣkavigrahaḥ  |
kāmaḥ krodhaśca tarṣaśca sa bhāvo'ntyāvasāyinām  || 11.17.020 ||
ahiṃsā satyamasteyamakāmakrodhalobhatā  |
bhūtapriyahitehā ca dharmo'yaṃ sārvavarṇikaḥ  || 11.17.021 ||
dvitīyaṃ prāpyānupūrvyājjanmopanayanaṃ dvijaḥ  |
vasan gurukule dānto brahmādhīyīta cāhūtaḥ  || 11.17.022 ||
mekhalājinadaṇḍākṣa brahmasūtrakamaṇḍalūn  |
jaṭilo'dhautadadvāso'raktapīṭhaḥ kuśān dadhat || 11.17.023 ||
snānabhojanahomeṣu japoccāre ca vāgyataḥ  |
na cchindyānnakharomāṇi kakṣopasthagatānyapi  || 11.17.024 ||
reto nāvakirejjātu brahmavratadharaḥ svayam  |
avakīrṇe'vagāhyāpsu yatāsustripadāṃ japet || 11.17.025 ||
agnyarkācāryagovipra guruvṛddhasurāñśuciḥ  |
samāhita upāsīta sandhye dve yatavāgjapan  || 11.17.026 ||
ācāryaṃ māṃ vijānīyānnāvanmanyeta karhicit |
na martyabuddhyāsūyeta sarvadevamayo guruḥ  || 11.17.027 ||
sāyaṃ prātarupānīya bhaikṣyaṃ tasmai nivedayet |
yaccānyadapyanujñātamupayuñjīta saṃyataḥ  || 11.17.028 ||
śuśrūṣamāṇa ācāryaṃ sadopāsīta nīcavat |
yānaśayyāsanasthānairnātidūre kṛtāñjaliḥ  || 11.17.029 ||
evaṃvṛtto gurukule vasedbhogavivarjitaḥ  |
vidyā samāpyate yāvadbibhradvratamakhaṇḍitam  || 11.17.030 ||
yadyasau chandasāṃ lokamārokṣyan brahmaviṣṭapam  |
gurave vinyaseddehaṃ svādhyāyārthaṃ bṛhadvrataḥ  || 11.17.031 ||
agnau gurāvātmani ca sarvabhūteṣu māṃ param  |
apṛthagdhīrupasīta brahmavarcasvyakalmaṣaḥ  || 11.17.032 ||
strīṇāṃ nirīkṣaṇasparśa saṃlāpakṣvelanādikam  |
prāṇino mithunībhūtānagṛhastho'gratastyajet || 11.17.033 ||
śaucamācamanaṃ snānaṃ sandhyopāstirmamārcanam  |
tīrthasevā japo'spṛśyā bhakṣyāsambhāṣyavarjanam  || 11.17.034 ||
sarvāśramaprayukto'yaṃ niyamaḥ kulanandana  |
madbhāvaḥ sarvabhūteṣu manovākkāyasaṃyamaḥ  || 11.17.035 ||
evaṃ bṛhadvratadharo brāhmaṇo'gniriva jvalan  |
madbhaktastīvratapasā dagdhakarmāśayo'malaḥ  || 11.17.036 ||
athānantaramāvekṣyan yathājijñāsitāgamaḥ  |
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā snāyādgurvanumoditaḥ  || 11.17.037 ||
gṛhaṃ vanaṃ vopaviśetpravrajedvā dvijottamaḥ  |
āśramādāśramaṃ gacchennānyathāmatparaścaret || 11.17.038 ||
gṛhārthī sadṛśīṃ bhāryāmudvahedajugupsitām  |
yavīyasīṃ tu vayasā yaṃ savarṇāmanu kramāt || 11.17.039 ||
ijyādhyayanadānāni sarveṣāṃ ca dvijanmanām  |
pratigraho'dhyāpanaṃ ca brāhmaṇasyaiva yājanam  || 11.17.040 ||
pratigrahaṃ manyamānastapastejoyaśonudam  |
anyābhyāmeva jīveta śilairvā doṣadṛktayoḥ  || 11.17.041 ||
brāhmaṇasya hi deho'yaṃ kṣudrakāmāya neṣyate  |
kṛcchrāya tapase ceha pretyānantasukhāya ca  || 11.17.042 ||
śiloñchavṛttyā parituṣṭacitto dharmaṃ mahāntaṃ virajaṃ juṣāṇaḥ  |
mayyarpitātmā gṛha eva tiṣṭhannātiprasaktaḥ samupaiti śāntim  || 11.17.043 ||
samuddharanti ye vipraṃ sīdantaṃ matparāyaṇam  |
tānuddhariṣye na cirādāpadbhyo naurivārṇavāt || 11.17.044 ||
sarvāḥ samuddharedrājā piteva vyasanātprajāḥ  |
ātmānamātmanā dhīro yathā gajapatirgajān  || 11.17.045 ||
evaṃvidho narapatirvimānenārkavarcasā  |
vidhūyehāśubhaṃ kṛtsnamindreṇa saha modate  || 11.17.046 ||
sīdan vipro vaṇigvṛttyā paṇyairevāpadaṃ taret |
khaḍgena vāpadākrānto na śvavṛttyā kathañcana  || 11.17.047 ||
vaiśyavṛttyā tu rājanyo jīvenmṛgayayāpadi  |
caredvā viprarūpeṇa na śvavṛttyā kathañcana  || 11.17.048 ||
śūdravṛttiṃ bhajedvaiśyaḥ śūdraḥ kārukaṭakriyām  |
kṛcchrānmukto na garhyeṇa vṛttiṃ lipseta karmaṇā  || 11.17.049 ||
vedādhyāyasvadhāsvāhā balyannādyairyathodayam  |
devarṣipitṛbhūtāni madrūpāṇyanvahaṃ yajet || 11.17.050 ||
yadṛcchayopapannena śuklenopārjitena vā  |
dhanenāpīḍayan bhṛtyānnyāyenaivāharetkratūn  || 11.17.051 ||
kuṭumbeṣu na sajjeta na pramādyetkuṭumbyapi  |
vipaścinnaśvaraṃ paśyedadṛṣṭamapi dṛṣṭavat || 11.17.052 ||
putradārāptabandhūnāṃ saṅgamaḥ pānthasaṅgamaḥ  |
anudehaṃ viyantyete svapno nidrānugo yathā  || 11.17.053 ||
itthaṃ parimṛśanmukto gṛheṣvatithivadvasan  |
na gṛhairanubadhyeta nirmamo nirahaṅkṛtaḥ  || 11.17.054 ||
karmabhirgṛhamedhīyairiṣṭvā māmeva bhaktimān  |
tiṣṭhedvanaṃ vopaviśetprajāvān vā parivrajet || 11.17.055 ||
yastvāsaktamatirgehe putravittaiṣaṇāturaḥ  |
straiṇaḥ kṛpaṇadhīrmūḍho mamāhamiti badhyate  || 11.17.056 ||
aho me pitarau vṛddhau bhāryā bālātmajātmajāḥ  |
anāthā māmṛte dīnāḥ kathaṃ jīvanti duḥkhitāḥ  || 11.17.057 ||
evaṃ gṛhāśayākṣipta hṛdayo mūḍhadhīrayam  |
atṛptastānanudhyāyanmṛto'ndhaṃ viśate tamaḥ  || 11.17.058 ||
11.18.001|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
vanaṃ vivikṣuḥ putreṣu bhāryāṃ nyasya sahaiva vā  |
vana eva vasecchāntastṛtīyaṃ bhāgamāyuṣaḥ  || 11.18.001 ||
kandamūlaphalairvanyairmedhyairvṛttiṃ prakalpayet |
vasīta valkalaṃ vāsastṛṇaparṇājināni vā  || 11.18.002 ||
keśaromanakhaśmaśru malāni bibhṛyāddataḥ  |
na dhāvedapsu majjeta tri kālaṃ sthaṇḍileśayaḥ  || 11.18.003 ||
grīṣme tapyeta pañcāgnīn varṣāsvāsāraṣāḍjale  |
ākaṇthamagnaḥ śiśira evaṃ vṛttastapaścaret || 11.18.004 ||
agnipakvaṃ samaśnīyātkālapakvamathāpi vā  |
ulūkhalāśmakuṭṭo vā dantolūkhala eva vā  || 11.18.005 ||
svayaṃ sañcinuyātsarvamātmano vṛttikāraṇam  |
deśakālabalābhijño nādadītānyadāhṛtam  || 11.18.006 ||
vanyaiścarupuroḍāśairnirvapetkālacoditān  |
na tu śrautena paśunā māṃ yajeta vanāśramī  || 11.18.007 ||
agnihotraṃ ca darśaśca paurṇamāsaśca pūrvavat |
cāturmāsyāni ca munerāmnātāni ca naigamaiḥ  || 11.18.008 ||
evaṃ cīrṇena tapasā munirdhamanisantataḥ  |
māṃ tapomayamārādhya ṛṣilokādupaiti mām  || 11.18.009 ||
yastvetatkṛcchrataścīrṇaṃ tapo niḥśreyasaṃ mahat |
kāmāyālpīyase yuñjyādbāliśaḥ ko'parastataḥ  || 11.18.010 ||
yadāsau niyame'kalpo jarayā jātavepathuḥ  |
ātmanyagnīn samāropya maccitto'gniṃ samāviśet || 11.18.011 ||
yadā karmavipākeṣu lokeṣu nirayātmasu  |
virāgo jāyate samyaṅnyastāgniḥ pravrajettataḥ  || 11.18.012 ||
iṣṭvā yathopadeśaṃ māṃ dattvā sarvasvamṛtvije  |
agnīn svaprāṇa āveśya nirapekṣaḥ parivrajet || 11.18.013 ||
viprasya vai sannyasato devā dārādirūpiṇaḥ  |
vighnān kurvantyayaṃ hyasmānākramya samiyātparam  || 11.18.014 ||
bibhṛyāccenmunirvāsaḥ kaupīnācchādanaṃ param  |
tyaktaṃ na daṇḍapātrābhyāmanyatkiñcidanāpadi  || 11.18.015 ||
dṛṣṭipūtaṃ nyasetpādaṃ vastrapūtaṃ pibejjalam  |
satyapūtāṃ vadedvācaṃ manaḥpūtaṃ samācaret || 11.18.016 ||
maunānīhānilāyāmā daṇḍā vāgdehacetasām  |
na hyete yasya santyaṅga veṇubhirna bhavedyatiḥ  || 11.18.017 ||
bhikṣāṃ caturṣu varṇeṣu vigarhyān varjayaṃścaret |
saptāgārānasaṅkḷptāṃstuṣyellabdhena tāvatā  || 11.18.018 ||
bahirjalāśayaṃ gatvā tatropaspṛśya vāgyataḥ  |
vibhajya pāvitaṃ śeṣaṃ bhuñjītāśeṣamāhṛtam  || 11.18.019 ||
ekaścarenmahīmetāṃ niḥsaṅgaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ  |
ātmakrīḍa ātmarata ātmavān samadarśanaḥ  || 11.18.020 ||
viviktakṣemaśaraṇo madbhāvavimalāśayaḥ  |
ātmānaṃ cintayedekamabhedena mayā muniḥ  || 11.18.021 ||
anvīkṣetātmano bandhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca jñānaniṣṭhayā  |
bandha indriyavikṣepo mokṣa eṣāṃ ca saṃyamaḥ  || 11.18.022 ||
tasmānniyamya ṣaḍvargaṃ madbhāvena carenmuniḥ  |
viraktaḥ kṣudrakāmebhyo labdhvātmani sukhaṃ mahat || 11.18.023 ||
puragrāmavrajān sārthān bhikṣārthaṃ praviśaṃścaret |
puṇyadeśasaricchaila vanāśramavatīṃ mahīm  || 11.18.024 ||
vānaprasthāśramapadeṣvabhīkṣṇaṃ bhaikṣyamācaret |
saṃsidhyatyāśvasammohaḥ śuddhasattvaḥ śilāndhasā  || 11.18.025 ||
naitadvastutayā paśyeddṛśyamānaṃ vinaśyati  |
asaktacitto viramedihāmutracikīrṣitāt || 11.18.026 ||
yadetadātmani jaganmanovākprāṇasaṃhatam  |
sarvaṃ māyeti tarkeṇa svasthastyaktvā na tatsmaret || 11.18.027 ||
jñānaniṣṭho virakto vā madbhakto vānapekṣakaḥ  |
saliṅgānāśramāṃstyaktvā caredavidhigocaraḥ  || 11.18.028 ||
budho bālakavatkrīḍetkuśalo jaḍavaccaret |
vadedunmattavadvidvān gocaryāṃ naigamaścaret || 11.18.029 ||
vedavādarato na syānna pāṣaṇḍī na haitukaḥ  |
śuṣkavādavivāde na kañcitpakṣaṃ samāśrayet || 11.18.030 ||
nodvijeta janāddhīro janaṃ codvejayenna tu  |
ativādāṃstitikṣeta nāvamanyeta kañcana  |
dehamuddiśya paśuvadvairaṃ kuryānna kenacit || 11.18.031 ||
eka eva paro hyātmā bhūteṣvātmanyavasthitaḥ  |
yathendurudapātreṣu bhūtānyekātmakāni ca  || 11.18.032 ||
alabdhvā na viṣīdeta kāle kāle'śanaṃ kvacit |
labdhvā na hṛṣyeddhṛtimānubhayaṃ daivatantritam  || 11.18.033 ||
āhārārthaṃ samīheta yuktaṃ tatprāṇadhāraṇam  |
tattvaṃ vimṛśyate tena tadvijñāya vimucyate  || 11.18.034 ||
yadṛcchayopapannānnamadyācchreṣṭhamutāparam  |
tathā vāsastathā śayyāṃ prāptaṃ prāptaṃ bhajenmuniḥ  || 11.18.035 ||
śaucamācamanaṃ snānaṃ na tu codanayā caret |
anyāṃśca niyamāñjñānī yathāhaṃ līlayeśvaraḥ  || 11.18.036 ||
na hi tasya vikalpākhyā yā ca madvīkṣayā hatā  |
ādehāntātkvacitkhyātistataḥ sampadyate mayā  || 11.18.037 ||
duḥkhodarkeṣu kāmeṣu jātanirveda ātmavān  |
ajjñāsitamaddharmo muniṃ gurumupavrajet || 11.18.038 ||
tāvatparicaredbhaktaḥ śraddhāvānanasūyakaḥ  |
yāvadbrahma vijānīyānmāmeva gurumādṛtaḥ  || 11.18.039 ||
yastvasaṃyataṣaḍvargaḥ pracaṇḍendriyasārathiḥ  |
jñānavairāgyarahitastridaṇḍamupajīvati  || 11.18.040 ||
surānātmānamātmasthaṃ nihnute māṃ ca dharmahā  |
avipakvakaṣāyo'smādamuṣmācca vihīyate  || 11.18.041 ||
bhikṣordharmaḥ śamo'hiṃsā tapa īkṣā vanaukasaḥ  |
gṛhiṇo bhūtarakṣejyā dvijasyācāryasevanam  || 11.18.042 ||
brahmacaryaṃ tapaḥ śaucaṃ santoṣo bhūtasauhṛdam  |
gṛhasthasyāpyṛtau gantuḥ sarveṣāṃ madupāsanam  || 11.18.043 ||
iti māṃ yaḥ svadharmeṇa bhajennityamananyabhāk |
sarvabhūteṣu madbhāvo madbhaktiṃ vindate dṛḍhām  || 11.18.044 ||
bhaktyoddhavānapāyinyā sarvalokamaheśvaram  |
sarvotpattyapyayaṃ brahma kāraṇaṃ mopayāti saḥ  || 11.18.045 ||
iti svadharmanirṇikta sattvo nirjñātamadgatiḥ  |
jñānavijñānasampanno na cirātsamupaiti mām  || 11.18.046 ||
varṇāśramavatāṃ dharma eṣa ācāralakṣaṇaḥ  |
sa eva madbhaktiyuto niḥśreyasakaraḥ paraḥ  || 11.18.047 ||
etatte'bhihitaṃ sādho bhavān pṛcchati yacca mām  |
yathā svadharmasaṃyukto bhakto māṃ samiyātparam  || 11.18.048 ||
11.19.001|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
yo vidyāśrutasampannaḥ ātmavānnānumānikaḥ  |
mayāmātramidaṃ jñātvā jñānaṃ ca mayi sannyaset || 11.19.001 ||
jñāninastvahameveṣṭaḥ svārtho hetuśca sammataḥ  |
svargaścaivāpavargaśca nānyo'rtho madṛte priyaḥ  || 11.19.002 ||
jñānavijñānasaṃsiddhāḥ padaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vidurmama  |
jñānī priyatamo'to me jñānenāsau bibharti mām  || 11.19.003 ||
tapastīrthaṃ japo dānaṃ pavitrāṇītarāṇi ca  |
nālaṃ kurvanti tāṃ siddhiṃ yā jñānakalayā kṛtā  || 11.19.004 ||
tasmājjñānena sahitaṃ jñātvā svātmānamuddhava  |
jñānavijñānasampanno bhaja māṃ bhaktibhāvataḥ  || 11.19.005 ||
jñānavijñānayajñena māmiṣṭvātmānamātmani  |
sarvayajñapatiṃ māṃ vai saṃsiddhiṃ munayo'gaman  || 11.19.006 ||
tvayyuddhavāśrayati yastrividho vikāro   māyāntarāpatati nādyapavargayoryat |
janmādayo'sya yadamī tava tasya kiṃ syur  ādyantayoryadasato'sti tadeva madhye  || 11.19.007 ||*
11.19.008|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
jñānaṃ viśuddhaṃ vipulaṃ yathaitadvairāgyavijñānayutaṃ purāṇam  |
ākhyāhi viśveśvara viśvamūrte tvadbhaktiyogaṃ ca mahadvimṛgyam  || 11.19.008 ||
tāpatrayeṇābhihatasya ghore santapyamānasya bhavādhvanīśa  |
paśyāmi nānyaccharaṇaṃ tavāṅghri dvandvātapatrādamṛtābhivarṣāt || 11.19.009 ||
daṣṭaṃ janaṃ sampatitaṃ bile'smin kālāhinā kṣudrasukhorutarṣam  |
samuddharainaṃ kṛpayāpavargyairvacobhirāsiñca mahānubhāva  || 11.19.010 ||
11.19.011|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
itthametatpurā rājā bhīṣmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varam  |
ajātaśatruḥ papraccha sarveṣāṃ no'nuśṛṇvatām  || 11.19.011 ||
nivṛtte bhārate yuddhe suhṛnnidhanavihvalaḥ  |
śrutvā dharmān bahūn paścānmokṣadharmānapṛcchata  || 11.19.012 ||
tānahaṃ te'bhidhāsyāmi devavratamakhācchrutān  |
jñānavairāgyavijñāna śraddhābhaktyupabṛṃhitān  || 11.19.013 ||
navaikādaśa pañca trīn bhāvān bhūteṣu yena vai  |
īkṣetāthāikamapyeṣu tajjñānaṃ mama niścitam  || 11.19.014 ||
etadeva hi vijñānaṃ na tathaikena yena yat |
sthityutpattyapyayān paśyedbhāvānāṃ triguṇātmanām  || 11.19.015 ||
ādāvante ca madhye ca sṛjyātsṛjyaṃ yadanviyāt |
punastatpratisaṅkrāme yacchiṣyeta tadeva sat || 11.19.016 ||
śrutiḥ pratyakṣamaitihyamanumānaṃ catuṣṭayam  |
pramāṇeṣvanavasthānādvikalpātsa virajyate  || 11.19.017 ||
karmaṇāṃ pariṇāmitvādāviriñcyādamaṅgalam  |
vipaścinnaśvaraṃ paśyedadṛṣṭamapi dṛṣṭavat || 11.19.018 ||
bhaktiyogaḥ puraivoktaḥ prīyamāṇāya te'nagha  |
punaśca kathayiṣyāmi madbhakteḥ kāraṇaṃ paraṃ  || 11.19.019 ||
śraddhāmṛtakathāyāṃ me śaśvanmadanukīrtanam  |
pariniṣṭhā ca pūjāyāṃ stutibhiḥ stavanaṃ mama  || 11.19.020 ||
ādaraḥ paricaryāyāṃ sarvāṅgairabhivandanam  |
madbhaktapūjābhyadhikā sarvabhūteṣu manmatiḥ  || 11.19.021 ||
madartheṣvaṅgaceṣṭā ca vacasā madguṇeraṇam  |
mayyarpaṇaṃ ca manasaḥ sarvakāmavivarjanam  || 11.19.022 ||
madarthe'rthaparityāgo bhogasya ca sukhasya ca  |
iṣṭaṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ madarthaṃ yadvrataṃ tapaḥ  || 11.19.023 ||
evaṃ dharmairmanuṣyāṇāmuddhavātmanivedinām  |
mayi sañjāyate bhaktiḥ ko'nyo'rtho'syāvaśiṣyate  || 11.19.024 ||
yadātmanyarpitaṃ cittaṃ śāntaṃ sattvopabṛṃhitam  |
dharmaṃ jñānaṃ sa vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ cābhipadyate  || 11.19.025 ||
yadarpitaṃ tadvikalpe indriyaiḥ paridhāvati  |
rajasvalaṃ cāsanniṣṭhaṃ cittaṃ viddhi viparyayam  || 11.19.026 ||
dharmo madbhaktikṛtprokto jñānaṃ caikātmyadarśanam  |
guṇesvasaṅgo vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ cāṇimādayaḥ  || 11.19.027 ||
śrīuddhava uvāca yamaḥ katividhaḥ prokto  |
niyamo vārikarṣaṇa kaḥ śamaḥ ko damaḥ kṛṣṇa  || 11.19.028 ||
kā titikṣā dhṛtiḥ prabho kiṃ dānaṃ kiṃ tapaḥ śauryaṃ  |
kiṃ satyamṛtamucyate kastyāgaḥ kiṃ dhanaṃ ceṣṭaṃ  || 11.19.029 ||
ko yajñaḥ kā ca dakṣiṇā puṃsaḥ kiṃ svidbalaṃ śrīman  |
bhago lābhaśca keśava kā vidyā hrīḥ parā kā śrīḥ  || 11.19.030 ||
kiṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhameva ca kaḥ paṇḍitaḥ kaśca mūrkhaḥ  |
kaḥ panthā utpathaśca kaḥ kaḥ svargo narakaḥ kaḥ svit || 11.19.031 ||
ko bandhuruta kiṃ gṛhaṃ ka āḍhyaḥ ko daridro vā  |
kṛpaṇaḥ kaḥ ka īśvaraḥ etān praśnānmama brūhi  |
viparītāṃśca satpate śrībhagavānuvāca  || 11.19.032 ||
ahiṃsā satyamasteyamasaṅgo hrīrasañcayaḥ  |
āstikyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ ca maunaṃ sthairyaṃ kṣamābhayam  || 11.19.033 ||
śaucaṃ japastapo homaḥ śraddhātithyaṃ madarcanam  |
tīrthāṭanaṃ parārthehā tuṣṭirācāryasevanam  || 11.19.034 ||
ete yamāḥ saniyamā ubhayordvādaśa smṛtāḥ  |
puṃsāmupāsitāstāta yathākāmaṃ duhanti hi  || 11.19.035 ||
śamo manniṣṭhatā buddherdama indriyasaṃyamaḥ  |
titikṣā duḥkhasammarṣo jihvopasthajayo dhṛtiḥ  || 11.19.036 ||
daṇḍanyāsaḥ paraṃ dānaṃ kāmatyāgastapaḥ smṛtam  |
svabhāvavijayaḥ śauryaṃ satyaṃ ca samadarśanam  || 11.19.037 ||
anyacca sunṛtā vāṇī kavibhiḥ parikīrtitā  |
karmasvasaṅgamaḥ śaucaṃ tyāgaḥ sannyāsa ucyate  || 11.19.038 ||
dharma iṣṭaṃ dhanaṃ nṝṇāṃ yajño'haṃ bhagavattamaḥ  |
dakṣiṇā jñānasandeśaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ paraṃ balam  || 11.19.039 ||
bhago ma aiśvaro bhāvo lābho madbhaktiruttamaḥ  |
vidyātmani bhidābādho jugupsā hrīrakarmasu  || 11.19.040 ||
śrīrguṇā nairapekṣyādyāḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhasukhātyayaḥ  |
duḥkhaṃ kāmasukhāpekṣā paṇḍito bandhamokṣavit || 11.19.041 ||
mūrkho dehādyahaṃbuddhiḥ panthā mannigamaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
utpathaścittavikṣepaḥ svargaḥ sattvaguṇodayaḥ  || 11.19.042 ||
narakastamaunnāho bandhurgururahaṃ sakhe  |
gṛhaṃ śarīraṃ mānuṣyaṃ guṇāḍhyo hyāḍhya ucyate  || 11.19.043 ||
daridro yastvasantuṣṭaḥ kṛpaṇo yo'jitendriyaḥ  |
guṇeṣvasaktadhīrīśo guṇasaṅgo viparyayaḥ  || 11.19.044 ||
eta uddhava te praśnāḥ sarve sādhu nirūpitāḥ  |
kiṃ varṇitena bahunā lakṣaṇaṃ guṇadoṣayoḥ  |
guṇadoṣadṛśirdoṣo guṇastūbhayavarjitaḥ  || 11.19.045 ||
11.20.001|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
vidhiśca pratiṣedhaśca nigamo hīśvarasya te  |
avekṣate'raviṇḍākṣa guṇaṃ doṣaṃ ca karmaṇām  || 11.20.001 ||
varṇāśramavikalpaṃ ca pratilomānulomajam  |
dravyadeśavayaḥkālān svargaṃ narakameva ca  || 11.20.002 ||
guṇadoṣabhidādṛṣṭimantareṇa vacastava  |
niḥśreyasaṃ kathaṃ nṝṇāṃ niṣedhavidhilakṣaṇam  || 11.20.003 ||
pitṛdevamanuṣyānāṃ vedaścakṣustaveśvara  |
śreyastvanupalabdhe'rthe sādhyasādhanayorapi  || 11.20.004 ||
guṇadoṣabhidādṛṣṭirnigamātte na hi svataḥ  |
nigamenāpavādaśca bhidāyā iti ha bhramaḥ  || 11.20.005 ||
11.20.006|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
yogāstrayo mayā proktā nṝṇāṃ śreyovidhitsayā  |
jñānaṃ karma ca bhaktiśca nopāyo'nyo'sti kutracit || 11.20.006 ||
nirviṇṇānāṃ jñānayogo nyāsināmiha karmasu  |
teṣvanirviṇṇacittānāṃ karmayogastu kāminām  || 11.20.007 ||
yadṛcchayā matkathādau jātaśraddhastu yaḥ pumān  |
na nirviṇṇo nātisakto bhaktiyogo'sya siddhidaḥ  || 11.20.008 ||
tāvatkarmāṇi kurvīta na nirvidyeta yāvatā  |
matkathāśravaṇādau vā śraddhā yāvanna jāyate  || 11.20.009 ||
svadharmastho yajan yajñairanāśīḥkāma uddhava  |
na yāti svarganarakau yadyanyanna samācaret || 11.20.010 ||
asmiṃlloke vartamānaḥ svadharmastho'naghaḥ śuciḥ  |
jñānaṃ viśuddhamāpnoti madbhaktiṃ vā yadṛcchayā  || 11.20.011 ||
svargiṇo'pyetamicchanti lokaṃ nirayiṇastathā  |
sādhakaṃ jñānabhaktibhyāmubhayaṃ tadasādhakam  || 11.20.012 ||
na naraḥ svargatiṃ kāṅkṣennārakīṃ vā vicakṣaṇaḥ  |
nemaṃ lokaṃ ca kāṅkṣeta dehāveśātpramādyati  || 11.20.013 ||
etadvidvān purā mṛtyorabhavāya ghaṭeta saḥ  |
apramatta idaṃ jñātvā martyamapyarthasiddhidam  || 11.20.014 ||
chidyamānaṃ yamairetaiḥ kṛtanīḍaṃ vanaspatim  |
khagaḥ svaketamutsṛjya kṣemaṃ yāti hyalampaṭaḥ  || 11.20.015 ||
ahorātraiśchidyamānaṃ buddhvāyurbhayavepathuḥ  |
muktasaṅgaḥ paraṃ buddhvā nirīha upaśāmyati  || 11.20.016 ||
nṛdehamādyaṃ sulabhaṃ sudurlabhaṃ   plavaṃ sukalpaṃ gurukarṇadhāram  |
mayānukūlena nabhasvateritaṃ   pumān bhavābdhiṃ na taretsa ātmahā  || 11.20.017 ||*
yadārambheṣu nirviṇṇo viraktaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ  |
abhyāsenātmano yogī dhārayedacalaṃ manaḥ  || 11.20.018 ||
dhāryamāṇaṃ mano yarhi bhrāmyadaśvanavasthitam  |
atandrito'nurodhena mārgeṇātmavaśaṃ nayet || 11.20.019 ||
manogatiṃ na visṛjejjitaprāṇo jitendriyaḥ  |
sattvasampannayā buddhyā mana ātmavaśaṃ nayet || 11.20.020 ||
eṣa vai paramo yogo manasaḥ saṅgrahaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
hṛdayajñatvamanvicchan damyasyevārvato muhuḥ  || 11.20.021 ||
sāṅkhyena sarvabhāvānāṃ pratilomānulomataḥ  |
bhavāpyayāvanudhyāyenmano yāvatprasīdati  || 11.20.022 ||
nirviṇṇasya viraktasya puruṣasyoktavedinaḥ  |
manastyajati daurātmyaṃ cintitasyānucintayā  || 11.20.023 ||
yamādibhiryogapathairānvīkṣikyā ca vidyayā  |
mamārcopāsanābhirvā nānyairyogyaṃ smarenmanaḥ  || 11.20.024 ||
yadi kuryātpramādena yogī karma vigarhitam  |
yogenaiva dahedaṃho nānyattatra kadācana  || 11.20.025 ||

yathorṇanābhirhṛdayādūrṇāmudvamate mukhāt |

chandomayo'mṛtamayaḥ sahasrapadavīṃ prabhuḥ  |

gāyatryuṣṇiganuṣṭupca bṛhatī paṅktireva ca  |

11.22.001|0 śrīuddhava uvāca

11.22.004|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
yuktaṃ ca santi sarvatra bhāṣante brāhmaṇā yathā  |

11.23.001|0 śrībādarāyaṇiruvāca
sa evamāśaṃsita uddhavena bhāgavatamukhyena dāśārhamukhyaḥ  |
sabhājayan bhṛtyavaco mukundastamābabhāṣe śravaṇīyavīryaḥ  || 11.23.001 ||
11.23.002|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
bārhaspatya sa nāstyatra sādhurvai durjaneritaiḥ  |
duraktairbhinnamātmānaṃ yaḥ samādhātumīśvaraḥ  || 11.23.002 ||
na tathā tapyate viddhaḥ pumān bāṇaistu marmagaiḥ  |
yathā tudanti marmasthā hyasatāṃ paruṣeṣavaḥ  || 11.23.003 ||
kathayanti mahatpuṇyamitihāsamihoddhava  |
tamahaṃ varṇayiṣyāmi nibodha susamāhitaḥ  || 11.23.004 ||
kenacidbhikṣuṇā gītaṃ paribhūtena durjanaiḥ  |
smaratā dhṛtiyuktena vipākaṃ nijakarmaṇām  || 11.23.005 ||
avantiṣu dvijaḥ kaścidāsīdāḍhyatamaḥ śriyā  |
vārtāvṛttiḥ kadaryastu kāmī lubdho'tikopanaḥ  || 11.23.006 ||
jñātayo'tithayastasya vāṅmātreṇāpi nārcitāḥ  |
śūnyāvasatha ātmāpi kāle kāmairanarcitaḥ  || 11.23.007 ||
duhśīlasya kadaryasya druhyante putrabāndhavāḥ  |
dārā duhitaro bhṛtyā viṣaṇṇā nācaran priyam  || 11.23.008 ||
tasyaivaṃ yakṣavittasya cyutasyobhayalokataḥ  |
dharmakāmavihīnasya cukrudhuḥ pañcabhāginaḥ  || 11.23.009 ||
tadavadhyānavisrasta puṇyaskandhasya bhūrida  |
artho'pyagacchannidhanaṃ bahvāyāsapariśramaḥ  || 11.23.010 ||
jñātyo jagṛhuḥ kiñcitkiñciddasyava uddhava  |
daivataḥ kālataḥ kiñcidbrahmabandhornṛpārthivāt || 11.23.011 ||
sa evaṃ draviṇe naṣṭe dharmakāmavivarjitaḥ  |
upekṣitaśca svajanaiścintāmāpa duratyayām  || 11.23.012 ||
tasyaivaṃ dhyāyato dīrghaṃ naṣṭarāyastapasvinaḥ  |
khidyato bāṣpakaṇṭhasya nirvedaḥ sumahānabhūt || 11.23.013 ||
sa cāhedamaho kaṣṭaṃ vṛthātmā me'nutāpitaḥ  |
na dharmāya na kāmāya yasyārthāyāsa īdṛśaḥ  || 11.23.014 ||
prāyeṇāthāḥ kadaryāṇāṃ na sukhāya kadācana  |
iha cātmopatāpāya mṛtasya narakāya ca  || 11.23.015 ||
yaśo yaśasvināṃ śuddhaṃ ślāghyā ye guṇināṃ guṇāḥ  |
lobhaḥ svalpo'pi tān hanti śvitro rūpamivepsitam  || 11.23.016 ||
arthasya sādhane siddhe utkarṣe rakṣaṇe vyaye  |
nāśopabhoga āyāsastrāsaścintā bhramo nṛṇām  || 11.23.017 ||
steyaṃ hiṃsānṛtaṃ dambhaḥ kāmaḥ krodhaḥ smayo madaḥ  |
bhedo vairamaviśvāsaḥ saṃspardhā vyasanāni ca  || 11.23.018 ||
ete pañcadaśānarthā hyarthamūlā matā nṛṇām  |
tasmādanarthamarthākhyaṃ śreyo'rthī dūratastyajet || 11.23.019 ||
bhidyante bhrātaro dārāḥ pitaraḥ suhṛdastathā  |
ekāsnigdhāḥ kākiṇinā sadyaḥ sarve'rayaḥ kṛtāḥ  || 11.23.020 ||
arthenālpīyasā hyete saṃrabdhā dīptamanyavaḥ  |
tyajantyāśu spṛdho ghnanti sahasotsṛjya sauhṛdam  || 11.23.021 ||
labdhvā janmāmaraprārthyaṃ mānuṣyaṃ taddvijāgryatām  |
tadanādṛtya ye svārthaṃ ghnanti yāntyaśubhāṃ gatim  || 11.23.022 ||
svargāpavargayordvāraṃ prāpya lokamimaṃ pumān  |
draviṇe ko'nuṣajjeta martyo'narthasya dhāmani  || 11.23.023 ||
devarṣipitṛbhūtāni jñātīn bandhūṃśca bhāginaḥ  |
asaṃvibhajya cātmānaṃ yakṣavittaḥ patatyadhaḥ  || 11.23.024 ||
vyarthayārthehayā vittaṃ pramattasya vayo balam  |
kuśalā yena sidhyanti jaraṭhaḥ kiṃ nu sādhaye  || 11.23.025 ||
kasmātsaṅkliśyate vidvān vyarthayārthehayāsakṛt |
kasyacinmāyayā nūnaṃ loko'yaṃ suvimohitaḥ  || 11.23.026 ||
kiṃ dhanairdhanadairvā kiṃ kāmairvā kāmadairuta  |
mṛtyunā grasyamānasya karmabhirvota janmadaiḥ  || 11.23.027 ||
nūnaṃ me bhagavāṃstuṣṭaḥ sarvadevamayo hariḥ  |
yena nīto daśāmetāṃ nirvedaścātmanaḥ plavaḥ  || 11.23.028 ||
so'haṃ kālāvaśeṣeṇa śoṣayiṣye'ṅgamātmanaḥ  |
apramatto'khilasvārthe yadi syātsiddha ātmani  || 11.23.029 ||
tatra māmanumoderan devāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ  |
muhūrtena brahmalokaṃ khaṭvāṅgaḥ samasādhayat || 11.23.030 ||
11.23.031|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
ityabhipretya manasā hyāvantyo dvijasattamaḥ  |
unmucya hṛdayagranthīn śānto bhikṣurabhūnmuniḥ  || 11.23.031 ||
sa cacāra mahīmetāṃ saṃyatātmendriyānilaḥ  |
bhikṣārthaṃ nagaragrāmānasaṅgo'lakṣito'viśat || 11.23.032 ||
taṃ vai pravayasaṃ bhikṣumavadhūtamasajjanāḥ  |
dṛṣṭvā paryabhavan bhadra bahvībhiḥ paribhūtibhiḥ  || 11.23.033 ||
kecittriveṇuṃ jagṛhureke pātraṃ kamaṇḍalum  |
pīṭhaṃ caike'kṣasūtraṃ ca kanthāṃ cīrāṇi kecana  |
pradāya ca punastāni darśitānyādadurmuneḥ  || 11.23.034 ||
annaṃ ca bhaikṣyasampannaṃ bhuñjānasya sarittaṭe  |
mūtrayanti ca pāpiṣṭhāḥ ṣṭhīvantyasya ca mūrdhani  || 11.23.035 ||
yatavācaṃ vācayanti tāḍayanti na vakti cet |
tarjayantyapare vāgbhiḥ steno'yamiti vādinaḥ  |
badhnanti rajjvā taṃ kecidbadhyatāṃ badhyatāmiti  || 11.23.036 ||
kṣipantyeke'vajānanta eṣa dharmadhvajaḥ śaṭhaḥ  |
kṣīṇavitta imāṃ vṛttimagrahītsvajanojjhitaḥ  || 11.23.037 ||
aho eṣa mahāsāro dhṛtimān girirāḍiva  |
maunena sādhayatyarthaṃ bakavaddṛḍhaniścayaḥ  || 11.23.038 ||
ityeke vihasantyenameke durvātayanti ca  |
taṃ babandhurnirurudhuryathā krīḍanakaṃ dvijam  || 11.23.039 ||
evaṃ sa bhautikaṃ duḥkhaṃ daivikaṃ daihikaṃ ca yat |
bhoktavyamātmano diṣṭaṃ prāptaṃ prāptamabudhyata  || 11.23.040 ||
paribhūta imāṃ gāthāmagāyata narādhamaiḥ  |
pātayadbhiḥ sva dharmastho dhṛtimāsthāya sāttvikīm  || 11.23.041 ||
11.23.042|0 dvija uvāca
nāyaṃ jano me sukhaduḥkhaheturna devatātmā grahakarmakālāḥ  |
manaḥ paraṃ kāraṇamāmananti saṃsāracakraṃ parivartayedyat || 11.23.042 ||
mano guṇān vai sṛjate balīyastataśca karmāṇi vilakṣaṇāni  |
śuklāni kṛṣṇānyatha lohitāni tebhyaḥ savarṇāḥ sṛtayo bhavanti  || 11.23.043 ||
anīha ātmā manasā samīhatā hiraṇmayo matsakha udvicaṣṭe  |
manaḥ svaliṅgaṃ parigṛhya kāmān juṣannibaddho guṇasaṅgato'sau  || 11.23.044 ||
dānaṃ svadharmo niyamo yamaśca śrutaṃ ca karmāṇi ca sadvratāni  |
sarve manonigrahalakṣaṇāntāḥ paro hi yogo manasaḥ samādhiḥ  || 11.23.045 ||
samāhitaṃ yasya manaḥ praśāntaṃ dānādibhiḥ kiṃ vada tasya kṛtyam  |
asaṃyataṃ yasya mano vinaśyaddānādibhiścedaparaṃ kimebhiḥ  || 11.23.046 ||
manovaśe'nye hyabhavan sma devā manaśca nānyasya vaśaṃ sameti  |
bhīṣmo hi devaḥ sahasaḥ sahīyān yuñjyādvaśe taṃ sa hi devadevaḥ  || 11.23.047 ||
taṃ durjayaṃ śatrumasahyavegamaruntudaṃ tanna vijitya kecit |
kurvantyasadvigrahamatra martyairmitrāṇyudāsīnaripūn vimūḍhāḥ  || 11.23.048 ||
dehaṃ manomātramimaṃ gṛhītvā mamāhamityandhadhiyo manuṣyāḥ  |
eṣo'hamanyo'yamiti bhrameṇa durantapāre tamasi bhramanti  || 11.23.049 ||
janastu hetuḥ sukhaduḥkhayoścetkimātmanaścātra hi bhaumayostat |
jihvāṃ kvacitsandaśati svadadbhistadvedanāyāṃ katamāya kupyet || 11.23.050 ||
duḥkhasya heturyadi devatāstu kimātmanastatra vikārayostat |
yadaṅgamaṅgena nihanyate kvacitkrudhyeta kasmai puruṣaḥ svadehe  || 11.23.051 ||
ātmā yadi syātsukhaduḥkhahetuḥ kimanyatastatra nijasvabhāvaḥ  |
na hyātmano'nyadyadi tanmṛṣā syātkrudhyeta kasmānna sukhaṃ na duḥkham  || 11.23.052 ||
grahā nimittaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoścetkimātmano'jasya janasya te vai  |
grahairgrahasyaiva vadanti pīḍāṃ krudhyeta kasmai puruṣastato'nyaḥ  || 11.23.053 ||
karmāstu hetuḥ sukhaduḥkhayoścetkimātmanastaddhi jaḍājaḍatve  |
dehastvacitpuruṣo'yaṃ suparṇaḥ krudhyeta kasmai na hi karma mūlam  || 11.23.054 ||
kālastu hetuḥ sukhaduḥkhayoścetkimātmanastatra tadātmako'sau  |
nāgnerhi tāpo na himasya tatsyātkrudhyeta kasmai na parasya dvandvam  || 11.23.055 ||
na kenacitkvāpi kathañcanāsya dvandvoparāgaḥ parataḥ parasya  |
yathāhamaḥ saṃsṛtirūpiṇaḥ syādevaṃ prabuddho na bibheti bhūtaiḥ  || 11.23.056 ||
etāṃ sa āsthāya parātmaniṣṭhāmadhyāsitāṃ pūrvatamairmaharṣibhiḥ  |
ahaṃ tariṣyāmi durantapāraṃ tamo mukundāṅghriniṣevayaiva  || 11.23.057 ||
11.23.058|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
nirvidya naṣṭadraviṇe gataklamaḥ pravrajya gāṃ paryaṭamāna ittham  |
nirākṛto'sadbhirapi svadharmādakampito'mūṃ munirāha gāthām  || 11.23.058 ||
sukhaduḥkhaprado nānyaḥ puruṣasyātmavibhramaḥ  |
mitrodāsīnaripavaḥ saṃsārastamasaḥ kṛtaḥ  || 11.23.059 ||
tasmātsarvātmanā tāta nigṛhāṇa mano dhiyā  |
mayyāveśitayā yukta etāvān yogasaṅgrahaḥ  || 11.23.060 ||
ya etāṃ bhikṣuṇā gītāṃ brahmaniṣṭhāṃ samāhitaḥ  |
dhārayañchrāvayañchṛṇvan dvandvairnaivābhibhūyate  || 11.23.061 ||
11.24.001|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
atha te sampravakṣyāmi sāṅkhyaṃ pūrvairviniścitam  |
yadvijñāya pumān sadyo jahyādvaikalpikaṃ bhramam  || 11.24.001 ||
āsījjñānamatho artha ekamevāvikalpitam  |
yadā vivekanipuṇā ādau kṛtayuge'yuge  || 11.24.002 ||
tanmāyāphalarūpeṇa kevalaṃ nirvikalpitam  |
vāṅmano'gocaraṃ satyaṃ dvidhā samabhavadbṛhat || 11.24.003 ||
tayorekataro hyarthaḥ prakṛtiḥ sobhayātmikā  |
jñānaṃ tvanyatamo bhāvaḥ puruṣaḥ so'bhidhīyate  || 11.24.004 ||
tamo rajaḥ sattvamiti prakṛterabhavan guṇāḥ  |
mayā prakṣobhyamāṇāyāḥ puruṣānumatena ca  || 11.24.005 ||
tebhyaḥ samabhavatsūtraṃ mahān sūtreṇa saṃyutaḥ  |
tato vikurvato jāto yo'haṅkāro vimohanaḥ  || 11.24.006 ||
vaikārikastaijasaśca tāmasaścetyahaṃ trivṛt |
tanmātrendriyamanasāṃ kāraṇaṃ cidacinmayaḥ  || 11.24.007 ||
arthastanmātrikājjajñe tāmasādindriyāṇi ca  |
taijasāddevatā āsannekādaśa ca vaikṛtāt || 11.24.008 ||
mayā sañcoditā bhāvāḥ sarve saṃhatyakāriṇaḥ  |
aṇḍamutpādayāmāsurmamāyatanamuttamam  || 11.24.009 ||
tasminnahaṃ samabhavamaṇḍe salilasaṃsthitau  |
mama nābhyāmabhūtpadmaṃ viśvākhyaṃ tatra cātmabhūḥ  || 11.24.010 ||
so'sṛjattapasā yukto rajasā madanugrahāt |
lokān sapālān viśvātmā bhūrbhuvaḥ svariti tridhā  || 11.24.011 ||
devānāmoka āsītsvarbhūtānāṃ ca bhuvaḥ padam  |
martyādīnāṃ ca bhūrlokaḥ siddhānāṃ tritayātparam  || 11.24.012 ||
adho'surāṇāṃ nāgānāṃ bhūmeroko'sṛjatprabhuḥ  |
trilokyāṃ gatayaḥ sarvāḥ karmaṇāṃ triguṇātmanām  || 11.24.013 ||
yogasya tapasaścaiva nyāsasya gatayo'malāḥ  |
maharjanastapaḥ satyaṃ bhaktiyogasya madgatiḥ  || 11.24.014 ||
mayā kālātmanā dhātrā karmayuktamidaṃ jagat |
guṇapravāha etasminnunmajjati nimajjati  || 11.24.015 ||
aṇurbṛhatkṛśaḥ sthūlo yo yo bhāvaḥ prasidhyati  |
sarvo'pyubhayasaṃyuktaḥ prakṛtyā puruṣeṇa ca  || 11.24.016 ||
yastu yasyādirantaśca sa vai madhyaṃ ca tasya san  |
vikāro vyavahārārtho yathā taijasapārthivāḥ  || 11.24.017 ||
yadupādāya pūrvastu bhāvo vikurute'param  |
ādiranto yadā yasya tatsatyamabhidhīyate  || 11.24.018 ||
prakṛtiryasyopādānamādhāraḥ puruṣaḥ paraḥ  |
sato'bhivyañjakaḥ kālo brahma tattritayaṃ tvaham  || 11.24.019 ||
sargaḥ pravartate tāvatpaurvāparyeṇa nityaśaḥ  |
mahān guṇavisargārthaḥ sthityanto yāvadīkṣaṇam  || 11.24.020 ||
virāṇmayāsādyamāno lokakalpavikalpakaḥ  |
pañcatvāya viśeṣāya kalpate bhuvanaiḥ saha  || 11.24.021 ||
anne pralīyate martyamannaṃ dhānāsu līyate  |
dhānā bhūmau pralīyante bhūmirgandhe pralīyate  || 11.24.022 ||
apsu pralīyate gandha āpaśca svaguṇe rase  |
līyate jyotiṣi raso jyotī rūpe pralīyate  || 11.24.023 ||
rūpaṃ vāyau sa ca sparśe līyate so'pi cāmbare  |
ambaraṃ śabdatanmātra indriyāṇi svayoniṣu  || 11.24.024 ||
yonirvaikārike saumya līyate manasīśvare  |
śabdo bhūtādimapyeti bhūtādirmahati prabhuḥ  || 11.24.025 ||
sa līyate mahān sveṣu guṇesu guṇavattamaḥ  |
te'vyakte sampralīyante tatkāle līyate'vyaye  || 11.24.026 ||
kālo māyāmaye jīve jīva ātmani mayyaje  |
ātmā kevala ātmastho vikalpāpāyalakṣaṇaḥ  || 11.24.027 ||
evamanvīkṣamāṇasya kathaṃ vaikalpiko bhramaḥ  |
manaso hṛdi tiṣṭheta vyomnīvārkodaye tamaḥ  || 11.24.028 ||
eṣa sāṅkhyavidhiḥ proktaḥ saṃśayagranthibhedanaḥ  |
pratilomānulomābhyāṃ parāvaradṛśa mayā  || 11.24.029 ||
11.25.001|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
guṇānāmasammiśrāṇāṃ pumān yena yathā bhavet |
tanme puruṣavaryedamupadhāraya śaṃsataḥ  || 11.25.001 ||
śamo damastitikṣekṣā tapaḥ satyaṃ dayā smṛtiḥ  |
tuṣṭistyāgo'spṛhā śraddhā hrīrdayādiḥ svanirvṛtiḥ  || 11.25.002 ||
kāma īhā madastṛṣṇā stambha āśīrbhidā sukham  |
madotsāho yaśaḥprītirhāsyaṃ vīryaṃ balodyamaḥ  || 11.25.003 ||
krodho lobho'nṛtaṃ hiṃsā yācñā dambhaḥ klamaḥ kaliḥ  |
śokamohau viṣādārtī nidrāśā bhīranudyamaḥ  || 11.25.004 ||
sattvasya rajasaścaitāstamasaścānupūrvaśaḥ  |
vṛttayo varṇitaprāyāḥ sannipātamatho śṛṇu  || 11.25.005 ||
sannipātastvahamiti mametyuddhava yā matiḥ  |
vyavahāraḥ sannipāto manomātrendriyāsubhiḥ  || 11.25.006 ||
dharme cārthe ca kāme ca yadāsau pariniṣṭhitaḥ  |
guṇānāṃ sannikarṣo'yaṃ śraddhāratidhanāvahaḥ  || 11.25.007 ||
pravṛttilakṣaṇe niṣṭhā pumān yarhi gṛhāśrame  |
svadharme cānu tiṣṭheta guṇānāṃ samitirhi sā  || 11.25.008 ||
puruṣaṃ sattvasaṃyuktamanumīyācchamādibhiḥ  |
kāmādibhī rajoyuktaṃ krodhādyaistamasā yutam  || 11.25.009 ||
yadā bhajati māṃ bhaktyā nirapekṣaḥ svakarmabhiḥ  |
taṃ sattvaprakṛtiṃ vidyātpuruṣaṃ striyameva vā  || 11.25.010 ||
yadā āśiṣa āśāsya māṃ bhajeta svakarmabhiḥ  |
taṃ rajaḥprakṛtiṃ vidyāthiṃsāmāśāsya tāmasam  || 11.25.011 ||
sattvaṃ rajastama iti guṇā jīvasya naiva me  |
cittajā yaistu bhūtānāṃ sajjamāno nibadhyate  || 11.25.012 ||
yadetarau jayetsattvaṃ bhāsvaraṃ viśadaṃ śivam  |
tadā sukhena yujyeta dharmajñānādibhiḥ pumān  || 11.25.013 ||
yadā jayettamaḥ sattvaṃ rajaḥ saṅgaṃ bhidā calam  |
tadā duḥkhena yujyeta karmaṇā yaśasā śriyā  || 11.25.014 ||
yadā jayedrajaḥ sattvaṃ tamo mūḍhaṃ layaṃ jaḍam  |
yujyeta śokamohābhyāṃ nidrayā hiṃsayāśayā  || 11.25.015 ||
yadā cittaṃ prasīdeta indriyāṇāṃ ca nirvṛtiḥ  |
dehe'bhayaṃ mano'saṅgaṃ tatsattvaṃ viddhi matpadam  || 11.25.016 ||
vikurvan kriyayā cādhīranivṛttiśca cetasām  |
gātrāsvāsthyaṃ mano bhrāntaṃ raja etairniśāmaya  || 11.25.017 ||
sīdaccittaṃ vilīyeta cetaso grahaṇe'kṣamam  |
mano naṣṭaṃ tamo glānistamastadupadhāraya  || 11.25.018 ||
edhamāne guṇe sattve devānāṃ balamedhate  |
asurāṇāṃ ca rajasi tamasyuddhava rakṣasām  || 11.25.019 ||
sattvājjāgaraṇaṃ vidyādrajasā svapnamādiśet |
prasvāpaṃ tamasā jantosturīyaṃ triṣu santatam  || 11.25.020 ||
uparyupari gacchanti sattvena brāhmaṇā janāḥ  |
tamasādho'dha āmukhyādrajasāntaracāriṇaḥ  || 11.25.021 ||
sattve pralīnāḥ svaryānti naralokaṃ rajolayāḥ  |
tamolayāstu nirayaṃ yānti māmeva nirguṇāḥ  || 11.25.022 ||
madarpaṇaṃ niṣphalaṃ vā sāttvikaṃ nijakarma tat |
rājasaṃ phalasaṅkalpaṃ hiṃsāprāyādi tāmasam  || 11.25.023 ||
kaivalyaṃ sāttvikaṃ jñānaṃ rajo vaikalpikaṃ ca yat |
prākṛtaṃ tāmasaṃ jñānaṃ manniṣṭhaṃ nirguṇaṃ smṛtam  || 11.25.024 ||
vanaṃ tu sāttviko vāso grāmo rājasa ucyate  |
tāmasaṃ dyūtasadanaṃ manniketaṃ tu nirguṇam  || 11.25.025 ||
sāttvikaḥ kārako'saṅgī rāgāndho rājasaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
tāmasaḥ smṛtivibhraṣṭo nirguṇo madapāśrayaḥ  || 11.25.026 ||
sāttvikyādhyātmikī śraddhā karmaśraddhā tu rājasī  |
tāmasyadharme yā śraddhā matsevāyāṃ tu nirguṇā  || 11.25.027 ||
pathyaṃ pūtamanāyastamāhāryaṃ sāttvikaṃ smṛtam  |
rājasaṃ cendriyapreṣṭhaṃ tāmasaṃ cārtidāśuci  || 11.25.028 ||
sāttvikaṃ sukhamātmotthaṃ viṣayotthaṃ tu rājasam  |
tāmasaṃ mohadainyotthaṃ nirguṇaṃ madapāśrayam  || 11.25.029 ||
dravyaṃ deśaḥ phalaṃ kālo jñānaṃ karma ca kārakaḥ  |
śraddhāvasthākṛtirniṣṭhā traiguṇyaḥ sarva eva hi  || 11.25.030 ||
sarve guṇamayā bhāvāḥ puruṣāvyaktadhiṣṭhitāḥ  |
dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ anudhyātaṃ buddhyā vā puruṣarṣabha  || 11.25.031 ||
etāḥ saṃsṛtayaḥ puṃso guṇakarmanibandhanāḥ  |
yeneme nirjitāḥ saumya guṇā jīvena cittajāḥ  |
bhaktiyogena manniṣṭho madbhāvāya prapadyate  || 11.25.032 ||
tasmāddehamimaṃ labdhvā jñānavijñānasambhavam  |
guṇasaṅgaṃ vinirdhūya māṃ bhajantu vicakṣaṇāḥ  || 11.25.033 ||
niḥsaṅgo māṃ bhajedvidvānapramatto jitendriyaḥ  |
rajastamaścābhijayetsattvasaṃsevayā muniḥ  || 11.25.034 ||
sattvaṃ cābhijayedyukto nairapekṣyeṇa śāntadhīḥ  |
sampadyate guṇairmukto jīvo jīvaṃ vihāya mām  || 11.25.035 ||
jīvo jīvavinirmukto guṇaiścāśayasambhavaiḥ  |
mayaiva brahmaṇā pūrṇo na bahirnāntaraścaret || 11.25.036 ||
11.26.001|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
mallakṣaṇamimaṃ kāyaṃ labdhvā maddharma āsthitaḥ  |
ānandaṃ paramātmānamātmasthaṃ samupaiti mām  || 11.26.001 ||
guṇamayyā jīvayonyā vimukto jñānaniṣṭhayā  |
guṇeṣu māyāmātreṣu dṛśyamāneṣvavastutaḥ  |
vartamāno'pi na pumān yujyate'vastubhirguṇaiḥ  || 11.26.002 ||
saṅgaṃ na kuryādasatāṃ śiśnodaratṛpāṃ kvacit |
tasyānugastamasyandhe patatyandhānugāndhavat || 11.26.003 ||
ailaḥ samrāḍimāṃ gāthāmagāyata bṛhacchravāḥ  |
urvaśīvirahānmuhyannirviṇṇaḥ śokasaṃyame  || 11.26.004 ||
tyaktvātmānaṃ vrayantīṃ tāṃ nagna unmattavannṛpaḥ  |
vilapannanvagājjāye ghore tiṣṭheti viklavaḥ  || 11.26.005 ||
kāmānatṛpto'nujuṣan kṣullakān varṣayāminīḥ  |
na veda yāntīrnāyāntīrurvaśyākṛṣṭacetanaḥ  || 11.26.006 ||
11.26.007|0 aila uvāca
aho me mohavistāraḥ kāmakaśmalacetasaḥ  |
devyā gṛhītakaṇṭhasya nāyuḥkhaṇḍā ime smṛtāḥ  || 11.26.007 ||
nāhaṃ vedābhinirmuktaḥ sūryo vābhyudito'muyā  |
mūṣito varṣapūgānāṃ batāhāni gatānyuta  || 11.26.008 ||
aho me ātmasammoho yenātmā yoṣitāṃ kṛtaḥ  |
krīḍāmṛgaścakravartī naradevaśikhāmaṇiḥ  || 11.26.009 ||
saparicchadamātmānaṃ hitvā tṛṇamiveśvaram  |
yāntīṃ striyaṃ cānvagamaṃ nagna unmattavadrudan  || 11.26.010 ||
kutastasyānubhāvaḥ syātteja īśatvameva vā  |
yo'nvagacchaṃ striyaṃ yāntīṃ kharavatpādatāḍitaḥ  || 11.26.011 ||
kiṃ vidyayā kiṃ tapasā kiṃ tyāgena śrutena vā  |
kiṃ viviktena maunena strībhiryasya mano hṛtam  || 11.26.012 ||
svārthasyākovidaṃ dhiṅmāṃ mūrkhaṃ paṇḍitamāninam  |
yo'hamīśvaratāṃ prāpya strībhirgokharavajjitaḥ  || 11.26.013 ||
sevato varṣapūgānme urvaśyā adharāsavam  |
na tṛpyatyātmabhūḥ kāmo vahnirāhutibhiryathā  || 11.26.014 ||
puṃścalyāpahṛtaṃ cittaṃ ko nvanyo mocituṃ prabhuḥ  |
ātmārāmeśvaramṛte bhagavantamadhokṣajam  || 11.26.015 ||
bodhitasyāpi devyā me sūktavākyena durmateḥ  |
manogato mahāmoho nāpayātyajitātmanaḥ  || 11.26.016 ||
kimetayā no'pakṛtaṃ rajjvā vā sarpacetasaḥ  |
draṣṭuḥ svarūpāviduṣo yo'haṃ yadajitendriyaḥ  || 11.26.017 ||
kvāyaṃ malīmasaḥ kāyo daurgandhyādyātmako'śuciḥ  |
kva guṇāḥ saumanasyādyā hyadhyāso'vidyayā kṛtaḥ  || 11.26.018 ||
pitroḥ kiṃ svaṃ nu bhāryāyāḥ svāmino'gneḥ śvagṛdhrayoḥ  |
kimātmanaḥ kiṃ suhṛdāmiti yo nāvasīyate  || 11.26.019 ||
tasmin kalevare'medhye tucchaniṣṭhe viṣajjate  |
aho subhadraṃ sunasaṃ susmitaṃ ca mukhaṃ striyaḥ  || 11.26.020 ||
tvaṅmāṃsarudhirasnāyu medomajjāsthisaṃhatau  |
viṇmūtrapūye ramatāṃ kṛmīṇāṃ kiyadantaram  || 11.26.021 ||
athāpi nopasajjeta strīṣu straiṇeṣu cārthavit |
viṣayendriyasaṃyogānmanaḥ kṣubhyati nānyathā  || 11.26.022 ||
adṛṣṭādaśrutādbhāvānna bhāva upajāyate  |
asamprayuñjataḥ prāṇān śāmyati stimitaṃ manaḥ  || 11.26.023 ||
tasmātsaṅgo na kartavyaḥ strīṣu straiṇeṣu cendriyaiḥ  |
viduṣāṃ cāpyavisrabdhaḥ ṣaḍvargaḥ kimu mādṛśām  || 11.26.024 ||
11.26.025|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
evaṃ pragāyannṛpadevadevaḥ sa urvaśīlokamatho vihāya  |
ātmānamātmanyavagamya māṃ vai upāramajjñāanavidhūtamohaḥ  || 11.26.025 ||
tato duḥsaṅgamutsṛjya satsu sajjeta buddhimān  |
santa evāsya chindanti manovyāsaṅgamuktibhiḥ  || 11.26.026 ||
santo'napekṣā maccittāḥ praśāntāḥ samadarśinaḥ  |
nirmamā nirahaṅkārā nirdvandvā niṣparigrahāḥ  || 11.26.027 ||
teṣu nityaṃ mahābhāga mahābhāgeṣu matkathāḥ  |
sambhavanti hi tā nṝṇāṃ juṣatāṃ prapunantyagham  || 11.26.028 ||
tā ye śṛṇvanti gāyanti hyanumodanti cādṛtāḥ  |
matparāḥ śraddadhānāśca bhaktiṃ vindanti te mayi  || 11.26.029 ||
bhaktiṃ labdhavataḥ sādhoḥ kimanyadavaśiṣyate  |
mayyanantaguṇe brahmaṇyānandānubhavātmani  || 11.26.030 ||
yathopaśrayamāṇasya bhagavantaṃ vibhāvasum  |
śītaṃ bhayaṃ tamo'pyeti sādhūn saṃsevatastathā  || 11.26.031 ||
nimajjyonmajjatāṃ ghore bhavābdhau paramāyaṇam  |
santo brahmavidaḥ śāntā naurdṛḍhevāpsu majjatām  || 11.26.032 ||
annaṃ hi prāṇināṃ prāṇa ārtānāṃ śaraṇaṃ tvaham  |
dharmo vittaṃ nṛṇāṃ pretya santo'rvāgbibhyato'raṇam  || 11.26.033 ||
santo diśanti cakṣūṃsi bahirarkaḥ samutthitaḥ  |
devatā bāndhavāḥ santaḥ santa ātmāhameva ca  || 11.26.034 ||
vaitasenastato'pyevamurvaśyā lokaniṣpṛhaḥ  |
muktasaṅgo mahīmetāmātmārāmaścacāra ha  || 11.26.035 ||
11.27.001|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
kriyāyogaṃ samācakṣva bhavadārādhanaṃ prabho  |
yasmāttvāṃ ye yathārcanti sātvatāḥ sātvatarṣabha  || 11.27.001 ||
etadvadanti munayo muhurniḥśreyasaṃ nṛṇām  |
nārado bhagavān vyāsa ācāryo'ṅgirasaḥ sutaḥ  || 11.27.002 ||
niḥsṛtaṃ te mukhāmbhojādyadāha bhagavānajaḥ  |
putrebhyo bhṛgumukhyebhyo devyai ca bhagavān bhavaḥ  || 11.27.003 ||
etadvai sarvavarṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca sammatam  |
śreyasāmuttamaṃ manye strīśūdrāṇāṃ ca mānada  || 11.27.004 ||
etatkamalapatrākṣa karmabandhavimocanam  |
bhaktāya cānuraktāya brūhi viśveśvareśvara  || 11.27.005 ||
11.27.006|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
na hyanto'nantapārasya karmakāṇḍasya coddhava  |
saṅkṣiptaṃ varṇayiṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ  || 11.27.006 ||
vaidikastāntriko miśra iti me trividho makhaḥ  |
trayāṇāmīpsitenaiva vidhinā māṃ samarcaret || 11.27.007 ||
yadā svanigamenoktaṃ dvijatvaṃ prāpya pūruṣaḥ  |
yathā yajeta māṃ bhaktyā śraddhayā tannibodha me  || 11.27.008 ||
arcāyāṃ sthaṇḍile'gnau vā sūrye vāpsu hṛdi dvijaḥ  |
dravyeṇa bhaktiyukto'rcetsvaguruṃ māmamāyayā  || 11.27.009 ||
pūrvaṃ snānaṃ prakurvīta dhautadanto'ṅgaśuddhaye  |
ubhayairapi ca snānaṃ mantrairmṛdgrahaṇādinā  || 11.27.010 ||
sandhyopāstyādikarmāṇi vedenācoditāni me  |
pūjāṃ taiḥ kalpayetsamyaksaṅkalpaḥ karmapāvanīm  || 11.27.011 ||
śailī dārumayī lauhī lepyā lekhyā ca saikatī  |
manomayī maṇimayī pratimāṣṭavidhā smṛtā  || 11.27.012 ||
calācaleti dvividhā pratiṣṭhā jīvamandiram  |
udvāsāvāhane na staḥ sthirāyāmuddhavārcane  || 11.27.013 ||
asthirāyāṃ vikalpaḥ syātsthaṇḍile tu bhaveddvayam  |
snapanaṃ tvavilepyāyāmanyatra parimārjanam  || 11.27.014 ||
dravyaiḥ prasiddhairmadyāgaḥ pratimādiṣvamāyinaḥ  |
bhaktasya ca yathālabdhairhṛdi bhāvena caiva hi  || 11.27.015 ||
snānālaṅkaraṇaṃ preṣṭhamarcāyāmeva tūddhava  |
sthaṇḍile tattvavinyāso vahnāvājyaplutaṃ haviḥ  || 11.27.016 ||
sūrye cābhyarhaṇaṃ preṣṭhaṃ salile salilādibhiḥ  |
śraddhayopāhṛtaṃ preṣṭhaṃ bhaktena mama vāryapi  || 11.27.017 ||
bhūryapyabhaktopāhṛtaṃ na me toṣāya kalpate  |
gandho dhūpaḥ sumanaso dīpo'nnādyaṃ ca kiṃ punaḥ  || 11.27.018 ||
śuciḥ sambhṛtasambhāraḥ prāgdarbhaiḥ kalpitāsanaḥ  |
āsīnaḥ prāgudagvārcedarcāyāṃ tvatha sammukhaḥ  || 11.27.019 ||
kṛtanyāsaḥ kṛtanyāsāṃ madarcāṃ pāṇināmṛjet |
kalaśaṃ prokṣaṇīyaṃ ca yathāvadupasādhayet || 11.27.020 ||
tadadbhirdevayajanaṃ dravyāṇyātmānameva ca  |
prokṣya pātrāṇi trīṇyadbhistaistairdravyaiśca sādhayet || 11.27.021 ||
pādyārghyācamanīyārthaṃ trīṇi pātrāṇi deśikaḥ  |
hṛdā śīrṣṇātha śikhayā gāyatryā cābhimantrayet || 11.27.022 ||
piṇḍe vāyvagnisaṃśuddhe hṛtpadmasthāṃ parāṃ mama  |
aṇvīṃ jīvakalāṃ dhyāyennādānte siddhabhāvitām  || 11.27.023 ||
tayātmabhūtayā piṇḍe vyāpte sampūjya tanmayaḥ  |
āvāhyārcādiṣu sthāpya nyastāṅgaṃ māṃ prapūjayet || 11.27.024 ||
pādyopasparśārhaṇādīnupacārān prakalpayet |
dharmādibhiśca navabhiḥ kalpayitvāsanaṃ mama  || 11.27.025 ||
padmamaṣṭadalaṃ tatra karṇikākesarojjvalam  |
ubhābhyāṃ vedatantrābhyāṃ mahyaṃ tūbhayasiddhaye  || 11.27.026 ||
sudarśanaṃ pāñcajanyaṃ gadāsīṣudhanurhalān  |
muṣalaṃ kaustubhaṃ mālāṃ śrīvatsaṃ cānupūjayet || 11.27.027 ||
nandaṃ sunandaṃ garuḍaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ caṇḍaṃ eva ca  |
mahābalaṃ balaṃ caiva kumudaṃ kamudekṣaṇam  || 11.27.028 ||
durgāṃ vināyakaṃ vyāsaṃ viṣvakṣenaṃ gurūn surān  |
sve sve sthāne tvabhimukhān pūjayetprokṣaṇādibhiḥ  || 11.27.029 ||
candanośīrakarpūra kuṅkumāguruvāsitaiḥ  |
salilaiḥ snāpayenmantrairnityadā vibhave sati  || 11.27.030 ||
svarṇagharmānuvākena mahāpuruṣavidyayā  |
pauruṣeṇāpi sūktena sāmabhī rājanādibhiḥ  || 11.27.031 ||
vastropavītābharaṇa patrasraggandhalepanaiḥ  |
alaṅkurvīta saprema madbhakto māṃ yathocitam  || 11.27.032 ||
pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca gandhaṃ sumanaso'kṣatān  |
dhūpadīpopahāryāṇi dadyānme śraddhayārcakaḥ  || 11.27.033 ||
guḍapāyasasarpīṃṣi śaṣkulyāpūpamodakān  |
saṃyāvadadhisūpāṃśca naivedyaṃ sati kalpayet || 11.27.034 ||
abhyaṅgonmardanādarśa dantadhāvābhiṣecanam  |
annādyagītanṛtyāni parvaṇi syurutānvaham  || 11.27.035 ||
vidhinā vihite kuṇḍe mekhalāgartavedibhiḥ  |
agnimādhāya paritaḥ samūhetpāṇinoditam  || 11.27.036 ||
paristīryātha paryukṣedanvādhāya yathāvidhi  |
prokṣaṇyāsādya dravyāṇi prokṣyāgnau bhāvayeta mām  || 11.27.037 ||
taptajāmbūnadaprakhyaṃ śaṅkhacakragadāmbujaiḥ  |
lasaccaturbhujaṃ śāntaṃ padmakiñjalkavāsasam  || 11.27.038 ||
sphuratkirīṭakaṭaka kaṭisūtravarāṅgadam  |
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ bhrājatkaustubhaṃ vanamālinam  || 11.27.039 ||
dhyāyannabhyarcya dārūṇi haviṣābhighṛtāni ca  |
prāsyājyabhāgāvāghārau dattvā cājyaplutaṃ haviḥ  || 11.27.040 ||
juhuyānmūlamantreṇa ṣoḍaśarcāvadānataḥ  |
dharmādibhyo yathānyāyaṃ mantraiḥ sviṣṭikṛtaṃ budhaḥ  || 11.27.041 ||
abhyarcyātha namaskṛtya pārṣadebhyo baliṃ haret |
mūlamantraṃ japedbrahma smarannārāyaṇātmakam  || 11.27.042 ||
dattvācamanamuccheṣaṃ viṣvakṣenāya kalpayet |
mukhavāsaṃ surabhimattāmbūlādyamathārhayet || 11.27.043 ||
upagāyan gṛṇannṛtyan karmāṇyabhinayanmama  |
matkathāḥ śrāvayan śṛṇvanmuhūrtaṃ kṣaṇiko bhavet || 11.27.044 ||
stavairuccāvacaiḥ stotraiḥ paurāṇaiḥ prākṛtairapi  |
stutvā prasīda bhagavanniti vandeta daṇḍavat || 11.27.045 ||
śiro matpādayoḥ kṛtvā bāhubhyāṃ ca parasparam  |
prapannaṃ pāhi māmīśa bhītaṃ mṛtyugrahārṇavāt || 11.27.046 ||
iti śeṣāṃ mayā dattāṃ śirasyādhāya sādaram  |
udvāsayeccedudvāsyaṃ jyotirjyotiṣi tatpunaḥ  || 11.27.047 ||
arcādiṣu yadā yatra śraddhā māṃ tatra cārcayet |
sarvabhūteṣvātmani ca sarvātmāhamavasthitaḥ  || 11.27.048 ||
evaṃ kriyāyogapathaiḥ pumān vaidikatāntrikaiḥ  |
arcannubhayataḥ siddhiṃ matto vindatyabhīpsitām  || 11.27.049 ||
madarcāṃ sampratiṣṭhāpya mandiraṃ kārayeddṛḍham  |
puṣpodyānāni ramyāṇi pūjāyātrotsavāśritān  || 11.27.050 ||
pūjādīnāṃ pravāhārthaṃ mahāparvasvathānvaham  |
kṣetrāpaṇapuragrāmān dattvā matsārṣṭitāmiyāt || 11.27.051 ||
pratiṣṭhayā sārvabhaumaṃ sadmanā bhuvanatrayam  |
pūjādinā brahmalokaṃ tribhirmatsāmyatāmiyāt || 11.27.052 ||
māmeva nairapekṣyeṇa bhaktiyogena vindati  |
bhaktiyogaṃ sa labhata evaṃ yaḥ pūjayeta mām  || 11.27.053 ||
yaḥ svadattāṃ parairdattāṃ hareta suraviprayoḥ  |
vṛttiṃ sa jāyate viḍbhugvarṣāṇāmayutāyutam  || 11.27.054 ||
kartuśca sāratherhetoranumoditureva ca  |
karmaṇāṃ bhāginaḥ pretya bhūyo bhūyasi tatphalam  || 11.27.055 ||
11.28.001|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
parasvabhāvakarmāṇi na praśaṃsenna garhayet |
viśvamekāmakaṃ paśyan prakṛtyā puruṣeṇa ca  || 11.28.001 ||
parasvabhāvakarmāṇi yaḥ praśaṃsati nindati  |
sa āśu bhraśyate svārthādasatyabhiniveśataḥ  || 11.28.002 ||
taijase nidrayāpanne piṇḍastho naṣṭacetanaḥ  |
māyāṃ prāpnoti mṛtyuṃ vā tadvannānārthadṛkpumān  || 11.28.003 ||
kiṃ bhadraṃ kimabhadraṃ vā dvaitasyāvastunaḥ kiyat |
vācoditaṃ tadanṛtaṃ manasā dhyātameva ca  || 11.28.004 ||
chāyāpratyāhvayābhāsā hyasanto'pyarthakāriṇaḥ  |
evaṃ dehādayo bhāvā yacchantyāmṛtyuto bhayam  || 11.28.005 ||
ātmaiva tadidaṃ viśvaṃ sṛjyate sṛjati prabhuḥ  |
trāyate trāti viśvātmā hriyate haratīśvaraḥ  || 11.28.006 ||
tasmānna hyātmano'nyasmādanyo bhāvo nirūpitaḥ  |
nirūpite'yaṃ trividhā nirmūla bhātirātmani  |
idaṃ guṇamayaṃ viddhi trividhaṃ māyayā kṛtam  || 11.28.007 ||
etadvidvānmaduditaṃ jñānavijñānanaipuṇam  |
na nindati na ca stauti loke carati sūryavat || 11.28.008 ||
pratyakṣeṇānumānena nigamenātmasaṃvidā  |
ādyantavadasajjñātvā niḥsaṅgo vicarediha  || 11.28.009 ||
11.28.010|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
naivātmano na dehasya saṃsṛtirdraṣṭṛdṛśyayoḥ  |
anātmasvadṛśorīśa kasya syādupalabhyate  || 11.28.010 ||
ātmāvyayo'guṇaḥ śuddhaḥ svayaṃjyotiranāvṛtaḥ  |
agnivaddāruvadaciddehaḥ kasyeha saṃsṛtiḥ  || 11.28.011 ||
11.28.012|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
yāvaddehendriyaprāṇairātmanaḥ sannikarṣaṇam  |
saṃsāraḥ phalavāṃstāvadapārtho'pyavivekinaḥ  || 11.28.012 ||
arthe hyavidyamāne'pi saṃsṛtirna nivartate  |
dhyāyato viṣayānasya svapne'narthāgamo yathā  || 11.28.013 ||
yathā hyapratibuddhasya prasvāpo bahvanarthabhṛt |
sa eva pratibuddhasya na vai mohāya kalpate  || 11.28.014 ||
śokaharṣabhayakrodha lobhamohaspṛhādayaḥ  |
ahaṅkārasya dṛśyante janmamṛtyuśca nātmanaḥ  || 11.28.015 ||
dehendriyaprāṇamano'bhimāno jīvo'ntarātmā guṇakarmamūrtiḥ  |
sūtraṃ mahānityurudheva gītaḥ saṃsāra ādhāvati kālatantraḥ  || 11.28.016 ||
amūlametadbahurūparūpitaṃ manovacaḥprāṇaśarīrakarma  |
jñānāsinopāsanayā śitena cchittvā munirgāṃ vicaratyatṛṣṇaḥ  || 11.28.017 ||
jñānaṃ viveko nigamastapaśca pratyakṣamaitihyamathānumānam  |
ādyantayorasya yadeva kevalaṃ kālaśca hetuśca tadeva madhye  || 11.28.018 ||
yathā hiraṇyaṃ svakṛtaṃ purastātpaścācca sarvasya hiraṇmayasya  |
tadeva madhye vyavahāryamāṇaṃ nānāpadeśairahamasya tadvat || 11.28.019 ||
vijñānametattriyavasthamaṅga guṇatrayaṃ kāraṇakaryakartṛ  |
samanvayena vyatirekataśca yenaiva turyeṇa tadeva satyam  || 11.28.020 ||
na yatpurastāduta yanna paścānmadhye ca tanna vyapadeśamātram  |
bhūtaṃ prasiddhaṃ ca pareṇa yadyattadeva tatsyāditi me manīṣā  || 11.28.021 ||
avidyamāno'pyavabhāsate yo vaikāriko rājasasarga esaḥ  |
brahma svayaṃ jyotirato vibhāti brahmendriyārthātmavikāracitram  || 11.28.022 ||
evaṃ sphutaṃ brahmavivekahetubhiḥ   parāpavādena viśāradena  |
chittvātmasandehamupārameta   svānandatuṣṭo'khilakāmukebhyaḥ  || 11.28.023 ||*
nātmā vapuḥ pārthivamindriyāṇi devā hyasurvāyurjalaṃ hutāśaḥ  |
mano'nnamātraṃ dhiṣaṇā ca sattvamahaṅkṛtiḥ khaṃ kṣitirarthasāmyam  || 11.28.024 ||
samāhitaiḥ kaḥ karaṇairguṇātmabhir  guṇo bhavenmatsuviviktadhāmnaḥ  |
vikṣipyamāṇairuta kiṃ nu dūṣaṇaṃ   ghanairupetairvigatai raveḥ kim  || 11.28.025 ||*
yathā nabho vāyvanalāmbubhūguṇair  gatāgatairvartuguṇairna sajjate  |
tathākṣaraṃ sattvarajastamomalair  ahaṃmateḥ saṃsṛtihetubhiḥ param  || 11.28.026 ||*
tathāpi saṅgaḥ parivarjanīyo guṇeṣu māyāraciteṣu tāvat |
madbhaktiyogena dṛḍhena yāvadrajo nirasyeta manaḥkaṣāyaḥ  || 11.28.027 ||
yathāmayo'sādhu cikitsito nṛṇāṃ punaḥ punaḥ santudati prarohan  |
evaṃ mano'pakvakaṣāyakarma kuyoginaṃ vidhyati sarvasaṅgam  || 11.28.028 ||
kuyogino ye vihitāntarāyairmanuṣyabhūtaistridaśopasṛṣṭaiḥ  |
te prāktanābhyāsabalena bhūyo yuñjanti yogaṃ na tu karmatantram  || 11.28.029 ||
karoti karma kriyate ca jantuḥ kenāpyasau codita ānipatāt |
na tatra vidvān prakṛtau sthito'pi nivṛttatṛṣṇaḥ svasukhānubhūtyā  || 11.28.030 ||
tiṣṭhantamāsīnamuta vrajantaṃ śayānamukṣantamadantamannam  |
svabhāvamanyatkimapīhamānamātmānamātmasthamatirna veda  || 11.28.031 ||
yadi sma paśyatyasadindriyārthaṃ nānānumānena viruddhamanyat |
na manyate vastutayā manīṣī svāpnaṃ yathotthāya tirodadhānam  || 11.28.032 ||
pūrvaṃ gṛhītaṃ guṇakarmacitramajñānamātmanyaviviktamaṅga  |
nivartate tatpunarīkṣayaiva na gṛhyate nāpi visṛyya ātmā  || 11.28.033 ||
yathā hi bhānorudayo nṛcakṣuṣāṃ tamo nihanyānna tu sadvidhatte  |
evaṃ samīkṣā nipuṇā satī me hanyāttamisraṃ puruṣasya buddheḥ  || 11.28.034 ||
eṣa svayaṃjyotirajo'prameyo mahānubhūtiḥ sakalānubhūtiḥ  |
eko'dvitīyo vacasāṃ virāme yeneṣitā vāgasavaścaranti  || 11.28.035 ||
etāvānātmasammoho yadvikalpastu kevale  |
ātmanṛte svamātmānamavalambo na yasya hi  || 11.28.036 ||
yannāmākṛtibhirgrāhyaṃ pañcavarṇamabādhitam  |
vyarthenāpyarthavādo'yaṃ dvayaṃ paṇḍitamāninām  || 11.28.037 ||
yogino'pakvayogasya yuñjataḥ kāya utthitaiḥ  |
upasargairvihanyeta tatrāyaṃ vihito vidhiḥ  || 11.28.038 ||
yogadhāraṇayā kāṃścidāsanairdhāraṇānvitaiḥ  |
tapomantrauṣadhaiḥ kāṃścidupasargān vinirdahet || 11.28.039 ||
kāṃścinmamānudhyānena nāmasaṅkīrtanādibhiḥ  |
yogeśvarānuvṛttyā vā hanyādaśubhadān śanaiḥ  || 11.28.040 ||
keciddehamimaṃ dhīrāḥ sukalpaṃ vayasi sthiram  |
vidhāya vividhopāyairatha yuñjanti siddhaye  || 11.28.041 ||
na hi tatkuśalādṛtyaṃ tadāyāso hyapārthakaḥ  |
antavattvāccharīrasya phalasyeva vanaspateḥ  || 11.28.042 ||
yogaṃ niṣevato nityaṃ kāyaścetkalpatāmiyāt |
tacchraddadhyānna matimān yogamutsṛjya matparaḥ  || 11.28.043 ||
yogacaryāmimāṃ yogī vicaranmadapāśrayaḥ  |
nāntarāyairvihanyeta niḥspṛhaḥ svasukhānubhūḥ  || 11.28.044 ||
11.29.001|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
sudustarāmimāṃ manye yogacaryāmanātmanaḥ  |
yathāñjasā pumān siddhyettanme brūhyañjasācyuta  || 11.29.001 ||
prāyaśaḥ puṇdarīkākṣa yuñyanto yogino manaḥ  |
viṣīdantyasamādhānānmanonigrahakarśitāḥ  || 11.29.002 ||
athāta ānandadughaṃ padāmbujaṃ haṃsāḥ śrayerannaravindalocana  |
sukhaṃ nu viśveśvara yogakarmabhistvanmāyayāmī vihatā na māninaḥ  || 11.29.003 ||
kiṃ citramacyuta tavaitadaśeṣabandho dāseṣvananyaśaraṇesu yadātmasāttvam  |
yo'rocayatsaha mṛgaiḥ svayamīśvarāṇāṃ śrīmatkirīṭataṭapīḍitapādapīṭhaḥ  || 11.29.004 ||
taṃ tvākhilātmadayiteśvaramāśritānāṃ   sarvārthadaṃ svakṛtavidvisṛjeta ko nu  |
ko vā bhajetkimapi vismṛtaye'nu bhūtyai   kiṃ vā bhavenna tava pādarajojuṣāṃ naḥ  || 11.29.005 ||*
naivopayantyapacitiṃ kavayastaveśa   brahmāyuṣāpi kṛtamṛddhamudaḥ smarantaḥ  |
yo'ntarbahistanubhṛtāmaśubhaṃ vidhunvann   ācāryacaittyavapuṣā svagatiṃ vyanakti  || 11.29.006 ||*
11.29.007|0 śrīśuka uvāca
ityuddhavenātyanuraktacetasā pṛṣṭo jagatkrīḍanakaḥ svaśaktibhiḥ  |
gṛhītamūrtitraya īśvareśvaro jagāda sapremamanoharasmitaḥ  || 11.29.007 ||
11.29.008|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi mama dharmān sumaṅgalān  |
yān śraddhayācaranmartyo mṛtyuṃ jayati durjayam  || 11.29.008 ||
kuryātsarvāṇi karmāṇi madarthaṃ śanakaiḥ smaran  |
mayyarpitamanaścitto maddharmātmamanoratiḥ  || 11.29.009 ||
deśān puṇyānāśrayeta madbhaktaiḥ sādhubhiḥ śritān  |
devāsuramanuṣyeṣu madbhaktācaritāni ca  || 11.29.010 ||
pṛthaksatreṇa vā mahyaṃ parvayātrāmahotsavān  |
kārayedgītanṛtyādyairmahārājavibhūtibhiḥ  || 11.29.011 ||
māmeva sarvabhūteṣu bahirantarapāvṛtam  |
īkṣetātmani cātmānaṃ yathā khamamalāśayaḥ  || 11.29.012 ||
iti sarvāṇi bhūtāni madbhāvena mahādyute  |
sabhājayanmanyamāno jñānaṃ kevalamāśritaḥ  || 11.29.013 ||
brāhmaṇe pukkase stene brahmaṇye'rke sphuliṅgake  |
akrūre krūrake caiva samadṛkpaṇḍito mataḥ  || 11.29.014 ||
nareṣvabhīkṣṇaṃ madbhāvaṃ puṃso bhāvayato'cirāt |
spardhāsūyātiraskārāḥ sāhaṅkārā viyanti hi  || 11.29.015 ||
visṛjya smayamānān svān dṛśaṃ vrīḍāṃ ca daihikīm  |
praṇameddaṇḍavadbhūmāvāśvacāṇḍālagokharam  || 11.29.016 ||
yāvatsarveṣu bhūteṣu madbhāvo nopajāyate  |
tāvadevamupāsīta vāṅmanaḥkāyavṛttibhiḥ  || 11.29.017 ||
sarvaṃ brahmātmakaṃ tasya vidyayātmamanīṣayā  |
paripaśyannuparametsarvato muitasaṃśayaḥ  || 11.29.018 ||
ayaṃ hi sarvakalpānāṃ sadhrīcīno mato mama  |
madbhāvaḥ sarvabhūteṣu manovākkāyavṛttibhiḥ  || 11.29.019 ||
na hyaṅgopakrame dhvaṃso maddharmasyoddhavāṇvapi  |
mayā vyavasitaḥ samyaṅnirguṇatvādanāśiṣaḥ  || 11.29.020 ||
yo yo mayi pare dharmaḥ kalpyate niṣphalāya cet |
tadāyāso nirarthaḥ syādbhayāderiva sattama  || 11.29.021 ||
eṣā buddhimatāṃ buddhirmanīṣā ca manīṣiṇām  |
yatsatyamanṛteneha martyenāpnoti māmṛtam  || 11.29.022 ||
eṣa te'bhihitaḥ kṛtsno brahmavādasya saṅgrahaḥ  |
samāsavyāsavidhinā devānāmapi durgamaḥ  || 11.29.023 ||
abhīkṣṇaśaste gaditaṃ jñānaṃ vispaṣṭayuktimat |
etadvijñāya mucyeta puruṣo naṣṭasaṃśayaḥ  || 11.29.024 ||
suviviktaṃ tava praśnaṃ mayaitadapi dhārayet |
sanātanaṃ brahmaguhyaṃ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati  || 11.29.025 ||
ya etanmama bhakteṣu sampradadyātsupuṣkalam  |
tasyāhaṃ brahmadāyasya dadāmyātmānamātmanā  || 11.29.026 ||
ya etatsamadhīyīta pavitraṃ paramaṃ śuci  |
sa pūyetāharaharmāṃ jñānadīpena darśayan  || 11.29.027 ||
ya etacchraddhayā nityamavyagraḥ śṛṇuyānnaraḥ  |
mayi bhaktiṃ parāṃ kurvan karmabhirna sa badhyate  || 11.29.028 ||
apyuddhava tvayā brahma sakhe samavadhāritam  |
api te vigato mohaḥ śokaścāsau manobhavaḥ  || 11.29.029 ||
naitattvayā dāmbhikāya nāstikāya śaṭhāya ca  |
aśuśrūṣorabhaktāya durvinītāya dīyatām  || 11.29.030 ||
etairdoṣairvihīnāya brahmaṇyāya priyāya ca  |
sādhave śucaye brūyādbhaktiḥ syācchūdrayoṣitām  || 11.29.031 ||
naitadvijñāya jijñāsorjñātavyamavaśiṣyate  |
pītvā pīyūṣamamṛtaṃ pātavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate  || 11.29.032 ||
jñāne karmaṇi yoge ca vārtāyāṃ daṇḍadhāraṇe  |
yāvānartho nṛṇāṃ tāta tāvāṃste'haṃ caturvidhaḥ  || 11.29.033 ||
martyo yadā tyaktasamastakarmā niveditātmā vicikīrṣito me  |
tadāmṛtatvaṃ pratipadyamāno mayātmabhūyāya ca kalpate vai  || 11.29.034 ||
11.29.035|0 śrīśuka uvāca
sa evamādarśitayogamārgastadottamaḥślokavaco niśamya  |
baddhāñjaliḥ prītyuparuddhakaṇṭho na kiñcidūce'śrupariplutākṣaḥ  || 11.29.035 ||

kṛtāñjaliḥ prāha yadupravīraṃ śīrṣṇā spṛśaṃstaccaraṇāravindam  || 11.29.036 ||
11.29.037|0 śrīuddhava uvāca
vidrāvito mohamahāndhakāro ya āśrito me tava sannidhānāt |
vibhāvasoḥ kiṃ nu samīpagasya śītaṃ tamo bhīḥ prabhavantyajādya  || 11.29.037 ||
pratyarpito me bhavatānukampinā bhṛtyāya vijñānamayaḥ pradīpaḥ  |

prasāritaḥ sṛṣṭivivṛddhaye tvayā svamāyayā hyātmasubodhahetinā  || 11.29.039 ||
namo'stu te mahāyogin prapannamanuśādhi mām  |
yathā tvaccaraṇāmbhoje ratiḥ syādanapāyinī  || 11.29.040 ||
11.29.041|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
gacchoddhava mayādiṣṭo badaryākhyaṃ mamāśramam  |
tatra matpādatīrthode snānopasparśanaiḥ śuciḥ  || 11.29.041 ||

11.29.045|0 śrīśuka uvāca

śiro nidhāyāśrukalābhirārdradhīrnyaṣiñcadadvandvaparo'pyapakrame  || 11.29.045 ||
sudustyajasnehaviyogakātaro na śaknuvaṃstaṃ parihātumāturaḥ  |

tatastamantarhṛdi sanniveśya gato mahābhāgavato viśālām  |

ya etadānandasamudrasambhṛtaṃ jñānāmṛtaṃ bhāgavatāya bhāṣitam  |

bhavabhayamapahantuṃ jñānavijñānasāraṃ   nigamakṛdupajahre bhṛṅgavadvedasāram  |
amṛtamudadhitaścāpāyayadbhṛtyavargān   puruṣamṛṣabhamādyaṃ kṛṣṇasaṃjñaṃ nato'smi  || 11.29.049 ||*
11.30.001|0 śrīrājovāca
tato mahābhāgavata uddhave nirgate vanam  |

divi bhuvyantarikṣe ca mahotpātān samutthitān  |

11.30.005|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
ete ghorā mahotpātā dvārvatyāṃ yamaketavaḥ  |
muhūrtamapi na stheyamatra no yadupuṅgavāḥ  || 11.30.005 ||

tatrābhiṣicya śucaya upoṣya susamāhitāḥ  |

brāhmaṇāṃstu mahābhāgān kṛtasvastyayanā vayam  |
gobhūhiraṇyavāsobhirgajāśvarathaveśmabhiḥ  || 11.30.008 ||
vidhireṣa hyariṣṭaghno maṅgalāyanamuttamam  |

iti sarve samākarṇya yaduvṛddhā madhudviṣaḥ  |
tatheti naubhiruttīrya prabhāsaṃ prayayū rathaiḥ  || 11.30.010 ||
tasmin bhagavatādiṣṭaṃ yadudevena yādavāḥ  |

tatastasminmahāpānaṃ papurmaireyakaṃ madhu  |
diṣṭavibhraṃśitadhiyo yaddravairbhraśyate matiḥ  || 11.30.012 ||
mahāpānābhimattānāṃ vīrāṇāṃ dṛptacetasām  |

yuyudhuḥ krodhasaṃrabdhā velāyāmātatāyinaḥ  |
dhanurbhirasibhirbhallairgadābhistomararṣṭibhiḥ  || 11.30.014 ||
patatpatākai rathakuñjarādibhiḥ kharoṣṭragobhirmahiṣairnarairapi  |
mithaḥ sametyāśvataraiḥ sudurmadā nyahan śarairdadbhiriva dvipā vane  || 11.30.015 ||
pradyumnasāmbau yudhi rūḍhamatsarāv  akrūrabhojāvaniruddhasātyakī  |
subhadrasaṅgrāmajitau sudāruṇau   gadau sumitrāsurathau samīyatuḥ  || 11.30.016 ||*
anye ca ye vai niśaṭholmukādayaḥ sahasrajicchatajidbhānumukhyāḥ  |
