dāśārhavṛṣṇyandhakabhojasātvatā   madhvarbudā māthuraśūrasenāḥ  |
visarjanāḥ kukurāḥ kuntayaśca   mithastu jaghnuḥ suvisṛjya sauhṛdam  || 11.30.018 ||*
putrā ayudhyan pitṛbhirbhrātṛbhiśca   svasrīyadauhitrapitṛvyamātulaiḥ  |
mitrāṇi mitraiḥ suhṛdaḥ suhṛdbhir  jñātīṃstvahan jñātaya eva mūḍhāḥ  || 11.30.019 ||*
śareṣu hīyamāeṣu bhajyamānesu dhanvasu  |
śastreṣu kṣīyamāneṣu muṣṭibhirjahrurerakāḥ  || 11.30.020 ||
tā vajrakalpā hyabhavan parighā muṣṭinā bhṛtāḥ  |
jaghnurdviṣastaiḥ kṛṣṇena vāryamāṇāstu taṃ ca te  || 11.30.021 ||
pratyanīkaṃ manyamānā balabhadraṃ ca mohitāḥ  |
hantuṃ kṛtadhiyo rājannāpannā ātatāyinaḥ  || 11.30.022 ||
atha tāvapi saṅkruddhāvudyamya kurunandana  |
erakāmuṣṭiparighau carantau jaghnaturyudhi  || 11.30.023 ||
brahmaśāpopasṛṣṭānāṃ kṛṣṇamāyāvṛtātmanām  |
spardhākrodhaḥ kṣayaṃ ninye vaiṇavo'gniryathā vanam  || 11.30.024 ||
evaṃ naṣṭeṣu sarveṣu kuleṣu sveṣu keśavaḥ  |
avatārito bhuvo bhāra iti mene'vaśeṣitaḥ  || 11.30.025 ||
rāmaḥ samudravelāyāṃ yogamāsthāya pauruṣam  |
tatyāja lokaṃ mānuṣyaṃ saṃyojyātmānamātmani  || 11.30.026 ||
rāmaniryāṇamālokya bhagavān devakīsutaḥ  |
niṣasāda dharopasthe tuṣṇīmāsādya pippalam  || 11.30.027 ||
bibhraccaturbhujaṃ rūpaṃ bhrāyiṣṇu prabhayā svayā  |
diśo vitimirāḥ kurvan vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ  || 11.30.028 ||
śrīvatsāṅkaṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ taptahāṭakavarcasam  |
kauśeyāmbarayugmena parivītaṃ sumaṅgalam  || 11.30.029 ||
sundarasmitavaktrābjaṃ nīlakuntalamaṇḍitam  |
puṇḍarīkābhirāmākṣaṃ sphuranmakarakuṇḍalam  || 11.30.030 ||
kaṭisūtrabrahmasūtra kirīṭakaṭakāṅgadaiḥ  |
hāranūpuramudrābhiḥ kaustubhena virājitam  || 11.30.031 ||
vanamālāparītāṅgaṃ mūrtimadbhirnijāyudhaiḥ  |
kṛtvorau dakṣiṇe pādamāsīnaṃ paṅkajāruṇam  || 11.30.032 ||
muṣalāvaśeṣāyaḥkhaṇḍa kṛteṣurlubdhako jarā  |
mṛgāsyākāraṃ taccaraṇaṃ vivyādha mṛgaśaṅkayā  || 11.30.033 ||
caturbhujaṃ taṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa kṛtakilbiṣaḥ  |
bhītaḥ papāta śirasā pādayorasuradviṣaḥ  || 11.30.034 ||
ajānatā kṛtamidaṃ pāpena madhusūdana  |
kṣantumarhasi pāpasya uttamaḥśloka me'nagha  || 11.30.035 ||
yasyānusmaraṇaṃ nṛṇāmajñānadhvāntanāśanam  |
vadanti tasya te viṣṇo mayāsādhu kṛtaṃ prabho  || 11.30.036 ||
tanmāśu jahi vaikuṇṭha pāpmānaṃ mṛgalubdhakam  |
yathā punarahaṃ tvevaṃ na kuryāṃ sadatikramam  || 11.30.037 ||
yasyātmayogaracitaṃ na vidurviriñco   rudrādayo'sya tanayāḥ patayo girāṃ ye  |
tvanmāyayā pihitadṛṣṭaya etadañjaḥ   kiṃ tasya te vayamasadgatayo gṛṇīmaḥ  || 11.30.038 ||*
11.30.039|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
mā bhairjare tvamuttiṣṭha kāma eṣa kṛto hi me  |
yāhi tvaṃ madanujñātaḥ svargaṃ sukṛtināṃ padam  || 11.30.039 ||
ityādiṣṭo bhagavatā kṛṣṇenecchāśarīriṇā  |
triḥ parikramya taṃ natvā vimānena divaṃ yayau  || 11.30.040 ||
dārukaḥ kṛṣṇapadavīmanvicchannadhigamya tām  |
vāyuṃ tulasikāmodamāghrāyābhimukhaṃ yayau  || 11.30.041 ||
taṃ tatra tigmadyubhirāyudhairvṛtaṃ   hyaśvatthamūle kṛtaketanaṃ patim  |
snehaplutātmā nipapāta pādayo   rathādavaplutya sabāṣpalocanaḥ  || 11.30.042 ||*
apaśyatastvaccaraṇāmbujaṃ prabho dṛṣṭiḥ praṇaṣṭā tamasi praviṣṭā  |
diśo na jāne na labhe ca śāntiṃ yathā niśāyāmuḍupe praṇaṣṭe  || 11.30.043 ||
iti bruvati sūte vai ratho garuḍalāñchanaḥ  |
khamutpapāta rājendra sāśvadhvaja udīkṣataḥ  || 11.30.044 ||
tamanvagacchan divyāni viṣṇupraharaṇāni ca  |
tenātivismitātmānaṃ sūtamāha janārdanaḥ  || 11.30.045 ||
gaccha dvāravatīṃ sūta jñātīnāṃ nidhanaṃ mithaḥ  |
saṅkarṣaṇasya niryāṇaṃ bandhubhyo brūhi maddaśām  || 11.30.046 ||
dvārakāyāṃ ca na stheyaṃ bhavadbhiśca svabandhubhiḥ  |
mayā tyaktāṃ yadupurīṃ samudraḥ plāvayiṣyati  || 11.30.047 ||
svaṃ svaṃ parigrahaṃ sarve ādāya pitarau ca naḥ  |
arjunenāvitāḥ sarva indraprasthaṃ gamiṣyatha  || 11.30.048 ||
tvaṃ tu maddharmamāsthāya jñānaniṣṭha upekṣakaḥ  |
manmāyāracitāmetāṃ vijñayopaśamaṃ vraja  || 11.30.049 ||
ityuktastaṃ parikramya namaskṛtya punaḥ punaḥ  |
tatpādau śīrṣṇyupādhāya durmanāḥ prayayau purīm  || 11.30.050 ||
11.31.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
atha tatrāgamadbrahmā bhavānyā ca samaṃ bhavaḥ  |
mahendrapramukhā devā munayaḥ saprajeśvarāḥ  || 11.31.001 ||
pitaraḥ siddhagandharvā vidyādharamahoragāḥ  |
cāraṇā yakṣarakṣāṃsi kinnarāpsaraso dvijāḥ  || 11.31.002 ||
draṣṭukāmā bhagavato niryāṇaṃ paramotsukāḥ  |
gāyantaśca gṛṇantaśca śaureḥ karmāṇi janma ca  || 11.31.003 ||
vavṛṣuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi vimānāvalibhirnabhaḥ  |
kurvantaḥ saṅkulaṃ rājan bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ  || 11.31.004 ||
bhagavān pitāmahaṃ vīkṣya vibhūtīrātmano vibhuḥ  |
saṃyojyātmani cātmānaṃ padmanetre nyamīlayat || 11.31.005 ||
lokābhirāmāṃ svatanuṃ dhāraṇādhyānamaṅgalam  |
yogadhāraṇayāgneyyā dagdhvā dhāmāviśatsvakam  || 11.31.006 ||
divi dundubhayo neduḥ petuḥ sumanasaśca khāt |
satyaṃ dharmo dhṛtirbhūmeḥ kīrtiḥ śrīścānu taṃ yayuḥ  || 11.31.007 ||
devādayo brahmamukhyā na viśantaṃ svadhāmani  |
avijñātagatiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dadṛśuścātivismitāḥ  || 11.31.008 ||
saudāmanyā yathāklāśe yāntyā hitvābhramaṇḍalam  |
gatirna lakṣyate martyaistathā kṛṣṇasya daivataiḥ  || 11.31.009 ||
brahmarudrādayaste tu dṛṣṭvā yogagatiṃ hareḥ  |
vismitāstāṃ praśaṃsantaḥ svaṃ svaṃ lokaṃ yayustadā  || 11.31.010 ||
rājan parasya tanubhṛjjananāpyayehā   māyāviḍambanamavehi yathā naṭasya  |
sṛṣṭvātmanedamanuviśya vihṛtya cānte   saṃhṛtya cātmamahinoparataḥ sa āste  || 11.31.011 ||*
martyena yo gurusutaṃ yamalokanītaṃ   tvāṃ cānayaccharaṇadaḥ paramāstradagdham  |
jigye'ntakāntakamapīśamasāvanīśaḥ   kiṃ svāvane svaranayanmṛgayuṃ sadeham  || 11.31.012 ||*
tathāpyaśeṣasthitisambhavāpyayeṣv  ananyaheturyadaśeṣaśaktidhṛk |
naicchatpraṇetuṃ vapuratra śeṣitaṃ   martyena kiṃ svasthagatiṃ pradarśayan  || 11.31.013 ||*
ya etāṃ prātarutthāya kṛṣṇasya padavīṃ parām  |
prayataḥ kīrtayedbhaktyā tāmevāpnotyanuttamām  || 11.31.014 ||
dāruko dvārakāmetya vasudevograsenayoḥ  |
patitvā caraṇāvasrairnyaṣiñcatkṛṣṇavicyutaḥ  || 11.31.015 ||
kathayāmāsa nidhanaṃ vṛṣṇīnāṃ kṛtsnaśo nṛpa  |
tacchrutvodvignahṛdayā janāḥ śokavirmūrcchitāḥ  || 11.31.016 ||
tatra sma tvaritā jagmuḥ kṛṣṇaviśleṣavihvalāḥ  |
vyasavaḥ śerate yatra jñātayo ghnanta ānanam  || 11.31.017 ||
devakī rohiṇī caiva vasudevastathā sutau  |
kṛṣṇarāmāvapaśyantaḥ śokārtā vijahuḥ smṛtim  || 11.31.018 ||
prāṇāṃśca vijahustatra bhagavadvirahāturāḥ  |
upaguhya patīṃstāta citāmāruruhuḥ striyaḥ  || 11.31.019 ||
rāmapatnyaśca taddehamupaguhyāgnimāviśan  |
vasudevapatnyastadgātraṃ pradyumnādīn hareḥ snuṣāḥ  |
kṛṣṇapatnyo'viśannagniṃ rukmiṇyādyāstadātmikāḥ  || 11.31.020 ||
arjunaḥ preyasaḥ sakhyuḥ kṛṣṇasya virahāturaḥ  |
ātmānaṃ sāntvayāmāsa kṛṣṇagītaiḥ saduktibhiḥ  || 11.31.021 ||
bandhūnāṃ naṣṭagotrāṇāmarjunaḥ sāmparāyikam  |
hatānāṃ kārayāmāsa yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ  || 11.31.022 ||
dvārakāṃ hariṇā tyaktāṃ samudro'plāvayatkṣaṇāt |
varjayitvā mahārāja śrīmadbhagavadālayam  || 11.31.023 ||
nityaṃ sannihitastatra bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ  |
smṛtyāśeṣāśubhaharaṃ sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam  || 11.31.024 ||
strībālavṛddhānādāya hataśeṣān dhanañjayaḥ  |
indraprasthaṃ samāveśya vajraṃ tatrābhyaṣecayat || 11.31.025 ||
śrutvā suhṛdvadhaṃ rājannarjunātte pitāmahāḥ  |
tvāṃ tu vaṃśadharaṃ kṛtvā jagmuḥ sarve mahāpatham  || 11.31.026 ||
ya etaddevadevasya viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi janma ca  |
kīrtayecchraddhayā martyaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  || 11.31.027 ||
itthaṃ harerbhagavato rucirāvatāra   vīryāṇi bālacaritāni ca śantamāni  |
anyatra ceha ca śrutāni gṛṇanmanuṣyo   bhaktiṃ parāṃ paramahaṃsagatau labheta  || 11.31.028 ||*

12.01.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
yo'ntyaḥ purañjayo nāma bhaviṣyo bārahadrathaḥ  |
tasyāmātyastu śunako hatvā svāminamātmajam  || 12.01.001 ||
pradyotasaṃjñaṃ rājānaṃ kartā yatpālakaḥ sutaḥ  |
viśākhayūpastatputro bhavitā rājakastataḥ  || 12.01.002 ||
nandivardhanastatputraḥ pañca pradyotanā ime  |
aṣṭatriṃśottaraśataṃ bhokṣyanti pṛthivīṃ nṛpāḥ  || 12.01.003 ||
śiśunāgastato bhāvyaḥ kākavarṇastu tatsutaḥ  |
kṣemadharmā tasya sutaḥ kṣetrajñaḥ kṣemadharmajaḥ  || 12.01.004 ||
vidhisāraḥ sutastasyā jātaśatrurbhaviṣyati  |
darbhakastatsuto bhāvī darbhakasyājayaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 12.01.005 ||
nandivardhana ājeyo mahānandiḥ sutastataḥ  |
śiśunāgā daśaivaite saṣṭyuttaraśatatrayam  || 12.01.006 ||
samā bhokṣyanti pṛthivīṃ kuruśreṣṭha kalau nṛpāḥ  |
mahānandisuto rājan śūdrāgarbhodbhavo balī  || 12.01.007 ||
mahāpadmapatiḥ kaścinnandaḥ kṣatravināśakṛt |
tato nṛpā bhaviṣyanti śūdraprāyāstvadhārmikāḥ  || 12.01.008 ||
sa ekacchatrāṃ pṛthivīmanullaṅghitaśāsanaḥ  |
śāsiṣyati mahāpadmo dvitīya iva bhārgavaḥ  || 12.01.009 ||
tasya cāṣṭau bhaviṣyanti sumālyapramukhāḥ sutāḥ  |
ya imāṃ bhokṣyanti mahīṃ rājānaśca śataṃ samāḥ  || 12.01.010 ||
nava nandān dvijaḥ kaścitprapannānuddhariṣyati  |
teṣāṃ abhāve jagatīṃ mauryā bhokṣyanti vai kalau  || 12.01.011 ||
sa eva candraguptaṃ vai dvijo rājye'bhiṣekṣyati  |
tatsuto vārisārastu tataścāśokavardhanaḥ  || 12.01.012 ||
suyaśā bhavitā tasya saṅgataḥ suyaśaḥsutaḥ  |
śāliśūkastatastasya somaśarmā bhaviṣyati  |
śatadhanvā tatastasya bhavitā tadbṛhadrathaḥ  || 12.01.013 ||
mauryā hyete daśa nṛpāḥ saptatriṃśacchatottaram  |
samā bhokṣyanti pṛthivīṃ kalau kurukulodvaha  || 12.01.014 ||
agnimitrastatastasmātsujyeṣṭho bhavitā tataḥ  |
vasumitro bhadrakaśca pulindo bhavitā sutaḥ  || 12.01.015 ||
tato ghoṣaḥ sutastasmādvajramitro bhaviṣyati  |
tato bhāgavatastasmāddevabhūtiḥ kurūdvaha  || 12.01.016 ||
śuṅgā daśaite bhokṣyanti bhūmiṃ varṣaśatādhikam  |
tataḥ kāṇvāniyaṃ bhūmiryāsyatyalpaguṇānnṛpa  || 12.01.017 ||
śuṅgaṃ hatvā devabhūtiṃ kāṇvo'mātyastu kāminam  |
svayaṃ kariṣyate rājyaṃ vasudevo mahāmatiḥ  || 12.01.018 ||
tasya putrastu bhūmitrastasya nārāyaṇaḥ sutaḥ  |
kāṇvāyanā ime bhūmiṃ catvāriṃśacca pañca ca  |
śatāni trīṇi bhokṣyanti varṣāṇāṃ ca kalau yuge  || 12.01.019 ||
hatvā kāṇvaṃ suśarmāṇaṃ tadbhṛtyo vṛṣalo balī  |
gāṃ bhokṣyatyandhrajātīyaḥ kañcitkālamasattamaḥ  || 12.01.020 ||
kṛṣṇanāmātha tadbhrātā bhavitā pṛthivīpatiḥ  |
śrīśāntakarṇastatputraḥ paurṇamāsastu tatsutaḥ  || 12.01.021 ||
lambodarastu tatputrastasmāccibilako nṛpaḥ  |
meghasvātiścibilakādaṭamānastu tasya ca  || 12.01.022 ||
aniṣṭakarmā hāleyastalakastasya cātmajaḥ  |
purīṣabhīrustatputrastato rājā sunandanaḥ  || 12.01.023 ||
cakoro bahavo yatra śivasvātirarindamaḥ  |
tasyāpi gomatī putraḥ purīmān bhavitā tataḥ  || 12.01.024 ||
medaśirāḥ śivaskando yajñaśrīstatsutastataḥ  |
vijayastatsuto bhāvyaścandravijñaḥ salomadhiḥ  || 12.01.025 ||
ete triṃśannṛpatayaścatvāryabdaśatāni ca  |
ṣaṭpañcāśacca pṛthivīṃ bhokṣyanti kurunandana  || 12.01.026 ||
saptābhīrā āvabhṛtyā daśa gardabhino nṛpāḥ  |
kaṅkāḥ ṣoḍaśa bhūpālā bhaviṣyantyatilolupāḥ  || 12.01.027 ||
tato'ṣṭau yavanā bhāvyāścaturdaśa turuṣkakāḥ  |
bhūyo daśa guruṇḍāśca maulā ekādaśaiva tu  || 12.01.028 ||
ete bhokṣyanti pṛthivīṃ daśa varṣaśatāni ca  |
navādhikāṃ ca navatiṃ maulā ekādaśa kṣitim  || 12.01.029 ||
bhokṣyantyabdaśatānyaṅga trīṇi taiḥ saṃsthite tataḥ  |
kilakilāyāṃ nṛpatayo bhūtanando'tha vaṅgiriḥ  || 12.01.030 ||
śiśunandiśca tadbhrātā yaśonandiḥ pravīrakaḥ  |
ityete vai varṣaśataṃ bhaviṣyantyadhikāni ṣaṭ || 12.01.031 ||
teṣāṃ trayodaśa sutā bhavitāraśca bāhlikāḥ  |
puṣpamitro'tha rājanyo durmitro'sya tathaiva ca  || 12.01.032 ||
ekakālā ime bhūpāḥ saptāndhrāḥ sapta kauśalāḥ  |
vidūrapatayo bhāvyā niṣadhāstata eva hi  || 12.01.033 ||
māgadhānāṃ tu bhavitā viśvasphūrjiḥ purañjayaḥ  |
kariṣyatyaparo varṇān pulindayadumadrakān  || 12.01.034 ||
prajāścābrahmabhūyiṣṭhāḥ sthāpayiṣyati durmatiḥ  |
vīryavān kṣatramutsādya padmavatyāṃ sa vai puri  |
anugaṅgamāprayāgaṃ guptāṃ bhokṣyati medinīm  || 12.01.035 ||
saurāṣṭrāvantyābhīrāśca śūrā arbudamālavāḥ  |
vrātyā dvijā bhaviṣyanti śūdraprāyā janādhipāḥ  || 12.01.036 ||
sindhostaṭaṃ candrabhāgāṃ kauntīṃ kāśmīramaṇḍalam  |
bhokṣyanti śūdrā vrātyādyā mlecchāścābrahmavarcasaḥ  || 12.01.037 ||
tulyakālā ime rājanmlecchaprāyāśca bhūbhṛtaḥ  |
ete'dharmānṛtaparāḥ phalgudāstīvramanyavaḥ  || 12.01.038 ||
strībālagodvijaghnāśca paradāradhanādṛtāḥ  |
uditāstamitaprāyā alpasattvālpakāyuṣaḥ  || 12.01.039 ||
asaṃskṛtāḥ kriyāhīnā rajasā tamasāvṛtāḥ  |
prajāste bhakṣayiṣyanti mlecchā rājanyarūpiṇaḥ  || 12.01.040 ||
tannāthāste janapadāstacchīlācāravādinaḥ  |
anyonyato rājabhiśca kṣayaṃ yāsyanti pīḍitāḥ  || 12.01.041 ||
12.02.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
tataścānudinaṃ dharmaḥ satyaṃ śaucaṃ kṣamā dayā  |
kālena balinā rājannaṅkṣyatyāyurbalaṃ smṛtiḥ  || 12.02.001 ||
vittameva kalau nṝṇāṃ janmācāraguṇodayaḥ  |
dharmanyāyavyavasthāyāṃ kāraṇaṃ balameva hi  || 12.02.002 ||
dāmpatye'bhirucirheturmāyaiva vyāvahārike  |
strītve puṃstve ca hi ratirvipratve sūtrameva hi  || 12.02.003 ||
liṅgaṃ evāśramakhyātāvanyonyāpattikāraṇam  |
avṛttyā nyāyadaurbalyaṃ pāṇḍitye cāpalaṃ vacaḥ  || 12.02.004 ||
anāḍhyataivāsādhutve sādhutve dambha eva tu  |
svīkāra eva codvāhe snānameva prasādhanam  || 12.02.005 ||
dūre vāryayanaṃ tīrthaṃ lāvaṇyaṃ keśadhāraṇam  |
udaraṃbharatā svārthaḥ satyatve dhārṣṭyameva hi  || 12.02.006 ||
dākṣyaṃ kuṭumbabharaṇaṃ yaśo'rthe dharmasevanam  |
evaṃ prajābhirduṣṭābhirākīrṇe kṣitimaṇḍale  || 12.02.007 ||
brahmaviṭkṣatraśūdrāṇāṃ yo balī bhavitā nṛpaḥ  |
prajā hi lubdhai rājanyairnirghṛṇairdasyudharmabhiḥ  || 12.02.008 ||
ācchinnadāradraviṇā yāsyanti girikānanam  |
śākamūlāmiṣakṣaudra phalapuṣpāṣṭibhojanāḥ  || 12.02.009 ||
anāvṛṣṭyā vinaṅkṣyanti durbhikṣakarapīḍitāḥ  |
śītavātātapaprāvṛḍhimairanyonyataḥ prajāḥ  || 12.02.010 ||
kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ vyādhibhiścaiva santapsyante ca cintayā  |
triṃśadviṃśati varṣāṇi paramāyuḥ kalau nṛṇām  || 12.02.011 ||
kṣīyamāṇeṣu deheṣu dehināṃ kalidoṣataḥ  |
varṇāśramavatāṃ dharme naṣṭe vedapathe nṛṇām  || 12.02.012 ||
pāṣaṇḍapracure dharme dasyuprāyeṣu rājasu  |
cauryānṛtavṛthāhiṃsā nānāvṛttiṣu vai nṛṣu  || 12.02.013 ||
śūdraprāyeṣu varṇeṣu cchāgaprāyāsu dhenuṣu  |
gṛhaprāyeṣvāśrameṣu yaunaprāyeṣu bandhuṣu  || 12.02.014 ||
aṇuprāyāsvoṣadhīṣu śamīprāyeṣu sthāsnuṣu  |
vidyutprāyeṣu megheṣu śūnyaprāyeṣu sadmasu  || 12.02.015 ||
itthaṃ kalau gataprāye janeṣu kharadharmiṣu  |
dharmatrāṇāya sattvena bhagavānavatariṣyati  || 12.02.016 ||
carācaragurorviṣṇorīśvarasyākhilātmanaḥ  |
dharmatrāṇāya sādhūnāṃ janma karmāpanuttaye  || 12.02.017 ||
śambhalagrāmamukhyasya brāhmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ  |
bhavane viṣṇuyaśasaḥ kalkiḥ prādurbhaviṣyati  || 12.02.018 ||
aśvamāśugamāruhya devadattaṃ jagatpatiḥ  |
asināsādhudamanamaṣṭaiśvaryaguṇānvitaḥ  || 12.02.019 ||
vicarannāśunā kṣauṇyāṃ hayenāpratimadyutiḥ  |
nṛpaliṅgacchado dasyūn koṭiśo nihaniṣyati  || 12.02.020 ||
atha teṣāṃ bhaviṣyanti manāṃsi viśadāni vai  |
vāsudevāṅgarāgāti puṇyagandhānilaspṛśām  |
paurajānapadānāṃ vai hateṣvakhiladasyuṣu  || 12.02.021 ||
teṣāṃ prajāvisargaśca sthaviṣṭhaḥ sambhaviṣyati  |
vāsudeve bhagavati sattvamūrtau hṛdi sthite  || 12.02.022 ||
yadāvatīrṇo bhagavān kalkirdharmapatirhariḥ  |
kṛtaṃ bhaviṣyati tadā prajāsūtiśca sāttvikī  || 12.02.023 ||
yadā candraśca sūryaśca tathā tiṣyabṛhaspatī  |
ekarāśau sameṣyanti bhaviṣyati tadā kṛtam  || 12.02.024 ||
ye'tītā vartamānā ye bhaviṣyanti ca pārthivāḥ  |
te ta uddeśataḥ proktā vaṃśīyāḥ somasūryayoḥ  || 12.02.025 ||
ārabhya bhavato janma yāvannandābhiṣecanam  |
etadvarṣasahasraṃ tu śataṃ pañcadaśottaram  || 12.02.026 ||
saptarṣīṇāṃ tu yau pūrvau dṛśyete uditau divi  |
tayostu madhye nakṣatraṃ dṛśyate yatsamaṃ niśi  || 12.02.027 ||
tenaiva ṛṣayo yuktāstiṣṭhantyabdaśataṃ nṛṇām  |
te tvadīye dvijāḥ kāla adhunā cāśritā maghāḥ  || 12.02.028 ||
viṣṇorbhagavato bhānuḥ kṛṣṇākhyo'sau divaṃ gataḥ  |
tadāviśatkalirlokaṃ pāpe yadramate janaḥ  || 12.02.029 ||
yāvatsa pādapadmābhyāṃ spṛśanāste ramāpatiḥ  |
tāvatkalirvai pṛthivīṃ parākrantuṃ na cāśakat || 12.02.030 ||
yadā devarṣayaḥ sapta maghāsu vicaranti hi  |
tadā pravṛttastu kalirdvādaśābdaśatātmakaḥ  || 12.02.031 ||
yadā maghābhyo yāsyanti pūrvāṣāḍhāṃ maharṣayaḥ  |
tadā nandātprabhṛtyeṣa kalirvṛddhiṃ gamiṣyati  || 12.02.032 ||
yasmin kṛṣṇo divaṃ yātastasminneva tadāhani  |
pratipannaṃ kaliyugamiti prāhuḥ purāvidaḥ  || 12.02.033 ||
divyābdānāṃ sahasrānte caturthe tu punaḥ kṛtam  |
bhaviṣyati tadā nṝṇāṃ mana ātmaprakāśakam  || 12.02.034 ||
ityeṣa mānavo vaṃśo yathā saṅkhyāyate bhuvi  |
tathā viṭśūdraviprāṇāṃ tāstā jñeyā yuge yuge  || 12.02.035 ||
eteṣāṃ nāmaliṅgānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ mahātmanām  |
kathāmātrāvaśiṣṭānāṃ kīrtireva sthitā bhuvi  || 12.02.036 ||
devāpiḥ śāntanorbhrātā maruścekṣvākuvaṃśajaḥ  |
kalāpagrāma āsāte mahāyogabalānvitau  || 12.02.037 ||
tāvihaitya kalerante vāsudevānuśikṣitau  |
varṇāśramayutaṃ dharmaṃ pūrvavatprathayiṣyataḥ  || 12.02.038 ||
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśceti caturyugam  |
anena kramayogena bhuvi prāṇiṣu vartate  || 12.02.039 ||
rājannete mayā proktā naradevāstathāpare  |
bhūmau mamatvaṃ kṛtvānte hitvemāṃ nidhanaṃ gatāḥ  || 12.02.040 ||
kṛmiviḍbhasmasaṃjñānte rājanāmno'pi yasya ca  |
bhūtadhruktatkṛte svārthaṃ kiṃ veda nirayo yataḥ  || 12.02.041 ||
kathaṃ seyamakhaṇḍā bhūḥ pūrvairme puruṣairdhṛtā  |
matputrasya ca pautrasya matpūrvā vaṃśajasya vā  || 12.02.042 ||
tejo'bannamayaṃ kāyaṃ gṛhītvātmatayābudhāḥ  |
mahīṃ mamatayā cobhau hitvānte'darśanaṃ gatāḥ  || 12.02.043 ||
ye ye bhūpatayo rājan bhuñjate bhuvamojasā  |
kālena te kṛtāḥ sarve kathāmātrāḥ kathāsu ca  || 12.02.044 ||
12.03.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
dṛṣṭvātmani jaye vyagrānnṛpān hasati bhūriyam  |
aho mā vijigīṣanti mṛtyoḥ krīḍanakā nṛpāḥ  || 12.03.001 ||
kāma eṣa narendrāṇāṃ moghaḥ syādviduṣāmapi  |
yena phenopame piṇḍe ye'tiviśrambhitā nṛpāḥ  || 12.03.002 ||
pūrvaṃ nirjitya ṣaḍvargaṃ jeṣyāmo rājamantriṇaḥ  |
tataḥ sacivapaurāpta karīndrānasya kaṇṭakān  || 12.03.003 ||
evaṃ krameṇa jeṣyāmaḥ pṛthvīṃ sāgaramekhalām  |
ityāśābaddhahṛdayā na paśyantyantike'ntakam  || 12.03.004 ||
samudrāvaraṇāṃ jitvā māṃ viśantyabdhimojasā  |
kiyadātmajayasyaitanmuktirātmajaye phalam  || 12.03.005 ||
yāṃ visṛjyaiva manavastatsutāśca kurūdvaha  |
gatā yathāgataṃ yuddhe tāṃ māṃ jeṣyantyabuddhayaḥ  || 12.03.006 ||
matkṛte pitṛputrāṇāṃ bhrātṛṇāṃ cāpi vigrahaḥ  |
jāyate hyasatāṃ rājye mamatābaddhacetasām  || 12.03.007 ||
mamaiveyaṃ mahī kṛtsnā na te mūḍheti vādinaḥ  |
spardhamānā mitho ghnanti mriyante matkṛte nṛpāḥ  || 12.03.008 ||
pṛthuḥ purūravā gādhirnahuṣo bharato'rjunaḥ  |
māndhātā sagaro rāmaḥ khaṭvāṅgo dhundhuhā raghuḥ  || 12.03.009 ||
tṛṇabinduryayātiśca śaryātiḥ śantanurgayaḥ  |
bhagīrathaḥ kuvalayāśvaḥ kakutstho naiṣadho nṛgaḥ  || 12.03.010 ||
hiraṇyakaśipurvṛtro rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ  |
namuciḥ śambaro bhaumo hiraṇyākṣo'tha tārakaḥ  || 12.03.011 ||
anye ca bahavo daityā rājāno ye maheśvarāḥ  |
sarve sarvavidaḥ śūrāḥ sarve sarvajito'jitāḥ  || 12.03.012 ||
mamatāṃ mayyavartanta kṛtvoccairmartyadharmiṇaḥ  |
kathāvaśeṣāḥ kālena hyakṛtārthāḥ kṛtā vibho  || 12.03.013 ||
kathā imāste kathitā mahīyasāṃ vitāya lokeṣu yaśaḥ pareyuṣām  |
vijñānavairāgyavivakṣayā vibho vacovibhūtīrna tu pāramārthyam  || 12.03.014 ||
yastūttamaḥślokaguṇānuvādaḥ saṅgīyate'bhīkṣṇamamaṅgalaghnaḥ  |
tameva nityaṃ śṛṇuyādabhīkṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇe'malāṃ bhaktimabhīpsamānaḥ  || 12.03.015 ||
12.03.016|0 śrīrājovāca
kenopāyena bhagavan kalerdoṣān kalau janāḥ  |
vidhamiṣyantyupacitāṃstanme brūhi yathā mune  || 12.03.016 ||
yugāni yugadharmāṃśca mānaṃ pralayakalpayoḥ  |
kālasyeśvararūpasya gatiṃ viṣṇormahātmanaḥ  || 12.03.017 ||
12.03.018|0 śrīśuka uvāca
kṛte pravartate dharmaścatuṣpāttajjanairdhṛtaḥ  |
satyaṃ dayā tapo dānamiti pādā vibhornṛpa  || 12.03.018 ||
santuṣṭāḥ karuṇā maitrāḥ śāntā dāntāstitikṣavaḥ  |
ātmārāmāḥ samadṛśaḥ prāyaśaḥ śramaṇā janāḥ  || 12.03.019 ||
tretāyāṃ dharmapādānāṃ turyāṃśo hīyate śanaiḥ  |
adharmapādairanṛta hiṃṣāsantoṣavigrahaiḥ  || 12.03.020 ||
tadā kriyātaponiṣṭhā nātihiṃsrā na lampaṭāḥ  |
traivargikāstrayīvṛddhā varṇā brahmottarā nṛpa  || 12.03.021 ||
tapaḥsatyadayādāneṣvardhaṃ hrasvati dvāpare  |
hiṃsātuṣṭyanṛtadveṣairdharmasyādharmalakṣaṇaiḥ  || 12.03.022 ||
yaśasvino mahāśīlāḥ svādhyāyādhyayane ratāḥ  |
ādhyāḥ kuṭumbino hṛṣṭā varṇāḥ kṣatradvijottarāḥ  || 12.03.023 ||
kalau tu dharmapādānāṃ turyāṃśo'dharmahetubhiḥ  |
edhamānaiḥ kṣīyamāṇo hyante so'pi vinaṅkṣyati  || 12.03.024 ||
tasmin lubdhā durācārā nirdayāḥ śuṣkavairiṇaḥ  |
durbhagā bhūritarṣāśca śūdradāsottarāḥ prajāḥ  || 12.03.025 ||
sattvaṃ rajastama iti dṛśyante puruṣe guṇāḥ  |
kālasañcoditāste vai parivartanta ātmani  || 12.03.026 ||
prabhavanti yadā sattve manobuddhīndriyāṇi ca  |
tadā kṛtayugaṃ vidyājjñāne tapasi yadruciḥ  || 12.03.027 ||
yadā karmasu kāmyeṣu bhaktiryaśasi dehinām  |
tadā tretā rajovṛttiriti jānīhi buddhiman  || 12.03.028 ||
yadā lobhastvasantoṣo māno dambho'tha matsaraḥ  |
karmaṇāṃ cāpi kāmyānāṃ dvāparaṃ tadrajastamaḥ  || 12.03.029 ||
yadā māyānṛtaṃ tandrā nidrā hiṃsā viṣādanam  |
śokamohau bhayaṃ dainyaṃ sa kalistāmasaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 12.03.030 ||
tasmātkṣudradṛśo martyāḥ kṣudrabhāgyā mahāśanāḥ  |
kāmino vittahīnāśca svairiṇyaśca striyo'satīḥ  || 12.03.031 ||
dasyūtkṛṣṭā janapadā vedāḥ pāṣaṇḍadūṣitāḥ  |
rājānaśca prajābhakṣāḥ śiśnodaraparā dvijāḥ  || 12.03.032 ||
avratā baṭavo'śaucā bhikṣavaśca kuṭumbinaḥ  |
tapasvino grāmavāsā nyāsino'tyarthalolupāḥ  || 12.03.033 ||
hrasvakāyā mahāhārā bhūryapatyā gatahriyaḥ  |
śaśvatkaṭukabhāṣiṇyaścauryamāyorusāhasāḥ  || 12.03.034 ||
paṇayiṣyanti vai kṣudrāḥ kirāṭāḥ kūṭakāriṇaḥ  |
anāpadyapi maṃsyante vārtāṃ sādhu jugupsitām  || 12.03.035 ||
patiṃ tyakṣyanti nirdravyaṃ bhṛtyā apyakhilottamam  |
bhṛtyaṃ vipannaṃ patayaḥ kaulaṃ gāścāpayasvinīḥ  || 12.03.036 ||
pitṛbhrātṛsuhṛjjñātīn hitvā sauratasauhṛdāḥ  |
nanāndṛśyālasaṃvādā dīnāḥ straiṇāḥ kalau narāḥ  || 12.03.037 ||
śūdrāḥ pratigrahīṣyanti tapoveṣopajīvinaḥ  |
dharmaṃ vakṣyantyadharmajñā adhiruhyottamāsanam  || 12.03.038 ||
nityaṃ udvignamanaso durbhikṣakarakarśitāḥ  |
niranne bhūtale rājananāvṛṣṭibhayāturāḥ  || 12.03.039 ||
vāso'nnapānaśayana vyavāyasnānabhūṣaṇaiḥ  |
hīnāḥ piśācasandarśā bhaviṣyanti kalau prajāḥ  || 12.03.040 ||
kalau kākiṇike'pyarthe vigṛhya tyaktasauhṛdāḥ  |
tyakṣyanti ca priyān prāṇān haniṣyanti svakānapi  || 12.03.041 ||
na rakṣiṣyanti manujāḥ sthavirau pitarāvapi  |
putrān bhāryāṃ ca kulajāṃ kṣudrāḥ śiśnodaraṃbharāḥ  || 12.03.042 ||
kalau na rājan jagatāṃ paraṃ guruṃ trilokanāthānatapādapaṅkajam  |
prāyeṇa martyā bhagavantamacyutaṃ yakṣyanti pāṣaṇḍavibhinnacetasaḥ  || 12.03.043 ||
yannāmadheyaṃ mriyamāṇa āturaḥ patan skhalan vā vivaśo gṛṇan pumān  |
vimuktakarmārgala uttamāṃ gatiṃ prāpnoti yakṣyanti na taṃ kalau janāḥ  || 12.03.044 ||
puṃsāṃ kalikṛtān doṣān dravyadeśātmasambhavān  |
sarvān harati cittastho bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ  || 12.03.045 ||
śrutaḥ saṅkīrtito dhyātaḥ pūjitaścādṛto'pi vā  |
nṛṇāṃ dhunoti bhagavān hṛtstho janmāyutāśubham  || 12.03.046 ||
yathā hemni sthito vahnirdurvarṇaṃ hanti dhātujam  |
evamātmagato viṣṇuryogināmaśubhāśayam  || 12.03.047 ||
vidyātapaḥprāṇanirodhamaitrī tīrthābhiṣekavratadānajapyaiḥ  |
nātyantaśuddhiṃ labhate'ntarātmā yathā hṛdisthe bhagavatyanante  || 12.03.048 ||
tasmātsarvātmanā rājan hṛdisthaṃ kuru keśavam  |
mriyamāṇo hyavahitastato yāsi parāṃ gatim  || 12.03.049 ||
mriyamāṇairabhidhyeyo bhagavān parameśvaraḥ  |
ātmabhāvaṃ nayatyaṅga sarvātmā sarvasaṃśrayaḥ  || 12.03.050 ||
kalerdoṣanidhe rājannasti hyeko mahān guṇaḥ  |
kīrtanādeva kṛṣṇasya muktasaṅgaḥ paraṃ vrajet || 12.03.051 ||
kṛte yaddhyāyato viṣṇuṃ tretāyāṃ yajato makhaiḥ  |
dvāpare paricaryāyāṃ kalau taddharikīrtanāt || 12.03.052 ||
12.04.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca
kālaste paramāṇvādirdviparārdhāvadhirnṛpa  |
kathito yugamānaṃ ca śṛṇu kalpalayāvapi  || 12.04.001 ||
caturyugasahasraṃ tu brahmaṇo dinamucyate  |
sa kalpo yatra manavaścaturdaśa viśāmpate  || 12.04.002 ||
tadante pralayastāvān brāhmī rātrirudāhṛtā  |
trayo lokā ime tatra kalpante pralayāya hi  || 12.04.003 ||
eṣa naimittikaḥ proktaḥ pralayo yatra viśvasṛk |
śete'nantāsano viśvamātmasātkṛtya cātmabhūḥ  || 12.04.004 ||
dviparārdhe tvatikrānte brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  |
tadā prakṛtayaḥ sapta kalpante pralayāya vai  || 12.04.005 ||
eṣa prākṛtiko rājan pralayo yatra līyate  |
aṇḍakoṣastu saṅghāto vighāṭa upasādite  || 12.04.006 ||
parjanyaḥ śatavarṣāṇi bhūmau rājanna varṣati  |
tadā niranne hyanyonyaṃ bhakṣyamāṇāḥ kṣudhārditāḥ  || 12.04.007 ||
kṣayaṃ yāsyanti śanakaiḥ kālenopadrutāḥ prajāḥ  |
sāmudraṃ daihikaṃ bhaumaṃ rasaṃ sāṃvartako raviḥ  || 12.04.008 ||
raśmibhiḥ pibate ghoraiḥ sarvaṃ naiva vimuñcati  |
tataḥ saṃvartako vahniḥ saṅkarṣaṇamukhotthitaḥ  || 12.04.009 ||
dahatyanilavegotthaḥ śūnyān bhūvivarānatha  |
uparyadhaḥ samantācca śikhābhirvahnisūryayoḥ  || 12.04.010 ||
dahyamānaṃ vibhātyaṇḍaṃ dagdhagomayapiṇḍavat |
tataḥ pracaṇḍapavano varṣāṇāmadhikaṃ śatam  || 12.04.011 ||
paraḥ sāṃvartako vāti dhūmraṃ khaṃ rajasāvṛtam  |
tato meghakulānyaṅga citra varṇānyanekaśaḥ  || 12.04.012 ||
śataṃ varṣāṇi varṣanti nadanti rabhasasvanaiḥ  |
tata ekodakaṃ viśvaṃ brahmāṇḍavivarāntaram  || 12.04.013 ||
tadā bhūmergandhaguṇaṃ grasantyāpa udaplave  |
grastagandhā tu pṛthivī pralayatvāya kalpate  || 12.04.014 ||
apāṃ rasamatho tejastā līyante'tha nīrasāḥ  |
grasate tejaso rūpaṃ vāyustadrahitaṃ tadā  || 12.04.015 ||
līyate cānile tejo vāyoḥ khaṃ grasate guṇam  |
sa vai viśati khaṃ rājaṃstataśca nabhaso guṇam  || 12.04.016 ||
śabdaṃ grasati bhūtādirnabhastamanu līyate  |
taijasaścendriyāṇyaṅga devān vaikāriko guṇaiḥ  || 12.04.017 ||
mahān grasatyahaṅkāraṃ guṇāḥ sattvādayaśca tam  |
grasate'vyākṛtaṃ rājan guṇān kālena coditam  || 12.04.018 ||
na tasya kālāvayavaiḥ pariṇāmādayo guṇāḥ  |
anādyanantamavyaktaṃ nityaṃ kāraṇamavyayam  || 12.04.019 ||
na yatra vāco na mano na sattvaṃ tamo rajo vā mahadādayo'mī  |
na prāṇabuddhīndriyadevatā vā na sanniveśaḥ khalu lokakalpaḥ  || 12.04.020 ||
na svapnajāgranna ca tatsuṣuptaṃ na khaṃ jalaṃ bhūranilo'gnirarkaḥ  |
saṃsuptavacchūnyavadapratarkyaṃ tanmūlabhūtaṃ padamāmananti  || 12.04.021 ||
layaḥ prākṛtiko hyeṣa puruṣāvyaktayoryadā  |
śaktayaḥ sampralīyante vivaśāḥ kālavidrutāḥ  || 12.04.022 ||
buddhīndriyārtharūpeṇa jñānaṃ bhāti tadāśrayam  |
dṛśyatvāvyatirekābhyāmādyantavadavastu yat || 12.04.023 ||
dīpaścakṣuśca rūpaṃ ca jyotiṣo na pṛthagbhavet |
evaṃ dhīḥ khāni mātrāśca na syuranyatamādṛtāt || 12.04.024 ||
buddherjāgaraṇaṃ svapnaḥ suṣuptiriti cocyate  |
māyāmātramidaṃ rājannānātvaṃ pratyagātmani  || 12.04.025 ||
yathā jaladharā vyomni bhavanti na bhavanti ca  |
brahmaṇīdaṃ tathā viśvamavayavyudayāpyayāt || 12.04.026 ||
satyaṃ hyavayavaḥ proktaḥ sarvāvayavināmiha  |
vinārthena pratīyeran paṭasyevāṅga tantavaḥ  || 12.04.027 ||
yatsāmānyaviśeṣābhyāmupalabhyeta sa bhramaḥ  |
anyonyāpāśrayātsarvamādyantavadavastu yat || 12.04.028 ||
vikāraḥ khyāyamāno'pi pratyagātmānamantarā  |
na nirūpyo'styaṇurapi syācceccitsama ātmavat || 12.04.029 ||
na hi satyasya nānātvamavidvān yadi manyate  |
nānātvaṃ chidrayoryadvajjyotiṣorvātayoriva  || 12.04.030 ||
yathā hiraṇyaṃ bahudhā samīyate nṛbhiḥ kriyābhirvyavahāravartmasu  |
evaṃ vacobhirbhagavānadhokṣajo vyākhyāyate laukikavaidikairjanaiḥ  || 12.04.031 ||
yathā ghano'rkaprabhavo'rkadarśito   hyarkāṃśabhūtasya ca cakṣuṣastamaḥ  |
evaṃ tvahaṃ brahmaguṇastadīkṣito   brahmāṃśakasyātmana ātmabandhanaḥ  || 12.04.032 ||*
ghano yadārkaprabhavo vidīryate cakṣuḥ svarūpaṃ ravimīkṣate tadā  |
yadā hyahaṅkāra upādhirātmano jijñāsayā naśyati tarhyanusmaret || 12.04.033 ||
yadaivametena vivekahetinā māyāmayāhaṅkaraṇātmabandhanam  |
chittvācyutātmānubhavo'vatiṣṭhate tamāhurātyantikamaṅga samplavam  || 12.04.034 ||
nityadā sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ parantapa  |
utpattipralayāveke sūkṣmajñāḥ sampracakṣate  || 12.04.035 ||
kālasrotojavenāśu hriyamāṇasya nityadā  |
pariṇāmināṃ avasthāstā janmapralayahetavaḥ  || 12.04.036 ||
anādyantavatānena kāleneśvaramūrtinā  |
avasthā naiva dṛśyante viyati jyotiṣāṃ iva  || 12.04.037 ||
nityo naimittikaścaiva tathā prākṛtiko layaḥ  |
ātyantikaśca kathitaḥ kālasya gatirīdṛśī  || 12.04.038 ||
etāḥ kuruśreṣṭha jagadvidhāturnārāyaṇasyākhilasattvadhāmnaḥ  |
līlākathāste kathitāḥ samāsataḥ kārtsnyena nājo'pyabhidhātumīśaḥ  || 12.04.039 ||
saṃsārasindhumatidustaramuttitīrṣor  nānyaḥ plavo bhagavataḥ puruṣottamasya  |
līlākathārasaniṣevaṇamantareṇa   puṃso bhavedvividhaduḥkhadavārditasya  || 12.04.040 ||*

12.05.001|0 śrīśuka uvāca

12.06.002|0 rājovāca

12.06.008|0 sūta uvāca
ityuktastamanujñāpya bhagavān bādarāyaṇiḥ  |
jagāma bhikṣubhiḥ sākaṃ naradevena pūjitaḥ  || 12.06.008 ||
parīkṣidapi rājarṣirātmanyātmānamātmanā  |

sarpasatre samiddhāgnau dahyamānānmahoragān  |

apaśyaṃstakṣakaṃ tatra rājā pārīkṣito dvijān  |

taṃ gopāyati rājendra śakraḥ śaraṇamāgatam  |

sahendrastakṣako viprā nāgnau kimiti pātyate  || 12.06.020 ||
tacchrutvājuhuvurviprāḥ sahendraṃ takṣakaṃ makhe  |

iti brahmoditākṣepaiḥ sthānādindraḥ pracālitaḥ  |
babhūva sambhrāntamatiḥ savimānaḥ satakṣakaḥ  || 12.06.022 ||
taṃ patantaṃ vimānena sahatakṣakamambarāt |
vilokyāṅgirasaḥ prāha rājānaṃ taṃ bṛhaspatiḥ  || 12.06.023 ||
naiṣa tvayā manuṣyendra vadhamarhati sarparāṭ |
anena pītamamṛtamatha vā ajarāmaraḥ  || 12.06.024 ||
jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ jantorgatiḥ svenaiva karmaṇā  |

sarpacaurāgnividyudbhyaḥ kṣuttṛdvyādhyādibhirnṛpa  |

tasmātsatramidaṃ rājan saṃsthīyetābhicārikam  |

12.06.028|0 sūta uvāca
ityuktaḥ sa tathetyāha maharṣermānayan vacaḥ  |
sarpasatrāduparataḥ pūjayāmāsa vākpatim  || 12.06.028 ||
saiṣā viṣṇormahāmāyā bādhyayālakṣaṇā yayā  |

12.06.037|0 sūta uvāca

śṛṇoti ya imaṃ sphoṭaṃ suptaśrotre ca śūnyadṛk |

tato'kṣarasamāmnāyamasṛjadbhagavānajaḥ  |
antasthoṣmasvarasparśa hrasvadīrghādilakṣaṇam  || 12.06.043 ||

savyāhṛtikān soṃkārāṃścāturhotravivakṣayā  || 12.06.044 ||
putrānadhyāpayattāṃstu brahmarṣīn brahmakovidān  |
te tu dharmopadeṣṭāraḥ svaputrebhyaḥ samādiśan  || 12.06.045 ||
te paramparayā prāptāstattacchiṣyairdhṛtavrataiḥ  |

kṣīṇāyuṣaḥ kṣīṇasattvān durmedhān vīkṣya kālataḥ  |

asminnapyantare brahman bhagavān lokabhāvanaḥ  |
brahmeśādyairlokapālairyācito dharmaguptaye  || 12.06.048 ||
parāśarātsatyavatyāmaṃśāṃśakalayā vibhuḥ  |
avatīrṇo mahābhāga vedaṃ cakre caturvidham  || 12.06.049 ||
ṛgatharvayajuḥsāmnāṃ rāśīruddhṛtya vargaśaḥ  |
catasraḥ saṃhitāścakre mantrairmaṇigaṇā iva  || 12.06.050 ||
tāsāṃ sa caturaḥ śiṣyānupāhūya mahāmatiḥ  |
ekaikāṃ saṃhitāṃ brahmannekaikasmai dadau vibhuḥ  || 12.06.051 ||
pailāya saṃhitāmādyāṃ bahvṛcākhyāṃ uvāca ha  |
vaiśampāyanasaṃjñāya nigadākhyaṃ yajurgaṇam  || 12.06.052 ||
sāmnāṃ jaiminaye prāha tathā chandogasaṃhitām  |

pailaḥ svasaṃhitāmūce indrapramitaye muniḥ  |

caturdhā vyasya bodhyāya yājñavalkyāya bhārgava  |

adhyāpayatsaṃhitāṃ svāṃ māṇḍūkeyamṛṣiṃ kavim  |

śākalyastatsutaḥ svāṃ tu pañcadhā vyasya saṃhitām  |

jātūkarṇyaśca tacchiṣyaḥ saniruktāṃ svasaṃhitām  |
balākapailajābāla virajebhyo dadau muniḥ  || 12.06.058 ||
bāṣkaliḥ pratiśākhābhyo vālakhilyākhyasaṃhitām  |

bahvṛcāḥ saṃhitā hyetā ebhirbrahmarṣibhirdhṛtāḥ  |

vaiśampāyanaśiṣyā vai carakādhvaryavo'bhavan  |
yaccerurbrahmahatyāṃhaḥ kṣapaṇaṃ svagurorvratam  || 12.06.061 ||
yājñavalkyaśca tacchiṣya āhāho bhagavan kiyat |
caritenālpasārāṇāṃ cariṣye'haṃ suduścaram  || 12.06.062 ||
ityukto gururapyāha kupito yāhyalaṃ tvayā  |
viprāvamantrā śiṣyeṇa madadhītaṃ tyajāśviti  || 12.06.063 ||
devarātasutaḥ so'pi charditvā yajuṣāṃ gaṇam  |

yajūṃṣi tittirā bhūtvā tallolupatayādaduḥ  |

yājñavalkyastato brahmaṃśchandāṃsyadhi gaveṣayan  |
guroravidyamānāni sūpatasthe'rkamīśvaram  || 12.06.066 ||

12.06.073|0 sūta uvāca
evaṃ stutaḥ sa bhagavān vājirūpadharo raviḥ  |

laugākṣirmāṅgaliḥ kulyaḥ kuśīdaḥ kukṣireva ca  |

kṛto hiraṇyanābhasya caturviṃśati saṃhitāḥ  |

12.07.001|0 sūta uvāca
atharvavitsumantuśca śiṣyamadhyāpayatsvakām  |

śauklāyanirbrahmabalirmodoṣaḥ pippalāyaniḥ  |
vedadarśasya śiṣyāste pathyaśiṣyānatho śṛṇu  |

babhruḥ śiṣyo'thāngirasaḥ saindhavāyana eva ca  |

purāṇalakṣaṇaṃ brahman brahmarṣibhirnirūpitam  |

sargo'syātha visargaśca vṛttirakṣāntarāṇi ca  |

avyākṛtaguṇakṣobhānmahatastrivṛto'hamaḥ  |

puruṣānugṛhītānāmeteṣāṃ vāsanāmayaḥ  |
visargo'yaṃ samāhāro bījādbījaṃ carācaram  || 12.07.012 ||
vṛttirbhūtāni bhūtānāṃ carāṇāmacarāṇi ca  |

rakṣācyutāvatārehā viśvasyānu yuge yuge  |

manvantaraṃ manurdevā manuputrāḥ sureśvarāḥ  |
rṣayo'ṃśāvatārāśca hareḥ ṣaḍvidhamucyate  || 12.07.015 ||
rājñāṃ brahmaprasūtānāṃ vaṃśastraikāliko'nvayaḥ  |
vaṃśānucaritaṃ teṣāṃ vṛttaṃ vaṃśadharāsca ye  || 12.07.016 ||
naimittikaḥ prākṛtiko nitya ātyantiko layaḥ  |
saṃstheti kavibhiḥ proktaścaturdhāsya svabhāvataḥ  || 12.07.017 ||
heturjīvo'sya sargāderavidyākarmakārakaḥ  |
yaṃ cānuśāyinaṃ prāhuravyākṛtamutāpare  || 12.07.018 ||
vyatirekānvayo yasya jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣu  |
māyāmayeṣu tadbrahma jīvavṛttiṣvapāśrayaḥ  || 12.07.019 ||
padārtheṣu yathā dravyaṃ sanmātraṃ rūpanāmasu  |
bījādipañcatāntāsu hyavasthāsu yutāyutam  || 12.07.020 ||
virameta yadā cittaṃ hitvā vṛttitrayaṃ svayam  |
yogerla vā tadātmānaṃ vedehāyā nivartate  || 12.07.021 ||
evaṃ lakṣaṇalakṣyāṇi purāṇāni purāvidaḥ  |
munayo'ṣṭādaśa prāhuḥ kṣullakāni mahānti ca  || 12.07.022 ||
brāhmaṃ pādmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca śaivaṃ laiṅgaṃ sagāruḍaṃ  |
nāradīyaṃ bhāgavatamāgneyaṃ skāndasaṃjñitam  || 12.07.023 ||
bhaviṣyaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ savāmanam  |
vārāhaṃ mātsyaṃ kaurmaṃ ca brahmāṇḍākhyamiti triṣaṭ || 12.07.024 ||
brahmannidaṃ samākhyātaṃ śākhāpraṇayanaṃ muneḥ  |
śiṣyaśiṣyapraśiṣyāṇāṃ brahmatejovivardhanam  || 12.07.025 ||
12.08.001|0 śrīśaunaka uvāca
sūta jīva ciraṃ sādho vada no vadatāṃ vara  |
tamasyapāre bhramatāṃ nṝṇāṃ tvaṃ pāradarśanaḥ  || 12.08.001 ||
āhuścirāyuṣamṛṣiṃ mṛkaṇḍutanayaṃ janāḥ  |
yaḥ kalpānte hyurvarito yena grastamidaṃ jagat || 12.08.002 ||
sa vā asmatkulotpannaḥ kalpe'smin bhārgavarṣabhaḥ  |
naivādhunāpi bhūtānāṃ samplavaḥ ko'pi jāyate  || 12.08.003 ||
eka evārṇave bhrāmyan dadarśa puruṣaṃ kila  |
vaṭapatrapuṭe tokaṃ śayānaṃ tvekamadbhutam  || 12.08.004 ||
eṣa naḥ saṃśayo bhūyān sūta kautūhalaṃ yataḥ  |
taṃ naśchindhi mahāyogin purāṇeṣvapi sammataḥ  || 12.08.005 ||
12.08.006|0 sūta uvāca
praśnastvayā maharṣe'yaṃ kṛto lokabhramāpahaḥ  |
nārāyaṇakathā yatra gītā kalimalāpahā  || 12.08.006 ||
prāptadvijātisaṃskāro mārkaṇḍeyaḥ pituḥ kramāt |
chandāṃsyadhītya dharmeṇa tapaḥsvādhyāyasaṃyutaḥ  || 12.08.007 ||
bṛhadvratadharaḥ śānto jaṭilo valkalāmbaraḥ  |
bibhratkamaṇḍaluṃ daṇḍamupavītaṃ samekhalam  || 12.08.008 ||
kṛṣṇājinaṃ sākṣasūtraṃ kuśāṃśca niyamarddhaye  |
agnyarkaguruviprātmasvarcayan sandhyayorharim  || 12.08.009 ||
sāyaṃ prātaḥ sa gurave bhaikṣyamāhṛtya vāgyataḥ  |
bubhuje gurvanujñātaḥ sakṛnno cedupoṣitaḥ  || 12.08.010 ||
evaṃ tapaḥsvādhyāyaparo varṣāṇāmayutāyutam  |
ārādhayan hṛṣīkeśaṃ jigye mṛtyuṃ sudurjayam  || 12.08.011 ||
brahmā bhṛgurbhavo dakṣo brahmaputrāśca ye'pare  |
nṛdevapitṛbhūtāni tenāsannativismitāḥ  || 12.08.012 ||
itthaṃ bṛhadvratadharastapaḥsvādhyāyasaṃyamaiḥ  |
dadhyāvadhokṣajaṃ yogī dhvastakleśāntarātmanā  || 12.08.013 ||
tasyaivaṃ yuñjataścittaṃ mahāyogena yoginaḥ  |
vyatīyāya mahān kālo manvantaraṣaḍātmakaḥ  || 12.08.014 ||
etatpurandaro jñātvā saptame'smin kilāntare  |
tapoviśaṅkito brahmannārebhe tadvighātanam  || 12.08.015 ||
gandharvāpsarasaḥ kāmaṃ vasantamalayānilau  |
munaye preṣayāmāsa rajastokamadau tathā  || 12.08.016 ||
te vai tadāśramaṃ jagmurhimādreḥ pārśva uttare  |
puṣpabhadrā nadī yatra citrākhyā ca śilā vibho  || 12.08.017 ||
tadāśramapadaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyadrumalatāñcitam  |
puṇyadvijakulākīṛnaṃ puṇyāmalajalāśayam  || 12.08.018 ||
mattabhramarasaṅgītaṃ mattakokilakūjitam  |
mattabarhinaṭāṭopaṃ mattadvijakulākulam  || 12.08.019 ||
vāyuḥ praviṣṭa ādāya himanirjharaśīkarān  |
sumanobhiḥ pariṣvakto vavāvuttambhayan smaram  || 12.08.020 ||
udyaccandraniśāvaktraḥ pravālastabakālibhiḥ  |
gopadrumalatājālaistatrāsītkusumākaraḥ  || 12.08.021 ||
anvīyamāno gandharvairgītavāditrayūthakaiḥ  |
adṛśyatāttacāpeṣuḥ svaḥstrīyūthapatiḥ smaraḥ  || 12.08.022 ||
hutvāgniṃ samupāsīnaṃ dadṛśuḥ śakrakiṅkarāḥ  |
mīlitākṣaṃ durādharṣaṃ mūrtimantamivānalam  || 12.08.023 ||
nanṛtustasya purataḥ striyo'tho gāyakā jaguḥ  |
mṛdaṅgavīṇāpaṇavairvādyaṃ cakrurmanoramam  || 12.08.024 ||
sandadhe'straṃ svadhanuṣi kāmaḥ pañcamukhaṃ tadā  |
madhurmano rajastoka indrabhṛtyā vyakampayan  || 12.08.025 ||
krīḍantyāḥ puñjikasthalyāḥ kandukaiḥ stanagauravāt |
bhṛśamudvignamadhyāyāḥ keśavisraṃsitasrajaḥ  || 12.08.026 ||
itastato bhramaddṛṣṭeścalantyā anu kandukam  |
vāyurjahāra tadvāsaḥ sūkṣmaṃ truṭitamekhalam  || 12.08.027 ||
visasarja tadā bāṇaṃ matvā taṃ svajitaṃ smaraḥ  |
sarvaṃ tatrābhavanmoghamanīśasya yathodyamaḥ  || 12.08.028 ||
ta itthamapakurvanto munestattejasā mune  |
dahyamānā nivavṛtuḥ prabodhyāhimivārbhakāḥ  || 12.08.029 ||
itīndrānucarairbrahman dharṣito'pi mahāmuniḥ  |
yannāgādahamo bhāvaṃ na taccitraṃ mahatsu hi  || 12.08.030 ||
dṛṣṭvā nistejasaṃ kāmaṃ sagaṇaṃ bhagavān svarāṭ |
śrutvānubhāvaṃ brahmarṣervismayaṃ samagātparam  || 12.08.031 ||
tasyaivaṃ yuñjataścittaṃ tapaḥsvādhyāyasaṃyamaiḥ  |
anugrahāyāvirāsīnnaranārāyaṇo hariḥ  || 12.08.032 ||
tau śuklakṛṣṇau navakañjalocanau   caturbhujau rauravavalkalāmbarau  |
pavitrapāṇī upavītakaṃ trivṛt  kamaṇḍaluṃ daṇḍamṛjuṃ ca vaiṇavam  || 12.08.033 ||*
padmākṣamālāmuta jantumārjanaṃ   vedaṃ ca sākṣāttapa eva rūpiṇau  |
tapattaḍidvarṇapiśaṅgarociṣā   prāṃśū dadhānau vibudharṣabhārcitau  || 12.08.034 ||*
te vai bhagavato rūpe naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī  |
dṛṣṭvotthāyādareṇoccairnanāmāṅgena daṇḍavat || 12.08.035 ||
sa tatsandarśanānanda nirvṛtātmendriyāśayaḥ  |
hṛṣṭaromāśrupūrṇākṣo na sehe tāvudīkṣitum  || 12.08.036 ||
utthāya prāñjaliḥ prahva autsukyādāśliṣanniva  |
namo nama itīśānau babhāśe gadgadākṣaram  || 12.08.037 ||
tayorāsanamādāya pādayoravanijya ca  |
arhaṇenānulepena dhūpamālyairapūjayat || 12.08.038 ||
sukhamāsanamāsīnau prasādābhimukhau munī  |
punarānamya pādābhyāṃ gariṣṭhāvidamabravīt || 12.08.039 ||
12.08.040|0 śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca
kiṃ varṇaye tava vibho yadudīrito'suḥ   saṃspandate tamanu vāṅmanaindriyāṇi  |
spandanti vai tanubhṛtāmajaśarvayośca   svasyāpyathāpi bhajatāmasi bhāvabandhuḥ  || 12.08.040 ||*
mūrtī ime bhagavato bhagavaṃstrilokyāḥ   kṣemāya tāpaviramāya ca mṛtyujityai  |
nānā bibharṣyavitumanyatanūryathedaṃ   sṛṣṭvā punargrasasi sarvamivorṇanābhiḥ  || 12.08.041 ||*
tasyāvituḥ sthiracareśituraṅghrimūlaṃ   yatsthaṃ na karmaguṇakālarajaḥ spṛśanti  |
yadvai stuvanti ninamanti yajantyabhīkṣṇaṃ   dhyāyanti vedahṛdayā munayastadāptyai  || 12.08.042 ||*
nānyaṃ tavāṅghryupanayādapavargamūrteḥ   kṣemaṃ janasya paritobhiya īśa vidmaḥ  |
brahmā bibhetyalamato dviparārdhadhiṣṇyaḥ   kālasya te kimuta tatkṛtabhautikānām  || 12.08.043 ||*
tadvai bhajāmyṛtadhiyastava pādamūlaṃ   hitvedamātmacchadi cātmaguroḥ parasya  |
dehādyapārthamasadantyamabhijñamātraṃ   vindeta te tarhi sarvamanīṣitārtham  || 12.08.044 ||*
sattvaṃ rajastama itīśa tavātmabandho   māyāmayāḥ sthitilayodayahetavo'sya  |
līlā dhṛtā yadapi sattvamayī praśāntyai   nānye nṛṇāṃ vyasanamohabhiyaśca yābhyām  || 12.08.045 ||*
tasmāttaveha bhagavannatha tāvakānāṃ   śuklāṃ tanuṃ svadayitāṃ kuśalā bhajanti  |
yatsātvatāḥ puruṣarūpamuśanti sattvaṃ   loko yato'bhayamutātmasukhaṃ na cānyat || 12.08.046 ||*
tasmai namo bhagavate puruṣāya bhūmne   viśvāya viśvagurave paradaivatāya  |
nārāyaṇāya ṛṣaye ca narottamāya   haṃsāya saṃyatagire nigameśvarāya  || 12.08.047 ||*
yaṃ vai na veda vitathākṣapathairbhramaddhīḥ   santaṃ svakeṣvasuṣu hṛdyapi dṛkpatheṣu  |
tanmāyayāvṛtamatiḥ sa u eva sākṣād  ādyastavākhilagurorupasādya vedam  || 12.08.048 ||*
yaddarśanaṃ nigama ātmarahaḥprakāśaṃ   muhyanti yatra kavayo'japarā yatantaḥ  |
taṃ sarvavādaviṣayapratirūpaśīlaṃ   vande mahāpuruṣamātmanigūḍhabodham  || 12.08.049 ||*
12.09.001|0 sūta uvāca
saṃstuto bhagavānitthaṃ mārkaṇḍeyena dhīmatā  |
nārāyaṇo narasakhaḥ prīta āha bhṛgūdvaham  || 12.09.001 ||
12.09.002|0 śrībhagavānuvāca
bho bho brahmarṣivaryo'si siddha ātmasamādhinā  |
mayi bhaktyānapāyinyā tapaḥsvādhyāyasaṃyamaiḥ  || 12.09.002 ||
vayaṃ te parituṣṭāḥ sma tvadbṛhadvratacaryayā  |
varaṃ pratīccha bhadraṃ te varado'smi tvadīpsitam  || 12.09.003 ||
12.09.004|0 śrīṛṣiruvāca
jitaṃ te devadeveśa prapannārtiharācyuta  |
vareṇaitāvatālaṃ no yadbhavān samadṛśyata  || 12.09.004 ||
gṛhītvājādayo yasya śrīmatpādābjadarśanam  |
manasā yogapakvena sa bhavānme'kṣigocaraḥ  || 12.09.005 ||
athāpyambujapatrākṣa puṇyaślokaśikhāmaṇe  |
drakṣye māyāṃ yayā lokaḥ sapālo veda sadbhidām  || 12.09.006 ||
12.09.007|0 sūta uvāca
itīḍito'rcitaḥ kāmamṛṣiṇā bhagavānmune  |
tatheti sa smayan prāgādbadaryāśramamīśvaraḥ  || 12.09.007 ||
tameva cintayannarthamṛṣiḥ svāśrama eva saḥ  |
vasannagnyarkasomāmbu bhūvāyuviyadātmasu  || 12.09.008 ||
dhyāyan sarvatra ca hariṃ bhāvadravyairapūjayat |
kvacitpūjāṃ visasmāra premaprasarasamplutaḥ  || 12.09.009 ||
tasyaikadā bhṛguśreṣṭha puṣpabhadrātaṭe muneḥ  |
upāsīnasya sandhyāyāṃ brahman vāyurabhūnmahān  || 12.09.010 ||
taṃ caṇḍaśabdaṃ samudīrayantaṃ balāhakā anvabhavan karālāḥ  |
akṣasthaviṣṭhā mumucustaḍidbhiḥ svananta uccairabhi varṣadhārāḥ  || 12.09.011 ||
tato vyadṛśyanta catuḥ samudrāḥ samantataḥ kṣmātalamāgrasantaḥ  |
samīravegormibhirugranakra mahābhayāvartagabhīraghoṣāḥ  || 12.09.012 ||
antarbahiścādbhiratidyubhiḥ kharaiḥ   śatahradābhirupatāpitaṃ jagat |
caturvidhaṃ vīkṣya sahātmanā munir  jalāplutāṃ kṣmāṃ vimanāḥ samatrasat || 12.09.013 ||*
tasyaivamudvīkṣata ūrmibhīṣaṇaḥ prabhañjanāghūrṇitavārmahārṇavaḥ  |
āpūryamāṇo varaṣadbhirambudaiḥ kṣmāmapyadhāddvīpavarṣādribhiḥ samam  || 12.09.014 ||
sakṣmāntarikṣaṃ sadivaṃ sabhāgaṇaṃ   trailokyamāsītsaha digbhirāplutam  |
sa eka evorvarito mahāmunir  babhrāma vikṣipya jaṭā jaḍāndhavat || 12.09.015 ||*
kṣuttṛṭparīto makaraistimiṅgilair  upadruto vīcinabhasvatāhataḥ  |
tamasyapāre patito bhraman diśo   na veda khaṃ gāṃ ca pariśrameṣitaḥ  || 12.09.016 ||*
kracinmagno mahāvarte taralaistāḍitaḥ kvacit |
yādobhirbhakṣyate kvāpi svayamanyonyaghātibhiḥ  || 12.09.017 ||
kvacicchokaṃ kvacinmohaṃ kvacidduḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ bhayam  |
kvacinmṛtyumavāpnoti vyādhyādibhirutārditaḥ  || 12.09.018 ||
ayutāyatavarṣāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi śatāni ca  |
vyatīyurbhramatastasmin viṣṇumāyāvṛtātmanaḥ  || 12.09.019 ||
sa kadācidbhramaṃstasmin pṛthivyāḥ kakudi dvijaḥ  |
nyāgrodhapotaṃ dadṛśe phalapallavaśobhitam  || 12.09.020 ||
prāguttarasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ tasyāpi dadṛśe śiśum  |
śayānaṃ parṇapuṭake grasantaṃ prabhayā tamaḥ  || 12.09.021 ||
mahāmarakataśyāmaṃ śrīmadvadanapaṅkajam  |
kambugrīvaṃ mahoraskaṃ sunasaṃ sundarabhruvam  || 12.09.022 ||
śvāsaijadalakābhātaṃ kambuśrīkarṇadāḍimam  |
vidrumādharabhāseṣacchoṇāyitasudhāsmitam  || 12.09.023 ||
padmagarbhāruṇāpāṅgaṃ hṛdyahāsāvalokanam  |
śvāsaijadvalisaṃvigna nimnanābhidalodaram  || 12.09.024 ||
cārvaṅgulibhyāṃ pāṇibhyāmunnīya caraṇāmbujam  |
mukhe nidhāya viprendro dhayantaṃ vīkṣya vismitaḥ  || 12.09.025 ||
taddarśanādvītapariśramo mudā protphullahṛtpaulmavilocanāmbujaḥ  |
prahṛṣṭaromādbhutabhāvaśaṅkitaḥ praṣṭuṃ purastaṃ prasasāra bālakam  || 12.09.026 ||
tāvacchiśorvai śvasitena bhārgavaḥ   so'ntaḥ śarīraṃ maśako yathāviśat |
tatrāpyado nyastamacaṣṭa kṛtsnaśo   yathā purāmuhyadatīva vismitaḥ  || 12.09.027 ||*
khaṃ rodasī bhāgaṇānadrisāgarān dvīpān savarṣān kakubhaḥ surāsurān  |
vanāni deśān saritaḥ purākarān kheṭān vrajānāśramavarṇavṛttayaḥ  || 12.09.028 ||
mahānti bhūtānyatha bhautikānyasau kālaṃ ca nānāyugakalpakalpanam  |
yatkiñcidanyadvyavahārakāraṇaṃ dadarśa viśvaṃ sadivāvabhāsitam  || 12.09.029 ||
himālayaṃ puṣpavahāṃ ca tāṃ nadīṃ nijāśramaṃ yatra ṛṣī apaśyata  |
viśvaṃ vipaśyañchvasitācchiśorvai bahirnirasto nyapatallayābdhau  || 12.09.030 ||
tasmin pṛthivyāḥ kakudi prarūḍhaṃ vaṭaṃ ca tatparṇapuṭe śayānam  |
tokaṃ ca tatpremasudhāsmitena nirīkṣito'pāṅganirīkṣaṇena  || 12.09.031 ||
atha taṃ bālakaṃ vīkṣya netrābhyāṃ dhiṣṭhitaṃ hṛdi  |
abhyayādatisaṅkliṣṭaḥ pariṣvaktumadhokṣajam  || 12.09.032 ||
tāvatsa bhagavān sākṣādyogādhīśo guhāśayaḥ  |
antardadha ṛṣeḥ sadyo yathehānīśanirmitā  || 12.09.033 ||
tamanvatha vaṭo brahman salilaṃ lokasamplavaḥ  |
tirodhāyi kṣaṇādasya svāśrame pūrvavatsthitaḥ  || 12.09.034 ||

athomā tamṛṣiṃ vīkṣya giriśaṃ samabhāṣata  |

12.10.008|0 sūta uvāca
ityuktvā tamupeyāya bhagavān sa satāṃ gatiḥ  |
īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāmīśvaraḥ sarvadehinām  || 12.10.008 ||

na veda ruddhadhīvṛttirātmānaṃ viśvameva ca  || 12.10.009 ||
bhagavāṃstadabhijñāya giriśo yogamāyayā  |
āviśattadguhākāśaṃ vāyuśchidramiveśvaraḥ  || 12.10.010 ||
ātmanyapi śivaṃ prāptaṃ taḍitpiṅgajaṭādharam  |
tryakṣaṃ daśabhujaṃ prāṃśumudyantamiva bhāskaram  || 12.10.011 ||
vyāghracarmāmbaraṃ śūla dhanuriṣvasicarmabhiḥ  |
akṣamālāḍamaruka kapālaṃ paraśuṃ saha  || 12.10.012 ||
bibhrāṇaṃ sahasā bhātaṃ vicakṣya hṛdi vismitaḥ  |
kimidaṃ kuta eveti samādhervirato muniḥ  || 12.10.013 ||
netre unmīlya dadṛśe sagaṇaṃ somayāgatam  |
rudraṃ trilokaikaguruṃ nanāma śirasā muniḥ  || 12.10.014 ||

harasya jṛmbhaṇaṃ yuddhe bāṇasya bhujakṛntanam  |
prāgjyotiṣapatiṃ hatvā kanyānāṃ haraṇaṃ ca yat || 12.12.039 ||
caidyapauṇḍrakaśālvānāṃ dantavakrasya durmateḥ  |
śambaro dvividaḥ pīṭho muraḥ pañcajanādayaḥ  || 12.12.040 ||
māhātmyaṃ ca vadhasteṣāṃ vārāṇasyāśca dāhanam  |
bhārāvataraṇaṃ bhūmernimittīkṛtya pāṇḍavān  || 12.12.041 ||
vipraśāpāpadeśena saṃhāraḥ svakulasya ca  |
uddhavasya ca saṃvādo vasudevasya cādbhutaḥ  || 12.12.042 ||
yatrātmavidyā hyakhilā proktā dharmavinirṇayaḥ  |
tato martyaparityāga ātmayogānubhāvataḥ  || 12.12.043 ||
yugalakṣaṇavṛttiśca kalau nṝṇāmupaplavaḥ  |
caturvidhaśca pralaya utpattistrividhā tathā  || 12.12.044 ||
dehatyāgaśca rājarṣerviṣṇurātasya dhīmataḥ  |
śākhāpraṇayanamṛṣermārkaṇḍeyasya satkathā  |
mahāpuruṣavinyāsaḥ sūryasya jagadātmanaḥ  || 12.12.045 ||
iti coktaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā yatpṛṣṭo'hamihāsmi vaḥ  |
līlāvatārakarmāṇi kīrtitānīha sarvaśaḥ  || 12.12.046 ||
patitaḥ skhalitaścārtaḥ kṣuttvā vā vivaśo gṛṇan  |
haraye nama ityuccairmucyate sarvapātakāt || 12.12.047 ||
saṅkīrtyamāno bhagavānanantaḥ śrutānubhāvo vyasanaṃ hi puṃsām  |
praviśya cittaṃ vidhunotyaśeṣaṃ yathā tamo'rko'bhramivātivātaḥ  || 12.12.048 ||
mṛṣā girastā hyasatīrasatkathā na kathyate yadbhagavānadhokṣajaḥ  |
tadeva satyaṃ tadu haiva maṅgalaṃ tadeva puṇyaṃ bhagavadguṇodayam  || 12.12.049 ||
tadeva ramyaṃ ruciraṃ navaṃ navaṃ tadeva śaśvanmanaso mahotsavam  |
tadeva śokārṇavaśoṣaṇaṃ nṛṇāṃ yaduttamaḥślokayaśo'nugīyate  || 12.12.050 ||
na yadvacaścitrapadaṃ hareryaśo   jagatpavitraṃ pragṛṇīta karhicit |
taddhvāṅkṣatīṛthaṃ na tu haṃsasevitaṃ   yatrācyutastatra hi sādhavo'malāḥ  || 12.12.051 ||*
tadvāgvisargo janatāghasamplavo yasmin pratiślokamabaddhavatyapi  |
nāmānyanantasya yaśo'ṅkitāni yatśṛṇvanti gāyanti gṛṇanti sādhavaḥ  || 12.12.052 ||
naiṣkarmyamapyacyutabhāvavarjitaṃ   na śobhate jñānamalaṃ nirañjanam  |
kutaḥ punaḥ śaśvadabhadramīśvare   na hyarpitaṃ karma yadapyanuttamam  || 12.12.053 ||*
yaśaḥśriyāmeva pariśramaḥ paro varṇāśramācāratapaḥśrutādiṣu  |
avismṛtiḥ śrīdharapādapadmayorguṇānuvādaśravaṇādarādibhiḥ  || 12.12.054 ||
avismṛtiḥ kṛṣṇapadāravindayoḥ kṣiṇotyabhadrāṇi ca śaṃ tanoti  |
sattvasya śuddhiṃ paramātmabhaktiṃ jñānaṃ ca vijñānavirāgayuktam  || 12.12.055 ||
yūyaṃ dvijāgryā bata bhūribhāgā yacchaśvadātmanyakhilātmabhūtam  |
nārāyaṇaṃ devamadevamīśamajasrabhāvā bhajatāviveśya  || 12.12.056 ||
ahaṃ ca saṃsmārita ātmatattvaṃ śrutaṃ purā me paramarṣivaktrāt |
prāyopaveśe nṛpateḥ parīkṣitaḥ sadasyṛṣīṇāṃ mahatāṃ ca śṛṇvatām  || 12.12.057 ||
etadvaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ kathanīyorukarmaṇaḥ  |
māhātmyaṃ vāsudevasya sarvāśubhavināśanam  || 12.12.058 ||
ya etatśrāvayennityaṃ yāmakṣaṇamananyadhīḥ  |
ślokamekaṃ tadardhaṃ vā pādaṃ pādārdhameva vā  |
śraddhāvān yo'nuśṛṇuyātpunātyātmānameva saḥ  || 12.12.059 ||
dvādaśyāmekādaśyāṃ vā śṛṇvannāyuṣyavān bhavet |
paṭhatyanaśnan prayataḥ pūto bhavati pātakāt || 12.12.060 ||
puṣkare mathurayāṃ ca dvāravatyāṃ yatātmavān  |
upoṣya saṃhitāmetāṃ paṭhitvā mucyate bhayāt || 12.12.061 ||
devatā munayaḥ siddhāḥ pitaro manavo nṛpāḥ  |
yacchanti kāmān gṛṇataḥ śṛṇvato yasya kīrtanāt || 12.12.062 ||
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni dvijo'dhītyānuvindate  |
madhukulyā ghṛtakulyāḥ payaḥkulyāśca tatphalam  || 12.12.063 ||
purāṇasaṃhitāmetāmadhītya prayato dvijaḥ  |
proktaṃ bhagavatā yattu tatpadaṃ paramaṃ vrajet || 12.12.064 ||
vipro'dhītyāpnuyātprajñāṃ rājanyodadhimekhalām  |
vaiśyo nidhipatitvaṃ ca śūdraḥ śudhyeta pātakāt || 12.12.065 ||
kalimalasaṃhatikālano'khileśo hariritaratra na gīyate hyabhīkṣṇam  |
iha tu punarbhagavānaśeṣamūrtiḥ paripaṭhito'nupadaṃ kathāprasaṅgaiḥ  || 12.12.066 ||
tamahamajamanantamātmatattvaṃ jagadudayasthitisaṃyamātmaśaktim  |
dyupatibhirajaśakraśaṅkarādyairduravasitastavamacyutaṃ nato'smi  || 12.12.067 ||
upacitanavaśaktibhiḥ sva ātmanyuparacitasthirajaṅgamālayāya  |
bhagavata upalabdhimātradhamne suraṛṣabhāya namaḥ sanātanāya  || 12.12.068 ||
svasukhanibhṛtacetāstadvyudastānyabhāvo  'pyajitaruciralīlākṛṣṭasārastadīyam  |
vyatanuta kṛpayā yastattvadīpaṃ purāṇaṃ   tamakhilavṛjinaghnaṃ vyāsasūnuṃ nato'smi  || 12.12.069 ||*
12.13.001|0 sūta uvāca
yaṃ brahmā varuṇendrarudramarutaḥ stunvanti divyaiḥ stavair  vedaiḥ sāṅgapadakramopaniṣadairgāyanti yaṃ sāmagāḥ  |
dhyānāvasthitatadgatena manasā paśyanti yaṃ yogino   yasyāntaṃ na viduḥ surāsuragaṇā devāya tasmai namaḥ  || 12.13.001 ||*
pṛṣṭhe bhrāmyadamandamandaragirigrāvāgrakaṇḍūyanān   nidrāloḥ kamaṭhākṛterbhagavataḥ śvāsānilāḥ pāntu vaḥ  |
yatsaṃskārakalānuvartanavaśādvelānibhenāmbhasāṃ   yātāyātamatandritaṃ jalanidhernādyāpi viśrāmyati  || 12.13.002 ||*
purāṇasaṅkhyāsambhūtimasya vācyaprayojane  |
dānaṃ dānasya māhātmyaṃ pāṭhādeśca nibodhata  || 12.13.003 ||
brāhmaṃ daśa sahasrāṇi pādmaṃ pañconaṣaṣṭi ca  |
śrīvaiṣṇavaṃ trayoviṃśaccaturviṃśati śaivakam  || 12.13.004 ||
daśāṣṭau śrībhāgavataṃ nāradaṃ pañcaviṃśati  |
mārkaṇḍaṃ nava vāhnaṃ ca daśapañca catuḥśatam  || 12.13.005 ||
caturdaśa bhaviṣyaṃ syāttathā pañcaśatāni ca  |
daśāṣṭau brahmavaivartaṃ laiṅgamekādaśaiva tu  || 12.13.006 ||
caturviṃśati vārāhamekāśītisahasrakam  |
skāndaṃ śataṃ tathā caikaṃ vāmanaṃ daśa kīrtitam  || 12.13.007 ||
kaurmaṃ saptadaśākhyātaṃ mātsyaṃ tattu caturdaśa  |
ekonaviṃśatsauparṇaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ dvādaśaiva tu  || 12.13.008 ||
evaṃ purāṇasandohaścaturlakṣa udāhṛtaḥ  |
tatrāṣṭadaśasāhasraṃ śrībhāgavataṃ iṣyate  || 12.13.009 ||
idaṃ bhagavatā pūrvaṃ brahmaṇe nābhipaṅkaje  |
sthitāya bhavabhītāya kāruṇyātsamprakāśitam  || 12.13.010 ||
ādimadhyāvasāneṣu vairāgyākhyānasaṃyutam  |
harilīlākathāvrātā mṛtānanditasatsuram  || 12.13.011 ||
sarvavedāntasāraṃ yadbrahmātmaikatvalakṣaṇam  |
vastvadvitīyaṃ tanniṣṭhaṃ kaivalyaikaprayojanam  || 12.13.012 ||
prauṣṭhapadyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ hemasiṃhasamanvitam  |
dadāti yo bhāgavataṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim  || 12.13.013 ||
rājante tāvadanyāni purāṇāni satāṃ gaṇe  |
yāvadbhāgavataṃ naiva śrūyate'mṛtasāgaram  || 12.13.014 ||
sarvavedāntasāraṃ hi śrībhāgavatamiṣyate  |
tadrasāmṛtatṛptasya nānyatra syādratiḥ kvacit || 12.13.015 ||
nimnagānāṃ yathā gaṅgā devānāmacyuto yathā  |
vaiṣṇavānāṃ yathā śambhuḥ purāṇānāmidaṃ tathā  || 12.13.016 ||
kṣetrāṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ yathā kāśī hyanuttamā  |
tathā purāṇavrātānāṃ śrīmadbhāgavataṃ dvijāḥ  || 12.13.017 ||
śrīmadbhāgavataṃ purāṇamamalaṃ yadvaiṣṇavānāṃ priyaṃ   yasmin pāramahaṃsyamekamamalaṃ jñānaṃ paraṃ gīyate  |
tatra jñānavirāgabhaktisahitaṃ naiṣkarmyamāviskṛtaṃ   tacchṛṇvan supaṭhan vicāraṇaparo bhaktyā vimucyennaraḥ  || 12.13.018 ||*
kasmai yena vibhāsito'yamatulo jñānapradīpaḥ purā   tadrūpeṇa ca nāradāya munaye kṛṣṇāya tadrūpiṇā  |
yogīndrāya tadātmanātha bhagavadrātāya kāruṇyatas  tacchuddhaṃ vimalaṃ viśokamamṛtaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ dhīmahi  || 12.13.019 ||*
namastasmai bhagavate vāsudevāya sākṣiṇe  |
ya idaṃ kṛpayā kasmai vyācacakṣe mumukṣave  || 12.13.020 ||
yogīndrāya namastasmai śukāya brahmarūpiṇe  |
saṃsārasarpadaṣṭaṃ yo viṣṇurātamamūmucat || 12.13.021 ||
bhave bhave yathā bhaktiḥ pādayostava jāyate  |
tathā kuruṣva deveśa nāthastvaṃ no yataḥ prabho  || 12.13.022 ||
nāmasaṅkīrtanaṃ yasya sarvapāpa praṇāśanam  |
praṇāmo duḥkhaśamanastaṃ namāmi hariṃ param  || 12.13.023 ||
